names.d:
Aaliyah, please stop texting. In fact, here, give me the phone. Thanks, now, here at career day do you really think the secrets to the universe are in that device of yours? What are you going to do with your life, Aaliyah? You do know that you can do whatever you want, all you have to do is start. But to determine where you’re headed you’ll have to look around you and spend some time getting in touch with who you are, not staring into this bloody phone. You with me? 
No? Okay, (sigh) here’s your phone back. Let’s talk again later...
Management.
Ab is what Abby turns into after the day is done, and when she can put her feet up and relax

Yeah, spell her name with an 'ey', just a 'y', or any which way you like, you're still going to be dealing with a funny, pragmatic, intelligent woman who, most of the time, is fun and laid back. And if she starts bitching about how you've mis-spelt her name, hand her a Bloody Mary (if she's old enough) and tell her to stop complaining.
Whether she’s your teacher, work colleague, wife, lover, mother or friend, Abby is unavoidable and inevitable, and for all the right reasons.

You're kidding me, right? You're not? Well shit Abcde, your parents should be arrested and thrown in an Indonesian jail. They say a moron is born every minute and your parents lucked out on that front. Okay, here’s what we’ll do. We’ll get a SWAT team and come and get you. If your parents shoot at us we’ll take them out – don’t worry, they won’t feel a thing – and get you off to a good school with a proper diet and good friends who philosophically constitute more than a pack of pigs grunting over swill in the welfare trough.
‘The Abigail’ is a prawn trawler built for a purpose and not for speed or adulation. Those who sail on her love her.

The sunset is about an hour away. The young man sits in their favourite restaurant, high up on the cliff over-looking the giant sea-filled crater that is Santorini, Greece. He's been going out with Abra for a while now and she's the one. He knows it. She knows it too. He hears a voice behind him. His palms are sweaty. Abra walks in with that big smile, all clean and fresh from a shower after a languid, blissful day spent lying on a beach at the back of island. 'Hi honey,' she says. He toys with the little box under the table and smiles back. Win, lose or draw, there's nowhere else he'd rather be on earth right now...

Acacia loves people and she is extremely friendly. However, she is prone to relax and forget about her greater ambitions once she's comfortable somewhere, and this might mean simply being around people she likes. And that's fine - there are others living much worse lives than her. Make yourself a little rule, Acacia: never attend a cash register and never accept a job behind a desk. Beyond that, good luck!

No, she’s not dull although I suppose once upon a time you may have been correct to describe her as a little shy. Acaxia, you don't have to go along with the crowd. Sometimes, sure, but not always. Find your own path Mother Goose and stick to your guns.
Message from Management: If she has any, throw out all makeup....at least for three months.

You'll often see old people of Asian heritage practising her, for Ada is a special secret method of Tai Chi. If employed correctly, she generates a very high vibrational level within the soul, and a lovely, light and special smile upon one's face.
Adalita is a hopeless romantic who tends to avoid confrontations, unless she’s called Addie of course, in which case we’ll end it here and suggest you skip on down to the in-your-face-trouble maker.

Addie is one of the few girls in the Kingdom who will go to extraordinary lengths to set up an ‘accidental’ date with the man/woman she’s besotted by. You might question why not just get their phone number or stalk them on fucking Facebook, but where is the art in that? Addie was born to make every moment memorable, and by god she does a good job. Addie, you’re a legend.
Callum's sister. And they are very similar in that regard.
A banshee before she was born, Adelaide is the life of the party on a good day and a dangerous psychopath on a bad one.

Life has a certain rhythm to it and it changes. Rather than fight it, sometimes the trick is to let the flow carry you. The answers, if your eyes are open, will often appear quite mysteriously. (They're actually around us all the time, but that's another story.) Anyway, Adeline is very adept at giving herself to the flow.

Something in her name throws her way out there, almost beyond reach and nearly completely isolated. But, once you get there Adele is lovely, and sensual, and intelligent, and funny, and anyone who knows her could go on and on…

Thank God for Ado, eh? It's a stinking hot day on deck and the crew feel like a dip, here in the middle of the ocean, and that's fine. And you can all swim with some level of comfort because, see that spunk up there in the white bikini? Holding a rifle? Well, she's not just a pretty face, let me tell you. If a shark comes anywhere near the surface they won't be around here for long....
Adrian is intolerant of fools and she thinks ahead. A great leader.

The B-grade actress who is happy enough to work on Days of Our Lives for 10 years. Yeah, she’s a bit of a prima donna but deep down she’s quite chilled out, and so long as she’s somewhere near the centre of attention she’s happy enough.
The mature one in the group, no matter how she appears on the outside. She always puts forward good ideas and she should have gone into politics.
Does anyone really know her? She’s intelligent and she’s normal but, let’s face it, not that many people are permitted in the front gates.

No, she doesn't take life too seriously. Her parents are too musical for that. Her smile is wider than the Irish Sea and her friends are scattered around the planet like wee dots of glittering confetti. If she gets to town you'll hear about it because there'll be a party. Don't you worry about that.

Yes, it's true, not everyone can handle the name of a superhero or some kind of mythical creature (Afrika's parents, after all, are a few ostriches short of a full paddock.) In this case, however, that's doing them a disservice for Afrika apologises for nothing. She is a brazen, funny lass who is completely aware her parents are missing those ostriches, and that only makes her love them all the more. Her smile is neither small nor flippant, and she leaves a nice memory wherever she goes.

Afton deals only with open and shut cases and she deplores duplicity in people. 
“Do you mean what you say or are you wasting my time?” – you’ll hear her say that quite often to clients.
Ag speaks the truth, she’s funny and overall she’s bloody good value but she is about as prissy and sensitive as the Tanami, the Gobi or the Sahara in the middle of any of their respective summers.

Agata sees passed all bullshit, her laughter is never false, she does what she says she’s going to do and she secretly weeps the tears of the stratosphere when she hears of great suffering of those she doesn’t even know.
A busybody. A stickybeak. A cooker of cakes.

Some women simply aren't romanced enough, are they? How can a fellow expect greatness when he rings a woman at 1am, intoxicated by both alcohol and his own ego, and slurs, “Howdy love…. (hiccup)…. God you're gorgeous! I miss you! Can I come round?”
Like Di, Bev, Deb, Sue and Lyn after her, Agnes has worked too hard and given too much for that kind of shit. Best of all she’s funny, and whether she’s in the middle of her too-many chores or not.
Ahkim has probably walked the Earth before. It might explain her constant, calming smile, and her apparent prior knowledge of nearly everything. Is she Cantonese?

We’ve spoken to the psychics and while they’re not always accurate, they unanimously agree. They foresee marriage to a man with tattoos on his face and neck, which is fine, I suppose, but they also foresee a big belly at a young age, and they foresee several years of toil.
So, screw that Aicha! Prove them wrong. Get fully educated, just for the hell of it, then come let us know what happens…

A snap decision made in the heat of battle which is both correct and uncompromising is something that Aila will never have to do, either metaphorically or literally. She's a quiet peace-loving lass who isn't into confrontation or dangerous situations. Nice clothes, though.
Can you imagine Ailana in the olden days crossing frontier country with a horse and a wagon? She'd last 20 minutes.

Does a larger heart exist? Aileen is the kind of lady who might spend years working for the Salvation Army. The young and down-trodden, the drug-affected, the homeless, the bereft of hope - she treats all and everyone with love, and it gets her everywhere. Which begs the question, What do you do to help?
Aili is a nice lass but there is some question as to her capacity to produce a sustained effort. Aili, what do you have to say about that?

Big smile with braces, although nothing is forever. Ailie is just winding herself up in life. It'll take several years for her to reach her full speed and until then we'll just keep tabs on her occasionally. Forget the hype, she's not the gentle, vulnerable little girl you thought she was.
A mercenary. Currently she's in Northern Pakistan - we don't know why and we don't want to know - and she loves it. She's never heard of Valentine's Day.
A howling drunk and not the wailing damsel in distress, drunk. More like the howling at the moon like a fucking werewolf, drunk. Maybe she’s from Ireland or New Zealand? (Apologies if she isn’t.)
Ainslea is intensely loyal. Her conservative skin hides a core that is ready to burst into song at any moment.

Like a large wave jacking up before it hits the shore, Ainslee will put up with a fair bit until she lets all her frustrations out, generally in a single, energetic moment. Does she suffer from not expelling her negative emotions as soon as she experiences them? Well, perhaps, but then again, as a sensitive soul she expects the best from people so you can't blame her for hoping things improve. Intensely passionate (if not highly secretive) in matters of love.

Ainsleigh loathes the idea of public speaking, which is a pity. As a thoughtful and incredibly compassionate person she has a lot to give, and a lot of wisdom to impart. Her path through life hasn't always been an easy one and it's for this very reason she'd be wonderful working for any organisation dedicated to helping others.
Yes, I'd read the girl above and below her on the list, and Ainsley is therefore well placed in the middle. It's just how it is sometimes.

Ainslie is the kind of lass at the engineering firm who will cast an eye over the new piece of equipment, talk to the heads of department and give a yay or nay about it's implementation. This is no time for jokes or frivolous statements. There is a lot involved here, as well as the jobs of around 90 people.

Not so humble. Not so meek. Ainun is a modern lass very aware of the effect she has on the opposite sex and on her underlings. Theoretically, she’ll grow out of this arrogance and one day she will remember that a healthy ego is alright, for each of us, so long as it is ultimately directed at the assistance of others. You up for that Ainun?

Rarely insecure, Airlie doesn't so much as walk into a room as she glides. Yes, she's using her feet but what is it? Is it her smile that does it? Perhaps it's her air of silliness at the ready? I wonder if it's because we know she probably won't stay for long, but the attention she receives lifts her up in our vision, somehow. We're not sure but she's wonderful.

Another modern girl who is adept at squeezing the most from a situation. She’d be great to have around if your washing machine decided to spit the dummy and the sodden towels needed to be wrung out, manually, for instance.

Aisling is like a brand new, thick rubber band. She's smooth and flexible, and she wraps herself around people/ideas/strange situations in ways that force you to think she is a perfect fit. Yes, it's true, she can direct her anger/frustrations in a very poignant manner, which occasionally inflicts ‘harm’ on people, but it's not really harm now is it. The truth can hurt, and this is all she's doing. She'd make wonderful old, and very funny Matriarch.
The gorgeous Kyoto rebel.
Alana rhymes with A Good Lie Down. She’d love to be viewed as being mysterious and sexually exotic – who doesn’t? – and when she’s on her own she absolutely is.

If Alanna is hammering nails into a floor, and there might be 1200 of them, if she makes a single hammer-whack that isn't perfectly straight and functional, she'll be disappointed in herself. No, she doesn't have OCD and she's not that fretful to talk to or deal with, she just believes that if you're going to do something, you might as well do it well. She's watchful in relationships and with her kids, probably too much sometimes, but this is the life. Oh yeah, don't spell her name wrong....

There's a new sport on the scene. It's called Roller Derby. Have you heard of it? Anyway, it's violent, fast and furious and Alannah is a natural. She’s broken some bones and just have a look at that smile, will you? Her Game Name is Raunchy and Rambunctious!

Alara is wiser than her peers and far more knowledgeable about what she’s doing in the world and where her life is headed. She’s never going to get pregnant too young - well, we hope - and she can’t stand people who fuck around with basic problems for hours. She looks down the barrel when she looks at you and she expects you to do the same. If you don’t, you’re out. Her finances are in order and she makes love with great intensity, which might be a product of not meeting nearly enough good lovers.

Alaska, were you conceived in Anchorage or are your parents first-order crazies? I wonder. Anyway, if it's the former you're lucky you weren't made in Riyadh, otherwise we'd be calling you Saudi Arabia and nothing much grows there, I can tell you. Anyway, here we are Alaska, and you're a fun and enthusiastic girl whose first response to a question is usually yes. We suggest you keep it up, we like you a lot, but can you send  your folks off to an institution? Thanks. Management.

You know that scene from many-a-romantic comedy: It's night time and a suitor is outside throwing little rocks at the window of that special someone on the first floor who they're trying to get the attention of? Well, here in the real world, the person outside trying to get the attention of her betrothed is Alax, but she doesn't appear to be the brightest spark because (A) she's a good throw and (B) the rocks she brought aren't small. The result is a busted window, a titillated betrothed and irate, screaming home owners.
See the male Doc.

Alayna, it's time to stand up and roar. The sun is shining outside, every potential moment of wonder is therefore right there in front of you and all you have to do is CHARGE, BY GOD!!! Don't lie down. Stand up and jump!

A judicious lass who thinks about what she's doing, as well as enjoying herself. For some reason, if you go around to her house for a visit you will always find her in rather unusual positions. The last time I visited she was out the back trying to play a trombone she picked up at a garage sale. The time before that she was up a ladder inside her lounge room endeavouring to weld a sculpture she had hanging from the bloody ceiling. In fact, if you're bored, just drop in and say hello. She's quite a fascinating woman and you can't blame her for looking a little distracted most of the time.

Alicie is a relaxed character who, like Trevor, believes in a fair reward for a fair day's effort. She deplores the welfare system as she believes it institutionalises the masses. Having said all that, she helps out with community projects and does what she can. Better suited to a rural life with fresh air.
The nonchalant chip off the old block whose refreshing and unexpected ways belie her inner drive. She’s smart, but she’s not a smart-arse.

George Clooney smiles up at her from the deck of his expensive wooden speedboat and takes her hand while she steps from the dock. Soon, they are speeding across the waters of an Italian lake heading to his private island where servants, incredible food, stunning wine and a large boudoir await. At least, this is the reverie Alech finds herself in just as her little brother begins banging on the bathroom door. Dismayed at her domestic surrounds that contain her family, she sinks her head beneath the surface of the bath water and prays for a day when she can leave all of this behind....
Alecia fully intends to pursue a career on television; in front of the camera, not behind it.

Jittery? I don't think so. 'Aleena' has a smooth beginning and a nice ramp at the end and it means that she blends an agreeable proportion of drive and relaxed humour into her life at the same time, encouraging her friends, helping where possible and advising where she sees fit. (Note: there's a tattoo on her hip that she really wishes she never got, but we all live and learn.)
In a past life her name was Richard.

Pressure cooker situations: she deals with them very well. Alesha has an analytical mind and she's very comfortable inside her skin. The only downside in all of this, if you'd call it that, is that she sometimes finds it difficult to spot the forest for the trees. 
For example, if Alesha and her partner were on a row boat that they'd hired and were now out in the middle of a big lake - with all the right stuff for a long, lazing picnic lunch on the water under a brolly - given all she's had to organise for it to happen, it may not occur to her that the two of them can make love without being seen from shore, basically any time they like. Once it's suggested though, no worries!
If Alessandra is ever forced to wear cheap sunglasses her heart begins to have palpitations.

Alessia can wag her sexy tail with the best of them. Is she prone to doing slightly less than what is required? I suppose there might be some debate about that, but in a life which attracts a lot of attention it’s sometimes difficult to remember what the hell one is supposed to be doing. Maybe that’s the key for Alessia? To remove herself from distractions and focus on what she desires, and how she wants to see her world.

An Eastern European motorbike that is loud, belches smoke and carries-on if she's been left in the cold, and who will rile against her rider just so they remember who is in charge. Ain't nothing subtle about Ms Aleta!

Never just an ornament, Alethea is a girl raised in an educated household, and who isn’t as formal as she sounds. Yes, she’s organised and intelligent, but there is levity in her step and she possesses a quirky sense of humour. Is she kinky? Well, she probably hasn’t the time to think about it, although we can tell you that she’s never bored for very long, and she would prefer a clean kitchen to a messy one. Yes, everyone likes a clean kitchen, but by noon the following day after a big, loud dinner party, you can expect Alethea’s kitchen to be pretty schmick, no matter how many reds she consumed. It’s just how it is. 
Alethea.

Alex is a control freak and the name of a roll of barbed wire. Sexy, yes, intelligent, yes, but rile her at your peril! On the flip side she loves fiercely, she’s totally kinky and she can usually see the future. Not bad eh?
Alexa drags her husband around the shopping centre - a rather exclusive and expensive shopping precinct - by the ear.
‘Where’s my pony, mother? I WANT MY PONY!!’
Best friends with Tricia.

A city girl who is quite beautiful. She has a billion equally mysterious friends and if she is ever sad about something you will never know. No one knows if she works or not, and I guess some people are afforded that luxury, in which case she needs our congratulations.
Alexis is the sensation you feel when you hop into an old Mercedes with dodgy suspension and drive fast along a heavily corrugated road.

Alfie is dream boat, albeit in a tomboy-kind of way. She’s empathetic, she’s optimistic, she doesn’t buy into the crap most of us are laboured with here in the western world and as a result literally EVERYONE wants to be her friend. Like Annie, however, you’ll be hard pressed to see her for very long. She’s a great traveller, she has a delicious smile and you’ll hardly ever see her with a wedding ring on her finger.

A listener, a teller and the fulcrum and shock absorber of any mechanical or chaotic system, though she is usually a tremendous energy generator in her own right. Her ego usually lies just beneath the surface…usually. Either way, Ali is delicious.
Razor sharp, relaxed and adventurous all at once. Nothing gets passed this girl.
She wouldn't, of course, but she'd love to have collagen injected into her lips. I mean, who doesn't??

A walking dichotomy: Apart from being sexy and intelligent, she has a huge ego that requires lots of maintenance yet she knows (and has an interest in) nearly everyone. She’s cool in a crisis but then again she’ll fly off the handle if she discovers someone else has been using her hairbrush. And if she takes a dislike to you, then you’ll never hear the daggers being thrust into your back.

A calm child and a thoughtful adult, Alida doesn't really take part in silliness. Perhaps she should? There's more to life than work. Having said that, being a professional referee means she gets to travel the world which she enjoys. Germany is her favourite country.

Intricate, demanding and organised, if she's ever on a blind date and realises the person sitting opposite doesn't cut the mustard, she will immediately thank them for turning up before briefly explaining to them that they just don't (and will never) turn her on. Date over. Why waste your time on things that don't matter?
An ET trapped in a human body - there's a few of them roaming amongst us - but she's racked with amnesia. The poor thing thinks she's a human, god love her.

Never unreliable, Aline aligns herself with a life plan in the same way the pilot of a large commercial airliner makes a final approach to land. Not prone to outlandish public rants or getting caught doing lewd things in a dark alley on the way home from the theatre, Aline's life is smooth and content, and dare we say it - predictable. I wonder how the chaos of motherhood sits with her? Anyway, Aline is lovely and she acts as something of a maintaining lubricating oil for the clunky parts of her friends' lives, who crave her company as something of a rock. .

She's no racoon, but she's definitely a busy beaver and the busier the better. Great under pressure (indeed, pressure, she'll say, is nothing other than a means to get the best out of yourself!) Alinta is a great event/project management, in fact any job that needs a capable captain who can deal with 50 tasks at once. Raising a family?....a mere trifle! And because she's busy she's fit, which is part of the reason boys love her.
Sure, she's a bit of a snob but she's actually quite talented.

Sweet as pie and with a very cute grin, men do have a tendency to fall at her feet a bit. But, she's more than just a pretty face gents/admirers/prospective partners. One of her knacks is discovering neat little ways to get around problems, almost right at the last minute. True, sometimes she's not always successful, but she'll tell you that the lessons learnt in the mistakes only propel one to greatness somewhere else, later, which means bad bits don't actually exist in the first place. In short, don't take Alisa lightly.

Alisha went to uni but didn't really know why. She used her degree for a while then got bored, then kind of fluffed around for a while, secretly searching for that thing in life which would fill her with passion. She hates that all her friends are so brain-washed into thinking they need a partner to keep them happy, and she berates herself for feeling that way herself, from time to time. This subtle dissatisfaction is why she says yes to new adventures so quickly, to see if the secret to her life is hidden under the next rock. Maybe it's love. Maybe it's a pass-time. She's not sure and neither are we. Note from Management: Alisha, this moment here is perfect for you. Breathe in, breathe out, and take a moment to calm your soul and consider what it is you truly want, then start. There’s no rush.

Here we have another rather sensual and sexy smart arse. Breaks rules and hearts, pretends she's never done either, and often leaves a mess. Motherhood is going to be funny to watch when all the chickens come home to roost!

Alison gives people the benefit of the doubt unless they’re obvious fools, in which case she’ll nod politely, above the table, while tapping the foot of her husband/boyfriend/partner beneath it. Indeed, Alison is contained yet not reluctant.
....bullshit. She couldn’t lie to save her life.

The name of a hair dresser who talks constantly and with so much arm movement that she's accidentally cut the ears of customers with her scissors. Not badly, mind you. They always come back. Mostly because it appears that Aliyah is the Hub of All Gossip.
If 'Alana' rhymes with a good lie down, then Allanah rhymes with a good lie down next to a swimming pool.

Tougher and more stoic than you'd imagine, Allara isn't so much frugal and a little thrifty as she is a tiny bit pedantic. She probably needs to be because a stack of her friends seem to be all over the bloody shop and are therefore completely unreliable. She looks deeply into the soul of the boys she likes, trying to ascertain their deeper intentions, and her take on people is pretty good. She trusts her gut instincts, as she should, but she seems to look a little frustrated when she's working. No one knows why. A good friend to have in a dicey situation.
The magic elixir of seduction.
The gorgeous little nymph from the island of Crete, in the Mediterranean Sea. She’s funny, she’s happy and she’s delightfully unpredictable.
Yes, Allie is a happy, calm and clear thinking scientist, and it's for these reasons that she is DEADLY with a handgun.

Allira, let's bust this mould together. Do something stupid and something totally inappropriate, just to see what it feels like. THEN we can begin! Things don't have to be cool and organised all the time, you know.

Yes, in this case the double 'l' makes no difference. Allison therefore gives people the benefit of the doubt unless they’re obvious fools, in which case she’ll nod politely, above the table, while tapping the foot of her husband/boyfriend/partner beneath it. Indeed, Allison (like her twin) is contained yet not reluctant.
The Scottish haggis. Google it if you don't know what that is. It's usually eaten in a loud and happy setting, where thoughts of responsibilities, civil or otherwise, are none of anyone’s business.
Oh well, it's better than being a bloody kitchen hand all your life.

The sensual analyser who understands the bigger picture, as well as endeavouring to seek answers to those questions that arise from behind the scenes. It’s a busy life but somehow she manages to keep it all together and retain her rather cool (if not occasionally secretive-looking) exterior.
The name of a stunning Blue Russian who is in full heat.
Spit and polish.

A maker and executioner of a well laid-out plan. Invariably there are nooks and crannies, and sexy little surprises mixed-in with the booby traps, all of which aim to (A) entertain her and (B) toughen you up. Alodie is lovely and she doesn’t come lightly. Suffice to say, if Alodie is looking at you with sexy, super-heated blood in her veins then you’re not going to have much say in whether you’re going to be attacked or not. So good luck!
Nowhere near as sharp as her sister (Alice), Alyce cruises along with the tide of life, which takes her this way and that. But it's a nice tide and a fun ride, and she does alright at the finish.

You know how the Hulk runs through brick walls and tosses cars around and stuff? Well, this ain't Alyse. She's more like that girl out of the movie Chasing Amy, aside from one small, albeit quite important detail: Alyse isn't really ever sobbing and yelling at someone in a public place. She tends to see that shit coming a fair way off, which enables her to nip problems in the bud before they fester and burn the house down. 
Attitude towards Public Displays of Affection: Probably not face-sucking park-kissing.....more like hand-holding and gentle whispers in ears. Alyse.

Men smother her with attention so life is often quite easy for this one. Doors open quickly and they shut only when she deems fit, it seems. True, a working responsibility isn't her business but we all have a groove to deal with, in one way or another. Pools, friends, sunshine - this are the things that make Alyss tick.

Alyssa is the sound of a marlin fin slicing through the surface of the sea. A beautiful creation of nature, the great fish is curvy and sexy but not if she leaps into the boat with all that chaos and ill-directed energy, which you hear about happening occasionally.

Loves the kitchen. Loves cooking loves eating and loves lots of friends in there with her while it's happening. She prefers quality over quantity. She reads everything she can get her hands on and she's never rappelled down a mountain or jumped from a plane. When she falls in love she falls as deeply as anyone can, which means she might need to be careful who she gives her love to.
Your mouth stays open at the end of saying her name, and this is the preamble to discovering how delicious and rare she really is. What is it about Amanda?

Hmmm, well, yes, Amani has an ego larger than Bangladesh in its entirety, and we'll leave you to decide if this is a good thing or not. Certainly, if a world calamity struck, Amani might not last beyond the first wave of casualties. Then again, maybe she'd surprise us. Perhaps all this selfie-energy and this huge desire to be at the front line of cutting edge fashion and style would be directed to saving herself and others in a no-holds-barred fashion. Then again, maybe being extremely cute in a modern world is what moulded her in the first place. What do you think Amani?....Are we talking crap or not??

Attentive, frisky and highly observant, Amarech is rarely bored because she's very aware of how wonderful life can be. What a tremendous person to know, be it as a lover, a friend or just someone you bump into while walking down the street.

On one level Amaria is flamboyant and funny, on another level she likes to have all the safeguards in place before she acts. Why is that? We're not sure. It might be because her parents did it tough when they were younger and instilled in her a sense of carefulness. Don't get us wrong, Amaria is a funny lass with plenty of friends, and she loves a gathering, but yes, it's true, sometimes Amaria frets over things which, let's face it, don't matter a flying rissole to the state of the universe. (Having said all that, I never want to fly with Korean Airlines either.)
Amaya keeps her chocolates hidden!

Option A:  Amber has $10,000 boobs, wears an incredibly tight skirt and charges between $300 and $800 per hour – depending on the weather and how busy it is.

Option B:  Tree hugger.

Amberlee aches to be on the 'X-factor', 'Someone's got Talent', or any number of those insane TV shows where people stand up and try to get themselves famous. Girl, you know this already, but the answer is inside, not outside.

Her name stands up straight and makes you do the same. She expects your attention and she will give you hers if she deems you worthy. That sounds very snobbish but she's not that bad, to be honest. Her parents raised her in the same way they raised their Scottish terriers - they expect her to show intelligence, a hint of arrogance and they don't expect her to date boys who are beneath her. (If they found out Amberley was gay, and not many of them are, they would die.)

Ambrosia is over-flowing like a glass which has had coke poured into it far too quickly. For a second it looks delicious and exciting, until it dawns on you that you are faced with little to drink and a mess. Her romantic life is usually a fucking disaster.
Ameisha is a clever girl who possesses a wonderful sense of occasion. And that, my friends, requires a thing called patience and foresight.

As a vast expanse of North Australian desert, Amelia rhymes with “Aaah, Christ it’s hot...” Not much grows there and not much wants to. If you intend to visit I’d take plenty of water and definitely tell someone where you’re headed. Bon voyage. (Which is to say, Amelia is a skilled, determined and intensely independent woman.)
Great things are always expected of her, and that is always possible, but Amelie is actually quite shy.
Amellie, take your foot off the clutch honey and let it roar! You'll be okay… (it's insured, no matter what happens, and the roll-cage is impregnable.)
Seductive, refined and mysterious, Amera incites wonder and intrigue in all who meet her. Men want to gobble her up and women want to know how she does it.

A'mhara has just finished her 9 week rehab course and is doing well these days. We're really proud of her. She's putting on weight again and she's got colour back in her cheeks. It's a beautiful thing. She's even laughing, which lights up the whole room up.

Not as charismatic as her more gorgeous and volatile cousin (Amy), Amie is a good soul full of decent causes and fun-loving desires, although she more fearful of death and/or some kind of public embarrassment.
Conscientious and secretive.

Can anyone tell us why Amra is continually misread as being overly serious?....coz' we don't get it either. Anyway, be that as it may, Amra is a highly energetic lass who doesn't spend much time mired in regret. Highly educated and informed, she has an excellent memory and has oodles of common sense.
Beautiful and sensitive, Amy rides a motorbike, rolls a mean joint, does a thousand things at once and often has far too much energy for any man to catch. If only they were so lucky!

Heavens to Betsy, she was shot at during a recent trip to Brazil, her drink was spiked in London, that bull in Texas tried to skewer her in half and only yesterday, in Brisbane, an Australia Post van ran off the road and crashed into a fence right in front of her. Lucky she was texting (no hands) on her push bike at the time otherwise she would have died. This sort of near-catastrophe seems to follow her around. Sadly, or happily, she wouldn't have it any other way.

With a personality that could easily be described as moderate and crisp, Ana is slightly unfinished and as a result she needs and/or wants more attention than most. Not to be messed with in the morning.

No, don't be silly, Anaise isn’t bitter at all. In fact, she’s the exact opposite. (Unless she’s Swiss. Is she Swiss? And even then, it’s not a case of being bitter, she’s just too bloody organised and therefore leaves no space for instant, chaotic moments of crazy inspiration.)
Anyway, yes, Anaise is a very smart lass who travels with a plan. She’s shy around boys until she spies the one she really wants, then fuckin’ look out. To summarise, Anaise is never obnoxious, she asks lots of questions, she enjoys a short manageable hairdo and her mission of peace is rarely misunderstood.
Beautiful, zany and completely unorganised.
Weird name, amazing girl. If she isn’t donking saltwater crocodiles on the head with a special saltwater crocodile donking stick, she’s telling jokes while making sandwiches. Anaxe.

Anchalee has a Thai/European heritage which provides her with a wise head. For instance, she flies to Bangkok to get her hair and eye lashes done and by doing so, saves a packet. Cost: Hair $850 (plus extensions), lashes $150.
Professional snooker player. If she's lining up for a kill on the black, earthquakes, gunshots and other mild distractions aren't enough to put her off.

Andrea says the following phrases quite often: ‘No! Not again!’,  ‘Oh, look, I’m so sorry! Oh dear!’ and ‘Have you got insurance?’ (Note: if she's wearing lots of bling then she doesn't utter those phrases at all. In which case she'll capably lead the charge, be it socially, on horseback or into the front line.)

Andrine knows how to prioritise. If she is going on a camping trip in her new four-wheel drive, for example, and she is trying, unsuccessfully, to fit a super-frozen bag of ice into the esky that happens to be next to the car, she will instinctively wrench the bag from the vessel and swing it against the vehicle, slamming it against the fresh duco in order to break up the ice so it can fit around the beer.

The consummate professional who rarely looks flustered even if she is. Unfortunately she spooks a lot of men, but the usual rules apply here: Anees the good ones are always worth the wait, and they always show up eventually!

Aneka performs best when conditions are tough. You can imagine her in a tent on a mountain side in a blizzard, hunkered down in minus 35 degrees, wrapped up in all the high-tech gear which was designed for serious trekking, and God-knows Aneka doesn't head into such places ill-prepared. Slightly uncomfortable around inane conversations and inane individuals, Aneka is the real deal and a no-nonsense personality. Not given to bed hopping, Aneka discovers her kindred spirit and together they form an unbreakable bond.

No, she's not the greatest confrontationist but then again how many people really are? As a rather stylish cat Anélise looks the part, she fits the bill and she makes her way through and around most urban landscapes with comfort and panache. Camping out in the African wilderness for weeks on end, photographing the animals, for instance, with nothing but a tent and a single local guide whose only weapon is a spear and a big toothy grin, is never going to be her idea of a fun time. Give her some mod-cons and a car that's no junk heap and she's halfway to being happy.

Mmmm....well.....if she's a bottle blonde, then all the Blonde Jokes you ever heard were written about her. i.e: she's gorgeous and she has the IQ of a donut. But, if Anessa is a brunette, and we suspect with long silky brunette hair, then she's a mischievous little dynamo who wins the heart of just about everyone, and who takes ages to make her (generally correct) decisions.
The Nun.
Fun-loving and frivolous, Anetta is angered only by boredom.
See Annette.

Good old Ang’. The remnants of the chaotic Angela, Angel and Angeline loom large on her horizon but when she’s here, Ang' is more relaxed than anywhere and certainly good fun to have around. Watch out for that repressed temper, although...
Yeah, no she's not. She is the only person that matters and as such she is a walking disaster.
The Angela is the act of colliding your little toe into the bottom corner of a cupboard that you happen to be walking past. Great fun.
Demonstrative and sensual. Very long legs.

Angelina is actually the name given to the act of driving across a major city in broad daylight whilst stark naked. Is it fun? Kind of. Is it sexy? Nearly. Is it terrifying? Usually. Are you glad you did it? Yeah, probably.

The Angeline is the name of the expression which develops on your face after you eat a large spoonful of delicious-looking strawberry yogurt that, after increasing seconds, you realise is probably off. Indeed, it might be very off. (Is she a control freak? Well, maybe yes maybe no, but she's an excellent leader and a skilled and passionate lover. Ain't no one and nothing is perfect.)

You're flying down the hill on your bike, and i mean FLYING! The wind is in your hair and you're screaming out aloud. But wait! You're going too fast! Speed wobbles! Panic! You start to squeal! Then, to your horror, you hit a divot in the road and suddenly you're careering off the bitumen! You can't see the ground for grass but you're about to disappear into a ditch and die! The grass crashes hard into your legs! Pain is surely imminent! And then, just as quickly as it began, the grass kind of stops you in your tracks. Just like that.
There was no pain. There was no death. And now you find yourself sitting on your bike seat, laughing hysterically at how you didn't just die.
Angelique.
Placid on the outside, fiery in the middle when she needs to be. She can drink, she’s passionate in bed and she doesn’t fucking-well dilly-dally. Amen.

Lucky they didn’t call you South Straddie or Trestles, eh? Anyway, Angourie’s parents spent a lot of time surfing and/or having sex in the waters of northern NSW, Australia. You can’t blame them really. As it is, Angourie is a well-rounded lass who doesn’t spend too much time or money adorning herself to resemble some kind of parrot covered in multi-coloured plumage. She delves into her loves and her causes with a high level of commitment, although there is a chance she’ll spend years living in the forest of some hinterland, somewhere. She’s an Earth girl, all right.
The black sheep of any family whose foul moods are worse and more tempestuous than most. Boys are crazy about her but are never sure how to approach her.

For a girl whose approach to life is rather perpendicular, success comes easily and often. All those k’s and a’s in her name shoot her off in all kinds of unheralded, tangential directions and rarely is she disappointed. 

Does that make sense?…

If Anila were a car she'd be an Aston Martin, or a Bentley, or on a sensual day, perhaps even a BMW. She leaves no lose ends, you see. She works hard and expects you to do the same. If you make a mistake that's fine, just tell her about it as soon as it happens so she can organise what she needs to organise. Like Silvia way after her, wasting time is something she's never done and she is fiercely loyal!

Yes, well, initially, Anisha has it sussed. Her business plan is sound, she invites the right people to help her and she appears to have the resources, but at the first hurdle she becomes highly frustrated and easily distracted. Anisha, the universe does this deliberately, you understand? It's asking you a question: Do you believe?
So come on, buck up! We’re looking for direction. Stop frowning. Where to now?...

The seductive gym head. Don’t waste your time by asking her anything about any modern political system, any of the world wars or even the factors affecting climate change. She does her job. She gets paid. She goes out. She goes to the gym. Repeat. And yes, she does have a penchant for men who have spent so much time pumping weights they look like someone has shoved a bike pump up their arse and given-to until it seems their skin and blood vessels are about to burst.
Anita is an honest if not deceptively restless soul who leaves many tasks in her life slightly unfinished.

“Come on,” she says playfully. “Hurry up. I don’t want to be late!”
She doesn’t say it because she’s antsy about getting there on time, but because she loves life – loves all the big, fun, social bits – and wants to share in it as much as she can before she gets old. She's as smart and playful as a monkey.
The Juggler, be it kids, jobs, cars, men, women, friends, time, employees, lovers, hairdos, shoes, knickers, rings….i.e: pick a number.
Anje has it ‘goin on’ in all areas, and she’s not to be taken lightly. Tres smart, tres cute and sufficiently unforgettable, actually, is our Anje.

Anjel, a quick word. Just come here for  a second…..come close so I can whisper…..you listening? Okay, now, your parents: you need to leave them. They're not right in the head, you see. Yes, they mean well, and they do love you, in their own twisted way, but as soon as you're old enough get the flock out of Dodge City,. Good luck. (Note: Anjel is tough.)

Her name is a sexy little journey over hill and down dale on a very expensive mountain bike, through sunshine and occasional rain and mud, and where unexpected people and obstacles appear at every turn. 
So, there are only a few questions one might need to ask oneself when planning to meet up with the saucy Anjila:

(A) Can I keep up?

(B) Am I ready to party?

(C) Will I ever have time to just lounge around and relax for a few hours?

(D) Are my stomach muscles up for it?...(the laughter, that is.)

Anyway, you'll work it out, but don't give her the fucking car keys.

Good luck. Management.
The Sexy Clown. She has a degree in psychology, music and economic management and no one knows how she fits it all together.

Anki is open and thoughtful, sensual and unusual, and as a living embodiment of some kind of night-fairy we always expect that weird and wonderful coincidences will occur whenever she’s around. Maybe she’s another good witch?

The name of a stainless steel commercial juicer in any health food shop. Some days she might be overly temperamental, groaning at length about the littlest thing and threatening to tear your fingers off if you so much as look at her, while other days, just when you least expect it, she’s the one that comes to the fore when the chips are down and when the day needs to be saved by someone. (She looks great when she isn’t stressed.) Anyway, what day is it?
See Anmaree.
Ann possesses and more progressive outlook than her twin sister (Anne) and therefore she is more relaxed about morally questionable acts that might happen in her presence.

Inside the boundaries of correct behaviour she’s a picture of neatness, loveliness and calm. Outside it, she’s a sensual and charismatic wildcard who is capable of nearly anything. So, who’s in the room?

Rarely thin and even when she is, she is rarely dim. Annabel is highly educated, perfectly sarcastic, perpetually ready for what's around the corner and is an imaginative and attentive lover. We suggest you never take Annabel for granted, and one of her skills seems to be the capacity to get involved with unusual projects. Indeed, Annabel is something of an independent explorer.
Annabella is into life, money, property and men who have their shit together.
The Melodramatic Actress.

“Check my agenda,” she says to her male secretary. “Can you make sure I’m out of the country in eight weeks? I can’t bare to deal with that fucking idiot one more time.”
Her secretary bows his head and smiles, for as pig-headed and brilliant as he knows her to be, deep down she’s just a little girl who, from time to time, would just prefer to bury her head in the sand rather than face an uncomfortable issue.
The secretary puts away his smile, looks up and says, “Consider it done, madame.”
Annalea is a dynamic and gorgeous woman. She’s read every book and seen every movie, she can act as well as the best of them and she’d make a wonderful drama lecturer. In fact, where is she?

Life is rarely straight forward for this girl. Men, money, women, good times and bad all come and go seemingly with the changes in the wind for Anna-lee. On the flip side she gets bored very quickly and so perhaps she conjures up all of these things unwittingly? Maybe we all do?

Lovely and a bit ditzy, Annali is never aware when anyone is angry at her, which comes in handy, depending if you are Annali yourself, or her work colleague or partner. Put it this way, Annali is never reliable enough to get accepted into the police force, god bless her.
Initially she may seem quite proper and posh but she isn’t, really. She is, in fact, very natural and she has classic looks that force the husbands in the boardroom to wish they were very single.

Food. Sex. Music. Children. If you’d followed her life you would have observed the ratio of these four aspects continually jostling for position. And don’t imagine for a second that age has diminished her desire for the second one either. Amen.
See Anmaree.

Well, those God-fearing days are behind her now and, like Carol, she could use a good holiday. After countless generations of ensuring everyone else is well, is not embarrassing themselves and generally being protective of her kin and her friends, it's about time Anne took her shoes off, accepted a nice hot tea, or a whisky, or a glass of wine, or whatever blows her hair back as a means to relax, and just do that for a bit. She's done enough chores, she's whacked enough backsides and she's over cleaning other peoples' clothes.The End.
Right, who has those Monty Python DVDs? Can you send them to Annece please? She needs a good laugh. She's been working way too hard.

The following is a typical Anneli story...
Having done quite well in the last year artistically, it seems that all that hard work is beginning to pay off. To treat herself, she flies solo to Norway for a month because she’s always wanted to trek around the fjords in winter time. Being who she is, she befriends weird and wonderful people everywhere she goes. And today, because it’s a tradition apparently, her and a bunch of other naked people are about to jump into an ice bath in a frozen lake. It’s what they do here on the last day of January so it’s what she’s going to do. As it turns out she won’t freeze to death, and she’ll return home with more incredible new friends and memories than she knows what to do with.

Annelie is a sensitive, delicious treat not to be taken lightly. It's only after she leaves the room that you start to realise how much you want her around. Why is that? No one is certain. The only small issue is that she takes a while to find her way out of some of the mazes she finds herself in, inside her personal life. Then again, I suppose this can be a problem for all of us.

Quick on her feet and with an excellent knowledge of the opposition, for a long time Annelies worked on the President's re-election campaign. Rarely seeking the limelight, as soon as that job was done she flew out to Central America to handle another diplomatic disaster that was brewing. Many people ask when she's going to settle down although no one but no one can see that happening any time soon. Sure, it might appear to happen physically, but not in her mind.

The American president Roosevelt once said, “Give a lazy man a job and he’ll find an easy way to do it,” and this applies to Anneliese, perfectly. She’s got street smarts, man smarts and life skills which enable her to live her life well, and with a smile on her dial.
See Anmaree.

It’s not so much that Annetta looks dishevelled, it’s just that she’s always late, and I mean seriously late. Which is why she falls through the door with only half of the buttons done up on her trousers or blouse. No, she hasn’t been sharing a passionate embrace with someone she wasn’t supposed to, although, that might do her some good, she’s just late again. She hasn’t even had time for makeup, thank God.

An interesting person; an interesting phenomenon - that being, when string, nylon or any kind of rope tangles up into an irretrievable disaster. A good example is that of a parachutist who leaps from a plane, pulls the rip-chord and then falls to their death as they try and spread apart the shrouds that have mortally tangled. At least, you could say that about Annette on a bad day. On a good day, however, she's funny, and unorthodox, and a skilled shit-giver, and Christ knows we don't get too much of that these days.
The Live Wire!
The naughty little sister. Quick to arrive and quick to leave, frisky Annie lives a busy life although no one is ever sure where she is at any given time.
See Anmaree.
See Anmaree.
The name of the lady behind the harpoon which is mounted on top of the bow of a Russian whaling ship.

Anouk is careful not to take her eyes from where she's headed for too long. You may not hear her laughter across the road, but that doesn't mean she's sad or morose. She's just intent on sticking to the plan, or at least, getting back to it if it's been lost or too much wine has been consumed. She's an intense lover.
Thoughtful. Sexy. Cool......usually!
As a lovely psychiatrist she will often ask the question, ‘What’s it to ya’?’, although in a very non-threatening manner. (She actually asks herself the same question, all day long.)
Anthea is the sponge cake that never rose and is now out the back being eaten by the dog. Don’t assume, therefore, that she isn’t maximally loveable, and for the right reasons.

In hindsight you probably could have foreseen how all the prep was for nought. Then again, perhaps the amount of time put into this dinner kept you busy and gave you something to distract yourself with? It's hard to say. You spent $250 on food and the preparation for your date with this amazing person has taken you most of the day, but you don't want to let yourself get too excited, even though you've never felt so electrified by anyone in years.
After a day slaving over perfectly baked pastries (dessert), making the sauces (for the main and for dessert), as well as organising the intricately presented caviar, cheese and prosciutto (entree), you're dressed and ready. It's 7pm sharp and the door bell rings. You can scarcely believe your luck.
Then, this person comes into the room and, nervously, almost, you greet. You lead them to the kitchen where a bottle of champagne awaits, and then you stop and look into each other's eyes. Neither of you can help yourself. The ensuing passion takes over the table, the kitchen bench and even occasionally the floor. All food is sent asunder and 7 hrs of prep goes out the window. 
These acts of instantaneous, rude, delicious and chaotic love are a rare thing indeed. Scientifically they are called an Antigoni Moment, but we just pray you get to experience one soon because a more splendid mess does not exist.
Laid-back? Antionetta? ...Are you serious? No way.
Very well travelled, Antoinette enjoys intrigue in a relationship, she’s disappointed by cheap red and she delights in floral bath salts.

The whole party scene kind of passed her by. She was too busy reading and getting educated. In any case, she was far too sensitive to partake in the lives of the moronic males she knew she’d be surrounded by. But Antonella is a deeply sensuous and thinking woman, so don’t presume she doesn’t know how to play. She does. Antonella is quite stunning and in so many areas. The boys up here in the commentary box have all been in love with her for years, and they guard her name in the same way surfers, who discover a new, amazing surf break: they only tell their best friend, and even then on the condition of death if they tell anyone else.
Antonia is beautiful but she has no idea where milk comes from.

Anwen is in her prime when times are tough. Recessions - she loves them. It means she can get out the manual butter maker, dust off that clothes washing slab that she can whack the clothes against and get back into the veggie patch, generally. A bit of hard work is good for the soul, she'll tell you. And she's right. God bless you Anwen!

Exact. Precise. Punctual. These are some words which might be used to describe one of the world's great managers. She's a gifted delegator and seems to have the capacity to monitor several different situations at once. How she does this no one is quite sure. As a publicist/band manager/radio or TV producer she'll always do well. She's not into mud or animals, however. All the boys think she's cute, and they love her not-seen-enough smile.
Anyu cares for lost puppies in a dog shelter.

Rarely spasmodic or unreliable, Aoife's clarity and general well-centeredness stems from the fact that people are constantly amazed that a human being can carry such a name. Then they meet her, at which point they are flabbergasted at how large her smile is, let alone how easily she pulls it out. Indeed, Aoife (pron. 'Eefa') is not only normal, she works hard for others and she's warm-hearted. Not bad eh? (And never would she let on with the truth, which is that many of her friends are stark raving fucking mad.)
.....yeah, whatever you reckon.

Naive. Then again, the meek shall inherit the Earth, so some of us are told, and if that happens, by George, we’ll need idealists up the front showing us how to at least give it a fair-dinkum crack after western civilisation falls apart.
April will do whatever she can to ensure than she and her family always give a good impression of themselves, and regardless if she is the daughter, the mother, the aunty or the grandmother.
The gorgeous princess in a mystical land. Legend has it that she can drink anyone under the table, and that she has actually killed men in bed.

“Oh, Araminta!” you yell with disgust, after you’ve discovered that you've just sat on chewing gum that has effectively melded into the material and destroyed the garment. The trousers/skirt/shorts/dress was brand new, too!
Polished marble.

As the full spinnaker of a multi-million dollar maxi-yacht that’s leading the fleet up the river after an 1100 kilometre ocean race, Ari drives the vessel like it’s nothing at all, and she does it with a sensual and easy poise which comforts and encourages all those behind her, on board, who would be completely screwed without her.
Aria has at least 175 different bottles, tubes and jars in her shower/bathroom, they're all hers, and none of them are passed their use-by date.

Ariana? Work for a local government deciding where the sewage system is going to go? I don't think so. She's more inclined to be strolling through an Audi showroom, having just finished lunch at that new, schmick little restaurant over-looking Sydney Harbour, the Thames or San Fransisco Bay. (You know the one...the entrees cost $180.) Sure, some people think she's a snob, but not once they get to know her. But it is true, she is quite like Bernard in that she detests trivial jobs that are none of her business. I can't say I blame her.

Ariane, I hear on the grapevine that you are a pain in the arse. Now, is this true? If so, why?
...Oh, I see, you didn’t know that you weren't the only person in the room.
...And you weren’t aware that they have needs and desires as well.
...Okay, okay. I understand. All right, Ariane, here’s what we up here in the psych department suggest you do. We think you should open your eyes and take a look around. See all these people? They too are full of greatness, and if you let them in they’ll help you if you ask nicely – ordering people gets you nowhere – and they’ll provide more love and joy than you can possibly imagine. You with me?
Ariel is the name of a giant gold statue of the Buddha. She is all-knowing, fun-loving, truth-seeking and a sage that everyone is happy to be near and learn from.

Is Aries a bit of a ditz?....perhaps just a little. She's certainly a whole lot less capable than those girls born under the sign of the goat, but maybe that's her niche.

(Oh, what's a ditz, you ask? Well, she's a bit clumsy and forgetful....that kind of thing.) 

Beyond that, Aries loves her mysticism and good old fashion pagan symbology, and seems to swan around 'hoping' rather than 'doing', and by that we mean 'doing the hard work'. 

However, she is also lucky and this is a powerful tool in anyone's kit bag.

Her parents called her that on their return from a trip to Botswana years ago, and they thought it was wonderful. Eventually, of course, they were done for growing and selling copious amounts of pot. Arifab turned out quite well, though, don't you think?

The Greek dynamo who is at peace with herself because she knows who she is. Don’t worry, she’ll bark at you if you’ve screwed up, or you’re about to, but she also knows that unexpected events are inevitable, because change is inevitable. 
If the fools she is surrounded by took the time to speak to her properly they might discover that for themselves.

Yeah, well, it’s kind of a secret but what the hell. Aristea does herald from aristocracy, although we not allowed to say any more than that. In life, Aristea has an ego and she has the smarts, she treads on toes and embarrasses useless men. (Yes, she has her licence but we’d all be safer if she’d just re-hire her driver.)

Mmm, I wonder which planet she is from? Anyway, Arki is lean in stature, is ready to move at a moments notice and takes particular attention to detail. As a photographer of either very small or very close-up things, she's quite the artist.

Now here is a woman born to adapt and to survive. Prada bags, Dolce & Gabbana perfumes and Christian Dior makeup are none of her business. Indeed, the last time we spotted Arlene she was going fishing with Neville in croc country, and the only thing they were taking was an esky full of bait and piss, and a loaded .303, just in case.

Sure, Arley is straight to the point but she's not so unaware of other peoples' feelings that she'll put a needless dagger through someone's heart, in the case of them being a little over-sensitive. As a suave and well-centred lass, Arley grasps the crux of nearly all situations (and personalities) and kind of glides through life with relative ease. Infectious smile. Tons of friends.

Arlie ain’t here. We’ve just spoken to her though, well, at least we did before the generator where she’s staying got switched off. F.Y.I Arlie is in India as we speak, sipping a g&t while looking over the tranquil lagoon, somewhere. And she said it’s hot, but not too hot.

Here we have a classic case of one of those girls who is (A) too physically gorgeous for words, (B) writes off more sports cars than just about anyone and (C) seems to miraculously pay nothing in insurance, ever, because the owners of the sports cars are too enamoured to care. 
And yes, they've all copped their fair share of half-empty champagne glasses tossed at them at a rate of knots. Go you good thing!

Artemis, before you contract asthma like most of the young people today, you need to get outside each day and deliberately dive into a mud puddle. Get covered in it. Even drink a bit. Likewise, let your food go-off slightly before you eat it, and only eat organic. Bugs  and bacteria are good for you. Your body needs them. I know, your mum freaks out about dirt and germs, but I'm a biologist and I'm telling you, get some germs on and in you and not only will your skin look healthy like never before - and you're cute already, have no fear - but you'll live forever. Amen.
As an administrator in the tax department Arwyn keeps an immaculate office, a spotless car, a well-washed poodle dog and she invests her money wisely. She likes her lovers to be extremely clean.
Blue sky. (ie. Ash can do anything and everything and people just adore her. Amen.)
The shape and sound of a sleek and sexy arrowhead whistling through the air. A great way to live. A great way to die.

Yes, it’s true. In a past life that last surfaced thousands of years ago, Ashana was a serene Persian Princess. She had slaves – most of whom adored her – she had style, and she was far more compassionate than most of her forebears. In this life, her smile hasn’t gotten any smaller, she takes her time no matter how much attention she receives, and she generally gets plenty, she possesses an excellent speaking voice, and, as ever, she encourages those around her to be better. Not bad eh?

Yep, Ashla is one of those characters who is often the centre of other peoples’ conversations. You see, the friends who know her, know her. They know how clumsy she is, they know how late she always is, and they’ve all encountered her propensity to attract ridiculous, ill-timed coincidences which affect everyone present. Thing is, Ashla is so cute and cool, like she has all the time in the world, that strangers who have just met her scarcely credit such rumours. Know what I mean? Anyway, we love her, and the world would be a much more boring place if she weren’t around. (Note: her bad moods are all bluff and bluster.)
Ashlan never looked at the rule book and these days I hear she is full of licentiousness. (Look it up, girl!)

Of all the spellings of her name, this one is the most chilled-out when people misspell it. She just likes to get on with things, know what I mean? True, she's often laboured with more tasks than most and this assists her in only getting riled over the things that really matter. Love, food and friends - if you have these then in her book you're doing okay, and we suspect she's on the money.
GET A JOB!!!!! …..even a hobby, at least!
The Boss!
Ashley is a pretty girl who worries too much about trivial things, but then again she is The Boss, as well!!
Ashlyn, don't worry, things are going to be great. Here, come and splash some cold water on your face. Felt good, didn't it? Alright, so, what are you waiting for??

And here was us thinking they were going to call her Antarctica. Oh well, Asia is a bright spark and not one to rest on her laurels. True, she gets plenty of grief about her name but it is water off a duck's back. Make no mistake, Asia is a modern woman on a mission.

Astra always looks surprised. It might be because she's quite gullible, which is cute. Rarely does she have her feet on the ground, though, and so doing something like constructing a cohesive business plan isn't really her deal. Folk festivals - this is what Astra lives for.

A Swedish-German Princess who rides a late model BMW motorbike and who wears a short hairdo. Maybe she’s gay, maybe she isn’t, but it matters not. Astrid is an intellectual juggernaut and we can only marvel at what her imagination comes up with when trying to surprise her partner on their birthday. Astrid is just lovely.
Athali is one of the very few students on Earth who is so enthusiastic that she is always gutted whenever class ends.

As the ex-Queen of a lost civilization, Athena was re-incarnated into this life as a well-made and expensive bell around a healthy cow’s neck. She now makes a wonderful noise that sounds a bit too dopy to take seriously.

I mean, why not just call her Warsaw? Anyway, Atlanta is a nice girl, deep down, but she spends an inordinate amount of time chasing her tail around like one of those insane little dogs you see on those humorous YouTube clips.
An English Literature graduate who lost her virginity way too late. But that’s okay because she now makes a wonderful older lover.
Aurelia faces front-on at all times. Yes, subtle gestures may be lost on her, either in the bedroom or on the playing field, but she presents directly.

She can't really act and she knows it, but at $30mill a picture, do you think she really gives a shit? Anyway, she gives most of it to charity. Note: her bedroom is easily one of the Top 5 messiest bedrooms in the entire Kingdom.

Autumn needs an education and whether she uses it or not is irrelevant. It will provide something of a rock to cling to in the final, formative years, so when she finally stands confident in her own power, later, she’ll understand the benefits gained by persisting and not just giving up at the first sign of (perceived) hardship.

As someone who went through rehab and spent years of living on the other side of the tracks, Autumn-Lily is quite an accomplished and giving counsellor because she understands what people are going through. She's got dream catchers hanging all through her house.

In theory, Ava is dramatic and unselfconscious but, in reality, she is very thoughtful and just a little bit shy. Some advice from the commentary box Ava, after you get in to university, take at least a year off at least and see how you feel about it then. People are in a hurry these days and there is no reason you should be.
Misty eyed.

Avani is that annoying intern at the hospital who, though just out of medical school, appears to know more than any of the long-standing surgeons who have been cutting people open for years. Yes, it’s true, her bedside manner needs a bit of work but we’re confident that, after she loses a few patients, compassion will eventually arrive. (After all, it really is why she’s here in the first place: to help and to assist, both physically and mentally.) 

Anyway, in case we’re wrong up here can you let us know?

Cheers. Management.

Avanka is the sort of cook/mother/care-taker/wife/girlfriend who is difficult to be skinny around. Sure, she loves skinny dipping, and that's another story, but if she is the one dishing out the cream onto the bowl of strawberries then you can guarantee you won't be able to see the fruit. 
Avanka argues loudly and she and makes love loudly, and sometimes simultaneouslyYou should see her watching a teary movie…

Like her distant cousin Grace, Ave has time on her side and she invokes calm wherever she goes, but there are two subtle differences: (1) Ave is a borderline tomboy in her youth and, (2), she doesn’t always wear her reactions on her sleeve. Sometimes she’ll sit back and see how a situation unfolds. For fun, she might even play-act a little, just seeing what an unexpected reaction will provide for a space. All the boys just love Ave, and she’ll never be short of attention - this we can guarantee. And she loves sitting out under the stars.
Averil is her own woman and a keen observer of human behaviour. Have you read 'The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo'?  The main female character could so easily have been called Averil.

Avian possesses way more daring than you might imagine. Sure, she’s never loud and almost never rude, but if Avian were an ant she’d single handedly tackle a wasp 12 times her size if it represented a threat to the nest. And she wouldn’t give her personal safety a moment’s thought.
Aviva teaches salsa dancing and in a past life she was an Argentinian stallion. Cassandra and Richard secretly adore her but they have no idea why.

Yes, well, she gets in a spin and a tizz from time to time, but her moments of freaking out are kept behind closed doors. Of course, that's what she thinks anyway, because Avona is more melodramatic than most of her peers, which is good thing. In matters of love, she throws herself in full bottle, and yep, she gets hurt, but she recovers. Believe it or not, Avona carries the Romantic Gene and woa-betide any man who doesn't act accordingly. Gentleman we suggest an expensive clifftop hotel, overlooking an ocean somewhere, and you can make up the rest.
Ayda carries certain responsibilities that weigh her down from time to time, but she listens to people and she’s friendly.
Similar to Amen, Ayema is what you say when you arrive at a tranquil water hole after a three day trek through northern Pakistan. What a wonderful vision she is.

While shopping Ayesha moves so quickly and so eratically between stores that if she were being tailed by a private investigator, without even meaing it she would lose the 'tail' without even knowing she was being followed. Surprising too, really, given how much noise she makes everywhere she goes.

Like an intricate 3-dimensional board game for very intelligent Germans, Ayesher is multi-layered, unforgiving if you get it wrong and it takes ages to get a handle on her. But, concentrate, remember what the rules are and you'll find her presence almost addicitve, after a while. Good luck!

A soothing cup of herbal tea, infused with lemongrass. (Until she heads out with the girls where she scolls vodka like it's tap water.) Aylah is never in charge but she is friendly and agreeable, and her path in life is directed in an almost accidental way, as determined by the river is which she happens to be floating. She is therefore not often heavily stressed.
Come on girl! Put some elbow grease into it! Don't just sit there and wait!
As a modern day Mavis, Aylin rarely puts herself at the top of her list of priorities.

Homeless? No.
Academic? Probably.
Musical? Only in the shower, and only if drunk.
Religious? Fuck off.
Hair-do? Short.
Occupation? High level manager.

"Yeah, yeah, yeah, I heard what he said. I don't care - he's an idiot."     (Note: Friends of Azia, if you aren't already aware, then know that Azia has a great eye for the energy of the Right Man for her, and you'll never badger her into anything else. In fact, if all of you desperados took a leaf from her book the divorce rate would halve overnight.)
B takes no shit from anyone or anything and she gets on with it, having as much well-earned fun on the way within the constraints of the situation.

Rarely given to treachery, Babette tends to do things fully and completely, and her rather splendid radar means she rarely needs to deal with unmitigated fuckwits, which is handy in a world where every third or fourth buffoon has something tattooed across the side of their face. No, this girl enjoys fine wine, intelligent and insightful conversation, she's rarely paranoid, she's well-travelled and her life-desires are particular and unique, as are her close friends.

You know how sometimes you get on a ship or a large boat and you just know that the skipper, while a friendly and gregarious individual, shouldn't be in charge of any kind of vessel? Well this is a lot like Babita. Yes, she beats her chest and talks long and hard, and she's funny, but is she keeping her eye on the horizon enough to make those around her feel safe? I'm not so sure...

Rarely rushing to a decision or a point of view, Babs surveys the scene in second gear for most of the time, moving and thinking with an easy style. When she decides to act, however, you will definitely know about it.
If she's at home then she's in her room, and it doesn't seem to matter if she's 7 or 27.
What Bamba says, goes. She’s a mighty fun lass, however.

Bambi flies one of two ways. For example, her biggest problem in life is either one of two things:

1. Deciding which colour to put in her hair (or perhaps which style of feathers or dreads to go with) and which style of fairy wings to purchase for the next music festival.

OR

2. Which weapon to use as regards either her elbow, fist or foot, to finally dispatch this Japanese Kung Fu master, in her final test to become the most proficient, fast and skilful martial arts exponent on the planet.
Banita is a zesty, punchy, hop-a-long kind of gal who doesn't dilly-dally in front of the TV for too long.

If ever home alone, and it's a rare event these days, Barb' loves nothing more than stripping off, cracking a good bottle of wine and turning up the music in preparation for some delicious Nude Pizza Base Tossing!!!!

A sensual women who has travelled the world. In wintertime she wears an exquisite woollen scarf which she tosses around her neck with the grace of movement that one would see in a stallion’s tail if at a gentle canter.

What a bizarre and inquisitive woman! If told a joke, she will frown like mad during the telling and frown even harder while she computes the punch line. Five long seconds will pass, then she will explode into the loudest laughter you have ever heard. She's not putting it on. This is how she is. Her German/Austrian/European heritage might have something to do with it, I'm not sure. She loves her stroodle and cream.

Unemployment benefits will never be any of her business. Barbette rarely sits around idly wondering ‘what if’ and, god bless her cotton socks, she has no compunction about asking a prospective out on a date or even proposing marriage if she feels so inclined, or to shag him or her quickly around the corner.

Big hat, big smile and, if she’s living in anything larger than a small country town, a ton of bling. Barbie is raucous fun and a generous lover and friend. She reads neither philosophy nor science and has no need. She’s attached to Mother Earth more than even she realises, which is why she is loved by most plants and animals. Humans included.
Bay loathes loud discos and pestering men. She consumes a very healthy diet, reads more than most people and is wary of strangers.

Unemotional, I don't think so. If anything Bayley is too emotional, too compassionate and perhaps she needs to tend to her own needs a little more than she does. Unlike many women in the Kingdom Bayley doesn't really mind if people spell her name wrong, although maybe she should? As it is, Bayley works hard, she never gets arrested and she's never the boss. Maybe she should be?...
See B.

No, she doesn't wear one all the time, but she does like bright colours and bright happy people. You can't say her name and not be smiling at the end of it, and this propels Beany headlong into a busy, funny life which involves a million like-minded playful cats. A career: Mmmmmm.....what the fuck are they talking about?, she'll say.
Life is ostensibly a collection of seconds, and they're delicious if you choose them to be - they may very well scribe this on Beany's gravestone. 
(Although, to be honest, she's more likely to have herself burnt on a giant pyre surrouned by 300 partyers who loved her more than god, while all that wonderful Beany dust floats up into the atmosphere and covers all of us.)
Patient and never intrusive, Beate possesses a lovely calming aspect.
Beatrice hasn’t had an orgasm for about 15 years, not even by herself. Not that it matters, really, because she’s passed all that bullshit.
Woah! So what if she’s 70 years old? How many grannies do you know have their nipples pierced??

Far more interesting than her male counterpart, Beau makes decisions and follows them through to some kind of useful, positive outcome. She’s not a tomboy in the strictest sense of the word, but she’s not far off it. She definitely speaks her mind without fear nor favour and often it takes her ages for her to realise some man is hitting on her. Usually her friends have to tell her. She’s funny like that.

What a handful. After all the booze is drunk and the partying is done on their wedding night, the real party can begin back in the wedding suite with his wife, and that's great. But his wife, Beauty, has three giant dogs she loves more than life itself - certainly more than him - and if he thought he wouldn't be sharing the bed with the creatures this night, at least, he was gravely mistaken.
Yep, smart, savvy, sexy. Bec has her shit together. And if she doesn't, well, she's killed her partner and is now in prison. Even there she's a hoot, though.

Sweet and gentle, my arse. Becca has the IQ of one of the heads of the Manhattan Project, the determination of a one ton white pointer that’s doing 50km/hr right behind you and an overall understanding of ‘the bigger picture’ that the Archbishop of Sydney would pay alot of money for.

So, you're on the mountain-side studying the heavily guarded compound on the otherside of the valley through binoculars. You pass them to your 2IC and give them a minute to have a look and a think. They put the binoculars down and look at you.
“It’s too heavily fortified,” they say. “The only person who could penetrate the perimeter fence is Beckie, and she’s better on her own because no one would see her.”
You agree. Beckie it is. It’s not the first time she’s done this either...

Becky is the driver in a drag car. She's little, has no fear and her uptake on mechanical information - indeed, any information that she's given - is second to none. She has very little time for romance or romantic types.
Brazenly tough while at the same time delicate and complex, Beige has a wise head and a composure which is far beyond her years. Thank Christ her parents never called her Stardust.
Bek loves being just that little bit different, but that doesn’t detract from the notion that she is diabolically tremendous.

Songwriter, seamstress, sex worker, lucid dreamer - it matters not. Bekkii is big in life and sufficiently unforgettable. Don’t judge her, just go along with her and make sure you’re on her team. That’s all she’ll ask of you.
See Bell.
