Belinda is well groomed (or at least she tries to be), she is curvaceous and she is an uncomplicated lass. Indeed, her partner might benefit from remembering that all she wants, really, is to be looked after and to be happy. So, are you doing your best to look after her?

A sleek and sexy game boat that is worth about $3 million. She can punch through most weather with ease and she spends each fishing season cruising the blue waters off Lizard Island, North Queensland, Australia. Not only is she fast, beautiful to look at and charismatic to be near, she’s extremely determined.
Like the 3rd of 4th sequel to a popular movie, she’s nice enough, funny enough, smart enough and sexy too, but original? Who cares, because Bella is often the most compassionate person in the room.
A remarkable firestorm. As a pure observer, her exuberance borders on pomposity except that she is maximally caring and true.
Where do you start? Belle is sweet and smooth and smart and pure (kind of) and sexy and knowing and loving and funny and shit-stirring. And there’s more...

Carefree? Not really, but she does buzz into action whenever the situation demands it, moving quickly, thinking fast, and even causing the odd minor uproar. For instance, if Benita was at a dignified cocktail party and a close female friend confided in her that she was secretly distraught because, only a week earlier, she caught her husband in bed with his secretary, Benita's face would boil with rage. She would probably then confront said husband in the middle of the party, at the top of her voice, and include some splendid finger pointing as well. God love her.
Berenice is the name of a gazelle that all the lions know they can't handle alone. Yes, mothers are protective by nature, but Jesus, Berenice can protect the heard better than some of the stags.

If you imagine Bernadette as some kind of normal person living some kind of normal, quiet life, then Bern is the figure who emerges from the nearest mop cupboard after the former has heard of some calamitous world event where people are in desperate need of a ravishing, multi-coloured super hero, and who drives all men berserk. Nice work Bern.
Dots of freckles cover her face and body and she occasionally gets lost. She is, however, exceptionally bright.

Reclining in her director's chair at the end of a long, final day, she pulls out her sacred cigar and sucks it alight before a satisfied smile spreads across her face. True, there are more hours to be had in the editing suite before the project is truly over, but the filming went well and she feels good about it, and certainly good enough to have a small celebration at another stage completed. After all, Beth knows the journey is where it’s at. The destination is just an idea…0

The only part of dining at restaurants that Bernice dislikes is dessert. Make no mistake, she loves the course, but she'd much prefer to eat dessert in her own home (and possibly in her own company) so she can pleasure-groan as loudly as she likes. It’s never attention-seeking, she's not that vein, but she got so fed up with being told to shoosh by wait staff that she just stopped eating out. Isn't that sad? Bernice has a wicked, cheeky smile, she is a generous and sensuous lover and the boys up here in the box adore her and want her to return to restaurants and groan as often and as loudly as she pleases. The End.
Bernie drives a truck, or at least she did in a past life. She has a great laugh and she’s a good drinker.

While rarely in serious personal trouble anyway, Bertie is capable of the most magnificent and surprising of comebacks. Unconventional, outgoing and with a chilled kind of sensual air, Bertie’s sole goal is to have a shitload of fun and she encourages others to do the same by constantly moving the goal posts. She’s definitely the sort of bridesmaid who, if single and feeling a bit frisky, would sneak outside and shag one of the groomsmen in the bushes during reception.
Beryl is a happy to get her hands dirty for the sake of the farm, her children and for the local community. And that’s more than many people do in a lifetime.

Like a beautiful old motorbike with only one cylinder, she takes ages to get going (or relax) but once she does (or is) then she is arguably one of the loveliest ladies in a room. It just takes a while to get there, that’s all.
The Farmer’s Truck.

Yeah, I know what you’re thinking. Don’t worry, we’ve heard it all before. You say her name and your head kind of nods downward a little bit, and you think, ‘Oh, maybe Beth isn’t that exciting after all.’
What a load of unmitigated horse shit! 
Beth is an incredibly sensual woman, her ‘feel’ for people is second to none, her smile literally radiates light and she’s one of those souls that even wary strangers want to hug.
You with me?

On the surface, Bethan seems to struggle from one odd, obnoxious situation to the next. In truth she's a very complex lass who actually invites this chaos into her life because without it she'd be as bored as a bored bird sitting alone on a bored-looking electric wire out in the sticks where there aren't any hills, trees or other birds to talk to. So, she has a glass of wine at night and talks to herself about her day, analysing what happened and how she reacted, and then she laughs aloud and says, "Hang on! I'm cool! I'm a really nice person."
She’s 150% right, of course. Bethan is a delight and all she wants to do is help.

Nurturing. Her name sounds like good and dutiful dairy cow lumbering its way along its habitual track toward the organic dairy farmer’s shed at five in the morning. But, there is far more to her than that. Far more indeed.

What a rip-snorter of a girl! Betsy ia always the last one to want to go home no matter how old she is and no matter what is happening. (Unless it's the hospital visit, in which case she wants nothing to do with the place. "Why be surrounded by sick people?" she'll ask.)
Bettina is cold and complex, and not even that cold, really. She is, however, super intelligent and extremely driven.
Broccoli.
Hold on to your hat kids, Beulah is about to turn up and she's as timid and as subtle as Tyrannosaurus Rex.

Bev makes the sandwiches for the shearers in the shed where Ruth reigns supreme. They appreciate the food and Bev’s sense of humour as much as she appreciates them for doing a good job on all of her sheep.

As the Principal of an expensive all-girl’s private school, Beverley knows all the rorts because she has seen and done it all before, herself. Push her and you’ll see a temper but she’s nowhere near as uptight as you imagine. She’s actually very generous.

Beverlie is like a big friendly dragon who springs to life if there's a bonfire that needs lighting. Sure, she looks gruff and a little intimidating when you first meet her but no way is she like that. Beverlie's presence keeps others in check, which is fine, but she's actually quite loving. Go on, go and give her a hug but be careful though, she might just scoop you and take you for a fly. Just relax and trust her. You’ll be right…

Bezena explodes into the world in the same way that Jackson Pollock threw paint at a distant canvas. Artist or not, she definitely adds colour to a scene, be it literal or metaphoric, and her occasional irrationality is something to be coveted.

Here we are in the first half of the 21st Century, and here we have an example of the new generation. At a quick glance many people suspect Bianca is chaste and normal, and ever more perceive her as rather dim and self-centred, unambitious and lazy, but you’re all wrong. 
Give her a role somewhere up near the front of the wagon, where her decisions matter, and you’ll be doing everyone a favour, including yourself. Amen.

Difficult to rile, Biata's defining characteristic is that she is the objective listener. She has the capacity to think outside the box and she takes her time in coming to a solution, which is rarely wrong. Indeed, her ideas are often covetted.

Man, what a chick. Seriously. Biba is the kind of girl who, disregarding the possibility of being chased and eaten by a giant fucking grizzly bear, will hike up to a giant rocky outcrop in the Canadian Rockies on her own, camping out for a few nights, and when she finally gets to the top she will sit down quietly, cross her legs, put a flower in her hair (which she brought especially for the occasion) and meditate with a contented smile on her face. Here, of course, she will remind herself that she is a part of everything and that everything and everyone is a part of her. Back down in the real world, Biba floats along as if she were travelling on a cloud and she has more friends than she knows what to do with.
The brilliant. The beautiful. The becalmed. Bibo.

Billee is another one of those aliens pretending to be a human inside a human body. She's actually an Intergallactic Anthropologist. Totally loving and (usually) harmless, Billee's role, here on Earth, is to perform zany and crazy acts in public and to then measure and record the response from the locals. You can try and ask her about, or suggest that you know who she really is and what she's up to, but she, like all the visitors, and there are a few of them out there, are sworn to secrecy. You can't blame them really.

“Hi Billie....how is the new...??”  (the gorgeous Billie flies passed on her roller blades....)  ..So, what did you do last ni-LOOK OUT!!....” ..Billie flies by again, narrowly missing everyone else...)  ..."..and what do you think of- OWW!! SHIT!!!!..” Billie laughs and that’s all we hear before she disappears, once more, into the sunset....)

Ever seen those American baseball movies where the tension has built up over the course of the game, and where it all comes down to one last play. Billie-Kay is the umpire standing behind the catcher, and if nothing else she has a penchant for the dramatic. Better still, she has a loud voice.

Scores are tied and the game is nearly over. The pitcher takes his stance on the mound.

The crowd of 30,000 gathers a hush.

The hitter is 2 strikes down. The championship is about to be decided. 

The pitcher winds up and lets it fly. The ball is drifting wide but does it swing back enough? The batter doesn't take a swing.....

The crowd takes a giant, collective breath......

Billie-Kay grimaces, points to the sidelines and yells out at the top of her voice, ".........SSSSSSTEEEEEEEEEEEEEEERIKE!!!!!!!!!!"

Amid the celebrations of the fielding team, the immediate arguing and bitching in her face from the batting team are water off a duck's back. (As you can imagine, she’s never been stalked by some fucked-up ex-partner.)
A funny, intense lady whose sanity is border-line.
See Bruno.
There’s no point doing anything if you’re not going to test your own limits - this is the only thing the beautiful and brilliant Bjork insists upon.

Option A: Had Blade been around in the era when women’s magazines were at their peak she would have loved it. The glitz and the glamour; the shocking scandals involving the latest movie star couple and a recent breakup; how Jennifer Whogivesaratsarse got her 6-pack model body back 40 minutes after giving birth - Blade lives for this kind of crap. She takes 4 hours to get ready just to go down the street and her boyfriends are hen-pecked to within an inch of their lives. She earns a living by uploading half naked pics of herself on Instagram et al.

Option B: A very quietly spoken and sensitive lass who is calm and loving, and whose healing centre is doing very well.
Tough on the surface, sensitive in the middle, Blair does what it takes and in a quietly determined way, even though her methods may be quite unorthodox and her dreams seemingly unrealistic.
Her red hair and her accent are nearly always a given but she has spark, spunk and style.

Like a male Simon, no one is ever really sure of what Blake is thinking. Fortunately, she gets offered the best jobs and gets invited to the best parties because, rightly or wrongly, people presume they will benefit from knowing her. Truth is, she's not as devious as people think. But, yes, she's no fool and so long as she isn't spoilt, she's absolutely worth knowing.

Blanche lives with her dripping jewellery at a sea-side mansion at one of the ‘finer’ locales inside Vancouver harbour, or somewhere swank overlooking water, and she’s gruff and unforgiving like that old troll that lives under the bridge and eats children.
Aircraft and alcohol - it's a deadly mix. Has she got her pilot's licence back yet? Anyone?
Not the most hospitable creature in the Kingdom, when Bliss says jump she expects everybody to jump.
John Wayne, eat your heart out.
Yep, see Blithe.
Bobbie can’t escape a tomboy maleness and it compels her to live a bit harder than the next girl. She will therefore try most things and snub her nose at the world if people don’t like it.

Okay, so she doesn't live for puzzles, well, maybe she does, but later in life when her body starts to wind down she will be one of these people who we'll describe as being as sharp as a fucking tack. Interesting people and places: Boneka will always live for these. So, give her a puzzle now if you like and watch her nut it out in no time. And we could be talking about metaphorical puzzles here too, including problem relationships, weird work conundrums and general social dramas which need a clear head and fresh pair of ears. She'd make a great shrink or government advisor.
The happy, naïve little pony.

She's not a ball-breaker and she’s not a bully - she’s not! Bonita is just determined to achieve her goals her way. Is that so bad? The world needs more powerful women, and here is one of them. Praise the lord!
Fruity and freckly, Bonnie metaphorically lassoes calves at rodeos from the saddle of a galloping horse and she wins prizes for it. You just can’t keep the good ones down, thank goodness.
Independent and philosophical, Bourby plods along like a gently plodding camel. Bourby is lovely.

Graceful and sensual inside her ‘boyishness’, Bowie is usually the most charismatic and capable person in the room, though not everyone will be aware of it. She doesn’t gesticulate and carry-on and there’s never any need. Have no fear, Bowie is amazing.

In what is a lovely change of pace, Brandie isn’t caught up in the life’s crazy modern haste. Does she have freckles? Anyway, it matters not because Brandie is cute regardless, she speaks at you not over you and her presence eases any tension which might exist in the room. It’s funny how some people have that effect. And for those of you lucky enough to be in a position to find out, she’s almost certainly a great kisser. Who would have thought such a simple name could provide such a thing…

Breanna, remember to read. Doesn't matter if it's real books or blogs. Whatever you think you know madam, there is someone out there who has done it before and they can help with whatever you are up to. Got that?

Gaunt and undernourished, I don't think so. Breanne can be a tad lazy, although every time she gets motivated about life/love/work/exercise etc, she is reminded of how much fun she has, and how good she feels. Luckily, her good friends (Mia, Brook, Jess and Bianca) are pretty good at keeping her thinking - and moving. Only one question remains, really - what’s her passion?...
A rare and ornately coloured little bird with a shrill mating-call. Unsighted in the winter months.

So here we go again, another child whose parents were brought up on a diet of chips, cake and coke. What do you do? The irony is that their ineptitude at both spelling names and life in general has meant that Breeanna has had to grow up quick - to help look after the poor buffoons, most of all. She is therefore smarter than most around her, she's incredibly optimistic and she wants to help. It's a miracle she made it through so well.

Heavens to Betsy, and we thought Breeze was going to be gentle and loving and forgiving! Here's a tip, if you give her your car keys on a Friday night, after she's begged and begged and pleaded and promised that she'll be responsible, you can probably expect the vehicle to come sailing in through the lounge room wall anytime between about 1am and 5am. So good luck with that!

The Queen of Dysfunction.  (eg. You’re sitting there watching the news when you hear a noise in the next room, but you dismiss it until the strange crackling gets louder. Suddenly you remember, and run to the kitchen where you discover that the damp phone bill that you put on the fry pan to dry-out has caught on fire and, though you don’t know it yet, the entire house is about to burn down. Ironic, isn’t it? That the house burnt down because of an overdue phone bill? Anyway, life goes on, your name is Brenda and this sort of thing happens all the time. But you’re good fun and, generally, you have red hair.)
Never unhappy and rarely uneducated, Brenna makes the world feel at ease because she's at ease herself. Fabulous in bed. Fabulous in life.

Sexy Brexxy. Her name looks and sounds like an out-of-whack spine being realigned. She’s compassionate, she’s holistically educated and, as one of the world’s great chiropractors, she can massage even the most stressed person into a blissful, boneless chicken.

Bria is a crack-up. You can see her listening to what the fellow, who is supposed to be her boyfriend, is telling her, with a curious look on her face. Until it suddenly dawns on her that, in a very long-winded, roundabout way, he is telling her he wants to break-up with her. At which point she reacts instinctively by either slapping him hard across the face, throwing her glass of wine at him or kicking him hard in the testicles. It's not done out of malice or anger - she's never that nasty or immature, plus she was sick of his crap anyway - it's just a natural event that occurred in the moment. And now it's done it's time to move on. Amen.

Odd as it is, her Dad is Brian and this sense of humour runs through her whole family, whom she adores, and as a result she loves living. Ain’t no other way to describe it - Brianette is a fucking superstar who refuses to see obstacles. They simply don’t exist, for what is an obstacle but an opportunity for humour and group bonding? Exactly.

Brianna is a vivacious girl who hangs around with Alecia, Georgia, Bianca and Maya. She goes out with a boy called Dylan, Hudson or Gabriel, maybe Tom if she is feeling a bit traditional (Ryan if she was feeling rebellious) and one day she hopes a boy with super-rich parents will arrive on the scene and sweep her away from her pseudo career, which she was never really into anyway.

Reliable and fair-minded, Briar is about as far from being a paranoid schizophrenic as you can get. Very intelligent, she shuns the spotlight and while very few are actually aware of it, Briar is one the pillars of the company.
A cross between a white dove and a virginal bride, Bridie is a modern-day Mother Teresa.

Her name cuts itself off like few others and, consequently, Bridget gets flustered over every single thing, occasionally fretting badly. But, she’s great to tell your problems to because she’s probably experienced most of them herself, either in real life or theoretically.

Brielle plans and executes well. She's highly skilled at trimming excess fat from companies who have been managed poorly but unfortunately her social life exists largely around work. She could probably loosen up a little but then again, she wouldn't be as successful at her job now, would she? Perhaps a more involved sex life might help?
Picture Frankenstein, trapped in the body of a gameshow hostess.

Way deeper than you imagine, no matter how deep you think she is, Brigid was born to get the job done under the toughest circumstances. Society seems to have brainwashed most of humanity, but not this one. She is her own cat, make no mistake about it, and her methods are therefore anything but orthodox. She's never a deliberate rebel either, but sometimes, as a genuinely empowered and highly intelligent woman, she'll often get talked about in this way. 'Fuck them', is what we up  here in the commentary box reckon about that. We love how she plays the game.
The drill sergeant. She's good for people like Dave.

The kind of woman who would make a horrible psychotherapist but a wonderful astronaut. She’s very bright, well organised, makes excellent quick decisions, is happy to sacrifice herself for the greater good of the capsule/mankind and judgements about her personal safety are made using only solid logic and mathematics. (Note: her orgasms are short in duration, reasonably infrequent but very intense, so that’s nice.)

Brigitte dives into things without thinking and because she can't keep her elbows down, if she’s ever startled by something and leaps backwards unexpectedly, which seems to happen often, she tends to break the nose of the person standing  immediately behind her.
A set of knuckle dusters covered in white baby seal fur.

The modern-day Joan of Arc. Yes, she’s cute, but more important than that she spends her time standing up for, and helping, others. She’d make a brilliant human rights lawyer and if she were a canine she’d be an Avalanche Alsatian, trained in the art of sniffing out buried skiers.

The name of the supreme mystical goddess often seen depicted on a box of Tarot cards. She can see the past, she can see the future and she is so ethereally magical that you will scarcely believe such a human being actually exists. Note: Like a male Nick, she has no idea about a thing called Taxation.

Welcome to Brishon Valley, and rarely in the Kingdom does one see two large rivers flowing in such close proximity. One river is where the backpackers flock to - there are rapids and swimming, sandy beaches and quiet, protected water holes which are cool and inviting. There is even a bloke downstream who sells coffee and icecream in summer time, at least that's what the brochure tells us. Certainly, no one has drowned in it yet. The other river however is a different story, and many people will tell you this is the real Brishon. The waters are deep and dark, and it's freezing near the bottom, legend has it, but the jungles around it make it tough to get to and there are rumours of carnivorous fish. No one knows where this river finishes, and a couple of people have tried and vanished, so these days it's left to only a select few (her close friends, usually), who get to rejoice in her properly, which is a pity. So, what kind of journey are you up for today? We suggest you ditch the backpacker crowd...
Just as Brett is a dedicated blend (perhaps we all are?), Brit is a delightful mix of Nat, Lib, Stacey and Jenn.

I can see it now. The boat is anchored off the island of Capri and on the foredeck the waiter has just delivered Britt a Bloody Mary. Reclining on a banana lounge she looks serene and seductive in a white one-piece and her big black sunnies. The party was fun and though she'd never admit it, she is secretly chuffed that the married prince asked for her phone number. Will she take him up on his offer? Probably not, but then again, Britt treats life as a saucy kind of game, so who knows?...

Brittany is the name given to the physical act of standing up quickly and cracking your head on the corner of something sharp that you forgot was there. But her intentions are noble. Perhaps she just needs to plan ahead a little better? Brittany, any comments you’d like to add here?…

Morbid? Not a chance. Like Lola after after her, Brittney is effectively tone deaf although singing isn't her major passion. She's more of a ribbon-tossing gymnast who has so many friends she can barely keep up with them. It all stems from her level of energy, you see, which is seemingly infinite. She's make a good Emergency Department doctor, just don't give her the microphone at the Christmas party...
The Idealist. She leaves her male counterpart for dead. Why? Because she doesn't care a hoot what others think of her opinions or actions and she's wiser than you imagine.
A sexy woman with a deep voice, possibly the deepest.
Bronte has beautiful clean lines. She might be a little slow to catch on but she’s incredible when she does.

Her hair is normally long and a luscious deep red in colour, but don’t be fooled by the cool façade. For a hobby she organises get-togethers with her girlfriends, many of whom she can’t really stomach for too long, which is why she experiences the odd petty social drama, but Bronwyn is looking for love and comfort like the rest of us.
The Female Gladiator who is prepared to takes steroids.
The Female Gladiator.
The piston in the machine. She never stops - ever - she roars when she needs to and, heavens to mercy, get out of the way if she's coming fast!
Praiseworthy and attentive.

Books are fantastic things aren't they? Without so much as setting foot outside your front door you can be transported to a 20 foot yacht and the sailor who is  single-handedly crossing the Southern Ocean, you can visit the peaks of the Andes and you can succumb to the trials and heart-break of the traders and explorers who first mapped out the Silk Road. 
Born to seek out and to discover the limits of human endeavour, both inner and outer, Brynn is the kind of woman people write such books about...
Like the mood you’re in after a day at the beach with salt on your skin and kisses on your mind, Bryonie is wistfully relaxed and she always seems to have plenty of time.

Bryony affects people in the same way a flying fox ride affects first time users as they go sailing beneath a rainforest canopy. Initially, many people, and especially those who aren't great with heights, find it hard to believe that anyone could become peaceful and calm during such an ominous looking ride. Soon after they take off, however, they understand the cables and harnesses are well-tended, they can barely hear the roller whizzing down the wire, and soon enough they begin to take in the sounds and the smells of the mountain rain forest which surrounds them. At the end, of course, the waterfall finish leaves them breathless and wanting more. And this is Bryony all over.

Again, we suspect Bub is short for Barbara, or Bernice, or Beatrice, or some such name. As it is, Bub's name shoots out into the air like a clay pigeon about to be shot-at by a person wielding a shotgun. Except there's no shotgun here, folks. Bub keeps on flying, and laughing, and doing naughty little skits, forever and ever and ever. We love Bub and so should you.

Jesus Christ, where is she off to now? She wants to race NASCARs in the USA? Are you for real? And, say that again...then she's off to Mexico for the World Cliff Diving Championships? Holy shit! And she did what? She shot that crazy Russian ex-boyfriend of hers? Well good, he was a fuckwit anyway. At least we know the mob wont be game to come after her again. And just repeat that last bit please....next year she's entered the Iditarod? Oh my god. 
Look, if you're talking to her, just tell her to call home once in a while, and can you tell her about this bar bill from that night at the Ritz in London. I haven't got 8 grand just lyin' around. Okay, so, can you tell her that please?
Funny as hell. Pragmatic and insightful, Cad is a sensual tomboy who all the boys are secretly in love with.

Reserved and somewhat demure, Cadance is careful where she puts her feet, her affections and her time. She does have a very acute business sense, however, and the maintenance schedule for her car is always up to date.
Trouble maker/problem solver. I guess it takes one to know one…

Cadence is the name of a bank teller you see every Monday morning. She's cute, she has a nice smile, she looks at you when she's talking and she seems just that little bit shy. Little do you realise however that for years and years her name has been on the door at all the big exclusive nightclubs, downtown. It's amazing she ever turned up to work on time.
Demure, strident and sensual, Cailen rushes into things only rarely. This birthday, be crazy girl!!

Yep, another level-headed lass who tends to do things thoroughly. Does she get caught up in her own little world sometimes such that when boys approach her with suggestions of romance she takes a moment to wonder what they are doing? Yes, she does. Then we get to see that smile. We probably don't see it enough.

Mmmm, well, yes, once upon a time we described Caitlin as a head on train crash waiting to happen, but after watching her pick up her third consecutive Most Courageous Player Award we feel we must add a giant caveat. You see, like very few others in the Kingdom, the speed, determination and initiative she displays in the face of adversity has to be seen to be believed. Caitlin is a delight.
(And yes, if you’re in her way at such a moment you’ll probably wake up in hospital, wondering what the hell happened.)

She'd make a great bush rat. Why? Because she knows all the getaway tracks, she can fight if she has to and yet she can still dart out for some shenanigans at a moments notice. It's just how she is. If you're a complaining man/lover/partner I wouldn't anticipate spending too much time with her, and fair enough too.

Yes, the boys up here in the commentary box love it when Caleiah strides out on to the park. Not only is she a happy player who obviously enjoys herself out on the field, she's quite the competitor. While her opponents are standing around discussing how to spell her name, Caleiah and her sexy little smile has gone right past them. You'd never pick her as a game-changer, would you? We certainly didn't...
Her parents are Kelvin and Eileen so, thankfully, she was never going to be dull. And so it is.
A brand new silver Toyota Camry. (ie. she’s not generally known as a rule breaker, so who knows, perhaps it’s time she got herself arrested?)

Calliope is a whirlwind of joy and delight, a carnival of unicorns and rainbows, punctuated by either crushing migraines or utterly idiotic boyfriends. Can someone take out maximum insurance on her car please? Cheers.

Calyn is one of those friends who snaps into action when someone she cares about is in dire need. For instance, say she's out with the girls one night and one of the crew has had one drink too many, and this after a big dinner. "Come on now," Calyn will urge. "Just make yourself vomit."

Her rather distraught friend looks at her, aghast. "...What?"

"Yep. Look, trust me. You need to purge. It won't hurt and it'll all be over before you know it."

Before the victim has time to protest, Calyn is round behind her and gripping their lower abdomen in a bear hug. 

"Come on now girl!" Calyn urges, pulling her hapless friend’s belly tight and shunting her off the ground. "It won't hurt a bit!"

That's our Calyn for you.

Yes, we have another beautiful tomboy on our hands here folks, although by 16 or 17 that tends to wear off. She certainly has a ton of male friends though. They seem to get amorous from time to time, I mean, let's face it, she's pretty cute, but she's well adept at putting them in their place. Career-wise anything is possible. Once she finds her feet she thrives under a bit of pressure, so who knows? (The business suits will take a bit of getting used to, however, given her love of jeans.)
A powerful, gorgeous Tom Boy in a fast moving world.

The great pink hog. She loves wallowing in filth and the fact that the swill trough is all hers. Go you good thing! (ie: if Camilla wants to do something, be it a wonderful sex romp with a dozen others or to suddenly up and trek across the Andes on her own, she’ll bloody well do and to hell if she’ll waste a moment listening to detractors. Amen.)
Can a person be too selfless? The answer is no, for Camille is a miracle.
A sexy stick of dynamite.
Perhaps we should mandate a law preventing names like Bolivia, Romania and Portugal? Who knows. Anyway, Canada, like the nation, is inoffensive and friendly, so perhaps it’s not all bad.
...“If only the jewellery draped all over my wardrobe wasn’t fake!”

And here we have one of the most ambitious and competitive people in the Kingdom. Like marzipan, you either love her or hate her but she’s definitely very intense and perhaps too intense for many. (It’s a personal-taste thing on our behalf and a self-obsessed thing, on hers.)
She’s lazy, sure, but Candy is refreshing because of how she makes a game out of it for others. It’s actually quite a skill. (And no, we’re not being sarcastic.)
A very nice island, but the girl is unsure if she can cut it in the real world. Baby, YES YOU CAN!!
Caprice is cute and lazy, but "Caprice" rhymes with “Just past the point of most beautiful.”

The Cara Manoeuvre exists for less than a second and is employed by two cowboys when they stand in the street facing each other. Some you win and some you lose, but if you lose you die. (Note: She loves whipped cream squirted directly into her gob.)
Caren is always busy but she manages to get all these tasks done without speaking. How is that possible? It's quite bizarre.
Where? Where'd she go?..... Is this her shoe??

Are you ever going to see Carey leaning over the pulpit, reading a psalm from the bible?

No.

Will you see her scrounging for money near the homeless shelter, dressed in rags?

Nah ah.

Might you see Carey in the middle of telling a joke to few other staff nearby, when suddenly a phone rings, alerting the emergency department of the massive impending influx of patients from a nearby train crash, whereby she ditches the joke, grabs her stethoscope, dons the plastic gloves and rushes into help?

Yes. Yes you would. And she'd finish the telling of the joke just as the first ambulance pulled up. 

Bravo Dr Carey.
The Revolutionary. You'll often see her on a Harley but if she is a member of a motorcycle gang then she's not a revolutionary at all - more like a lost conformist. Carina is better off on her own.
See Karine, unless she has an accent, in which case she is probably French or Belgian, and damn-near perfect.
Her parents hail from a beach in Greece, and this has produced a startling dark-haired woman who is feisty, intelligent and loving of only those people who have earned it.
The name of type of kiss during which both parties can’t actually stop....

Carleah likes to have fun and she doesn't like to think too much. For example, if she and some friends visited a theme park based on water rides, Carleah would bust through people to be the first in line at that ride where you stand vertical in a capsule, awaiting the floor to open beneath you, thus sending you free-falling at break-neck speed through a tube-ride that has to be seen to be fully appreciated. Trouble is, she's shit-scared of heights. Once inside, she starts screaming at the top of her lungs and nothings even happened yet. In a nutshell, she loves it, she hates it, she loves it, she hates it, etc etc etc. (Page one line one of the Carleah manual: Keep her busy!)
Baby, once, just for once, can you do me a favour and look where you're going? Thank you. X

Carlene is a spirited, confident lass, but she knows how to relax. She's equally at home in the city as well as next to a camp-fire beneath the stars, and if she had to do without her hair products for a while she'd lose no sleep whatsoever.
See Carli, basically, except that her dealings in life are not quite as smooth.
Carli has the power and confidence to go it alone. While not a dedicated troublemaker, she has the capacity to attract unwanted attention that she may not be able to shed very easily.

Not as reactive as Carli, and with less time to waste than Carly, Carlie is better balanced in that she sees the real picture faster and more cleanly than most. But, as ever, if she's in a rush or bothered about something or someone, you can expect her to do something about it sooner rather than later. She loves her all-day music festivals.
The ‘y’ rounds her off to perfection such that she is blessed with one of the largest and most luscious smiles in the Kingdom, and many men find her completely intoxicating as a result.

A dysfunctional woman that lives in the rich and leafy streets of the plush side of town. In a strange twist of irony, she is actually a kind soul but her good deeds are completely misread by many as being arrogant displays of ostentation. She doesn’t really care about the money and, like billions of people all over the world, all she really wants is some genuine friends to love, and who love her back.

A cross between Lizzie, Rosemary and Nancy, Carmela has long ago thrown out the rule book. She's drunk peyote with the Indians in New Mexico, she's had sex in restaurant toilets with her betrothed (at the time), she's cartwheeled down mountain sides pissing herself the whole way after smoking a joint and going skiing, and she's broken more hearts of men she's never met than most girls do in a life time. Christ knows what she does these days, where she lives and how she's lived this long, but Carmela has ticked all the boxes because she lives life to the full and regrets nothing. Amen.
Originally from Malta, she will ask you if you want to use the bathroom even before you step into her house. I have no idea why.

You'll generally see remnants of Carmena's work in surfing magazines. She's that gorgeous young siren in a bikini, standing on a beach at sunset, the orange light glinting off her black black hair, and she'll be looking down, kind of mournfully with those big dark eyes. Does she surf? We're not sure. She should if she doesn't.

The name of the Sticky Date Pudding served at the end of a rather splendid dinner. The guests love her, even though 21% of them will inevitably dribble a large amount of Carmody down the front of themselves. Initially they are embarrassed and saddened at their public sloppiness, but not for long. It’s not as if they’re being fed some kind of baby custard in a poor hospital now, is it? They’re being fed Carmody, and she’s delightful, especially as you get to lick her off your fingers at the finish!

Caro’ sighs, because it’s not like she hasn’t waded through all this bullshit before, fatigued and in need of a good shower and a lie down. How she retains her sense of humour is what we find really impressive. Most men in her position would bitch and complain and carry on, but not this girl. She has the nous and wherewithal to get on with it, as well as encourage those who are lagging behind. Good on you Caro’, we appreciate what you’re doing. 
Love Management. x

The peace-loving and well-natured Loggerhead Turtle. Despite a deep-seated desire to ‘break out’, she swims thousands of miles every year in the course of mating and giving birth, but the effort of dodging Tiger Sharks and laying countless eggs has taken its toll. She’s looking forward to the next life and she deserves a break. Carol is lovely.

Carolann sports a sizeable curiosity which sometimes takes a while to show itself. For example, she might pass the same homeless man on the same corner four days every week for 5 years, until one day she realises he's wearing an old school jacket from the same institution she attended. Then she'll pull all her prejudices down. She'll probably even give him a few bucks and suggest a place where he can get a feed and have a shower.

Carole is very similar to Carol, except Carole gets to experience just a little bit more relaxation time over the journey. It's the E at the end that does it. It's like the tail of a monkey that swings to and fro, removing excess stress and allowing a little more time for irreverent play.

If Carol-Ann spies so much as a sniff or an itch from her kids then BANG, she's onto it; ringworms, coughs, colds, rashes - you name it - she snaps into action. You should see her medicine drawer. And she has a very expressive forehead.

The name of a Spanish dance that is complicated, passionate and energetic. Get it wrong and you’ll look like an A-Grade fool, but get it right – and you’ll have to dedicate yourself – then the rewards are endless. Good luck!

Once upon a time we described Caroline as a powerful and sexy ‘chick’, who ran her own arms company and who never made the same mistake twice. That and the fact she lived in Geneva, Switzerland, and was worth millions. Thing is, the metaphor holds true: Caroline is organised and she has style. She doesn’t tolerate idiots and she is well-travelled. She loves the idea of a romantic getaway but she’s not going to spend her holiday camped next to a mosquito-ridden swamp. And while she desires to be loved and cared for she’s more than equipped to find peace and love within her own heart. And Caroline is a sexy girl. It’s just how it all is. 
So, you got all that?
Carolyn is rather refined, either in real life or in her own head, and she would rather die than flash her breasts in any kind of public space.
Carrie is extremely beautiful but she killed her parents when she was very young because she discovered that they’d lied to her about the milk being low fat. It was full cream.

Carryn works tirelessly behind the scenes. Never in-your-face, she keeps her head down and does her bit as part of the team. If she were a wasp and something appeared to be approaching the nest she'd be one of the first to throw down tools and go out and attack. Bet you didn't expect that huh?

She may not be the most ordered person in the Kingdom but she certainly prepares well and she knows what she wants. As one of the most judicious people in any room that she happens to be in, she exudes a calm and steady energy. For that reason alone she is relaxing to be around, but you'll never see her at a male strip show. At least, not unless she decides to sneak out and go on her own when no one is watching.
As a passionate and intense soul, Casey gets bored at the drop of a hat. She is quite sexy on her day and while no one knows what she does for a living, she’s definitely not a knitter.
Apprentice beautician.

Life for Casidhe consists of layer upon layer upon layer. Yes, that could be said for a lot of us, but she has the unique skill of not wasting moments. These various layers of her life therefore, be they work, family, lovers, pets, the car, required stationary, the gym, the bloody supermarket, or you name it, basically, will be intertwined with one another in such a way that she always seems to be killing multiple birds with one stone. Know what I mean? We don't think it's a fluke either. It's why she always looks a little preoccupied when you're talking to her. Cute grin though.

Here is a typical conversation with Casie….

“Hey Casie, what are you doing?”
“I’m pulling this stereo apart to see what components I can use to make a bomb with.”
“…..What do you want to blow up?”
“The postman. Three days in a row now he just flicks the letters onto my front yard. Doesn’t even bother with the letter box.”
“…..Casie, you haven’t got a letter box.”
“….oh shit, you’re right. Oh well, let’s just see what happens. I’m not trying to kill him, I just want to see what happens.”

You with me?

Very driven, highly intelligent, and with a knowledge of foreign affairs that is second to none, Cass is a highly regarded secret service operative and one of the groups most skilled interrogators. And yep, with a fake passport in her pocket she can party the house down with zero fear of reprocussions.

Cassady is an expert at leading her boyfriends/partners/lovers/acquaintances into a conversational trap where upon they are set upon by an irrefutable argument, such that they wish the ground would just swallow them up. We suggest you, the reader, avoid lying anyway, but certainly NEVER LIE TO CASSADY. She'll eat you for breakfast, pure and simple.
Cassandra rides a big white horse on a beach in the nude, in slow motion, but ‘Cassandra’ is also the name given to the sound of any long hair that swooshes.

To talk to Cassia you would have no idea that her home life is rarely straightforward and simple. She's such a positive, enlivened person that to imagine her stressed is almost impossible. Perhaps some people are born to help and assist others a little more than they ought to? We're not sure.
Cassidy is one of very few people who swims in the ocean knowing that sharks are too scared to go anywhere near her.
The Realist. She can’t be badgered into doing anything.
All boys are desperate to know her. She exudes…something incredible.

The no-nonsense tracker/ researcher/ protagonist/ commander in chief. Fiercely and naturally independent, Catarina moves too quickly to gather any moss. On the rare occasion she is a slow-moving Catarina, then she is most assuredly voluptuous and funny, and not prone to moving anywhere quickly. Both versions are a long way from dim.

As a refined and rather regal cat, Cate likes the idea of a walk in the national park to admire the flora and fauna, but not a seven hour gut-busting mission where you you have to poo into plastic bags and carry it out with you. And if it's raining even just a little bit you can forget the whole thing. Give her a book or a movie and a hot chocolate and a couch, and she's done. Cate. x

Trying to explain Cateline's personality is like trying to explain how a city works by studying a giant map of the rail system, traffic lights, roads and highways. It is so complex it's beautiful, and maybe that's the key? So, in relation to our Cateline, the question you need to ask yourself, therefore, is where do you think you are in the system, and is it currently functioning well? (It usually is, because a large and well-organised group of maintenance staff are at the ready, 24/7.) Either way, good luck, and let us know if there's a breakdown somewhere.
A practical woman who never quite understands why men pay her the attention they do.
Like a bean bag on the back porch, Cath is wholly accepting and forgiving and she's as happy in the back of the ute as she is in the front seat behind the wheel.

A normal smooth-skinned, fast swimming, elegant cetacean that wanna-be hippies hang posters of, on the wall. Yes, dolphins are very smart, very successful, they form complex social groups, have a highly developed language, look good…..etc, etc, etc.
See Cath, except Cathy is far more tolerant of dog hair.

If Catrianna were a walrus she'd be the loudest, proudest walrus on the beach. If Catrianna were a nesting magpie she'd be the only magpie in the street who would swoop everything - dogs, riders, kids, adults, cars, trucks etc. If Catrianna were a killer whale she'd play with her trainer for a little while and then eat them, although, having said that, she'd be lucky to get caught in the first place. If Catrianna were a car she'd be a canary-yellow Ferrari. If Catrianna were a surgeon she'd wear crazy clothes, play loud music and dance in theatre. 

Indeed, I'm detecting a pattern here...
Why, Catriona is a Rosella parrot in full plumage, darling!

Another of the Gifted Ones. This girl is relaxed in her life, funny in company, intelligent if she feels like speaking, incredibly beautiful without flaunting it and more adaptable to hardship than most. There’s no question to be had: Caz is someone worth knowing and loving from any angle.

You have to stutter in order to say her name and Cecilia therefore stutters through life, often altering her desires and her perceived path in the universe as frequently as the weather changes. Maybe she just gets bored easily? She’s great fun though.

Okay, now Cecille, just relax for a second. Hear all those kids yelling? That lover of yours who whinges? That cow at work who gives you grief? None of them actually exist, you know. They're just memories in your head, as you stand here and talk to me. So, have a sip of this and put your feet up here. Is this music okay for you? Good, alright, so just chill out for a bit, think about nothing, and I'll come back and wake you up in a few hours. Enjoy......

Plucky and irresistable, Cecily struggles to find the time to properly relax and put her feet up. Why is that doll? She wraps her friends up very tightly if they need it and, like many in the Kingdom, she definitely gives more than she receives.

Better than Silky Oak, eh? Anyway, Cedar turned out all right as a non-tree. She’s amiable and conscientious, just a little bit timid, and we’re hoping that having some notion of wood in her name will prevent her from ever deciding to get breast implants. That would be a tragedy.

A well-weighted name for a well-weighted, sensual and dignified girl. Her grandmother once told her that she shouldn't pay for anything unless she couldn’t afford it, and she's applied that to her whole life. She dabbles when she feels like it, keeps it real for the most part and is delicious and naughty if the time is right.
A sexy girl that enjoys her stargazing so much she’s developed a bruised chin from walking into things with her head in the air.

The demanding head of the local church choir. She actually doesn’t give a shit about any kind of religious crap – she just likes to sing – but don’t be turning-up to practice with her if you’re not ready to give 100%. You got that?

Do yourself a favour, if you want to hear something funny go up to her front door - if you can get past the hounds - and ring the doorbell. Do you hear that music that sounds like a 4-piece quartet coming from inside? Well, that's not a recording. That's a 4-piece quartet that she has play every time someone does that. I've no idea what they do all day. Indeed, I've no idea what Celine does all day? Celine, can you help us here please?...

Some people are just never quite ready, are they. At the Oscars, for example, she's always last out of the limo' because she's still getting dressed. Consequently she couldn't give a rats arse about the paparazzi on the red carpet - she's too busy doing up her shoes. Ironically, perhaps, the paparazzi, as well as the crowd in general, just adore her.
Cerise insists she has a sense of humour. Didn't Stalin say the same thing?

Now Chabli, are you a bit chubbly? I mean, chubby? Okay, well then let's do somethig about it. How about this for a start? Throw out all lollies, chips, icecreams, chocolates and sugar drinks. Indeed, anything processed including cheese - ditch the lot. When you've done that come back here and we'll give you some ideas. It's only after you start respecting your body that we can begin...

Lucky they didn't call her Verdun, or Toulouse, eh? Anyway, Chamonix is the name of French resort town, and the name of any girl who is just a little bit lost. Girl, only one question do you need to answer, and you might have to go on a journey to find out, but what do you want?
The Mischievous Crow!

Dazed and confused? Well, head on over to Chandra's house. She'll make you a soy latte coffee (organic, naturally), or a herbal tea, she'll put on some gentle meditative music, light some cleansing incense to remove all that bad energy and insist you sit with her and concentrate on letting in all that love in the world that's right there on tap, so long as you're in the flow. Peace be with you and don't ever shave, man or woman.

I suppose the following can be said for most of us, but it applies very aptly for Chanel: If ever some world drama removes electricity and, by necessity, all electrical/motorised items from the planet, Chanel wouldn't cope for very long.
Chantal has a stronger self-belief than her sister, below, and she couldn’t care less if people deem her to be proud and loud in the way she operates. She would have made an excellent hunting eagle.

No muddy boots here kids. She's got every type of social media account known to man, she has no idea where Venus is, she's heard of the Milky Way, but she thinks it might be a nightclub, and she takes more selfies than 87% of the population. Chantel, honey, your'e cute and you're no fool, but maybe it's time to get yourself a dog!
Strong self-belief. Chantelle is into real estate and the markets so it makes sense that, despite her rather quiet nature, she is quite competitive.
Stripper, and a good one. And she’s neither stupid nor a pushover.

Thank goodness they didn't name her Disappointment, or I'm Really Horny. Anyway, like any goldfish worth its salt, Charisma has a memory that's good for about twelve seconds. You might need to attach a radio transmitter to her if you want to keep track of what she's up to, especially given that she's not sure herself.

Charissa is not always the most obliging colleague, only because she dives so deeply into issues that she sometimes finds it difficult to see the world outside. And she doesn't enjoy leaving things half finished. She takes ages to get ready to go out and we're still wondering how her life got so complicated. Usually, Charissa is busier than God.

Rare, beautiful and pure like bush honey, Charity does just about anything she wants and with an air of nonchalance. In fact she reminds me of a recipe – has anyone tried honey-roasted potatoes lately?

Charlee is one of those recruits that just loves the marching. She actually prefers it when it's pouring with rain and the parade yard is a mudbath. She really gets her teeth into it, taking it on as a personal challenge. Never would she be the first one to capitulate if the platoon was sent into battle, but she may very well be the last. Indeed, the enemy wouldn't want to capture her. She'll kill 'em all and win herself the highest military honour in the land.
Yep, Charleen you are so similar to Charlene it ain't funny, and that's a good thing. So just pop over there and, well, what can we say?....Congratulations, probably!

Thing about Charlene, you never quite know what's going through her head. Yep, she's funny and delicious and unselfconscious and all of that, and she turns the boys heads, and she's devoted when she's in the zone, etc etc, but here's the thing...Say she's in the kitchen one day with her lover/partner, enjoying a little joke about something that happened last week while she chops the vegies (with a big, sharp knife). For something to do the thought might just pop into her mind about what it'd be like to stab her partner in the back. Not out of hate or malice, you understand, but purely as a scientific/artistic exercise. Charlene, you see, understands and fully indulges the length and breadth of her imagination - as we all should. The moral to the story here is that her life - and her partners therefore - is a rarely going to be dull. (And anyway, say if she did stab her partner to death, they both know that a next-life exists, so it's all good in the end.)
Yes, just like Charlie, her twin sister, Charli is seductive and funny and great company, but she is also just a teency weency bit unstable. And that’s a grand thing, by the way.

Charlie bawls her eyes out one minute and is the picture of perfect calm and confidence, the next. She’ll often insist on driving herself home from the nightclub at four in the morning when she’s so out of it she can hardly stand. The funny thing is that under these conditions she’s one of the world’s great drivers. Weird, huh?
Works with Teagan.

Some people have the capacity to convince themselves of just about anything. Last time we heard from her, her millionaire boyfriend from bloody Monaco, or somewhere, had abandoned her on the Champs-Élysées at 2am after a roaring, public fight in one of the city's finest restaurants. They recovered of course and spent a day and a half in bed. It happened all over again in Nice a week later. Anyone know where she is this week?

Blessed with incredible luck, both perfect and farcical, Charlotte is a gifted lover, sister and partier, who enjoys nothing more than sitting around at an outdoor restaurant with her multitude of friends, while they feast on good food and wine in the summer sun. Outstanding performance, Miss Charlotte.

As a giraffe that strolls the African savannah, Charmaine is a long and elegant name for a slender and damn-near elegant woman. She looks down on the myriad of creatures that live in her world with a sense of fascination and wonder, engaging all those in her midst without rancour.

Macdonald's Trainee Manager. Committed and capable. (Don't let the system brainwash you, Charne. Management.) 

(Note: there may possibly be a strange apostrophe above the n. Either way, the commentary team like this girl, and we suggest you ought to, too.)

Well, yes, she does sometimes wear chanel, but in terms of providing herself with a refined, dignified air, this is about as close as she's going to get.

Party? You bet. Champagne, chardonnay, Pimms - and the rest. 

What's that you say? Her parents are worried she'll never find a job?

I wouldn't worry about that too much. She seems to attract alot of attention from some quite lovely men who seem to have more money than sense, so, who knows, Charnele might be doing a great job after all.

And no, she's not likely to spend 3 months in Tibet on a spiritual pilgrimage. You with me?

Chase can handle the onslaught. Her group is slightly useless but if and when a leader is needed or requested, Chase is always the one to step to the front. Boys, some advice, you need to be a man here because you’re going to be dealing with a superior intellect.

God, she's a pain in the arse. Yes, she's funny and smart and she's got the gift of the gab, and people generally adore her, but she's a bloody stubborn mule when wants to be! For instance, if she's only just poured herself her morning cup of tea and an earthquake begins, don't expect her to run out of the house. Indeed, she'll just sit there, pissed off that her morning routine has been thrown out the window.

In a past life Chay was a barbarian and a leader who was totally ruthless and courageous. It probably explains why she ends up so bored a lot of the time in this life. She doesn't know it of course, but her soul is perpetually pissed off that no one seems to want to kill anybody anymore! Nice girl though, and, as one might expect, she hates being beaten at anything.

Has she got the looks to become a cheer leader? Yes. Would she ever consider cheer leading? Not on your life. Chaya isn't quite the full bookworm, but she reads and she listens to those she deems worthy of listening to, and she has great ambition to get in and get things done. Her parents taught her about money very well.
Well, rather than listen to us tell you about how generally funny and cheeky she is, how splendidly sarcastic she can be, we suggest you just go around to her house and see for yourself.

Not as swashbuckling as some of her more commonly-spelt cousins, Chelcey lacks that killer punch. Sure, we all have a niche to fill but this Chelcey is better adapted to a more standardised life. Certainly, she’s never killed a pig with a large hunting knife and she’d never try to outrun the cops. On the flip-side, her room is a mess and this points to a greater artistic capacity than average.

Seen those movies lately that come out of Hollywood or wherever, and in some military/intelligence-gathering scenario, a young woman's advice is heeded by all and sundry? Aside from being extremely cute, Chelcey-Anne is full-on, head-strong and she knows exactly what she wants. Sadly, there aren't enough of these women in the real world, but here is an exception. Chelcey-Anne can plan a war, plan a hit, plan a party and plan her friends' plans, all without batting so much as en eyelid. It's quite a gift.

How laid-back do you wanna’ get? Last time we took Chele to a restaurant, and quite a nice restaurant I might add, as the desserts were being brought out she was given a dare. It wasn’t even that serious, but do you think Chele gives a fuck? Just as the last bowl of sticky date was placed on the table, Chele stood up, winked to the person who dared her, and with a rapid and dramatic flail of arms, attempted to whisk the table cloth out from underneath 5 dessert plates, 7 1/2-full wine glasses, 3 wine bottles, an array of butter plates and a plethora of shiny silver cutlery. It actually went pretty well, but she still made a hell of a mess. At the end of it the carnage the maitre’d rushed over, distraught, but not Chele. She shrugged and said, “Yeah, that’s not bad for a first attempt, eh?” Chele.

Gentlemen, if you intend to ask Chelsea out on a date, don’t just think that your personality alone is going to be enough. You’ll need an expensive restaurant, you’ll need to look like you know what you’re doing, and that’s just the beginning…

Provincial, regular and mundane: no fucking way would anyone use any of these words to describe Ms Chelsey. Not a chance. More like: New York, the Greek Islands and Ecstasy-Up-The-Eiffel tower - they're much more appropriate. Like Nathaniel way after her, Chelsey needs the occasional real-life melodrama to prove life isn't some boring merry-go-round where no one really does much and nothing that exciting really happens. Some advice from the commentary box: If you're bored, head on over to Chelsey's house where your only plan is not to say no to anything. Amen.
The Black Panther with a glistening coat. She’s bloody dangerous when kept in the house but perfect in the wild. Please don’t ever put her in a zoo.

Okay sure, we once described Cherie as piquant, which infers that she is quite rich and intense. This maybe true, but we feel we need to expand somewhat. Cherie doesn't just dawdle off in some direction as determined by the crowd. Nup. This girl takes forthright steps in an attempt to make things happen sooner rather than later. She therefore frowns if things don't go her way and these minor frustrations occasionally get to her. It depends on who you talk to and your belief system, of course, but there is a train of thought which says the universe always provides one with exactly what one needs. I wonder if Cherie has heard of that? Then again, her passion for life is expressed inside an ardent desire to try new things, and to not wait around for shit to happen, in which case, she's doing a grand job. Let me put it another way: beneath Cherie’s quite organised and diligent skin is a tiger awaiting to break the shackles and wreak some passionate havoc. Amen.

Cherine experiences her life like a glass of fine wine that was forgotten about and is now a little bit acidy to taste, while the party has moved to the next room. What a waste. The bottle cost $300 - outstanding vintage - which means that untouched full glass, now off, cost about 60 bucks. Sure, the cellar is full and there will be plenty more glasses drunk from that old and rather magnificent brew but a glass gone is a glass gone. Why and how did they not drink her? Cherine, ditch the clan for a week or two and take a holiday for some ‘Cherine Time’. If they don’t appreciate you properly find some people who do.
Love Management.

Weird name, lovely girl. Yep, she can pack a punch but it’s rarely undeserved. Don’t buy into the cosiness of her name - that’s complete bullshit. Cherish is functional and busy, and certainly too busy to stop and have a pointless conversation about why her parents named her that way.

Nah, Cheron is no nincompoop. Yes, she's fun and she laughs, and you should take a look at her friends, jeepers, but her defining characteristic is that SHE WILL NOT TOLERATE DASTARDLY DEEDS PERFORMED ON ANYONE SHE CARES ABOUT. Not for a second. Perhaps she runs a woman's shelter? Anyway, if she asks you for money give it to her with good grace.
She'll be giving it to someone who needs it more than you. Amen.
A well-rounded, hilarious lady who, after you arrive at her outdoor party or barbecue, will insist you put on the silly hat that she gives you.

Cherryl-Anne is a bit weird. Perhaps she's Canadian but either way, Cherryl-Anne likes to make her coffee in the morning, let it go cold and drink it from a see-through container. Why does she do this? No one knows. Her life is replete with these strange little idiosyncrasies and for that reason alone she's fun to follow around.
Cheryl works her fingers to the bone for little or no reward.

Well, if the whole world only knows her as that then we might have a few issues. Is she a painful bloody fuss-pot? 

Yep.

Does she think her shit doesn't stink?

Yes.

Does she have friends?

Yes, and they're a pain in the arse as well.

Worst of all, she can't kiss and she's useless in bed.

Chez, where did you go, honey?

Yep, that second 'l' does all sorts of things. It makes her happier, it makes her way more forgetful and it makes her flash her knickers more often. Perhaps these three things are linked - we're not sure. Suffice to say the boys up here in the commentary box are delighted, not only for her presence on the ground today, but because win, lose or draw, you won't find Cheryll sulking. Life moves forward and not for one second backward - this is something she reminds us regularly.
As a young lass Cherylyn hitched more miles than any other girl in the Kingdom. But don't worry about her, in case you are. She can look after herself, alright.

“What's the problem NOW?” the seamstress asks, exasperated. This is the 6th time Cheryse has brought her dress back to the store. “Didn't you try it on when you bought the bloody thing?” 
“Oh stop your complaining,” Cheryse says with a wave of her hand. “Now I’ll be back 5 o’clock and I expect it to be ready!”
Cheryse.

Cheyenne is a complicated lass who promises much but she will have to ensure she never becomes complacent or too lazy, otherwise there is a risk she’ll end up going nowhere in a hurry. Greatness is there for the taking, no question, and she can spit and curse as much as she likes, but only she can go and get it.

Like a female Dave, Chez makes others feel at home. Her sense of humour is easy and often self-deprecating, and people feel extremely comfortable in her company. Not one for formality, she shuns the spotlight unless she's on a party rampage, and even then her ego isn't aware she's the centre of attention. She's Chez, and she's real, and that's all that matters.
Deceptively normal. (Dad: Chito. Mum: Andrea)

Rarely prone to bullshit, if Chiara is taken to an expensive restaurant and the gentleman suitor is making a big song and dance about decanting the $700 bottle of wine into a carafe, Chiara will huff in exasperation, shake her head and say, "For Christ's sake mate, just pour the bloody thing will you?"

Chiffeni escaped from a psychiatric ward years ago and, out under the radar, she has managed to carve out a successful catering career. For years she worked in chaotic restaurants where she fitted right in. In the end, she figured she should get one, herself, and so she did. She's worth heaps now and she pays her taxes, she has lots of fun and even has a passport which she uses every few months, so you can put that straight jacket away, thanks.
On a school trip to a cattle farm, Chilli initially refused to get on the bus and then threw a tantrum in protest that she wasn't going to be permitted to brand the animals.
The talented and solo artist, China has a tempest-like temperament
KARATEEEEEEEEEE CHOP!!!! (Note: she's also been offered a role as a Bond Girl.)
Chloe is a tan coloured calf that gulps down milk faster than her mum can make it. (i.e: Chloe is optimistic, she has fun and she doesn’t want to fuck about.)

Sure, in a past life she worked for the council designing where new street lights were to be positioned, but we all evolve, even though Chris’s work ethic is almost as good as Sue’s. Chris manages the various aspects of her life with ease, and yes, it takes a bit of work. What she’d never do is just give up and fall into a heap, and she’s never boisterous or obnoxious. Chris is another lass who needs more massages, although if she’s not used to them she’s liable to give you a strange look and ask you what the hell you are doing, rubbing her shoulders.
Her name sounds like an Olympic hurdler crashing into the first hurdle and landing, splat, on the gravel. But, as long as she isn’t grizzlin’ Chrislyn is ambitious and excitable.
This girl is outrageous fun. Her only hiccup arises when she endeavours to complicate matters.
See Chrissie, except that Chrissy has had a child or two or three and has long since left the occasionally crazy world of ‘Chrissie’ behind her.

No matter how twisted her private life gets Christa is always able to scrape together the funds/friends she needs to get her rather zany ideas off the ground. It's only once they're up and running that she runs into difficulties. But, lord knows Christa will find a way!

Perfection, purity and refinement: these are words Christene enjoys the sound of. As a proud A-type who tells everyone of the correct spelling of her name, she ensures tasks are completed by her underlings and it takes a lot of hard work (by herself or others) to achieve orgasm.
Christian is an unusual and sexual entity. She knows she has a presence and she just likes to make sure, occasionally, that you know, too. And that’s okay.
Christiane's wrist watch is about the same size as a restaurant dinner plate.
"D'at flap jack hit da' floor, but we don' mine'. We just love dem' flap jacks!"
Christie-Jo works in a sausage factory.

Christin is a medium-sized lake filled with perfectly clear water, and which is frozen solid. And you can skate out over her in winter, enjoying her slippery acceptance, but just stop and have a look deep into the ice, for a moment. If you're lucky you'll see her ex-husband's car, and lord knows what other little secrets she keeps hidden away down there!
An Italian, Spanish or Portugese Goddess who is brown from years in the sun, and whose green eyes take you somewhere else when you look into them. She’s a demon on a scooter.
Christine is intelligent and a borderline intellectual. She should have been an author rather the hard-arse CEO that she became, and 67% of Christines detest being called Chris.

An inoffensive lass who has never tried to lift anything heavy. She's be useless in an African tribe where you have to walk kilometres for water, for instance. Ironically enough, western Cians can be quite politically active, just don’t ask her to help move furniture around in the campaign office.
Ciara doesn't tolerate slackers and she expects people to contribute. Her ego is healthy, her outlook the same, and she inspires and assists her friends where and when they need it.
Cilia isn't silly, she's just a little preoccupied. It might be her bag, her credit card, her jeans, how short her shorts are, the man she likes etc etc. Get the picture?

Yes, interesting. Cimonne is a busy, attractive lass who seems to look great even first thing in the morning. However, Cimonne IS the kind of lady who, if travelling on, say, the Titanic, would simply refuse to believe such a disaster could happen to her. In which case, she may well be one of the girls to go down with the ship purely because she refused to leave the vessel without her make-up kit.

Cinamon needs a little more chilli in her life, in the form of either a life passion, a loving funny man/woman/pet, a new job or perhaps even a new city to live in. Sometimes you have to change it up to discover the real you, Miss Cinamon.

Cinderella is so incredible that the only way to describe her properly is with the use of mathematics. If there are around 7.5 billion people on the planet, give or take, and there are only about 9 Cinderellas in existence, that means that she is not just one in a million, but more like one in eight hundred and thirty three million, three hundred and thirty three thousand, three hundred and thirty three point three, recurring. What more can anyone say? x

Cindy was probably born about 40 years too late and belongs in a simpler, less complicated time. Sure, she’s sexy and she’s motivated, and she does quite well in the modern world, but this phenomenon of everyone constantly checking their bloody phones and social media feeds really gnaws at her deeper psyche. And yep, she gets caught up in the bullshit like everyone else, but fewer people are more detrimentally undermined by all this irrelevant crap. Give her friends, give her a jetty on a lake to jump from, give her sunshine and give her a normal bloody land-line phone. The End.
Yes, Cissy is eager and excited and she gets bored and she wants to run and she loves to meet up with her friends and flirt and carry-on and just keep on going. She's never heard of work.
Perfectly gorgeous. Reasonably impossible.

Hi Clair. The crew up here in the commentary box are delighted to see that you're playing today. In fact, we hope you're in one of your very rare foul moods because we love watching you play when your blood is up. Anyway, please head on over to your funk soul sister (Claire) for the full report. Indeed, the fact that we suggest that might be enough to inspire you to a best-on-ground performance today. Good luck!

Well, sure, once upon a time she might have been a type of perfume packaged in the most inviting and seductive bottle imaginable but those days are far gone. Claire is far more proactive and ambitious than you think. Yes, she has slightly skewed ideas about men, women and romance, but she sticks to her guns and she listens when she feels like listening. And if she doesn't feel like listening, and you've done something to piss her off, don't be surprised if one of those empty perfume bottles comes flying at you at a rate of knots.

Sure, her work life is all over the shop, her romantic life is even more chaotic and she’s at least one bill is way overdue, but Clancy is one of those people whose imminent  arrival at the party gets everyone excited.
Closely related to Bessie, Clara is the name of an old Massey Ferguson tractor. She loves the mud and she’s super reliable, and she’s arguably the funniest woman you’ll meet this year.
A dedicated environmentalist and artist. Clare is so passionate about her various pursuits that she sometimes forgets to stop and smell the roses because life for her is generally wonderful.

In lots of ways, Clarissa was born a couple of generations later than she ought to have been. That's not to say she doesn't fit-in now, but her enthusiasm and her drive, as well as her knack for providing humour and motivation in times of dire need and real catastrophe are wasted in a normal, safe environment. She might be better off working for Medicine Sans Frontier or some such aid organisation where she could really make a difference to the world.
(In a past life she flew planes around England for the RAF during World War II, delivering them, and though she rarely displayed her anger, she was pissed off that she couldn't join an active fighter squadron and fight for her country. She was certainly skilled enough.)

If only it were that easy - good one mum and dad! By definition she sucks at it because chaos is her friend. Well, either that or she’s too shy to show herself during daylight hours, in which case no one knows what she’s up to. Hopefully, at some point, she’ll steal her dad’s car and write it off. Now that’d be funny…so long as no one is hurt.

Whether Claudia works for the communist party or not, she has wild hair that befits her ardently held opinions and she loves a hearty debate where at least one person present starts sobbing, and it’s rarely her. (Deep down, of course, she just loves the theatre.)

Claudine is that person in a group of friends who knows when all the best bands are coming to town, and how to get tickets. Some of these bands you've never heard of, which, on the surface, is a pain when you consider she's never backward in coming forward with regards to getting her lazy friends off their backsides. Indeed, Claudine has difficulty taking 'no' for an answer. But this raises a good point: How often have you ever gone out and wish you hadn't?
Exactly. 
And she knows everyone. (As a wee side issue, the back seat of her car is a bloody mess - mostly due to the fact that her dog goes everywhere with her. And neither of them have missed a gig.)
The quite lovely bomb-disposal expert. i.e- yes she's sensual, but she is extremely committed and focussed when she needs to be. She wants for nothing.

Clementa can't run quickly, mostly because her parents bought her shoes a size and half too big for her in the hope that she'd grow into them. In adulthood she therefore tends to take things slowly because whenever she attempted otherwise she'd invariably fall over. However, as a SCUBA diver she feels very comfortable walking to the water's edge with her fins on and you won't find a more graceful person in a zero-gravity situation. She doesn't handle being rushed.

Of sound structure, both philosophical and spiritual, Clementina makes an excellent barrister. She never takes no for an answer, her capacity to think laterally means she's never bored and in the bedroom she is a forthright and considerate lover. As with all members of this species, it's Clementina who does the divorcing, not the fellow.

Right, well, if everyone calls her Clementine I suggest you don't visit without (A) sending her a letter, requesting a visit at least a fortnight before your planned arrival and (B) bringing her some kind of expensive gift - champers, caviar, both probably, or perhaps invites to that summer tea party that the Prince holds every August. Good luck!
A rather gorgeous heat-seeking missile.

She either embraces her name and gets large in personality, life and presence, and who, despite being an occasional pain in the arse, becomes utterly delicious and memorable, or kind of shies away from centre stage and turns into a very friendly and loveable checkout chick. Who you got?…

Once upon a time, we may have described Clio as a highly intelligent Golden Retriever, who was therefore one of the gentlest individuals on earth. Turns out we need to revise this because we spoke to the coach. Thing is, she's so fast and nimble that no one, not even us, her biggest fans, can see her cheeky and borderline criminal behaviour on the field. No wonder we seem to win so many games.

An open name for an open girl. Cloe watches and she listens, and she considers her opinion. As an ostensibly good and generous individual it takes a pretty dodgy situation or person to visibly piss her off. Indeed, the crew up here in the commentary box have been discussing her, and we think she’s probably a little bit too nice sometimes. She is a doting partner and a romantic lover, and our only suggestion for Cloe is that she act on her gut instinct faster than she does.

Nah, she ain’t no push over folks. Far from it. Yes, her name sounds like a lush green pasture for big fat dairy cows and the closest we can say about that is that she is generous, but underneath this homely and almost adorable exterior is a very smart lass who understands the systems and mechanisms she needs to employ (or put up with) in order to achieve what she wants. She’s a thinker and she’s not lazy, and it’s a simple fact of life that some things take time.
You want coconuts? Well you'll need a bona fide jungle girl to help you not only collect them, but to slice them open.

Why didn't your parents think about Hydrogen? Or maybe Berelium. Boron is a favourite up here in the box of late. Anyway, Cobalt rhymes with Bloody Forgetful. People anticipate that Cobalt is larger than life, and that she bursts into rooms like Captain Wonder Woman. This is a little unfair, though. She's just a girl, a normal girl who we like, who you should like, and who we should all sit back from and allow to evolve at her own speed. Amen.

The name of a plush white fur wrap-around or scarf that is draped over the shoulders of a high class hooker and, who, in turn, is tanned, curved, drop-dead gorgeous and wearing nothing else but a seductive smile.
