Cody is a product of the modern generation who are seemingly attached to some kind of social media outlet. Will she have a long career? Not a chance. But, she applies herself and gets frustrated when things don't go her way. A philosophical outlook is miles off but she is a text book pocket rocket.

Picture this: The famous restaurant is pumping. The open kitchen is right there next to the diners and so the heat is on to look chic. Two chefs in a team of 15 are closest to the main floor, Coggo and her colleague. After a big night out, however, the colleague is struggling next to her and as the restaurant starts to really pump this is not a good look.
“Are you alright, mate?” Coggo asks furtively, out the side of her mouth.
The other chef leans on the bench, head bowed slightly, and starts to speak when, BANG, down he goes, passed out!
Coggo looks out across the restaurant – no one saw it. She continues to prep what’s in front of her, the whole while nudging the unconscious man with her foot and whispering like a ventriloquist, “Hey! Are you okay? Fuck man! Come on! Are you alright? Wake up!”
An elderly customer appears across the stainless steel bench in front of Coggo. A lady.
“Listen dear, we just wanted to say we had such a wonderful meal. Can you please tell the head chef?”
Coggo smiles. “Certainly madame, how kind. Thank you. I will.”
The chef at Coggo’s feet starts groaning. The old lady looks around, startled at what the noise is. Coggo kicks the chef in the head, which stops the groaning quick smart.
“Don’t worry, madame,” Coggo says, all smiles. “That’s just the air conditioners kicking in.”

Like an interrupted movie, Coleen falters and hiccups a bit, but eventually she'll find her way again, settling down and getting on with things. The story actually ends quite well although you might have to watch it a couple of times to get a proper handle on the plot. Her children might be somewhat problematic.
Colette has long erratic hair and spends each morning with her head in her hands, wishing she hadn’t drunk so much and smoked so many fags the night before.

“Yeah, come on Jimbo!” she yells across 30 people in the direction of the bar. “Didn’t you say that if I flashed my tits you’d shout everyone?” 
All heads point to Colie and sure enough, she obliges. 
Poor Jimbo drops his head, but he’s okay with it. This sort of shit happens when you go out with Colie and while she’s hard not to love, she’s definitely impossible to ignore. 
The End.

Sometimes you need a perfectly chaotic system to deal with another. And so it is for dirty pots, for the only thing that produces a glistening sheen is a perfect tangle of stainless metal. That’s right - Coliette is the most expensive steel wool on earth and, shit, she does a good job.

Another name that is impossible to say without wincing like you’ve just jammed a splinter beneath your fingernail. Sure, maybe sometimes Colleen was a little ghastly, but not these days. The chores of everyday life - this is what she's sick of. When is someone going to look after her for a while? That's a good question...
The vegetarian who lives on Pringles that have been deep-fried in so much animal fat you’d scarcely believe it unless you saw it.
Concetta loves her children and her children's children, but how much can one person eat? Don't kill them with love, madame!
Connie whips up a storm wherever she goes, but rarely in the kitchen. That's someone else's area for production, not hers.
The stringent fan belt.  You'll hear her whining if you don't give her some attention from time to time, but generally she purrs along, ensuring that everything else is okay.

Cooper is a city girl and she’s got gadgets. Like her friends, she piles on loads of beauty products and other crap no one needs - remember, Cooper, that your body has evolved over 4 billion years and knows what its doing and what it needs - and generally she gets caught up in the minutiae that modern living provides, and she succeeds because she is funny and she is quick. 
(Note: Oddly enough, Cooper as a girl and Cooper as a boy are very similar in that they don’t sit around waiting for shit to happen.)

Competent? You betcha. Cora isn’t really one for church weddings, especially if she is the one getting married, as she’d much prefer not to be the centre of attention. A sensitive lass who is incredibly intelligent, Cora is the secret weapon for many companies, a couple of Generals, and oddly enough, in most relationships that she happens to be in. 
If reincarnation exists, and the crew in the commentary box aren’t remotely convinced that it does, also know that Cora’s purity of heart means she’s either on her first life or her last. (We can't help you with which one.)

Rarely a girly-girl, Coral is one of the few women in the Kingdom who, if driving a car and needing to manually give the inside windscreen a wipe with her hand or a cloth while she’s moving, will not take her eye off the road. Sure, she makes an impression this girl but she’s not impressionable, herself.
Beautiful. Controlling. Funny. Controlling. Sexy. Controlling. Fit. Controlling, etc etc etc
A US marine. She's actually aiming to become a SEAL.
Like Tamara, Corey is a gifted fire fighter. They're the only two girls in the entire squad, except Corey feels less pain and can therefore deal with the extreme rescues a little better.
Personal Motto: Push the boundaries at all times, but keep your head on your shoulders at the coming of the dawn. Corina.
Raised with pindan between her toes and her parents’ 4WD out the front, Corindi is into mud-crabbing, fishing and fighting.

We've just had an idea up here in the commentary box. We think all those people out there who get befuddled and frustrated that the rest of the population can't spell or pronounce their names should be packed off to the newly-opened, For Fuck Sake Who Really Cares How You Spell My Name, University. It’s a 30 year degree and the Dean of Psychology is Professor Corinna. She’ll tell you how to sign up...

Corinne is perpetually covered in bruises. They may have arrived from getting pitched over the falls onto a shallow reef while her board was snapped in three, crashing her skateboard into a truck at the bottom of the hill or falling off the top of the couch during a moment of sexual role play. She regrets none of them and why would she? All good scars tell a good story, so she tells us often enough, and this chick is here to live. Amen.

She was always going to end up near coral reefs and so she has, for Corioli is an underwater archaeologist, remembering that those that live and meditate above and below the surface of the sea tend to be strange and gifted creatures.
The name given to a big family pack of biscuits. Grandkids love ‘em.
A rather lovely and exquisite scientist = ∞

Do you think Corrie spends more than 3 minutes sitting down, relaxing? Never. 

She's here. 

She's there. 

She's in your face if you've screwed up. 

She's patting you on the back and extolling your virtues if you've done good. 

She's running around like a blue-arsed fly organising for the party, ensuring everything is working and that all those involved are doing their job.



In short, she's damn near omniscient.
Corynne drives nice cars and drives men sufficiently gaga. Well-travelled, sensual and peculiar, Corynne’s mission of self-discovery is already mostly over, she just hasn’t realised it yet.
Cosima never gets embarrassed about anything and she blasts her way through life like an unsmooth bowling ball crashing through a set of nine pins.

If there is something that needs to be done, or some obstacle that needs to be removed, count on Courtney to take care of it. If her and Angus were together and didn’t kill each other they’d move mountains.

A fascinating woman. Coweena loves it when she gets to shout-out. Her name rhymes with a wink, it rhymes with a clink of glasses, it rhymes with an old metal bed not so much as squeaking (although that's a part of it too) but bloody-well thumping across the wooden floor above your head as the couple on board shag themselves senseless. It's not even like they never see each other very often - they fucking live together! Can you believe that shit? So, yes, Coweena has long, loud orgasms and may the lord above (even her bedroom) smile, as well as rest in peace, because it's hard to do that and not be happy. Amen.
A fearless competitor who takes to the stage or arena without hesitation. For a long time people thought she was shy. What utter bullshit!
Like Rae after her she's quite a gifted pugilist.

Option A:  A middle-aged lady who wears a ton of make-up and has a drink in her hand most hours of the day.

Option B:  A young material girl - and a nice one, actually - who is caught up in the crap of a material world

The rumours are true, I'm afraid. If Crystalyn visits you then you need to hide all your expensive glassware and china. It's not that she's clumsy, really, more to do with the fact that she is in some kind of hurry and so she tends to crash into things. One thing is for certain though: this girl is never going to 'grow up' and thank god for that!

The platoon leader who is loved and respected by everyone in the company. Here they are now, about to go over the top, and it's Csilla who is about to receive the order. It's a harrowing moment for any human, but the love and adoration Csilla has for her charges is unquestioned. Most, if not all, of them are about to meet their maker, but Csilla has the capacity to still raise a chuckle even though she knows she probably won't be alive in five minutes, herself. How do humans do this to one another? Either way, thank God for Csilla, eh?

Cudge can solve anything. The bigger and more unsurmountable the problem, the better. All we need now is to solve her rather enigmatic romantic life. Cudge is delicious, no question, so we’re at a loss as to why she picks losers a lot of the time. Anyone got a theory about that?…
One of the very rare female electricians. Necessarily extremely safety-conscious, Cushla takes her time so she can do a fine job.

Cyley is the name of one of those mysterious puzzles about the size of your fist that looks like a strange kind of sealed wooden box. She smells wonderful, she looks quite exotic and unique - you can tell she's travelled across the globe - but you are tasked, in this game, to find out how it opens. You twist it this way and that, you pull it up to your face to have a real close look at it, but you can't see any seams or gaps anywhere. How does it open, then? Easy. You need to be smart, you need to think laterally, you need a sense of humour and, most of all, especially if you're shit at these kinds of games, you'll need mountains of patience. Cyley.
Given the number of vials, pills, capsules, creams and ointments she has in her bathroom, to imagine her out camping for a few days where there are things like dirt, bugs and river water is absurd.

Bulky and cumbersome? I very much doubt it. Cyndi was born to move and move pretty quickly at that. As a lover/partner if you tick her off you may not get a second chance - and she's cute enough to know that there are plenty more available fish in the sea - but the trade off is a passionate soul who her gives her all. She's make a great ice hockey player.

Cynthia spends more money on medicines than anyone. She’s a lean woman with chronic health problems that have their root in her levels of stress. Maybe it’s her lot but she’s actually a very caring soul.

Don’t be fooled by the gentle nature of her name ladies and gentlemen. Beautiful, yes, sensitive, yes, but Daisy is so much more than that. There’s a theory rummaging around in the commentary box that Daisy is one of the best female names in existence, and we don’t say that publicly very often. What does that mean, you might ask? Well, bloody hell, pick a category, Daisy is just top notch. She listens, she loves, she tries new things, she waltzes into the room and people fall over themselves to try and meet her, and she loves meeting new people. Her radar for idiots is ace, she always smells nice and that smile melts hearts. What more can we say?
Hangs out with Montana.

A nice lady with a wonderful intent who, when she gets on in years, unwittingly leaves strange parcels of gifts on the doorsteps of all of her neighbours. They will contain things like lollies, rotting onions, scissors, old jars of relish, half-filled boxes of white wine and if you’re really lucky, an old painting and maybe even a pair of underpants.
Part tomboy, part supermodel.

Like a butterfly emerging from a chrysalis, Damara has two distinct life phases. As a young girl she loves donuts and coke, and old people see her walking down the street and imagine she has been dressed by aliens. Then in adulthood we observe a reserved and rather elegant creature who has well and truly left her bogan/redneck roots behind. She has persisted with the makeup, however.

Dami is one of the few people in the Kingdom who struggles to scare anyone. She leaps out from behind a door and rather than shit yourself, you only feel this strange fuzzy feeling in your belly, like your best friend has just said hello at the front door. She’s just too nice and her energy is too welcoming, but that energy is put to good use everywhere else. If you meet her you’re liable to either fall in love with her or adopt her as a new best friend.

Dana generally has short hair, and she’s make a splendid Harley Davidson-riding lesbian who adores women with a nice bum and a short skirt, just as she’d make a splendid, gorgeous, proactive, heterosexual mum who was involved with her family, the community and the local latin dance class. Dana is one of those delicious women who can do it all and she’s never out of place. Nice one Dana. x
The Rock.
Daneeka, some advice from the commentary box: You ARE worthy of the captaincy! All you have to do is believe you are too.

Danelle is the chilled-out and subtle comedienne of the group. Sarcastic and very bright, why and how men miss her attractiveness is a question we up here in the commentary box have been scratching our head over for ages. Maybe she's just too smart for them?
Danica gets bored. Baby, what do you want? If money was no option, seriously, what would do with your days? Because, my love, THAT'S WHAT YOU'RE MEANT TO BE DOING! Management.

Pinpoint in her criticism, her compliments and her corners, if she heads off on a long road trip you can expect her to arrive within 5 minutes of when she said she would, having used the exact amount of fuel that she expected to use - and yes, she did all the necessary calculations beforehand. Hitch hikers? Not a chance.

Daniella rhymes with Mecca, and for most men, at least, she exists only as a distant image. In life she may be accustomed to a certain amount of latitude but there is no denying her rather dramatic presence.

The name of a Grand piano whose owner insists she gets tuned, cleaned and dusted every Monday afternoon. It actually drives her bananas because all she wants to do is relax and play wonderful music, which might explain why she has such a horrible temper.

She's hard going, sometimes, but some within the Kingdom, or should I say, some souls within the Kingdom have deemed it necessary to take their owners on a journey of hard work and redemption. I'm buggered if I know how it works, but the fact that Danika was a Mongol chieftian in a previous life, who killed village people by the score, probably has an awful lot to do with the fact that, today, she is a busy, fretful and compassionate Hospital Director. It seems that Karma has a tendency to catch up with all of us in the end.

Somewhere between a perfect technique which results in unimaginably grandiose outcomes with a minimal of effort, and a full knee reconstruction that most gun-netballers experience at some point in their lives, Danique exists as a tantalising example of what might be possible. It is therefore a given that she is slightly eccentric.

Danka approaches all aspects of her life like one of those idiots in Scotland, or somwhere, who deliberately race down a very steep hill, on foot. Invariably, they accelerate so quickly that many of the contestants wind up sommersaulting through thin air at God-awful speeds. It's hilarious to watch and bloody dangerous to take part in. And yes, Danka has the scars and the bruises to prove it, but what she also has are very well developed stomach muscles from laughing so much. Imagine if we all suffered from the same fate?

Don't overlook Danna. Beneath all her directions, she's actually quite a thoughtful and chilled-out girl. For some reason known only to the universal gods, and quite like Doris, actually, people around her are often slightly crazy, which stresses her out. But I wonder, was she put here on Earth to try and encourage these poeple to relax, and to let go of their fear?...

The Uncompromising Rancher. Mending large gates, doing up horse buckles tightly, putting down injured cattle, branding, yelling loudly at dogs and farm hands, cutting off wire with gloves and industrial wire cutters, having only one shower per month: this is Dannette's lot. Things need to be kept in check and you've got to be organised, because you just never know when adversity will strike. Parties? Impuslive fun? Sometimes, maybe, but this is a large hands-on operation and someone has to ensure it's running smoothly 24/7.

Danni is a gifted genius no-one understands and she is always just a little bit lost. She cops a lot for her beliefs and if she wasn’t such a decent person, deep down, she would have made a great spy.

An effervescent young woman with bounce in her step and a frisky demeanour. Her family are slightly twisted, but she’s shaken off that mantle and become her own powerhouse. Cute grin too, and she uses it, as she should. Amen.

Sure, Danuta likes getting nude, but her university days are behind her - back then she was first to skinny-dip. More significant, Danuta needs something to do and she loves energetic gatherings. The last thing you'd try (let's say, if you were attempting to win her heart as a gentleman) is to take her to a game of Test Cricket. You'd never see her again. Aside from that, she'll never shy away from confrontation and she's a chaotic cook.

Another walking, talking Enigma. It takes a lot to get into the 'inner sanctum' of her private life, and her radar is pretty amazing, hence not just anyone will cut the mustard. But, once you're there, Daphne is an exquisite example of a funny, artistic, giving, sensual woman. Best of all, she loves to play.

Great in business, Dara has a cutthroat attitude in deals and consequently she’s rarely broke. Keep your eye on the prize and don’t forget what your goals are: this is what she’ll tell you. 
Occasionally perhaps she needs to laugh more than she does but who knows, she looks pretty happy to us, in which case she needs to keep doing what she’s doing.

Common as Irish rain, Daragh is bloody funny and wholly present. With a constant smile that she carries everywhere, she’s proof that all anyone needs to do in order to be happy is to bloody-well decide that they’re going to be happy. It doesn’t sound too hard, does it?
Posh Spice, eat your heart out.

Ever seen the Monty Python skit involving the World Championship of Hide and Seek? The game starts with one guy counting to 100 with his hands over his eyes, while his competitor takes a taxi to the airport and gets on a plane bound for the Middle East. Anyway, that just about sums up Darci's approach to everything. In a nutshell, retain a sense of humour at all times and good luck! She’s nearly always worth the trip.
Okay, go and have a look at Darci before you read any further…….okay, welcome back. Unlike Darcy and Darci, this one spends more time removing chewie-gum from the bottom of her runners.
Darcy has a dimpled smile and is occasionally extremely sarcastic. As a sensual being from millions of years ago, today she’s an intense girl who generally gets what she wants. Boys love her.
Diligent and busy, Daria possesses an excellent work ethic and everyone, be they man or woman, suspects she is simply amazing in bed.
There’s a good chance she is quite domineering – especially if she’s South African – but Darian’s great quality is that she speaks only the truth, whether it hurts for someone to hear it or not.

Thank God someone is keeping it real today. Yes, she puts a nip of whisky in warm milk and gives it to wailing children to shut them up, but so what? They sleep longer, we sleep longer, and everyone is happy.
Darnae is as beautiful on the inside as she is on the outside. Full stop.

Drama - why is it some people love and/or attract it? I don't get it. I'll never get it, I don't think, but that's not my job. In this case, it's Darrylee who attracts these chaotic moments and people. I wonder if, in a past life, she was a humble seamstress working in a cold, glum, northern European clothes shop for 50 years? Either way, she's now here to jump into stuff, crash her car into things, spill drinks and break hearts, all with a gay abandon, and she will drive you crazy. It’s her job.

Even in today's frantic world, Daryl is one of those few creatures in the Kingdom who seems to have time, and this enables her to think about things, ponder her decisions and contemplate the world around her, as well as those in it. "Hello Daryl," you'll say to her. "Well, hello to  you," she'll say in return, and she'll be smiling whether she knows you or not.
What a lovely day.
Exotically charismatic and temperamental, Davina is the chief curator for most of our best art galleries.

Her name sounds like a rubber gum boot being extracted from a pond of mud, but she’s far sweeter and savvier that that. Yes, Dawn is understated, but beneath her skin is a beautiful and generous soul and on her day she is fucking hilarious.

Once again we find ourselves in the middle of the desert. The car has barely made it to town, if you call this a town, and you need a mechanic desperately. Hark! The only garage for 200 miles appears to be open although at first glance you can’t hear anything in the heat.
“Hello?” you say, as you walk into the blissful shade of the shed. “Anyone here?”
“...yeah, I’ll just be tick,” a gruff woman’s voice says, unseen. “I’m just droppin’ the kids off at the pool.”
Perplexed, you stand and wait. There are tools and car bits and crap everywhere. A toilet flushes from out the back, you hear cursing and boots on concrete. A tap is turned on and water splashes. A person groans with pleasure. Dayle appears in the doorway bedraggled. Her face is wet and she’s wiping her hands on her grey overalls which appear to be older than the sun. 
“How ya’ gaaaarn?” she says. “Is it hot enough for ya? Let me guess, you’ve cooked it haven’t ya?”
Dayle.

Dayna is a savage hunter. Indeed, she'd make a very beautiful and confronting savage on a desert island too, but that's another story. She's one of the few people who look incredible with a shaved head and she's never single.

Deah is many things, but first and foremost she is ready - ready for change. The usual hum-drum of life is something she copes with pretty easily, but what she's searching for (and secretly needs) is some chaos, some passion, an exhibition of irreverent stupidity and an act of chivalrous idiocy. So, the question is, who and/or what will provide it?...

Like her twin sister Deanna, Deana doesn’t spend much time wondering why something didn’t work.
"Come on, buck up," she'll say if things haven't gone your way. "What are you going to do? Sit around here and mope all day? Not in this house! Come on now, what can I do to help?"

Forthright. She pushes her kids hard and they're up for it. It's good for them, and Deanna, meanwhile, manages to keep it all together, and she's more laid back and definitely sexier than she sounds….

Welcome to a wonderful and unsung Enigma. The length of her name is exactly inversely proportional to her level of charisma, sexiness, directness and her capacity to get the job done. Deb is a marvel.
A tough hombre in all situations, she overcomes hurdles in an instant with a smile and a huff of having to deal with the occasional idiot. Does she get kissed enough?
The Perfectionist.

Debra doesn’t piss-fart around. Sure, she’s got style and brains and a sense of humour, and she’s sexier than even she possibly realises, but her great skill is forcing others to get their shit together. (Note: It is a given that hers already is, unless she flies off the handle, in which case disregard the entire paragraph.)
Debs services her own car.

Maths teacher. Diligent and highly intelligent, Decima expects a lot from her charges and is never shy about admonishing those she considers not reaching their potential. The education system could do with a few more like her, as a matter of fact.
Dee has 11 children and lives a busy life. Flustered by very little, as a younger woman she was drop-dead gorgeous.

Dee May is a tough opponent in a debating contest because she researches her topic meticulously. Her arguments therefore are generally indefensible. She is quite successful professionally, as you can imagine, and her house is full of big personalities and laughter, as well as good food and wine. She’s a stickler for good table manners.
Proper, funny and true.

“Oh no, not another drama, Dejana! So, did you own up this time?”(Dejana balks….she turns her head…she flips her hair……she looks away.)
"...Ah, not yet…but I will. I promise!" she says. (ie. Operation normal.)

The sophisticate. Her tasks and standards arise from a life lived surrounded by artisans and great expectations, and as such she has been afforded the luxury of desiring more of those nights filled with stories and sexual intrigue. Is she conceited? Well…..maybe, but, then again, her friends would never agree with that. (Just avoid adding too much Botox, honey: Management.)

As a rather brilliant and magnetic soul, she repeatedly sets social precedents by doing something as banal as walking out the front door. Time - she has oodles of it, both for leisure and a good come-back, if it’s warranted. She understands the game of life and how absurd most things are, which means she’s good for the rest of us. Good luck is her ally.
The name of the brief head-bow that combative martial artists (who are both smiling quietly because each knows how good they are) give to one another before entering into battle. So, are you ready?
Bloody bloody bloody splendid!!!

Delin is a diligent and dedicated deligator and we encourage anyone who knows her to buy her joke books and plane tickets, and sex toys if you know her well enough, and on the proviso that you keep it a secret.
Instructive and upright, Dell bloody-well gets on with things. Rural or not she wears sensible knickers and isn’t beyond fisticuffs if need be. She asks excellent, pertinent questions.

It's the Olympic final of the 100metre sprint for women. All the training comes down to this. The starter's gun is raised and an eerie hush fills the stadium. Della is primed, but OH NO! She's jumped the gun! Years of hard toil down the drain and amid the despair of her first few metres, she makes a decision.
She decides to keep on running the race, on her own. By the time she crosses the finish line, having run a PB, 100,000 people are egging her on. Della.

"Oh, Barb!" she says, almost embarrassed at her good friend's outrageous behaviour in the expensive restaurant. "Will you leave that poor young waiter alone?" 
(Secretly, of course, she wants to flirt with him too.)

In a past life Delphi was a world famous pirate trapped in the body of a mermaid, and to be honest it used to piss her off. Sure, she lured many-a-sailor to their grave but this was never her intention. All Delph’ ever wanted - and all she ever wants in this life, as a matter of fact -  was to gather up a bunch of like-minded larrikins and have as much fun as humanly possible. Danger barely registers with her so you better hang on, as her multitude of friends can attest. And don’t give her an outlandish dare, whatever you do…

Her name rises up and prepares itself like a big, beautiful cobra being wooed from its cane nest by it's charmer. Yes, Delphia is tantalising and beautiful, she has attitude and she can look after herself, don't worry about that, but you may not know that she is also very loving. She wants those around her to rise up, just like her. Not bad eh?

Delphin never gets sanctioned, never gets told off and seems to fall into favour with just about everyone. How does she do this? Perhaps it’s because she has plenty of time, she reads people very well - as well as being well read, herself - and she sticks to the plan. Not prone to sudden crazy rushes of impulse, we wonder if maybe she should give them a go?
And yes, she’s a deeply romantic woman.

With quite a masculine name, Delrae takes her time, as she should. The journey (and in her case it’s a rather seductive one) is the secret and so long as you trust her you’ll be fine. She’s smarter than you are, probably, so just relax. D will take care of you.
Perfectly shaped with a mystical kind of presence, but something about Delta is completely upside down...

Delwyn plans ahead with diligence and nous, all the with the knowledge that things can change quickly and unpredictably. Rather than fear these unexpected hitches, Delwyn embraces them because she always enjoys the humour of the moment. Big laugh.

Difficult to pin down, either literally or philosophically, once you get to them you will discover that Demelza has strongly held opinions which are both fair and equitable. Yes, she fiddles around and gets lost sometimes, usually retaining her sense of humour in the process, but she encourages those around her to have fun. She's good friends with her kids.

Demi is about 4 inches tall and wears a tiny little tutu. She plays the flute and flies around the sky using her dragonfly wings, while at the same time casting spells on people that force them to smile giddily, and dream of lemonade and/or fornicating in fields.

There are two species of Denella…

Denellas metropollosis : A city slicker who wouldn’t be seen dead in last season’s jacket. She communicates through a wide range of eyebrow movements and hair flicks, and is attracted to men who, when topless, resemble some kind of dehydrated insect. 

Denellas slugaloungas : A tracksuit-wearing slob who rarely leaves the couch. She has a TV remote stuck to her hand and the notion of exercise involves getting up and walking to the fridge, although the more intelligent specimens have learned to position said device within reaching distance of where she reclines.

We’re hoping to hear news of a third species, as yet undescribed…
A sexy little thrill-seeker.
Denise has been through three divorces and is tired of bullshit, although she hasn’t lost her sense of humour. She is now more comfortable in her skin than she’s ever been.
Idealistic. If she isn’t a full-blown political animal, then Denita is intimately involved with issues regarding personal or human rights within society.
Cute, yes, but Denver is just a little bit shy.

It's interesting that some people are better at manifesting different things into their lives than others, isn't it? Derrian is one of those. What does she manifest, I hear you ask? Well, languid trips away, relaxed cocktail evenings under warm starry nights and the laughter of friends - these are some of the things that attract to Derrian's life. Does she work hard? I've no idea. That's none of our business and probably none of hers.
Best friends with Ruby and Rae. Need we say anymore?

Nickname or not, Des is like some magic form of relaxed glue which makes everything better. She is rarely stressed, she’s always funny, she has a million friends and there are many many men (and ladies if the situation ever presented) who would love nothing more than to spend several hours/days/years curled up in her company. 
Note: She’s a little tired of being the go-to person whenever someone has a petty drama to relieve themselves of.

Big personality, giant heart, De Shan attracts dramas like nobodies business. Yes, she fell asleep at the wheel once, wrote the car off and woke up without a scratch, proof that someone or something up there is looking out for her. She shrugged off a regular life a long time ago. Yes, she's an artist, and an actress, and a comedienne. Ostensibly unembarrassable, in a past life De Shan was another gorgeous, black Spanish bull except she's not here to hurt anyone. She's here to help, and to have buckets of fun, naturally.

Oh my lord, Desi's father is just about going insane with the number of boys who keep turning up at his door, asking for his daughter's hand in marriage. Desi, of course, has so many engagement rings that she had to create an entire draw for them. And rightly so.

Feathers - she loves them. She loves being tickled by them, she likes some of her clothes to be made from them and in a perfect world, on hot days, two black, naked slave men would fan her with a giant peacock feather, each. She’s crazy when she’s drunk and her blood is up.

"Good morning, Geeves," she says, running passed him in only a bra and a pair of white panties. She's late again, and it's not like he's never seen her semi-naked before in this situation. 
"Good morning, madame," he replies, reverently. But then he raises his voice, hopefully, after her. "Will you be dining-in this evening? The caviar arrived this morning fresh from St. Petersburg?"
"Oh, shit!" Desley yells behind her, back down the corridor. "Sorry Geeves, I've got dinner at that bloody actor's house, tonight. Will it keep?"
Geeves smiles quietly, to himself, almost. "That's perfectly alright, madame. I'm sure it will."
Her name is Desley, and so it goes.....

Now Deslie, I know - you're not 'ey'. That's okay. And deep down you know it is too. You and your sister aren't normal and for this reason we love you. So, head on over to Desley and we'll have a drink afterwards. The crew up here in the commentary box will be surprised if you hate them for not separating the two of you.
Good mates with Annie, Desmaralda is the name of a special kind of polkadot dress, where the 'dots' are actually little round holes that have been cut out of the material.

She's funny. For instance, say she gets sick and tired of tripping over all of her shoes scattered around the floor, one day she decides to make an inventory of exactly how many pairs she owns (before she puts them all away). Three minutes into the task, involving a notepad and pen, swearing and cursing all the way, a girlfriend will ring her with a luncheon invite, at which point Desmia will feign disappointment, toss the notebook over her head, don the pair of stilettos she happens to have in her hand and be out the door. Then, at 3am that night, or the next, she'll stumble in the door and trip over a pair of shoes, cracking her elbow on the corner of her bed. Then she curses again. How she gets anything done is beyond us, but she's fun to watch and the boys love her.

Oh, Despina! Don't worry about it! I know, the dress is ruined but, honestly, you're got your health, you're kids are having a good time and are good people, you live in a nice house filled with love and laughter, your days are fun and busy, and so what if that stupid woman spilt strawberry sauce all down the front of you? Life could be worse.....Indeed, I'm not sure it can get any better.  Love Management. x
Yes, she’s had fun, but she grew tired of the party drugs and the associated wankers - all the good ones do. Today she is very real and very lovely.
Devaki is a nice girl who, too often, tries to fit too much inside boxes that are too small. But it's fun to watch her try.

Ah, delicious Dewi. LIke a male Gilly way after her, Dewi's smile is larger than her face and she's therefore impossible to say no to. Colours: she fills her life with them - in her wardrobe, in her house - and she's an experimental cook. The louder and the more esoteric the accompanying music, the better.

This girl lives for peaches ’n cream, preferably in bowl or on a plate, but she can handle them poured anywhere on her body, really. Some call it art. Like Kenny way after her, there is some question as to what she does with her time. Does she work? Does she own a car? Anyone have any idea?...
A cool cat. She has short dusty blonde hair, she can light a campfire, take a funny restaurant order and she can organise 100 kids at once. Yep, Di is excellent value. Did I say she was sexy?

Always busy busy busy. Forget all that Princess rubbish, Diana is a modern lass who juggles the whole damn thing - kids, husbands, work, life, you name it - and does it with aplomb. Money isn’t really an issue for her, but perhaps she needs to employ a cleaner or something because one always feels compelled to fetch a seat for her as soon as she enters the room.

Diane is surrounded by orthodoxy and, to be honest, she's a bit over it. Where is the fizz in life? Why doesn't her husband bring her presents like he used to? Maybe it's time for a change? The sad thing is, whether she likes being called Di or not, Dianes stopped being produced years ago, which means she and her rather stunning sister (Di) will soon be extinct and, excuse my language, but that is a fucked situation.

Shameful? Never. Her ego is way too large to admit defeat or even an error. It may be because of the inner-fortitude gained from having corrected so many people on the spelling of her name. We’ll never know. Good in battle, passionate in the boudoir, impatient in the kitchen, Dianna fulfils her role as the Somewhat Dissatisfied Matriarch.
She'd never visit a nudist camp, that's for sure. Maybe she should? It'd loosen those shoulders that aren't being massaged nearly enough.

Dillan can delegate, she can shake it in a sexy dress, she can disarm the most determined, deluded drunk in any room and she has a great laugh. She should be a manager/producer of sorts - be it for radio, stage or for a marketing firm. Her radar is very good and she sums up people quickly and quietly, moulding her response to fit the situation. Her tomboy start has made her one hell of a savvy performer out there in the real world. Nice work Dillan.
English-Frumpy-English.

Her life is filled to the brim with high comedy and high drama, usually occurring at the same time. For example, the last time she went on a giant water slide she got out of the pool at the bottom and was mortified to discover her entire bikini had been torn from her body during the descent, which meant of course that she was standing naked in a public place. If she was at a dance/hedonism festival in the desert such attire wouldn't be a problem, indeed, it's often encouraged, but this is boring middle-class white-man country we're talking about. Dilys.

Dimitra will put up with quite a bit. She worked in her parents business for a long time as a little girl so that silly, playful edge has been eroded somewhat. Like Carol, Dimitra could do with a holiday.
A very driven and self-assured lass, Dimity goes pretty hard and generally in the right direction. It's actually quite impressive to watch.

Dione is an industrious lass who always looks busy and concerned. Yes, women are being encouraged to stand on their own two feet these days, away from the implied protections/expectations of the past that says they should find themselves a man of means to look after them, and Dione represents this ideal more than most. And bravo! She doesn't really tolerate buffoons and she expects quite a lot of her children.
Dior has handed out more fake orgasms than most. Dior, some advice from Management, don’t waste your time. Just speak the truth because that’s all any of us have. The end.

No, she ain't normal. So, lets just have a look at Dixie's past lives, shall we? In WW2 she flew Mustangs for the US Airforce in Europe where she spent her months blowing up Nazis. In Roman times we see here she was one of the few successful slaves who attained freedom in the colosseum by spearing angry lions, and in Paris in the 30's her legs and her smile were famous. Yep, Dixie was made to move and be a rambunctious, flamboyant extravert, which may or may not be true today. People love her. They always have. They always will. It's all about ridiculous, dangerous fun, you understand, and Dixie wrote the book. Amen.
Djana wears matching jewellery and is eager to impress people. She possesses a stylish walk and somehow manages to stand casually with her legs crossed.

Big boobs, maybe, but there is more to her than that. To cope with this nickname – if it’s a nickname – requires a personality with spunk, intelligence and an unselfconscious sense of fun. 
(Note: Normal-sized or small-breasted Dollys are often even funnier and more intriguing, only because they aren’t compelled to surrender to their title.)
What a woman? She’s helped so many men and women that needed a little bit of love or money that it isn’t funny.
A double agent who has a foot in the KGB. She’ll do what she needs to do without fear nor favour. She’s as sexy as hell and it makes her job a lot easier.

Somewhere in her heritage is a struggling mum living in a humpy, but not anymore. Today, Donna is an adaptable and pro-active whip-cracker who thinks it all, does it all and laughs heaps amid the cacophony of modern life. Madame, take a bow.
For Pete’s sake stop worrying about other peoples’ shit. They’ll work it out, and they’ll be better for having sorted it out themselves. Go and have some fun D!

Dora is the sort of girl who, 70 seconds before the news goes live to air, will burst into the producer's studio with an important communiqué sweating and panting heavily, having just ran at full speed from the fax machine which is three floors up.
“We have to lead with this,” she says, already pulling up a seat and beginning to type.
The producer just nods. If Dora suggests that things need to be reshuffled in a hurry he or she knows they need to be.
Dora.

Perhaps a career is coming, but in the meantime her and her rather stunning entourage are happiest at that rooftop bar - you know the one, in summer, with that exclusive membership thingo’? Anyway, are they full of it? Well, yep, but it’s summer, they’re gorgeous, and does anyone have responsibilities on such a night? 
(Note: You’ll never see her wearing an outfit with a NASA badge on the front of it.)
The great and sacred cow. She lives in the fields of India, not far from the River Ganges, and munches thick lush grass, all day long, disbelieving of how perfect each one of them is.
Dori is the happy-go-lucky sidekick who should be the leader. She’s cute, she laughs easily and if she were a bird she’d be a busy little Honeyeater.
Who knows what she looks like but she’s a great comedienne. Sexy or not, she attracts more weirdos than anyone else in the kingdom and, consequently, she needs to carry a gun.

It's not that she's flustered, really, but why does Dorit always look like she's late? I don't get it. She's a smart lass who understands how the world functions - maybe that's it? Perhaps she spends more time than she should concerned about how the process is going to turn out rather than how it's going here in this second. She has to concentrate heavily while driving.
Dorota has her standards and she will only cross those boundaries if and when she is sure the time is right.
Her European heritage gives her a certain measured grace, but sometimes it’s just fun to walk down to the local park at lunchtime, rip all your gear off and jump around like silly loon!!

Dorothy is a fence paling that’s fallen off due to the nails rusting out completely and she now lies on the back lawn that has grown so tall around her that you can barely see her. Poor Dorothy, you might say, but beneath her is a teeming metropolis of snails, worms, bugs and beetles that she lovingly tends. She’s been nominated for this year’s Nobel Peace Prize and let’s hope she wins it – she deserves it.
Mrs. R.M. Pragmatic.

Walk into an adult shop that deals with special toys and it gives you whole new perspective on the normal folk you see walking down the street every day. And praise be the Lord, Dotty is leading the charge.
Beware the Sleeping Dragon. I’ll say that again….  BEWARE THE SLEEPING DRAGON!!
See Duglass.

A woman cannot be called Dug, or Duglass, unless she is in the Top 10 most charismatic, outgoing and love-generating people on the planet. Please utter a small prayer of thanks if you hear that one exists. Bless you.
Wow, what a dollop of sexy, playful, irreverent bubble of fun and joy and perfectly cooked everything! A killer smile. A heart larger than Madagascar.

Her parents are hopeless romantics and that’s okay, but Dumas is a rather hard-headed business woman who has lots said behind her back, not much of which is pleasant. How pathetic is that? (If you have something to say to her, just go and say it. She’s not as harsh as you think and she’ll be shocked at the gossip, which will be mostly bullshit anyway.)

Dusty is nearly always a blonde, but she is definitely a Top 5 Enigma. Not just because of the rarity of her existence, but because the power, spunk and savvy coolness of this goddess is inversely proportional to her number in the wild. So, never try and put her in a cage and get as many photographs of her as you can, although like Duglass above her, you’ll be lucky if you even see one.

We're forever pondering how is it some names on a man are so utterly different to what they are on a woman? For instance, a male Lindsay is usually gentle and placid, while a female Lindsay is sharp and precise, and almost a little unstable. A male Kerry is a leader of industry and of men, whereas a female Kerry is skilled at buying the milk (okay, so that’s a bit of a stretch and we aplogise), but you get the gist.
So, here we have a female Dylan, and do you really need us to tell you of the potency of this lass in comparison to her male counterpart? She-Dylan is dynamite. She is smart and proactive. She says she cares about her hair but none of us believe it. Dylan is busy and she is industrious, and she couldn’t give a rat’s arse if people suddenly seem to believe she ought to be humiliated. Indeed, is Dylan embarrassable? It’s a good question. 
Either way, as soon as the war starts ring her up and get her around. If she's next to you then you'll very probably live.

Yeah, good luck putting her in a pigeonhole, well, unless you want her to catch one or two - at her suggestion, I might add - and cook them up using that ancient Belgian recipe that her grandmother gave her. Oh yes, Dymphia can cook, and she can eat too. Men's hearts a lot of the time. But this is Dymphia, you see. She starts the journey, takes a left turn that is odd, and turns it into a bizarre kind of celebration. The results are never expected, and for this reason she is never unhappy. Truth be known, neither are we. (No one has any idea what she does as a career.)

Dyna would make a great long-distance space traveller, not only because she can put herself into a coma without too much preparation, but because apart from being a gifted lateral thinker, her calm and understanding nature means that she is good company for any amount of time.
Precocious in youth, worried in adulthood.
A brand of soluble aspro.
The Gorgeous Powerhouse.

Ebbeny places a high priority on wearing the right clothes and living in the right house that’s in the right suburb. With regard to her occupation, she’ll look for something in the lower echelons of the legal system, a swank accountancy firm or, in a more outgoing specimen, perhaps something in the TV game.
The Pick Pocket, which means she aint silly, and she can move quick. (Sister, you ever thought of  getting into theoretical physics?)

Option A:  A professional hockey player whose competitive nature made her lethal, and don’t believe the rumours about her dying young. She’s too energetic and she’s too lucky for that to happen any time soon. 

Option B:  Luckily, however, whenever she passes over to the next adventure she’ll be reincarnated as a Piranha Fish swimming in the Amazon Basin of North Central Brazil. Life’s therefore is a beach for this girl whether she’s alive or not. (And yes, we very much hope she is.)

Oh baby, movies are only movies. They're not real. Please, if you want to fly don't expect to do it by dreaming big, smiling hard and leaping off a cliff. Go to a flying school and get  your pilot's licence, okay? Lots of love, Management.
The optimistic and sensual risk-taker.

“Is Eden here? Oh, thank god....okay, everybody?...Just relax now. Shake it out. Suck in some deep breaths....everyone feeling good?.....excellent.....so just lie down now, empty your mind and enjoy the moment........Thankyou Eden...”
Edith has led a long and happy life. Kids, grandkids, travel, turmoil and euphoria - you name it, she’s done it. What a gal.

Oh Edna, finally a normal name in a world that has gone crazy! I love you. I love your warmth. I love your honesty. I love how you stand up for what you believe in. I love how you deal with adversity and I love your sense of humour. Peace be with you.
Edwina is a survivor and a woman of substance.

Gentlemen, a tip: if you can't hold your end up for longer than the average man with regeards to providing a decent biblical showing of yourself, bascially where and whenever Effie sees fit, be it around the house or at any time in the 24 hour cycle of life, then you are fucking kidding  yourself if you think you're worthy of marrying her. You with me?

Eila rarely complains and, if she does, something must be rather dire. In life she actually achieves quite a lot. We sound like we’re surprised because we are. Indeed, she’s a well-rounded, sexy, modern woman. Not bad eh?
Swears like a trooper, brews her own beer and fishes for Barramundi professionally.
"Ah, stop talkin' shite," she'll say, in a heavy Irish accent.

Eilish is, The Entrusted One.
(ie. she’s the girl at parties who will prevent a drunk person from driving home no matter how much they protest, and she’ll tangle with them physically if she has to.)
Is she Israeli? If she is it makes sense because Einat is………. The Armourer.
A cross between Kazza and Daniella. The End.

“Will I wear this blouse? Maybe that one? What about this skirt? Will that blouse match this skirt? Or what about that one? Is Arthur going to be there? Hang on, I better try something else….what about this one?”……and so on, and so on.

Elan, we up here in the commentary box don't like to give advice but sometimes we think it's warranted. So, yes, now, we recommend you ask your parents if you can borrow the car one night, okay, and when you do that 'borrow' one of their handicards also, and don't come home.
You heard us right. You’re too organised and too nice and you haven’t been, seen or done anything strange or crazy yet. Take a punt girl. Go. The car is insured. And trust us, your parents will eventually sob with pride at the leap you’ve made.
Come and visit us up here in the commentary box. The kettle is on and we’re waiting...
An Italian Princess.

No, she's not that technically minded but she grasps the big picture quickly and she knows enough to save your life. Her name is open and replete, with no hidden little ditches to trip over, and it has made her warm and funny and wholly present. She mixes work and pleasure better than nearly anyone, because she perpetually attempts to incorporate one with the other. Nice work hoss.

Eleani is just a little bit nuts. Just a tiny bit. The right amount, to be honest. No point being boring, she says that all the time. I don't think she works, only because she cant sit still for very long.
Regal. She's not boring, she just understands a thing called social etiquette. Importantly, she is one of the first people to act when a situation becomes life threatening.
The name of a large, doleful, Grey Nurse shark at an aquarium. She's long and lithe and she seems to move without any effort. And she's doleful only up until the moment she eats or mates.

Electra is irrefutably more conservative and considerate than you imagine. Yep, she has a ridiculous name, but like a well-made boomerang she’s returned in fine fettle. She’s direct and pleasant, and like everyone she just wants to have fun. (We’ll omit any sexual discussion about Electra, because we can tell you she’s just about sick of it.)

Can someone please tell us how Elektra is going to cope in the real world with a name fit for a plastic doll? Elektra, we hope you're not a plastic doll. Have you left home? If you haven't, can you please? We up here in the commentary box have passed around the hat and we've got a little kitty for you to start up with. It's not much but it's a start!

Elena’s predecessors are European aristocracy that go way back. Hence, her family in the current life expect her to conform to the rather strict rules they lay down as a means to mould her into some kind of modern, polite lady. What horse shit! If they saw what she got up to after she skips out of the house they’d sever all future inheritance. (Elena, we suggest you keep doing what you’re doing.)

Christmas Eve is actually more fun for her than Christmas itself because it's the day when she and her friends gather for the ritual de-shelling of the prawns. It involves lots of drink, lots of shiny steel bowls for both prawns and shells, rolled up sleeves, some music and perhaps even a quiet little tipple. Eli.

It's not that Elia is confused or even mildly unintelligent - she's actually quite savvy - but she does seem to be easily rattled. Perhaps she's just a little forgetful, not that we blame her of course. A great many people seem to ask (or suggest) she do a great many things and in these situations it's sometimes difficult to see the wood for the trees, let alone remember you are trying to organise yourself in an at times unphathomable and ridiculous life. She certainly doesn't stay in one place for very long.
Rich men and very expensive tastes are what’s on offer here, ladies and gentlemen. We can’t be bothered explaining any more than that.

Elina takes pride in preening herself to just the right degree. No, her ego doesn't rule her life, but she's a forthright woman who understands that if you don't look the part it's nigh impossible to act the part. She speaks the truth and she doesn't tolerate buffoons. She might be a little kinky though, which is a grand thing, not to mention a wonderful release valve for being in charge all the time.

Like her sister with more l’s and t’s, Eliot can't stand to just sit around and watch, and she especially can’t stand to watch someone fuck things up. It literally drives her insane. At formal presentations she’s the one cracking jokes at the back and grappling colleagues inappropriately beneath the table. God bless you Eliot.

Never overbearing or a bully, Elisa likes playing and we’re glad to see her name on the team sheet. Not really inclined to get in and get really dirty, Elisa is more or a periphery player who looks fabulous running with the ball in her hand. She doesn’t like to see anyone hurt. Indeed, she’ll often attend an opposition player if they are injured, which often infuriates her team mates.

"A pinch and punch for the first of the month!" she says gaily, while you rub your arm at the amount of pain she's just inflicted. 
What are you going to do, NOT live with her?

Shy like grass, maybe. Chances are she grew out of that, however, and slid into the business world as easily as an otter yawns on the water’s edge before slipping back beneath the surface. Is she open to bribery? Well, not if it involves ripping off people who don’t deserve it. Usually Elise is pretty cute, which, in this absurd, male-driven business environment helps her achieve most of her goals reasonably easily. She knows she doesn’t live in Iraq or Afghanistan where women are perpetually persecuted, and so she doesn’t mind taking a few liberties when she can. She knows she’s just lucky that she can.
Elisha, if you don’t put away your phone and start concentrating here in class we're going to confiscate it. As a burgeoning adult she goes through men like cheap frozen dinners.
Elissa is quite beautiful and she knows how to keep a secret.
Excuse my French, but Eliza is simply fucking delightful. She's another Good Witch, you understand. Did you know that?

Elizabeth, if she is called this and knows no other nickname, owns an opulent dining room full of fine china and heavy silver cutlery. Her grand house has an Aston Martin parked out the front, and she has had a crush on the right side of Julio Iglesias’s head since she was a little girl.

Eliza-Jane has a very detailed list and woe-betide anyone if they suggest a few things on it should be forgotten or skipped. She still believes in the magic of lingerie and she attracts men who think along similar lines. They’re usually not permitted to nibble her through them however, only because her collection is as rare as it is expensive. 
(Note: The more evolved Eliza-Janes are called EJ, and this sub-species has long-learned the fun in having all manner of clothes nibbled off her own body, and she couldn’t give a flying fuck if a few trivial points on the agenda are skipped, either. Amen.)

A cross between a cute little Eskimo man wearing deer fur and Bambi, the baby deer, Elka exists as the perfect circle of life. Sexy as hell with a clean view of the world, and of herself, Elka milks the moments for their worth with the luxury of someone who embodies the big picture as well.
Serious, serious, serious, serious, serious….(then)...okay, hug now please!!

Ella rhymes with, “Yeah...whaddaya want?” 
And it takes a lot of energy for her just to say it, let alone act on the answer, which she will only if she thinks she needs to. Don’t waste her time with trivial tasks.

Surrounded by chaos, sometimes in her house, sometimes in her street, Ellay-Rose has learnt to ride with the punches and go with the flow. Yes, humans can be unpredictable beasts at the best of times, but this rather energetic beginning has prepared her for a life that is anything but boring. Grace under pressure: this sums her up quite nicely. Sure, she'll crash her share of cars and hang out with the wrong boys for a while, but she knows what she's doing.
“Oh yeah, I don’t care.” she shrugs, nonchalantly, barely half awake. “That sounds fine. Can someone make me a coffee before we leave, thanks....”

An A-type personality in and out of the bedroom, and don’t get me started on how she reacts to misspellings of her name. In fact, that’s enough. I’m tired of her complaining about it. Suffice to say she could run a country quite well and we’ll just leave it at that.

Yes, true, in a past life her name was, indeed, Alan, which is why she shrugs off all problems, in this life, with a look on her face as if to say, "Listen, dickhead, what the fuck are you complaining about? If you've got you're health, you've got everything." And, Amen to that.
Prize Fighter.
The Red Menace.

Ellia is a fun-loving, life-kicking kind of a lass, who is great fun to have around, and who is incisive in her observations. Like a male Jasper, she's good at getting around corners and finding the weak spots. Not that she's here to deliberately screw things up - she's never that malicious - she just likes to encourage others to be the best they can be, and sometimes a quiet word in someone's ear is enough. She'd only publicly embarrass someone if they deserved it. 

Note: If you give Ellia the reigns, the helm, or the map, and you tell her to drive for a while, don't expect her to relinquish control in a hurry.

Standing stark-naked in the middle of the street for some kind of weird European magazine is not where you will ever see Elliana. You're more likely to find her sipping demurely at her latte in downtown whereever, preparing for a conservative day of work/house chores. (Nice house though.)

The sensual female monk. Not much really seems to faze her because she believes that everything in the world is linked, and that all things are part of an ever-changing system of energetic flux. In a nutshell, she is optimistic, young at heart, and she knows that good things come and good things go.

No, she doesn't really adhere to a stock-standard path, be it in the wilderness or down the career road. Her name is completely open-ended at the finish, and in many respects the world is her oyster. But she needs to look up, or maybe she needs prompting to look up. It's a big, crazy and wonderful world out there and Ellinja is best advised to travel plenty - certainly, her best work will be done thousands of miles from where she was born. What that is exactly, however, is anyone's guess!

Geez, where do you start with Elliott? In a nutshell, she's a delightful, unpredictable and happy little chicken who darts about sprucing things up and breathing fresh air into old houses and washed-up personalities who haven't seen light for years. She's make great medical doctor but Elliott needs fresh air, herself, and hospitals just don't cut it.

If she's not extremely timid in the face of a microphone, then Ellise is whip-smart and lightning quick, and she ain't slowed down by micophones, bulls or out of control aircraft. There are two very disparate outcomes here so who have you got?

How and why is it that some people seem to attract confessions? Ellodie has this skill. She doesn't even mean to do it, which means her energy or her aura is subconsciously recognized by people around her as being loving, intelligent, wise and objective. She should probably start charging.
The cocky little spunkrat!

What I’d give to get all the ‘Ellouise-type-spelling’ ladies together and just watch them talk.Very soon they’d realise they’re all very bloody similar. i.e: Spunks. Loud. Power players. Always right. Funny on their day. Impatient….etc etc etc. 

So, good evening & good luck.

Just like her twin sister, Elly is a sensual female monk. Not much really seems to faze her because she believes that everything in the world is linked, and that all things are part of an ever-changing system of energetic flux. In a nutshell, she is optimistic, young at heart, and she knows that good things come and good things go.

If she hides something then give up trying to find it because there's no way. She was highly prized by Jewish families during World War 2 when trying to find hiding places from the SS guards. Not only that, if she needs to talk she'll talk but equally she understands the power of silence.

Ellyn is the kind of girl who, if attending a rodeo, will literally have to stop herself from leaping over the fence and running out into the stadium to go and help the clowns, who are currently attempting to distract a 500kg bull from stomping a cowboy to death. She loves this kind of thing. Similarly, a couple of years back she went to South Africa to dive with the sharks. While most of the men on board just wanted to flirt with her, all she wanted to do was launch over the side to see if it was possible to be towed along by a 6m great white if she grabbed its dorsal fin. Bored - Ellyn is never that for very long. Know what I mean?

Elodie will blow the whistle, she will yell the truth, she will be in the face of liars, cheats, con artists and charlatans. Thank God humans are evolving because Elodie has copped it hard in previous lifetimes. She's been burned at the stake, drowned, fed to rats - you name it - all because she saw past all the ridiculous bullshit mythology that her uneducated world of yester-year was brainwashed with and refused to keep quiet. You know what we need? Elodie as Prime Minister or President, then we'd see some real, meaningful change. (Note: Elodie, we'll help with your campaign. Management. x)
The spunkrat who doesn't even know it. Eloise is the kind of girl every man hits on at the Christmas party.

It's a miracle she's alive. For example, the last time she went to Africa a humble spider fell in her lap while she was driving somewhere. Calmly (bullshit), she let go of the steering wheel screaming, to whit the car veered off the road, crashed through a barrier and plunged into a river. With the help of some local kids who were swimming nearby, she made it back to shore and eventually back to their village where she was given dry clothes and food. Later that night she wound up dancing around the fire in traditional clobber, and rumour has it the chief proposed to her. But you should have seen what happened to her when she tried SCUBA diving. Anyway, someone needs to make a TV show about her. The end.

Look out ladies and gentlemen. Here we have on our hands another heart-breaker. As we're pretty sure we've said before, you can't explain it, you can't grow it and you certainly can't put it in a bottle. It just is. You're just born with it, we think. We're still figuring out the mechanism. Anyway, Elsa is the girl all the girls want to be, and all the boys want to marry whether they're into marrying or not. Indeed, most of the girls want to marry her too, even if they're not into girls. It's just how she is.

Thanks Els', we'll leave you to it, and bravo.

(Oh yeah, Elsa is sensual, caring, spontaneous, happy, wise, present, smells amazing, great listener, and best of all she's lucky. The end.)

Elsie almost never encounters freaks or arse holes, she wears flowers in her hair and likes to make love in the hay, at least she did when she was younger. Is she a little bit shy? Not usually, but she’d rather keep her mouth shut if there’s a dickhead in the room, put it that way.
A very sexy chainsaw.

The drought on the property lasted years and finally, just last night, it broke. How'd you celebrate? You stripped naked, walked out into the magnificent deluge and pointed your face and hands to heavens, before yelling out, "…Oh Elspeth! GLORY BE, MY ANGEL!"

Elvie is a rip-snorter. She’ll trek on her own if she needs to, she’ll passionately kiss in public for the same reasons and she’s been caught shagging more than once. Dramas for her barely register because she is here to live well, which means things like regrets don’t exist either. Everyone is happy when she shows up, be it for work or play. Oh yeah, and she’s more reliable than she sounds.
A drop-dead raven-haired fire-ball who is deliciously naughty and/or artistically magnificent. Hopefully a bit of both.
An affable, funny and sexy doer who means well and does well.
"Emalee! Wait your turn, please!"……if she's heard it once she's heard it a thousand times.

Accident-prone. Nice girl, sure, but be careful lending her your car (never a motorbike) and how many sets of keys has she managed to accidentally drop into storm-water drains? 
Plenty.
A very shiny, full gas bottle. She is therefore as powerful as she is dangerous.
If her boyfriend is so much as 30seconds late picking her up, LOOK OUT!!

A little confused about what to do in the world, Emerald bumps along for the most part. Even she admits that the profitable situation she is standing in happened largely as a fluke. The universe will never forget about her because she has a good heart and a kind soul, so imagine what she could achieve if she stood up proudly, confidently, and stepped to where she knew she needed to be with real gusto? It’d be quite something, we assure you…
A busy, cute and very capable tomboy.
Wow, what a sexy, fun-loving cat she is! Very smart, Emile knows what she wants, knows how she's going to get there and all we can hope for is that she asks us to come along.

True, her resting pulse is about 100 bpm but this is perfectly healthy for her. Like a fast-twitch muscle ever-ready to take on the world and to leap into action, Emi-lee never dies wondering. Rash, she may be, but she always seems to get the job done. Like Annie way before her, she is never where you think she is.

Like a chilled carafe of well-made sangria sitting quietly on a white marble bar at 11pm, to suggest that Emilia is either underprepared or unwilling to get the job done is pure folly. And, oh yes, she's here to have fun but just be mindful that there is a certain etiquette with regards to drinking a well-made sangria, especially here in Portugal. Good luck!

The Delegator, The Organiser, The No-Shit-Taker, The Revenge Seeker (if she thinks the person will benefit), The Taster-Not-The-Cook, The Champagne Popper, The Never-Does-The-Dishes, and lastly, the girl who can get by on 3 hours sleep. Yep, she's full-on kids.

Yes, it’s true, Emily was once crowned the Table Manners World Champion. She won it in Zurich apparently, ages ago. How did she accomplish this feat, you ask? Well, it was easy really. For a start Emily is highly competitive - did you know that? - she has impeccably high standards when it comes to public behaviour (which couples nicely with her capacity to find faults in systems/personalities) and her middle-class background (minimum) means she knows a decent restaurant menu when she sees one.
And just a little note to any fellow who aspires to court our Emily: If you get so far as being involved with her you need to get comfortable with the notion that she’ll be wearing the pants in the relationship, not you.
So, you got all that?

If she'd been a rugby league or gridiron player she'd have been feared and revered across the league for the ferocity of her attack on both the opposition players and the ball. Sure, she's pissed off that she has to spell her name 12 times per week but hey-ho, life could be worse. She's no fool, and she knows what she wants.

Like the surface of a swollen river after the monsoon, she’s smooth and bubbling on the surface, but all those m’s are almost too perfect to be true because beneath them is a chaotic riverbed of drama and complexity. Befriend one and you must ask yourself the question: Can I swim?

Like a traffic cop who is going to fine you, no matter how much you complain and beg and plead and offer-up genuine, legitimate excuses for why she pulled you over in the first place, she will smile, and nod, and placate where necessary, but when the rules (be they official or otherwise) are broken you can expect to pay the penalty.
Stand up straight, be proud of what you are and take responsibility for your actions: this is EK's mantra.

Sure, she drives fast and furiously, but she hasn't crashed yet and (touch wood) we don't expect her to. In that regard feel free to give her the keys to the captaincy of the team as well. Once she makes a decision she sticks to it and she'll harass anyone who initially said they were on board but for whatever reason has lost enthusiasm. Emma-Leigh hasn't got time to fuss about with lazy, lying shit heads. Her only impatience stems from having to apply this thing called makeup. Want our advice EL? Toss it all out. You don’t need it.

Emmalyn’s disquiet here in the 21st Century stems from being burnt at the stake once upon a time just for being a strong and independent woman. The idiots considered her a witch, when all she was doing was standing up for her sisters and encouraging a little free-thinking among them. What the hell is wrong with that? (Please read that line again, all you dim-witted, narrow-minded fundamental religious men.)

So, give her a little latitude. Emmalyn is on a mission and if she succeeds then we all win. End of story.
Martyrdom - forget it. She's not that political. And anyway, she'd get her finger nails dirty.
A very French version of Stephanie!
Chatterbox.
Emmylou is an idiot at heart who embraces all debauched behaviour and she loves the sound of her own shrill attempts at opera singing which, sadly, are truly crap.

Enfys is the name given to the first rock that a shipwreck survivor (Michelle, or Angela, perhaps?) first grabs a-hold of when they miraculously reach the shore. Yes, she will cut and graze you, but how much do you need her?
Enid is the name of any grandmother that interrupts a game of backyard cricket or baseball with a tray of biscuits and raspberry cordial, although she always did like beautiful young boys.
Ennis = Ducati.

Illogical. Neurotic. Schizophrenic. Although, perhaps it’s not all her fault because Erica is occasionally infected by mean-spirited ghosts that make her behave very erratically, sometimes dangerously.

Does a more competent, single-minded woman exist? If she joined the airforce she'd waltz through the jet fighter course to the point where her fellow (male) students wouldn't even question her capacity to pass the course and end up on a squadron somewhere. (As ever, you don't really want to mess with her, even if she's on the ground.)

Erin is relaxed, sensual, playful and, despite her occasionally serious look, she rarely loses her sense of humour. She keeps fit, physically and spiritually, and she does it all amid a whirlwind of friends and socialness because she lives her life for her and not for anyone else.
Erolyn is one of those people always running late. She's never on time to catch a plane, for example, which is a pity because she catches heaps.
She’s Dutch, and so she knows what an esky is, already. That is, a venue for fun and friends. And so she is.

Esmai is an army general who is adored by the troops, and whose arrival into camp always provides a wonderful boost for morale. She looks each soldier in the eye and listens intently to what they say. Whether she’s taking-in all she hears is irrelevant because each man and woman knows she has their welfare in mind as much as she can, even though they know war is hell, and that not everyone will be alive this time tomorrow night. She’s here right now, and that's whats important. Esmai.
Nah, forget the hype. Esme is lovely, downright lovely. Indeed, everyone, stand to attention and salute. Thankyou. Thankyou Esme.

Rarely outlandish, Essena is a quietly-spoken girl who looks like she’s thinking heavily most of the time. Not often the leader the of the pack, she kind of glides along on the third or fourth rung in any hierarchy but she always attracts plenty of attention from the boys.

A roaring gale can't keep this girl down - no way. Esta can run, stop and pivot faster than anyone. She changes jobs every two or three weeks, her boyfriends and lovers even more often and in the end, people go to her house with a pre-written message for her, knowing that she's not going to be home even when she says she is. Esta needs a crash helmet.
This girl has a smile that’s wider than the horizon and a laugh that can be heard for miles, and the ghosts of her ancestors tread the landscape, still.
Having spent all day building a 20 foot-high bonfire, if you don’t let her light it then there’ll be hell to pay!

If Esther isn’t in a nursing home, then she is young, incredibly intelligent, wears comfortable shoes and cackles loudly. Like a few others in the Kingdom, however, the energy she generates also gives her the capacity to attract weirdos by the 100’s.
Good old fashion shoe polish. Big in the 50’s.

The frisky Japanese princess who detests the royal life. She'd much rather go to a concert and sneak her way into the mosh pit, up the front, than attend the cocktail party at another foreign embassy. Her father isn't happy, but that's nothing new.

A cross between Janice and a lump of wood, as a very expensive life-like doll made in Japan for extremely lonely men, Eunice looks incredible but there is some question as to whether or not she is plugged in. Anyone got a double adaptor?

For god's sake, can someone pull her away from that bloody laboratory for a while and stick a drink in her hand. Oh, she doesn't drink? Okay, well that's fine, give her some cake. Or maybe a can of coke. What? She doesn't eat sugar? Okay, get a few of you, bust into the research station lab, pick her up and take her down to the beach, clothes and all, and then throw her in the ocean. Life doesn’t have to be all work and no play, girl.

Ev is everyone’s great mate because everyone feels comfortable around her. (Unless, of course, you happen to be one of the few people that she detests, and you would need to be a complete prick/bitch to achieve that.)

Powerful and sexy when she needs to be, Eva is forgiving, compassionate and deliciously unselfconscious, everywhere else. She laughs with her whole body and it affects all those within earshot. There was never any doubt; Eva is an incredible woman.

Evalena has guts and she has nous. She'll travel and laugh, and squeeze the juice out of every situation. She says yes most of the time and doesn't stand for idiocy for more than about 9 seconds. Big smile. Big heart. Unapologetic.

Crikey, you'd think it wasn't a difficult task, would you. All you asked of her was to take the car down to the mechanic and drop it off for a simple service. The car's in good shape anyway, really, but she's been watching a little too much of Pimp My Ride, hasn't she. So, what was going to be a normal $200 change-of-oil and a general check-up has turned into a 5 grand fiasco involving a stereo that kind of everts itself out of the entire back seat, not to mention these ridiculous white-wall tyres that alone cost $800 a pop. God, what next?

The name of a seldom-heard-of play by William Shakespeare. Basically, it’s a story of a beautiful young peasant girl, the young man who loves her and the effect she has on the King (and monarchy) after a chance encounter by the main castle gates, one day. In short, it’s an explosive tale of love, ambition and betrayal that will remain with you long after you leave the theatre. In summation, if you were married to Evangelina life would never be dull.

Option A:  Eve doesn’t have a nasty bone in her body. She’s very disappointed when her trust is misplaced and, after events such as this, it take ages for her to recover. 

Option B:  She is Leecey’s major support up there in the forest. Yes, Eve has been known to cut the throat of a living goat with a knife but it’s all for a good cause. Thank God we’ve started to celebrate some of our witches!

The pre-eminent goddess who walks amongst us, and who deals with the young and old in the same fashion. Like a few other girls in the Kingdom she tends to stop most rooms she walks into and the only hiccup arises when her father, husband, boyfriend, girlfriend, mother or housemate won't let her drive because of how much champagne she's drunk.
The sweet-smelling, ever-loving tourniquet.

Evie's heart is in the middle of her body and at the centre of her life. She'd never work for the military, for example, and if she did it'd only be as a Colonel in charge of a humanitarian aid effort after some natural disaster or other. Evie has a large number of wonderful friends but it's not all Bible studies and biscuits. If you're a bit glum and want to party, Evie can do that too, because this girl is able to devote herself to a cause. She's here to help, don't forget.

Evizel is complicated – you might as well try and explain why an Australian Echidna tries, unsuccessfully, to dig its way into a pile of gravel – but the important thing to remember is that Evizel rhymes with 
Everythingsgonnabealrightintheend. And it is.
What a woman? She’s cares about you and the world, she listens, she gives good advice and she laughs all the time. In fact, where is she when you need her?
Serene and unflappable, Ezi is a quick learner and therefore super-skilled at everything she tries. Smart arse subtlety from male idiots is none of her business, thankfully. Ezi is bloody delightful.
