(Said with a heavy French accent.) Bonjour my darling-eh, she is, how you say...very beautiful, no? She does not work....but....I think....ahhh, so what? Why should she? I mean....what would she do? (Hands tossed in the air, unknowingly.)

Option A: Faith is older than 65 and lives for Friday night bingo.

Option B: Faith is younger than 40 and is a fast-moving girl with a large smile and who is eager to get moving. She leans into people she’s listening to and she doesn’t like sitting around once she’s made her mind up. (Note: if her parents named her that because of their own devout Christian beliefs, then we may have a problem Houston.)

No, Fallon may not be the deepest sea out there but at least she gets to fly all over the world. She loves dressing up in shiny, colourful outfits so who knows, perhaps we'll see her in the Winter Olympics skiing or maybe driving V8’s for a production car racing team. She’s look awfully good sitting in a Porche.
Her bathroom is full of coastal themes that highlight what might have been had tragedy not struck as often as it did. Outside the bathroom she finds life somewhat daunting.
See Farah.

Farren is a selfie addict. Until she stops with all that ego bullshit we can’t tell you what she’s going to do with herself, but there’s no denying that she’s the captain of her own ship. When/if armageddon arrives, the hardships endured will pull her out of her deluded reverie faster than most and she’d survive just fine.
Fatima is a loud and generous lover.

Fauziah isn’t one to spend hours and days sitting around complaining about the lack of things to do, no way. She has ambition, she has spunk and she gets shit done. She owes it to her family and her community, and don’t for a second think she’ll tolerate any misogynistic behaviour. Imagine that, a day when, say, Saudi Arabia, crowns a Queen Fauziah? Imagine what that could mean….

(Sung to any decent rap melody)
"My name is Fay
If you don’t get out of my way
You’re gonna’ suffer
Great dismay.”
Judge. And a fair-minded one too. Her private life is actually a bubbling ball of social hilarity, although you’d never know it from seeing how she behaves in court.

The standard handling rules apply to Fee as they do your cousin (Fi). 
Be prepared. 
Be prepared. 
Be prepared. 
Beyond that, hold on and good luck, and don’t ring us if something or someone catches on fire.
If the girl in front of you presents as a shy, diminutive and secretive girl, you're not looking at Felicia. End of story.
The Stalker. Felicity can be very sexy but she’s definitely quite crazy.

Fenella approaches most tasks like a long-limbed spider who has the capacity to think about (and handle) plenty of objects and ideas at any given moment. She is therefore very knowledgeable and she enjoys applying that knowledge where she sees fit. Pure playfulness may be a little beyond her brain to compute the usefulness of, but if she can direct her mind to sexual play and get all her attention focussed in the one place, she can have an orgasm that vibrates the very fabric of space-time around her.

Fergie is not easily missed or forgotten. Interestingly, she is exactly one part Fi and one part Felicity, and that makes her quirky and artistic (whether she has talent or not), and sexy, and in your face if she feels like it, and she’s fabulous in bed - if not slightly unorthodox.

No, Fern isn't the gun powder, she's more like the calming  balm of the linseed oil that is rubbed into the smooth, old stock of a very expensive rifle worth tens of thousands of dollars. She smells great, she has patience and after spending time in her company, after a while all you want to do curl up against her and fall asleep.
“Get out of my way!” she barks, heading for the bar/party/car keys/front of the queue/cupboard/fridge/bedroom/spa/diving platform/dance floor/anything.

I wonder if she was ever attached to the fashion industry? She is definitely big on design and large scale events. Families rock her boat and she insists her kids give her grandchildren, which means her presence for certain people is always a blessing and a curse.

Yep, we know, it’s a weird name but by George it’s done her proud. Fiefield is not only a woman, a rather beautiful and optimistic woman, actually, but she is fiercely independent and capable. Sensual too. Indeed, you say her name and sit up, both startled and delighted all at once at the sound of such a title on a human. This reaction has given her space and nous and self-belief. Fiefield is a bloody legend and she doesn’t care what you make of her. Like a few others out there, the only sadness (which his ours, not hers) is that there are just incredibly few Fiefields in the wild.
In fact, if you meet one can you give us a tingle?
Thanks.

Christ or mighty, where do you start? Well, firstly, she ain't shy and she doesn't shy away from a confrontation either, so don't ask her if she'd like a pretend punch up - there'll be nothing pretend about it, mostly coz' she hates to lose. Secondly, she loves sex and she's generally good at it, although she's usually a wee bit more timid in the bedroom than she is in real life, which is probably a relief. Why is that? I've no idea. Thirdly, if you piss her off, she'll just cut you out of her life with not so much as a second thought. And rightly so. In a past life Fi-Fi was a World War 1 fighter pilot in a biplane, and sometimes, after she ran out of ammo', she was forced to shoot at her opponents in the sky with her pistol.

Trashy? Finella? No way Hosay. Finella is by and large the epitome of style and subtlety. Did she study Arts at university, or was it Law, or was it both? Well-read from a little girl, by the time she travelled the world she’d already spent a few hours in her head at la Fontana de Trevi, the Eiffel Tower and Times Square. She saw them all in the flesh eventually and felt a gentle kind of delight, because she knows you can’t know a person or a place until you smell them. 
Finella is a lovely deep sea worth taking the time to get to know well, and to love if you get the chance, and she is almost certainly not a natural blonde.

Finn will take off on her own for weeks, months and sometimes years, travelling to all parts of the world, engaging with as many different peoples as she can. It's her way of both giving and receiving and she's way more energetic than her male counterpart.

There are no in-betweens with Fiona. Either she’s plain and a bit dull, or she is incredibly sexy, ambitious, charismatic and occasionally stressed. Regardless of which one she is, however, Fiona would go to the hairdresser every day if she could. Outside her bad hair days – of which there are at least five every week – she’s surprisingly chilled out.

No, Fionola is not a grand instrument, although she did play the piano for a while. She is, in fact, a very happy and dedicated mine-site manager. She wears a hard hat everywhere she goes and the bright orange outfit kind of matches her bright red hair. Despite the smile, her advice is to be taken seriously, you got that?

Italiana? No? Oh well, she’s still molto sexy and a splendid actress. Boys drool and she always get large discounts at hotels/shops etc, and she rarely pays for a drink. She terrifies passengers with her driving however, even though she hasn’t crashed badly yet. She looks distracted, I know, but fear not, she’s on the case.
Possibly Swiss, Fish is clean living and clean thinking, if not on the surface then definitely at her core. And, naturally, she’s great in, on and under the water.

Frisky. Despite her bull-approach in the professional arena Fitzy is a surprisingly sensitive soul. Like trillions of beings throughout the universe, all she really wants to do is hang out with the one she loves, meet with her friends, and contemplate what she might get up to tomorrow. Is that so much to ask?

It’s not possible for anyone to be as soft and as perfect as the sound of her name, and so it is. Fleur might be the first drops of rain from the storm, she might be the wayward personality with delusions of grandeur, and she might be the hard-hitting journo’. Who knows? This girl is anything but normal and she does non-normalness very well.

The sensuous and intelligent blonde who is rollicking good fun. Like any half-decent Bower Bird, she is attracted to all bright and shiny metal objects; bracelets, brass knuckles, 9mm nickel-plated pistols, wedding rings, stainless steel shackles, handcuffs….you name it. Friends and lovers, have you got a padlock?

Fliss is wonderful. Her smile does damage she has no idea about, and every time she turns around she subconsciously expects there to be some kind of incredible life discovery in front of her. Imagine living like that every day? No wonder she seems happy and relaxed all the time. Her sour moods, on the rare occasion when they do arrive, therefore tend to be funny rather than catastrophic.
“Oh well,” she drones slowly, squinting into the blazing sun. “We’ve got a drought on now, but we get floods out here too, mate. Anyway, what can you do? That’s life in the bush for ya, hey.”

Florence is 92 yrs old and lives in a small country town that's 300 miles from the nearest city. If everyone knew what she knew and lived as simply as she did, peace on Earth would become a rapid and remarkable reality.

Florencia can afford a team of well-paid gardeners to tend her expansive flower beds, but she loves getting out there and shovelling shit for the greater good. The personal satisfaction she receives is always worth the hard work.
Forrest is the real deal - as wise as the hills she sits on, as proud as she needs to be, diverse and quirky down to her roots and she helps and urges everything and everyone around her with a smile.
She almost gives Lainey a run for her money in terms of a laid-back nature, but Foxy has that spark of charisma that allows her to pack a punch. And yes, she’s a wonderful flirt.
Often caught in the mire of life’s chores, she’s a more generous person than most. Aside from being gifted with special psychic powers did you know that in her cupboard are heaps of sexy suspenders?

Picture this: It's summer, night time, and  you're skinny dipping near some cliffs in the Greek islands. You're with friends, the water is clear and life doesn't get much better. Suddenly you hear an almighty screech from up above, near the cliff face! Look out! HERE COMES FRANCA!

Tired of life’s drudgery, Francelle would love to be transported back in time to a Monet painting. Her idea of heaven, right now, is to recline in a small wooden boat afloat on a calm pond which is being oared by a Frenchman in a beret, and whose shirt is half-unbottoned. At her feet is a basket containing wine, cheese, a baguette, a knife and corkscrew. And a blanket, which she hopes to employ a little later.  ;)

Frances enjoys wearing big black boots with steel caps. She clomps around the house making lots of noise, which makes up for her quiet nature, unless she’s hungry of course, in which case she clomps loudly and with genuine purpose.

A wonderful woman who is full of life, love, compassion and humour. She has more complications during her pregnancy and subsequent labour than any other woman, however, and if she can survive all of those then she’ll have a big and wonderful family. We wish her well.

Even when she's smitten Francine keeps her cool. She never shirks her responsibilities and a superior intellect means that she accomplishes most things in her life with relative ease. She's big on surprises, and no, we’re not being sarcastic.

Frankie is enthusiastic. For example, having just taken up surfing in Western Australia only a matter of months ago and loving it, the news of 9 people being eaten by great white sharks in the last four weeks within two miles of her favourite spot deosn't enter her head.
"Why would they bother me?" she says. "I'm only little."
The sun is setting and yet there she is, paddling out on her own.
There's nothing little about Frankie, trust me.

Like a very cute and capable soccer referee who has a dozen players in front of her face yelling and screaming their displeasure at a decision that went against them, Fraser remains cool and unflustered amid the noise and the anger. Little do they don't know that she was a Navy Seal before she got into umpiring sport. These idiots don't know what anger is, she's thinking, which is why she's smiling at their on-field antics.
Pure. Funny. Replete. Here. X

Freda loves her boots and she likes striding out of the house on a winter's day, under a jacket and scarf, feeling like she looks the goods. She likes how her bum is looking at the moment and, though she'd never admit it, that serious look on her face is all bluff. She gets her car cleaned regularly.

The playful messenger who darts in and out of spaces, and who is nearly incapable of being overcome with sadness, aside from the regular romantic dramas she seems to attract. Freddy is a dish. Indeed, some advice: Freddy, most of them are drop-kicks so be patient. Greatness is a-coming. Make no mistake. Management. x
Freya rhymes with ‘Easy does it’, but she grew out of that. As a fashion designer of some note, these days she is extravagant and laid-back. Indeed, nothing isn’t impossible for this persona.
Sensual and affectionate, Frida is occasionally overly sensitive.
Folks, fear not. Frith’s fown is rarely, if ever, intended as a sign of frustration or pain. Frith is just intensely curious and she’s here to help, end of story.
Frog wears her name like one of those English pubs that has a name like, The Pork Horn and Miss Dingleberry’s Underpants. Lovely girl. Nice pub.

It's not that you can't take her anywhere - with a laugh that loud and contagious how could you leave her at home? - but if she's at a swank dinner with the in-crowd at San Diego’s finest restaurant, and she spills some syrup off her spoon during desert, don't think she wont lick her hands and fingers clean, right at the table. Why waste all that beautiful sauce, she's tell you, and the universe loves her fot it. Peer group pressure is for sheep, not for this vixen.

Funky Fynn is definitely funny, as well as adaptable and proactive. She’s far better outdoors than in and as a tomboy of sorts, she’s intrigued all the boys for an awfully long time and she always will. Clunky in romance, however. She’d make a fantastic park ranger or zoo keeper.
Friendly to all, Gabby’s optimism is appreciated by most people and she is envied by women for her slight figure and her talkative nature. But more significant than that, Gabby is brave.

Question: What does she do?
Answer: Anything she wants.
Not only because of her looks, but all doors will open for this girl because there are some people that, somehow, have been touched by magic. Up here in the commentary box we don’t understand it either.

Gabrielle drives men berserk by getting regularly on her motorbike while wearing a mini-skirt and, because she’s pragmatic and eccentric, she doesn’t understand their reaction at all. She has short hair.

Like the male Einar, Gaenna rhymes with "When do you think you're gonna'?" but this girl isn't trained in martial arts, and so never learned how to kill a man with a single forefinger jab to the throat. However, Gaenna probes and looks and thinks and smiles and thinks some more, and then arrives at the solution with a unique kind of grace and energy. Does that make sense?

Heavens to Mercy, you wouldn’t want to fight her, would you? If Gaewynne were a fishing vessel I suspect very few seas would scare her, and if she were a wolf you’d see her in one of those movies, caught staring out across a blizzard-covered tundra, snow and ice gathering on her whiskers, while she coldly surveys her prey some distance away. And she wouldn’t look cold. Life in the western world as a living, warm-hearted woman, therefore, presents her with a dream ride. As she knows, most people have no idea what true hardship really is. Personal motto: Be grateful for what you've got and work hard if you have to. Amen to that, My Lady.
Gai is not all that feminine and she is quite bare-knuckled about it all, but if you want to get something done in a hurry, and done properly, then you could do a lot worse than getting her on board.

Her name is as about as much fun as hacking off frost bitten toes with a knife and so Gail is naturally pretty tough, yet she’s a funny and relaxed character who is good company. And she makes an excellent CEO. Not bad, eh?

If Gappy were a cop she'd not only be unbribable, but everyone in the village would know her on a first name basis. Despite never  attracting genuine violence and bloodshed, in front of the mirror every week she would still practice pulling her weapon from its holster quickly,  just in case, before pointing the gun at herself and shouting, “FREEEEEEEEZE!", god love her.

Gaye rarely tosses and turns in her sleep. Is there a decision to be made? What are the pros and cons, who will be impacted by such a decision and what is my role in this?
These are thought processes Gaye moves through very quickly. She’s not being dispassionate, she’s being real and she’s being fair. 
“Fuck Facebook opinion. Show me the facts and we’ll move from there.”
They may very well inscribe this on Gaye’s gravestone.
"Shut up," she says, sternly. "Pain is good for you."

Dear Gayle, I know the spelling is very different but I’m afraid you and Gail are twin sisters with identical DNA. Please, therefore, make your way to Gail. She is you and you is she, aside from one small issue. If the two of you are parachuting for example, you will generally land smoothly with two feet, where as 'Gail' will often end up either in a tree or a dam, or maybe caught in a fence.

Heaven bless this girl, for there are few people who bring as much enthusiasm to the table as she does, while at the same time beginning so many projects that end unexpectedly, catastrophically, comically and spectacularly. However, she knows very well that if you make no mistakes you learn no lessons. She could write a book on how to attack life. In fact, perhaps she already has?

Gaylin toils hard in the short term, but it generally means she'll prosper in the greater picture. She has a tough shell and like an army tank she can absorb quite a lot of damage and rarely, if ever, will she capitulate.

Gayner discusses issues not people and she’s usually the most knowledgeable person in the room. You might argue that she doesn’t giggle enough but, don’t worry, she’s happy. 
One question: Is she so busy that her sex/love life gets forgotten about? 
When she gets home from this conference we’ll ask her…

Gaynor is the the Queen, President, boss, leader or manager who is loved by her underlings, and who also laugh at how funny she is when she gets angry. They know she's doing her best and they know, too, that she hasn't got a unpleasant bone in her body. It's just how it is.
Note: As a side job, she hosts people like Lawrence, once in a while, who pay her a lot of money for deeds so bizarre and fantastic we literally can't discuss them here.
The Queen of Persuasion.

Usually physically gorgeous, Gemma is deceptively ambitious and will use her sexy smile to help her anyway she sees fit. Life is a game for her and she therefore devotes as much time as possible to having as much fun as possible. She is a loud drunk.

Gena is the kind of girl who, after a couple of champagnes, is likely to say yes to just about anything, so long as not too many people get hurt. The last time she was in New York, for instance, it was winter time and yep, she wanted to skate a lap of that big outdoor ice rink starkers. You might have seen her on Youtube. If you did, you're not likely to forget her.
The note-taker, the PR, the diminutive office organiser, the stalwart. We'd be screwed without her.

Geneva is one of these people who has literally no idea how a car functions. "Oil? What the hell is that?" she's asked more than once. Having said that, she tends to read human behaviour very well, which has probably saved more accidents and bloodshed than her driving skills ever would. She keeps her intelligence to herself for some reason. Why is that? Management thinks this is only a short-term thing, and that one day she might even run the company, and not just because all the head-honchos love her looks.

Slender, elegant and with a glorious sense of self, this girl operates from another realm. Your head sways with the euphoric grace of a Puccini aria as you say her name .…..Genevieve. Few may understand her properly and so what.
She’s not a Jeanie, she’s not a Fairy and she’s no Genius. What Genia is, however, is enthusiastic and caring.

Hmmm....let me see. Petite, demure, timid and well-behaved: bullshit. Have you ever been to the rodeo and seen those bulls stomp on the cowboys stupid enough to let go? Need I say anymore, although I will state the obvious: this girl doesn't die wondering. In the bedroom, in society and confronted with any questionable behaviours or individuals, Genine is an unfettered Beast of a Woman. Those poor male sods in the Middle East who don't understand women at all could learn a lot. GO  YOU GOOD THING!

Man, is she sick of spelling her name to people? But at least it hasn’t turned her into a psychopath. Georga takes it on the chin and if anything it has aided her to stand up for what she believes in. Don’t be fooled though, she’s no push-over. She has style and ambition, and she’s here to find her own path. Note, if you yourself are slightly lost, she’s good for sound advice. True story.

George does everything quite easily, and the only hiccup is that the maleness of her name blinds men to her true and natural beauty, which is both unique and substantial. So, look again gentlemen. (She’d make a great professional surfer.)

Here’s a heads-up: if you want to deal with Georgette successfully and she’s not into any of her nicknames, never call her Goerge, Goergie or G. Only call her Georgette otherwise she’ll take her business, love, ambitions and money elsewhere. You got that?

With the capacity to pulverise and inspire, Georgi is no push-over. No, she's not arrogant folks, just self-confident and serene. If you could bottle it you'd make a fortune. Having said all that, in her younger years at least, you'll see her at the 'in parties', where she seems to know everyone but, here's something, how many of that 'in crowd' donated money to the latest disaster cause? Georgi did.
A country in her own right and a person in her own skin. Ambitious and confident, just say yes when you think you should and she won’t kill you.

On one level, Georgie is a fuzzy little lamb who is so neat, cute and wonderful that she makes you want to throw up but, thankfully, no one is that nice and she taps into this empathy to go a long way.

Aren’t female chimps terrific creatures? When Georgina is in heat, her hind-quarters become red and swollen but you’d be a fool to assume that she wasn’t outstanding value and highly intelligent. Absolutely.

The beautiful old girl became extinct about 65 million years ago when a meteor struck the earth somewhere near where Mexico is today. Prior to her extinction she was a giant herbivore that left piles of dung that were larger than a small car. What a wonderfully happy soul she was.
Gerlinda has never misappropriated funds, and as the Head of Finance she'd be very disappointed in anyone who did.
In a past life her name was Len.
Gerry is a scrumptious handful.

“What? Gertie is here? Are you for real?”……
This tends to be the response of most people when Gertie arrives because she is surrounded by the kind of chaos which makes one piss oneself with laughter. And as a delicious breath of fresh air, we’re not surprised.

Clumsy, lovely and friendly, Gertrude is one of those people who, for whatever set of reasons, which are apparently dictated by the universe at large, attracts bizarre and almost unbelievable ‘coincidences’. As a school teacher she is tantamount to a life saver, as she is everywhere.
A cocky male rooster trapped in a female body.

Gianna is one of those unusual creatures who insists that, in a past life, she was a regal empress. From where in the world, we know not. The upshot of previously being at the top of the food chain means that, here today, she bosses people like no tomorrow, expecting them to do her bidding. It's actually not her fault. But, she has mellowed this time around and as time goes on, more and more do we see her laughing and joking around with her friends and peers, getting out that big, luscious smile of hers.

“Just give it here..!” she whines at her stage manager. She takes the ream of paper in her hands and studies it intensely. She frowns for a few seconds, flips over a page, then another, and then shoves it back in his face. “Nup. Piece of piss,” she says. “Relax. Now fuck off while I get changed.”   Gib.
Yes, it's true. She was arrested by the Roman carabinieri for swimming nude in the Trevi Fountain at about 7 o'clock at night, mid-summer. You should have seen the reaction from the crowd…

Say her name once and it stops and starts and falters, say it three times and you see the truth because it was there the whole time; that is, she might not be gilded in the classical sense but she’s certainly one of the great German secrets. Gilda is unusual and utterly lovely.

Her name is impossible to say if you’re anywhere near sleep because she carries a big, sexy, brash personality. She loves mingling with different people, the more the merrier, and she loves a good game of hide-and-seek.

The tall and intelligent psychology student who wears vivid red lipstick and the brightest dresses anyone has ever seen. (They’re often covered with big embroided flowers.) Anyway, she’s raucous fun and a nightmare to argue with.

Gilly is not a standard issue. You'll need training, you'll need a supervisor early-on and we suggest you practice in a safe area if you're going to involve yourself with The Gilly. Have people died? Yes, but it's a very rare thing. We've found that most users benefit in ways that none of us predicted. But, as we say, you need to put in the hours...

Option A:  Sexy without being sensual. Passionate without being focussed. Unstable without being dangerous.

Option B:  The name of Kirsty’s vagina.
A sexy box of fizz and fun and light! Does she tell the truth?...Usually, yes.

The name of an upcoming model of Toyota motor car - the Toyota Gintra. It's a new thing the company is trying, endeavouring to capture the quite specific market of upwardly mobile women who like their air con and lots of internal mirrors, with blue tooth and all that nav crap, but who also love a bit of four wheel driving. The TV ad for the car will feature four super models in a red Gintra, driving it up a rocky cliff before dropping into the ocean, fish swimming all around them as they drive along the bottom back to the beach. Then they get out of the car in their bikinis, and yes, a fish ends up stranded on the bonnet. Underneath the car at the end it will read:
Toyota Gintra – Sexy and Tough, with an emphasis on Tough.

Ever seen the movie High Fidelity? It’s a flick about a man who owns a record shop. Anyway, there is a character played by the startlingly beautiful Catherine Zeta-Jones. In terms of describing Giorgia you need look no further. And what a story she is…

“Giovanna, Giovanna......where art thou Giovanna??” 
Men across the planet have been wailing that phrase outside her window for years. To no avail, usually, and she’s used to the attention these days. But, when you generate as much wonderful electromagnetic funk as she does you’re bound to emit a few ripples that alter the nature of things. Giovanna.

Gisela, honey, yes, you’re very cute and seductive and all that, but Princesses don’t actually exist here in the real world. At some point, therefore, you will need to don some comfortable clothes and put in the hard yards. We’re really sorry to have to tell you that, because up here in the commentary box, we want princesses to exist too. A good way to get things moving? Tomorrow morning, go and do the thing that scares you the most, or at least put the wheels in motion. You won’t regret it.
The sensuous heart breaker.

Formalities? She detests them. “Just get on with it,” she'll often heckle from the crowd at some function or other if the speeches are going on too long. She's quite the realist you know, and she's always eager to get all the chores and rubbish behind her so she can have a bit of fun.

One of those girls who, at 16, owned every expensive perfume bottle known to women. Is she past all that rubbish yet? (Note: if she is French or European it’s a different story altogether, and one which involves either the ocean or horses, in very much a hands-on capacity. This Giverny has barely even heard of perfume.)

Giz fights for the cause and she quite happily forgoes any kind of self-promotion, and so she doesn’t really look normal, either, thank Christ. Imagine Giz in a Muslim country? She might very well pave the way for peace among idiotic men. Imagine that? Peace in the Middle East. Can we put her on a plane?…
Shazaam!! And yes, she’s got one hell of an ego.....

Forget the boring social morays. Regardless of her socioeconomic status, if Gladys is at a party and, out of the blue, someone asks her to open her mouth and stick her tongue out in order to have her picture taken, she will immediately agree with unadulterated enthusiasm. The world needs more of them.

Glenda is a peach that is devoid of any momentum. She was perfectly ripe about four weeks back but she fell from the tree a week ago and is now lying on the ground, beneath it, as a rather juicy lump. Which is to say, you do the best you can, you make the most fun possible with what you've got, when you've got it, and you retain your sense of humour at all times. And if you fancy getting nude and sexy in a field just for the hell of it, then bloody-well get to it. Amen for Glenda!
A fair dinkum, u-beaut’, 100% genuine Australian Gum Tree.
Ever seen a road map for inner London? Welcome to the levels of complexity in the beautiful Glenwyn. I'll come back in a month and see how you're getting on…..
See Glenis, I’m delighted to say.
A simple and happy soul who is careful with most things. She has a permed hairdo.
Jesus, lucky they didn’t name you ‘Total Fuck Up’ eh? Anyway Glory is a friendly, agreeable lass who has had no other choice. She follows the rules and shuns public attention.

Goddess carries a whip, wears a studded leather collar around her neck, 4-inch stilletos that have mechanically sharpened heels on her feet and a smile fit for only those who enjoy the pain. Good luck!

“Screw that! The party will over by the time we get there!” she says, after having been told by the police that her and her girlfriends will need to drive all the way back into town and out and around the other way to avoid the flooded river. “Listen here sonny Jim, I’ve crossed this river a hundred times when it was higher than this, all before you were born.”
Ignoring the cops, Goldie plants her foot and before the officers can react her car is hurtling into the waters...

No, she ain't no goshawk, although she is reasonably fit and agile, and she has a large, open smile which makes a splendid welcome mat for those people who hear her name and say, "How do you say your name again?"
She's used to it, but it deosn't bother her anyway because Gosia possesses a loving, happy and relaxed nature, deep down, who likes meeting and talking to people any old time, and whether anyone says her name or not.
Born as a 40 year old and therefore measured and wise before her time, Grace has great faith in her friends because she often sees their future before they do. How do you top that?
The name of a plush white rug next to a sun-filled window that you go and lie on for a lazy nap on a winter’s afternoon.

Her name is so smooth and unusually cool that people have difficulty remembering it and, consequently, her life is far more complex than it need be. But, beneath these frustrating moments, she is a sensual and worldly individual.
Intense, very bright and long-legged, Greer takes most things seriously and someone needs to give her a giraffe onesie.
Greta works for NASA. Does she do her hair? Rarely. Does she wear pretty clothes? Sometimes, but it's largely a fluke. Is she fucking wonderful? You betcha'.

As a geology PhD student, she loves all rocks (especially igneous ones), wears boots, hiking trousers and a flannel shirt that Jake would be proud of. There is also at least one crater on Mars named after her.
A witch, and you’ve got to love a good witch. (Note that 19% of Gretels are horrendous and only cast evil spells, in which case they need to be taken out dancing whether they want to or not.)

Now listen here, Miss Gretta - I don’t want to hear a single bloody pip out of you, okay?  I'm sick of your whinging about shit that doesn't matter. So, breathe, breathe again, and now  go and check out 'Greta'. Have a nice day! xx
Like the Yeti, Santa Claus, the Tooth Fairy and Drop Bears, we want her to exist but she just doesn’t. Does she?

The name given to an exotic and fiendishly confusing maze in the plush grounds of a 16th century French or Italian mansion. Courtesans of the day attempted to fornicate in them during afternoon tea parties.

Serious. She wears her name like a Chameleon wears its colours but Gwen is cool and electric on her day, such that you might have to look and think twice about how remarkably beautiful and/or enigmatic she is. 
(Note: Please read this name theory again, this time beginning at the end of the first sentence.)

Gwenda is unequivocal in her approach to anything. Her moods arrive from the 40 corners of her globe, and they will range from unbridled flights of fancy; grim, determined moments inside the heat of a hard-fought battle and to the delights of sexual fantasy where the only limits are those bound inside her substantial imagination. 
In short, what is on offer here is a remarkable venture for friends, lovers and others. Gwenda: God love her, she ain’t normal.
In a past life her name was Eric.

Oh to be a princess again, she thinks to herself often. She did a past life regression once and, true enough, that's what she saw. Laid down with the chores of tending a large family in this life, she seriously wishes she could afford some maids to lend a hand.
The Controller. If you do the wrong thing she will withdraw her love. If you do the right thing she will return it.

Gwyneth knows exactly what she wants and how to achieve it. Having said that, she’s open and humorous and affectionate and she enjoys her time off. She’s not the full stress-head you were led to believe.
Gwynneth tends to act or speak from a solid footing. She knows what is what, this girl, and she moves with flare and with style. She's no where near as austere as we were led to believe.

Gypsy swirls though life with such chaotic magnificence that nothing ever gets done. Who knows what she does with her life, but she’s certainly happy. 
WARNING: Don’t give her any whisky unless it’s an emergency.
The savvy project manager. She gives a lot – maybe too much – and she has so many friends (of both sexes) that she hasn’t got the time to see them all. A very sexy lady.

Hadassah is rational, she is diplomatic, she has style and she detests grubby people. Some individuals appear as though they never need to rush anything, and this is Hadassah. By the same token, she doesn't speak without considering her words and trivial, meaningless career paths are none of her business. By default she is very well educated.
One minute genius, the next minute crazy. Perhaps she hangs out with Charlie too much? Either way, Hahmoni is a delight.
Haidee detests second place, and she's not averse to the idea of running over loved-ones or family members to get there.

Never one to antagonise over a decision, Hailee makes her mind up lickety-split and then bounds into action. Are her decisions ever wrong? Well, who gives a rat’s arse if they are because you never know unless you try, and if you’re optimistic then the past doesn’t bloody-well come into discussion anyway: this is Hailee’s personal motto.
And she’s very happy to kiss in public. (All the happy optimists are.) 
The End.
As a little girl she always wanted a pony but her family could never afford one. Full of good intentions for everyone and everything, she’s a good soul and good company.

Yep, this goes for Hailey and Haily as well: As a little girl she always wanted a pony but her family could never afford one. Full of good intentions for everyone and everything, she’s a good soul and good company. And ain’t nothing wrong with that. Love Management. x

Halle lives quite simply but don't presume her possessions are meagre. Not that material wealth drives her being, but Halle takes the time to do things properly and thoroughly. Many deem her to be something of a schemer but all she's doing, ladies and gentlemen, is biding her time and keeping her thoughts to herself.

Did you ever watch the early James Bond movies? You did? Okay, splendid. Well did you know Moneypenny was originally called Hanley?
True story. In short, Hanley is sexy, she’s organised, she has a perfect dry sense of humour and she is noticed by way too few, although we’ve a sneaking suspicion that’s just how she likes it.

Mishandle Hanna and karma will come back to get you, although Hanna can look after herself, which means you might get your karma real quick. Hanna is supremely intelligent, so much so she sometimes keeps quiet in an attempt not to embarrass anyone near her, although this is a quality which dissipates as she gets older, thankfully. The artistic streak which runs through her is high-powered and it leads to a glorious, unconventional life. She’s often difficult to pin down and she gathers up strange and wonderful friends everywhere she goes. Hanna.

65% of Hannahs are shy, gentle creatures whose parents insisted she take lessons in either the piano, the cello or the violin. The other 35% are dour competitors with a high tolerance to pain, and who refuse to give in to peer group pressure. 
(As young girls, the 35%-Hannahs placed any instruments given to them on the ground behind the back tyre of their parents’ car, who in turn invariably, and unwittingly, backed over them.)
So, which Hannah are you dealing with?

Hannelie likes the idea of a well-planned, out-of-left-field and potentially confronting holiday. Indeed, she rarely surrounds herself with droll individuals because she likes people who are just like her - inquisitive, interested and dedicated to the more unusual pursuits in life. Would she trek with a group of local tribesman through an African plain, who assure her the lions wont eat her? Damn right she would. And she'd love to see a lion, because she trusts her instincts, and those that she initially places her trust in. Give her waterproof boots over 4-inch stilettos any day.
Hari is a hugger. And they're good. She's the sort of gal' who walks into the local organic cafe and is known and adored by literally everyone present, be they staff or customers.

Yes, she's a sophisticate but don't forget that she loves people and she's extremely generous with her time and her resources. You don't believe me? See that homeless shelter there? Well, she raised the funds from countless fund-raising dinners so it could be built. What have YOU done lately?
Harper loves the idea of the spotlight until she's in it.

Harriett is full of pep and possibly even a decent sized ego, but she’s an odd one. Her carefully nurtured childhood, for example, might have given her one of the sweetest voices ever created. Then again, she might have become the compassionate Head Warden of a womens’ prison. Who knows?

Whether she's at the grindstone, behind the controls, in front of the crowd, beneath the car, on the roof, up the tree or inside the manager's office, Hattie is embedded so deeply inside your heart that you can't imagine life without her.

Life’s experiences aren't worth a cracker if they're lived alone, according to Madame, and to this end Hayleigh tends to form the hub of the group. Nope, she won't lead the charge at the male strippers on a girlie night out, nor would she ever volunteer to drive the crowd home (like Charlie-girl) if she was too drunk to drive, but she'll provide a level-headed rock if one is needed. Indeed, she'd keep herself sober so she could drive home those impulsive friends of hers. That’s the kind of person she is. Regardless of what she desires regarding a career, she wants kids and to be surrounded by a loving family.
As a little girl she always wanted a pony but her family could never afford one. Full of good intentions for everyone and everything, she’s a good soul and good company.
Hayley-Brea, don't take this the wrong way, but we suggest you head on over to Tricia. Thank you, and have a nice day. (And yes, we still love you. Management.)
Hayli has a bit more grunt than her sisters, although she only got into cake decorating so she could eat them.
Hazel is at ease. Hazel is warm. Hazel is wonderful

It was once hypothesised that if Heather didn’t spend each day in bad weather, she’d do a special rain dance and concoct it herself, sometimes quite unconsciously. Now, this may or may not be true, but some people are encumbered with, not only the defence of the country, but in devising a plan of attack in the war room which, by definition, requires great secrecy and intense concentration, and it’s not to be taken lightly. Do you think Heather derives any pleasure from sending up a squadron of rookie pilots against the imminent onslaught, knowing full-well at least a third of them won’t make it back alive? It rips her heart out. So, do her a favour: Take her to dinner. Take her dancing. Take her on a picnic or a visit to the museum or art gallery. If you are her partner, randomly lift up her jumper and kiss her belly sometimes. You with me? She could use the support, that’s all…

I wonder how a person would cope being named Satan Reincarnate? Anyway, Heaven is a chaotic nightmare, although it’s not her fault because her parents were off with the bloody fairies when they named her. She's not angry, or malicious or a nasty person, she's just wasteful, she lacks foresight and she is easily led. Might be time for a name change lass. How about Liz? Just for a few weeks to see how you go…(The one caveat we give with Heaven’s name is the following: if she acquired it after an ayahuasca ceremony, during which she convened with creatures, spirits and animals from other realms and dimensions, then Heaven is someone each of needs to go and spend some time with, and I’d be ignoring all that we said beforehand. Amen.)

If you give Heide a job in the company, expect her to be running the organization within a year or two. We also suggest that you don't fight the process. She's a great leader and she thinks clearly. What more do you want at the top?

Option A:  A German wrestler who was given her name by her manager because he insisted she do something to soften her image. And it nearly worked.

Option B:  Lives in the hinterland, is completely psychic, and runs a market stall where she sells kiddies clothes and/or South American artefacts.

Now here is the sort of woman who gets things done but rarely receives the kudos she secretly needs or deserves. As a rather complex soul, Helen doesn’t have time to try and be sexy – either she is or she isn’t – for there’s simply too much weight on her shoulders to worry about such banalities.

Helena is the name of the sound produced by two large, smooth chunks of limestone being rubbed together. For such a harsh activity the sound produced is surprisingly exotic and calming. “Hey hey…,” the noise will tell you, soothingly. “…..it will be alright.” (Just be careful not to put your fingers in between them.)

Helene lives for her hot soy decaf latte with a pot of hot water on the side, and when she jogs with the girls she attempts to look as ambivalent as possible, even though she ties a little jumper around her waist to stop people looking at her bum, and whether she has a nice one or not. Strange, eh?

Helga charges at life like a battering ram in the hands of the Huns. The quickest route between two points is a straight line, she'll tell you. In past life she dug through mountains with her bare hands and these days, if her lover is not performing well in bed, there will be immediate reprocussions.

Helina is the kind of girl who hates getting all jazzed up for a night on the town with her friends, bitching and complaining bout this and that while she begrudgingly gets ready, but she's always the last one to get in the taxi/Uber for the trip home.

Submarine Commander. She moves with stealth if need be, in a bad mood she's awfully dangerous and once she hits shore for some well-earned R&R you'll barely be able to keep up with her. She's a fair but imposing leader.

Oh my goodness, so you do exist, eh? Well let’s take a good look at you, girl. Yes, splendid posture, well spoken, your mummy and daddy have money and for your 18th birthday it looks like you’re going to get that new stallion you’ve been gawking at. Good luck in the country-side!

Hetti is like the game Jemanji. Ever see the movie?
Anyway, you look at the box of the game and you think, "Okay, this looks interesting. This might keep us and kids amused for an hour or so."
And then you open the box and begin to play and your life may never be the same again, but you’re going to have to be prepared to give yourself to the process, fully.
Hetti.
What a craftswoman. She walks quietly, as if praying in a temple, and the final result is without rival. Simple as that.

Hil ary goes about her business with a precision that a Swiss watch-making company would be proud of. She cares little for what anyone says about her, be it good or bad, she knows what she wants and there it is.

Yeah I know, you wouldn't picture Hilda as a sexual deviant. We would. Hilda is an untapped volcano spring of anything you want. The fact that she constantly reminds us that she can suck a golf ball through a garden hose tells us something. Go you wonderful thing, Hilda! Love Management.

Hill is cool. She laughs at herself as well as everyone else. She's sexy in a summer dress, in fact she's pretty sexy no matter what she's wearing, and she's here to help the rest of us try and figure out how the hell we're supposed to open our presents. God knows she's spent enough time preparing everything.
Incredibly clumsy and forgetful, Hilly’s moments of greatness and great achievement arrive largely as a complete fluke. And she’s chirpy.

If Hirani was any more chilled out she'd pass as a walking zombie. Although you never see zombies smile like Hirani does. Life for this girl is a flowing river of friends and funny moments and laughter, with the odd petty tributary of family drama and tragedy that gets absorbed into the main flow along with everything else.
An Islamic form of 'ohmmmm'. Hoda, therefore, is a secret and sexy treasure. But, can you commit?

Holger is a fascinating creature with blonde hair. As a large Grizzly Bear in a past life, Holger is desperately keen to chill out and relax in this life, yet she inadvertently finds herself needing to put idiots in a headlock from time to time, just to shut them up, or, as is usually the case, to stop them from hurting themselves. Being a female bouncer has its perks though, and she has a laugh that can be heard for miles. Exceptionally bright.

With a name like a leading lady in a 1950s Jerry Lewis movie (Google him if you've never heard of him), Holiday, by her very nature, is unable or unwilling to deal with dour or morose situations or people. Light and fluffy as a bag of feathers, Holiday giggles and twirls around, and she's crashed her car several times.

Yeah, she's cute, she's funny, she's slack sometimes, she's pretty good at most things (when she puts her mind to it) and she has a fantastic smile, which belies the most important facet of her entire personality - 
Hollie is perpetually happy and happiness, glory be, is contagious.

Spurned in school by the girls for being too wonderful, she flourished in her teens when she became a model. When she tired of that she went pro with the cello and the last I heard she was about to take up a post doc at CERN.
Languid and delicious.
The name of any stunning Pacific Ocean tropical sunrise. That is, she is a vivid orange sun, and she is the warm still air that smells of clean ocean salt.

Often a name will generate the opposite. Take Angel for instance - she’s a fucking nightmare - but Honor doesn't suffer this fate at all. Like her name, she avoids pointless gossip, she's garrulous only when or if a person or situation requires it and she has the knack of knowing what's around the corner before she gets there. How does she do this? No one knows, but it enables her to float around obstacles. In short, people adore her and rightly so - there's plenty to love - and we're very glad she's here.
Sensitive, my arse. Hope is and will always be, The Raging Bull.
Hristina wouldn't allow her daughter to marry a man she thought was beneath her, no matter how much in love she says she was. (Hristina, lighten-up!)
Desperately stylish, Humble proves no one is just their name. Extremely self-aware, Humble deals with the shadows of the city like a cat.
Hunter spends an average of 45 minutes per day shoe shopping.

Imagine Hytal as a pristine waterfall in an untouched rain forest, who knows how to handle small arms. Her eyes are either dark brown or a deep green and her smile, depending on your predilections, will possibly break your heart.

Compassionate, fair, wholly loving and frisky in the appropriate way and with the appropriate people, Ianthe has saved the day on so many occasions it's not funny. Not that she notices, usually. She's just being Ianthe and all of us are very glad she is.

No, Ilan doesn't begin a project lightly. She's thought about it, considered the pros and cons of both success and failure, while understanding that change is an inevitable part of the journey. If she's not already, we anticipate every success for this girl. Indeed, we up here in the commentary box have been talking about her lately and what we want to see more of this season is some pure, unadulterated, impulsive irresponsibility.

Ilani's soul is infused with a rich vein of calm compassion for her fellow man. She takes a long time to get over people and/or moments that are hurtful but she always recovers to a position of being glad it happened. As a very gifted, if not hidden, artist, we up here in the commentary box have strung out some Tibetan prayer flags and said a few short words each in the hope that she turns up for this afternoon's game.

Ilde can look at a situation, speak to one witness, taste the wind with an eye of skepticism and then accurately describe the whole event. She’d make a fine detective and a wonderful hooker, both occupations for which no one would suspect her, of her, which is why she’d be grand at either. You got all that?

Ilena's walk-in wardrobe looks like someone has set-off a small bomb. If she gets up to visit the loo in the middle of the night you can be guaranteed that, if she doesn't turn the lights on, you're going to hear her curse after standing on an unseen upturned stiletto. We've talked about it here in the commentary box and we're amazed she manages to get to the ground on time, which she always does. Stranger than that, she can actually play the game.
Ilene catches crocodiles for a living.

No, we wouldn't call her unadventurous either. Iliana's previous lives have all centred around positions of power and prestige. Here in this life she's still got the ego and all that, but she's about having a lot more silly fun. Sure, in eons gone by she sent many-a-peasant to their death but we all live and learn. This girl loves to travel, she loves exotic men/partners and she rarely steps out of the house looking like an unmade bed.

Sure, she's a loner sometimes but only because she's way more intelligent than everyone else, and what's the point of hanging around with idiots when you're striving to make a difference in the scientific world? All they'll do is drag you down. But, don't forget that this great intelligence makes her very funny.
Prominent, calm and delightful.
Bouncy, irreverent and funny, Imby is a distant cousin of Nina, and the name given to the act of base-jumping from a very tall cliff, having just been told an excellent joke immediately beforehand.
Cute and mysterious, no one is sure if Imelda is the consummate actress or if this is just how she is. The only certainty is that she is affiliated with the artistic world, someway, somehow.
Imogen has multiple orgasms nearly every day and therefore always looks like she’s about to have another one. Nice work if you can get it.
Nothing wrong with a strategic nipple-flash, she’ll tell you. Yes, she’s savvy and smart but, and I quote, “I have the looks, so why not?”
A very bright and busy girl. Too busy to talk to us, though. (She currently aspires to work for Wiki-leaks.)

You know, mum and dad, it's 2019...maybe even 2020 or 2022 by the time you get to read this, and you do know the Incas were basically wiped out in the 16th Century? Are you aware of that?

Hang on, did you also consider Inuit as a name? What about Mongol? Or Zulu? (Actually, that's not a bad one). Anyway, the point is, Inca is probably not related to the Incas, unless you conceived her inside an ancient Mexican temple. Did you? No? Okay, well, here we are. Inca is a gentle soul, never in-your-face, and we sincerely hope she doesn't become a social worker. Don't worry, it's a noble profession and we need them, but Inca has a brain and we hope she ends up operating at the other end of the social spectrum where she forges new philosophies and/or technologies which look forward, not mopping up after those who were dealt a dodgy hand.  Inca? Thoughts? Prognostications?...

Carried aloft by her seven Egyptian slaves who cater to her every whim, Inda floats around with an air of devilish intent that beguiles all those who are lucky enough to get close to her. She doesn’t intend to, but somehow she manages to walk the red carpet, even when doing something as banal as brushing her teeth.
Monty Python would have loved her because her name is woody, luscious, mysterious and inviting. And so she is....
Well, I suppose it’s a far sexier name than Northern Ireland, but who’s to say? In any case, and despite her parents’ best intentions, India is just a normal girl living a normal life.
Honey, don't be scared to scream your head off if you feel like it. True, society frowns upon such things, but that's exactly WHY you should. You with me? Bust out baby!
Sexy and shy.
See Indi.

Shy at first, Indigo assumes an extremely oblique approach to the universe and any kind of standard job, therefore, isn't any of her business. She's far too spiritual for that. She meditates daily and breathes slowly and deeply anyway, the immediate result being that her decisions often take a while to arrive. The universe doesn't just offer up solutions straight away, you know. Sometimes you have to wait. But, she knows that whatever the decision is, it will be the right one.

Her name folds over on itself like a thick, wood-fired pizza dough made by a meastro in his or her field. Indira concerns herself with the rights and wrongs of the world, and of her friends. Some people don't have time for irreverent, silly fun and that's okay. Some niches are more important and carry more weight than others. Indira.

Indra acts as a mainstay for her friends. She's reliable and honest and trustworthy, and she's becoming weary of being the constant shoulder for some of her peers who keep making the same mistakes with men, work and everything else, over and over and over again.

She makes an excellent captain and a fearless leader. She spots idiots in an instant and she orgasms easily and loudly if the situation permits. She's never broke and the idea of cooking all day is enough to maker her want to kill her partner/anybody.
Inez makes an excellent private investigator. She's abit odd, but then again so are the people who have employed her, usually.

Be careful what you wish for, girl. And just take it easy, eh?
Management.

Go on a date with Inga and you better be prepared. You might end up married, you might end up being chased by a bloody lion that escaped from the zoo - via one of these hilarious and ridiculous feats of coincidence that seem to happen to Inga all the time - and then again you might end up head over heels in love with three kids. You never know with this one but what a ride!

Another realist. Inge gives her all but as an older soul who knows the rules, she understands that extreme exertion, in whatever form that is, will only get her so far before the hands of luck and karma step in for the final say.
Inger used to hunt in Africa, professionally. Thankfully she saw the light and now she leads tourists with cameras. She's quite tough, you know.

Pragmatic and European, usually, Ingrid is also the name of a plate of short bread biscuits that are slightly burnt. You look at them, expecting them to do something, but nothing happens. They just sit there. (ie. here’s another woman who could do with a bit more ME time and a few less chores.)

In a myriad of ways, Iona is a complete mystery. In the middle of her name is a really cool little alley-way, and inside it are all kinds of intellectual, sensual and utterly playful scenarios. It's hard to explain, truth be known, but do you know what I mean?...

Is she Norwegian? Perhaps, like our friend Prue, she hails from another planet altogether? Who knows? Either way, she's here as a conduit for peace, love and creative greatness, which she encourages in others. She doesn’t even mean to do it.
Ira favours her dog over her husband and her children.
The PhD student. What’s she studying? No idea, but she scurries about the hallways of academia with a determined look on her face, as if the secrets to the universe are almost within her grasp....

‘Irene’ is what you say when one of the wings of the plane that you’re travelling on suddenly shears off. You then yell out ‘Irene’ as a blood-curdling scream that lasts for two full minutes until the end.

Like a hippopotamus wallowing in a water hole, Iris is intelligent, thoughtful, utterly confident of her position in the world, and she enjoys hysterical fun only when the time is right. Then she will be the one.
A great Clydesdale horse that remains unbothered by any din in her midst.
Forgetful.

Motherly and gentle, Isabel struggles with firing people. Indeed, being the boss isn't a position that sits well with her. Giving bad news is such a shocking prospect for her that, rather than have to tell someone they need to be let go, she'd prefer to go on holiday and not think about it at all. Is this the equivalent of sticking your head in a bucket of sand? Well, yes, I suppose it is but, on the flip side, she always, always puts other peoples' needs before her own. How many people you know do that?

Winter time in Venice and Isabella walks through Piazza San Marco wrapped in a plush black coat, followed by the eyes of one hundred Italian men who know a gorgeous and self-confident woman when they see one. Absolutely.

Buxom and over-the-top, I don't think so. Isabelle is a thoughtful lass who considers her actions before they happen. She absorbs information easily and stores it for a very long time, if need be. Educated and healthy, she knows how to recycle and she's after a man who is respectable and polite, with friendly eyes and a warm smile.

Ishka is a lover not a fighter, and the connection with the earth and Mother Nature is what is important here. She spent weeks living in a Mongolian ger until she tired of the yak milk, then she spent a year at an ashram in India where she got to meet the Dalai Lama. She has more bracelets than god, a hundred little feathery things in her hair and adorning her clothes, and at the forest doofs she is literally famous.

God of love - not quite. More like the God of Love Me, and I Don't Care What Happens So Long As I Get What I Want.
Question: Is the spoilt?
Answer: Is the Pope Catholic?

Rarely given to life's drudgeries, Isla is a harmonious soul who leans ever-so-gently in the direction of the future. By nature therefore she is optimistic and caring, sexy and fun-loving. Her name is often used by Buddhist monks as a mantra which induces calm although male monks can be easily distracted by her good looks. For as the French attest, Isla is tres sexy.

Isobel secretly wishes she was a dolphin where badness, hard drudgery and nasty people don't theoretically exist. If she attends mass on Sundays, then you can expect to see her at the pub Sunday arvo trying to unstraighten herself.

Isobelle never rules with an iron fist. Indeed, Isobelle would prefer someone else do the ruling, whether they are hard task-masters or not. As a gentle and friendly soul she doesn't belong anywhere near the corporate world and she avoids the television news which only serves to bring her down. She is a loving and attentive friend and teachers have always adored her pleasant demeanour and her good behaviour.

For kicks, Issy gets in her tinny, motors about 5 miles off shore, attaches herself to the boat with a rope after she dons her wetsuit, fins and goggles, then leaps over the side with her speargun. For the next three hours she'll duck-dive to around 30 metres and just relax for 3 or 4 minutes at a time, waiting for something big to show up. The bigger the better. She's fended off more sharks than you've had hot dinners. Issy.
I am. She is. You can. We are. You should, because life passes faster than you think…

Ivana  makes no apologies and why should she? She is a scrumptious broad with flamboyant hair, mannerisms and fingernails. Like a well-bred wine she only gets better and hornier with age. If you can’t handle her, nick off.
The Guillotine.

Ivy moves through her life like a wonderully happy and content plodding mammoth. You can't really see the smile but you know it's there, she quite likes the journey despite the deep rumblings that you might hear and her instinctive radar about where she's going and who she's dealing with work very well. Ivy.
Izzy lives quite a neat little double life: As a daytime job she is one of the Army’s most gifted snipers and when she’s on leave she does pretty well on the stand-up comedy circuit.
Fleet of foot, except she's very aware of every step. I wonder if, in a past life, she wasn't an energetic mountain goat?

Stable and well-oiled like a a big old wooden doorway of a grand old house that's been looked after, Jacinda hangs in the wings expecting mostly fun, love and happiness to be her company for the day and/or evening. And she's patient. And if no one looks like they're going fix things then she'll begrudgingly take up the mantle herself.

Jacinta needs a bit more pizazz in her life. How does one accomplish this? Right, well firstly, we want to see some hard, gut-busting exercise because when you feel energised and throbbing with life, wonderful and unpredictable things are more likely to happen. So forget the notion of attending pottery class, or some such thing Jacinta. Fuck that. Why not a nude drawing class? Imagine that? You get fit and for kicks you go and pose nude in front of a bunch of strangers? In fact, don’t get fit, just do it! Maybe spend some money is a sex shop? Why not? Whats wrong with more unadulterated pleasure in your life?
The point is, and it applies to everyone actually, try something new and scary and suddenly light and fresh air will blast into your soul and it will be the beginning of something.
What do you think Jacinta?…
Jack is often so busy, on her way to somewhere else, that she rarely has enough time to tell you what she’s up to or where she’s headed. Like her sister below, however, she is outstanding value.

Like all Becs, Jackie doesn’t fuck around and she’s probably more streetwise that anyone. She never seems to have time for overly romantic exploits but she’s a sexy and sensual woman, if not in body then definitely in spirit.
The name of an intercontinental ballistic missile that was fired in the enemies direction but has always had gyroscope problems, and now looks like it's headed this way. Good one!

An army tank in a past life, Jaclyn tends to bulldoze her way through problems as a means to overcome them. Why talk when you can just run over something, is what she'll tell you. We're not sure, but we suspect she's the record holder for the number of times she’s tossed wine in the face of a disrespecting man. And rightly so, funny thing is, some of them weren't even being disrespectful. They were just being a little intimidated and clumsy in the face of a girl they liked, and they happened to get her on an off day. Know what I mean?
The name of a sexy pin stripe business suit for a very capable, sensual woman.
Hardcore.
It almost goes without saying that Jacqui is beautiful and wild, but for fuck sake don’t ever get on her bad side.

As subtle as a clay jug crunched into the side of your head, Jacquie is nothing if not transparent. Her energy leaves many of us exasperated and that’s just the way we (and she) loves it. She never sits still long enough to have any idea what the word ‘boredom’ even means. 

The end.
Jade kind of floats around in a daze and, like Doreen, she’s disbelieving at how wonderful the universe seems to be.

Is she a little bit naive? Perhaps, but Jaida is on an early life (in reincarnational terms) which means she makes lots of mistakes and listens intently to all given advice. She certainly gives everyone their due without judgement, and there is no denying her passion for a cause that she believes in.

Like one of those North Korean rockets that you aren't sure is armed or not, Jaime arrives on the scene with huge aura of unpredictability. Will she explode right there on the launch pad? Will she sail harmlessly out over the sea and crash into the Pacific somewhere? Will she in fact make a bee-line for Tokyo and detontate a 20 kiloton nuclear device above a city of 20 million people and kill everyone? Maybe she's full of little love-letters and isn't armed at all, other than with buckets of love? We don't know. We have no idea. Does anyone?...

Did you hear about the job interview she just went to? She didn't like the comment one of the panel gave her and so she stood up, picked up her chair and threw it out the window. It landed on the bonnet of a police car where two cops were innocently eating their lunch. That was the last any of us have heard from her. If you see her can you tell her she got the job? They were so impressed with her passion that they want her on board immediately.
On one level she is completely innocent. On another, she has a tattoo on her arse and wheels through life with a Samurai sword that she’s spent years training with.

Jaki would make a pretty good cage fighter. She's tough, she's very bright, she's outstanding under pressure and, pain? It doesn't register with her until the fight/mission/lovers' tiff/stunt plane crash is over. If she's living, good. If she's not, well she won't worry about it because she won't be here. Funny as a dunny rat. Jaki.

Jali, a quiet piece of advice from Management: Have a crack at that thing in life that scares the shit out of you. It’s where greatness lies and where you really learn what you’re capable of. Even if you fail, the rewards are amazing. Let us know how you go…

Jalina is the kind of girl who, in her job interview, comes across as being fastidious and rigorous, and capable of solving any myriad of problem. And she's a nice girl, don't you worry about that. But, when it all comes down to it, she gets side-tracked very easily and, because she's an optimist, she always seems to have a million projects that aren't quite finished. Know what I mean? Great lady though, and there's no way you'd sack her.

Gullible and funny, Jamaica has a very difficult time looking serious. On one hand this is a blessing - she has plenty of friends and a busy, invigorating social life - but people at job interviews find it difficult to believe that she seriously wants the position. I hope her parents, as odd as they are, are able to leave her a nicely sized inheritance. Jamaica, how about art school? That might be your ticket.

Yes, there was a Boy Named Sue and there is, let me tell you, a Girl Named James, and she's bloody lovely. And cute. And she's got a tattoo on her arse like her long lost cousin (Jaimie) because she's a woman all right, and she'll tell you what's what. And because every day she flummoxes people with her name, she's got a lightning quick wit and she can deal with change/adversity as well as anyone. Not bad eh?
Jamie is cut from the same chunk of marble as her sister (Jaimie) but she has a greater capacity to unravel in comparatively straightforward situations.
Jamie-Lee is a fire ball. Pure and simple.

Surprisingly persistent and partially tomboy-ish, Jamieson cant be dissuaded of something if she believes in it, and rightly so. She likes nice wine and educated men, although there was a patch there in her teens where she was the textbook rebel/nightmare. Her parents quite feared for her at one stage, but she blew out of that like a pro-surfer being blown out of the barrel of his or her life. Adored by those who know her well.

Travel agent. She can organise nine different itineraries at once while simultaneously holding two other conversations with a bunch of annoying American tourists, who aren’t even purchasing any tickets to anywhere. (She knows that before they do.) But, she rarely loses her cool and on the weekend she coaches netball.
You’ll need a workman’s helmet if you intend to try and get close to her because Jana is a smooth concrete wall. (She once fell over on a building site and killed a guy, that’s all.)
As a product of the modern generation Janaya is only usually concerned with how attractive and likeable she is, and she has no idea what real work is about. But don’t worry. She’ll get there.

Welcome to one of the Enigmas. You might think that Jane rhymes with ‘Yes, done and finished,’ but you’d be wrong and the Plain Jane rumours are basically a load of shit. The entire word curls over in your head, and in your mouth as you say it, but the secret to Jane is to understand that it doesn’t just curl over and finish, because it’s a circle which keeps on going. What the hell are we talking about, you ask? In simple terms, and there’s not much which is simple about this girl, what you see is not who she is. Metaphorically, Jane is like that dedicated, insightful Lieutenant who is more well-informed, savvier and way wiser than the General above her who is making all the decisions, and Jane is not the only person in the Kingdom to suffer this fate. It’s why she looks a little frustrated, sometimes, and you can’t blame her. You want our advice Jane?….get out of the army and go start somewhere afresh where you’re either appreciated or in charge, and find yourself a lover who will randomly pull your trousers down and kiss your buttocks more than they do! Amen.

Janelle is name given to the phenomenon of dropping a full  carton of milk onto the floor that ruptures badly, whereupon it covers the entire area in a sticky mess that takes three separate mopping events to clean up. And what does this mean? Janelle works hard, more than most, and for whatever reason she doesn't seem to ever have anywhere near enough time to simply have fun and to be silly. Can someone help this lass out please? She's helped enough and she deserves a mountain of fun.

The tenacious ex-girl guide who, despite her best intentions, attracts peculiar events which many might deduce as being unlucky. I mean, yes, if a bus suddenly appears from nowhere and crashes through a puddle of water on the road in front of you, you’re probably liable to get angry. But honestly, why? It’s just water. Janet knows this, just as she understands that all events in life immediately become memories after they happen. The weirder things that happen to you (presuming no one is hurt or offended) the better. Her sense of humour is therefore a gift many people could learn from. 
Thank you Janet.

"You can kiss me but just don’t spell my name wrong!"
For a long time Janette considered getting this tattooed across her arse cheeks. She didn’t in the end. But the moral to the story is true: she’s a staunch competitor and what she lacks in talent she makes up for with a splendid work ethic and a disciplined training regime. We love her up in the commentary box because something always happens when she’s out on the field.

Yes it's true that we were once concerned if she was alive or not but Janice has made a grand recovery. The crew up here in the box have been talking about her inclusion in the team all morning and they’re excited. Rarely do we see a player covered in more mud, so much so that sometimes we can barely see the number on her back, which makes her difficult to call sometimes, but you can't miss the hair. She fights hard for her team, never slacking off an inch, and her cries of exertion can be heard all around the stadium. We think she’ll do quite well today. And look at that! For the first time she's leading the team onto the arena. How wonderful! It’s about time her skills were recognised.

After backing your car into a telephone pole, she opens the door and hops out, shrugs her shoulders at you and smiles. “Oh well, sorry about that, but it’s just a car.”  And she’s right – it is just a car. The strange truth of the matter is that, of all the people you’d like to crash your car, Janie is the one. She is a happy soul with a rare smile and she’s therefore hard to say no to. In the annuls of the universe, therefore, you might as well give her your keys and ask her to crash it again. It’ll probably be funny.

Rarely downtrodden for very long, Janina will somehow always find a way to get the upper hand. I suppose you could say she's tenacious, and she is, but she's no idiot. As well, her dress sense can be a fascinating kaleidoscope on occasion, but it just adds to the energetic theme. In her younger day she hunted many-a-young-fellow with poise and style, always gauging the right time when to corner her prey. In a nutshell, she acts first and asks questions later. Amen.

Okay, so once upon a time we described Janine as being a flat tyre but I think it’s time to fess-up. The fact of the matter is that Janines stopped being produced about 40 years ago because our manufacturing industry got sent offshore, and this is a tragedy. You see, the problem with the world today is that everyone wants a quick fix. Very few people can commit to long periods of hard work and even less are prepared to sacrifice their own happiness for the sake of helping others. Janine has this capacity and soon enough she will be extinct, along with all the Carols, the Roberts, the Brians and the Lynns. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg. And then we’ll be fucked, won’t we? So, no, Janine isn’t flashy but she’s real and she’s listening, so stuff that in your Facebook feed and smoke it. 
Thank you Janine. x

The Christmas Cake. Patient, lovely once you open her and always worth it, Janis doesn't get out anywhere near as much as she (and we) would like. Why is that? To be quite honest, up here in the commentary box we think it fitting to celebrate Christmas on the first of every month. Imagine how happy everyone would be? And imagine how often we'd get to see Janis in full flight, not stuck away in the bloody cupboard!

Another country lass married to a country man. She lives in a country house with their country dogs and their country chickens, maybe even a few country sheep. Janita can mend a fence, milk a cow, drive a tractor and shoot crows.
“Dya need a hand, Cyril?” she asks her husband.
“.....aaah, yep,” he says, again. Etc etc

Yeah, well, we all love a bit of serenity in our lives don't we? Just a little time out to re-evaluate what we're up to; Perhaps get away from the screaming hordes with a good book?; Maybe a nice afternoon walk in the forest? Well Janna says she'd like to do some of these things, and she occasionally even makes plans to get away from her nutty friends and family for a bit, but she never seems to actually do it. There's always some unforseen disaster that needs her attention. Sure, she says the constant noise and cafuffle are a pain, but do we believe her? She's be screwed without her phone, for one thing, so maybe that's the key, just for 48hrs?

Jannetta hasn’t got time to answer your questions about how to exactly spell her name because she moves too quickly to take the time to stop and tell you. 
Reactive? A little bit. 
Funny? Usually. 
Sexy? When she remembers what that’s all about, you bet. 
And busy. That’s our Jannetta. Even her kids shake their head at how busy she is.

Very bright this one.  An excellent problem/puzzle solver. In middle age she's one of the few women who will give herself a project to do just to stave off boredom. The result of which might mean that she'll be renovating her house for years on end, never actually arriving at the finish line. Complexity: she loves it.

Not entirely blessed with a long-term, measured understanding of the consequences of her actions, Jarneigh tends to jump in first and ask questions later. The world's too organised anyway, let's face it. Pretty soon they'll be taxing our need to breath oxygen, and when finally the uprising comes with spears and knives from those connected to the earth, you'll probably see Jarneigh in the leadership group, with feathers in her hair, giant silver bracelets around each bicep and riding a horse while wearing an outfit like a worrier princes. And she'll never die wondering....
Despite her initial shyness, she’s flourished into a sweet smelling, fast thinking, affable Goddess who turns a room when she’s wearing a blue dress.
Jasmyn, we up here in the commentary box suggest you head on over to Jasmyne. I know, you haven't got your own theory but we think you're brilliant. Amen.

Airy, bright, breezy, bouyant and cheerful: this are the usual qualities of Jasmyne. You wouldn't pick her as being that determined, only because the things she truly sets her heart on are rare. When she does though, you just watch - from under all that cruisy, smiley good humour will arise the steely queen.

Jasna isn't big on solitude because it means she's alone with her own thoughts, and deep down she's not really sure what she wants from life…yet! J, if in doubt, do some good, hard exercise. It'll free your mind and provide clarity. True story.

Was she conceived on the surf trip? Anyway, Java isn’t fussed what people make of her name because she’s here to make a life for herself, and maybe even a reputation. Perhaps all she needs is a healthy dose of compassion for the reactions of people (and peoples) whom she doesn’t know.
The Pick-Pocket.

Miss W.B Sarcastic Bastard, who went to Thailand years ago and got a tattoo on the back of her neck that she was told said ‘Lotus’. Turns out that it translates as ‘Crack Whore’, which she’s obviously not.
Patient. Calm. Centered.
If Jade is a brand new ladies silver Rolex watch, then Jayde is the Indonesian imitation, and from up close you’d be hard-pressed to tell the difference.
