I read somewhere recently that SILENT is an anogram of LISTEN, and that about sums up the lovely and very intelligent Jaye.

Diminutive and shy, I don’t think so. Born of hardworking parents, Jayleena plans to do none of that. We’re not sure how she’ll cope, to be honest, but I guess her friends will have access to criminal monies so perhaps the sky is the limit. A note from Management Jayleena: beware the idiot driving a loud car which he hopes will impress you. Just make sure he has a brain as well.
Shy and extremely timid - bullshit! Jayleigh likes it rough, she likes to play hard and she expects a few bumps because she enjoys delivering them.

Great friends with Raelene. Indeed, she's around at her house right now sitting alone in the kitchen. In front of her is her third whisky of the afternnoon. (Raelene is currently at the back door screaming at the kids who are creating mayhem out the back.)
Jaylo hangs out with Rebekka.
Jayma rhymes with “Can’t someone else do it?” It therefore takes a great effort for her to achieve anything and she’s a bit sick of feeling like she has to.
Friday after work, she goes out and grabs a box of beer, her fags, perhaps a little hooch, and she gets home with a smile on her face because now she's all set for the weekend.
Come on Jayne! Snap out of it! Get up! Come on! Here’s your jacket, now just ignore what those rude pricks said to you and get out there and lay down the law!

Jasmine isn’t really a follower of rules, anyway, but Jazz (and especially Jazzy, if she’s around) goes out of her way to break them, or at least to see what is possible in the universe. So long as she never decides to get breast implants she’ll be wonderful, even though everyone would still love her if she did.
The Ultimate Matriarch.

The Bush Fire. And I mean, the healthy bushfire. Yes, the creatures will be scared shitless and will flee for their lives, but she is refreshing and life-giving and don’t forget it. The forest needs her and WE need her, it's that simple.
Woah, that girl can drink. It might be the thing that gets her in the end, but you can't tell me she isn't a happy soul.
Jedda struggles with being kept indoors.

A staunch competitor. Yes, she has a sense of humour, but probably not when she's losing, although she is evolving as a human very well. Jelena is another whose aura attracts her fair share of attention, which is fine, but the boys in the commentary box want more people to make her laugh. Let us know how it goes...

Jem is fast on her feet, quick in her thoughts, wise in her actions, passionate and experimental in the kitchen and the bedroom, and all-in-all she is going places. In fact, let's face it, she’s already there. Jem
Jemaya is cute, normal and reliable, but she’s about as earth-shattering as a box of Weeties, or maybe Coco Pops. (Justin loves her.)

"Hang on, what? Can you say that again, please?"
"Sure. She's gone to visit her mate in Europe. She told me to tell you. She thinks you're an arsehole."
"Jemene, she's left me? And gone to Barcelona?"
"Yes, you idiot! What'd you think was going to happen? She wasn't going to put up with your behaviour for more than five minutes so she left. I don't blame her."
As a gorgeous ex-North American Indian squaw, Jemima is possibly the most beautiful and charismatic Tom Boy in existence.

Jemma is deceptively sensitive and thoughtful. And she can work alone. For example, on a family holiday to Tahiti recently, Jem' disappeared for an hour and a half and there was only one place she was going to be: we found her spear-fishing on her own about 300 metres from shore, out there on the reef front.

Does a more powerful, sensual and remarkable combination of letters exist in the English language?
The answer: Perhaps not.

Jeneane is one of these people that slips under the radar. You wouldn't normally think she is a sexual demon, yet she is. You may not credit her general knowledge to be enough to take the controls of this light plane, whose pilot just died of a heart attack, but it is. Equally, you might not perceive her to be sensitive enough to deal with your very private and sad situation, but she is. Indeed, right now she's the ONLY ONE you need to be talking to.

Moral to the story? Never judge Jeneane's book its cover.

Jenece has toiled hard during the game because there weren't enough players on the bench to give her a rest, so she’s looking forward to the siren going so she can take her boots off and have a drink. In summation, Jenece would have loved to have been able to be lazy over the course of her life, but who had time for that?

Yep, okay, so she's had her fair share of impediments in her life, but she always manages a way through, and she rarely gives up. As a younger lass Jeneen's first decisions may not have always been the best (eg. cars, husbands, houses etc) but she's either wisened up or she's stopped letting fools make decisions for her. Her gut reactions are always on the money and it's only now in her life that she's really beginning to relax into her skin properly.

Alright, so she isn't gracing the covers of the glamour magazines or keeping us titilated with scandalous gossip. Good! Unlike Jeneil, it seems the whole world is trying to be famous these days; desperate to be heard; aching to be lauded. What a load of bolony!
Jeneil, thank you for keeping it real and for caring for us, no matter how much we carry on.
Amen.

Jeni is actually pretty relaxed most of the time until she gets extremely stressed, at which point the only thing that will calm her down is a packet of 300 new un-sharpened pencils and a sharpener. Yep, I know what your'e thinking and, no, we have no idea why she gets off on that either.

Now listen here! Stop complaining about how your name is spelt and lift your eyes up to the horizon. Take your imagination there, as you walk. Do it. Excellent, now, kick all those fucking children out of the house when they turn 18, no matter what, and do something that you’ve always wanted to do, regardless of the consequences. (That’s right. Jenice spends too much energy on people who are too bloody lazy.)
Sexier than she thinks or knows, Jenn enjoys people and gets on well with everyone, and she is a good friend to have – on all levels – at least 89% of the time.

Jenna is a sexy girl, but one more ‘n’ in her name and you would risk falling asleep shortly after you met her. As it is, it only tends to make her a little lazy. Jenna, is that fair or not?  You can’t blame her I suppose. You hear her name and for a moment you wonder if you misheard it; “Was that Jenna, Jemma or Janna I just met?” In summation, Jenna is a party girl and we just hope she comes out the other end of this era in her life intact!

Mixed-up? Perhaps. Although only for a little while and it’s not her fault anyway. Having unreliable and crazy parents makes it difficult for anyone to lay down a solid, moral foundation, but this is Jennaya’s niche. However, if she can extricate her mind from the trivial crap in her midst, this chaos will produce a powerful, funny lady who has no qualms about taking the reins and calling a spade a spade. The fruits will arrive in adulthood a little later on, that’s all.  
As a youngster, all we urge is that she takes a second to ponder the consequences of her actions, and those of her friends’. And keep her out of the kitchen, for god’s sake.

Another stalwart of the community. Sure, she gets a bit weird about the misspelling of her name, but it’s probably a first world problem. However, when was the last time her husband tossed her onto the bed and ravished her in a moment of delightful surprise? Good bloody question…
One of the few women on Earth who always seems to carry a pen on her.

Jenneth is woken by her alarm at around 3am, because life on the land begins early. Perhaps she's off to milk the cows, maybe she needs to get some feed over to the stables, or perhaps she needs to meet the young fellas who are coming around to begin their day behind the wheel of a combine harvester? Either way, Jenneth is a hard-working, easy-smiling lady who cant imagine how city folk live. And she can't stomach a man who can't deal with engines and a welder.
High pitched nasal voice. She worries a lot.
Polite. She busies her herself with kids, the shopping, the house and she seems to look like she's thinking hard about the next chore, most of the time.

If she insists on being called Jennifer then you must say hello and, even if you don’t know any martial arts, at least pretend to make some kind of karate defence stance. If she doesn’t attack, make a hasty retreat. That’s it.

The opposite of a spendthrift, Jennifer-Penny may have European bankers as recent ancestors. If that's the case, then the edges of her material life are sealed off to prevent any leaks. It's not to say she doesn't enjoy herself within whichever aspect of the arts or of life that she loves, but outside that she'll happily wear the same pair of cruddy runners for years, and almost never see fit to replace her bed.

Is she a fire engine? Well, not quite but she could be. Jenn-Jenn is never shy and likes to keep things moving. Very bright and with a million friends, the only odd thing about Jenn-Jenn is that she'll tell you she has a mystical cross on both hands that, according to legend, makes her a healer. She certainly gives good advice so who knows, maybe she is a hidden healer?
The Community and family stalwart who is hard-working and very polite.
Maybe she smoked a heap of pot when she was younger, but Jerneen moves with all the speed and grace of a plastic bag wafting down the street.  Treachery and dishonesty are none of her business.
Jerrami rarely has a bad word for anyone. Physically active and happy, she always seems to be on the move and you will never see her in the company of morose or unsocialable people.

Jerri comes out with all guns blazing. Doesn’t matter where she is or what she’s up to. But, it’s kind of nice to know that, deep down, she’s something of a hopeless romantic. Can someone just give her a good hug once in a while? Cheers.
Jerry fights the masculine shit in her name, head-on, by being dashing, daring and exotic.

Remember that scene at the beginning of ‘The Empire Strikes Back’, when Han Solo discovers Luke out there in the snow? Luke is unconscious, injured, freezing and close to death. Han Solo makes a snap decision. The weird kangaroo-horse type animal he was riding dies of exertion and the cold, and there is nothing for it: Han gets Luke's lightsaber, cuts open the guts of the creature and despite the horrid stench, he pushes the unconscious Skywalker inside the warm body of the dead animal. The act saved Luke's life, which in turn, let's face it, saved the universe. 
Well, Han Solo was taught that move by Jes out in the bush. She’s good at this sort of stuff.
Asthmatic - who isn't these days?- but a delightful girl who walks around with a smile.
Jess may or may not be the most stunning girl in the room, but she certainly does nothing by halves.

Is she rational, many people ask? The answer is that, yes, she is, generally. What you have to remember with Jessami is that this is her first time on Earth. So, everything is new and wonderful, and almost to funny and bizarre for her to comprehend, do you know what I mean? For entertainment of an evening, don't turn on the tele' - go and hang out with Jessami. All kinds of crazy shit will happen, and not much of it wont be funny. Good luck!

Let me put it this way, if you are a scientist or philosopher from the opposing side, and the enemy grants you safe passage through their territories, offering you Jessekah as an escort, you can be assured that you will not be harmed. She will adhere to her orders to the letter and tend to your safety and needs as surely as if you were her kin. However, if you are a spy she will detect it and have you assassinated without so much as a second thought. (Note: do try to spell her name correctly.)

Well, yes, she made it through officer's training but to be honest she never quite got a handle on the nuances of being in charge of a large ship. Yep, she doesn't mind speed boats and the like, and she's good at ordering underlings around, but put her in charge of a destroyer and the first thing that would happen is that she'd probably destroy the dock by crashing into it, and this despite the warnings. We think it's because she gets distracted easily, which is a bloody dangerous situation when you're behind the helm of a 20,000 ton vessel. Out in the real, civilian world is where Jessemine belongs, where, once she knows what she's doing, she's ace. (As a wee side note, her boyfriends are fearful of arguing with her.)
Frumpy. She wails at her own birthday party when she realizes that there aren’t enough presents, of which there rarely is.

The wanna-be kitchen/interior designer. 
The End.
Jessie lives on a farm that’s had no rain for six years and she’s skilled at putting down horses with the back of an axe.

Jessy, like her twin, lives on a farm that’s had no rain for six years and, yes, she’s skilled at putting down horses with the back of an axe. In fact, axe, log, truck, stick, fist - she has loads of initiative.
Her family hails from somewhere on the African continent and apart from being born with natural rhythm, all we know is that she has an amazing smile that will lead her on quite an unexpected path.

Please tell me she’s no pushover who is aiming for nothing more than her own, personal mortgage. Let me hear great tales of the returned underdog. Regale us with stories of her traipsing across the Mongolian steppes, or forging a remote Canadian river in only bare feet because wolves ate her uggies, or perhaps fending off vultures in Africa having lain injured for 24 hrs…..go on…..tell me something like that. Don’t show me a picture of a girl in a bright coloured shirt wearing a name badge, trying to sell me a fucking telephone plan, and whose been brainwashed to within an inch of her life. 

Jewel?…
Imogen, eat your heart out.
Jill is kind of fun but she’s a bit too organised.

A weird name and a funny and unorthodox lady. We strongly suspect the rule book was tossed out with the water of the bathtub  she was born in after she arrived on Earth, that day. She's one of these people who, to amuse themselves from time to time, will walk right up to you, right inside your personal space, get their nose one inch from yours, look you in the eye and ask, "How the fuck are  ya?"
Her job, here on Earth, is to provide those around her with a different perspective. No, she's never going to be brainwashed by Western Society's behaviour walls, and thank god for that, eh?

Jilli accidentally gave her grandfather a heart attack when she was young. Bored one day, she stole a fire-cracker from the shop, back in the days when you could do such things, and stuck it under his morning chair. (Each day, of course, he'd sit out there in the sunshine and read the paper.) 
Anyway, nowadays he's happy as a peach up there in Morning Paper Heaven and he doesn't begrudge Jilli one bit.
Back here on Earth, in adulthood not much has altered, really. If Jilli is bored and near you, you need to prepare yourself for anything.

The manager of the typing pool. She rules her girls with an iron fist, and there is a rumour going around that she had something to do with the disappearance of her ex-husband. Note: There’s at least some red in her hair and the boys in the commentary box secretly adore her.

Perpetually in your face, Jina is a great ally and a Tour de Force in her own right. 
"Come on, you can do better," she says, either by words or by the examples of her actions. 
If she's scheming you'll know about it, indeed, you'll be joining-in whether you like it or not.
I can't imagine her sleeping very much.
Highly intelligent and extremely thoughtful, Jo is a sensitive, sensual woman. Once in a while she is reasonably psychotic but, generally, she’s adaptable and compassionate.

Well, yes, she's beautiful and potent, and smarter than Fergus. What you may not know is that not only did she win the country's national beauty pageant, but she's spent most of the last 20 years exploring the islands strewn across the Western Pacific in a sailing boat. And you should see her in the kitchen - even with her clothes on!

Metaphorically, Joanie regularly rappels down the faces of mountain cliffs, builds houses in order to promote her empire and divvies out goodies like they’re going out of fashion. 
(Note: If she is Kiwi, however, it’s pertinent to remember she is dangerous when out of it.)

Joanna was screamed at by her parents as a child quite a bit, so these days you can’t blame her for being off in her own little world most of the time. But it’s only made her great, because it turned her into an upright, intelligent personality. Odd at times too, but I suppose that applies to all of us at some time or another. And she has sex appeal, ladies and gentemen.

Joanne rhymes with Routine. As an accountant who lives in Mt.Isa, she made herself famous at the office last summer during that hot spell. It was 44 degrees at 2pm for two weeks straight and she wore her grey woollen skirt every single day.

Joasia is a girl who is a rushin' and in order to save time, which she is constantly short of, she therefore endeavours to combine as many chores as possible. For example, if she saw a guy she liked out in the surf, waiting for a wave, she would swim out to him from shore, free style, and go say hello. From his point of view it is a rather romantic and unusual gesture, and not one easily forgotten. Joasia, of course, is just dying for a pee and couldn't be bothered walking to the toilets.

Jocelyn was reared by foster parents after her biological parents were killed in a plane crash when she was three. However, her foster mother, jealous of Jocelyn’s intelligence and niceness, made her life a misery. She is a librarian now and, Jocelyn, it’s never too late to be anything you want, so what are you waiting for?
Jocy rhymes with Cosy, almost, and she kind of fits and hits you when you least expect it.

Feared by many and loved by many, Jode has a mean temper like her occasionally twisted sisters, below, but she’s far more relaxed. She drives fast on the road and expects others to do the same, and she’s extremely sexy, but not many people know that she can actually see the aura of individuals when she puts her mind to it. Jode is an incredible woman.
Jodi, darlin', we suggest you suck it up and go on over to Jodie. It's all good.

Similar to a gorgeous looking feral cat, if you corner her or piss her off there is a fair chance you won’t live to tell the tale. But, feed her well, stay out of her way if she’s in a bad mood and mind what you say in her presence, and you’ll be fine.

You should see the amount of food she throws out every week. We heard recently that the world wastes 50% of all food produced and Jodie-Anne contributes more than her fair share. Moral to the story: Jodie-Anne, stay focussed and plan to fully finish!
See Jodie, except that she is slightly calmer.
Surprisingly doleful.

It's a hell of a clan, isn't it - the Jodie/Jodi/Jody clan, that is. Joedi is another one. Here again, if you meet her we'd advise being very careful not to spell her name wrong, but honestly why they put an 'e' in there is anyone's guess. Be that as it may Joedi is tenacious, she's funny, she'll tell you when she's pissed-off/horny/hungry or happy, but usually she won't need to say anything. She doesn't plan too far ahead and she never forgets a fuckwit. So, you got all that? Good luck!

Brash. Relaxed. Super-smart. Joelene is all of these things and more. Finding beauty in the small things and chilling out about the large dramas are some of her skills. Okay, we admit, there have been a few anger issues in the past but she's over all that now. And there she goes, off into the sunset on her horse leaving a trail of dust. Who knows where she's headed? Did she tell anyone where she's going? ...No? Oh well, hopefully we'll see her again.

I'm not quite sure how she does it. If Joellen does something  as banal as drive down the street for juice and perhaps some eggs, even if she's on her own she'll kind of blast and rumble her way in the front door of the grocery store such that everyone's attention inside will be gripped by her arrival. For half a second they will think that she has an entourage of three or four people. This happens everywhere she goes.
The cheeky life of a cheeky party and/or swingers’ gathering.

As a lioness in a past life, Johanna enjoys nothing more than lounging around the house in the nude and sleeping as much as possible. Having done all her killing eons ago, these days she’s a sensitive soul with a soft name, and she is much better suited to lazy life on the French Riviera.

“Oh dear oh dear,” the match referee says to himself as Johllene struts onto the court. Yes, she's a wonderful player to watch and very melodramatic. While it's nigh on impossible to cheat these days, given the number of cameras focussed on the contest, he knows full-well that Johllene will undoubtedly bamboozle both her opponent and him (possibly even the crowd) with some half-baked decoy show that will confuse everybody. Is that cheating? Well, some might say yes it is, but this is entertainment after all. And that's why we're here, so, he takes a breath and the game begins...

Men want her. Women want to be like her. She works for either an ad agency or a publishing house and she’s good at what she does. Not really belonging in the fast lane, Johnno seems well-suited to a life by the beach whether she swims much or not.

Joi gives birth to many ideas and most of them are taken up with abject enthusiasm because, one, they are well thought out, two, they aim to make life better and more fun, and, three, they are nearly always fair and equitable. Sounds heavy. It isn't. Joi is here for a good time, exploring the world and herself as much as she can, while at the same time doing good. Joi is a gem.

Not really flowing like a river through a serene and quiet valley, more like a raft full of sexy and horny backpackers blasting their way over rapids on the Zambezi River with the expectation of a near-death experience today, followed by copious amounts of alcohol/recreational drugs or fornication tonight. This is our JoJo. She’s a bloody gem, not to mention highly intelligent although you’d never know it, only because she doesn’t flaunt it.

If Jolanda says she's going to do something, then she will do it, never flinching at what the consequences are. As a smart and loyal individual, she also only throws her affections at people that she feels are solid in both temperament and trust. Very passionate, Jolanda milks moments for their best parts and we could do worse that have her represent us at the UN. And she has wonderful long legs.

Jolene was born to move. If she were a gymnist who tosses of those ribbons into the air while performing amazing feats, for example, she could perform her routine and not miss a beat while at the same time hold a completely normal conversation with you as  you stand on the sideline. The fact that she is also quite beautiful doesn't effect her life one way or the other.

Great traveller and a cool chicken, all round. Jolie is the kind of girl, who, if walking a mountain trail with three guys she met at the backpackers, and who she trusted on sight in lieu of her radar being splendid, would react first when the group stumbles upon a 20 metre waterfall. "Right, well I'll see you guys in the water," she says, without hesitation. Then, BANG!, over she goes.....!

Hooly dooly! Where do you start and where do you finish? No, Joni doesn't sit around waiting for life to come to her, don't you worry about that. In her younger years she even gave Lucy a run for her money in terms of some of the fun she got into around the place. Heavens to Betsy! Luckily, she hasn't really slackened off. She's here to help, she laughs deeply and infectiously and, by God, if she's in a foul mood then run for the hills kids.
Jonika seems to relish confrontations and she’s definitely good to have around when difficult projects need to be finished-up.

Jooles is the kind of girl who attracts ridiculous and hilarious moments of coincidence. For example, the last time she had hiccups she accidentally swallowed a fly, which sent her into cataclysmic fits of vomitting, which is tough to do when you're still trying to hiccup. This is Jooles for you. But she can laugh about her misadventures as much as anyone.

Baby, yes, your looks may get you quite some way but there's more to it than that. You don't need your friends around you always, so, stand up straight, take responsibility for your actions, as well as a big breath, and step towards where you want to go. Only you can do it and it'll be worth it!

Like Flick before her, Jordana is deeply attracted to anything shiny -  eg. big black men with bright teeth, neon lights, jewellery shops and just about anything that sparkles. Her grand plan in life, therefore, is to live in Las Vegas and work as a knife-wielding flame-thrower.

Why does she always need that final little leg up, right at the end of a project? It's a mind trick she's playing with herself, you understand. Deep down, Jorja is just as confident and capable as anyone. She just forgets sometimes, that's all. In fact, if you know her, the next time she starts complaining that the piece won't fit, or she's too tired to make it to the top, or the wetsuit is too tight (even though she's worn it many times before), don't pander to her. Give her some friendly abuse. In fact, if she's half in that wetsuit when she starts whinging, push her over because sometimes a cushy response does no one any good at all.
Her parents collect grass as a hobby so, Jorji, do like a few others in the Kingdom have done and leave home ASAP! (Jorji, herself, is a spiffing young lass who has time for everyone.)
Impulsive. We think it's because she wants to get people to REMEMBER HOW TO SPELL HER NAME!

Josceline was also reared by foster parents after her biological parents were killed in a plane crash when she was three. And yes, her foster mother, jealous of her intelligence and niceness, made her life a misery. She is a librarian now and, J, it’s never too late to be anything you want, so what are you waiting for?

She's been told a million times of course, but in the end her commanders gave up. Especially as she does her job better than anyone. She's in the artillery. Her job, once the cannon shell is placed into the barrel, is to run around the front and get her big stick thing, shove it down the end of the barrel and push the shell back into the chamber as far as it will go, jump out of the way and scream, "FIRE!". 
What her superiors find distracting is that she refuses to go into battle wearing anything other than a bikini. Yes, we know, she's receives the odd cordite burn but that doesn't bother her. "If we're going to be blowing people up," she says, "we might as well look as sexy as we can."
You can’t argue against logic like that. (And you should see her on the dance floor.)
Josephina is a border-line saint. Had Sleeping Beauty been drawn with blonde hair instead of black, this would have been her name.
A beautiful romantic who is often let down by the men in her life. In short, she’s the perfect wine glass waiting for the perfect wine.

Josie is very lucky, although you do create your own, so they say, because she is lovingly in touch with her kismet. And what choice do any of us have? (Josie, have you thought about giving lectures on the topic?)

Joss owns a pair of hiking boots that have trekked across the Andes, through Nepal, and currently are taking her up Cradle Mountain in Tasmania. She lights a mean campfire, struggles with the bullshit in the real world and almost never wears make-up, deodorant or perfume. Joss, we salute you.

No time to waste here folks. If you go around to her house don’t expect to just sit around and watch the TV, no sir. If you’re lucky you’ll get to go on a hike somewhere, you might get to have a snorkel in the sea, or maybe you’ll get to spin the centrifuge she made which enables her to collect all the honey from her hive. Josy is just bloody splendid. The End.

Mmm, we watched her game last week from up in the commentary box and we're concerned she's not putting in enough effort. You can't sit back and just expect the ball to come to you Jourdan. Sure, some days it happens like that and you've been lucky in the past, but you need to work on your fitness, both physical and mental. You've got the raw talent, we've seen it, what we want is just a little more application. Good luck!
Professional arsonist. So, bloody well STAND BACK!!
An old fashion version of Ally. She loves drinking a nice whisky with her grandchildren, and we hope that in the modern era she doesn’t become extinct.
The wonderful rehab counselor.

The Stalwart. She’s past middle age nowadays and more relaxed with herself and the state of the world, but she still possesses a load of spunk. Joyce will tell you what’s wrong with you without the slightest compunction and then give you a kiss on the cheek, afterwards, to remind you that she still loves you. And she does. And that’s what matters.
Like Cassandra, Jozica is happiest when she's naked on her horse. Unlike Cassandra, however, Jozica is more into riding naked through forests while groups of young boys try to run after her.

Juanita has the personality and demeanour of an old pot being clanged repeatedly by an enthusiastic six year old wielding a metal ladle, and who is helping his or her mother, father or guardian concoct dinner.
Jude works at the pub where she pulls a mean beer. Laughs a lot. Fights hard.

Never judge a book by it’s cover ladies and gentlemen: this is what Judi reminds us. She’s the kind of soul, who, as a young adventurer, would happily agree to get paid to swim around underwater topless, in a swimming pool, which actually formed the wall of an expensive Japanese nightclub. And on land she probably talks to the animals, not that you’d ever hear about it. In short, Judi lives well and her rather inspirational life is totally experiential.
“Oh, Judith!” you cry, after the shit of a pigeon lands in your hair. Soon, though, you remember that it is good luck and you smile.
Yeah, Judy is great. Just be careful because she carries a concealed weapon most of the time. It’s all good, but just be careful.
Juju will only attend a show or some kind of staged performance if it is promised that all or any male cast members take all their clothes off at the end of it.
Jules is cool and all you have to do is look at her close female friends to understand why; Jackie, Stef, Bec, Janie, Nat and Libs. That says it all.
Like a loud and busy kitchen after someone has just dropped a stack of plates, Julia is as fun to be with as she is all over the shop.
The PA who could do a better job than the CEO she works for.

Would she plunge all her money into a hot tip from someone working at the stock market?
No - she's not that impulsive.
Would she make a bee-line for the delicious man she spies across a crowded room?
No - she's not that outgoing.
Would she compose herself at the freshly-happened car crash, take a few deep breaths and begin pointing, bandaging and delegating?
Damn right she would - and she'd save lives in the process.

Julie is lovely, but once in a while, at least, Julie rhymes with It’s Nice To See You But I’m A Little Flustered, it rhymes with I’m Happy And I’m Sorry I’m Late, and occasionally it rhymes with Life’s Okay But I Think I Married The Wrong Man. Disregarding all of that, remember that Julie is a decent, compassionate person and we up here in the commentary box are grateful she’s on the team list. And if she decides to ditch any useless men then she’s got our blessing. Amen.

If Julie-Ann says she wants to help what she's actually saying is that she is taking over. We suggest you either shoot her or hand over the reigns completely. There is simply no middle ground with Julie-Ann. And don't worry, she'll do a good job. (She might also spend the next year telling you about all the problems she faced.)

Like Repunzel, Juliet sits in a locked room at the top of the castle awaiting the arrival of her knight in shining armour. Not a Richard, for he cannot see the castle today, more like a knight called Dudley. Dudley the Knight? Are you out there, boy?

Rarely jaded, Juliette tends to say yes rather than no. Which means she tries things out, she has a go, she gives it a crack. Why don't more people do this? Occasionally she seems to look a little bothered or pestered, but she's not really. She's just figuring out how to do whatever it is she's about to do.

June is from the country. She used to swim in the river as a little girl and, now, as a mature and wise adult, she is a rock for everyone she knows and loves. To be honest, like Carol, she could probably use a few months away.

Like a field of sunflowers bursting into bloom in Northern France, at first, Junett is exotic and saucy and refreshing, but picnics in the French country-side, let alone anywhere else, require an organisational captain to oversee preparations.

Are the baguettes fresh?

Did you bring the bottle opener?

Have you dusted off that blanket?

Where is the olive oil - no, not that cheap shit. I want the double cold pressed virgin stuff, thanks.

And what about the basket? Is it going to fall apart?

Don't worry, Junett is all there for the fun and reverie of a delicious afternoon with friends, and she has plenty, but if you're going to do something you might as well do it to the best of your ability, otherwise it'll all end in tears.

I've no idea what her husband/partner/lovers are like, suffice to say they might need to be in excellent physical shape!

Bonjour Junett, ma cherie, et buon chance!

No, she's no cop, but she does have a hard head on her and is happy to make the tough decisions. In fact, if anything, her name has led her down the path of subtle leadership. And if she goes off the rails, she goes off the rails at full throttle, which kind of sits with her mantra anyway:

if you're going to do something you might as well do it to the best of your ability.

She'd be good in the armed forces.

Just like a faulty submarine, Justina attempts to do her best work when she’s hidden but there isn’t much that’s subtle about her, which means secret little ventures always get found out. Be that as it may, criticism washes off her like it’s nothing and she’s an expressive lover.
The mortar that holds any brick wall together. Often incredibly sexy, try building a civilisation without her and it will probably fall apart. Once she makes her mind up that’s it forever.
Juzzy bought a $3000 karaoke machine and unlike J9 below, she knows how to use it. Juzzy calls it how it is and by god can she look after herself.
Pedantic and self-assured.

Kacee is at home on the farm where things make sense. Like Gus way after her, she understands the momentum of objects and the moods of animals. She's wasted in the city where people spend too much time staring at themselves.
The Javelin.
Kacie deals with things she can see and touch. Ghosts, superstitions and other paranormal phenomena are none of her business. She's not the most romantic girl in the Kingdom.

This girl understands phycial situations. That is to say, if she and a bunch of girlfriends decided to go white-water rafting and none of them had ever done it before, very quickly the guide on the boat would realise Kadey grasped the concept better than anyone else on board and therefore place her in a leadership position. (And, true, she has a great smile when it comes out, especially when she's soaking wet and barking instructions at people.)

Kadi is busy and she hasn't got time to bother if people misspell her name. Deep down she's a sensitive, romantic soul, but geez, you'd barely think that if you only recently met her. She's neither dainty or meticulous and she'll be financially independent faster than most of her peers.

No, she ain't no leafy green vegetable folks. She’s an accomplished event organiser who turns every obstacle into an opportunity. That sounds like a cliché, I know, but why sit around and sulk when you have the full function of your arms, legs and eyes? This is what she will ask you, and rightly so. She’s mobile and she’s optimistic. If we could turn her into some kind of national vaccine we'd not only save the world, but we'd make a shitload of money. Amen.

Is she the Queen of Sophistication? Well, I think a more appropriate question is, "Are you talking about me, dickhead? If you are, make it good, and if it can't be good make it funny." 
This is what Kaelene would tell you. Never full of lies, once in while full of delusion and even less is she full of shit, Kaelene is one of those girls whose presence isn't easily forgotten. She'd rather take the kids to Euro Disney than spend a couple of days on a plush river cruise on the Seine, purely because she doesn’t like sitting around doing nothing either.
Yep, she's Irish. She's also mad. She's also lovely.
Ever seen Jurrassic Park, the movie? It was a great book. Anyway, Kahli is a veloca-fucken-raptor. Did you hear me? You got a gun? Or maybe a helicopter?
Receptionist.
Picture Karen, born of Northern European parents, like Sweden or somewhere. She is therefore slightly more aloof than normal, but rollicking and independent good fun, nonetheless.
Kahri is a good-looking, elemental girl who seems to attract unstable men.

Kaia is a sensual, ambitious and well-travelled woman with a healthy view of herself. As a result of spending her life having to constantly spell her name to people, she takes no shit from anyone and she doesn’t tolerate fools.
Kaicee bites her fingernails to the quick, which means that no one ever sees the dirt and grease that she deals with daily.

Rather surprisingly, Kailee is a relatively clean-cut young lass who, in adulthood, remains forever young. Yes, she has huge stores of energy and we suspect this is the key. Keep her outdoors and keep her active: these are the instructions that are written on the box Kailee arrives in, and we suggest you, the Kailee owner, take heed. Then again, after not too long you will realise that, like an untameable horse, NO ONE every really owns a Kailee. The best you can hope for is to hold on for as long as possible and enjoy the ride. (Big honest smile. Lots of friends.)

Kaine is just a little bit dangerous and unpredictable, and it makes a welcome change. Well, unless you’re the one in a hospital bed because of Kaine crashing her motocross bike into the crowd having mis-timed a jump.

City girl. Does she over-think problems? Sometimes. Usually however she grinds her way through issues. Generally she's correct and she certainly enjoys the problem-solving process. She's quite bright, you know.
Perhaps it's the adrenalin of it, but she's one of these people that would make a great war photographer.
The name of a boomerang made out of titanium that is travelling through the air at 320 miles per hour. It's worth a fortune and we all want one, but can you catch? Do you dare even try?...

Kaiyah moves through life like one of those Tibetan prayer flags blowing in a stiff breeze. Kaiyah is her own cat, true enough, and most people wonder if she's on the right path. OF COURSE she's on the right path! So, yes, Kaiyah is here, she's there, she's disappearing for days on end with friends you've never met and she has no fear of the sea. The question of 'what will she do with her life', is something that may never be any of her business, let alone anyone else's. It's hard to say. Don't let her sit indoors for too long however.

Kalani is almost an endangered species. She’s never known any predators, she believes everyone she meets is truly good and she doesn’t eat processed food. As you might imagine, her smile fills up any space she occupies and she therefore seems to be incredibly lucky most of the time, because there are some people who the universe just adores. It’s just how it is.

Often private and peculiar, Kalaye is rarely seen in the jungle during daylight hours. Sneaking furtively from one well-shaded tree (ie. secretive house/job/lover) to another quite regularly, almost in total silence, Kalaye tends to surprise everyone all the time. A welcoming smile and a friendly nature means people are only surprised by her evermore. Know what I mean?

Never slothful or useless, Kaley is a 21st century girl with an eye on how to do things cleaner, more efficiently and with more compassion than just about any of her peers. Mature beyond her years is this girl, with a never-say-die attitude. In fact, she might even be a little bit TOO optimistic.

Kali tends to zing here, she zings there, and she struggles to say the word 'no', which means she's generally flat-out, and laughing, and travelling lots. If she's a couch potato you might need to check her out - she might be from another planet. Overall, however, Kali's laugh can be heard a mile away, she has a mountain of friends and quite a subtle eye on where she's headed. She aint no fool.

As a little girl you can always spot her in the supermarket. She's the one eating her way into that bottom shelf in the chocolate aisle, leaving a trail of foil wrappers and carnage behind her. Good luck mum!

Despite having a name like the type of motorcar that could be described as a people-mover, Kalina is a good, normal person. She won’t find a cure for HIV or malaria but she won’t deliberately pour sugar into the fuel tank of your car in order to destroy it, either.

(Pron. Kar-loor.) A unique name has produced a unique woman – sensuous, big personality, great singer/actor/sculptor/painter and the life of the party. If a doomsday festival is ever held in light of Earth’s imminent demise, her name would be on the VIP guest list.
Don't be shy, lass. Everyone else feels the same as you, deep down. So go on…..be zany! Be crazy! Light up this world with your silliest ideas, that's the key.

Like a million other girls out there, Kamen doesn't experience enough random sexy surprises in her life. And they don't even have to be sexy all the time, either. A trip to the movies? A sudden invite to a picnic on the beach? Even the silly idea of taking a bottle of wine up on the roof? Kamen is need of something, we reckon. She's done enough for the team and it's about time they remembered that. The End.

Very hard to find in the wild, Kamina hides herself into dark crannies. Sometimes she lives in the trees, other times she'll steal another creature's burrow. Is she nocturnal? We're not sure. People have been bitten by her, at least, that's the rumour, although we've never actually encountered anyone directly who that's happened to. Certainly, of the few Kaminas we've seen none of them appeared to be aggressive in any way. As a mammal however, she's very intelligent and a great climber.

Like an oil tanker with a pissed skipper, Kamisha is here, she's there, in fact, where the hell is she? Not prone to a dedicated career, she has the ability to chop and change in a moments notice. She frustrates her lovers/partners but her rather kooky sense of humour means life is rarely dull, which is a good thing.
The all-loving hippy mother who is rarely on time.

Her tolerance is questionable, but not her partying capacity. Yes, she is a gossip and she has more shoes than God, and as a single lass she wades through her male admirers like a bored farmer trying to get back to the tractor through the heard of hungry cows that think he's bringing fodder. Note: If you haven't got two pennies to rub together gents, forget it.
The Wrestler, who in reality would prefer to knife her opponent in the throat when they are on the canvas, rather than let them up when they begin to plead for mercy.

Does she spend too much time mopping up after everyone? Perhaps she's getting her comeuppance because as a young girl she was a fair-dinkum disaster area. I know, back then it was her job, but honestly! How often can a little girl set one kitchen on fire, I'm not sure. She might even hold a record for it. So, no, life ain't a straight, placid line for this one. Like a constantly rumbling volcano that you swear might erupt at any moment, Karalee forces one to prepare for every eventuality.

In a world of death, famine, war, drought, disease, suicide, mortgage payments and stubbed toes, Karen is a welcome relief because she is Ultra-Double Normal. (ie. compassionate, optimistic, occasionally very sexy and surprisingly adventurous.) Well, unless she’s the Karen of her dreams who attends kink parties and has so many men after her it isn’t funny, but these Karens aren’t seen very often in the wild.

Darlin', I know you're desperate to get over that mountian because you think that on the otherside of it is nirvana. I'm telling you, when you get there, you're still going to be Karene. So, why not stop for a second and have a cup of tea. Perhaps you've passed over the mountain already?

You couldn't knock your opponent out, but just when you think you're ahead on points and cruising to an easy victory, BANG!!!!! The mean left hook arrived from nowhere and caught you smack in the middle of the face. Next thing you know you're lying flat on the canvas seeing stars. Never underestimate the KARI !!!!

Like someone born on an astrological cusp who is pissed off about it, Karin is over having to tell people that her name is spelt differently. But, it’s made her a person not known for finessing. Good friends with Nathan.

Karina is a perennial optimist who is sporty and outdoorsy, and competitive to boot.  She’s the sort of knock-about girl who, while at the same time as expanding her reputation in the scientific world, also represents Australia in netball at the Commonwealth Games.
Karine, hear this: It’s never over ‘til it’s over. Fight the tempest within! FIGHT IT, I SAY! GRIT YOUR TEETH AND FIGHT!...GODDAMN IT!!!
Flowers - Karissa hasn't really got time for them. If some man turns up with a bunch she immediately suspects he's feeling guilty about something. Either way, it's not a good look.
Karla is a very expensive knife that is crafted in Germany. She’s probably the sharpest thing in the world so be very careful. Wet or dry, however, she is an incredibly sexy woman.

Off with the fairies when she's on her own, Karlee is occasionally bitterly disappointed what her existence in the real world means. She hates filling out all forms, for instance, and wishes we humans would be just good to each other. It's all about the 'vibe' with this girl.
Nup, she’s no redneck folks. Karleen is sanguine, she plans ahead and her radar for people, be they fools or otherwise, is spot on. Quite the sexpot, I’ll have you know.

Well, let’s just hope she’s not stuck in some kind of boring-as-bat-shit office job. Yes, no one needs to suffer this fate and God knows there are millions out there who do, but this girl would have her heart ripped out bit by bit, one day at a time. Karly, you see, is a hopeless romantic who needs to get naked in waterfalls, ride horses through forests and make love under the stars.

Karlye is one of those rather remarkable creatures who indulges her passion and, without even meaning to, becomes world-reknowned. Perhaps she's a famous violinist? Maybe she designed a fail-safe winch mechanism for ski-lifts? I wonder if she's one of those sculptors who makes pieces large enough to be seen from a kilometre away? But you get the drift - Karlye is a delicious woman with a completely unique approach to everything and everyone. If humans ever get their shit together and end up living on another planet, we should think about cloning her.

Like they didn’t call her Comeuppance eh? Or An Eye For An Eye. Anyway, the name invites her to be a wise old sage from when she was born but this is an absurd notion. Time and experience are the only things which can lead to this, and in life Karma reacted against what her parents wanted the most. She parties harder than anyone and she is fiercely independent.

Why is it millionaires never seem to carry around any cash? I've never worked it out. It may be because she only sees the big picture and, let's face it, actual money doesn't really get a look-in, at this scale.

In her early years she was no where near as chilled out as her Carol/Carole cousins, but she recovered. Karol has long since given up correcting people who misspell her name, but yes, it irks her from time to time. In life she is very smart, saucy and inventive in the bedroom and yet reasonably chilled outside it. Not built to tolerate idiots, Karol will just shake her head at a buffoon in her midst and walk away rather than get into a long involved discussion with such a person. But no second chances here kids. If you piss Karol off then you can delete her number from your phone because she's almost certainly deleted yours. And amen to that, because you're probably worth deleting.
Karolin's been a member of the Mile High Club for years. Just don't tell her kids that!

Well, she may not be the full general, but she's definitely a well-respected, determined, exceptionally brave and decorated Colonel. Don't give her fucking star signs you wankers, give her some whisky, maybe even a cigar when the race is over and won. She doesn't go in for $300 hairdos or 3-day spas, she's more into the real world: a good vegie garden; a well maintained rifle collection; perhaps even a newly installed gearbox on the 4WD. And she'll get you there all right! Just trust her.

Lentils, beans, legumes, all varieties of nuts, dried fruits, organic vegetables all those different kinds of crushed grains - these are the kinds of things that Karri wishes she ate more of, and plans to!
A proactive woman who is angered that no one can spell her name. She therefore rides abit taller in the saddle, and expects abit more from both the menu and the staff as a result. Great at bridge.
Kasey aspires to be the only female mechanic in the Ferrari Formula 1 racing team.
Kasmira has sticky fingers, and cunning ways to retrieve the assests of ex-husbands.

Wow. In a past life Kassia was a giant Maori warrior who killed more enemy tribe members than anyone. Not really prone to multi-tasking, Kassia tries to keep it simple in this life. Indeed, having dealt with life and death very pragmatically in her previous realm, these days she's a far more peace-loving soul who is never sure why she feels unfulfilled. The advice from the commentary box K: get outside, get your hands dirty and involve yourself in tasks that test you physically and mentally. You'll be bored everywhere else.

Kassie thinks those girls who strut down the catwalk are piss-poor examples of womanhood. She can't stomach men who can't wield a hammer, only because she's pretty handy with one herself, and if ever she was to go out on a date with a fellow, she quite literally wouldn't know how to deal with a man who rushed around and opened her car door for her. However, when they meet her, everyone is surprised to discover how feminine and cute Kassie looks. But, yes, under that welcoming smile is the REAL DEAL. No question.

Yes, well, once upon a time we may have described Kat as the genial Lab Technician, and that may or may not have been correct. But here’s a weird thing, and I’ll let you in on a little secret…..girls whose names begin with the letter ‘K’ are on average, give or take, obviously, the most potent group of women in the Kingdom. I’d explain that story but it’d take too long, but Kat here is something of an Enigma in that she is calm, she is placid, and she literally (subconsciously) rebels against the cat-ness in her name. You don’t believe me? I don’t care. I’m telling you, Kat is nice, she is just a nice, good person and far nicer than any of us up here giving directions. Amen.

Bogan parents means we just hope she gets the hell out. 

The End.

I’d check for rocks first, but Kate is the name of the breath you take before diving into a perfect blue sea. If it’s a good day you’ll see the rocks, no worries, and if it’s a really good day then she’ll take your breath away. No question.

Katea is highly principled and disciplined. That's not to say she doesn't possess an excellent sense of humour - she does - it's just that, like the Germans, for instance, something as banal as a fart joke isn't necessarily going to resonate with her. She's deeper than that, ladies and gentlemen.

Nothing gentle or forgettable here, folks. For the most part I'd recommend checking out Caitlin, but there's an important difference: Caitlin's trains are two big old steam clunkers where as this Katelin's are two Japanese speed trains. If you're in the driver's seat when they meet they would find nothing, but what a way to go!

Now here is a girl who doesn’t require too much external stimulation to get fired up about a project. She works diligently and with a goal in mind, but she’s not so blinkered that she flips out if an unexpected horse pokes its head in the bedroom window and takes a mouthful of precious notes while she’s writing up her Ph.D thesis. Rather than sending it off to the knackery and making a few bucks, she’d probably use the opportunity to have a go at learning to ride the creature, which is her approach to life as a whole.
Charlatans and liars are strictly a no-go area, however, even if they’re funny.

Nervously, the young man telephones Katerina to ask her on a date. Quickly she says, "Great! Love to! How about I pick you up? 8 o'clock okay?" Relieved, he agrees. When the night arrives Katerina screeches to a halt out the front of his home at 7.59. He's ecstatic but he's sweating...

Kath is one of the most down-to-earth and knockabout women in the Kingdom but luck doesn’t always run with her. The hard ‘th’ at the end of her name might act as some kind of blockage or crossroad, it’s hard to say, but know this: she is a passionate and sensitive soul, reactive too, who only wants to see good deeds done.

Katharine leans over anyone who writes her name, and so much so that she is developing a hunchback. So, Katharine, don't worry about how they spell it and stop being a pain about it. You're tougher than that so go on, get on with it!

The name of a fine leather horse stirrup that is polished and taught, and ready for the day’s parade. (ie. Katherine is organised, she has a healthy ego, she has high standards and as for party drugs, forget it!)

I know, I know, her name sounds like the horrible screech produced when you drag your fingernails across a blackboard. Thankfully no one is that painful - well, except maybe a bloke called Rocko – and Kathleen has recovered to become a worthy country girl who pulls her weight and attempts to get the job done. Amen to that Kathleen.

Her daddy drives a big fat Range Rover - one of many owned by the family because they're good at getting around horse properties. Kathrina was brought up loving horses, naturally, and she's a determined girl, no question, accepting only certain types of behaviours. It helped her win an equestrian gold medal and if she plays her cards right she'll probably win another one at the next olympics, too.

Too organised to mismanage either the companies financial records or her families, Kathryn understands that someone needs to keep their feet on the ground otherwise the whole train will end up derailing. The last thing Kathryn needs is another mess to clean up. In fact, fuck it, Kathryn we up here in the box think you deserve a fun holiday. The Cayman Islands - do you want to go? We've got a spare ticket...
You know how a Valium makes you relaxed and ambivalent about everything? (They’re excellent to take before a long bus trip). Anyway, the Kathy Pill works in exactly the opposite way.
Very attractive. Super competitive.
The Sling Shot. Handle with care, or not. No matter. Katina is here to play RIGHT NOW. And she'll play in a supremely optimistic fashion whether you want to or not, god bless her.

The German DJ who breaks hearts by just being in the room. She exudes erotic greatness and she’s generous and funny, better than that her music could change the fucking world. Did I mention her deadly smile, and how much more do you want to know?…
Well, if you're going to juggle chainsaws for a living, I'd like to see you do it and not frown!
The beautiful archer who is impossible to distract as the pressure mounts. She expects a lot from her lovers and partners and she doesn't settle for dead-beats. Why would you?

Relentless in her artistic pursuits, Katrin often doesn't care if she lives like a pauper, so long as she is being satisfied on a deeper, artistic or philosophical level. Usually it never comes to that, however. Katrin is quite direct in her dealings, whether she has a French ancestry or not, and she is considered a bitch by only those who are mentally frail, so let's ignore them. Katrin is passionate in love as she is in life and we're not sure if, over the entire course of human history, a girl called Katrin has ever arrived at the end of her life at a location which is closer than 500 km to the place of her birth. Yep, figuratively and literally, this girl was born to travel.
‘Ka-treen-Na’ rhymes with ‘Oh-God-No’.
Question: Is Katrine the worst reverse parallel parker on the planet?

Some names catapult people into a line of society that deals with nice cars, a bit of bling, good schools for the kids and no mechanical knowledge whatsoever. If an asteroid strike was to decimate the electricity grid, for instance, Kattherrine wouldn't survive for long, but then again....maybe we underestimate her? Her name is like a convoluted maze lined with plush red velvet, so perhaps she'd find a way. Yes, she's sophisticated, but the craziness of the spelling of her name has also handed her a certain serenity which enables her to not give a flying fuck about things which are out of her control. Know what I mean?

Katy is less self-assured and she takes longer to make a decision than her sister, Katie, but there's no shame in that. Most people are. Katy is a little shy around strangers, she loves animals and she's something of a home-body.
A paper cut. Not life threatening. No hospital required. It stings in the shower but, luckily, it heals quickly. (i.e - Kay can handle herself and she hasn't time for airy-fairy bullshit.)

Kaya is slightly off the ground like a hovercraft. Smooth in movement and sexy in flight, she pines for the day when she can relax in knowing what she wants in the world, and thereby afford herself the time and space to relax without some unnerving feeling that she's not doing enough with her life.
"Hard work? What?? Are you serious?...."
The Nurse, be it metaphorically or otherwise.
The scheming mastermind.
Kaylee rarely does anything without thinking of others first. She might even be a modern day Dorothy.

“Ya canna’ hand a man a granda’ spanna’....”
(ie: She’s a realist, she doesn’t talk shit and she gets on with things.)

With a name like this you might imagine that Kayleigh lives for parties and drinking and cavorting. But alas, Kayleigh is a conscience student who is aiming high. Likewise, her moral standards are not set lowly and she tends to fill her life with interesting, educated and funny people who love her company as much as she loves theirs. Many people in the Kingdom would do well to observe how she goes about her life.

Kaylene is just as happy in the slaughterhouse of a Christmas morning mulitiple-family gathering as she is in the real thing with a giant knife in her hand and about to carve up a freshly killed beast. Kaylene will roll her sleeves up and get stuck in. Simple as that.
What a bloody delight! Kaz is the perfect mix of Issy, Lorraine, Nat and Trish, and perhaps even a sprinkling of a tipsy Isabella who is wearing a red satin dress that stops just above the knees.
One of the most well-rounded & loved humans in the Kingdom. She is also one of the boys.
Dynamic, powerful and ready, Keeley ensures the pace of the race is never lost and that everybody else knows exactly where they’re going and what they’re supposed to be doing.

If confined to an office cubicle there is a fair chance Keera would be carted off to a mental asylum within a week. This girls needs the outdoors like she needs oxygen to breathe. Even then, it's the crowds that get to her. Sure, she can handle the odd music festival where crowds represent most of the fun, but even then she's looking forward to getting away from the hustle and bustle.

Yup, her dad was, and hopefully still is, a surfin' man. Perhaps her mum too. And all that chilled out salt-water vibe has carried right on down the line. As an adult Keira now runs an ashram in northern India. What a delicious swarmi she is!

Like several others in the Kingdom, Keisha doesn’t have a nasty bone in her body – it’s a beautiful thing – and for a job, therefore, you’ll find her working either for a society that protects animals, or in a Cambodian orphanage.
Keitha likes people and she therefore likes places where they gather. As you can imagine then, Keitha loves her job as The Party Planner!

Natural and earthy, Keiva attracts friends like she attracts luck. If a piece of music could be ascribed to her, imagine, if you will, a nice piano lead-in which reminds you of the time you met up with that old flame you hadn’t seen for years, and who you’ll never stop loving.

Pretty girl, lots of friends and she's no fool, but does she see the project through to the end? Maybe she needs a bit of Bruce Lee tuition - the famous Kung Fu and martial artist who once said, when you're punching at something, don't aim for the surface of it, aim for one inch behind it. And once success becomes a habit for this girl, look out!!
Is she a dedicated genius or is she just drifting along?  She’s almost incredible but.....where is the unpredictable spark? We know it’s there, but we just want to see it!

An attractive reporter from any one of the commercial television networks. She doesn’t quite understand our system of parliament, the legal world or the finer points of the financial markets but you’d never know it, and she dyes her hair strawberry blonde at least once every year.
I know, you've got an E at the end but don't worry, you're just about identical to your soul sister above, Kelli. She just happened to appear on the team list before you. Management.
Kelly is physically attractive, outgoing and funny, but she is the sort of girl who, six months after the event, insists that all of her friends come around to watch her 4 hour wedding video.

In the old pirate days, if ever a ship ran aground and needed mending on the outside of the hull as well as the inside, they'd seek Kelsey's assistance. Yes, they'd ensure there were no sharks around, but only she could stay relaxed enough to both hold her breath for a long time and operate with speed and diligence. She's quite a calm soul this one, and very determined once she's given a project she can sink her teeth into, so to speak. Boys love her.

Spicy and tasty, Kelsie is a type of sauce that performs somewhere between straight tomato sauce, HP, Worcestershire, Tobasco and Sweet Chilli. True, not many restaurants have ever heard of her, but she has a small if not very dedicated band of fans.
Kendall parties hard and works harder, and she’s fantastic under pressure.
Kendell, like her sister above, doesn't mince words, rarely wastes a minute and endeavours to fill her life with fun projects. Occasionally the moments overflow, but she deals with it.

Some people just attract controversy, don't they. Don't get us wrong, Kendelle is no hell-raiser, although this happens from time to time, but she enjoys being close to where it's happening. If she's feeling whimsical and on a walking tour of the rim of a volcano, part of her would be quite excited by the prospect of how she might die if the thing  were to erupt good and proper. (Note: don't offer her the keys late at some party or other because she might just take them, and she's rarely the designated driver.)

The 'out-there' girl who loves nothing better than a good dare. If you take her to a football game, for example, unless you want to find yourself spending hours at a police station after the game awaiting to bail her out of lockup, the last thing I'd do, after a few beers, is jokingly suggest to her that one of you should strip off and run naked across the ground.
As Pippa's distant cousin, Kennedy is a professional bull rider. And the bigger the bull the better.

Not a dainty type, Kenzie prefers it when she's out in the forest or the bush, camping.
Towing people who are bogged: she likes this.
Fending off crocodiles or bears: she loves that.
And she definitely hates being invited to weddings because it means she has to put on all that girly shit which she detests 93% of the time.

Never plump, Keoni has a ton of energy. Up here in the commentary box we've come to realise that Keoni loves playing in the mud, because then she can dive in after the ball and crash into opponents without hurting herself but hurting them. As far as we can tell all she needs to become a champion is a little bit of direction. Where's the coach?

When confronted with the grind of daily life, Keren doesn't shirk her responsibilities. However, in her guts she believes that, as a gifted artist and entertainer, it's not really her job to deal with such things. Underlings exist to deal with this kind of shit, don't they? But, she's a lovely lady with a kind smile and an excellent social awareness.

Notions of honour, justice and integrity run deeply through this lass, and like a male Spiro she might look quite serious. There’s always a trade off somewhere with Keri however, you just need to find it. Maybe she’s an avid skydiver? Perhaps she’s famous at the local BDS&M club? Maybe she sculpts?

Smart girl with a very dry sense of humour. Mam', don't spell her name wrong else you'll go straight to the bottom of her list, but she wont obsess about it...usually. Not prone to standing around being idle, Keris is proactive and not easily dissuaded from her course of action if she believes in it. She doesn't understand slap-stick comedy at all and she's never overweight.
Always chatty and full of opinions, most of which are sound, Kerri is a spritely lass who always means well. Indeed, she might be very similar to Kerrie!
A Bronze Whaler shark about 8 feet long. She looks amazing and, boy, can she move? But, Jesus H Christ, if her blood is up and you’re in the water you need to have eyes in the back of your head…

A modern & empowered woman who, if feeling frisky on a train journey, might be so bold as to secretly slip her hand into the trousers of her betrothed in broad daylight and have a midday play. Life is for living and Kerrie does plenty of that. However, it's not to say her children (and family in general) give her the shits, she just enjoys it when they leave home so she can get back to being young at heart again.

Life can be tough sometimes. Life can be difficult. Life can drag and drag like a tired old hound whose been attached to the same old chain for months.
OR
Life can be vivid, and startling, and silly, and frivolous, and saucy, and completely embarrassing. You don’t even have to wear clothes if you don’t want to.
Kerrin, we think it’s time for you to end the former chapter, relax about how the fools spell your name, and begin the latter.
As you know, we are all but players in the most ridiculous game of all.
Amen to that.
Kerry is the sensation you feel in your nose, throat and chest when you begin to chew and swallow a mothball that you mistook for a large white mint.

Kerryl is far too normal and too much of a realist to want to spend hours in front of the mirror attending her mascara.
"Get off the bloody couch and get out into the world!" is what she tells people who are needlessly complaining about their lives. Her children therefore have no choice other than to use their initiative, which is most of the battle. Nice work Kerryl.

Ever watch the TV show M*A*S*H? You have? Excellent! Well, Radar O’Reilly IS Kerry Lynnette. Fortunately, or otherwise, someone in the household has to deal with the little chores, has to inform people of their tasks, has to nag at others to clean shit up and organise themselves so the place runs smoothly. Yep, she’s over it and she probably needs a holiday, but some habits are hard to break. Suffice to say if she weren’t around the place would fall apart.

Kerryn is a great buddy to have at university. She never misses any of the lectures, which is fabulous for those that occasionally do, and she understands what is being said even when you attended, but lacked the mental capacity to phathom what the hell they were babbling on about. God bless you Kerryn!

So what if her parents fed her only meat and sweet biscuits. Better than nothing, right? Oh well, at least she's left home by now. These days Kersti-Li aspires to work at a chocolate factory. Apparently you're permitted to eat as much chocolate as you like. Most people get sick of it pretty quickly. Kersti-Li ain't 'most people', however.

The no-nonsense negotiator. She reads people as quickly as she sees the solution to most problems and she rarely has time to deal with trivial issues. The Big Picture - this is what she's good at. In that regard she always looks a little serious, but not to those who know her well. Always well groomed and attractive, she's reasonably intolerant of fools and is a passionate lover, so long as her partner behaves.

Never slack like some people, Keryn was born to complete the job. She’s one of the least ego-filled people we know and all we wish for is for her to receive many more surprise moments of oral pleasure than she currently enjoys, which is basically none.

Rather undemanding, Keshia keeps to herself and shies away from attention. It's not that she falls apart if the spotlight is shined upon her, it's just that her ego isn't the driving force in her life. She's quite introspective in that way. She's not dull, trust me, but she'd make a wonderful scientist because she can dedicate herself to a line of study, mostly because she wants to see good things happen to the planet and to the creatures that inhabit it, be they human or otherwise.

“Well, thing is officer, I admit that yes, I did spend $50 in that store with a counterfeit note. It’s true, and for that I am guilty, but as for the huge counterfeit machine in that warehouse, I have no idea whose it is. Me and some friends stumbled upon it and thought, what the hell,” Kettie says, down at the station.
The detective looks at her, and Kettie's cheeky grin leaves him with nowhere to go. He drops his head. “.....Okay,” he says. “I believe you. You can go.”
Once she’s gone he tells a couple of cops to trail her, which they do. They follow her to the airport, they watch her buy $3 million in traveller’s cheques and they watch her get on a plane to India. Nice work Kettie.

Does 'Keturah' rhyme with 'Drama'?  Well, let me just have a look. Firstly, no way would Keturah stand for being the secret mistress. Not a chance. She's the main attraction in this show kids, so if the coveted man/lover in her life isn't prepared to join the show full-bottle then they will be shown the exit door, just over there at stage left. What else?...
An office job: not bloody likely. 
Children: Mmmm, perhaps, but later rather than sooner. (There's an ego here that needs to wash off a bit before we jump into being fully responsible, but maybe it's what she needs!) 
But, in summation, she's damn cute, everyone loves her and this, ladies and gentlemen, will take her a very long way.
The Needle Point.

Another stressed copywriter blasts his way into his boss's office where he finds his boss with her feet on her desk, her long legs crossed. Before he speaks Kezia raises a hand to silence him. “Look, just fuckin' calm down and relax…..now, tell me slowly, what's the problem?"

Keziah is an inconvenience to people who don’t enjoy speaking the truth, only. You’d never see her employed at government house, for instance. She’d never get a job working for a used car dealership and can you imagine how long she’d last at a famed marketing agency?
On the other hand, she’d be a skilled oncologist (because if nothing else she likes to get to the root of the problem) and in a million years you’d never see her working in a jewellery shop. 
Keziah has a hippy name, sure, but there ain’t no $150 yoga outfits here folks. Keziah is real. 
(Note: Her parents aren’t rocket scientists however.)

The fact that the oldest and wisest souls are usually the most playful should be a nice reminder for the rest of us. Complications exist only in the mind, not here in this moment. Such is Khadija, and such is life.

Mmm, she sounds sedate, doesn't she? Well, good luck with that idea. Khali is resolute in her attack on life inside her various pursuits and, well, it's not as though she's undisciplined, she just rips things to pieces, do you know what I mean? But she's fun at the same time. She must drive her parents batty.

Khoby isn't a trail-blazer as such, but she trails about 15 metres behind them. This means that she enjoys the challenges of life, but doesn't often reap the rewards of having gone out on a limb, herself. Rarely glum.
Yeah, see Khoby, give or take, although this one isn't as sure of her decisions. And like her kindred sister, Khody doesn't spend days depressed in her room.

See Kristy. I know Khristie, you hate that but look on the bright side - you're not a shy girl and you don't live in Iran, Pakistan or Afghanistan. Have you thought about what life is like for your sisters over there?

No, she doesn't work 70 hours per week but so what? That's not her gig. BUT Khristina IS sensual and indispensable. She doesn't run the company, but she knows all the loop-holes and good drinking spots, she's a wonderful if not very subtle flirt and she seems to have more holidays than anyone else. How she does it is anyone's guess.

Another potent horse wrangler, possibly literally but definitely metaphorically. Khristy is as sexy as she is full-on, and she is a prime example of how the idea of a simple, quite life for some people is but a distant pipe dream. If she is your partner, can we suggest you do her a favour by surprising her with a wee getaway holiday. She’ll thank you forever.

You know that feeling - you arrive at the supermarket after a nice day on the beach, surfing, sunbathing or whatever, and you're contemplating what you're going to have for dinner. You stand there in the fruit n' veg section before wandering around, aimlessly, waiting for inspiration to strike. As the minutes pass you realise that you're actually quite thirsty and it's at that moment you spy the grapes. And just look at them - they're green, they're fat, they're glistening with cold condensation fresh from the heavens and, by god, you've never seen anything more delicious and refreshing in your life. Kia.

A Textbook Hipster Girl. Cute, funny, educated and with little or no clue as to how to deal with catastrophe, so long as the planet doesn't slip into another great depression Kiaan will do just fine. Lithe and lean from all that yoga.

In the trenches in world war one, commanders at the front line would give their messages to Kiah. She was always their best bet in terms of getting it back to HQ in one piece. Why? Because she moves very quickly and very stealthily under the radar. She knows all the secret passageways, she knows when to keep her head low and she knows when she has to throw caution away and run like the wind. She's make a great tactician on a racing yacht.

Rarely will you see Kiana livid at someone. As Bruce Lee once said, "Be like water". Adapt, bend, mould to your surroundings, absorb the shock, walk around the pain, slide on through the good bits and enjoy them when you can. Kiana does all this. Horses love her because she's centred.
Intense but nice; serious but not; intelligence not genius; travelled but homely; arty but sort of naive.

Far happier outdoors than in. Cities are okay for Kiarna but they probably need to be near the coast where she can get seawater on her skin at least occasionally. Work-wise it's anyone's guess, but her boyfriends, lovers and partners will need to let her go and do her thing from time to time. It's probably wise advise for all of us, actually.
See Kirra, almost, except Kiera is just that little bit more sensitive, and she shaves her legs more (but never so much as someone like, Coco, for example).

KL drips with diamonds and pearls in the same way that she drips with affection and laughter, and so it makes sense that she provides the most exquisite and beautiful food of any non-practicing chef on the planet.

Yeah yeah, she’s beautiful like a Swedish Dolphin, but forget all that. Because, these days, after having not seen her for a week, Kiki walks up to you with a big cheeky smile, and asks you if you’ve been kissing anyone this week, all the while jabbing you in the ribs with hard, ticklish forefingers that are coming too fast and too hard to defend.

Well, we can't say she condones strong-arm tactics but then again, we haven't seen her in a life-and-death situation recently. What Killiana doesn't do, however, is sit around whining and complaining about what did or didn't happen. Sure, life is complex sometimes, and occasionally you don't get what you think you deserve, even though in the end, it turns out you did: Killiana is pretty adept at reminding others of this simple but rather confronting fact. It helps that she's got a great smile, but so what. The other thing she'll tell you is to use what you've got. 
Thanks K.

Kim actually holds a record in the Kingdom for possessing the greatest ratio of:                
Complexity of nature/Name length.
Indeed, Kim is sensual, she is worldly, she is determined and, yes, she is complex.
A sexual being, which is a good thing. She's up there with Fergus, Laurina, etc etc.
Kimberley has the I.Q of unknown proportions but that doesn’t matter. In a world where looks count, she does alright. She’s a lingerie model, and she’s organised.
The Weather Girl.
Flighty and superficial one day, hilarious and dangerous the next. Like a man called Muchy, she can’t sit in the one spot for more than about 10 minutes.
Kinga never goes to bed without handcuffs, an array of oils and some pretty funky music.

Super smart, very cute and with a mind that rarely switches off, Kinsey takes ages to get to sleep every night. She basically runs work without being the boss, which she's over, to be honest, and she detests wearing high heels.  Kinsey's defining characteristic however is that she's brilliant at getting to the root cause of things. She's make an excellent psychiatrist, investigative journalist, scientist or activist.

All the boys want to turn her into a lollypop so they can stuff her in their mouth. Some girls have that effect on men. As it is, Kinza snuggles into her particular maze of work and living and play so well that she barely seems to have a problem. She’s not needlessly rude to anyone.

Is she Inuit, Russian, Greek or English? No one is certain but none of that is really relevant. Kio dives into situations and this is her special skill. That’s not to say she carries no fear but she needs to test herself from time to time, which is why her hobbies/men/romantic intersts/friends seem out of the ordinary.
