Life is an interesting game for Kio, and we will do well to see what she says about it.
By pure accident, usually, Kipa is gifted slapstick comedienne.
Yep, Kira was conceived in the ocean and she's a little more timid than her cousin (Kirra), which is a good thing!

Her boyfriend/partner needs either a good sense of humour or plenty of that thing that we call PATIENCE. It's all about melodrama, you understand. Kiraley lives for it. If no one is producing then she'll take it upon herself to produce a melodramatic moment, personally. You should see her in action when she's tipsy and footloose.

Man, look out! If she ever performed as the official starter for the 100m sprint at the Olympic Games, she wouldn't fire the gun into the air, no sir! At the sound of the pistol the runner in the field whom she most detested will be shot in the leg. (Proof that she treats the whole thing as a game.)
Chews chewy at the back of the class.
Kiri allows herself only so much down-time before she stands up, dusts herself off and heads stridently back out into the field with her guide book, her sample vials and her trusty sextant.

Kirily, you've got all the crew up here in the commentary box in a bit of a tizz. We didn't think another Kirrily-type existed. They do. You do. Here you are. Can you please go and check out Kirrily. Love your work. (Management.)
The cute and compassionate tomboy who lives near the coast and is perpetually sun-kissed. And no, she probably not the most fiscally responsible person you have ever met
The more dashing cousin of Jeanette, Kirralea is the bushfire that no one can seem to put out. And why would you want to?

Each of us has a skill. It's just how it is. Sometimes it takes a while to figure out what that is, and sometimes it takes others to remind us what we are particularly gifted at. This is the situation which applies to Kirralee. Yes, she's a smart, canny lass who doesn't spend too much time sitting around moping, but what she's great at is needlessly slamming car doors. She doesn't even have to be in a hurry. She might even be early to some funtion or other that she's not even that keen on attending, but there you go - out she gets - and BANG! She scares the shit out of valets and used car salesmen, and rightly so. Interestingly, she exits relationships in a similar fashion.

Kirrilea is the name given to a rock-slide or avalanche. Yep, it's true, sometimes she kills people but if they're on the mountain after the warnings go up, what do you expect? Kirrilea is a natural function of life, as we all are. So, now, if you're about to head on out to the mountain for a trek/heli-ski you need to ensure you're prepared. Have you told people where you are going? Do you have provisions if you get lost or buried, and have you got an EPIRB? In a nutshell, sort your shit out and you'll be okay. Kirrilea.

The morning after a big night, and you wake on the couch. The house is peaceful and quiet and that's a good thing. You have a mouthful of water from the full glass which miraculously appeared on the floor next to where you're sleeping - you're pretty sure you never put it there - and just when you feel like it's okay to fall back to sleep, a car pulls up loudly out the front, music blaring until the ignition is turned off.
Kirrily blasts through the door, sunglasses on and carrying lots of plastic bags that seem to be full. "Come on you - up! I've got some panadol, I've got a roast chicken and all the salad stuff. We're off to the beach! Come on! Up!!!!"

So much for the quiet, chilled-out recovery - and she was partying harder than anyone. Kirrily.
No woman is an island but Kirsha does alright. She studied art design at university although no one knows if she scored a job in that field or not. She’s quite an intense lady…intense but nice.
The pulsating and seductive dare-devil.

Don't be late if she's invited you around for dinner. As in, don't be 30 seconds late. If you're on time, then no worries. You won't find a more loving and hospitable host, and she's a wonderful flirt. But if you're late then the whole plan for the evening is likely to be thrown out the window and the last thing we need is Kirstan stressed in a place where she can get her hands on a variety of big, sharp knives. Great smile though.

Wow, she'd be wild to live with, huh? One minute she'd be in the garden, using brute force to position railway sleepers for her new vegie patch, the next minute she's out the door, dolled up to the nines and dripping with jewellery and perfume that the neighbours can smell from over the road. They probably heard her getting ready too - screaming out if anyone has seen her fucking car keys. So, no, Kirsteen is anything but forgettable.

As one of life’s great reality checks, Kirsten is the name of that irritating pebble in your shoe that is hard to find, even after you take your shoe off. Don’t let her operate any kind of machinery, whatsoever, although she is great with animals. And she never gives up easily.

Like all girls with this kind of name, Kirsti doesn't die wondering. Her smile is large, as may be her hips and the sound of her laughter. She forgives after a loud fight and most of her friends will attest to her fiery will. Never as reliable as a man called Geoff, for instance, but Kirsti brings verve and life and sexy banter. Thanks Kirst'.

Kirstie may be small but she's not small in spirit. For instance, she'd make a great jockey. And she persists more than nearly anyone. She loves the outdoors and if she did become a jockey, the horses would really dig her energy.

Kirstine is the name given to the phenomenon of waking up early, and on the way to the kitchen where you plan to make a quiet coffee on your own, you pause at the stereo to turn on some mellow tunes. In your memory the volume was low from the night before and the music quite chilled - perfect, you think - but no. The volume was turned up flat-stick and it's fuckin' Kanye West screaming at you. By the time it comes on, nearly blasting the windows from their frames, you are already at the kitchen sink and faced with a desperate eight metre return dash across slippery tiles in order to kill the stereo before the entire house is awoken. Kirstine.

Faulty and defective? I doubt it. But no one is perfect, and the only hiccups arise for her when she acts without thinking, which usually only stems from moments of unbridled gusto and enthusiasm that are too powerful to repress.
True, we once described Kirsty as Samantha, from 'Sex in the City’, but that’s doing her a disservice, for there’s way more to this girl than just being forthright in the bedroom. 
Kirsty has a vision and she aspires to fulfil it, regardless whether that vision exists in three weeks time or not. When confronted with such passion, her friends go out of their way to help her too, such are her powers of persuasion. But we say again, Kirst’, if you can, just remember that this moment won’t last forever, and sometimes it’s okay to relax for a little while and just see how things play out. Big Love, Management. x

Kisha can get herself into a fizz very quickly and in dealings with the public she is therefore funny to watch. She speaks the truth of the matter and more than once has she chided a boyfriend in a very public display of anger. A nightmare relationship with most electronic devices means she needs a new phone every other week, although we have no idea how she pays for them.

Rarely tacky or cheap, Kissaine has an eye for composition, be it interior design or her own artwork. She can be a tad lazy, however. Several times last season we in the commentary box suspected she hit the ball out of play deliberately just so she could have a drink and wee sit down.
Like a soft leather holster for an expensive handgun, Kit has time, she's smooth and she smells incredible.
Kitty runs a business that sells sexual dress-up clothes for adults.
Gorgeous or otherwise, Klara is a decent person with a good heart who follows the trends.

Klaudia is one funny chick and a firecracker of a personality. For instance, if you are living with her in a romantic situation, or even if you've just stepped out of the shower and can't be bothered wrapping a towel around yourself en route to your bedroom, if you pass Klaudia and she happens to be holding a plastic ruler - perhaps she is measuring the exact height of a small brass sculpture, having gotten into a drunk argument with some engineer wanker, who happened to be visiting the night before, that there's NO WAY it was taller than 25cm (Klaudia hates being wrong almost as much as she hates authority) - she will undoubtedly lash-out and slap you on your bare ass, leaving a big, red welt that will match the size of her grin. Klaudia.
Like her name suggests, Klytie is ever so flighty. And she's over-reactive too, although she's quick to apologise when she's been a bit over the top or out of line.

Jesus Kobi, what's the rush? Seriously, why are you running? There are things called subtlety, patience and timing. Yes, you can run into everything as fast as you can but let us tell you, sometimes a slow, dignified and knowing build-up is more erotic and mysterious than any hash job. Are you with me? So, take a breath, no one is dying here, and use a few seconds to imagine what it might be like to build a scenario over time. Go on...

“Mmm, well Miss Kobie, we hope you don't take after your twin sister above (Kobi). Ah, you say you don't? Excellent. Well then you might be able to help me with something. You see, I’ve heard a report that a girl looking very much like you was seen at the wheel of Miss Roderick’s Fiat, which she reported stolen at morning recess…..It wasn't you?…. Well, that's just splendid. But tell me, why is the bottom of your skirt torn? I only ask because the same person who witnessed the car leaving the road and drive through a hedge, said the driver was wearing a school skirt because it was hanging out the bottom of the driver's side door. 
…..I see, so you're saying it wasn't you, then?…..Well, it's a good thing your grades are so high Ms Kobie. Now please go back to class, and for god's sake get your mother to mend that skirt."
The End.

A sneaky little trickster. Luck is her constant ally, as are her rather large group of friends. All the boys stand a little bit taller in her presence because deep down they know Kodi cannot stomach men who stand with their shoulders slumped.
Small, smart and tenacious, Kodie is super-strong for her size. She has never heard of a thing called peer group pressure and she'd be very confused at what it even means.

Girls whose name begins with the letter K are never lacking ambition or potential and so here it is again. Korina never remains in a rut for long, because she will immediately scratch and fight and punch her way out of it. Usually it’s a battle with herself and as you can imagine, therefore, she finds pregnancy something of a chore because by necessity she has to sit around for long periods either feeling dodgy or just eating, and she enjoys having things to do amid an active life. She’s a wonderful ally and a passionate lover, and when she’s not pregnant she’s bloody difficult to pin down, which is just the way she likes it. Oh yeah, and she understands men very well. Got all that?

Kris will tell you that in order to take yourself back to your past lives, you have to stick your finger in your belly button, repeat your name over and over and over and walk backwards and forwards as you do it.
Loco.

Late for kick-off again, is she? Bloody hell....oh hang on....here she comes. The umpire checks his watch. Krissi jogs out into the middle, takes her place in the lineup while 40,000 exasperated fans settle down in their seats.

Krissi looks at the umpire, gives him a silly kind of smile as if to say, "You wouldn't believe me if I told you."

He'd ask her, but he knows the story would take ages and while being generally hilarious and ridiculous, probably, now isn't the time for it.

All he says is, "Well, can we start now Krissi?"

She just nods.

And away we go again...

You can imagine Krissie at two in the morning sitting around with her staff, a drink in hand, her feet up on the seat in front of her, a smoking cigarette held aloft, relaxing and laughing about another crazy night in this crazy city that went off without a hitch. Finally, we get to see the beautiful and full expanse of that smile of hers.

Like a lone Jelly Fish pulsating its way through a clean ocean, Krista often produces a wonderfully unusual spectacle, not to mention a different perspective on life, but it takes her ages to get anything done and if she’s in a bad mood when you touch her you’ll wear the scars.

Kristelle often finds herself in rather embarrassing public situations when, theoretically, she's being sexy and quite chic. For instance, she tried that seduction method of taking her knickers off while in a restaurant, once, in order to drive the man wild with lust who was sitting opposite her. It was going great until the final move when she bent down to secretively retrieve them off the last high heel. Unfortunately, because she'd drunk a few wines, she overbalanced and fell sideways, knocking the table into the air as she hit the ground. Food and wine went assunder, Kristelle hit the deck and bared her uncovered nether regions to the maitre d' while her knickers ended up in a sticky date pudding three tables away. Thank God she has a sense of humour, eh?

World Peace isn’t really any of Kristen’s business and she accepts that she can’t make everyone happy. But, she is an extremely sensual woman, once she’s awake, and she sleeps most of the time because she seeks a stable state. Does that mean she’s lazy?.....yep, but who cares? You can’t get by at being lazy if you’re stupid and that she is not.

Kristi is very pointy at both ends, which means that getting in past the entrance to her home/burrow/eagle's nest is only the beginning. If she she suddenly insists you go with her to go and 'pick something up', however, make sure you're armed. Good luck!
Kristian is well-travelled and educated, not to mention rather refined. She only harps on about it when she’s drunk and she wouldn’t be seen dead kissing passionately in public, which is a shame.
An orthodox hot water bottle that is made out of blue rubber. She bubbles and squeaks if you touch her on the belly.
The Artful Dodger. (i.e: very smart, great escape artist, excellent memory, distracting smile.)

The manager of Chicago's most popular wine bar, and she is good. No matter how busy, how chaotic or how loud it gets, Kristina is on the case. She makes decisions very quickly and very well, and no matter what the repercussions she retains her cool. The upshot of all this is that no matter what happens, Kristina gives the impression that she knew it was going to happen, and that it was all part of the grand plan.

Kristine is a girl on a mission. Yes, she gets frustrated with little errors caused either by her or others which impede her progress, but she persists. Does she overdo it? Well, she certainly doesn't relax like she ought to, but then again, maybe that's her lot? The team in the commmentary box certainly love her never-say-die attitude.
If she isn’t slightly dull then she is likely to be extremely energetic, in which case she is a possible lawyer, pole dancer or professional kick-boxer.

Why is it girls whose names start with K can bust down doors more easily than almost anyone? This one is no different. And she’ll take a fall, lose some skin and get right up again. Is the job finished? No? Well then don’t expect Kristyn to stop or sit down. Even watching her is making us tired…
The Crusader.
If the sun is out and she is in the mood, Krystal has the bad habit of racking up a huge and almost un-payable credit card debt.
Krystina is the only person we are aware of who volunteered to work in the prison, on the condition that she was the one who got to flick the switch on Death-by-Electrocution day.

You know of those horror stories about violent husbands? (They're not to be tolerated under any circumstance, not ever.) Anyway, if Krystle ever found herself in that predicament, well, I tell ya, the husband wouldn't be very violent for long. He'd very quickly find himself either six feet under, or starin' down the barrel of a gun and being confronted with the news that if he doesn't shape up and get loving, quick, then he soon will be. A- fuckin’-men.
Kumi is a cross between Gwen Stefani and the Dalai Lama. The End.

If we put all the worlds troubles and all the world's angry, deluded fools into a single large bowl and give this bowl to Kwan, she will make everything better. How will she do it, you ask?…
Easy. She'll gently knead and fold the mixture over itself, bathing it in happy thoughts and a loving temperament, squeezing out all the dramas and all the hate, re-folding it again and again, until the process embalms the chaotic, angry mess with a strange kind of loving peace.
Kwan.
The warrior princess in waiting.

Strong-arm tactics: forget it. Kyhanna's spirit wants to run free across the savannah, without the hang-ups, the obligations and the petty material concerns of the modern world. In a past life Kyhanna was an islander in the south pacific wearing a straw skirt, her hips and her delicious smile swaying in time to jungle drums, and where she hypnotised many-a-suitor. In that regard, at least, not much has changed. How she manages to get by in the Western world is beyond us, but get by she does.

We've been discussing Kyiah up here in the commentary box this week and we think she's a good player and that she has the capacity to be champion. But what we want to see is a bit more grunt! A bit more agro! Don't apologise to your oponent if you trod on their head accidentally. We want you to trod on it again! Draw some blood if need be. If it’s a man, kick him in the nuts! Make him remember who he's dealing with! THAT'S the Kyiah we want to see!
Kyla kind of lies flat and keeps quiet….NOT!

It’s hard to tell if Kylee is either exhausted, pissed off or just plain bored. Yes, she has to remind people how to spell her name, AND WHATEVER YOU DO DON’T ACCUSE HER OF BEING A BOGAN OR TRAILER TRASH, but she’s always looking concerned about something. Why is that doll? If you’re not happy with a situation, be it where they decided to put the esky, what your boss said to you last week or how the car is sounding after having it serviced, don’t for a second hesitate to do something about it. You deserve to be blissfully happy.
Amen.
The Dignified Bogan.
Like her little sister, Kym is quick and often quite reactive, but she has a greater understanding of the consequences of her actions.

Kyra is modern, savvy kind of lass who has more energy than you think. Unbeknowns to her friends she's actually extremely intelligent, although she permits herself to be dragged along with the peer group without too much trouble. What she ought to do is go out and test herself in a job or passtime that stretches her intellect. Indeed, we probably all should, but Kyra can think laterally very quickly and therefore outmanoeuvre the opposition easily, be it in the form of a marketing obstacle, an irritating superior or a typhoon/cyclone/hurricane that threatens to put a hole in her holiday.
The Sleeping Volcano.
(Pronounced Kize.) Kys is a sexy, sly dog!! She's innovative, she's in your face, she laughs hard and rarely does she look over her shoulder. Melancholy doesn't get a look-in here folks.

One of the world's most seductive bar room brawlers, Laanie has lightened up in recent years. Does she get pissed off at the misspelling of her name? You bet, but it has forged an iron will. Fiercely competitive, as a young lass she used to enter the 100m sprint and, shit, did she make waves? When the gun went off, her first task would be to stick a foot out and trip over the runner to her right, before decking the runner to her left with a gentle fist to the head. But, she hates liars, she's passionate in the budoir and woah-betide anyone who messes with her kids!
Voulez vous coucher avec moi, cherie?....(Just kidding. But I've always wanted to say that.) Labouré is a funny and silly lady…who….I think….likes to ride…how  you say?.....the bicycle. Oui!

I know, look, the spelling is different but you're gonna have to suck it up, okay? So, now, take a breath and roll on down to your twin sister's story, Lacy. You'll find it's pretty good. Anyway, best of luck! Management.

Head auctioneer, stunt driver, spear fisherwoman.......these are the kinds of things Lacy,and her twin sister, above, dare I say, do to relax. Hang on to your hat, is the advice from the crew up here in the box.
Melodramatic? Sure. High expectations are what she carries, in conjunction with a very low tolerance to neck tattoos on men. And Laela, would you say you are way lazier than average?...Hmm?

Another girl whose parents are so dim that they force one to consider if, one day, it really would be a good idea if Big Brother gave out Children Licences. Anyways, L_ah is a happy gal' and she works in the $2 shop.

Lahnee starts each morning with a yoga routine, at least she tries to, and the aura of happiness she continually exudes has the effect of lulling all those that meet her into a state of contented joy. No, you're never going to see Lahnee hurrying down the mainstreet of London, San Fransisco, Hong Kong or Sydney dressed in a killer business suit, late for a 'high-powered' meeting. She deals in a different sort of higher power, altogether.
Laina never makes monstrous mistakes, although she never makes heroic, life-altering discoveries either.
Giving. Wise. Laconic.
See Lainey.

“Lakeishaaaaaaaaaaaar!” her friends bemoan half way into the city for a big night out. “How can you lose your purse AGAIN! Why didn't you check before we got in the car? When are you going to take full responsibility for your life?”… etc etc.
Well she’s definitely loquacious, though we’re not sure if she’d  know what that means. It certainly comes in handy at the beauty parlour where she works. Lakota always has a big smile for the boys.
Laksmi imports furniture from India, Vietnam and Indonesia. She runs a meditation retreat in her spare time.

Talking to her, you’d never know that she’s just saved countless lives, maybe the planet, and has come close to death on many occasions. I suppose it comes with the territory. But there she is, relaxed in her chair, a drink in her hand, a cute smile on her face that shows nothing of the hardship she’s just endured. She’ll tell you it’s all part of life’s rich tapestry, and she’s right. Extremely cool under pressure, Lan is bored by the 9-to-5 existence and if anyone has flown more on small, dodgy aircraft then we’d like to meet them.

The Plain Jane who expects plenty without ever having to do much? Say what? Nah, that's rubbish. Lana is one of the most committed players on this team, you're just a bit dazzled by her good looks and her natural charm. Make no mistake, Lana is a fighter when the chips are down., and she's not shy at all. Have you noticed?

Life can be hard for some people yet for others life can be one big delicious game, and so it is for our lovely Lang. It seems that all one has to do is make a choice, and it also seems that Lang made this choice while she was still inside her mother's womb. She has a big, open smile, she expects silliness to happen and she expects to meet bizarre and weird new people everywhere she goes, which she does. 

(Note: In a past life Lang was a cheeky fox who used to run around the countryside stealing eggs from bird's nests.)
"Go on," she says, with an inviting smirk. "…I dare ya."

What’s the story here? Let’s have a crack at this formula, shall we?

…Some girls are just too lovely and brilliant and sensual and funny and cute that they actually don’t even realise they have any of these qualities, let alone in spades. And so, they kind of crash their way through walls when, really, all it would have taken was a quiet wink to the doorman, just to her right, and he would’ve gladly opened it for her, handing her a glass of champagne on her way through. 

Sound about right?....

Anyway, we adore Lanie, and the world is a better place when she’s around. Beyond that, ladies and gentlemen, we offer you a beautiful mystery, and her name is Lanie.

Option A:   Lara floats around in a parallel cloud universe that, honest to God, does not exist. You’d never tell her that though and that’s okay because ignorance is bliss. 

Option B:   The name of your favourite tracksuit pants that you put on in the middle of winter after a nice, long hot shower.

Displeased at the continued misspelling of her name, Laraine tends to look concerned most of the time, like she's always being pestered to do something, or drive the kids somwhere, or hang the washing out, or cook the bloody dinner. We haven't said this to anyone before Laraine, but we suggest a tattoo across your forehead that says, "Morons, please leave."
That’ll sort the idiots from the sweet biscuits, no worries.

Yeah, she gets to spell her name to people more than she would like but that doesn't hide the fact that songs have been written about this girl. From outside her life looking in, Lareina seems cool and steady, sexy and interesting. From the inside it's a slightly different story, and Lareina would only agree with the former synopsis about 20% of the time. If you talk to her, she'll tell you her entire success has been a giant bloody fluke. (Even though she knows we all make our own luck.)

Like all good generals, Larina is only a fusspot when undertaking tasks that matter, be they party preparations, storming into the director's office with an ultimatum or tending the needs of a close friend in trouble. Then Larina will come into her own and you better do what she says. Outside these rather rare moments, Larina is a relaxed and playful soul who keeps her finger on the pulse, be it spiritual, financial, sexual or philosphical.
Larissa spends thousands calling telephone astrological guides, hoping and praying that one day she’ll be told that her life is, and will be, perfect. She retires to energy class once a week.

Larni is a terrific lady, but she concentrates so hard when she's being told something important that deep furrows have developed on her forehead, and which make her look a whole lot more serious than she actually is.
The classic Earth God Mother. She lives in Goa, Byron Bay or the hinterland, sleeps 15 hrs every day and eats organic everything.
Latasha doesn't use her body enough and she has so many bangles and bracelets on her wrists that, if she ever fell overboard, she’d very quickly be dragged to the bottom.
Does she have thin lips? Anyway, Latrice is a staunch pragmatist and even her friends say she needs a good shag.
Latrisse? Cowardly? You must be kidding! She's full-on my friend. And pretty funny, actually.

Yes, well, who isn't guilty of letting the bills stack up, just once in a while. It's not like she does it deliberately. She's got better things to do. Like, well, anything really. Oh, she forgot where she put them? Well that makes sense. Launa is a great lady with an infectious laugh and lots of friends, but heavens-to-mercy she loses shit more than anyone. For God's sake don't let her navigate.

Normally about 65% crazy. But Laura isn’t crazy enough not to be incredibly sexy, and not academic enough to be boring, but she’s definitely different, and usually exotic. Does that make sense? In short, Laura is a cracker and she’s a hoot to have around.

Okay, so she's not the most potent optimist present but, by god, when the shit hits the fan you won't be better prepared. She can handle herself in the outdoors, less than 3% of her underwear collection consists of G-strings and if she orders a coffee she doesn't order a 3/4-full 1/2-strength skinny latte with a pot of hot water on the side. She orders a flat-fuckin'-white and she puts sugar in it. We love you Laureen!
The wonderful female priest.

Yep, you’re a twin of your sister above Laurell. While you may not be a priest, you are honest, faithful, and if reading these words is filling you with a sense of boredom and disgust, can I suggest doing something outlandish? Did you ever hear of that heavy metal band in Norway, years ago, who went around burning churches? Anyway, try that. We won’t tell anyone, I swear.
The name of a movie genre. In this case, a comedic farce that takes place in the countryside and where everyone ends up married and living happily ever after.
A luxurious destiny awaits you Lauren so go forth in the guise that you choose and be wonderful. And she always smells great.

Right when you think she's not going to turn up, or that she's not going to come through with the goods, Laurene lands in front of you having broached so many obstacles to get here it isn't funny. Then you remember why you hired her in the first place - Laurene was born to orchestrate.
Laurentine has horrible reflexes, only because she's never had to do anything quickly.

Any time she puts up a fuss it is always a front because all she is really doing is letting you know that she is bored, and that she wants you to do something about it. And so she’s always sort of funny when she starts complaining.
Yeah, we thought about it but, Laurie, go and check out Lauri.

Laurina is remarkable – she’s happy, she’s sexy, she’s honest, she’s compassionate and she’s funny. There just aren’t many of them and for such a normal-sounding name this is probably the only mystery; Why aren’t there more of them? 
(Note: She is a true sexual deviant).

Shyer than her Lauren counterparts, Lauryn is therefore ever-so-slightly more subtle, which probably means she's more knowledgable when it comes to most things. (And Lauren is no fool.) 
Rarely does Lauryn rush her decisions, her friend base is genuine and large, and for some reason known only to the gods and maybe her parents, she smiles around her eyes, which is the key to discovering someone with a loving heart. Yep, ain't no hotel room tragedies here folks. Thanks Lauryn.
The Hindu Goddess of calming words, scrumptious smiles and naughty little tricks. Laya is delicious.

One of the gifted ones. Magic lies in her smile and her fingertips, which is a good thing because she rarely takes the easy option, but she is a rare creature whose ethereal beauty and sense of earthy wellness is offset perfectly by her laughter.

I know what you're thinking - Layle spends all day trudging back and forth from the well carrying a pail. BULLSHIT, she does! 

Layle is like a very expensive and smooth-running double-glazed, glass sliding door. She has layers, you understand. Usually you can see them, and usually she's very agreeable. However, don't get your fingers or any of your toes near the edge when she closes. Her tracks are clean and deep and that heavy door, once it starts to move, ain't coming off the rails (as in, once she makes her mind up, stand back!). So if she closes in a rush you need to be mindful, but the house needs and loves her, and rightly so.

Drawn-out transactions: she hates them but why does she seem to have so many of them? Like all of us Lea just wants to get on with things but rarely is she able to do this. Perhaps she gets distracted and flustered easily, I'm not sure.
Highly strung but that's okay. She looks amazing on a surf board.

No, she's not your average girl. She's been meditating for years and it gives her a wholly unusual and delicious take on people and on life. She sees auras and angels and other things that you would scarcely believe exist. Most important, she loves everyone and we're not just saying that.

A community-minded loud-mouth, thank God! For example, at the meeting of locals in the town hall, gathered to listen to the effects of the local coal seam gas mine planned for the area, and which is expected to impact the lives of many of her friends and neighbours, Leana will be first to stand up and grab the microphone and speak up for those she cares about.
Like a pair of old socks, Leanda is there when you need her. Lucky for those who know her, she is also very giving of her time.
Leandra is studying palm reading. She’s quite psychic, she says.
Leane operates the betting machine at the pub. (Works with Jude.)

Yep, at some time in her life Leanne operates the betting machine at the pub as well as pouring her fair share of beers to a bunch of regular men who have no idea of her true potential. (And yes, you might say that's a pity but shut up, will you. Have you any idea how many oppressed women around the world would be beaten and killed if found with a beer in their hands?) Leanne is more capable than most men, and way sexier than she lets on.
Great friends with L_ah.
Lechelle has big eyes, glossy lips and sells jewellery in a jewellery shop at hugely inflated prices.
Lee is often so energetic that if she were a metal object that you applied to the skin, you would hear a scorching sound.
KFC manager.

Leecey has one of those grins that men find irresistible. Indeed, we've discussed this up in the commentary box and we've come to the decision that it's not even that. Indeed, we don't know what it is about her that has an effect on people - men and women. Did you know that on the night of the summer solstice Leecey assumes her role as High Priestess at the annual pagan festival held up in the forest? Crazy, eh?

Has she got a good lawyer? Excellent, because life is not going to be slow, quiet or uneventful for this one. She wouldn’t have it any other way anyway, would you L-e? Great at taking the piss, it takes ages for her to figure out what she wants but until then she’ll treat the whole thing as one long prank. Can’t blame her really.
Passionate and unpredictable, Men often gravitate toward her for reasons that most of them would be hard-pressed to explain, themselves.

Doesn't she love it when people write her name with an 'i'? I wonder how many times per week she feels she has to correct people on this? Anyway, suffice to say Leesa believes she's less rural and a bit more cultured than our 'old fashioned Lisa', and she might be right. She's definitely less relaxed, but not so much so that you'd prefer not to hang out with her. Leesa is actually a mischievous, cheeky lass and she slides in and out of interesting and humorous situations quickly and easily. Not prone to clumsiness or being the cause of unmitigated disasters (she knows all about hills and park brakes on a car, for instance), Leesa seeks out lateral people and scenarios, which isn't something you might presume having just met her. I wonder if many (useless) men feel a little intimidated by her forthrightness?... if that's a word.

Leesha spends more time talking on her phone while she's driving than anyone. While it's a nice-enough car and she's a nice-enough lass, she has the greatest potential to drive off a cliff and therefore unwittingly kill herself. Which'd be a pity. The moral to the story here: Leesha, keep your eye on what you are doing, how you are doing it and where you are headed.
Leida is always on the lookout for freebies. If she wasn't as smart and driven as she is, she would have made a wonderful homeless person, only because she wouldn't be homeless for very long.

There is a cross on the map that denotes the location of the treasure. It won’t be an easy journey and not everyone will make it out alive. This, as they say, is life. But, to get there as quickly as possible you’ll need a Leigh to guide you as much as she can...... so, listen to what she says and good luck!

Leika is the kind of girl who could go to Iceland on a camping trip in the middle of winter and deal with the cold no worries. She can adapt, you understand. She can mould, she can bend, she can manipulate her surrounds, and she does all this like a form of meditation. It's why you won't often see her for months.

This girl is suave, sensual and inviting like a semi-inflated li-lo made of suede leather, although there may be an unforgiving rock inside it that is only ever felt if the air pressure gets too low. (It’s the niggling product of no one ever knowing how to spell her name.)

One of the most loving and overtly generous people in the Kingdom. Although, we up here in the commentary box struggle to describe her performance because she spends all her time on the field draping wreaths of flowers around the necks of the opposition, as well as giving them a kiss on the cheek and a Hindu blessing. And for some reason you can hear bells in the background.

Have you ever sat and closely studied the patterns of smoke that arise from the end of a quality stick of insence? It's quite a beautiful, yet completely chaotic phenomenon. And this is just like Leisa: from a distance she is kind of smooth and sanguine, fun to be around and sensual, in general. Get close though, and I mean really close, then you see that inside this apparent slick coolness is the engine of a fire truck, going like hell! (PS - Like Vicki, Vickie, Vikki, Viki and Vicky, Leisa isn't exactly over-joyed at needing to spell her name to people, basically all the time.)
Hates the fact that she is occasionally helpless.

A fascinating organism. Good friends with Alexandra, Leisia has gone through all the stages. First was the 'ballerina', next was the 'show-jumping champion', puberty hit and she wanted to be a model, then a rockstar, then a fashion designer. Her parents never did anything other than encourage her, thankfully, and now, here on the slippery slopes of adult life Leisia thinks carefully before she commits and she organises her finances better than anyone. You won't see this kid with debt she can't handle. Likewise, she can manage and she can listen. Not bad, eh?
Good friends with Cheryl, Berryl and Bessie. And Liz, probably.
She's the chick in a cat suit who, at the start of a Bond film can be seen breaking into the upstairs castle-party in Monaco, where she steals the laser-guarded diamond and stuffs it down her top.
Where’d she go? Is she sleeping again? And what’s happened to the chocolate??
A very sexy, inquisitive and intelligent woman. Beautiful smile. Yes, she might be German but don't hold this agianst her. If she is, she's one of the cool ones.
Nasty? Leni? Are you out of your mind? Leni is one of the sweetest, funniest girls I know. Sure, her painting skills might need a bit of work, but you can't tell me the colours aren't spectacular.

Closely related to Pauline, Lenine detests a mess although she's not quite as hard-lined about it. What Lenine really loves is a mad camping adventure with her friends. Yes, it kind of goes against the grain of wanting to keep things tidy, but that only really applies when she's at home. Out in the bush she's a maniac!

Lenore can't seem to stomach any of her girlfriends' boyfriends. She therefore scares the hell out of them simply by being in the same building. There are some women just too intelligent for most men.

Too passionate and reactive for the boardroom. In love Leona will nibble your toes and surprise you with a buttock bite when you least expect it. She’ll kiss for hours if you’re ready and she’ll laugh easily and often. As a sensitive lass she’ll cry and cry when her heart is broken until life finds its rhythm again, then she’ll front up once more. Rarely does she shut herself down out of fear, although this might produce a reaction once or twice that you do not like. Give her space when she needs it and if she wants to run with the wild animals you have no choice but to let her go. 

(Note: Don’t let Leona run away from her troubles though.)

The End.

In a previous life Leone was a skilled and daring captain of a Viking ship. Her and her men used to sail around the North Sea - the rougher the better - plundering ports and raiding villages. Occasionally her crew would be a little confused by some of her decisions and more than once were they certain she was completely lost, but because she appeared 100% confident they let it ride. And those that weren't killed in battle died of old age on land, not lost at sea. Leone.

Leoni is a barrel of laughs and disasters. And yes, it's true, she is the name of a Russian satellite that never worked properly anyway, but is now out of control and plummeting toward the Earth at 25,000 km/hr. All any of us can do is to cross our fingers and hope that she doesn’t land anywhere near us. Good luck!
A very busy community duck who is dynamite in the bedroom.
The shy Italian princess.

Yes, Leore has lots of Christian Dior on her bedroom table, and Coco Chanel, and more shoes than you could poke a stick in that wardrobe but, Leore, honey, once the game starts you're not going to have time for any of that crap. Out here you need nous and love, and the capacity to take a bump and, if need be, you need to be able to give a hard bump back. Can you do that?
Methodical. Lesla would make an excellent biochemist or molecular biologist. Her attention to detail is second to none, which explains why she rarely rushes into things.
Yes, now calm down Lesley but please head on over to Leslie. Management. X

As a woman cursed with a masculine name, she spent years visiting a psychiatrist. She went for so long that, in the end, she forgot why she decided to go in the first place. These days she’s doing well. Always was, really.
Leticia doesn’t tolerate idiots yet she manages to maintain her sensuality in all but the most stressful of situations. In short, she is a potent and sexy go-getter.
Darlin, if you're gonna drive the car around that you know has a serious oil leak then of course the damn thing is going to catch on fire!

Levi is a cocky little shit, but it's hard not to be impressed with her drive and her confidence. She parties with the same look on her face with which she works - ie. She dedicates herself to the cause when she knows it's for her own good. She's quite the competitor and she disgards men who are out of favour with her as easily and as quickly as taking off her socks. 
Personal Motto: The past is the past. Let’s move on.
A bona fide Enigma. She undergoes constant metamorphosis and she could be anything – anything but boring, that is.

Lexa receives plenty of wolf-whistles walking passed construction sites, and by God don’t those boys find out how well an empowered woman can throw a streamlined smart phone, which weighs more than you think. And it’s not like she can’t afford to replace it.
Triathelete.
Lexley is quite the adventurer but she has the habit of getting lost, be it physically, emotionally or spiritually. Although, even here she discovers she is a part of many-an adventure.
Beautiful but dangerous. I mean, seriously dangerous.

Sure, she's a little lazy but, you know, she makes up for it. She's sarcastic and funny,  and after a while you realise  you're dealing with quite a competent actor who is just out to have fun. There should be more of them.
People often queue for hours in order to receive her gift…..

Yes, interesting. Lia may very well be a bohemian dressed in the disguise of a suave, savvy modern business woman. Perhaps she's the the sexy oddball that you only get to meet properly once she's taken her work clothes off? Maybe it's the tattoo on her ankle/arm/back or belly that's got you thinking? Lia forges a path through life that is never a straight line. There are curves and bends, sometimes you're not even sure if SHE knows where she's headed, yet she always comes out the end intact. As for her love-life, you better siddown' and get comfortable. This’ll take a while...
Her parents love her because all she ever wants for Christmas is the largest packet of M&M's the supermarket possesses, and to sleep in.
Liane is potent and successful and yadda yadda yadda, but she’s tired of organising her own life and is desperate for someone else to organise it for her.

Lianne is an intense but nice lady, who is cursed, somewhat, by the fact that she sees errors and mistakes before they happen. Having said that, each of our life paths is perfect, so, therefore, is hers, which is why she loves a wee tipple so she can just unwind and let someone else deal with it for a while.

With all the eratic weirdness of Libby gone, Lib is a laid-back performer. When the heat of the contest rises you can expect Lib to bring her A-game to the fore. She's got a cute smile and even her opponents don't mind her doing well, mostly because of the fluid nature of her movements, her sexy smile and her happy vibe.
The name of a snake-skin jacket that looks fantastic and receives plenty of compliments, but it isn't tailored very well, and subsequently it's quite uncomfortable to wear after a while.
Bipolar. Be careful.

Liberty is a calm and generally shy lady who thinks carefully before acting or speaking. She loves her kids although she doesn't show it enough! Sometimes words as well as actions are needed in a situation, Ms Liberty.
Libs is great fun. She embarrasses her daughters.
The fretting mum.

If Liddy hadn’t had as much casual sex as she’s had, and smoked as much pot, she’d make a wonderful leader of a country. But because the political machines which run societies are such anal, conservative, greedy and controlling globs of shit, someone as free-loving and as free-thinking as Liddy can’t get a look-in. In fact, who wants to go on strike with me?

A Serbian lass who is ever so slightly crazy. If she dislikes her can of soft drink and she happens to be driving down a busy highway at the time, you can expect her to wind down her window and toss the half-drunk can at the nearest car, with an aim to try and smash one of the windows. If asked why she'd reply that it would look kind of funny.
Sensual and modern, Liena is perpetually dragged away from what she really wants to be doing.
Like a slippery young seal, Liesel is happy, determined and sufficiently enthusiastic.

Liesl has no sharp or ungainly edges, well, very few as far as we can tell, and like her twin sister immediately above, she slides into people and friendships easily and quickly, always thinking the best of those she meets. She tends to sleep quite well and with a clean conscience.
The elusive and mischievous fairy princess.

It’s Christmas morning, Darwin, Australia, 1974. Another house has just been blown away by a cyclone and those inside were lucky not to be blown away with it. Now that the tempest has passed, Lil emerges from the rear of the wreckage in a faded pair of trousers and a scraggy red cowboy shirt. 
“I found these in the bar fridge,” she says, passing her husband a beer with the exhausted and sexy smile that got him there in the first place.
We know, the spelling is different, fear not. Please go and check out Leila. Thank  you. Management. X
Silky.

Yes, it's an absurd name in many ways, which might point to a mentally deranged parent or two, but the following terms CANNOT be used to describe the quite wonderful, Miss Lily Rouge: meek; quiet; shy; unobtrusive.
You with me?
Big smile. Big bones. Big heart.

Lilian is a species of hippie often seen romping naked through the forest. She makes lots of ‘tweeting’ noises in an attempt to speak to the birds and only rarely does she fail. Regardless of her ornithological pursuits she’s excellent company.

If you are a young man with testosterone pouring out the ends of your fingertips when the magnetically irresistable Liliana happens to place her cross-hairs on you while out one night, then we suggest that you do what the Buddhists do and act like water flowing down a mountain. Liliana creates her own gravity, you understand, and you'll have no say in anything. Best part is, you won't want to. Is she dangerous? Well, technically, yes, but do you really think anything we say from this point is going to change anything?

With regards to the burdens imposed by the modern western life, some people ought to be handed a leave pass. Lilou is one of these select few. Lots of music, crazy canvases, extravagant clothes, some nice party drugs and even some public nudity are some of the possible arenas where you might find our Lilou from time to time. 
A nine-to-five job = get fucked.
She doesn’t really belong on your average street, and when she breaks up with someone either remove the weapons from the house or leave town, depending on who decides things. 
The End.
A clinical psychiatrist who took up the profession in order to help explain her own fissured personality. She’s a sexual dynamo.
Hot pants!

Yep, Linay tends to manage the tasks of life pretty well, usually, and she's handy with a list and a calendar, but there is a subtle ache underneath all this that rarely gets the chance to be voiced. Sure, she likes organisation, she's healthy and rarely is this girl ever out of shape, but we're not at war, no one is dying, so why not do something insanely silly, sexy and potentially even a little dangerous once in a while? She has this internal conversation with herself at least once every 48hrs.
A portly woman in adulthood, she often has a concerned look on her face – as if she is approaching a mountain bend in a car that’s travelling far too quickly. This is a classic Linda moment…

Linden is never quite ready. Yes, she's a bright and innovative girl but why is she always last from the house? She takes ages in the bathroom, for instance, looking identical to how she looked when she entered two hours ago, and she's rarely on time with anything. How she manages to succeed remains a constant mystery. It must be her enthusiasm which, let's face it, is rather contagious.

Her unusually stunning look is somehow complimented by the maleness of her name and the result is a unique and quite enigmatic woman. She’s not the full Enigma but she’s definitely an apprentice. If you intend to befriend her, however, you will need an atlas, a GPS and a psychic, just to see where you are really standing.
Part delicate flower, part army lieutenant, Lindy treads a more volatile and/or precarious path than most.
The stern choir conductor from the local parish church, and woa-betide anyone who she spots not putting in 100 percent!
The Cabaret Singer.
Brazen and sexy, Ling loves tossing caution to the wind.

The reliable and stable white picket fence. There is very little rust on the latch of the gate and her paint job is in good condition.All farms need at least one, or someone who is closely related to one, if for no other reason to provide sound advice.

Up here in the commentary box we're always impressed at people who are both organised and relaxed in their day to day life. Linnea is one of these people. Yes, she's very cute and probably quite tall, so she attracts plenty of attention from suitors, but she always seems to have it under control. Her job, transport, belief system, emotional awareness - they're all operating quite smoothly. Perhaps she's Swiss or Scandinavian, we're not certain. Anyway, she'll be back in a minute. She's gone skiing.

A bouncy, smiley girl of Indian extraction who thinks more than you might gauge from looking at her. Sure, she's happy and gay most of the time, and her friends adore her as much as she adores them, but she's never frivolous with money, nor is she over-impulsive. She's got quite a nice blend going on, as a matter of fact.

Lisa is supremely normal and often quite beautiful but, better than that, she endeavours to allow herself the freedom of passionate reactions in her life. 
(Note: Yes, it's true, once upon a time we weren't sure that if aliens abducted the English-speaking world’s most charismatic, mysterious and sensual woman as some kind of culture-enhancement project, Lisa would be the one. However, we up here in the commentary box have subsequently met several specimens who have been, and then returned to us in a more beautiful and remarkable state than they were already. So, yes, Lisa is very abductable, indeed, we might try and abduct one ourselves - with her permission, naturally.)
Sexually expressive, Lisa-Maree needs constant mental stimulation otherwise she's liable to shoot off in some zany direction like an out-of-control fire-cracker. Get her a skateboard, that'll help.

Lise is a sexy and generally fun girl who is great to be around. If annoyed, however, she does take a while to get over it, or move on, or dispel the angst because she’s definitely more sensitive than she seems. Perhaps that look on her face is representative of the uncertainty she feels about the upcoming moment? We're not sure but she's never lacking friends or good times.

Skilled at adding the final touches, she stands on toes sometimes and she couldn’t give a rat’s arse. Her sexy smile and her unforgiving demeanour provide her with a certain je ne sais quoi, and her children are also worth getting to know. Not bad for someone who many (fucking idiots) consider to be something of an ‘Ice Queen’, eh?
Sexy Liss. Like the playful tip of a cat’s tail, she is full of mischievous intrigue and naughty ideas.

Yep, Lissette, the spelling doesn’t really matter chickadoo. Apologies, but please skip on up to Lisette for the gist. The only difference? The double s means you care even less about what others think of you, and you take more time in bed. Congrats, on both accounts.
Litia has never paid for a disco entry, a train ticket or a restaurant bill in her life.

How many men/women have wanted to fall at her feet and yell, "My Queen! My Goddess!"?
Plenty, is the answer to that one.

Liv throws up when she get stressed so try not to get her stressed. Unfortunately she’s so cool and calm on the surface that no-one knows whether she’s stressed or just as chilled and wonderful as ever. Apart from that, no worries.
Giggle-pot.
In a past life her name was Geoff.
Lights. Camera…….Action!!!!

Either very tall or very wide, Lizzie carries an infectious laugh that is just as grandiose as her physical and/or spiritual presence. Remember at all times, however, that she is as mad as a cut snake.
See Lizzie.

Ljiljiana will quite happily kill people in order to fulfil her objectives and her name is far too confused for her to worry about things like looks. She’d be great in the Mafia but perhaps she should have gotten into politics?

Ljubica is the name of one of those cars that haven't changed since they start started being manufactured in the mid-50's. The trick is to get in it and drive as fast as you can every time, no matter what. Why? Because at any moment, whether you're going like hell, drunk on the highway at 3am or just idling at a set of lights en route to the local shop for bread and milk, the bloody thing might blow up and catch on fire. There's no warning, nothing you can do to prevent it, and all we can suggest is that you need to be prepared to leap from the vehicle at all times. (Not the kind of car you want to be getting frisky in, while moving.)

The 'Llalindra' is the name given to the half-way point during any journey to some destination, be it the otherside of the room or the otherside of the country. If applied to all things, however, it means that you spend too much time worrying about the destination and not the journey, because you never actually get there. Life is illusory, which means therefore that even if you're only half way to somwhere you're actually already there. It's a choice, you understand. Anyway, it's complicated and so is Llalindra.
Loanne is fun to take camping because she snores like a legend.

Snapchat, Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, all that and more, some of which you probably haven’t even heard of yet. Logan knows about these things. She’s young, she’s modern, and while fun, she doesn’t get outside into fresh air anywhere nearly enough. Well, unless she’s the Logan mustering cattle on a property which is out near the edge of the desert, and a good 500 miles from the nearest town. That Logan is a juggernaut.
Delicious, testy, saucy, toasty and invigorating she is, but Lois is also a nightmare to argue with.
Tone deaf to the tune of 100%. That doesn't stop her singing though. She thinks the cats howling in protest are actually howling with her, but you have to love her passion for the creative cause.
Quite unwittingly, Lolita has brought down governments with her smile.

(Pron. Lonnie) Lone works at a homeless refuge and she has seen and heard it all. Yes, she's saddened by what the modern world is doing to those at the down-and-forgotten end of the social spectrum, but it also hasn't dulled her sense of fairness. She knows hard work pays off and this is what she endeavours to install in those around her - that and a healthy sense of humour, no matter what. Keep it up Lone.
You want to overhaul the system that is now somewhat jaded and inefficient? You need to get Lonnae the consultant on board. Do what she says and pay her what she's due and you'll be right. Lonnae.

A delicious, zesty lass who loves life and who knows how to relax. Indeed, she's never been accused of relaxing too much, as far as I know. I wonder if people ever subtly take advantage of the fact that they know she'll finish the job if they can't be bothered?
Hi Lonnie, how goes it? Sorry about this, but please read your funk-soul-sister above, Lonni, for you are each other. Love Management x

Loraine works in the school tuck shop during the week and at the local footy ground on the weekend. She sells lots of pies, knows everyone, and no one feels bad or sad when they leave her company. (And she doesn’t really care if people put two r’s in her name, or not.)

“Who needs a rule book?” she'll say. As a large, loud, in-your-face bus driver with oodles of jewellery, who is famous in the city, if Loredana feels the need for a burger from her favourite burger bar, don't expect her to wait until her shift ends. No sirrreeee!
What she'll do is just stop the bus in the middle of the busy street, tell everyone on board to chill out, as well as giving the finger to disgruntled motorists who now find themselves trapped, and saunter on in to her shop and order one with the lot.
“Y'all take care now, ya hear!” she says on leaving, with a big smile. With her lunch in hand the wail of car horns and cursing drivers are like water off a duck's back. 
Loredana.
Lorella is a fluffy kind of bird that can’t seem to remember why she is standing where she happens to be standing. But she means well, she laughs easily and overall she’s splendid company.

Lorelle observes and she moderates, and god-knows a lot of the young kiddies these days require a bit of both, and whether they like it or not. She's also a wonderful counsellor for her friends, although some of her more sensitive peers won't go to her if they're having an off day because her truths are sometimes too close to the bone, which is absurd really, given that it's all we have. The other thing to note about Lorelle is that because her radar is pretty good, she tends to stick with one partner for a long time. She's not in and out of beds, willy nilly, so to speak, (and pardon the pun.) 
'If you're going to do something, you might as well do it to the best of your ability': they may very well write this on her gravestone.
If Lauren is a late model top of the range BMW, Loren is late model top of the range Toyota Corolla that has had small dog-carrying basket fitted into the front passenger seat.

Loreto drives a 1971 Alfa which is barely held together. She changes jobs every fortnight, has spectacular, loud orgasms and, like a gifted few in the Kingdom, she is basically unembarrassable. Someone needs to write a book about her escapades…
Loretta goes hard in the gym just as she goes hard in life. You'd do well as her friend although she makes a splendid adversary. Very sexy. Very bright.

Like a jaguar that has spent three hours stalking its prey, for the most part you might question if Lorin is actually present at all. How far from the truth this is. Far from being a shy and demure creature, Lorin knows what she wants, she takes her time and picks her moment. It's all surprise with this girl, you understand.

Forever eager to rise up, Loris is tired of being stuck in the doldrums. Tired of this job which, now that she's thought about it, she hates. "And when was the last time my husband gave me a sexy little surprise?"
Good bloody question!

“Where's Lorna gone?” you might ask. “She's just nicked down to the corner shop for a loaf of bread,” someone might answer. And that may be the truth. Equally, they could have replied with, “In an attempt to keep her corporeal body in good shape, which, in turn, enables her to continue her perpetual search for the reasons of her existence and to determine why there isn’t enough fun and love in her life, Lorna has elected to go and fetch some bread.”
Having said all that, Lorna is cute and she’s funny, and yep, she’s on a search.

The name of a wild brown bear who has endured a fun but intense feasting/mating season and is now nestling inside her little cave as the snow begins to fall, and where she anticipates hibernating for the next few months. The creatures of the forest can therefore relax for another winter while the crazy beast is out of action.....
Lorraine, we know, you've got two R's. Tough titties! Please head on over to your twin with one R and read it aloud. Thank you. Love Management. x
Petite and gentle? Who? Lotte? Don't be bloody stupid, Lotte drives tanks and trucks, as well as many men to insanity.
Floats like a feather. Stings like a bee. KAPOWWW !!!!!

Some gals just have that thing which makes them leave a trail of broken or pining hearts in their wake. It's a fascinating phenomenon. Science can't explain it  and neither can we. Conceived in a bungalow somewhere near Varanasi, here in the west Lotus has evolved into one of these humans who seems to have all the time in the world. She's beautiful and compassionate, she rarely gets stressed and all we can say beyond this is that she'll never work for the military or the government, and that she'll detest all unnatural fibres against her skin. Amen.
…..mia principessa.  She is so cute and clumsy and forgetful that she breaks your heart, yet she’s also quite determined.

Louisa is the name of that 3 minute time-period every elite athlete experiences before they have to walk out into the arena and commence. It’s full of nervous energy, and hope, and wondering, and planning, and gut-wrenching perfect adrenalin......SO LET'S GO!!

You wince when you say her name and it’s a position that is difficult to recover from. Maybe she’s bitchy, maybe she isn’t, but in one of the world’s great dichotomies, if she isn’t awkward in some regard then she actually turns out to be incredibly compassionate. Go figure.

Lovice doesn't spend too much time being reflective.
Does it work? Good.
Does it not work? Give it two minutes then get rid of it: this is how she operates for most of the time, rarely looking back at failed projects/relationships. Life moves forward and Lovice is motoring ahead. The best we can hope for is that she invites us along for the ride. Damn right.
Lovina loves her snake skin boots, but she's still coming to terms with looking like she's comfortable in those heels.

Well, our friend Loz starts the week off hating herself for getting so drunk on the weekend, where she had sex with another useless ugly pissed prick. Tuesday she swears she's going to save up and pay off the four credit cards that are maxed. By Wednesday she's been invited to three parties on the weekend. On Thursday she ducks down to the pub to check the wet t-shirt comp' but that turns into a bender that goes right though to an even more sorry and broke Monday than the last...
Lozza prefers a sneaky doobie here and there, is drop dead gorgeous and seems to attract other hotties as friends.
Hi Lu, how goes it? Now, don’t hate us, but Lu = Lou, and ain’t nothing wrong with that. Amen.

Luana rhymes with I Wanna’, and she does wanna’, but the artistic and extravagant thread of her nature is often held back for some unknown reason. Her name is very rich and open, and perhaps it just holds too many possibilities? I’m not sure, but she’d make a fantastic mother.

Luanne is a respectable woman although she is one of those girls who sets foot inside a male stip club and changes personality. The work-hard, need-more-sleep Luanne is replaced with a creature resembling an angry grizzly bear. While not exactly bloodthirsty, those boys will go home with some scratches on them tonight from you know who...
A wonderful lover, a big smile, a passionate arguer, and clumsy as all hell after only a coupld of drinks. Flashes her knickers a lot.

Having dissed the Rule Book of Standard Living Procedures, basically at birth, Lucelle’s life is dotted by weird recipes acquired in unexpected ways, as well as long kissing sessions with passionate lovers who have arisen from all over the globe. Sometimes, she might have even kissed two partners at once.

Single-handed, she’s sailed across all the major oceans. She once had to climb on deck in a Force 10 gale off the Cape of Good Hope in order to mend a hatch cover that had come lose. It threatened the yacht and therefore her life, and can you believe that she did that at two in the morning?

Every 20 minutes Luciana preens herself like a very careful and self-aware Bird of Paradise, taking care of minute details. And whatever you do, don't try and tell her looks don't matter! Yes, she has time and yes she is very bright, but she doesn't have time for men/partners with no resources. (Not that she needs one to be happy, you understand.)

Luciann doesn’t hang around with the poor people. She is university educated, plays at least one instrument - her father owns a violin that is insured for about $4million - speaks very well in lieu of having gone to an excellent school and she never flashes her knickers. 
(Note: If French is her native language please disregard the entire paragraph. She also laughs alot more and, yes, sometimes she does provide a cheeky little knicker-flash to the boys she fancies!)

The words declining, moribund and deflating have never been used anywhere near Lucie. She is magnanimous, sensual and funny, as well as being both interesting and interested, and people love her, as they should. She could do with a little more luck on the romance front, however.

The clouds begin to open up unnaturally above the lucky city where it's happening. People on the street panic. They think an alien invasion is imminent. A beam of Godly golden light shines forth from the heavens that's so bright people can barely look at it. Trumpets play from above. Then, a man appears standing on the ground at the base of the light. He looks like Jesus. Most of the crowd is stunned. It's the second coming of the lord! The man walks out of the light and up to the first person he sees. It's Lucille.
“Hello my child,” he says with a solemn head bow. “I’m here to forgive you and to bring you love.”
Lucille eyes him up and down. “Yeah, whatever dude. You got fifty bucks?”

A strong and unconventional girl. She’s not that religious, really, but having been given the task of ringing the giant church bells, years ago, she’ll never leave the faith. She loves getting picked up by the ropes on the upswing and shouting, “Praise thy bells!”

The poor driver who is quick to judge another's poor driving performance, so maybe she's improving? Indecision is none of her business regardless if those decisions are splendid or put peoples' lives in danger. Happy to shag on the first date but you'll be doing well to get passed a fifth. (She gets a little bored, you understand, which is why she follows fads with such immediate gusto.)
Lucy enjoys making love outside, preferably in a public place, and she loves all danger. Skydiving instructor, gun running, bull rider - these are some of the things on her CV.

Luda isn’t really lewd and she’s not an exhibitionist, per se, but if you could toss those qualities into a blender with one and a half shots of adrenalin and two shots of Jamaican Rum, you’d have an addictive cocktail called, The Luda. Two or three of those might change your life.
The Flamingo.

Luka may seem quiet and almost a little timid but fear and fret not. Beneath that almost boyish hairdo is one of the clearest and most adept minds in the entire Kingdom. She knows what she’s doing and, even if she doesn’t, she’s having fun in a way that just seems weird to those that don’t and/or can’t understand her. She might even be another genius...

A loud, funny girl who seems to be everywhere at once. If you're a young and up-and-coming rock band and she's your manager, you can expect Lula to be partying harder than you are. So, yes, you'll have lots of fun but you'll often find yourself late for flights and you'll never be sure how she's dealing with the money you earn, and don’t get me started on the fucking van she says she ‘found’.

Branded as a banshee from birth, Lulu tends to take off in hurry. It's only when she's most of the way down the street does she remember where she's headed to, usually, which results in screeching of tyres. A normal person would come to a halt on the road quietly, or perhaps pull into a drive way so they could reverse back out on to the road as part of a dignified three-point turn. Not our Lulu. She drives straight on to the nearest front yard at pace and does a single large turn, culminating in a burn-out once she's back on the bitumen. She's destroyed at least 20 flower beds but, because the world is running out of eccentrics, we love her. Impossible not to, really.

Yes, Luna often spends time on projects and inside philosophies which take her mind away and up into the ether. Extremely idealistic and with a large group of alternative friends, Luna is gluten free, dairy free and she’s been to more environmental protests than all of us put together. 

Praise be the Universe.

Lutz reads between the lines and observes the consequences of peoples’ actions very carefully. Lutz is no klutz and she’s definitely no dummy, and she's not big on very hot or very bright climates either.
Lydia wears berkenstock sandals and spills stuff.

Rarely an obnoxious loudmouth, Lyla keeps a low profile and hardly ever sits in the front row in class. She can’t imagine ever wanting to attract that much attention. For the majority of the time, therefore, she’ll follow the general path of the flock. I wonder if and/or when this will cease, and under what conditions? For these reasons alone she’d make a terrific drug mule. (Small joke, mum and dad.)

Whether people know her or not, Lylah is one of those girls who is freely admitted into the VIP section of every nightclub she walks into. What we find amusing is that she's no dumb blonde, which is what people expect.

Lyn works in the pits for one of the big American Nascar teams. Her job, and it happens more often that you think, is to stand by with a fire extinguisher every time a car catches fire during refuelling. She's the one that saves lives and she's been set on fire so many times it ain't funny, but at least she's dressed for it. And if the fuel does ignite, you just watch her move. (The moral to the story? Don’t dare waste Lyn’s time by giving her meaningless tasks.)
If only her husband knew the full depths of her……
Unsubtle.

"Well," she says slowly, looking up at the darkening clouds overhead. "We could make a trip on out to the lake, I spose, either way we're gonna get wet ain't we, so what the hey." True to form, the grandkids go nuts with excitement, everyone gets soaked and no one doesn't have a good time.

Courteous to strangers who haven't pissed her off yet, Lyndsay is an extremely intelligent individual who sticks to the rules. As a distant cousin to any girl called Sue, Lyndsay is one of the more reliable members of the clan who is on the perpetual lookout for danger and perilous obstacles. God knows she possesses the nous to deal with just about anything, and the universe is yet to stump her completely, but she toils hard for the team and, as such, she is one of our more valuable members. And if she gets her teeth into a serious passion, be it gardening or furniture renovation, then you can expect her to disappear for days at a time.

Her name falls out of your mouth like saying yes to a good friend who is pestering you, which is kind of like tripping over the doorstep and falling, face first, into the softest bean bag in the world and laughing about it.
A nice lady who is lean like a ballerina and possibly incredibly impatient (or just extremely ambitious).
The Petri Dish who loves testing things.

A seasoned negotiator. If Lynley were a civil rights lawyer and she was arguing your case you can expect her to fight doggedly until the end. Yes, she can become somewhat jaded after all the hard work she puts in and I wonder if the directors/seniour partners/spouses are aware of how hard she works, and what value she brings to the 'company'. Hmmmm, I wonder indeed!
Lynn will take on a project no matter how unpopular, crazy or perilous it might seem. If she believes in it, she’s in, and she’s generally in it until the end.

What is it with some parents? Oh I know! Let's give them a unique name - and then send them off to rehab! 
Just kidding, but Lynnda does tend to run around in circles a little bit. It might be because those Ns last for bloody ages, and by the time you get to the end of them everyone’s gone home and the lights are off. Nice girl though.

Like many girls in the Kingdom, misspell her name and you may need to visit the dentist so you can replace the teeth you just lost, but the sheer force of will that produced this reaction is exactly the thing that makes Lynne so formidable as an opponent. And she can’t understand how women wear those infernal G-strings either. 
“Jesus, which idiot invented those bloody things?” we’ve heard her say, more than once.

God bless you Lynne.

The only time Lynsey is truly and deeply at peace with herself is when she's heavily pregnant. Can you have a guess at why?
Because it’s only then that she can forget all the trivial, pointless little things that worry her so much in her daily life. Here, with a belly like a bloated whale, feeling uncomfortable and generally over it, she has no choice but to sit down regularly and rest, as well as empty her mind of all those things that might otherwise pester her. Amen to that Lyn.

While not that musical herself, she does tell a good yarn. Her name has lots of energy and tends to lift her off the ground, which is why she shies away from office jobs and useless lovers, and why she smiles most of the time. You can’t blame her really.

Lysette is the name of a pack of cards that is missing one of the jokers. Most of the time you play on, having a fun, interesting and competitive game until some situation arises and then you remember - the deck isn't full. You've just wasted an hour and a half. Rather than toss the deck out, however, you throw it in the cupboard and forget about it until you pull it out again 6 months later on a rainy afternoon. Then you do it all over again. Lysette.

Wise and refined beyond her years, Lyv is one of those girls who walks into a bar and every man in the room, whether they are with partner or not, cant help but stare. Not that Lyv is aware, really, she's just doing her thing. Most men, she will tell you, are pretty foolish anyway and so why be bothered where they're looking or who they're looking at? 
She's probably right. But it's Lyv's radar that makes her special. Truth be known, she'd make a great personal advisor to either a President or a Prime Minister, and the best bit about this? She'd get a lot more done for the country and she'd never be haunted by the fame. Nice work Lyv.

Well, you could go and check out Lyv if you like, but not if no one ever calls you that. Indeed, if Lyvia is strict about her full name being used, then she loves driving between the lines, she hates camping and insects, and she’s just slightly too uptight to be able to walk into a crowded bar and have her energy noticed by every man in the joint. Then again, we’ve been proven wrong before…
Maaika is never friends with her ex-partners. Indeed, several of them have taken out restraining orders against her.
"Oh, okay then," she says, dolefully. "I'll go." And off she goes at a gentle pace carrying her two wooden pales, as she begins her 5 mile round-trip to the well.

If ever a politician wanted to dig up the dirt on an opponent then he or she could do worse than looking to one of his or her most underrated advisors, Macaela. Sure, on the surface she's cute and attentive and diligent, and she looks fab at all the cocktail parties, but behind this façade is a rather savvy and subversive operator. As a teenager her parents had no idea what she really got up to.

Macarena's entire physiology produces so much energy that her hair has no choice but to be curly. Here is another bouncy, sexy soul who, when you say her name, spins around, eyes wide open and expectant. This is her entire approach to life. Amen.

If ever confronted with a male buffoon at some pub, bar or restaurant, who is attempting to swoon her with a pick-up line like, "Wow, you've got  a good body!", in very short order the afforementioned buffoon will find himself lying on the floor, clutching at his crotch and writhing in agony. And fair enough, too.

Machelle is a funny chick. She also knows how to pull-in all her resources to get the job done. Yes yes, her name is spelt weirdly but so what? It has forged an independent temperament and a well-rounded sense of fun and playfulness. Yes, she can argue the house down and don't for one second think it'll bother her if you tell her you're in a bad mood, expecting her to do something about it. She's just as likely to tell you to fuck off and come back when you're not. Her happiness is her responsibility and she expects the same of others. Amen to that.

Oh, goodness me. We can't say that she's always slightly hysterical for that is overstating it, but she certainly doesn't mind a healthy slice of in-your-face human interaction. The other thing she loves is designer labels. (This is one of her only flaws.)

"Ma-who?" most people say after meeting her. But, unlike many in the Kingdom she is unbothered by their reaction. Indeed, Macushla is unbothered by most things unless they are actually important to the health or well-being of her or her loved ones/colleagues. She's an extremely fair-minded lass who is loved by just about everyone, although for some reason that thought only occurs to them after she's out of the room. Weird, huh?
FBI agent.

Impossible to be depressed around, Madale turns up as another guest of the wedding, looking like a million dollars and with a smile to match. By looking at her, one might imagine she'd have a good time, drink a few champagnes, maybe even get out on the dance floor for a song or two, and then toddle off home in a taxi before it gets too late.  

Here's a tip: If the wedding reception is slightly dull, you might only spot Madale by following the music way down at the back of the garden, all hidden away. Not only has she stolen away three members of the band and a case of bubbly, she's secretly usurped most of the fun people from guest list, including the bride. And no one even saw her do it!

Cheeky but not rude. 

Funny but not a comedienne.

Always happy.

Always lovely.

Maddie is way more capable than she imagines.

Maybe she's a Madison, perhaps she's a Madeleine, or even more infrequently, she might even just be Maddy. Anyway, it matters not.
