Nakita is a lovely, happy and engaging woman whose only major floor is that she doesn't always think through some of her decisions properly. Did you hear about the time she decided to go parachuting? She's scared of heights, of course, but not to be disuaded, off she went. Anyway, there she was, in the plane, strapped to her skydive instructor, when at 9000 feet and about 40 seconds from the drop-zone she realised she couldn't go through with it. During the hysterical fit which followed the pilot actually injured in the wrist, and everyone on board was fortunate to make it down safely. Nakita.
Her name is as pure as the driven snow and behind this alibi she gets away with a huge variety of wonderful sins. Nancy, God bless you.
Demanding. Busy.

Picture this: You’re walking home while carrying one of those cool-looking carry bags from an expensive fashion store. You didn’t buy that much and so the bag isn’t that full but because it’s a windy day it’s almost impossible to walk without the bag blowing all over the place, at times nearly carrying you off balance or getting caught behind your legs. This phenomenon is called the Naomi Effect, and she has a pointy nose.

Is she a hell-raiser? Well, on her day, just about. Once she's warmed up and rolling, then yes, you could nearly say that she was. Nardene is her own woman though, and if that means pissing off the masses then so be it. It might equally mean the masses finish up adoring her all the more. For example, if she was on a party yacht with music, drinking and dancing and she suddenly got a craving for pizza, she would damn-near threaten the captain with death, as well as insight a general mutiny, if her wish wasn't granted. Then, later, after the shit-fight of finding a pizza shop that will deliver to a jetty has passed, even the captain is grateful he gave in. Nardene.
Naree isn't big on surprises and she doesn't like being poked.
A wild boar that lives in the forest. She has big tusks, she grunts and, generally, she is a contented soul in her strange little world. Like Jodie, she’s only really dangerous when cornered.
Nat is as cool as shit, and she cruises through life with the ease and grace of the bow of a cruise ship slicing the blue, warm tropical waters of the Coral Sea. Nice work Nat.

Natalia is a nice wholesome girl, but she freaks out if she spies so much as the hint of a hair in her armpits, an out-of-place hair on her eyebrows or crutch, and if she spotted a dark hair on her upper-lip there is a fair chance she would consider suicide.

The sexy new Swiss Army knife that’s ready to stab, cut, unscrew, slice, grip, open, scale, magnify and abrade anything that needs it. Unfortunately, she has so many functions that she sometimes forgets what to use when. The last time I saw her she was trying to cut through a wire fence with a screwdriver.

A gifted ice-speed skater who is fit, competitive and full of guile. She’ll share a joke with you before and after a race but just take notice; if you fall during the contest and forget to pull your fingers into a fist as you hit the ice, if you are in her way you can expect to lose at least a couple.
Nathalie is essentially identical to Natalie, except that she is slightly better at dealing with unexpected chaos.

What the army is putting together now is a Special Forces Unit called, The Natika. They're an excellent under-cover unit. No, they don't train so hard that everyone has a six-pack and most of their success arrives as pure luck, if not a gut-feeling. Indeed, the only six-packs they are aware of are those in the fridge. But if you want a group of comrades in some shitty little Middle-Eastern café/bar to come out and save your life - and it might involve some blood, death and general mayhem - then you'd do well to have The Natika in the room. Some will be pretending to be drunk. Some will pretend to be dry-humping a local hooker in the corner. Another might be pretending to be asleep on the bar. 
Sure, they'll have a beer with you while they're on duty and you'll piss yourself at some of their jokes, but in a blue flash they'll come to the rescue. So, there's only one question you need answer from her:

Are you my friend or foe?

Super cool and stylish, Navanne thinks before she speaks, thinks highly of her education and her life - as she should - and rarely dates plumbers. The only advice the universe would offer her is that, the 'dark side' can be fun!

Like a splendid introduction, be it to a thesis, a movie, a good book, an incredible meal or even a 5-day Himalayan trek, Nayeli is full of beginner's luck, hope, clean ambition and only-good outcomes. Dread, failure, sadness, physical stress and heartache all come much later, and probably with somebody else. She's quite good luck to have around.

Nasty?? Bullshit! Nazli is like a sexy little squirrel whose job in life is to stick her head around the corner, completely freak you out, kiss you on the lips and say, "Hah! Did I scare you?" Then she's gone again in a flash, to go and spook someone else. It might be her Middle Eastern heritage, but in a land where women are empowered and encouraged to become anything they want, she's blazing a trail of fun and saucy hilarity. Trouble is, she darts around so quickly she's impossible to keep up with. 
Q: Does the work? 

A: Don't be bloody stupid!

Are her parents Italian? Perhaps, but she’s definitely not usually blonde. Extremely punctual, Nea endeavours to live a highly organised and streamlined life and you can expect to incur a penalty if you deliberately (or accidentally) mess up her lounge room. We actually wonder if she works too much. If that’s the case, can some tremendous man/woman/lover/admirer please just sweep her up and whisk her away somewhere for a sexy, loving couple of weeks? That’d do her no end of good. Amen.

The travelling nanny. She's been everywhere. Each time she gets somewhere she mails us a beer coaster from the pub. (She avoids the Middle East because strong-minded female drinkers aren't exactly embraced with open arms.)
The elegant and sexy Ibis bird who hits her target every time, and with the greatest of ease.

Neive is no lout and while she's never won a raffle or a lottery prize in her life, she'd be almost disappointed if she did because life for her is about tapping into the undercurrents that flow below all of us. They involve things like passion, and love, compassion and self-expression. Indeed, you could learn by watching how she goes about it.
Is she the most distractible animal in the Kingdom? For example, she writes lots of letters to her friends, of which she has many, but the envelopes usually arrive at the destination empty.
Nell carries a rifle and pistol, she drinks liquor from the bottle, she wears a face mask and her horse can ride like the wind, which is handy when you consider that Nell is, The Loveable Outlaw!

Nelly arrived here with the First Fleet and she’s just about fed-up of having to wear a triple-layered dress, long sleeves and a bonnet in the middle of the Australian summer. Irrespective of that disaster, she can drive a team of bullocks, build fences, deliver babies and she can manually milk even a disgruntled cow in her sleep.

Neola never talks gobbledegook and she is dedicated, both to her friends and to living her life. Indeed, she performs a rather specific function in the Kingdom in that she acts like a human can opener. Why people hide most of their deeper fears and hopes is beyond us, up here in the commentary box, but people like Neola are a wonderful antidote to those who are uncomfortable talking about such things. The only real hiccup is that when dating, she has this fascinating '100 day policy' – that’s right, she won’t go to bed with anyone until they’ve been seeing each other for 100 days. Talk about getting to the root of your desire! But, we love her and if you ever find yourself doing the same, be it platonically or otherwise, then 100 days is a mere trifle. Let us know how you go…
Regardless – or perhaps, because – she carries a supremely divine personal aura, Nerida is trained in the classical arts and the classical airs.

Nerissa will balk and talk and look over the edge, and whinge a bit, then she'll go back and check her funds, maybe ring a friend, perhaps even ring her mum, but then, when all is said and done Nerissa will TAKE THE PLUNGE every time.  I don't know why she spends so much time inwardly debating it.
Ms/Mrs/Miss Fix It.

Yes, well, there's no question about Nerroli's capacity to get stuck in and get a job done, but does she wear the 'frown of responsibility' too often? As an extremely intelligent and investigative personality, Nerroli abhors laziness and dereliction of duty. If you're a man - or a woman these days - and you marry Nerroli, don't think for a moment you'll be able to hang up your boots and relax for the rest of your life. No way.

Ness is busy and she has a job to do. Maybe it’s motherhood, maybe it’s the business she’s involved in, but she’s never slack and she always feels like she needs a break. When did that last happen, I wonder?

You open the door and there is Nessie, looking like she’s just stepped off a roller coaster. How she fits it all in and stays happy is a testament to her never-say-die attitude. She prioritises well and she needs to, such is the fullness of her life. Someone, please, hand her a drink or better yet, drag her off to that yoga class she’s been talking about for the past six months.

Another skilled hotel concierge. Sure, she’s shagged in most of the rooms but what better way to get to know the place? She thinks on her feet and moves quickly, so it wasn’t like she was ever going to get caught.

Cousin of the male Riley, Neve has it all 'going on', as they say. She's got a heart, she rarely does or says wrong by others, she's cute, she's talented, and she's not caught up in all this modern day ego crap.

No, she's not a face cream you fool! She's a tame polar bear. As gentle and as humble as pie. She's very smart and for some magical reason, no one and nothing in her presence would dream of doing anything to anger or upset her.

No, she's not Bevan and she's not Neville, she's Nevin. Interestingly, however, she does present with a nice blend of hard work and street-savvy nous, as well as the intellectual penchant for detail and proper planning. But why isn't she where she expect her to be?

Honestly, how they pronouce 'Nyree' from that I don't know. Anyway, Ngaire is a wonderful, flamboyant and in-your-face fast bowler in a sport called cricket. Have you heard of it? She rarely does-up her shirt, she tries to put every batsmen in hospital and rumour has it that she set a record for drinking beers on a flight from Brisbane to San Fransisco. No, they don't play cricket in the USA but she got on the wrong bloody plane and decided to make the most of it. These sorts of things happen to Ngaire all the time. Someone ought to make a TV documentary about her.
Yes, more odd Irish spelling. This time it's pronounced ‘Neeve' and it has produced a funny, sarcastic, big-smiley, delightful lady who rocks your socks off.
Nic is an empowered woman who, apart from her generally gorgeous look, is full of true grit. Once she makes her mind up about something, there’s no turning back.

It's rained for 3 weeks solid. The visiting relatives are driving you insane and everyone is cooped up and going stir crazy. Then you have an epiphany: a jigsaw puzzle!! Sure enough, the 5000-piece ensemble of a big old sailing ship lies dormant in the cupboard where it's been for at least 15 years. With a surprising amount of excitement it's brought to the lounge room and so it begins. Six hours later, after what's been quite an enthralling and, at times, surprisingly funny day, the ship is nearing completion. Then, with about nine pieces left, a shocking discovery. "OH NO, IT'S A NICAELA!" someone shouts. And it's true - two pieces of the jigsaw puzzle are missing. Now you remember why it sat up in the cupboard for so long. Oh well, at least it's stopped raining. Amen.

Like many before and after her, she detests her name being misspelt and, despite being an ostensibly good and intelligent person, this spills over into her life in the form of a peculiar kind of impatience.

Yep, her name is spelt weird but don't tell her we ever said that. What it has done however is produce a very independent and intelligent woman. No, she takes no shit from anyone and as an event organiser you wont find anyone more capable. Not particularly loving of tents, bugs or cow manure, we don't suggest you take her camping. Indeed, let her take you around a few of her favourite city restaurants instead. She knows what she's talking about. She's careful who she loves because once she's in, she's in for good.
To carry such as a blasé name can only mean that Nickers has a huge IQ and a determination to get things done. And so it is. Did I mention that she’s also a bit saucy?
Nicky is similar to her more dashing cousin with the short nickname, except that she’s a little more humble, and a little more rural.
Intense and solemn like an encyclopaedia in a library, Nicola means well but she has twisted ideas about men and about the world. With lots of unconditional love, however, she’ll be fine.

In olden times, The Nicole was the name of a quiet prayer uttered by nuns all over the world every Friday night. They prayed that they had the strength to resist the desire to go out and socialise, and to meet boys, but thankfully times have moved on. Nicole’s conservative skin means there are certain behaviours which she will not tolerate in public, remembering of course that this applies only to Nicoles with no other nickname. As such, she is efficient in dealings, she is a fine leader and if she is having an affair you’d never know about it, god bless her.
A busy girl who owns a tobacconist shop.

Okay, now say her name with me, "Nieka, Nieka, Nieka……", and where does it take you? Nieka, Nieka...she nicks down into hard-to-get-to places, sometimes requiring a person to think coolly and very quickly, and to be very sure of themselves. Nieka, Nieka...fresh and zippy clean, her smile washes over you like pouring a cold bottle of soda water over your face in the middle of the desert. Nieka, Nieka...she takes responsibility for herself and others if need be. People love her and rightly so. 
And yes, she was born to keep our jet fighters in the air, although she would have succeeded at flight school had she tried.
Nien is so inoffensive that she puts people to sleep.
She's cool. She's fun. And she ain’t caught up in all this crap that most of us seem to take so seriously.

Really? Mum and dad?....Did you think about calling her Lunchtime as well? Well, deary me, Night, let's hope you are the breezy, jaunty and carefree soul your folks clearly aren't. Are they goths who took too much acid? Anyway, enough about your parents....it seems you are doing alright, Night, and have dodged and weaved your way around the expectation of being a quiet, heavy personality. Indeed, you're kind of normal. 

(But it was close, phew!)
See Nic, although this one has a much higher probability of having blonde hair.

No, she's not in the military but she's the sort of girl who could hack it if she was, even thrive on it. Why? Because she likes to know where she stands, she gets a kick out of achieving goals that actually matter and, secretly, she enjoys being given direction, although she'd never admit to that publicly.

Nikeisha is the name of a very expensive racing yacht. Yes, the rumours are true - she did capsize a few years back in the Volvo round the world classic, and yes, two of her crew drowned because they got tangled up in the mess of ropes and halyards that resulted from the mast snapping, but what do you do? This is ocean racing and it's not always safe. She's been mended, mind, with a new mast and we're hoping the skipper knows what she's doing, this time. Good luck!

Surprisingly, perhaps, Niki is adept at dealing with the finer details. Where some people will neglect/forget the small things (which often comprise the greatest parts of the whole) Niki will not. In that regard she takes her time with many tasks, only because she's not being slack. Niki is rarely in-your-face, but don't presume she hasn't got the nous and/or guts to follow her words with actions. Indeed, she's surprised more than one lover with her hidden passion!

It's not that she's dim, you understand, it's just that she lacks common sense, and that's okay.  Many artistic geniuses down through history have. Is she an artistic genius, you ask? Well, technically no, but did you see her talk her way out of getting that speeding fine last night? It was pure brilliance, so maybe she is?....

Mmmm, interesting. Put it this way, Nikita is an energetic young lass, she's cute and her shoes (when she's in her 'civvies') need to be able to move fast as well as look good. However, Nikita is shocking at taking orders and she is not the person you want in the control room, in the bunker, whose job it is to insert the key into the slot, flick the 'arm' switch and then hit the red 'launch' button. Sure, she's a nice girl, but nuclear armageddon is never far away if she's around. What? You think I'm kidding?...

90% of Nikki’s are blonde – it’s a fact of nature – and men adore them because they are attracted to all bright and shiny objects, and blonde hair reflects more light than most, but don’t be fooled by the cute name. Beneath Nikki’s sweet and sensual exterior is a core that is incredibly tough and flexible. 
(Oddly enough, occasionally it’s the reverse and we love her for it, either way.)

Nikki-Leigh pushes peoples’ buttons and therefore rarely goes unnoticed. Built to deliver the truth, and her idea of what should be happening, NL is confronting to many. Born of bogan parents she quickly rose above that household and became her own woman. Love or hate her, one must admire her uncompromising approach to life. She has no qualms about asking a fellow out on a date, or, indeed, for his hand in marriage.

How can an immoveable object always be so happy and playful? We don't know but it's a fact. Nik Nak is so free and fluid in life that stress and down times simply can't (or very rarely) get a look-in. She gives dull scenarios (and people) about 8 minutes in which to sort themselves out otherwise she's out of there. Another lass who attracts men by the dozens.

With a star sign of a Leo or a Taurus, maybe Scorpio, Nina is a French secret agent. She’s an expert in hand to hand combat, speaks eleven languages, can dismantle a AK-47 in about three seconds flat and she currently holds the record for le bisou du matin – The Morning Kiss. (A race that involves climbing the steps of the Eiffel Tower to the main viewing platform and base-jumping from it.) And she stops any room that she walks into.
Interior designer. Freak-out merchant.
Small things are never worth getting upset over Niska. Not ever, and most concerns are. Yes, you are cute and boys like your bottom, but happiness is your responsibility.

Her assessments of human behaviour, especially those of large groups, are usually pin-point. If she doesn't study law or politics or marketing at a university somewhere then for all we know she might be a Brazilian volley ball player. She's almost certainly got the legs (and by that we mean the height) for it!
Niya is a wonderful breath of fresh air who provides a calming and friendly influence.

There is a rumour that a New Zealand farmer once witnessed a few of his sheep lining up, side on, next to a cattle grid before crossing it by laying down and shunting their bodies over the grill until they got to the other side. So, who says that country creatures can't think laterally?

A stock standard Australian kangaroo. Red or Grey, it doesn’t matter, and she wears an ambivalent smile on her face whether things have gone to shit or not. “Fuck, that’s inappropriate,” she’ll say, if they have. If she lives on the land her schedule looks something like this: flood, make lemonade, flood, make lemonade, flood, make lemonade, flood...you get the picture.

Raunchy, zany and dangerous, not quite. Noelle is guarded and often quite secretive but never without cause. Fiercely independent and capable, Noelle is like an octopus in that she is unbelievably intelligent and she can blend perfectly into any background if a situation warrants it.

Madison Square Garden, New York. There is one round left and the heavy weight championship of the world will be decided in the next 3 minutes. It's been a bruising encounter. The underdog slumps down in his seat in the corner and slugs some water. His dogged little trainer is up in his face in a flash.
"You think you're exhausted! How do you think he's feeling? What do you think we've been doing for the past six months, you and me? Look at me! LOOK AT ME!" she barks at him, nose to nose. The young boxer is almost dead on his feet. He lifts his weary, swollen gaze up to the trainer he loves so much.
"That's it," she says, grabbing him by both cheeks. "Now, you're gonna get out there with heart. You're giant, beating heart! And you're gonna finish this job! Do you hear me, boy?"
"Yes," he says quietly.
"I can't hear you!" Nola screams. "Say it louder!"
"YES!" he yells. "YES!!"
"That's my lad," Nola says, smiling. "Now go out there and bring it home, son."
The young boxer is listening. And he's ready. He stands and, staring at his opponent, he walks back out to the middle of the ring...

The farmer walks into the house, hat in hand, looking meek and sorry for himself.
“Luv, I’ve bogged the tractor again.”
His wife looks at him. “Is it next to that fence I told you not to get near?”
“...yes.”
“Jesus, Jim. When are you going to learn?”
“I won’t do it again luv.”
“Yeah, yeah. Are the keys still in it?”
“Yep.”
“Orright. Well you stay here, take the turkey out of the oven when that timer rings and I’ll be back with the tractor.”
“Thanks Nollene.”
The End.

A staunch defender of the family jewels and morals, Nona cant help but rise to the head of the family. She loves her kids and grandkids with a fierceness rarely seen, even though part of her mantra is encouraging her loved ones to stand on two feet and to stick up for what they believe in, which means dishing out 'tough love'. Is she romantic? Well, she'd probably tell you 'yes', but romance is difficult to slot into a rather hectic schedule.
The name given to the final product in a secretive game of pass the parcel. The question is, who is she? And, will she be worth the wait?

Nonie likes playing a game that is some combination of the one involving her sister, above, with that of her other sister, below. In order to do this one assumes she is interesting, cluey, sexy and a mixture of all the good things. (And just as her sisters are, as a matter of fact).
Nonny is a funny and irreverent soul who loves playing sexual dress-up games. She’s great company and good in a crisis.
Like manure for the garden, Nora is enriching in all but the most obvious of ways.
The outgoing fitness freak and body builder who stands out in a crowd. Gemini.

Picture this: It’s just gone sunrise, mist fills the bottom of the valley and all is peaceful on the farm. Way back at the far end of the property there is a lone bull standing in a paddock. He has a stainless steel ring through his nose and he is a magnificent creature. In the still of the morning haze, he lifts up his great head, takes a long breath of air and then bellows out into the morning chill, “Nooooorreeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeen……??”
Highly competitive with a big ego, Nori-Jae will use all and any means available in order to get her way.
A blessed angel and realist.

Nova works for a world famous motivational speaker and her job is to come on stage first and warm up the crowd. It takes guts, energy, a natural exhibitionistic streak and, most of all, a genuine love of people. She's got all that then some.

Nuria never lags behind. Not ever. Indeed, by the time you catch up to her she's often found a better, quicker route to where you're headed. She has nimble fingers, works very well with small gadgets and she's a dynamite in the kitchen, although watching her won't make you relaxed at all.

Two a’s, mum and dad? Are you for real? Anyway, it doesn’t really matter in this case. You two might be a bit twisted in the head, or at the very least lacking any kind of decent education, but you’ve done well. Why? Because Nyaa is calm, she has time, she has an enrapturing smile and she has the capacity to care for people more than nearly anyone you know. 
Not bad eh?
The quiet and seductive hotel concierge who knows how to deal with problems. Of which there tend to be many...
Nyanda is lovely but she’s too polite to people who don't deserve it.

Forget about the mini-furrows of concern on her brow because Nylah is genuine and agreeable. If anything she's only concerned about YOU, and what you are doing. She takes her time when making important decisions and impulsive displays of rash ostentation are not her. Her intelligence seems to scare off many men but they need not fear. She would benefit greatly from getting in the ocean and ditching her earthly concerns once in a while. Absolutely.
The Nyree is the name of a pub about 3000 km inland, way out near the edge of the desert. Trackers, truckers, roustabouts and outback desert folk go there for beer and steak n’ chips.

Nyssa manages to get large tasks accomplished with a minimum of effort. How does she do this? It might be because she is super-quick at rifling through her address book and directing the right person to the right job. I'm not sure it's a skill that can be learned either. You've got it or you haven't and whatever the knack is, Nyssa has it in spades.

Listen, don’t tell her we said this, for Pete’s sake, but just get her off to drama school. Her name flings itself off into the performing abyss and where it is headed exactly is anyone’s guess. Can she sing? No matter if she can’t, she’ll be right. Don’t let her sign her own contracts though – paperwork and officialdom are not her caper! So, get her an agent and hopefully a good one.
Be it to a romantic interest, a career or an answer to a seemingly simple question, Ocean is nearly impossible to pin down.

Pardon the pun but can she swim? 
Yes. 
Good. Can she count? 
Yes.
Is she a scientist? 
Shit no. 
Is she a little bit shy? 
Yes. 
Is it her parents fault? 
Yes, yes it is. 
Is the happy? 
…Mmmm, she will be soon. She just hasn’t figured out what she wants yet. She will.

October never shaves, which is fine by us up here in the commentary box. All we wish for is that people do what ever it is that makes them comfortable without hurting others. October certainly won't. She's a hippie, she's a pacifist and the only person she would consider hurting is this unfortunate police officer, who is currently trying to unshackle the chain she's used to attach herself to this giant, 2000 year old tree.

How I miss the halcion days of travel before planes took over. Why are we in such a rush to get to the other side of the planet now? Isn't is it so that every second is a journey, filled with as much fun and mystery as you wish to inject into it? Odette is like that. As a dignified old luxury liner she carries her guests across oceans, providing a changing scene most seconds of every day, reminding us to laugh, to sleep and to mingle with our friends. She steers us around bad weather although she'll tear straight into it if she has no choice and, most important, she reminds us to be good to mother earth. Thank you Odette.
"That's enough TV, girl! Time to get outside and move that body!!" (Note: she is the current record holder for the girl who can shove the most number of chocolates in her mouth at once.)

Why is it hard not to envisage Olena in a Parisian flat, lying naked on a couch and getting her breath back while her lover is in the kitchen making her a fresh lemon and iced water. The tall 3rd storey windows are open, allowing a spring breeze to sway the lace curtains gently and to cool her damp skin, while the lazy saturday afternoon traffic outside begins to lull her into sleep.
Amen.

Man, those Eastern European girls pack some punch, don't they? In a past life Olenka was a squadron leader in the Russian air force. Her and her trusty Yak downed more Messerschmitts than almost any other pilot. A newspaper reporter went to interview her one afternoon after another successful sortie. They caught up with her at the bar. She was still dressed in her flight gear, smoking a cigarette and drinking a vodka, straight up. 
“Squadron Leader Olenka, can I talk to you about today's mission and how it's all going, so I can tell our comrades of how well we're doing?" the reporter asked, rather timidly,  
"Sonny, if you buy me a drink I'll tell you whatever you like. Otherwise leave me alone and let me do my job."
Amen.
Trouble.
Olga is big and tough, and as an Olympic discus thrower from St Petersburg, Russia, she needs to be.

You know those big weddings that require several caterers, not to mention a veritable events organiser, given the number of people attending? Well this is the space in which Olimpia is in her element. It's an arena for scandalous gossip surrounded by old family money, for get-togethers with a myriad of friends and family who she almost never gets to see in the same place at the same time, for wearing new ornate dresses that cost her husband an arm and a leg, and for squeezing the cheek of God-knows how many grandchildren. Yep, the noise of such a place drives many people insane, but not our Olimpia. The bigger and the louder the better. As for the clean-up, well don't worry. Daddy organised a company to take care of that too.

“Olive, I have a problem,” you say, and she sits quietly and listens while you tell her your woes. After you have finished she leans forward and takes your hands in hers, and explains how it is, how the world works, and what you can do to make your problem go away. Thankyou Olive.

Should we describe Olivia as a drama queen? Indeed, is it fair to describe anyone as drama queen?
We think it is. Why? Because if no one cried out and carried on, needlessly garnering attention and diverting the spotlight, how boring would life be? Imagine living in a world where no one complained, where no one shouted their euphoria from the top of a mountain at the top of their lungs? It’d be like everyone living in Switzerland where nothing outlandish happens, where all trains run on time and where no one is late for work.  
Life, remember, is a collected blend of light and shade, of noise and heat, of humour and tragedy, and thank Christ people like Olivia here exist, is all we can say. 
So, does Olivia carry on and sulk for no reason sometimes? …Sure.
Does she get excited over the littlest things? …Yep.
Would life be dull without her? …I bloody-well guarantee it. 
Amen.

Olwyn rhymes with, “What, another one? Oh well....alright then.”
As a phrase muttered regularly by midwives, secretaries and personal assistants all over the planet, daily, without her the modern world would surely struggle.

"What? You don't like that?" Oonagh asks through gritted teeth. The man who just told her he wanted to break up with her is currently in agony, lying on the ground with her foot on his neck, his left arm twisted horribly up behind his back. She might snap it at the shoulder, we're not sure. "....are you suuuuure you want to do that?"

He stutters. He tries to speak. He grimaces more and then he mutters, "......aaah....well.....now that I come to think about it....."
Ophelia is a curvaceous woman who seduces young men by telling them that she never wears any knickers.

The name of a huge dining table made out of solid American Oak. She was built where she sits and it takes 10 men to move her now, but by god has she seen some sights? She’s had food and all manner of booze tossed all over her, presidents, queens and the odd homeless person have feasted in her presence, and raunchy guests have fornicated on and under her.

God, has Oriana ever worked a week in her life? Ah, I see, she helped her dad run the vegie shop when she was a little girl. Well I suppose that's something. Then she married that shipping magnate and after her divorce she won't be working anytime soon. She'll be too busy getting ready for that annual ball in Monaco. She's met the prince, you know. She likes him. He thinks Oriana is fun, but she's loud when she's drunk, and you need to keep it together at these kinds of events.

Yes, she's dignified and lovely, whether in public or in private - very insightful, as a matter of fact - and she’s excellent company all round. And that's the thing about Oriel: she always leaves you feeling like she has more to tell or has more laughs to provide, and that you're missing out by not experiencing them. Do you know what I mean?....
The name of a cruise ship who is being skippered by a drunk Italian. What does that mean?…..It means ANYTHING IS POSSIBLE, and I'd keep a life-jacket handy.

Orla is waiting for her cliched Prince Charming to arrive and gobble her up, though you’d never imagine that by observing her behaviour. She works hard and is a fine delegator. In fact, she has become a bit cynical about the whole ‘Mr Right’ thing. (Don’t give up honey. They’re out there - Management.)
Ornella greets strangers like long-lost loves. She adores big gatherings and intimate evenings, and no one believes she actually goes to a thing called work.

I tell ya', Ottilia, how is it that every time you tell a story it takes off like a runaway train? The truth - well, never let it get in the way, as she'll tell you. But, despite her apparently mixed up and slightly confused approach to this thing we call life, she's excellent company and she drives a nice car. Is it hers?

Paige is the name given to a cup of Earl Grey tea that’s been left too long. It would have been lovely had it been drunk sooner but now it’s cold, and is there anything more offensively drab than a cold cup of tea? (Note: If Paige is younger than 35 years old then she is a can of Red Bull. In which case, sure, drink one, strap a camera to your head and jump out of plane inside a canoe. Don't whinge to us if you get hurt.)

Sure, she appears as a crazy and occasionally irresponsible girl, but is she really? For instance, yes, she regularly sneaks out her house to go and party while terribly under age, but at least she's had the good sense to write a comprehensive How-To guide based around this very life. She's no fool you see, and she's quite the entrepeneur. (In the back of the book she writes a small section on who to call if you get arrested and don't want your parents to find out.)
The brunette with quite a mysterious, sensual ‘look’. Doors open for Palma, and that’s fine, but there’s more suave elegance going on here than just her looks, ladies and gentlemen.

“Oh yeah,” she says, with a wave of the hand. "I know the kids will have themselves a party while we're away but, you know, they're good kids and we like their friends. And, anyway, didn't we do that when we were teenagers?"
Pamela picked up a very nice Mercedes Benz from her divorce and she kept the house. She re-married her lawyer.

Pamela-Rose suffers from a condition known as, Magazine Flanulatis. You’ll see them, these poor people, in the queue at the supermarket idly flicking through magazine after magazine. They literally cannot leave without buying one and no number of shrink visits can help them.

A large piece of sweet and nearly over-ripe chunk of citrus fruit. Pamelia has many fans, only a couple of enemies, not that she gives them any thought, and she is in your face if a situation isn't working. Naturally, she's a loud and genuine lover and fake orgasms are none of her business.

(Pronounced Parm-ella). So, another dinner party at Pamella’s house is there? No doubt she’ll pull out all the stops. If it’s anything like last time there’ll be Russian caviar and French bubbles, and more of that foie gras at a million dollars a pound, despite being a morally reprehensible food on every level. Anyway, that’s just the dinner. You should try being one of her children…

Private message from said child: I attend private school in Switzerland and I’m happy, but I hardly even know her. Is that bad? 
To be honest, I think the only reason they whisked us away was so they could fuck in one of the living rooms whenever they wanted, after doing lots of cocaine. They thought we never knew. I still love her though. She’s my mum. :)

Artists sometimes come in the most unrecognisable forms, don’t they? Some  of them are disguised as engineers, others as ground-breaking architects while others are performance clowns, who can take a scene and flip it upside down in a way which is both surprising and brilliant. Pamille is one of these people. To look at her, you may not presume she is capable of great, functional art, given how well she dresses and how eloquently she speaks, but you probably just have to trust us here. She is a wonderful artist, no matter what she does, and that’s all there is to it. Amen.

Yes, well, some names and some people aren't even names at all, are they? Take Pandora for instance. Larger than a person, Pandora is like the view you have when standing on a cliff top that overlooks the valley, the river at the bottom of it and the two or three townships dotted along it's edge as you peer down into the distance. Pandora, Pandora - the name given to a perfectly engaging and holistic view of the world and of life. It's all about peace, you see. And, honestly, what's the rush?
Sensual and giving, let's just pray that Paola never full grows up, ever!
The name of a fancy pair of red knickers.
The General.

Cute, sexy, and blah blah blah. However, you will do well to go out of your way in order to stay on her good side as she is otherwise intolerable. Is she dangerous in this situation?? I don’t know...probably.

Patricia, if she's called that, has certain ideals of behaviour and looks that she upholds. I suppose we all do in our own way, but Patricia is a name that flies up and down these short, steep rock mounds and so she expects a lot. Does that mean she frets over issues that, really, in the grand scheme of things don't amount to all that much? Well, yes it does, but, she's a loving soul and she'd benefit greatly from either yoga twice per week or perhaps even a meditation class once in a while.
See Noel, except it happens while you're at sea on a vessel, so there ain't no recovery this time!

It’s strange, isn't it, the effect some women have on people. Men have thrown themselves off cliffs over Patsy, for instance. Apparently she’s been proposed to at least 40 times. Aside from being basically hilarious, Patsy seems to invite moments of absurd coincidence that are generally the funniest thing you will ever witness. How is that? We don’t know. We just know we love having her around. Thanks Patsy. 
Love Management.
The deceptively potent Leader of the Pack.

Patti-Ann, please don't be too offended about this. It's purely a case of one name arriving into the commentary box before the other. So please head on over to your cousins house, Patty-Anne, and enjoy the show. Thee is they and they is thee. Amen.

"She's out the back," her husband says, all grumpy. He doesn't tell you of course, but they've just had a fight and Patty-Anne has gone out to vent her anger by weeding the vegie patch that she covets. It wasn't a huge fight, they're actually very loving to one another, but Patty-Anne won't back down if she believes in something. When you get to the garden, however, all that anger is long gone. She greets you with a huge smile and a hug, and so what if you've now got a bit of dirt on you. The tomatoes and beans she gives you will be worth it...
Paula is beautiful and she is charismatic, and she only just scraped passed the disaster without getting caught up in it. So, take a breath and relax baby.......you made it!

Paulette bounces around with a cute and sexy smile for any and everyone, and she gives one of the worlds' great hugs, but as much as she adores her kids, she is absolutely useless at helping them with their maths homework.
I know, you'd never pick it by watching her drive a motor car. Paulina is quite a gifted vet. I know, amazing eh?
The very sexy bottle of antiseptic solution. If she’s in a bad mood you need to leave her in the cupboard. If not, well, bloody-well get the gloves on and get cleaning!

Payton ties her hair back so tightly that some of it is beginning to fall out. She thinks it's due to some kind of follicle disease and that is not the case, obviously. If asked why she pulls it back so tight, she'll say that she just likes having things neat.

What a wonderful, chilled-out lady. It's 6am, she's lying in bed having slept pretty well, even though the her kids were out late and, while they're not idiots, like all mums she’s concerned for their welfare. Now they're arriving home in a taxi she decides to get up. By the time they sneak in the front door she's already got the toaster and the kettle on, eager to hear the de-brief from all the fun and frivolity that went on last night. Paz.
Peachy lives for getting tipsy and going skinny-dipping in the middle of the night.
Built to cope with adversity.
No matter how bright it is, she refuses to wear sunglasses. "Now, how would I see the fuckin' ducks if I wore shades?" she asks, indignant, her double-barrel shotgun carried easily on her shoulder.
What a life-giving babbling ball of bloody fun and love and splendid carry-on, she is.

Pela is 19 now. She cruised through high school and got into her preferred course at uni - she enrolled in arts but isn't really sure what she'll finish with - and right now she's on a boat off the Turkish coast. They're heading to Butterfly Valley with a mob she met at the backpackers in Instanbul, a few weeks back. She's the only Australian. She left her Aussie crew in London months ago, coz' she wanted to travel on her own for a while. Not that she ever gets much alone time. She's cute, she's smart, she's funny, she's got a wicked smile and people from all nationalities love her, and she harbours no fear about launching herself out into the world off on her own. It's just how it is.

Pember plump? Rubbish. She's loves the gym and she loves how she feels after a good hard session. This energy and verve are carried over into all aspects of her life, as a matter of fact, and she has a following.

A full-bodied woman who has one of the most powerful voices in the Kingdom. She showers outside in her luscious garden whilst singing to her heart’s content and the townsfolk can hear her from miles away, although they think the same of her as anyone who meets her for the first time: that Penelope is highly talented, incredibly sexy and generally wonderful.
More sensitive than she sounds or seems, Penn is supremely reliable in all manner of situations. Improbably sexy, also. Her high level of intelligence is virtually a given.

Does Penni work herself up into fits of occasional stress and anxiety? Well, yes, sometimes she does. Performance matters, she will tell you, and when she perceives hers is lacking she does fret somewhat. Question is, should we, as outsiders, attempt to do anything about it? There's probably no harm in trying, but Penni has high standards so maybe just encourage her to go about what ever she is doing the best way she sees fit, and offer to rub her feet if she's feeling a little off, afterwards.
Penny is energetic and she means well, never flinching at a poor reaction to one or more of her directions, because who else is going to tell the fools how to behave and/or clean up after themselves?
Gabriela, Isabella and Gisele: Pepper gives these girls a run for their money, any day.
She's putting herself through university (law school) by dancing at one of New York's most exclusive nightclubs. Clearly, the girl can move and, boy, what a smile…

Perinne kind of sneaks around there out the back. She gets things done and she's quite surprising in what she achieves and how she does it, but, like a male Parish, no one ever actually sees her do it. Things just get done almost by magic. It doesn't help that she keeps her fiercest reactions to herself, but this is the life, and this is the mysterious and quite lovely Perinne.

All of us have issues of some variety and Peta’s stem from having to repeatedly prove her femininity to the world. Not that she gives a shit, really, but the result is a tough and independent hombre. Peta is just wonderful.
One feels like one is standing in front of a Roman building built 2000 or more years ago, and out the front is an amazing marble sculpture of a goddess with wings: Petra.

Slightly offbeat, Petrea manages great success in most things she attempts in life. As a somewhat impatient and competitive lass she goes quite hard and the rewards generally follow. However, she is contemplating a few small botox or collagen injections in her lips and her forehead. (Don't do it darlin! Management.)

As a brand new, very expensive and highly motorized Meccano set, Petria is a complicated lass who doesn’t tolerate fools, and who insists that all her screws are done up correctly and in the right order.
Petrina walks the walk, she talks the talk, she’s sufficiently sensually picture-perfect and she takes no shit. You go girl!

Some girls, no matter how dramatic and occasionally idiotic they can be, have their fathers wrapped around their little fingers. She's broken more hearts than the number of hot meals a poor person eats in a year, not that she knows too many of them.
The Prissy Gameplayer.
A staunch catholic.
A doer, not a talker.
Pheona lives for filing things, be it moths in a museum collection, ice cores in an Antarctic research base or her own collection of teaspoons that she has amassed over the years.

There's no other way to say this, but Phil' is a ballsy girl whose got more grunt and get-up-and-go than most men. Gentlemen, you want to woo Phil'? Treat her very well and anticipate that she can look after herself. And, yes, that means you've got to bring a bit more to the table than normal. She can pick a fake a mile away.

Hello Philipa, how are  you? I'd just thought I'd say hello and see how  you're going. Is life fun? You having a good time?....Excellent. Me too. Now, I should come clean here. Truth is, I know you think that the one 'l' is different to the two 'l' version of your name, likewise the multiple 'p', but I have some bad tidings for you. Indeed, I'm only talking to you for this long to keep your attention because, yes, you and your sisters are cut from the same chunk of stainless steel. Remember though that I, we and all of us love you. So, with that in mind, slip on out of here and slide on down to Phillipa for the mail, and if I ever see you out I'll buy you a drink.  True story. Love Management.

Mmm, yes, we're been discussing you and your three sisters up here in the commentary box, Philippa. You're not going to dig this but c'est la vie. We suggest you head on over to Phillipa. Yeah, yeah, we know - the spelling isn't right. Suck it up baby. Life could be so much worse. And like we say, we'll buy you a drink if you ever drag your ego up here into the box. Management. x

Phillipa has the annoying habit of answering other peoples’ questions for them, especially when she’s bored. As a child she insisted that all of her friends play her games exactly as she intended and, in adulthood, nothing much has changed. (…oh come on Phil’…..that’s funny!)

Her father is certifiably insane, which explains why Phoebe is as complicated as she is. So it’s not her fault, classically speaking, but Phoebe is pretty cool. Keep an eye on her if you like, but she’ll be fine.

How can a person emulate what it is to be a phoenix, I ask you? It takes a while for her to find her feet in the world because all this attention and hype makes her avert her eyes, and makes her think inwardly about who she is and what she wants. In that regard maybe her parents did her a favour? The boys up here in the commentary box suspect she'll be used as a substitute late in the game when her guile and natural agility will take most of her opponents off guard. She might even be a secret weapon...
Phyllis is as rough as guts but she hugs harder than anyone.
Maximally attentive and lovely, Pia exists here in this moment, all the time. It’s an impressive skill.

Pierina is like one of those dignified flamingos who possess style and grace. Many people would say she has a decent sized ego and that maybe true, but don't forget that without a strong belief that you are going to do well, chances are you won't. Sure, she seems aloof once in a while but only if you're an idiot, so who knows, maybe her behaviour is doing you a favour? She'll never be homeless and she'll never be bankrupt for long, that's for sure.
Pieta has a very healthy scalp and she's not prone to wastage.
Her kids are polite and outgoing, and they take calculated risks, which says everything about this woman. Pina is strong-willed, sexy and lovely and not to be taken lightly.
Perfect to take into battle, Pip is passionate and single-minded, her decisions are made in a flash and her general level of sexiness makes the outcomes of such decisions even better….generally.

Interestingly, Piper is the middle sister of Pip and Pippa. As a man called Alby in a past life, she runs the rorts, takes the cash, laughs hard with the cops who she's in cahoots with, and generally has a rip-roaring time from start to finish, no matter what she's up to.

Borderline adrenaline junkie. As one of the few female bullfighters in existence, she loves being in the centre of the arena where her decisions really matter, and where she can singlehandedly thrill the crowd.
Pixie is the name of a special type of cardio-toxin. If ingested even in tiny quantities you'll laugh so hard that you end up having a fucking heart attack.
Wonder Woman – and we’re talking the invisible jet, the legs, the playful smile, the physics degree etc etc. An she’s more than happy to share a joke with the boys.
Po is centred, spiritually content and intelligently poised, and all of this makes her even more attractive than she already is. Indeed, Po deserves a round of applause....
See Po.

You wake up really late and leap out of bed before running out the door while still half asleep: this is called the Polly Moment. It feels crazy, painful and illogical at the start but everything turns out to be wonderful in the end. It always does.
Supremacy in the bedroom: this is what Pollyanna likes. (For her, that is.) Otherwise her and Monica are very close cousins.
Poppy is hard to miss and impossible to ignore. She has excellent posture and she always gets what she wants.
I know, it's almost a cliché but what can you do. Portia is magic dust and you don't see it everyday.
Way more potent than the male version, Possum is watchful and ready. Funny as fuck, as well, but she can jump into action in a flash.

Indian, and no, not the American horse-riding variety. Prakaash is as physically gorgeous as she is funny and skillfully business-minded. She has a lightning wit, can turn tragedy into success in a flash and she treats all people equally. Prakaash probably needs to be in politics, but she wouldn't tolerate the ego-filled cock-heads she’d be surrounded by, and we don’t blame her. God bless you Prakaash, and be he/she/they Hindi Gods or otherwise.
Prima donna.
A single-minded bird of prey who is both starving and impatient, so lookout!!

The attendees of that New York fund raising dinner, last year, are still talking to their shrinks about her. Prickles never goes formal, normally, but she was convinced to rock along by a man who didn't know her well. So, there were 20 people at the table and someone had just begun to give a speech - the mayor may have even been there - when her date whispers something in her ear in answer to her quiet question about the drinks. At his response, she frowns hard and looks around at her fellow guests.
“What?” she says aloud, stopping the orator in his tracks. “None of these tossers drink beer? What kind of a bullshit dinner is this?”

Princess is one of the most potent female names and not just anyone can pull it off. Indeed, it’s not possible for an individual to carry the name Princess, and not actually be some kind of Princess. In short, Princess is physically and spiritually beautiful and, without doubt, she is one of the funniest human beings you’ll ever meet.
Naive but completely honourable.

Oh shut up with your whinging and give it here,' she says to her useless husband. She grabs the shovel, pushes him out of the way and says, 'This is how you dig a trench. I'll do the first two metres and you can do the rest. If you don't do it right I'll come back out here and slap you over the head.'

Oddly enough, the majority of gals called Pru end up in either law or politics.

What an amazing irony. Anyway, if Earth is ever visited by aliens in a humungous fucking spaceship one day then be rest assured that, no matter what the inhabitants of such a craft are like and no matter why they are here, the name of the spaceship will be, The Prudence. She's looks odd, she's kind of sexy in a way that makes you want see what it's like to rub your face against her, and while she appears harmless enough, you're pretty sure that you don't want to piss her off any time soon. Prudence.

Prue was born on a planet that exists light years from earth and she arrived here in a space ship, which is why she might seem a little odd. Nowadays, having never acclimatised to our stronger gravitational field, she is always very thin and she struggles with any kind of physical exertion. This actually provides her with great comfort for so long as she is thought of as being anorexic and frail she will always be thought of as being human, and this is all she ever wanted. (She’s not the least bit dangerous.)
The perfect English host in the ideal English garden, unless you earn less than £200,000/year, in which case she'll sick the dogs onto you.

What a splendid, mischievous little mystery she is. Never satisfied with the veneer of a project or a person, and forever the cheerful optimist, Qew is very adept at seeking and searching for those hidden little corners of humour, life or intelligence. She loves being surprised by things. Boys love her too, although her independence might scare a few of them off, initially.

She shares her male counterpart’s intelligence and unusualness, except that she is so ideally happy within herself and her world that she almost belies belief. Quentin is amazing. She would have made an excellent grief counsellor.

Dripping with heartbreak? Had your innards torn out by the deeds, deceit or dastardly actions of another? You better go on over to Quill’s house. She may not be able to cure you but she’ll at least help with the first step. She’s sensual, she’s happy and she’s an optimist. In fact, go over and say hello even if you’re fine. 
The End.

As Quinn’s close cousin she shares similar traits: she’s thoughtful, she looks more serious than she is and her long and languid frame is admired from afar my many, but this one is better at finding her passions and making them happen. We have no idea how or why one letter can make such a difference.

The fact that Quinata did well at school and then went on to university was no surprise to anyone. The free-wheeling artistic life was never quite her, although had she attempted it she probably would have been quite successful there also. What you may not hear is Quinata orgasming from a mountain top. Then again...

Quinn is softer than her male counterpart but is she a sensitive loner? Do still waters run deep or do they just sit there? Just be a little mindful here everyone, for Quinn might take some time to get to know.

The name of an age old song that is sung by Turkish goat herders. The song speaks of nights under the stars, of the hope of green pastures and water over the next hill, and of the reminiscing about old friends.

Nah, she’s not unlucky. Well, maybe once in a while, but after much deliberation the panel here has agreed. Why they changed their mind we’ll never know - smoking too much pot, perhaps. Anyway, forget all that. Rachael is and always was, The Queen of Small Bikinis, and the The Queen of Eroticism. 

The End. (….phew.)

The question is, of course, how can we organise it so Rachel never has to work? Where have we seen her this year? Well, so far she's been on the back of a float at the Berlin Love Parade, dressed in a tiny blue bikini with angel wings and lots of makeup and surrounded by other gorgeous girls who may actually have been transexuals; I saw pictures of her when she was in Rio for Carnavale, except this time she was part of a large dance troupe shaking it down the street, and just last week she was back on a float again, this time at the Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras in Sydney. 

I'm beginning to see a pattern emerge here. I like it.
Rachelle is continually being offered $$$ and gifts from much older men.
Racquel is cute and she's got spunk, but she's not really the camping/outdoors type. It's the creepy-crawlies that freak her out, you see.
Like Rosco, she only really comes to life when there's the threat of blood being spilt. But then, HIGH KARUMBA!!!

Correct, she's Eastern European, originally, and her sensual magnetism means that she will always need to slash through the men in her life who are unconsiously gravitated towards her, as if she is hacking her way through a dense tropical jungle.

Boxer. She turned pro three years ago, wins every bout inside two rounds and carries a mean right hook. As a tough man in a recent past life, she’s desperately sad that she can’t urinate without consequence while standing up, in this one.

Raelene sticks her head out the back door with a cigarette in one hand, a rum and coke in the other, and screams at her five dishevelled-looking children in the back yard, “GET OFF THE CLOTHES LINE.... AND UNTIE THE BLOODY CAT!”

Raewyn is that lass who, had she entered the dramatic life, would now be a world-famous stand-up comic. Her sense of humour is drier than a decent-sized desert, she divvies out advice and jokes without even knowing she's doing it and she's currently masquerading as a Post Office clerk. In actual fact she's a non-licenced clinical psychiatrist and the post office allows her to meet, befriend and, more importantly, assist thousands of people without them realising it. And all for the price of a stamp. Nice one Raewyn.
Manuela's sister. Enough said, really.
The Gorgeous Mountain Lion.

Maybe she’s Maori maybe she isn’t, but she calls a wanker a wanker, she does anything she pleases and she couldn’t give a flying fuck what the reaction is. It’s women like Raiha who could teach those fundamentalist Muslim fools a thing or two. She has a big laugh, she’s dangerous when she’s drunk and, so, yes, we’re thinking she might be a Maori after all. God bless!

Ever tried to eat a mango in the nude with your hands, while bouncing on a trampoline? No, we haven't either, but if you did you'd be laughing the whole time, as well as making a glorious, crazy mess. And isn't that why we're here on earth?...to make a big, loud, silly, planet-friendly mess that makes us all laugh with (and at) one another? Rajeshni.

Ramana always wanted to act. That's what that tiny scowl in between her eyebrows is - it's all the pent up frustration of imagining what might have been. Ramana, remember though that all those moments passed have got you to here. Apologies for the cliche but tomorrow is a blank cheque and on the grapevine I've heard that the local theatre group needs a strong, female lead for their next play. Want their number?...
Dramatic. If she ever cries about anything you can hear her wailing from down the street.
No fear - she's probably got that tattooed on her arse somewhere, and it encompasses both her physical and moral courage.
Rani runs her own race. She's a quiet lass who many judge, incorrectly, I might add, as being nearly solemn. She just knows who she is. Do you?

Like a double-sided mirror that is perfectly clean and with extremely sharp edges, Rania is two-faced and vindictive in her ignorance. So, Rania, forgive me, but some advice……walk up to the nearest mirror. Get up close, so close you can see every pore in your skin, now look into your own eyes....have a deep long look. Do you see that little girl in there? Do you see how much love she's got for the world? And there you have it - go get that little girl!!
There ain't nothing slow or low about this lass. Whatever she does she does it better than 96% of the population.
There’s no one looking is there? Quick, let's go for a swim!
Rasa seems to know these strange little techniques that, while hardly applicable in the western world, could save your life if you were ever caught out in the jungle, alone.

Raylee has tons of energy and she needs something to get her teeth into - be it  work, a hobby or some form of artistic expression. She's no politician or philosopher, which is why sitting idle does her head in, as well as those whom she lives with.

She's not autistic, although there is a rumour that all of us are, just a little bit, although Raynee's attention is difficult to maintain. It's either because of her mental condition or more likely because she's no fool and she gets bored at the drop of a hat. Keep her occupied, keep her thinking and she'll be great.

Utterly capable and calm, Raynor is a shark hunter. Yes, shark hunters are a dying breed and fair enough - god knows the oceans need our help - but she'll slip into the on-land life of the savvy wheeler and dealer, no worries. Needless to say she doesn't tolerate idiots.
See Rebecca.

Rebecca is a gifted intellectual who should be making the most of her excellent upbringing. Far sexier than anyone might gauge from just looking at her, and like Mary before her, Rebecca can be a wonderful dark horse. However, there is a chance that she is actually a race horse wearing blinkers, in which case she can be incredibly frustrating, if not completely deluded. See how you go...
See Rebecca, just.

Big fish in a little pond, she may once have been. But to be honest, Rebekah today is just nice. She's polite, she's precise, she's attentive and she has plenty of friends. Best of all, she's young at heart.
Rebekka’s parents live in Hicksville, and their notion of a wholesome evening meal involves chips, coke, donuts, lollies and icecream.

Now here is a fiery competitor, a brilliant strategist and a person who barely wastes a second. As it happens, Rebel's name makes her exactly not what she sounds like, which isn't to say she deliberately goes against the grain (or the system)  - she has no chip on her shoulder and she's comfortable in her skin, so she has nothing to gain from being the centre of attention - but she knows what she wants, and she has the wherewithal and the nous to follow her ambitions. And don't worry, if she needs to rub people up the wrong way in order to get shit done, then so be it.

The world deems Rechelle to be a naturally glittering superstar Goddess of a persona, who simply doesn’t feel like have anything to do with the music industry, and whose smile and nature gravitate people and energy toward her. Rechelle, on the other hand, thinks she’s just Rechelle. (Both parties are correct.)
Wow!...... Just.. Wow.

Are we likely to find Reese at a 10-day vipassana mediation retreat?
Maybe not.
Are we liable to stumble upon Reese in the emergency ward at 3am having her stomach pumped?
Thankfully, no.
Do we expect to see Reese hiding from the camera, off to the side, as one of the minister’s best and most trusted advisors at his or her press conference?
Yes, yes you will.
As a fully-fledged rocker, she's seen Metallica in concert more than anyone.
Regi is open and loving, and ready to rock n’ roll at a moment’s notice.

Regina is closely related to Rebecca, except  she has the skill and the determination to spend hours, days and years at her chosen creative task. Success is usually the result. Her moods are greatly affected by the weather.

Rehana is the powerful clan leader. It wouldn't matter is she was deaf, blind or mute, she would still fulfil the role perfectly and would be revered and loved by everyone just as she is now. Personal gain and glory don't come into play here.
The Healer.
Gifted. Effervescent. Loving
Like many Y's, Remy's enourages her to turn around and look inwardly on her search for peace, love and enlightement. Remy is a gem in the making, you just watch...

Rena is a lovely lady but she's a little intense sometimes. Is it some kind of Hero Curse that she's carrying? No one is sure. Meditation might assist problems to pass through her, rather than getting stuck in her belly, making her feel like she has to do something about them immediately, but she’ll get there. The fact she kicked her last boyfriend out of the house in a very calm and amicable way probably suggests that she’s there already…

Back down? Renae? Are you fucking serious? Here is a girl who hesitates rarely, who secretly loves the sound of someone shrieking in horror or surprise, and who looks for (and finds) solutions quickly and easily. Yes, occasionally her methods are questionable but she hasn't killed anyone yet who didn't deserve it. And yes, she's quite the party host when she feels like socialising.

Renata loves new stockings: They can look terribly sexy and dramatic if worn well, and in the case of hunting young men, which, let’s face it, is something of a wonderful pastime of hers, they’re fun and easy to tear off.
Renate is a full-blown rabble-rouser. So tap her on the shoulder and then stand back!

Don’t overrule her if you can help it. Rene gives her all when her heart is in it, so don’t put her off with an early critical call. The trick for her (just as it is for many) is to prudently disregard most of the life-advice society and friends might subliminally give to her, about how to live her life. 
Find your own feet girl, they’re just fine: this is the message from the boys in the commentary box today. 
(And prospective lovers and others: you’ll be hard pressed to find a more devoted partner.)

The Pakistani bus that’s full of people and careering down a mountain road, having lost the function of its brakes. The 70 people crammed on board are screaming in horror because they know that they’re about to die a bloody and violent death. And they’re right. They do. (What they may not be aware of, however, is that Renee, the bus, loves a bit of comedy intermixed with life's usual offering of tragedy. "Why be boring?" she'll tell you, on her way past you to the valley floor.)

Agitated and confused....well....sometimes, but it's not her fault, usually. You see, Renelle seems to attract idiots, which can be unfortunate. She's learned to cope of course, and her radar has improved as she's gotten older, but the side-effect of all these weirdos is that it has filled her life with funny and absurd memories which she wouldn't trade for anything. Likewise, her kids aren't into books and they are loud.

The graceful artist. You can find her curled over her work in quiet concentration, forgetting the world while she strives, but all of us wait for her to leap up and burst into bloom. What a day that will be.

Okay, so things got slightly out of control last night. That ass hole gate-crashed the party and he wouldn't take no for an answer. We tried to be polite but some people (in this life) reach a moment where all their karma comes back to visit them in one go. And it happened to this joker last night.
Perhaps it was lucky for us he was from interstate? Anyway, after a ridiculous set of unfortunate coincidences, he was accidentally run over by the ute and killed. What do you do? So, yes, I suppose we could have called the cops but what's the point? A fuckwit died in the manner that he lived, and so the universe will take care of him in the next life. At least, this was Rennae's theory and who were we to disagree? She's way smarter than us. Hence, at her suggestion, we dug a hole, took a vow of silence and may he rest in peace.

Renni is a delight. Yes, she's very similar to her soul sister Rennie, but the missing e gives her that tiny edge in the artistic stakes, the romantic stakes, and the messy bedroom and kitchen stakes. Amen.
Rennie doesn't pulverise projects, she sneaks up on the them from the angle no one thought of. Which means she wasn't wasting her time after all…
Was she conceived in Nevada? Either way, Reno is articulate, punctual and efficient like a sexy little arrow, which has been aimed very well.

Like the soothing sounds of a babbling brook, Reshma is the wise and peaceful rock for those that are lucky enough to know her. No, you won’t see her throwing her knickers at a rock star performing on stage in front of her, but you could easily see her receiving a bravery award for saving the life of a drowning man she happened to spot while she was walking her dog along the beach.
Resi burns incredibly brightly but not forever. She’s a knockout in a scarlet dress.
Another astronomer. Black hole researcher.

No, not many can do this and that makes sense. It takes a unique blend of calm, impatience and focussed energy to decapitate an unopened champagne bottle with a sword cleanly, god bless her. (Note: Rexina treats all men/lovers, employees/employers the same way.)
Rhani is gentle, sensual, agile and noble. She might even be a little bit too gentle.....

Rhelma always starts well and with a definitive sense of direction. Yes, it’s true, she’s often loses momentum or finds herself a little lost, but at least the intent is there at the beginning. I think the only problem, if one exists, is that she believes most of what we humans get up to is a waste of time, so why worry if you get lost later anyway?
See Robert.

Rhianna doesn’t mind a bit of niggle. Yes, society tries to brainwash the female parts of her brain into buying god-knows how many different types of makeup and skin applications, but that crap doesn’t really absorb into her deeper psyche. Rhianna is quite the crusader when she wants to be.
She’s quiet and she’s not, and her seductive eyelashes hide a more acute acumen than is visible to the eye. Secret schemes are afoot here and she camouflages her controlling nature very well.

Her parents could have named her Theta, Gamma or Psi, and the result would have been similar. Rho is an unusual, specially educated and eclectic woman who deals with things like publishing houses and production companies, and who enjoys the finer things in life.

Rhominy usually acts without thinking, which is great if you're about to dive into a water from a very high tower (I mean, how many people die from deliberately doing that? Surely none, right?) but not if you've gone to the zoo after snorting a line of cocaine and suddenly feel like hugging the lions.
A normal lady who has led an interesting life and raised a proud family. She lives for scrabble.

The hopeless romantic. If you believe in reincarnations, then understand that Rhonda had been around many times before, although she’s still desperately searching. She seems very close to achieving what she’s always wanted but will this life prove to be the one? She does have lots of beautiful thick hair though – that’s nearly always a given.

Boy, doesn't she love it when people try and spell her name with only one 'd'. Anyway, Rhondda is no stooge because she leads from the front. Yes, the one 'd' version might be something of a hopeless romantic, but not this Rhondda. She's more like a bull rider who, despite a twisted ankle and a cracked rib from an fall earlier in the day, is chomping at the bit to get out into the arena again. "Pain is all in the head," she'll tell you. Indeed, there are no prissy little shy girls here, folks.

Normally the crew up here in the box are always very concerned when we meet a player with a silent 'h' in their name. Yes, we know, some of you parents like to do things differently these days and Christ knows there's no accounting for taste, let alone the institution some of these poor people end up spending time in, later in life, but here we see a positive outcome. Phew! Sure, Rhylee is forced to spell her name at least three times each week, but she's okay with it. She knows her parents are abit dippy, and this self-awareness has produced a quirky young woman who is comfortable in her own skin, who speaks her mind, and who is more compassionate than she lets on. Not bad eh?

Another not to be underestimated, Rhyll is rarely impulsive. She expects to attend university and she expects to do well. Many people enter higher education but few wind up being a leader in their chosen field. Rhyll is one of these people.

Never the fusspot and rarely under duress, Ria slips into gear quickly and without fanfare. She mingles easily with a vast cross-section of humanity and in doing so she is a supreme maitre d' at the best restaurant in town. (Note: Maybe it's a nickname, maybe it's her name - it matters not. Ria is one of those ladies who rule the roost, and she does it via a natural loving of everyone, and a deep sense of fun and enjoyment. Thanks Ria.)
The Examiner.

The fast-moving manager of the local high-end clothes shop for ladies. Yes, she looks sleek and sensual, and she can turn on the charm, but she also has a finger on the pulse of what's going on around town, how she can do better, and how her strategies and marketing ideas can be improved. Oh yes, and she MUST go on holiday at least once a year, otherwise what's the point?

Ricki is up there with Shazza, Liz and Jackie with regards to how she deals with the world. It's rarified air up here, no question, and not many can handle it. Ricki can deal with frost-bite, she can deal with sharks, she can deal with starvation, but what she struggles with is shy or insipid people. Oh yeah, and she just loves meeting up with bullies.
Rie is one of those rare individuals in the Kingdom who exudes a strange and electric aura that calms, soothes and rejuvenates. That makes her something of a Goddess.

Cabbage soup (Hang on!! I know! Why don’t we all just move to Alabama, go on the doll, eat nothing but quarter pounders and start shootin’ stuff?). Note: If Rihanna was over the age of 25 years old by 2017 then forget all that, for she is absolutely lovely. (It involves Fleetwood Mac, and it’s a long story...)
Rikki is in your face.

If Riley were a migrating goose she'd be somewhere near the front of the 'V', telling the leader where they should be headed as well as what landmarks to keep an eye out for. The whole while telling jokes and keeping everyone sufficiently motivated during the journey. Riley.

True, Rimini spends a lot of time off in her own little world, but she's never lost a game of hide and seek in her life. What she should do is ditch all of these STUPID men she keeps meeting, and find herself a REAL man. (i.e: someone who is genuine, and caring, and strong, and funny, of course.)
Optimistic. Unpredictable. Never home.
With a name similar to a famous Sicilian gangster, Rina is a well-oiled, beautifully maintained, seductively intriguing and absolutely lethal cross-bow.

How is it Rinra always accomplishes quite a lot without actually looking like she's doing very much? For example, she pops down the shops for only 20 minutes yet she returns with, not only enough supplies for the house for a week, but with the news that nine people are coming to dinner this Friday night, three people are interested in buying her next product line and she's off to New Zealand Thursday week to meet a supplier/purchaser. Weird eh? The men/lovers in her life can barely keep up with her.

As an attractive woman with very angular features, Rita lives a streamlined life. She recognizes yet-to-be-friends in an instant and lavishes them with love and attention, while she is polite to those she deems a fool. Rest assured, however, that people in the latter category mysteriously find themselves never encountering her again. It’s one of her great skills.
A Russian pistol. Sometimes it even works well, but there is no subtlety here at all kids. Riva is sexy and in your face, and just be advised to handle with care.

Man, look at her go! She darts here, she runs over there, she goes out at night and you've no idea where she is. Lucky her street nous is pretty good, eh? Her name bounces at you like a well-struck hockey puck and this is how she arrives into most peoples’ lives. She always therefore leaves a lasting impression!

Ro doesn’t have time or the inclination to buy things like sexy skirts, expensive perfume or matching underwear because she’s too busy getting-on and dealing with the things that matter – ie. friends, jeans, beer etc.

Ignorant? Not a chance. Roanne is no fool, she lines her plans up like she's been organising some of this stuff for years. It actually comes quite naturally. True, she doesn't suffer fools and she's never afraid to tell some fuckwit to just get the fuck out, although that situation rarely happens anyway because her radar for twits is pretty good. Oh yeah, the other thing - if you're a man and you ask her to go camping with you, don't expect her to sit around and be impressed by all your gear. In that scenario she's a hands-on chick and she's here to help make shit work properly. Your car need winching? A fire needs building? You'd be mad not to ask her to help, although you probably won't have to anyway.
Robbie gives her all. If she's into fishing then she doesn't catch many although she does love and adore the peace and quiet of the river.
Roberta rhymes with Out There. Commercial pilot, cigar smoker, deep-sea diver and tattooist for a while; she’s done it all. But (mothers, fathers, boyfriends and others) don’t expect her to marry.
Robin lives on a farm in Poland that grows potatoes when the soil isn’t frozen. She has short hair.
The name of a magic balm that you rub on your belly. The effect is a strange yet pleasant tingling and your knees start to move.

Perhaps she's just lucky, but among her many attributes is the fact that Robyn harks from a generation that has never heard of Facebook, or Twitter, or Youtube, sometimes even the internet. What does all this mean? Well, Robyn deals with human, living people and she has a heart. In fact, we've been analysing Robyn's game for some time now, and we've finally understood why she wins the Best Clubman every year: Robyn puts the needs of others before her own. And just imagine what would happen to the world if we all did that?
Oh Rochelle......she’s lovely but what’s all this fussing about??

Rodelle never gets flustered. She can run a business, give a splendid toast, tend a snakebite, deal with a car crash victim and jump out of a plane, and all the while she does the best she can and has as much fun as possible. And if she was named Rodelle because her parents were Rodney and Elaine, then she’s even better than that. She’s always been good with men.

Interesting, isn't it, how in a very short space of time a group of people will naturally gravitate to one or two amongst them who seem to have a greater awareness and intelligence than the rest. And she's cute. And on that note, I think the defence rests. Nice work Rohani. (Note: As a lover, she takes her time.)
