And here we have another one of those girls whom everyone adores. EVERYONE. Friend, lover or stranger, it matters not. Her mind moves quickly and smoothly around the most intractable problems and if she bats her eyelids at any fellow they are basically gone-for, almost immediately.
Róise behaves like a queen who has been accidentally dropped into a tiny out-of-the-way town with no money and no assistants, and where no one knows her.

Roisin (Pronounced Row-sheen) is a nice enough girl when you get passed the sheep manure, because though she’d never admit it - I mean, who could?- a part of her expects strangers she meets to bend ever-so-slightly at the knee. We understand that some people call this a curtsey but as I say, once you're passed that crap she's great.

Well, I suppose it's better than La Paz. (Roma's mum, La Paz is in Bolivia. You can find where that is by looking at a thing called an Atlas.) Be that as it may, Roma is a quite a handful for boyfriends. She can't, and nor should she, be controlled, although a small amount of self-control might do her the world of good.

So, do you really think Romani walks upstairs to the party? Crap. She tears up the stairs on a 600cc dirtbike and does a wheelie through the house, ending in the kitchen. "Right! Where's the champers kids?"

Yes, she spells her name at least a dozen times each week and she is no near as free-wheeling as her close cousin, Romani, who at this moment is in court. Anyway, Romany always looks late, which might explain she seems to rush and not idle casually between venues. Clunky in love, although in later years her luck will change.
Romee spends more time at play than nearly anyone - even in adulthood. If ever trapped in an office she slowly deteriorates until eventually crumbling to dust, like a vampire caught in sunlight.

Very bright and extremely dedicated, Romilly loves her job inside the Minister's office but don't even think about getting her on board for that smear campaign you've been talking about. Romilly wants to do good in the world - I'm quite serious - so take that trash idea somewhere else. The End.
Ever been attacked by a lioness?
A gifted sculptor who ended up getting a scholarship into Paris's most prestigious art school. Adored by Frenchmen.

Ronalda is a no-nonsense character and the name of the head maid at the mansion. She has about 10 staff who work under her, she knows all about the private lives of the lord and lady who live upstairs, she can handle their children better than they can and she bloody-well just gets on with things. Thank God someone does, eh?

The name of a poorly-maintained lawn mower which produces so much noise you need to wear double-insulated ear muffs. The problem is that she revs too high and the throttle doesn't exist. So even if you're just trimming a short growth she howls at full throttle, threatening to tear off down the street. It's a tragic waste of energy really but what can you do? And she's good looking machine as well.

Ronella is like Julie Andrews in the 'Sound of Music'. As a well-travelled, wise, affectionate and generally humourous nanny, she cares more about the children than the bloody parents. Teaches them more, too. She attends to the chores around the house like a big rumbling boulder, crashing from room to room. It's actually pretty funny to watch.
Gorgeous and seductive, Ronelle is so cool that she’s got the letter ‘R’ tattooed above her right breast.

Thing is, it's not that she's rude, you understand, but who wants to stand around waiting for stuff? So, if you and her are going for a drink, take my advice - give her the money, stand back then just follow the path she carves through the crowd. She somehow manages to push people out of the way without them even knowing about it.
Tall, slim and slender, Ronnie is as beautiful as she is temperamental. She might even be incredibly temperamental, if not highly prejudicial.
Roo is a sensual woman who gets shit done, primarily because she operates completely under the radar.

In the movie, Pulp Fiction, Harvey Keitel plays a character called the Wolf, who comes in to clean up a catastrophic mess with a determined ease, and with style. Had they made the movie in Australia and called the (female) character Ros or Roz, instead, nothing would have changed.

Rosa is short in stature, of Italian descent and she has beautiful eyes. However, DO NOT anger her unless you feel like being on the receiving end of a beating.  
(Hello Rosa, you look wonderful, by the way! xx)

Rosalba has a powerful sex drive, then again she has a powerful drive for everything she does. She doesn’t lose many arguments, the notion of preparing a big luncheon for 30 people only fills her with delight and she continually dares her children (as well as her friends, truth be known) to be unwaveringly BOLD!
Rosaleen loves a good hot dog stand. (Where's Frankie when you need him?)

Her name starts off okay then it immediately crashes awkwardly – in the same way that you might turn and walk away from a friend that you happened upon while you were down the street, trip over the edge of the curb that you forgot was there, fall onto the road and be hit by a cyclist who is travelling fast enough for them to break your arm. (At least it’s not a car, or something bigger.)
The metaphorical water carrier for the entire tribe. She might not be married to Graeme, but they make excellent cousins.
Yeah, I know, it pisses you off that you get mixed up with Rosalind but so what? You're both great. So, Rosaline, please see Rosalind. (Love, Management.)

Disorderly and lawless, I don't quite think so, although in her younger day she did indeed drive across England one drunken night in hot pursuit of a young man, pissed as the proverbial skunk. I suppose we all get a little bit wise in the end. Thing is though, Rosamund always has this cheeky streak running just beneath the surface. Yes, she tells the kids off when she needs to these days, and she makes sure the family ship is always in order, but give her half a length of playtime and Christ-knows what she'll be up to. Rosamund loves to break the shackles because she fully understands that this thing we call life is a remarkable game, and that you can't take your assets with you when you go.
High maintenance, no limits and great fun to hang out with 69% of the time. You can always sleep later. She's won two MVPs over her career and, man, she’s got the scars to show for it.

Spiritual, sensual and highly intelligent, Rose has a big personality. She is the kind of girl who rides a very old pushbike, and who has no compunction in kicking men out of her bed as soon as she has finished with them.

Roseanne hasn't lived some kind of cloistered life. She loves getting her hands dirty and she loves getting her teeth into projects, people and weird situations. Indeed, have you been bitten by her lately? If you have, fear not. She carries no diseases and her teeth are clean.

Roselee takes ages at the supermarket these days because she's so choosy. She pines for the old days when bread was bread, milk was milk and the breakfast cereal section had only three varieties, not 30.

"Oh don't be silly Roselyn," she says to herself, when part of her brain suddenly imagines her jumping naked out of a cake at the Christmas party, next week. Accounts is full of such boring people, she thinks. She imagines the scene again and looks over her shoulder to ensure no one is listening before smiling, and turning red with embarrassment. "...can you imagine if I did that?" she whispers.

If planning for a major event and someone runs inside in a state of panic over some dramatic piece of news that means everyone needs to change their plans, possibly even cancel the event, rather than freak out, Rosemaree will first slap the person in the face to calm them down (she knows very well panic is a destructive contagion) then calmly begin delegating in a methodical manner, and in such a way that those around her think she knew it was going to happen the whole time. And yeah, here’s another lass who loathes mispellings of her name. What can you do?

Always pressed for time, Rose-Marie barely has time to think about things like sex. Why is that, lass? Is there too much on your plate? Do you spread yourself a bit thin? Here, come and sit down and stop talking for a second. Shoosh, just stay here and I'll get a cup of tea. How many sugars? Six? Really? Jesus, no wonder you're exhausted when you get home...

Whenever Rosemary walks into the room, if you listen closely, you can hear the angels trumpet her arrival from above. In reality, however, and unless you have the hearing of a beagle, you will only be aware of the sound as a subliminal and inner sense of peace, happiness and relief.

Rosetta has a spring in her step and expects plenty from her kids, her friends and her lovers. Life passes too quickly to sit idly by and do nothing - so she says. Strangers love her grin and her energy and even a short trip to do the shopping can take a while. By the way, not just any partner will do for our Rosetta, and he better be able to stand up for himself.
An extremely rare and very expensive shotgun.

Her name sticks in your mouth like a sesame seed caught up the back between molars that you can feel but are unable to get to with your tongue. The result is a woman who struggles on but doesn't seem to laugh and enjoy her life as much as she should.
What a chick. Rosie is a modern, extravagant, fun-loving legend who will beat the living shit out of anyone that pisses her off.

World travel isn't really her thing. Sure, she appreciates the various peoples of the world and she enjoys what they bring to the society in which she lives, but she's a level-headed, pragmatic woman who isn't that impressionable. Her parents taught her well in that regard, perhaps too well, and a simple, honourable life is good enough for her. Theoretically, it should probably be good enough for all of us.

A gifted proof-reader, editor and final-person to have a look at the contract that's been drawn up. She therefore knows the rules, knows how to break them, and moves quickly and rather efficiently through life. Plus, she's happy and emotionally fit, she's got a great smile when she pulls it out and she helps awkward people relax.
“Rozzzzzzitaaaaaa.....!!!!!!!” her friends will squeal as she walks into the room because, finally, the glorious whirly-bird has arrived!
The name given to any local aneasthetic. At first it stings then soon…….peace.
The personal trainer who is impressed at her 'guns' and her six pack. She's a hard task master.

Proud Christmas wrapping paper. She MUST be taped up correctly and neatly, and the gift itself should be presented front and square beneath the tree, if you're into that kind of thing.
Question: Are there any Buddhist/Hindu/Muslim Rosslyns out there?...

Stubborn? 
You bet. 
Funny? 
100%.  
Sexy? 
Yep.
Tomboy? 
Usually. 
Smart as a fox? 
Tru dat.
Is she ever early?
……is that a serious question??

Rowena is just as happy in a bar of bush blokes as she is in front of the camera signing billion dollar deals with offshore mining companies. If you are genuine then she will give you your due and if you’re not, she will either ignore you or tell you to fuck off. Rowena.

If Roxanne is a city-dweller then she is surprisingly unadventurous and a tad prejudicial, as well as being totally institutionalised by the contraints of a life led mostly indoors. If she's a country girl, however, Roxanne is funny, and loud, and she tries different things and she'll listen attentively to unusual people. Rarely does the environment have such contradictory outcomes on a person.

A type of Impulse spray for girls. It’s a favourite with some sixteen year olds who cover themselves in it before heading out to nightclubs, underage, although it only really works when the accompanying mini-skirts are so short that any attempt to sit down results in a genuine knicker-flash.
See Ros.

A huge offshore racing boat. She's powered by two giant outboard engines with glistening stainless steel counter-rotating props and you can hear her tear up the opposition from miles away, and whoa-betide any beggars she meets while walking down the street, for they’ll be told to better themselves in no uncertain terms.

Jesus H Christ on a popsicle stick! Pierced fingernails, nipples, lips, belly buttons, and probably even a pierced you-know-what, Rozzie is about as quiet and as subtle as the opening few seconds of a Formula 1 Grand Prix. She doesn't just walk into a room, she crashes the stolen bulldozer straight through the wall, her raised fist waving outside the cabin, yelling, "FUCK YEEEAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!"
Need we say any more?

Ruba is one of those artists whose studio is massive, and yet filled to the brim with the spoils of her labour. It's a miracle she knows where everything is. Totally obsessive once she gets rolling, Ruba cannot and will not be distracted and, my god, you should hear her in bed…

Ever seen the movie "Bruce Almighty" with Jim Carey? Well, just after Morgan Freeman confers 'Godness' onto him, Bruce struts off down the street wielding his new powers. At one stage he turns, fires his Godness at a fire hydrant that explodes water into the air right on cue. The fire hydrants name was Rubi. She's red and she's in your face right when you need her most. Amen.

Option A:  Ruby lives alone with her 45 cats in a house filled with ornaments and trinkets from her two trips to India. She hopes to achieve enlightenment soon but little does she know that she’s on life number one. 

Option B:  If she isn’t a street fighter, Ruby is more like a Zen Buddhist monk and far and away the most (quietly) skilful and compassionate human being in the building.
The champion shearer and realist. She beats all the men all the time, and she wouldn't trade her love of ciggies, Wild Turkey or her blue cotton singlets to save her life.
The lazy and beautiful Sri Lankan Goddess of Safe Animals.

There are some creatures out there in the Kingdom who are difficult to describe, because to do so would mean trying to pigeon-hole one of the most pure, replete and centred individuals any of us will ever meet. Yes, we are all different, and we hate to say this, but some of us are just quieter, more introspective and more brilliant than the rest. Ry.

Ryanna is about as shy as a breaching mother humpback who has taken a dislike to your sea kayak an its proximity to her calf, and who is now totally airborne and 2 metres directly over your head.
So, Ryanna, yes, she’s lovely, she’s powerful, she’s sexual, she has a big smile, she loves a busy social life and she has a sense of humour. And in the next life we suggest you steer well clear of her calf.
The End.

A private school girl who trails her minions like the tail of a $300,000 Versace wedding dress. Ironically, if her dad doesn't spend at least this much on her wedding he'll be in the bad-books for the rest of his days.
A very determined classical pianist.
Ryley is proactive and a natural leader. Boys have to chase her hard to catch her, and only the best will do.

Saachi is a sensual girl, never shy of romantic attention, who applies herself completely to what she's doing in that moment. By the time she's turned her attention to you she's already forgotten whatever it was she was just doing so she can fully concentrate on what you are on about. Likewise, when she turns her attention back to her task you will be nothing more in her mind than a memory. She makes a very efficient and highly sought after PA, she eats well and never, oh never, would you hear of a Saachi being craned out of an apartment because she weighed a third of a ton and couldn't get up from the bed. Saachi is nothing if not lean.
Canadian. Which means she doesn’t like too much bad language, although she is always looking for more sex than she’s getting. Who doesn’t?

Made of silver and about 21cm long, Sabine is gorgeous to look at and wonderful to hold. When Elizabeth is hosting a formal dinner party, she polishes her like no-tomorrow because Sabine is a main course dinner fork, and is there no better fork in the world? I think not.

Spiritually-speaking she is as large and welcoming as a tree. Sabitri provides love and protection from the elements for those restless souls who come and meditate in her shade. (i.e: her friends who come around for dinner or maybe an afternoon cup of chai.)
As a very successful executioner, she wears the same sexy smile for both her best friends and her worst enemies.
The name of a super-plush velvet rug that is deep purple in colour, and desired to be rolled upon, naked, by any and all who her meet her.
Chilli powder.
Sachiyo cuts vegetables faster than anyone.

Her name falls out of your mouth like a dollop of hot chocolate, and to that end Sade is gorgeous-looking girl who is easily led. Advice from the commentary box? Sade, get away from your family and your familiar surrounds, and out into the world with the aim of finding the thing that brings you passion and joy, then do that till life alters once more. Amen
A very savvy, cannie lass who sizes you up in a flash. Always thinking, Sadie likes people around her to contribute just as she does, and she doesn't take to the shy types well at all.

Saffron, if you don't already, please get into the habit of doing some hard exercise. Get the muscles around your back strong and sturdy, and don't presume that everything you hear is true. The world doesn't always work like that.

An ancient bottle of brandy. She’s very – WHOAH!!! Who said you could touch her? Put her down immediately! What?....No, of course you can’t drink her, she’s too expensive! Is she beautiful? Of course she’s beautiful, but it’s look-don’t touch around here, buddy.
Pissed off she has to work, and therefore pissed off at everything. So, come on Sakarah, find your passion!
Picture a female version of Bruce Willis in any of the Die Hard movies.

Sallie is busy, friendly and unselfconscious like a horse who is eager to ride, but only by a rider who knows what they are doing. She simply hasn’t got the time and patience for the alternatives unless they are extremely unusual.

Energetic and complex, Sally pursues unusual projects and unusual men, which is the product of quite an acute acumen. She can often be seen sipping at her 5th coffee of the morning while staring out into space where she’s analyses all manner of philosophy. We think!
Best friends with a girl called Alex.

It has been almost impossible for Sam to shake the Tom Boy image but it’s made her an outdoorsy sort of person who is smart on her feet. She’s quite gifted at orienteering and it helps that she has an excellent sense of smell, although she doesn’t take to the dainty types too well – be they men or women.
A neat woman who fusses more than she needs to. No one knows what Samantha does for a living but she takes a lot of pride in having good hair and getting absolutely hammered on Friday night.
Like a tribal bonfire in a remote PNG mountain village, we expect her to be exotic and mysterious but the most we can say is that she is attentive and reasonably conservative.

Well, yes, Samart is smart, and most of her wisdom is probably accrued from realms that aren't usually visible to the naked eye. Samart is something of a shaman, you see, which means she runs either ayahuasca ceremonies or yoga classes, and to that end she is tapped into a realm of love so vast it's almost impossible to describe here with simple words. All we can suggest is that, if you're curious, drop your defences and go say hello...

Full of diplomacy, Samaya is a cruiser. She rarely gets out of bed before 11 and sunset is definitely her favourite time of day. Her smile is easy and genuine and on a casual stroll down the street she will stop and have a chat to many people from the local community who she knows well. Some she knows from yoga, others from drumming and all of them have taken to life in this quite sea-side village where time isn't what it is in the city.
Sami struggles with shy people, she snorts when she laughs and she sneezes and farts loudly.
No, Samira is not a leader of industry. She is a leader during clothes shopping.

Holy shit! Quick! Hide the booze? Cover up the stash! Okay, now when she gets into the room we'll all jump on her at once, all right? Then, after she's belted us all up and stopped laughing we can start the party. I hope you've all drunk lots of water and had a good feed, we're going to need it. What a girl!

Come on…..get out of bed! If you're a bit bored with it all girl, try something weird. Snap out of the routine. Do something crazy! I mean it….write down 5 stupid things and then actually do them. You watch what happens - your life will never be the same again, Sedentary Sandee!

Sandi and her husband/lover/partner have just walked in the door, exhausted after spending all day riding around on their hired scooters on the island of Corfu. It's a tough life.
"Darling," she says, "I know you're tired and I need a shower too, but while the sun is still up, can you just make love to me for a while?"
Sandi's statement stops him or her in their tracks. Sandi is already naked, almost, and making for the bed.
".....sure," they say, "and then can we go to dinner? I'm starving..."
Purposeful, attractive and occasionally aloof, she’ll do her thing and she’ll do it extremely well.

Relaxed and affable, earthy and sexy as well, Sandy’s fate is that she will give birth to a child-genius that will subsequently make her life far more complex than she ever planned. But, it’ll take a relaxed and interesting person to deal with it. (Don’t let her maleness bother you, gentlemen, for Sandy is lovely.)
Serene and gorgeous, Sangeeta is one of the most elegant and thoughtful creatures in the Kingdom.

"Oh my goodness me!" you exclaim after walking into the ballroom, startled. The hosts of the ball spent a quarter of a million dollars alone on the decoration of the space, and there was only ever one person they were going to hire. You guessed it. Better than her dramatic eye, Sangita's entire personality is such that people will do anything she asks, which in turn means her artistic vision is never compromised. Is she bossy? Well, technically, yes, but she bosses with love.

(Pron. Sunna) Sanne looks at you like a curious kind of bird with an expression on its face which is somewhere between, "Is that thing in your hand edible?" and "Exactly what are you if you're not a bird?"

So she's curious and she's peculiar. She speaks the truth. She meets her lovers in very weird situations. She dresses in comfortable clothes. She asks lots of questions and she cooks very odd meals, sometimes. (It might be the product of her extensive travels, we're not sure.)

Sansia doesn’t want for much. Some people never appear rushed or remotely desperate, mostly because they know who they are, completely. In life this means Sansia knows what she wants and that she also tends to attract all she needs. 
Problem solver extraordinaire. (Boys, don’t be intimidated. She’s a romantic girl like the rest, just more confident, is all.)
All dressed up and nowhere to go: this seems to be a common theme in Santina's life.

Sapphire parties way too hard, although she does like Ryan. What can you do mum and dad? Don't put a lock on her door. She'll just bust it down. You might want to get her off to a good driving school, however. If she's going to be hooning around with Christ-knows-who at two in the morning, at least give her the tools not to kill herself.
There is a train of thought in the scientific and archaeological world that Sara is actually the reincarnation of Cleopatra. (Certainly, 49% of Saras assume this to be the case.)
A prototype model of perfection. She tries not to offend people but sometimes it can’t be helped. Thoughtful, philosophical, generous and very sexy on her day, Sarah is generally an impatient cook.

SJ has no idea what normal people do and, while you’d never pick it, beneath the suave exterior is a gifted audiovisual artist who is quite insane. She once planned to spend six months in a tank full or water before she made the decision to pursue a career as an astronaut. And she’ll do it too. You watch.

Powerhouse. Sarah-Jean is steadfast in her beliefs and actions like one of those Easter Island statues. Ever tried to move one of them?....Exactly. Best of all the only things driving her are positivity and affection. Her laugh is open and infectious, she leads the way without even meaning to, she is a fiercely passionate lover and she probably has to remind herself not to smile too often in formal situations. In summation, all we can say is that every social group on Earth needs one. Amen.

Sardie is well known around town, despite being a 'gringo'. She lives in a small Mexican village on the west coast that she discovered on a surf trip, years ago, and never left. You'll find her most afternoons down on the sand where she runs her business hiring out catamarans for tourists. It's an easy life and she meets plenty of people. She picked up Spanish in a flash and the locals took to her lovingly, not just because of that, but because she is a breezy, contented soul who smiles and who is at peace.

The opposite of a scaremonger, Sarelle appeases and cajoles, she calms and encourages and she rarely seeks any adulation for her actions. If you see her give her a pat on the back and tell her how lovely she looks, and that you appreciate her deeds. The end.

Tougher than you might expect, Saretta can take quite a bit of punishment before she begins to crack. Not domestic abuse, of course - if her husband ever physically threatened her then we're pretty sure he'd wake up the next morning without his testicles and rightly so - we're alluding more to the lengths she'll go to in the pursuit of joy, health and happiness. Saretta has an ego and certain expectations, sure, but she's no push-over.

Conceived on the island of Flores in the Indonesian Archipelago, Sari wears bright colours, has at least seven piercings on her body and is never really sure how to organise herself in a western material world.

She sounds like an Indonesian cocktail. For all the dry bitterness in her name – and her capacity to hold a grudge – there is also a mountain of chaos and in that regard she can party till dawn. Possibly to her own detriment.

The name of a marquee above a well-partied wedding reception. She provides plenty of space and light and she is quite accustomed to being in the company of melodramatic drunkards at midnight. Strong wind and rain make her ill at ease, though, and in such a mood it is best if no one says anything to provoke any kind of reaction.

"Come on, hurry up you lot. You know how I hate being late and don't worry, you've all worked very hard and I'm sure you'll do well tonight. There's no need to be nervous. Just remember everything you've learned while you've been here. All I want from each of you is your best. If you do that then I'm proud of you already." 
More words of encouragement from, Sarita, the choir coach, which also means that sometimes she acts as a social worker as well as a child psychologist.
Sarogini is a happy girl who, more than anything, wants lots of progeny. Mostly, we think, because she has no desire to work in a thing called a job.

Mmmm, yes, a confident girl who likes things done her way. That's not to say she's remotely nasty, although we all have our moments, but if there is a hard decision to be made look no further than giving the responsibility of that decision to Sarrin. She'll make the right choice, don't worry, but it won't make everyone happy. In life she has a piercing gaze and, despite their fixation, she scares the crap out of many-a-men.
Sexy Sarz is one of the more highly vibrational and beautiful people in the Kingdom.
"Blah blah blah, this…..blah blah blah, that…," she says, constantly. If a man tries to chat her up and he has bad shoes she’ll simply huff loudly and walk away.

In scientific terms you might call Sasha spoilt but like her kindred spirit, Declan, the universe simply affords her plenty without her needing to do very much, and that’s okay. Surely someone in the Kingdom has to fill this niche, if for no other reason than to give the workaholics something to compare themselves against.

The name of that svelte little divot of skin just beneath the belly button of your adored lover. If one were so inclined, one might pour a few drops of one's favourite drink onto it before imbibing with the tongue. We're only here once, don't forget, and Saskia ain't your average slick of skin…

Satya has a warm, sensual smile and behind this is a fervent desire to have things organised and to maintain a certain level of efficiency and integrity. No fools are tolerated in this playground folks, and fair enough. And she’ll let you know about it too. In any relationship with a man she’ll be wearing the pants.
Satyam leaves the house with a chunk of salami sausage in her handbag, and a knife. "You just never know where  you're going to end up," she'll say, if asked why.
Savannah is quiet girl who gets complimented more than her ego requires.
A vixen from head to tail. Forget common sense - who needs it? Passionate in both love and hate, she delights in wearing bright colours, especially in her predominantly red hair.

Like all lasses of this lineage, Scherie is highly intelligent, highly social and a fierce competitor out on the pitch. Sure, her boyfriends in the early days are questionable, but her rather indefatigable nature, in conjunction with a very cute grin, means that Scherie generally gets what she wants and arrives at the destination of her choosing. Like Maria, she loves fiercely, except her radar for buffoons is way better these days, thankfully.

Graffiti artist. And I'm not talking about some twat like a young man called Billy, for instance, who only goes as far as scribbling his ugly looking tag on the side of a train. Seahn is world renowned, and often gets flown to cities where is she commissioned to decorate whole alleyways. True, the older folk will never get it, but stop and have a look at what she does...she's amazing.

It's true that many rooms in many many psychiatric wards contain people whose names are impossible to pronounce, let alone spell, but Sea'nah's name is so completely absurd that she's left all that behind. Although it's true: she isn't ever likely to win the Nobel Prize for literature or physics, she's not that academic. Her saving grace, however, is that she IS intelligent in her own way, and best of all she is an in-your-face competitor who never dies wondering. Sure, she complains too much when she doesn't get what she wants, but so long as she sheds these adolescent habits she'll be fine. Hard physical work/exercise is something she needs to persist with.
She's a betting girl, alright. Whatever the event, where ever it's taking place, Sebetla, like Deano, will put her money on having the most fun and the best outcome, every time.
Like her kindred spirit, above, Sekai almost certainly has flaming red hair, but she’s flat-out as wild as fuck. A magnificent effort, Madame Sekai.
A busy girl who doesn’t need much of an excuse to smile, or crack a bottle of bubbles. She hires and fires and she's got spunk.

The name of a yacht anchored in the Sea of Marmara, not far from Istanbul. It's late in the day and the trip is over, thanks be to god. It had its moments too. We were only shot at once but they were too far off to get close to us. We delivered our precious cargo so, for now, we'll put our feet up, enjoy a  nice vodka and orange, which kind of matches the sunset, and we'll think about tomorrow, later. Cheers.

Selina is a lovely, loving girl although most people wouldn't recognize it at first. Her partner adores her although they carry the scars. You see, Selina cant stand bugs in the house of any variety. Like a dog who changes personality when it sees a cat across the road, three times last year Selina was eating a lovely meal with her spouse when a small bug landed near her partner's plate. Acting on pure instinct, on each occasion Selina lunged at the creature with her knife. The last time she did it she skewed her man's hand to the table. He got 12 stitches. (But he loves the scar, there wasn't any nerve damage and he knows she wasn't trying to hurt him.)

Selma, darlin', there's only so many times you can go over the check-list before you get this plane off the ground. So, come on, everything is in order, the engine is running smoothly and it's all ship shape. You've done all you can do and you've got to trust yourself that if the unexpected happens you'll handle it well, which you will. So, enough farting around, let's punch it!

Like a jet aircraft flying at night with an ill-programmed navigation computer and a malfunctioning GPS, September never winds up where you think she ought, and rarely where even she anticipates. As a girl who attracts plenty of attention, and as someone who loves a good time, you probably can't blame her for not having had the wherewithal to lay a solid foundation. Then again, life for the rest of us without the occasional artistic black sheep in our midst would be awfully uninspiring. So, September, you go as hard as you like and give us a ring in July, just to let us know you're okay. 
Love Management.
The budding Buddhist who loves her vegie patch.

In a past life Seraphine was indeed in the French Foreign Legion, and now here in this one her job is to absolutely chill-the-eff-out. What does she do? Not bloody much, truth be known. The luxurious and rather splendid ride which her name provides grants this girl plenty of slack from the world at large. Big lunches, juicy, loving friends, trips away.....this appears to be Seraphine's lot. She is therefore rarely miserable. Nice (reincarnational) work if you can get it. Amen.

Serena travels a lot for work and she knows all the rorts. She has wardrobe full of towels and soaps from hotels from all over the world, and only a fair recollection of the men that she left pining in her wake after her. “Oh well,” she’ll say, after just recovering from the last conference. “Where are we off to next?”

Well let's go out on a crazy limb here and presume her name is pronounced as it's spelt. So, Serene isn't all that serene. She's not necessarily a ball-breaker either, but she is certainly complex and not the submissive hippy one might rudely presume. In fact, it might take a while for her to let you in - it's hard to say - but Serene is never as agreeable as you think, mostly because she's pissed off that everyone assumes she is, and this is a good thing. All that make sense?
Intensely private, even Seri's friends aren't sure if she's going out with that guy or not. Indeed, they're not sure if she's finished going out with the last one. Has she? Anyone?...

In a turn of incredible irony, proving there really are no coincidences here on Earth, seven cubed equals 343, which turns out to be EXACTLY the combined total number of brain cells in her parents' grey matter. That aside, Seven has turned out pretty well. She knows her name is absurd, but it aided her to mature quickly. These days she is quite the centred and compassionate soul, and way more than some of her siblings. She unconsciously rebelled against her name and it’s made her serene and thoughtful. We love her and so should you.

Oddly enough, her and her running mate, Seven, are currently in the lock-up. Driving drunk again, and you should have seen what the cops found in the boot! They'll be in there for a while this time, no matter what daddy's lawyer says.

Yeah, you know the knots they tie up on boxer's gloves before the welter weight championship of the world (the welter weight fighters are notorious for their high number of punches)? You do? Well, that final knot is called The Shann. Fuck it up and you'll be unconscious before you're even aware you were hit, but get it right and you're most of the way to taking over the world. True story.
A very gentle, fair-minded and compassionate sex therapist.
Often very fit and healthy, Shae is a nice lady in some kind of a hurry.

Beneath that independent crust Shaela is a hopeless romantic. She can’t spend too much time alone and needs her friends around her. Shaela needs a little direction in life and might flail around if it is lacking. Once she's pointed in the right direction however she's brilliant.
Her house is adorned with a multitude of Tibetan prayer flags.

Nope, she doesn’t look ‘normal’ and nor should she. Shaina gives no quarter, she takes no prisoner and whether it’s because of her looks or her nature, she always leaves behind her a wake worth remembering.

Naturalist. At least, that's what she tells her friends rather than saying she's off to a nudist beach. Fittingly, Shakyrah enjoys the outdoors, she has lots of friends who look you in the eye when they talk to you and she has an excellent tan. Does she work much? Nope. 
(Note: If Shakyrah lives in New York then she probably needs to leave New York - all her friends indulge too much, no one exercises and their diet is shocking - but if she doesn't then splendid!)

Shalini would cope very well in the wild if she wound up lost and on her own. Not that she probably would - her sense of direction, after all, is pretty good. She thinks fast, she thinks rationally and she spends little or no time pondering how things might have been if she'd behaved differently. And she has a great smile.

A rip-roaring tomboy, deep down. Usually, her friends and family look-on with a fascinated sense of wonder at how she seems to accomplish all she does, given the associated level of general chaos and mayhem she surrounds herself with.

Apprentice chef. The head of the kitchen barks at her constantly, only because he knows she's good under pressure, and that one day not too far away, by the look of things, she'll be the head chef herself, somewhere. Pressure: she can handle it.

We’re not quite sure how she does it. One minute she’s screaming and yelling and carrying on, and in the blink of an eye she’s the most chilled-out person in the room. True, she never stays that way for long but it’s nice to watch when she is. Then, just as suddenly she’s up and out the door. Anyone know where she’s off to?…

Option A:  An incredibly gifted indigenous artists.

Option B:  Is she white? Yes? Okay, she works with Teagan.

The Shandra is an ancient spell that women used to employ to have the men of their desires fall hopelessly in love with them. Sadly, it died out during the middle ages when the Europeans decided to burn all their witches. Or did they?

She went to an art gallery once. She had a nice enough time, although she didn't quite get a handle on the abstract pieces. In front of a 4 x 3 metre 'masterpiece' that supposedly represented the struggle of the modern artistic man in an urbanised, utilitarian world, Shanelle raised a few eyebrows. People next to her were making heart-felt 'oooh' and 'aaaah' noises at the painting's apparent beauty, until Shanelle eventually couldn't help herself. She looked across at them and said, "You've gotta be joking, don't you? It looks like someone's poured paint all over the tyres of my ute and gone and done burn-outs in the back yard! What a load of shit!"

Ever seen the movie Ghostbusters? And know those machines the ghost catchers carried on their back? With all those lights and bells and gismos? (They make a lot of noise and, though used rarely, basically they blow up any room in which they're turned on?) That device is called The Shani. Good luck and use sparingly.

Don't tell her something is taboo, for God's sake, coz' she'll just go right out and do it. Full stop. Ah, hang on! We've an idea! Tell her all full-body tattoos are really great! Tell her eating organic vegies is a shocking health plan, as is running. And you might as well tell her that only the coolest, most popular people text on their phone while they're driving. We won't even go near the whole drinking thing.

Shanice is definitely improving, but she represents a classic case of female brainwashing by society at large. The clothes, the makeup, the selfies, the self-image, the you-fuckin-name it. As someone brilliant once said, if all the women of the world woke up and suddenly believed they looked great just as they were, $400 billion of industry would be flushed down the drain immediately, and the world would be a better place. Shanice, maybe you should start a trend, sister? It’s certainly time to ditch all this crap that don’t matter diddleesquat!
Whenever Shanine is arrested she refuses to go quietly.

Shanna should be restricted from driving on her own as much as possible. How many crashes has she had? Plenty. Luckily no one has been badly injured so far, although we can't say the same for an indeterminate number of animals she's hit. Concentrate darling - this is the message to be heeded. If you start something, make sure you attempt to finish it. If you spy a car doing something odd just up ahead, for example (although the metaphor works for everything in life) keep an eye on it. Try not to get distracted. I know, it can be tough. You're not a fool, so come on…

Her name sounds like a slippery slide that spirals downwards in the shape of a DNA double helix. And that's great, except it's covered in melted butter which means there's a chance you'll end up flying off unexpectedly at any moment. This is dangerous. Shannae - some advice from the crew up here in the commentary box:

Slow down for a second and surround yourself with people and situations which enrich you, and not suck your energy (or turn you into a raging, drunk monster!) There's more to life than a nice pair of shoes.
A raging pitbull when she figures out what she wants.

Like Courtney, Shannon has a lot more grunt than her male counterpart. So much so, in fact, that she’s often thought of as being damn-near pig-headed and this is unfair. She’s just complex and driven, and there’s nothing wrong with that.

Is she a ball-breaker? Well, thankfully, sometimes, we have to say yes, Shanon is a ball-breaker. But that doesn't really give credence to what's going on here.
Are you full of shit? Do you bend the truth sometimes to make yourself look a little better than is the case? Maybe you broke something and just kind of put it back together willy-nilly or hid it in the garage, hoping no one would find it? Well, a word of warning - Shanon will only get her back up if she's being lied to, or promised certain things that clearly will never happen. If you've screwed up go and tell her immediately. You won't find a better person to confide in.
Shantae knows when and how to let go, and as a nimble and skilled rock climber she needs to. She gets bored, you see.

Shantelle as an eye for what suits her. Now that might sound silly, but think about it. How many people do you know bite off more than they can chew, react impulsively and mess things up, jump on a plane without money or a plan and just hope for the best? Shantelle isn’t one of these people. She lives within her means, she plans her life as much as she can and in a million years she’d never allow herself to be seen naked in the lounge room by a passerby.

She's too happy and forthright to ever live in one, although she’d make the best of life if she did, and still laugh and bubble enough to make everyone around her happy. Her kids make a big, delicious mess every day and what better way to clean up than with an artistic eye and a house full of music. Shanti is a larger-than-life, sexy beast of a woman.

You lean forward when you say her name, as if you're about to start a 100 metre sprint. As soon as the gun goes off you're abruptly halted in your take off and left standing in the middle of the track wondering when the real race is going to commence. This is Shapelle's lot -  a false start here, a bad position there and a piece of bad timing somewhere else. But, we must commend her on her general level of intent.

Highly combative, Sharan loves it when the Pirate Captain says to her crew, "Right, we're going to board this ship and I want you impress upon all of you, once more, that we'll need to kill everyone before we can go through the booty. You got that, you idiots?"
Sharan loves these moments. It’s why she joined up with them in the first place. She hasn’t told anyone, but the only people she lets go are those that spell her name correctly. She whispers the question in their ear while no one is looking. So far, no one has got it right...

Sharee doesn't really go in for all that girly-crap. She only recently got herself a smart phone. She only did it because she was sick of people telling her that her old 'clunker' needed replacing. She was perfectly content just the way she was.
Shareen would do well in the military. Why? Because she doesn't dilly-dally, she understands physical objects and how they work and, let's face it, she's always loved shootin' shit.

Shareena is the name of a set of tennis racquet strings that are way too tight. Up until one snaps she is excellent, fast and furious, and supremely capable. But have you ever seen someone fall into a heap so quickly and so unexpectedly?
A well-adjusted, shit-giving girl who has a stack of friends, noble ambitions and a firm grasp on reality.

What a lovely, peculiar girl. Sure, she's icy when she's angry but c'est la vie. Surprisingly prompt in her delivery of services - she’s actually quite a skilled small business owner - she manages a nice blend of work and play, and from a moment of full-blown stress Shari can let it all out in a single breath. It might be all the purple and red that she wears, we’re not sure.

Sharina, stop looking down at your shoes. You're not going to trip over anything, trust me. Have a look up here for a minute, have a good look around. See those mountains out there - why don't you quit the city and go on a trek through them. Overall you've got it sussed - you have friends and a career and you're very cute in a slightly concerned-looking way - but it might be time to do something that slows your mind down for a while. Best thing is, even if it doesn't work, you'll have a great reason to host a big party on your return.
Cracks her knuckles at the dinner table.

Sharlene murdered her boyfriend in a fit of P.M.T. and she’s currently on the run in either South America, Cabramatta or Marseille. If only she’d become show jumper like she aspired to be when she was a little girl, things might have turned out okay. In any case, he probably deserved it.
Spits the dummy if the cocaine runs out.

Sharman is a surprising name but there are no surprises here. Whatever her appearance, underneath Sharman’s skin is a gruff male witchdoctor from the island nation of Haiti. Which means that if you're her boyfriend or girlfriend and you do something to displease her, you can expect sharp pains in your eyes during the night. It's a Voodoo thing.

Sharmila can charm anyone. She's great at handling over-sized, over-sensitive egos and is therefore a great producer because she knows how to handle the 'talent' who, let's face it, are quite often a complete pain in the arse.
Very close to the coveted land of exotica, Sharna actually rhymes with ‘Shit, that’s sharp!’ and ‘Oh, bugger it, I think I’ve lost my sunnies...’

Once upon a time she had slumped shoulders and no ambition. Well thank Christ those days are over. She ceased doing check-out long ago and far from being serene, Sharne is quick to get her heckles up. She'd make a great professional rugby league player....ooh, sorry, no, I meant cheerleader. Indeed, she might be the only cheerleader with a degree in economics and law. Full on, eh? And if you're going out with her, don't expect a quiet journey.

Option A:  Impatiently, almost, Sharni slips into the dazzling shimmering dress, pulls up the zipper at the side in a hurry, shakes her hair in the mirror, likes what she sees, claps her hands and shouts downstairs, “OKAY!!....I’M READDDYYYYY!!”

Option B:  A foul-mouthed and very funny charter-boat skipper.
Kylie’s cousin. Although Sharnia is almost certainly less dignified.
The Shock Jock.

Sharny rhymes with, "Shit Yeah!", it rhymes with, "I'm first out of the plane!", it rhymes with, "Ah, what bullshit! That cobra isn't real. Here, give it to me", it rhymes with, "You call that a cock?" and it rhymes with, "Holy shit, it's an earthquake! Grab the fuckin' esky and let's get out of here!" 

It seems a pattern might be emerging...

Interesting. Sharode is the name of an energetic way of being. What does that mean, you ask? Well, for instance, there's never any point in rushing something. Not ever. Sharode knows this. You'll often see chefs talk about not beating something too hard. Occasionally a mix must only be folded, not thrashed to death. Sharode taps into this ethos in everything she does. It makes her a great listener and a very peaceful, happy soul. 
(The only thing you wouldn't get her to do is build a stone wall by hand. Each rock would be lovingly tended and spiritually analysed, and the whole process would take eons, but, as she'd tell you, and she's right, every moment is followed by every moment, and what moment is therefore any different to any other.)
Amen.

Okay, so, yes, we know - to describe Sharon as a traditional bowl of porridge might, on the surface, seem a little cruel.
The crew up here in the commentary box have discussed this at length but it still stands. Sharon is a wholesome, real, rural girl who speaks the truth, she’s good for those around her, her ego is completely in-check and she’s not into ornate displays of anything which doesn't actually help anyone.
Know what I mean? And anyway, who doesn’t love porridge?
Another woman who hates hates hates it when you spell her name incorrectly, which results in her walking around in a huff a lot of the time.
The name given to the act of using a skipping rope that's on fire.
Sharyn has no time to waste, and she loathes it when people spell her name with an ‘o’.

Yes, many will perceive her to possess a boy’s name, but this doesn’t bother her for Shaugn is a contented soul who is replete with life, laughter and nous, and who views the world as a peculiarly wonderful place that needs to be experienced to the full.
Potentially lush and exotic, Shauna is actually arid and complex like an expensive garden bed that hasn’t been given enough water, and which is slightly frustrated that it hasn’t

Shaunagh is the name of a wee cottage on a mountain side in Scotland, in the middle of winter. A snow storm is coming but fear not. Though small, the cottage is well-sealed with a thick wooden door and well-made shutters on the tiny windows, and smoke from the chimney means it must be warm inside. It’s just a long, arduous journey to get here, but once you are here you’ll probably want to stay for ages.
Often very fit and healthy, Shay is a nice lady in some kind of a hurry. And yes, she is very similar to Shae.
No time to waste! So hurry up and crack that bottle, open those dips and get everyone outside!

Shayne is more of a doer than a procrastinator. Sure, she was a tomboy for a while but check her out now - she's actually mellowed quite a bit but she got sick and tired of listening to idiots say, "Deeerrrrr, that's a strange name for a girl!" As ever, a moron is born every minute, because these days Shayne has a quick wit, a stunning smile and she gets shit done. Nice work Shayne.
The Queen of the Roadhouse.

The world famous DJ. Seen her recent music video? All they did was get snippets from her last tour and put them together. Even the roadies looked like they were having a good time. The 80,000 screaming fans at her last gig were having a pretty good time too, by the look of things. Only one death and 20 arrests, which isn't bad for Rio.
Shazza uses modern day metro-sexual men to wipe her arse.
Big. Black. Beautiful.
Like any adult female Killer Whale, Sheena is gentle and intelligent on the surface but there is an inner strength that has to be seen to be believed.
You might think that Sheila is dangerously dumb but you’d be a fool if you did. Apart from being possibly red-headed and buxom, Sheila never misses a trick.
Shelby bleaches her hair white-blonde, she loves her ug boots and she lets the dog sleep on the couch with her. Saving the planet isn't really her thing but she likes the idea.

Task orientated, Sheldon got over her laziness yonks ago, if indeed she was ever lazy in the first place. Perhaps she's escaping the constant assumption that she's not a male, which is silly. Sheldon is cute, she's no where as serious as she seems when you first meet her and, yes, underneath is a very capable tomboy who can mix it with the best.

What a terrific woman. She’ll roll her sleeves up, she’ll shag her lover in the bushes if the mood takes her, she gives good advice, she’ll aid a broken heart and she’ll jump into romance. She probably just needs more sleep, right?
Shella always seems to be in a rush but despite being either a little bit basic or maybe a little naive, she’s a nice person.

Energetic and never dull, Shelley exists in the same way as an extremely hot curry: In the short term she’s a bit too much but in the long term she’s tremendous and/or perfect. And yes, she's basically identical to her twin sister, Shelly.
A harmless lass who hasn't got the funds to be extravagant in where and how she lives. However, she does work hard and so who knows?
Energetic and never dull, Shelly exists in the same way as an extremely hot curry: In the short term she’s a bit too much but in the long term she’s tremendous and/or perfect.

Sheralyn is the name of the phenomenon of trying to make a bed that is jammed along one wall. Sure, the sheets are clean, expensive and the room is bright, airy and inviting. But how does one get the sheets tucked-in next to the wall without moving the bed? How can you get the creases out? Why have they got an electric blanket? It's enough to drive a person insane...
Sheree lives for the hot hard sweat of the Mosh Pit!!

Shereen spends no time whatsoever pondering bad decisions. She literally hasn’t got time. If money was squandered then so be it - you can’t change the past and it means some good luck must be on the horizon: this is how she approaches everything. She considers the happiness of her children their responsibility, the happiness of her partner their responsibility, and if she met you, and she had the inclination, she’d tell you that your happiness is completely in your hands as well. And she’d be right.

Suggestive and sometimes indecent? Well, we bloody well hope so. This political correctness crap taking over the world isn’t much fun for anyone, least of all Sheri who is a saucy little legend at the best of times. 
Amen.
Sheridan over-thinks it, she over-does it, and she is therefore problematic. Does she love the drama?.....Maybe. Perhaps she should run a brothel?
The name of the facial expression produced on a woman's face after seven hours of standing around in a pair of high heels when she's trying to smile.
A more unglamorous version of Cherie, although her mood swings aren’t as catastrophic.
Sherree, what have you done with the biscuit tin?

A loud, reactive lass for whom it is basically impossible to walk into a room quietly. She'd make a useless spy, unless of course she went under the cover of a lead singer in a rock n' roll band. (Apologies to the singer, Dave Graney.) Anyway, Sherrie is fabulous on the dance floor, if a little dangerous, and she expects plenty in the bedroom although she doesn't usually remain friends with her ex-boyfriends or girlfriends.

Never abusive, Sherril strives to keep some kind of balance in her life. Who doesn't? But Sherril's job is a little tougher than most because the majority of her friends are dispirited alcoholics and so someone has to make sure they eat something. The question is Sherril, are you looking after yourself? And are you getting pulled down into the abyss with them?...

Like an octopus with fast-moving, agile tentacles and who can deal with juggling 14 balls at once, Sherrilyn is far happier when she has a million things to do. Sure, she mightn’t actually admit to that, but trust us, being bored is her worst nightmare. Her men/lovers/partners love her and loathe her for the same reason; she’s a mountain of fun to be around but chilled out down time is a thing they’ve only heard about in magazines. (And yes, they'd all admit to a rather wonderful and energetic trade-off in the bedroom anyway.)
You hear her on the radio she sounds quite calming and gentle, and she is, but in real-life she's the exact opposite, and a whole lot funnier to boot…
Loves a good old fashion country dance, where she can check out the local workin' men and rub cheeks with a couple of them.
As Cheryl’s older cousin with much longer hair, Sheryl copes a little easier with life and laughs a bit more. And she’s far more musical.
Shikin is a Malaysian drink. Super sweet with a ton of alcohol, she compels one to bob up and down and think hard about visiting a disco.

Shiloh is a tonic to sadness or anger. What you do is say her name three times whenever you feel yourself begin to ‘lose it’: Shiloh....Shiloh.....Shiloh, you intone. Mysteriously, all the anger, the fear and the frustration that you felt will begin to abate, leaving you feeling content and happy. Loving, even. (Alternatively, of course, you could just go around to her place for a cup of tea.)

Shiralee is a loaded metal spring that is quite rusted. If she doesn’t shoot straight when she goes off, and she usually can’t, then you can expect to receive some kind of nasty pinch on the skin, or possibly even a nice rusted cut.

Well, no prizes for guessing what her parents were drinking the night Shiraz was conceived. Lucky they weren't drinking Smirnoff, eh? Anyway, Shiraz is far more charming and able than the people who brought her into the world, thank God. Yes, she gets asked about her name every 18 hours but far from making her bitter and twisted, it's turned her into a forgiving and thoughtful lass who is not only not an idiot, but quite compassionate and bubbly. So, maybe her parents aren't fools after all? We'll ponder that one up in here in the commentary box...
Country girl. Fuck the g-strings. She'd rather have a new suede cowboy hat. Maybe some new riding boots.

As something of a schemer, although not a malicious one, Shireen is arguably the only person in the Kingdom who could heard cats with any kind of success. Perhaps it's because in a past life she was one. (And yes, she's related to Jodie.)

It’s mid-January, Longreach, Queensland, Australia. You’ve pulled up at a servo where you’re prepared to pay $8 for each litre of diesel you’re about to fill your Landcruiser with, and Shirl comes out to greet you in a old pair of blue shorts with matching blue shirt, a rough and ready smile and sun-blasted frizzy hair. 
She leans on the bonnet casually and smiles, “So how are ya’?”

Never stationary, Shirlanne is constantly on the look-out for excess dirt, unwelcome gestures and stressed guests. As a staunch competitor both within and outside the family home, Shirlanne is rarely prone to ostentatious displays of euphoria. True, when the time comes to let her hair down she will celebrate with the best of them, but only when all the chores are taken care of. I mean, someone has to look after the joint, right?
Breaks horses in for a living.

Self-deprecating and wholly loving, Shirley dreams of the day when she is paid for taking bubble baths. She loves the suds, you see. When she’s tipsy, she throws them in the air with her hands and yells, “Yippeeee! Bubbles!”
Shnookems is red-faced about how much fun she has most of the time. She almost feels guilty about it.
Shon rhymes with Swish, because she seems to breeze in and out of rooms, lives, jobs, countries, etc etc etc. A wonderful, sexy lass, no matter how she does it.
Shona packs a mean, all-knowing and sexually-charged punch.
Fun girl, big laugh and she hugs like a polar bear, but some people just wont accept 'No' for an answer.

The secret garden path. Prickles and vines totally cover the way sometimes, and despite the sunshine she’s so dark and eerie that you think a torch might be handy; maybe even a big stick. But something really cool is down there...you can feel it!!........
Pimms, the sexy summer drink. Disaster somewhere? Who cares? Cheers!!!..
Some people just don't deal well with the notion of personal responsibility.
Her mum was in love with the actor Yul Brynner. Don't know him? Ask Siam. She's sick of hearing about it. Anyway, Siam is a friendly, flighty and sexy woman who struggles to put down solid roots.
Sian's modus operandi is not dissimilar to that of a hot wind blowing its way down the Rift Valley. As in, she's free, she has time, she's been here many times before, and wisdom is being acrued...
Baby, I hate giving clothes advise but if I don't tell you then who will? Wear what you want, not what your friends are into, that's all we have to say!

The economics graduate who is getting funnier and more relaxed with every passing year, which is a very fine thing. She certainly had the space to improve. She took a long time to meet a man/partner however, only because even when she’s happy, she doesn’t appear to be that happy. Maybe it’s time to quit that job?
Sibon is skeptical of strangers initially and it takes a fair bit to get her guard down, even longer to get her laughing so hard she can't breathe properly.

A sexy Italian city. (Twice every summer the locals have a horse race around the main piazza that’s filled with a million people, and they yell and scream while the riders try to kill each other. When it’s over and won, everybody parties for two days, hugging and kissing anyone else who is moving or relevant, and then wonder what the hell happened. I’m not sure if there is a rehab clinic nearby but they probably need one.)
Famous for her white bikini and her huge dark sunglasses, Sierra is beautiful and frivolous.
Her single-mindedness seems to intimidate everyone but there’s really no need. 'Sigourney Cool', is actually a nice name for a yacht. Anyway, everyone, say hello to her. She won’t bite. She’s nice

An army Captain. Shoosh, here she comes!
"......Staaaaaaaaand hup!!"

Silma, I hope your Muslim faith stems from your heritage and not from a fearful position which has arisen from being a woman brought up in or near Bondi Beach, Australia, for instance, and who got hassled one night on her way home because she was wearing a short skirt. Don’t get us wrong, bad behaviour is abhorrent in any land and in any language, especially towards women, but if you think the Muslims of the world have the best interests of women at their core, you are fucking kidding yourself. You’re a thinking, intelligent woman, and we suggest you celebrate your uniqueness in a place where you still can, inshallah.

They once wrote a song about her.
“....All the boys,
think she’s a spy.....”

No, Silvia's flustered complexion isn't a bi-product of being angry at you, she's just late and so she's in a hurry. Is she always late?....Yep, pretty much. You should see her bedroom - it's a bloody nightmare. If you can get some one-on-one time with her you'll discover a much more chilled lady. Sexy smile too.
Reviewing the best movie you've ever seen is never easy. Up here in the commentary box we don't even know where to start. Just go and see it, is my advice. You'll fall in love like we did.
Whip crack! If you're a shy person don't even toy with the idea of asking her out.

Short of stature and sexy as all get out, Simi is an optimist with loads of initiative. She can dart into a space and fix most problems in a flash. Just as quickly she’s gone again, and way too fast to even thank. Simi.
Simmo wears a short skirt and runs the two-up betting ring at the outback race track, where she gets to party hard and yell at the top of her voice. She’s hard to miss.

A rather secretive and sensual cat who makes exquisite rings and bracelets. They're not cheap and nor should they be. She sells them at the local fair market and she sort of slips around the place like a shadow that has a smile.
A legal secretary that dresses in drab colours. She loves American TV dramas and, secretly, she thinks she would have done well on Big Brother.

If she is born of European parentage then she is delightful - funny, musical, quite sensual and definitely great to be around. If she isn't, or if her parents gave her that é just for something cool to do, she'll spend way too much time in rehab and we hope that one day she gets a job.

For such a complicated name Simonette is quite gifted at plonking herself in a comfortable situation. A nice lounge, fun non-psychotic kids, a friendly and attentive partner - these are things Simonette has acquired. If you asked her if it was simple she'd tell you that nothing is ever straight forward, so don’t try to tell her otherwise. And, we should say, though it's not really relevant to anything, she's never obese because those double t's give her long legs and a desire to be healthy. Weird, eh?

Yes, she used to be an IRA sniper until they started running drugs. Then she got out and turned to eastern religions and now she's just as chilled and as funny as could be. Don't get her too angry though!

"Stop crying about that stupid man," she'll say to her friend when she's just about heard enough. 

Thing is, and just like her name, Sinja's entire personality whips around at you in the same way a playful cobra might, but there's no danger here. A proactive and sexy lady is our Sinja and you'd be wise to heed her advice every time. And her complexion alone is enough to drive potential lovers quite balmy.
(Pron. She-bonn). See Kiki, except that her dad might be part Chinese.
Smarter than anyone has idea about, Siosi loves playing silly-buggers!
Busy. She's hardly ever at home and when she is she fusses about trying to get as many things organised as possible before she has to leave the house (and her computer) again.
Foxy, in the good old fashioned way.

Sita looks at you and sees everything. If she smiles while she does that you're liable to feel a lovely little tingle in your belly. It has nothing to do with romance, although she's not usually lacking in that department.

Sky sunbakes in the nude and is learning to be a naturopath, karmic healer and transcendental therapist. She has no idea who or what the P.M is but she makes up for it by being smart in ways that we mere mortals have no idea about.
See Sky, although Skye knows who the PM is. The trade off is that she isn’t nearly as skilled at seeing the future.
Broadway Producer. Which surprised a lot of people.
Skylah lives in a giant apartment in New York. No one knows how she got it. Equally, she doesn't know why her parents put that 'h' on the end of her name, not that its held her back in the least.

(Pron. Slavitza) Slavica upholds certain levels of presentation and behaviour, and you’d never in a million years find her begging for money on the street. This rather brash and seductive Eastern European woman is known by nearly everyone, although she’s never met most of them. You’d try and tell her why - how some woman possess a particular kind of electricity which is rather magnetic - but we suspect she wouldn’t believe us.
The Queen of the Little Black Dress, although Cat and Pepper would probably need to be included in that statement.
Smiddy gets shit done and she makes others laugh, and she’s got that thing about her that drives men crazy. Yep, she’s hard to miss.
In a past life her name was Hamish.
Snezana loves big guys, with big legs. "You know how it is," she says with a shrug. "You need a big hammer for a big nail."

"Oh well, it's the same story as last time," the teacher says to Soey's parents. It's parent-teacher time at the end of term and they are here to learn how their daughter is progressing from someone other than their daughter. "Soey is the smartest and most compassionate child in the class, probably in the whole school, and potentially in the entire state if I thought about it. If she wants to be a Prime Minister I've no doubt she will."
The parents look at each other, kind of smile and shrug. No surprises here, but they still don't quite know how they did it.

No, Sofia doesn't have a halo above her head, theoretically, although many if not most admirers view her that way. Some people just have that intangible thing, and we up here in the commentary box can't explain it to you either. Suffice to say she's a great player and we just love that she's out there.

Sohini lives for ducking down little alley ways, unexpectedly. She's the sort of girl who would travel to Venezuela or somewhere for an organised tour of an ancient temple, get bored, drag a few of her friends down some tunnel when the guide wasn't watching and after 3 hours of mis-adventure that would put Indiana Jones to shame would press the nose of small rock statue, just to see what it does. People 300 miles away can see what happened next and pretty soon the whole planet does: a thick beam of vivid blue beam of light forms at the top of the temple shooting off into space, the sole purpose of which is to signal an alien race that we are ready for them to visit. Know what I mean? Motto here: Have Sohini. Will travel.

Many people, these days, have Asian words tattooed on some part of their body as a symbol. They speak of things like ‘peace’, ‘love’, ‘happiness’ and ‘fertility’. “Sokina” is what a young girl in Tokyo, for example, might tattoo on herself to reflect a similar idea: the letters (symbols) looks nonsensical yet inviting, and deep down you know that, somehow, it represents mysterious greatness, which is correct.

Powered by the sun alright, Solara converses with those beings that seem to float around wherever they like. True, most of us can’t see them but that doesn’t mean they’re not there, which means that we need Solara’s guidance, especially if life is tough.
In a past life Solita was a quiet and polite Japanese geisha girl, who secretly knew she was far smarter and savvier than all the ridiculous men she was surrounded by.

Like her twin sister (Sommer) Somer tends to over complicate things just a little. Sure, sometimes it's warranted but honestly, she stands in the kitchen podering whether her morning herbal tea should be in the purple mug or that weird green one, for twenty minutes. By the time she makes her mind up she needs to boil the kettle again.

You're driving along and all is well, but then a strange clicking sound starts up from under the bonnet. You lean in towards the dash, frowning at what it might be. The car is handling well but you know nothing about cars and so your options are limited. You're sure everything will be fine and, let's face it, it always is. But, this scowl that forms on your face, head tilted, is called the Sommer Proponent. Will she act or won't she?

“Holy Toledo, Batman!” Robin shouts at Batman. “There goes the amazing Sonali!” And the caped duo stand there, bewildered on the tarmac, as Sonali takes off in her secret spy plane, having foiled capture once again.

Is it time to lash out, Sondra? Let’s see…does your have family portraits on the wall in your stairwell at home? Why? Do you forget how you came to be alive? Our suggestion: put them all in a box in the attic, sell the old house and GET OUT THERE!

Sonia rhymes with ‘Hurry up’. Like any female spider worth her salt, if Sonia is ever pestered, bothered or let down by a man in her life, she will immediately deem him to be of inferiority quality before clinically dispatching him. She will then feast on his body at her leisure.

The sexy scalpel blade in a skilled doctor's hand, so don't mess with her! Sonja is usually prepared and organised although her methods may be confronting and unorthodox. She has no problem with being in the spotlight.

You walk out the door. You're in you're most fabulous outfit, you've never felt better, and the party of the millenium is only a taxi ride away, and that'll be the taxi out front now. You get in the cab, make it to the venue and OH MY GOD!! Quickly, you see the party is going to be bigger than even you imagined. You're not even in the front door yet but the whole joint is PUMPING! You diss your coat to the coat people - oh, they're organised all right - and you make it to the main room. Holy shit, look at this?! The music is incredible! A waiter arrives in front of you. 

"Champagne?"

"Sure!" you say.

He begins to pour, but the mood of the party is affecting even the liquid in the glass. The champers erupts inside your flute and spills out and down your hand. The waiter looks at you. Smiles. Shrugs. Waits for it to settle and fills you up again. You lick the spilt drink off your hand and all is grand, but that's Sontai:

A frothing champagne poured in a frothing party. Gotta love that girl. x

Sonya may or may not have a Macedonian grandfather, in which case the gloves are off, but like her slightly more reactive cousin, above, she is a sensual woman with a full comprehension of who she is and her place in the world. She is definitely someone worth knowing and loving, platonically or otherwise.
Remember this: every perfect mango that you ever eat for the rest of your life is not just a mango – her name is Sophia. Please don’t forget it.

Your favourite block of chocolate. (As a quick aside, her name in your mouth is a quaint and hot little blob of sweet tasting glue that bonds her to her good friends very strongly, and she’s only too sweet about 14% of the time.)
Soraya regularly climbs giant trees and shackles herself to the upper limbs in order to stop logging of old-growth forests. Soraya, hallowed be thy name…...

Far from being elitist Sorcha is actually quite shy, and she tires of people insisting she thrust herself into the spotlight. Yes, her name is slick and sexy and cool, but like a thoughtful hare emerging from its winter burrow, Sorcha might take a little while to warm up those running muscles. She'll be ready for anything though, don't you worry. And God knows she'll need a stick to fend off her admirers. A word of adivce from the commentary box Sorcha: beware of bullshit artists!
Southern lives for dusk. It is here that her soul is at peace.
Sleepy head!
Great value and ‘out there’, Spider is a big wholesome country girl who drinks a lot of piss.

In many ways, you hear her name and wonder if maybe that might be the sound of an old Croatian vegetable truck trundling down an old cobbled road. Not so. Indeed, you might say it's the reverse, although we will agree that we don't quite know how she does it. Spomenka is actually the sound of a champagne cork being popped from a very expensive bottle, on the balcony of a chic little hotel in Nice or Monaco, or somewhere, and where close and loving friends have gathered. Perhaps the owners of the bottle are celebrating how well their new film has been received at Cannes, this year. We're not sure. And it's one of those warm nights when you couldn't care less that a $700 bottle of plonk has been poured too quickly and is over-flowing out of the glass. Spomenka therefore sports a smile which is utterly contagious, and that's just the beginning…

Stacey is a very neat and perfectly functioning stapler and it’s not possible to run an organized and professional looking office without at least one of them. (Unless she’s the Stacey that races motorcars and says, “I fucken hate pre-menstrual bitches”, quite often.)
A very loveable and (these days) tender drug addict.
Stardust is cute and she believes in fairies, and she is the first person to capitulate into a useless ball of panic when the ground rumbles and the ocean begins to recede...
Safe-conduct? Hah! I don't think so, Roger!

She’s your mate, good friend, bosom buddy and pal. She rushes into the pub/house/studio in a fit of being late in lieu of some remarkable disaster that could have only happened to her, but that’s okay. She’s here now, so let’s get our coats off and get on with it.

There are some apples you come across in your life that, as soon as you crunch into with that first bite, you know you're going to remember for a long, long time. For instance, I reckon I can recall the Top 6 apples I've eaten in my life: I remember where I was, I remember what the weather was like, and I remember how happy I was in that moment. Steg, ladies and gentlemen, is a World Top 3 Apple, and love is all that can be said about her. Amen.
The tired old battle-axe who, no matter how much the roof leaks and no matter how hungry she gets,  is always able to find something to laugh about.

Everything’s fine, then you start pedalling up the hill when all of a sudden your chain comes off. “Oh no!” you yell. “I’ve had a Stephanie!” Invariably, you swear and curse as you wrestle the chain back onto the cogs, ending up with grease all over you, but if you stood back and analysed the situation rationally you’d see that you were only off your bike for about 40 seconds. And, truth be known, you enjoyed standing for a few moments and stretching your legs, didn’t you?
"Just rum for me, thanks luv."

Stevi is so fiercely independent, the first thing she does after she meets you is to tell you about her fierce independence. But, she's a passionate woman worth talking to, if only for the experiences she's had. She could actually benefit from a little meditation, although that would necessitate her being in one place for at least an hour, and this is something she’s hardly ever done.

A cross between Isaac, Bec, and a female Smiddy, Stevie throws herself into the world with abject gusto. Some days she wins, some she loses, but as a hopeless romantic she always expects greatness to arrive in the next couple of seconds.
Storee hides behind a veil of many, many layers…..
Stormie is surprisingly hesitant, but what do you expect with drug addicts for parents?
Yes, it's true. Stormy, like her twin sister, immediately above, is surprisingly hesitant, but…in fact…bugger it. Stormy, move out of  home, get a job and throw out those bloody Tarot cards.

For Christ's sake don't give her the rule book because no doubt she'll do what she did last time - screw it up into a little ball, jam it down her undies and dare anyone game enough to come and get it, on the proviso their hands are tied, if you get my drift. So, we've got no advice up here, suffice to say hold on just go with it. Defend yourself if you see fit, but no interaction with this woman won't be worth remembering, so good luck!

All the girls envy her long legs – all the boys want to kiss them – but behind her physical attributes is an intelligent and sensitive soul who, like her male counterpart, might not be as laconic as her name suggests.

No matter how big the party is, and no matter how long is lasts for, Stroma is always one of the last five people present. The girl has stamina, that's for sure, and she definitely doesn't possess an off button.

The one species of Susan/Sue/Suzanne etc who has completely shed all of her DNA that compels her to work hard and be serious about life. She is, however, very serious about having a good time. Thank you Su.

Never liable to crack under pressure, Suann wears the pants in the family and she carries a whip on those nights which we can't talk about here in public. Yes, she has a devilish sense of humour but if you are weak of spine and duplicitous of nature, you won't be in her close circle for very long.
