Like a rip old egg-laden salmon not long for this world, Willora’s aspirations are pretty simple and she moves through life like the aforementioned fish swimming steadily upstream to spawn. Barring catastrophe she’ll get there.

Zany, crazy, hyperactive and dangerous? Probably, but like the tree, Willow, can be thoughtful, unusual, curvy and genuine. Depends what day of the week it is, really. Willow is sufficiently unbelievable, but be prepared for a wrestle.
Christ she's sick of housework. In fact, she's so sick of it she left. Last I heard she was in a bar in Paris snogging a young man from Portugal, god love her!

No, she’s not a a wallaby, but Wiloughby would make a wonderful ecologist if so inclined. She’s very bright, she cares about her surrounds and she’s good for people and the planet. She is a little clumsy at this whole romance caper, however. It’s the only aspect of her life she lacks confidence in. We have no idea why.

She walks with her eyes pointing down like a criminal, her thumbs inside the sleeves of her jumper, and she rarely shaves her pubic hair. The last I heard she was off to the U.S for a huge meeting of girls.
Her Vietnamese heritage assists her but as one of the most agile and nimble decision makers in the Kingdom, Win always gets what she wants.

What a splendid single-minded creature she is. Here's an example - let's say she was interviewed for a job by the tax department - which is possible, given her love of numbers and having things in the right piles - during which she was permitted to bring in a set of tax-department folders as a means to assist her with her answers. If asked a question that she found rather vexing she would have no issues and feel no pressure, there in front of the three-member panel, sifting through the documents for several hours trying to find the answer. In a past life she was a splendid hunting beagle.

21 no matter how old she is, Winnie laughs big. She has a big family as well, none of whom are shy little violets either, and whatever her weight, be it described in kilos or pounds, it will consist of only hilarious buckets of love. Amen.
“Oh, muuuum,” her sister moans from the lounge room. “Winona has split up with Tommy again....can you tell her to go and cry in her room please??..”

The name of that railway line out there in the middle of a big country. Dead straight and stretching to the horizon in both directions, you stand there in the quiet heat of a stinking hot summers' day marvelling at the noise a train would make if it appeared. (i.e. Winsome saves her energy for when it's really needed, and right now she's deep in some kind of meditative slumber.)

No, her parents couldn't afford to pay the heating bill and here we are. If they spent the money on electricity and not booze perhaps they could have. Then again, without booze Winter may never have existed and we're glad she does. She's a little shy at first but she has a heart of gold. Just stay off the booze baby!
Wrenne bursts onto the scene like a greyhound exploding out of the box. This girl has spunk and energy to burn and 'No', therefore, is a word she rarely utters. And, by God, can she move!

Mourful? Not a chance. Yes, she got thrown by the horse again but so what? Before the dust has even settled she's up again ready for another go, hat on head, wry smile on face. It takes a lot to get this girl down and she knows how to ride the bumps.

Xanthe is very similar to her sister below (Xanthie). The only differenceis that Xanthe can see what is going to happen even before they get to the stadium and she will therefore act accordingly. (She'll make sure her camcorder is charged.)

If (begrudgingly) at a football game with a group of people that included Kendra, and the conversation turned to the possibility of what it'd be like to do a naked sprint across the ground while play was taking place, Xanthie would immediately shake her head, wish everyone a quick farewell and (gratefully) leave before the carnage began. She's not that silly to want to stick around.

Like a very expensive vase made of imported crystal, Xenia likes to know what's going on, she likes to contain chaos and, if she's in charge of a situation, and she usually is, then I wouldn't go changing the designated plan unless you get the okay from her, first. Having said all that, like an unexpected volano erupting in the middle of a calm sea, she will surprise you from time to time in quite remarkable ways. In this situation - say, she decided to jump into a pool from a formal first floor cocktail party - our advice is to do what she does.
Highly energetic like a sexy little buzz-beetle, Xiindi is musical and worldly, as well as perfectly peculiar.

Xitise (pronounced Zateece) hides away from finding out what she really wants from life by camouflaging herself into a neat, functioning city life by living in a nice place, working in a decent 9 to 5 job, having nice clothes, having good friends who she goes out with often, and by giving herself semi-unwittingly to the brain washing that society seems to place on humans who congregate together like rats. Don't get us wrong, Xitise is lovely, but she can do better!
Yael soulful. Yael beautiful. Very well read and city bred.

Yaiwa was one of those students who never handed in a single assignment on time, and when she finally did they always seemed to be off-topic. But, they were presented with such colour and tangential brilliance that no one had the heart to expel her. Suffice to say Yaiwa received her Arts Degree, via a few years off, and neither Yaiwa nor her lecturers have any idea what she’ll do with it. Moral to the story here is those parts underlined. Amen.

You say her name and you want to scream out, then you stop, and you listen. ‘Yalda,’ you say again. ‘Yes,’ she says, and you have nothing more to add because you know the truth. Yalda is here – here she is – and she is lovely.

Like a suave and delicious piece of 17th Century furniture made of priceless mahogany, Yarrow is sensitive and sensual. Here is another girl for whom most doors will just inexplicably open any time she wants. And her ego won't be doing the driving, bless.

Yasmin wears buckets of perfume and glossy red lipstick, sometimes a black head-band, and she has large eyes that look startled most of the time – as if she is a newly born gazelle just learning how to walk.
Yasmine has time and she has style. She reads other peoples’ body language as if holding an expensive vase with a pair of fine white gloves, and she hardly ever flashes her knickers.

Yazmine has travelled lots but Columbia is this girl's favourite country. She loves the perceived danger, she loves their musical nature, she's useless at Spanish but loves the sound of it, and yes, she loves those dark Columbian men!
Seductive. Inquisitive. Intriguing. Slightly shy.

Regrets? Zero. As a staunch optimist, Yessenia jumps into whatever she's up to with immoderation. "What's the point of doing anything in a half-arsed fashion?" she'll tell you, and she's right. I watched her get on a horse, once, that she was told might be beyond her. She mounted, the horse bolted and even after the horse dissappeared around the corner with the rider still present we could hear Yessenia screaming and laughing at the same time. (Until, of course, we heard a brief silence, then a thud, then wailing. We rushed to the scene to find Yessenia sitting on the ground sobbing with the horse ambivalently munching on green grass next to her.)

Panic-stricken? Well, sometimes. The thing about Yindi is that, while good fortune usually follows her, she often forgets that when things don’t go her way it’s just the gods assisting her to see some kind of delicious, comedic truth. People simply adore her - men especially - because they think she needs their help. Wrong, gentlemen. As it happens, you probably need hers. And she possesses a wonderful laugh. Yindi.

Lucky her parents didn't spell her name, Kbkd, eh? Anyway, Ynys possesses a staunch work ethic. Hold your chin up; walk straight; be proud of who you are; don't be too impulsive or wasteful - these are the some of the things that we will write on her gravestone. Thank you Ynys.

The fellow (or lady) who discovers Yogi as their perfect love/lover/partner will need to possess many qualities:
They’ll need to be industrious, just in order to find her.
They’ll need to like to dance and socialise.
They’ll need to be good in bed and they’ll need to be funny. And it probably helps if they’re at least a little artistic, and possibly even a little autistic, and one might help the other. 

What they don’t really need to be is particularly punctual, affluent or disingenuous. 

You got all that?

A backbone made of titanium means this girl is her own woman. She doesn’t suffer fools or from peer group pressure, and always always always is she looking for the best in a situation. We can only marvel at how fantastic the world would be if everyone knew themselves as well as this one, and what would be collectively achieved. 
Thanks Yoko.

Yolanda is often a strange, beautiful and quite ethereal woman. Years at university probably isn’t her thing, although she’d actually make a wonderful surgeon. The only downside, if you’d call it that, is that she doesn’t possess a great deal of common sense, no matter what she does. And that’s okay.
The Acrobat. She looks great in tights, seems to have no fear and is happiest when she's off the ground - be it in plane, on a trapeze, dangerous love affair, etc etc.

Famous within her circle of friends, and sometimes a fair way outside it, Yolandi drives men berserk whether she’s into them or not. Yes, she attracts a lot of attention because of her general level of sensuality and the volume of her laughter, but she’s also pretty good at accidentally knocking over wine glasses and champagne bottles. The upshot of all this is that the local bar staff sigh with a haggard sense of delightful resignation whenever she walks into the joint - they know everyone is going to have fun but they also know there’s going to be a mess to clean up afterwards. Yolandi.

Uncompromising. Yona looks you dead in the eye no matter what the scenario and in the back of her mind there are only three questions being answered:
1. Are you friend or foe?
2. Could I kill you if I had to?
3. If so what could I use nearby as a weapon?
Believe it or not, having said all that Yona is rollicking fun, she has a great laugh and she loves just as fiercely as Maria. No question.

Hopeless with money, Yoni makes up for it with a charming, girly wit and a ravishing smile. While that alone won't appease the banks and credit companies who are chasing her, they'll be hard-pressed to find her anyway. Yoni loves to travel, no matter who is paying, and she plans to be buried on the Greek island where her grandparents were born.

Yep, like Lizzie before her, she's quite bonkers but so what? True, she's a little clumsy and she accidentally cuts herself quite often, but she laughs hard from deep inside her belly and her little hissy-fits are funny rather than serious or problematic. She's not a bus driver.

Ain't no moth-eaten jackets in her wardrobe, let me tell you. If she ever found one she'd insist she pay for the entire apartment building to be fumigated, immediately. (She lives in a Parisian flat and so that little exercise would not be cheap.) She'd tell you it was worth it because no way is she setting foot outside looking anything less than stunning.

If only we could make a movie of what Yve gets up to on the weekend. At 6pm every Friday, two sexy little horns appear on her head, making her all the more delicious and remarkable than she already is.

The weary news journalist. For the past few months she's worn a flak jacket every day and can often be seen on the 7 o'clock news where she submits regular reports from Baghdad. She recently quit cigarette smoking and she's not very happy about it.
Self-sacrificing and loving.
Zadie has a massive bookshelf at home which is choc-full. She'll get around to them, sure, although she's never at home. She’s only read a third of them.

The name of a pilot whose peers describe as being something of a cowboy. Yes, not just anyone can get their commercial pilot's licence, but we're concerned at the number of times she's had to ditch an aircraft into the sea because it ran out of fuel. It's happened so often that she's actually quite good at it now. Certainly, no ones even been badly injured yet. Have they?
Zahli loves being in the middle of a crowd, though not necessarily the reason for its existence. She'd go nuts in a one-horse town.
Refreshing and upbeat like a freshly squeezed fruit juice that has a heap of ginger in it, Zali is healthy, different and enlivening.

Well, I suppose they could have called her Angola or Equatorial Guinea, so that's a relief, eh? Zambia takes ages to get going, or to figure out what she wants. Make-up - why all the make-up, though? Her sunnies are so large that we can hardly tell who we’re looking at. Girl, take them off, get your bearings and then come with me into the Life Path Office so we can have a chat...

Sensual, passionate and inquisitive, Zan never criticises unless she's been through the same ordeal. Even then, her rather sage approach arise from empathy rather than chastisement, because she's screwed things up nearly as much as anyone.

No, she's not a white supremacist, but if she was one she'd be lethal, only because if she takes a stance on something her ego propels her towards the strongest stance possible. In life she's not racist, but she's definitely a 'slackist'. That's right - if she gives you a job to do (and let's face it, she's a wonderful delegator) and you don't do it, or try to worm your way out of it, she'll be onto you in a flash. You’ll probably get a dressing down in public.

As a young girl Zaneisha was truly happy when she was out with the boys, wallowing in and getting covered in mud. When she was really young she used to eat it. As an adult now, she still secretly yearns for playful, silly moments of chaos that metaphorically or otherwise toss mud and dirt all over the place. Overly serious chores or attitudes just ain't her. Amen.

Zara, it's true, yes, that generally men will come to you. But once in a while, you're going to have to make the move. He'll be worth it so don't worry, you'll be right……(ps-She hasn't quite arrived at the notion that outrageous behaviour often results in greatness.)

Zardi will never ever need to visit a shrink. Indeed, perhaps she should become one, but then she'd spend her days stuck indoors listening to sad and confused people. Sure, she'd do some good, but what about everyone else who'd miss out on her company?

Too proud to beg. Not bright enough to commit a crime. Zarlah will follow the herd.
Up here in the commentary box we think it’s time she left home and jumped out into the world. Get some dirt on you, girl. Poke your head into dangerous corners and think for yourself!
The only reason she'll get married is for a Big, Fat Diamond.

Wow, you don't see this every day. The eagle chick has been flapping her wings in the eerie for a while now and under the watchful eye of her mum, it seems she is ready. She stands at the edge and opens her wings. The warm afternoon breeze fills them and with the wind over her face, she can feel the lift they generate. For the first time she jumps. Zayla is the name given to an eagle's first moments of flight and time seems to stop...

Zebedee is not an intellectual juggernaut but she  loves dancing, until she's directed to dance in a choreographic routine. On her own at the club, yep, she can shake it and roll it with the best of them but put her in a group setting, say, for an audition, and she'd struggle. (And no, she's not on her own in that regard.) 
Moral to the story: Don't try to limit her creative expression!
Zeina's bedroom has more photos of Brad Pitt on its walls and ceiling than any other in the Kingdom, which partially explians why she works at the ticket booth at the cinema.

Wow! Where'd she go? A minute ago she was kissing that DJ. Isn't she supposed to be the captain of this ship? How's she got time to kiss the musos?? Oh my God! Look at her now! Hunting that young man on the dance floor! Who is in control of the vessel??? ZELDA!!!! CONTROL YOUR URGES AND GET BACK TO WORK!!!!

Zelka keeps her family on an even keel, bracing them for any weather, usually without them even knowing. It takes a lot of work behind the scenes to keep the company together and happy. If only they knew the hours she puts in for them…

Zena walks through the door as a teenager, throws her bag on the table and a handgun and knife fall out onto the floor. Her father shakes his head.
“Darling, tell me you’ve got a licence for that gun?”
“Sure Dad,” she says, smiling.
He just nods. He knows she can look after herself.
The director of a reputable and compassionate funeral service company.

Zenela is the name of a drive in the country with a couple of friend’s friends, who turned up two days ago and are now struggling to find something to do. You read the bible where as they do drugs and partake in strange sex acts, or vice versa, and the whole thing is awkward and dysfunctional.

"Okay, so Zenia, you've booked yourself on a ski trip to Canada, which is great. Have you ever skiid before?" 
"Nah," she says, chewing her gum loudly and looking distracted.
"Right, so, do you think you'll enjoy it?"
"Oh, I don't really care about the skiing."
"....Huh?"
"I just want to look like a ski bunny and kiss a cute Norwegian (Australian, probably) ski instructor."
"Rrrrright. So, who's paying for all this?"
"Ah, Daddy, I think. I'm not sure."
Indeed.

Zenovia's method for eating watermelon: 

1. She places the untouched fruit squarely on the chopping block, takes a few moments to get her stance correct and to feel the weight of the machete in her hand, and to compose herself. 

2. She raises the weapon over her head (she stole it from a giant African black man she had an affair with, years ago) and takes a big breath. 

3. Screaming like a Japanese Samurai warrior, she does one almighty chop in the middle of the watermelon, splitting it in two, then quickly steps to the right and performs another chop on one of the halves still rocking. 

4. She tosses the machete aside, lunges for one of the quarters and, with both hands, buries her face into the juicy flesh where she feasts in a fashion not dissimilar to a Scandinavian Viking eating a roasted turkey. 

The End.

Zettie never stays in one place or thought pattern long enough to get depressed. She's as busy as a beaver this one and spends all her time racing around like an amicable wasp trying to figure out where the clan should settle next.
The sensual and worldly non-pushover.
Zia wears metallic finger nail polish with lots of glitter.

Zion is one of the few people in the Kingdom who had the balls and foresight to confiscate the weed off their parents. They were smoking way too much and sometimes even forgot to take her to school. And things haven't changed, hence Zion isn't as 'out there' as you'd imagine. She's a class warrior, that one.
As a kitchen Bamix she looks cool and curvy, even though she doesn’t do much until she is stimulated into action in some way. If that happens then either stand back or take care.

When she’s not a princess-in-waiting, she’s a princess-proper. Everyone flippantly assumes she is conceited and arrogant but they’d never tell her because, deep down, if they stopped and thought about it, they’d know that this is untrue and that this news would kill her if she ever found out.  Zoe is never that nasty.

Like a succulent chunk of tropical fruit, Zoey is memorable and sensual. She holds her opinions in front of your face if the moment requires it, but she’ll let things slide if need be as well. A lover of social fun more than most, Zoey embraces strangers and often forms the core around which many gatherings rotate. Zoey never lacks followers – be they romantic or otherwise – and rarely does she spend days on end on her own.

Warmer and more forgiving than her cooler cousin (Zoe), Zoi has had a late start but she makes up for it. She'd be good at identifying niche markets for a new start-up, just as she'd predict the impending emotional breakdown of a friend and have rescue plans already set in place for when it happens. She'd even do it for an acquaintance, for this girl has a heart. Cute dimples.

Christ, you ready? If she were a marksman she'd be deadly. Zorette is the kind of girl who'll go to Mexico and, having only seen it on TV, will jump off a 100 foot cliff into the ocean on a whim. Is she crazy? Maybe, but that's her job, God love her.

Elizabeth Taylor, Kelly Slater, De Niro, Redford and Madonna - some names shouldn’t be replicated for the sake of popularism, and Zsa Zsa is one of those. Unless it’s a nickname of course, in which case, ZZ is a curvy, loud and hilarious chunk of overly laid-on sexuality and bravado, and by god she does it well. (If it’s an actual given name…then we don’t even want to go there. Have a nice day.)
Zsusanna knows things about Lawrence that his wife has no idea about.
80% of her body is covered by tattoos, which is fine, but now what?

Aarj has the capacity to barge his way into the conversation, true enough, though it seldom happens. He’s a placid, lovely guy who is rarely rude. On the days he does fire and jump in unannounced, however, you’ll discover a funny mother fucker, and definitely someone worth knowing.
A conniving little shit that squeals like a piglet if he doesn’t get what he wants. When he loses a game of badminton, for example, he’ll often belt the victor in the face with his racquet.

Abe is one of the most chilled-out people in the Kingdom. It's either that or he suffers from narcolepsy. You'll never see him at the side of a sporting ground, for instance, screaming red in the face at an umpire who is in charge of a game that his child is playing in.
Yes, Abel means well, at least we hope he does, but his powers of retaliation know no bounds. And he isn't a fool.
A big, tall, black man, who, like a girl called Besa way before him, takes ages to get warmed up and moving. He's worth it though.
In the words of Yoda, finish what you begin young man. Apply what you have learned. Don't say - do. Etc etc.
Suuuuuuure, he's an accountant. Nah, he smokes the house down and he spends all his money betting on horses. How's that going for you Hoss?
"Achilles, that's enough out of you! Bruno and Hercules are outside already, and if you don't shut up you'll be joining them!"
Adam is a perfectly weighted chunk of granite that sails through the air in a lovely parabolic arc before making a wonderful ba-doink noise as it enters the water. Adam.
The Beer Bringer.

Nice guy, but don't put him in charge. It's not that he's a dill and it's not that he hates the attention of leadership, but he's just too nice. Sometimes leaders need to be ruthless, and this Addison is not. Confrontation isn't really his deal, and that's okay. We can't all do everything. On the flip side, girls love him because he's got a softer heart than most of the wankers they are surrounded by.
Adem can be counted on to do what he says and also to solve the problem with a unique and quite lateral solution. He isn't really a class clown.

As an open and thoughtful individual, Aden deals with responsibility very well and the only real serious trade-off is that, in a million years, he’d never suddenly reappear sleep-walking in the nude at the dying end of a big dinner party, having gone to bed early because he had to work the next morning.

The subtle mastermind who trails almost no discernible wake. Within his circle of friends he is adored and famous, outside it no one has ever heard of him. How does he accomplish this? 

Primarily, by keeping his cool, also by keeping his opinions to himself, unless asked and by retaining a calm sense of optimism and adventure.

Constantly thinking and humorous is Adi, but you wouldn’t pick that either, until you meet him.
An irreverent soul who wants to be where the action is. Whether he turns out to be a tortured artist or not, he is a sensitive, giving guy who has a lot of love for the world.

Adler likes a his 4-wheel drive cars to be big - the bigger the better - and with big shiny wheels. True, he barely drives anywhere that would get the car dirty, but he loves the idea that one day soon he will. Adler.
As a potential control freak, his name is the first thing you say after trying on a pair of shoes that are a size and a half too small. “Oh, ouch!” you yelp as you stand up, “No, their Adrian’s.”

Yes, a very female-leaning name which lends itself to a compassionate and friendly man. Deceptively smart and devoid of a stick-your-chest-out macho ego, Adrien operates behind the scenes with such efficiency and nous that he is largely unheard of and/or underrated, which is a pity. Then again, we suggest Adrien enjoys not being in the limelight. Almost certainly, while he is skilled at nearly everything he turns his hand to, he'd make a wonderful counselor/psychologist and his foresight and understanding of others would be largely wasted if he was a carpenter. All that make sense?
The nickname for many-a-man who understands that life is but a delicious game, and in the paraphrased words of Shakespeare, all you can do is play the best game you can. Amen.

Option A:  If he's a black man, and the blacker the better, then his smile will be larger than his face, he carries peace-only in his heart and he has a deep, long laugh that is contagious like the best flu you've ever heard of. He's intelligent and he's prepared to solve problems and not just walk away from them. Most music gets his hips moving involuntarily, whether he is shy or not, and we can only imagine the fun he gets up to in the boudoir. 

Option B:  If he's a white man then the only permissible reason he was named Africa is if he was conceived there. If he was, then he smiles a lot, he has a ton of friends and his calm demeanour is loved by all. If he wasn't then Africa has buffoons for parents, he's covered in tattoos in ways that make his grandparents wince and, like his parents, he unfortunately has the IQ of a dried packet of chicken noodle soup. High probability he’s on welfare.
Agron rides a fucking dragon to work so it makes sense that he’s a bit strange
An exact male version of his female counterpart, and she’s marvellous.
You belligerent bloody galoot! Now just quieten down for a second please Agostino, we’ll get to your opinion in a moment….Like tomorrow.
Named after a furry puppet, Agro doesn’t have an evil bone in his body and, instead, is impressively quick-witted.

Aidan never weaves a complicated web, at least, not from what we can observe, although most of his thoughts are kept to himself, so perhaps we’ll never know? His only real issue in life is settling on the thing that he loves doing and how he wants to spend his time. This uncertainty is why he looks just a little bit serious. To jolt him out of this, once in a while just give him a playful cheek-grab. That’ll loosen those shoulders up, no worries. (Note: this is a task better undertaken by the women in his life.)
The name of an icebreaker ploughing steadily through the frozen waters of the Antarctic. He is safe and ultra-reliable in even the worst weather.

A.J is an outdoors fellow and he often thinks he should've joined the army. If this is the case then can we suggest not being a machine man for too long. We want you to think for yourself and make your own decisions, brother.
Aktil is rather dippy but he's funny.
Al is alert, he’s hardly ever alarmed and, baby-face or not, he might even be a rather relaxed genius....
The local butcher. (ie. he knows everyone, he’s liked by nearly everyone and he usually answers even the deepest questions with only one sentence.)
Alastair feels that he’d be best suited for an amicable coupling with someone who is aesthetically, financially and morally superior.
A comedic legend that rarely exercises. Having said that, he’s surprisingly quick on his feet, he loves a joke and he’s young at heart.
Alberto is the ring leader until the cops turn up and then he's first out the door. Funny guy, though.
Alby rhymes with “Naah, she’ll be right, and if it breaks, well.....fuck it....it’s not ours anyway.”
In order to escape the tax department Aldo joined a circus. And yes, he's a clown.

A high-powered name on one level but, basically, Alec is too nice to be ruthless and apart from being embarrassed if you ever suggested he should be, he has to carry around the mantle of ‘what might have been’.
Too sensitive to work as a labourer on a construction site, Aleron is a modern man who is good on social media and adept with his personal grooming in his nether regions.

Not a scratch on his female counterpart. The ‘x’ at the end of his name is like a cross road where he stands for most of the time unable to make a decision. (The trade off is that, usually, Alex possesses the highest IQ in the room.)

Alexander married his colleague, Lily, and boy don’t they have fun? Fortunately they have no close neighbours. He is very organised and neat and loves his lycra.  No way would he ever be seen in public holding hands with a hippie.
Alexei is rather brilliant. He is also a nutter.

Yep, both movies were correct, so rather than listen to us for too long, just go and watch those. (…Okay, in a nutshell, Alfie’s niche is to avoid responsibility, have as much fun as he can and to dodge the tax department at all times. Not husband material, ladies.)

An odd one, albeit a nice one. For example, Alfonso will buy a house because he likes the architecture, and he’ll love it forever, even though the Feng Shui is clearly bloody awful and hardly anyone ever visits. He wouldn’t hear a word against his treasure, and why should he? Is he narrow-minded? I suppose it depends on your point of view, but you can’t ever begrudge a passionate human.
Alfred is a quiet old man who wears a Panama hat but no one knows that his younger years were spent exploring the rivers of Northern Africa. He has lived quite a remarkable life.

There are probably a million irresponsible larrikins in the world and here is another one. The closer to the equator Alfy originates from the more fun he is and, regardless of how much work he doesn't do, he is impossible not to like. Just don't loan him any money.
Think long hair. Think calm in a crisis (and possibly so calm he’s useless). Think reserved of opinion.
See Allister.
Publican. (ie. friendly, knows everyone, quick to help and not bad around motors and engines.)

A very intelligent individual who has patience (he doesn't bother to correct people too often if they misspell his name, for instance), a quietly powerful foresight that he rarely shoves down peoples throats and, overall, his children are polite, friendly and happy.
Accountant.
Mummy’s favourite.
Pizza Maker!!! EVERY ONE loves Alonso!!
The Manta Ray.

Alvin was turned into a frog by an evil witch but he’s quite relaxed about it now. He looks like he’s smiling all the time and, like many good frogs, he pisses distilled water, which is great fun at parties. In a nutshell, Alvin takes very little seriously.
The gifted, mysterious and mischievous garden gnome.

Amadeo is a New Guinean Bird of Paradise, with a huge plumage of ornate colourful feathers. He flitters about the jungle canopy, safe from predators below, chirping his way into many-a-maidens’ heart, although he never seems to hang around for too long afterwards. Some creatures are born not to take life’s general irrelevant crap too seriously, and so he doesn’t. Thankfully, Amadeo is also one of these creatures that the universe seems to mysteriously protect. No one knows how or why...

A short man and an excellent pool player. He loves his mates and he loves pulling-off a dodgy deal, so long as no one is hurt at some point down the track. (I only mention it because the same can't be said for some of the people he hangs around with.)

Okay, yes it's true his parents walked down the aisle to the theme from Star Wars, but don't think for a second that this bothers him. Anakin is quick off the mark, and he certainly doesn't have time for boring accountant/government-type people. Indeed, if you're hosting a party that's dying in the arse, you need to get him over quick smart. He might even paint the walls if he dislikes the decor, but fret not. If he says rearrange the furniture you rearrange it. If he says change the music you change it. And if he spies a buffoon in his midst he’ll actively seek to have that person removed from the premises. And if you start to complain then be prepared for him to either ignore you, or simply turn around and walk out the door. It ain't like he hasn’t got another party on somewhere else. Anakin.

Anderson is an Academic. No, he wont win a Nobel Prize and people won't know his name, but he will play his part perfectly and with diligence. (Note: At some point in his life he needs to leap from the roof of a house into the pool, on impulse. Or, preferably, from a large vessel that he happens to be sailing on, perhaps in the Adriatic. If he does this early enough, then look out because the gloves will come off!!)
The Fork Lift who takes his time, and who believes a handshake is as good as a signed contract.
He speaks Spanish – or at least everyone thinks he does – and girls love him, but for some reason he never seems to look like an ‘Andre’.

Andreas approaches the various aspects, tasks and components of his life like a dedicated scientist who leaves nothing to chance. This very driven nature can be painful to deal with, let alone observe, but he has a good heart and he’s probably good at chess.

Sure, his methods can be harsh but what can you do? As a Russian mafia boss this is what his life has become. Sadly, he's come to understand the folly of such an existence, but it's too late to get out of it. There's too much invested.

For a long time we didn't get it either, up here in the commentary box, because nearly all Andrews are decent people, often wonderful, but it’s a nothing name that doesn’t actually do anything at all. Once upon a time, the best we could have said is that he might be a quiet mystery. At worst, a nothing bit of nothing, but that’s not fair. He has now evolved into a very nice, very straight piece of quality wood. He’s sanded, he’s there on the carpenter’s bench and he’s ready to rumble. So we’ll just sit here until a carpenter shows up, eh? It’d shouldn’t be too long. We hope...

Backgammon World Champion, unless he’s Argentinian, in which case he saunters from A to B without much movement, and with a quiet look of calm humour on his face, as if he’s just thought of a great dish he’s going to cook tonight.

Similar to his cousin, above, his name drops away into nowhere right at the end when it needs to fly and he therefore spends a lot of time feeling slightly disappointed. But, he’s not half as bland as he sounds because he is a generous and friendly personality and the only question we have is, can he prevail? Andy, have you got a carpenter ordered, brother?

"Mmmmmmm, I see," he says, rubbing his chin. Despite being busy, Anees gave your problem three seconds of pure concentrated thought and, bang, here is your solution. Chances are it will be correct, and if you don't like it we suggest not wasting his time again by asking him something else later on. Indeed, waste his time once and you probably won't catch him again anyway.
More stubborn than Leigh (male) and deafer than Reg, Aneurin approaches life like a coal brick.
Angel is a funny guy who is reliable 47% of the time. He’s also a gambler and a womaniser, but hey, no one’s perfect.
Upbeat and opportunistic.
The axis of any rotating sphere. Every moon, planet and star has one, and they are constant forces in a silent universe, which means that some are more perfectly hidden than others.

Devoid of any fanfare, Angus is contented and always well prepared. If you want to fix a situation then get him over immediately. Don’t speak to him unless spoken to, and if he asks you to do something then do it without question. It’ll be the right thing to do and it might very well save your life. (If you are married to one, or intend to, don’t expect him to remember your birthday.)
His name ends before it begins, which is why he doesn’t have time to say hello. He’ll just jump out in front of you, all smiles, grab you around the shoulders and say, “Quick! Let’s go!”

Anish ain’t no sycophant, no sir. He’s the captain of his ship and often the captain of his peers, who he rules with ridiculous ideas and a stupid grin. 
“It’s a tough life,” someone will say.
“Oh no it’s not,” Anish will reply, quickly. “Life is a mystical adventure. Why are you not thinking the same, my friend?”
And if someone wants to wallow then Anish will assist for only so long, because usually he has a scheme going on just around the corner and if he doesn’t move fast the opportunity may pass.
Anish.
Anson has never publicly displayed affection in his entire life. Anson, my boy, perhaps it's time to go live in Italy for a while?

One of the more loving, aware and socially active men in the Kingdom. A pacifist, Ant' will do whatever it takes to keep everyone happy and only then will he see to his own needs. He makes a sensational father, an interested work colleague and a funny and faithful friend to have on any level. If anything, his frustrations arise from not having enough time for himself.

Anthony hates it when he’s called Tony but it happens so often that he lets it slide, although this does build up a slight, if not general, resentment of the twits that he’s surrounded by. Normally, he holds a Ph.D in either physics, law or some kind of biological science.

Antoine drives a 40 tonne truck at a mine-site…(just kidding!) Antoine is a bar of soap (metrosexual city boy) and he smells nice…..well….unless he’s French, in which case he’s a comedian and a fornicator.
As a mild-mannered physician, his name isn’t short for anything and it isn’t long for anything. Indeed, it’s just right. Anton.

Not quite the head of state, he is the attempted-head-of-the-family, at least he is until his wife chimes in, at which point he capitulates. In short, Antonio looks good and frowns at the right moments, which works as a nice bluff for a while, but he’s full of shit. 
And that’s okay. Remember that some of us have to be.

The temperamental coffee maker with a Southern European heritage who talks non-stop. He’s rude to most people, he loves to dance close with beautiful women in the same fashion that a large fake Coca-Cola bottle rotates on a milk bar counter, and he loves his own reflection.
Aquila loves sashimi and his style in life is reflected by this. He likes things simple and elegant, and easy to understand first time round.

Archer is successful in business although he does occasionally lack the human touch. All he needs to do, in order to become the perfect human, like most of us, probably, is to go and volunteer in a third world country where the shit has well and truly hit the fan, and where compassion is your only currency. (Good friends with Phillipa, Mitchell and Marius.)

Best friends with Phillip/Philip, Archibald knows all the Renaissance masters, he is well-read and he is excellent company at a large and talkative dinner party. But, if the fate of the planet depended on Archibald catching a tennis ball that was thrown reasonably accurately at him from 30 metres away, then the world, I'm afraid, would be in dire straits.
Pure as the driven snow my arse. Archie is, however, a very canny bookmaker.

To call Argo a loner is to assume he is only happy in his own company, and this isn’t so. Argo is one of the very few gifted geniuses, and defining genius is effectively an exercise in artistic appreciation. Argo loves people just as he loves life, but he is able to throw his thoughts and imaginings so far from where he stands that not many are able to grasp what he is capable of, or where his mind is. In short, Argo is crystal-pure and unique to the point of distraction.
His entire name is off the ground like an Osprey at full tilt and this boy, therefore, can do just about anything and make it look pretty easy. In which case, he needs our congratulations.

Would you describe Arian as The Flash?

No, you wouldn’t because he tends to take his time.

Would you describe him as something of a using toad?

No, you definitely wouldn’t because he is considerate and thoughtful in most situations.

Is he an artist?

….sometimes.

Is he a macho, obnoxious waste of time?

No, he’s definitely not that. Indeed, his rather quiet nature leads people to believe he is gentle and secretive. 

(Note: He does love his sci-fi.)

Yes, it's true: He HAS made a plaster cast of his own erect phallus, but you've got to appreciate a man who not only does that, but places it fair and square in the middle of the mantelpiece, afterwards. (He encourages guests to rub it for good luck.)
Arjen is aloof like a lone lion.

Option A: Take a breath, now hold it in. Hold it. Don’t breath, and listen. Listen to the stillness...Can you hear it?
Ark. That’s him - the noise of perfect nothing. No one knows how he does it.

Option B: A terrifying youngster.

Ah, the prodigal son whose ego is clearly never in need of bolstering, no siree. Highly intelligent, Arkaan cruised through school and then through university, and he hasn't been tested properly yet, it seems. The question is, will he cope under pressure? We suspect he not only will, but secretly will have been wishing for this moment his whole life.
Maths nerd. If he's a caucasian then only Asian women find him attractive, and vice versa if he's of Asian extraction himself. Strange, eh?

No, he's not shy. He's just not wasteful in any way. As a deep-thinker who always, always means well, he speaks his mind and is thoughtful at all times. Had he been born in India he'd be a bloody guru of some sort by now, with a huge long beard and a dot in the middle of his forehead, easily visible to everyone stretched out in front of him in the 150 metre queue of people desperate to touch his feet.
Arlo is one of the few men in the Kingdom who actually PREFERS to skinny dip on his own. I've no idea why, although as a hyper-sensitive and rather brilliant artisan I guess it makes sense.

You probably wont seem him for very long, if at all. Arlyn used to work for the CIA smuggling men and weapons across more than one Middle Eastern border. Most of the time his bosses didn’t even know where he was. These days he rarely acts rashly, he is highly intelligent, he is the last person to comment on any particular issue and no way would he be seen partaking in any kind of potentially scandalous act. Oh don’t worry, he’s not a saint, you’ll just never see him enjoy himself properly, that’s all. He’s never that public. So just bare this in mind when you meet him.
What a brilliant and marvellous lump of melodrama he is. Although he struggles to keep his dick in his pants. I suppose it comes with the territory.

A mixute of German and South African, Armin was armed for a long time, especially when the marauding locals tried to strorm his compound near Jo'burg. None of them lived for long and, boy, isn't Armin a barrel of laughs nowadays!

A rare South American nut that is very hard, albeit delicious. It’s so hard in fact, that if you dropped it from the top of a very tall building onto a bitumen road, it wouldn’t register that anything has actually happened to it. (Closely related to Wendell.)

Where as Aaron might be a conniving little shit, Aron is far more forgiving, and happier, actually. The lack of double A at the start means he doesn’t kill anyone in front of him, but he’s still a sneaky little prick - a buck here, a peak up a skirt there, an extra chocolate shoved down the trousers somewhere else - you name it. Aron can garner all that he needs and without anyone knowing about it and he’s therefore skilled at guerrilla warfare.
Yes, by default he possesses the temperament of an artist, but he is also The Quiet and Remarkable Achiever.

You might think he’s a dour old man, but he is, in fact, a funny bastard who has lost his keys. He knew he put them down somewhere but for life of him he doesn’t remember where. And he’s late. Naturally, he talks to himself while he searches in the hope that some Lost Key God will find humour in his search and thus show him where they are. This is Arthur’s lot.

Arturo looks like a serious man but don’t be deceived. Having said that, he wastes no time talking to people whom he believes have no spine and he has multiple career changes each year. In fact, like Kenny, no one really knows what Arturo does with his days. When he marries he doesn’t get divorced (theoretically).
Ash is beautiful, flexible and contented like one of those monster trees that live in The Valley of the Giants, in Western Australia, or perhaps Northern California.
Now Asher, there's only one person who stands between you and untold greatness. Do you know who that might be?...
A good-looking smart arse. He and Dean are as thick as thieves, and they occasionally are.
The Flat Football. All he needs therefore is a powerful partner to pump him up and get him out the door.
Asif endeavours to plan most things meticulously.

Proof that variety is the spice of life, if all of us abhored physical labour as much as Aston then nothing would get built, not a single hole would be dug and barely any beer would be drunk in far-flung pubs out there on the desert edge after a hard day’s work. (Note: Single-handedly he keeps at least three male hair product companies in business.)
Tell me he’s a comedian? If he isn’t he should be. Someone this funny needs to make some money out of it, surely.

There's always that question in sport: What's better, a team of champions or a champion team?
The team of champions is great to watch, but they lack the discipline to work for each other. So, of course you’d prefer a champion team.
Atticus, despite his rather irreverent appearance and the girth of his ego, is the name of a such a group.

No, he doesn't spend hours and days cooped up in one, like a long-lost painting. Attiq is 'at it' and into life. After people meet him they develop that look on their face which says, "Oh right! That's an unusual name, but what a lovely, present and centred individual!", by which time they immediately feel slightly better about life and themselves.

All problems are solvable, and all dilemmas lead to moments of great learning: this is what Attiq has  been brought here to tell us. Don't sit around and complain. Pinpoint your weakest areas or greatest fears, then go do something about it. Amen, young Attiq.

Aubrey got whacked in the nuts playing either cricket or baseball as a kid and gave up sport immediately. Today he designs tax breaks for corporations and hangs out with Christian, Jonathon and Benjamin.
The flamboyant crepe maker who rarely spends a night in.
A Kiwi. Except he moves like a Sloth and ingests way too many substances.

Highly intelligent, cheeky after the curtain drops and always scoping out interesting people and situations, Austen would make a splendid rat. Now, don’t freak out, we don’t mean that in a bad way at all. Austen is skilled and he’s busy, so give him any kind of unsolvable dilemma and watch him go. (The only thing you’ll never see Austen do is boast about his achievements.)
Austin is the name of a fat gold ring that’s worn on the pinkie of a fat man who is middle aged, wealthy, and in the process of discovering his homosexuality.
Intelligent, patient, thoughtful and rarely prone to displays of outrageous public affection = Chief flying instructor.

Yes, Avi is avid, naturally. He's also open, and happy, he's business savvy and he's quick to act. True, he's never once received a splinter and he can't hit a tennis ball to save his life but we all have a niche to fill!

If he can handle the corporate life and the drudgery of wearing a suit every day he'd make a talented spin-doctor. However, our advice, young Axel, is to ditch that ego, at least for a little while, and select a course that takes you on a different route altogether and away from one that aids in the dumbing-down of the masses. Money ain't everything so perhaps you should work for the other team? Do some good: this is the message today.

(And yes, you're still allowed a stack of fun.)

Does he think things through properly? Has he ever? Mmmm, it's a good question. I suppose you can't blame him. If he believes in only this second and has difficulty seeing the future - and let's face it, he's not on his own - then maybe that's his lot. In a politically correct world, perhaps we need a few more Axton-Bulls to run at the gate and shake things up a bit?

He's about as close as any man can get to being The Invisible Man. People meet him at parties, chat to him for ages and enjoy the whole conversation and then, two days later during a discussion about the aforementioned gathering, those same people will be surprised to hear that Ayden was there.
How this happens we’re not sure. Ayden looks after himself and expects others to do the same, but he keeps it all very low-key. He's a nice fellow and this is just how it is.

On his gravestone they will write:

Not only did he go under the radar 
He built the radar.
If there is such a thing as the middle of the road, then Ayman is the machine that spits out the dotted white line. As we keep saying, we all have a niche to fill.
The young folk of today just don't know the value of a hard days' work, do they.
Believe it or not Baba shuns the limelight and he has a good nose for a bargain, be it for a car, a bag of drugs or an offshore company.

Yep, Baden can light a fire and he can put up a tent but he's a pacifist. Hence, if you're out there in the wilderness, starving to death and in need of a big protein hit, don't give the knife to him. He'll kill nothing and only wind up hurting himself.
A humble man who works with his hands.

The fat happy man that giggles constantly. He works for a merchant bank in downtown New York, London or Sydney and apparently he’s pretty good at what he does. Often seen with spittle on his shirt of a Friday night, all he wants from his life is to hang out with his friends and try to talk to girls.

Yep, Bailin was conceived inside a surfboard cover on a cold and chilly night on some beach midway between Sydney and Brisbane, Australia. In adulthood, therefore, you probably can’t blame him that he has more bracelets and necklace-thingos than he’s ever had jobs. However, he walks with a smooth style and he has a cheeky grin, which seems to open more doors than it closes.
It is alleged by chemists, physicists and modern-day philosophers that inside Galaxy Bairdy, the normal laws of Quantum Mechanics do not apply. Indeed, they cannot apply.
Tough nut. Funny cunt. Good value.
Plumber.

Balin has a clean heart and is good with his hands. He's uncomfortable in a suit (he hates ties altogether) and he likes girls who wear ornate metal bracelets around their biceps, and who are deeply tanned from places very near the equator. He'd look damn good skin diving in Micronesia, for example, and while many might suggest he do a stint at uni to get him started, all those crowds might suffocate him. Balin, be free!
He's a funny little bugger, alright. Lot's of friends. Good at building cubby-huts.

Yes, I know what you're thinking and no, he isn’t human. Bam Bam is actually the name of a wooden club that has fairy lights wrapped around the outside which strobe on and off. It is owned and used by a famous DJ who pulls it out during the beat-peak of one of his songs when the crowd before him is erupting maximally. Bam Bam loves the noise, he loves the girls screaming at him, and he has no responsibilities in life whatsoever.

Is he a human rights' lawyer?
No.
Is he the pilot of the plane you're travelling on?
No.
Does he shower every day?
No.
Would he pass the rigours of an elite military diving course?
No.
Would he make a lot of people laugh over a quite drink, after he's finished his gig?
Yes. Yes, he would.
Nope, he'll never work for one and he'll profit quite nicely, both financially and philosophically, from the 4 or 5 or 6 plants he lovingly grows, annually. Banks ain't designed for the city.

The Swedish submarine. (Once upon a time, during war games against an American carrier fleet, the sneaky sub made its way past a ring of destroyers, frigates and cruisers, and nailed the aircraft carrier with a single torpedo, before escaping undetected.)

So, anyone seen him lately?

So, anyone seen him lately?
Bar is neither sloppy nor stupid. He's the sort of bloke who makes his mind up quickly and rarely changes it. If he says he's going to be somewhere at a given time, that's what will happen.

The smooth walkin' black man with a big sack. He ain't no hack, so you won't need to watch his back, an' all he really needs is some marines to go on the attack. "Attack who?" you ask. He stops and looks at you evenly, ensures he's got your attention and then says, "Fear. That's what we need to attack.” So be it, Young Barack.
Barnaby loves it when one of his mates has a buck’s party because it means he can try and kiss the strippers.
The name of any man who owns and runs a pub or a bar, or at least spends three hours every afternoon in the same one as a patron.

Option A: The annoying drunkard who is famous at his local night club, if only because he is always the oldest person on the dance floor.

Option B: The staunch loner who deals with his eccentric passion without fanfare or ego.
The Gentle Giant.
Barry is a genial fellow who is rarely rushed and whose heart in the right place
Basic. Funny guy though and, no, he won't be heading up a major corporation any time soon.

As a great man once said, talk about a blind man in a dark room trying to find a black cat that isn't there. Bartholemew can barely even put his own trousers on, such is his general level of confusion over just about everything. Nice fellow, however.

“Barton!” you yell. “Where are you boy?”

You listen... No, he's not here. Which means he's somewhere else, either fishin', laughin', surfin' or schemin' for girls and maybe a beer.

Barton.

How can one scientifically describe a beautiful painting? Should we? How? I mean, where do you start, especially if it’s an abstract piece? Take the colours for example…..they’re supposed to be strange and comedic, right?

Reasonably forthright and conscientious, Bastian is a traditional man. So traditional, in fact, that he pines for the day when terrorists wipe out the power grid so he will be able to meet and greet foreign and exotic women via the use of an introductory letter that has been written by someone else. (Who knows? Maybe he’s a budding terrorist, himself?)
Bat has five mobile phones on him. You probably need to ask him why that is, although sometimes in life it's best not to know. Bat.
The Curtain Raiser who is actually funnier than the main act.
An informed man who keeps his opinions to himself, generally. Not mainstream, Bay may very well be a vegan or vegetarian. He’s a nice fellow.

You probably wouldn’t make Bayden head of an OH&S consultancy, though he’d fake his way through it and do a good-enough job anyway. What am I talking about, you ask? Well, Bayden is a well-rounded, interesting and interested individual, but he is all about standing up for what you believe in and not shirking your responsibilities, be they personal or professional, and having a laugh, of course. In a nutshell, Bayden as a CEO would do okay, but his company wouldn’t rip any body off ever, and so somewhere sometime profit margins may not be as great as they might be. On the flip side, if every cop was like Bayden new prisons wouldn’t be needed because humour and genuine assistance (at all levels) is what the constabulary would fight all crime with. The results would be staggering. (And in this ‘Bayden World’ naturally, where everyone looks after themselves and everyone else, OH&S consultancies are never needed.)
Addicted to video games.
The zombie killer who never leaves home without a handkerchief.
The ‘zed’ at the end of his name bubbles like French champagne (or cheap beer) and so whoever he is, Baz is effervescent and outgoing in some way, and probably more than most of his peers.

The first time you say his name you feel like you’re dealing with a fluffy, jolly kind of cake which wasn’t mixed enough before it went in the oven. Repeat it a few more times and you are confronted with the reality of an extremely well-weighted name and a well-tended personality. When the chips are down Bealy’s gaze turns steely and he moves swiftly and with determination. Courage personified.
Way deeper than he looks (or sounds), many people surreptitiously seek Bean out for advice because of his streamlined approach to all things.

Bear only considers he's had a fun night out if he comes home with blood on his shirt and at least one loose tooth. Yes, he's killed people but what the hey. In 4 billion years the sun is going to expand as it dies and engulf the Earth, at which point what will matter?
Yes, he has a beard and he is a gifted maniac.

Beau rhymes with “Oooh!” It is also the name given to the phenomenon of a bag of banana lollies being carried by a 4 year old, who drops the bag, which splits, sending the bananas sprawling through the sand. In anyone’s language this is a tragic event. (Not a natural-born leader.).
Nope, Bec isn’t a chick, he’s a man with an easy smile and a surprisingly relaxed demeanour. He hardly ever gets into a rage, which is nice, and he has plenty of friends.

A single-minded young man who settles on his target displaying neither emotion or fear, whether it's a record sales number for the company he works for, the exit of the 12 foot Tahitian  barrel that he's currently in, or that tiny dot on the map which represents the end to a 400 mile desert crossing.
Does he actually ever work?
…nope.
Like a possum preparing for winter, if Beecher sets out to do something he does it, and generally better than any of his peers.
Beef is not as daft as you might think and he's quite generous with his time and money. His approach to women is basically identical to J.D's - and he has the same deep voice.

A quiet word here, a gentle nudge of advice there, perhaps a meaningful gift of encouragement anonymously placed on the bonnet when you least expect it. Belly is a team player and will probably go to his grave giving more to the group around him then he would ever expect himself. Better with men than with women.

Deep in a shallow kind of way, Ben inhabits the role of a loner more than you might think. He may not be the life of the party although he’s not always predictable, either, and he’d definitely suffer at the hands of an interrogator for longer than most.

Option A:  All the girls in the girls' toilets are talking about that Benedict fellow, whose opening line seems to consist of him suggesting that they might like to come home with him and measure his penis. It sounds like Benedict is in for another long, fruitless night.

Option B: Studied law and politics, and if he lines his ducks up right, and he usually does, he'll fight for human rights and maybe one day become the Premier. Go you good thing!

Benj is one of the most peace-loving animals in the Kingdom. He's been reincarnated many times however, especially in the era of motorcars, because he's thrown himself in front of many in the course of saving a young child from certain death.
Benjamin is a neat, nice and formal individual without being a pain about it, hopefully, and yes, he’s a mild soul that appreciates the good in the world. We can’t all be John Travolta.
As a North Sea Viking in a past life, Benji is full of Scottish blood and rollicking good humour, although these days he is so nice that even he admits that girls with large bosoms frighten him.

Like a modern day computer that updates itself automatically, Benn looks after his own affairs with relative ease. The double Ns provide a tall fence behind which we can hear him building, constructing, welding and cavorting. What's he up to in there? No one knows. In fact, here, give us a leg up. Let's take a look...

Benna’s moral code is extremely rigorous, so much so that he might even evolve into some kind of human rights lawyer. Hard to imagine here, I know, but as a traveller and a peace-lover perhaps it makes sense. He’s a good cook.

You know those movies where there is a drinking competition between two people? They're generally surrounded by the whole bar, it's loud, everyone is drunk and it's late, and one man has the job of directing competion and announcing exactly when a shot has been successfully swallowed. He might even  be handling some of the bets. Anyway, that man is Bennett, and while he's a shonky prick he's also good to know.
Cheesy.

A reincarnated warrior from the moors of middle-England, hundreds of years ago. He was something of a clan leader back then, although he was never that successful. But he planned the battles as well as he could, and if he ever did a past-life regression, today, he would understand why he loves topographic maps as much as he does. Google Earth, therefore, is the most magnificent invention he's ever seen.
Fast hands. Easy smile. Good with the ladies - and the men if he's in the market for them. Benson is a croupier who is good at making strangers feel at ease.

No, he wasn't conceived in the back of one, although the seats would be worth it. Bentley is, however, an erect and diligent man who aspires to the top end of town. Will he get there? No one knows, but his journey will be fun to watch. He's quite the exhibitionist, you know.

Beran struggles in the kitchen. He loves eating and he loves good food, but cooking is just not his thing. We suspect it's because he has quite a stressful job and when he comes home he just needs to chill out and contemplate nothing.
No, he's not a sociopath, he’d just comfortable in his own skin and calls a spade a spade. Don’t like it? Leave.

As a patron of the arts and a patron of all things related to the delivery of humour and life, Bernard loves champagne and his friends and he’s a marvellous person to have around, but don’t waste his time by asking him to fix your car.

A pragmatic man of German or Northern European origin. Once you get a handle on his sense of humour, and let's face it, sometimes that can take years, you will discover he's quite a funny and intelligent individual.

Bernie is the sort of man who, at formal functions, will curse at his reflection in the men’s toilet when he realizes that, three minutes earlier, he was chatting-up a girl while he had flecks of food stuck to the side of his chin and an unusual globular shaped mass inside his right nostril.
Midway between a fart, a burp and a bump in the night, Bert is a light-hearted man who makes everyone feel eminently comfortable – special, even. I wonder where he has gone....
Like a goldfish who can only deal with the present moment, Bertie will never own a house and he’ll never be lonely. Funny as fuck, Bertie has a presence that is undeniable.

Bertrand doesn't carry around that many burdens, indeed, he may lug around no baggage whatsoever. He's definitely not a coal miner and as an educated and travelled man, Bertrand remains incredulous at the amount of irrelevant bullshit human beings appear to get involved with. Life should be simple, it should involve laughter and friends and good wine, and interesting stories which force one to consider how fortunate one is: this is his perfect life mantra. (And yes, a tiny wee part of him enjoys being lauded for his unique brilliance, but this isn't unusual.)

At big luncheons Berty shines. He eats with his hands, talks with a mouthful of food, laughs with unbridled enthusiasm and no matter which vicar is present, and no matter how initially shocked they are at his behaviour, Berty wins them over in the end. He doesn't even realise he's doing it. And at the end of lunch, if the tea is too hot to drink, he'll pour it into the saucer to so it can cool before guzzling it thus.

As a close relative of Eugene and Nigel, Bevan is absolutely more energetic and intelligent than one might presume. The great side-effect of the comedy of his name is that he has more friends than most people, and he’s always giving with his time and industrious with his actions.

No one is that stupid and obtuse, and Bevis is actually quite delightful. He shrugs his shoulders at most dilemmas and will usually find a way through. Believe it or not he’s quite calm under pressure.
A loud leader of his friends who is braver than most. He struggles with shy people and if he doesn’t drive a BMW at some point in his life I’ll eat my hat.

Ah, Bickerton, where's a camera when you need one? You know those preposterous moments in life when, say, three incredibly unusual events happen at the same time? (eg- you've just finished removing leaves from the roof and you're half way down the ladder with a large screwdriver stuffed down your shorts, when two things happen. 1. You have a sudden attack of diarrhea and 2. There's an earthquake.) Anyway, a moment like this is described in scientific literature as a Bickerton Interception.
No, you can't see them coming. You've just got to do the best you can.
Sometimes a handshake is all you need to tell you that you like a person. This handshake is known as The Bill. It is a rare and wonderful event.

Billy perfected his graffiti tag about six months ago and this week, having been given a dare in front of a girl that he really likes, he plans to ride into the city on the top of a train. There’s a 19% chance that he’ll live to tell the tale.

B.J plays hard (at least he did as a young man), he works hard, he loves his friends and family and he has a very deep sense of what’s wrong and right with the world. And he’ll do what he can to help.

Yep, he's a cocky (and funny) little shit who knows he is good looking. And that's okay. His mother has a list of his addresses and it isn't short, and if anyone kept track of the ladies in his life they might find a similarly thick document. Marketing, advertising and the beach life: this is where you might find him. Has he visited Bondi Beach or Tijuana yet? (If he does he many never leave.)
A breath of fresh air.

Betwixt between the intellectual world and the soulful realm of the undercurrents, Blackie is sort of bloke who is truly at peace on his surfboard. He’s not an ornithologist, for instance, but he can spot a New Holland Honeyeater quicker than anyone, although, as a trade-off, he carries a whip-like temper and he gets jealous.
His friends tell the story: Leo, Leon, Tyrone and Jason (Jasonicus thuggus, not Jasonicus raucous.)
With all the charisma of a witch's hat Blaine is a self-appointed legend. You certainly can't miss him.
He’s no bar-room brawler, but Blair is intensely ambitious

Okay, so he's got another of these American titles that are taking over the world. Fortunately, Blake is a smooth name and so he rides-out all that nonsense with style and with an educated kind of grace. He's actually a lovely fellow who is compassionate and thoughtful, and he's no dill. Not a bad performance all round, to be honest.

Money, business, money and prestige - seriously brother, who gives a shit. Get out in the desert, get out in the ocean, just get outside anywhere which will peel back your senses and make you feel the blood in your veins. Good luck.

Sketchy? Never. Well, as a young fellow it took him a while to find his feet but that happens to most people. He does like his personal projects though and he may never be known as the best Team Player. Very well-suited to city living.
Fart cushion manufacturer.

"I know, I agree with you, don’t worry. I hate hitting any animal with my car, shit! But we're nearly there, both of us are hungry, and that deer will taste great on the campfire, trust me.”                             -Blowie.
Shy around girls if he hasn’t got a beer in his hand.
Deeper than a very shallow pond, Bo rarely bothers with a preamble. He sees it, he’s in. He doesn’t think, he just acts. Bo.

Okay, so Boab was conceived on a camping trip somewhere between Broome and Darwin, in north-west Australia, which is fine. So, did they send you to school Boab? You do know how to count, right? Indeed, like Murray back in the good old days, Boab feels very uncomfortable around too much traffic, noise and people, so he’s better off staying away from cities. The ocean might do him good as well. He tends to go out with stunning hippy girls with feathers in their hair and sexy leather straps around their biceps.
An affable bloke who rarely rushes things and who learns from his mistakes.

No not a boab, that’s a tree that gets very big and very old, but Boaz isn’t a bad representation. He’s patient, he likes to do things right, he has a calming demeanour and he has plenty of friends. Not prone to attracting crazy women, Boaz does very well in his own company and in a million years he’d never shop at Ikea.
Bob is an old ute that’s done about a million miles and he has a fair bit left in him yet. He’s not in mint condition and he’s not meant to be. (Good mates with Graeme.)

In a group of young male idiots who are possessed by the thrill and power of the pack, Bodhan, though not the leader of the group, is the single, shining light who provides a moral compass when needed.
People expect the opposite, and that is exactly why Bodhi is slow to take the initiative. Nice guy though.

Bodo loves a good flood. He likes getting out in the waters that are waist deep in his street, and he enjoys helping others in distress. Perhaps it's the idea of boating down the road that he loves? We're not sure.

Mate, don’t worry, your parents used to smoke a mountain of weed. Anyway, Boedy is a shy kind of cat who trails behind the corporate leaders who he eventually realises are full of shit. It gives him time to ponder the deeper things in life, anyway, which has also enabled him to realise that beauty is in the small things and therefore everywhere. He’d be an excellent yoga instructor.
Bohden has always harboured a desire to go canoeing down a long river with nothing but a tent, some basic provisions and perhaps a gun and a companion/maiden.
Yep, he's the dead-spit of Herman Munster.

A giant man with a giant heart. And that's great, but even he would admit to not being the sharpest tool in the box. More than most, Bomber craves a simple life with a loving wife and couple of healthy kids that he can throw around in the back yard in summer time.
Booker is the kind of bloke who submits a $9 million boat plan to a boat-building company on white butchers’ paper, having spent five minutes drawing it with a black crayon.
No, there are no surprises here folks. "Now, Boris! Just siddown' otherwise the boat will capsize, you idiot!"

You can't choose your family yet, can you? Pity. Anyway, Boston is just a normal, slightly shy kind of fellow.
Will he become the country’s leader?
No way.
Does he have friends?
Yes.
Does he fully believe he can achieve greatness?
Not yet…

Bow is the only man in the Kingdom that has to charge his jocks. They have weird little LED fairy lights woven into them, you see. He can even alter what they do. Have a chat to him about it - he's not shy at all and he's quite proud of them. He thinks he'll meet a wife because of them.

Like solid bark on a healthy old tree, Bowden operates with the minimum of fuss. You will never see him getting married in the nude during a parachute jump, for instance, and everything he does is accomplished with a nonchalant kind of grace. One can easily imagine Bowden’s wife about to enter the water on a SCUBA dive, as part of a resort getaway she had bought them as a treat, and the dive master asking her, “Hang on, you’re on your own. Where’s Bowden?” In all likelihood, she would smile, look back at them and say, “Oh, he’s back at the resort, sitting. Just sitting.”
As a professional hunter he's adept as keeping himself in the shadows and he'll quite happily sit hidden in the one spot for hours, if need be.
A spender and a pot head.

Boyd always looks like he's thinking hard. He's actually quite a funny soul, despite his heavy academic load. Oh, did I mention that Boyd is a geology lecturer at university? Rocks don't move too fast and this suits Boyd to the ground, pardon the pun.

If he isn’t a new yo-yo (ie. a fad that comes and goes without affecting the philosophy of those that he mingles with) then Brad is a calming soul whose direction in life seems to have been perfectly predestined. It helps that he is almost invariably tall, but in this case, even a short conversation with Brad is enough to provide you with clarity of insight.
Rarely superficial or flippant, Braden navigates a reasonably meaningful and dedicated path through life. He likes his sport and his girlfriends/lovers/partners etc are normally quite well adjusted.

Honestly, does anyone really care? (Note: If this is the only name people know him by, can we suggest that he ignores the career suggestions of his parents by not attending either law or medical school, and that he gets out in the world more than he has? Thanks.)
Brady is a nice enough guy with plenty of friends and yadda yadda yadda, but he's completely inoffensive.

He's not Bruce, he's not Ray, he's Brae! Like his cousin Victoria, Brae is a well-mannered horse who knows what-is-what. Unlike horses which are incapable of lying, however, Brae can bend the truth and will often hold his cards very close to his chest. He has plans and he has nous, and why explode with emotion at some unexpected outcome when you know that time is on your side?

Man, he's a stubborn prick sometimes. It must be that pig's cranium that sits on top of his neck. But, you have to give him his due because like Sue before him he's wonderful at finishing projects well. He makes an excellent foreman/CEO.
No, don’t brake Braith, accelerate. Jump. Be daring. Rip off that fucking tie and get out there boy! Who cares what anyone thinks!
Bram is not the pig-headed mule that you presume he might be. He's actually a little bit shy. He's not a fool, though.

Brandon is the branch of a gum tree that broke off in a storm about three years ago. He was sturdy and flexible when he hit the ground but the months in the summer heat have dried him clean and made him frail. Nowadays he’d make easy prey for a hot summer fire that was gathering steam and he’d snap in your hands if you tried to break him in half, but there’s a 20% chance that, if you did that, he would slap you in the face as the final energetic act of his quite complex life.

Sure, he does know a lot but can someone take him off the school of human behaviour and teach him the art of reading peoples' reactions? Maybe he just needs to work on his delivery? We know you don't mean to brother, but even if required-information is shoved down peoples' throats you'll end up sitting alone on desert island wondering what happened.
Brant prides himself on his feet which he pumices regularly. He detests spilt food and messy sex, and he has a spectacularly neat bedroom.
Definitely no moron, Brantley is educated and quirky, and it takes more than just a passing shower to dissuade him. He looks like a nerd doesn’t he? He’s not.
Big, loud, bold and red-headed.

It's a modern trend apparently, that being when men shave their groin but not their face. Why is that? Yes, Braxton may not indulge in either of these pastimes but he does have all the makings of a rather splendid hipster. It's the hairdo (on his head) that gives it away. Smart guy though, with friends and ability, and as a modern man he's tech savvy, but Lord help us if calamity strikes and suddenly we have no electricity, for the Braxtons will struggle to inherit the earth!

Rarely prone to dirt and germs, if Bray is travelling then you wont find him in the bug-ridden jungles of Sumatra or Brazil. No, he'll be at a swank resort on either Fiji or Tahiti, sipping cocktails by the pool. The air conditioner in his room is well and truly on.

Born into a nice middle-class family, Brayden is good in school, popular with people, successful in life and happy. True, he won’t ever trek to the North Pole, discover a new species of fish in Lake Victoria or get ‘Hi, how are you?’ tattooed down the length of his member, but he’ll procure a wife, have three kids and enjoy watching them grow and contribute, just as he did.

Many girls have tried to tame Brec for a domestic life inside a house with them, but few have succeeded. Brec is his own man. The five-day stubble isn't a look, he just doesn’t like shaving plus it keeps the sun off. Brec spends more time on his own than most men and he’s fine with that.

He can shoot. He can mend a fence. He can remove the testicles of young steers with a knife and he knows how to fix the diff on the Landcruiser. (Note: If he's a city boy he can do none of those things and he spends way too much time in front of the mirror.)

Brekyn rhymes with 'So, waddaya reckon?', even if it's said with a slightly impatient tone. To this end he is a good kid and an industrious young man but he gets bored. And, okay, yes, so he has stubborn horns that stick out the top of his head, but, honestly, who's perfect?
Like any sensitive concrete block, Brendan is functional, surprisingly conservative and occasionally highly competitive. And he’s nearly always tall.

Like a bashful wee beaver, busy making his little damn in the little creek, he knows people think he's a tiny bit odd. So what if he is? Doesn't Mother Nature have each of us performing strange little deeds that everyone else might think is absurd? This is part of the grand plan, you understand. So, there Brenden is, scurrying around between locations, hiding from the spotlight and sticking to the shade. Predator Avoidance is at the top of his list.
A rather dopey bloke who thinks with a clean heart, unless no one is looking.
An extremely large and weighty office table made of dark mahogany wood. The rather fantastic item is a place of great insight and, most important, top level secrets….
Organised. Preoccupied. Occasionally intolerant…or is he? He looks shy but he’s not. He might even be a “player”. I guess we’re about to find out…
Brenton, if he is known by this precise name and none other, is about as charismatic and endearing as a dry thicket fence.

An interesting man who never quite got into the party scene, which was a bonus for both his wallet and the amount of highly-functioning grey matter in his head. Having selected a different fork in the road, Bretnall enjoys unusual hobbies and peculiar interests. His ego, thankfully, never really got off the ground and, to be honest, his whole approach is damn refreshing in the modern era. Softly spoken.
The universal gods were mucking around in the kitchen one day and they put John, Shane and Nathan in a blender and vwa-la: Brett.
The Remarkable Clown and another perennial teenager.

Option A:  The lemon tree in the back yard that is pissed-on by dogs, men and children. He doesn’t produce tonnes of fruit but he’s growing in excellent soil and it is therefore no effort for him to produce more than enough lemons of the highest quality.
