Option B:  Brian is the kind of teacher who, if invited to teach in a mixed race American High School in the 1960s, would create a scandal when, as a white man, he would happily accept the offer to dance from a lovely young black student on prom night. He is also the kind of man who, after rumour got out amongst the parents of the black kids that their teacher was a cool and loving white man, would be invited to attend a large black ball with his wife. On arrival at the ball, he and his wife might even be formerly announced into the room before they realise they are the only white folk present. They might then go on and have one of the nights of their lives. And who knows, maybe the innocent actions of a man like Brian might begin something...

Yep, Brie is a man, and a gentle, quietly spoken and well-educated man at that. When confronted with the prospect of being conscripted into the army in lieu of some bullshit allied war in the Middle East or somewhere, he will have no compunction in conscientiously objecting. What you may not immediately assume of this fellow is that he is experimental in a very quiet way. (For example, tantric sex is something he'll almost certainly try at, at some point.)
Party animal. And sometimes it ain't pretty.

It’s of constant fascination to his more anal friends how someone can be so late so regularly, yet look so joyously peaceful and happy all the time. Truth is, before he arrived on Earth he made a decision to be friendly and welcoming in all circumstances, and there endeth the lesson. Brin.
Bristle is a Commando or SAS soldier and adrenalin is the only thing that makes him tick. On at least one occasion, for example, he has leapt from an aircraft with an Alsatian strapped to his chest.
Brock would make love to his reflection if he could and he can be extremely impatient.
Anoints his own phallus with oil every evening, and whether anyone is watching or not.

What, annoying? Brodie? Well, no, not really. He's too chilled out to be annoying. 
Lazy around the house, maybe, yep.
Popular with his friends and ladies - tick.
Useless at servicing his own car - check.
Well balanced when it comes to dancing/surfing/skating - roger.
And he has a endearing smile and a warm heart. That's our Brodie for you.

Brody the Show Pony. For employment he works as a bell on a little girl’s new bicycle, unless he’s the Brody that cuts down trees for a living, in which case he’s far more elemental and genuine – good value, as a matter of fact.
Now, Brogan, you're never going to change the world if you cannot, for the life of you, remember to take your shoes off!

Brogue loves the modern trend of brushing your fringe diagonally across your face that covers your eyes completely, as it means he doesn’t have to look directly at anyone. No, he's not an arrogant twat, he's just a little vein. He'll grow out of it.
Bronco has no pain receptors in his brain, what so ever.

Here we have the tidings from another mother obsessed with another Hollywood star. What do you do? But, old Bronson here is far deeper than these mere trifles. He thinks about it, he looks at the bigger picture, he takes a moment to reflect and he judges reasonably well, most of the time. Yes, he has friends and admirers and he'll go places if he wants because his ego works with him, not against him.

(Just dont tell him we said all that.)

Brook is an even-tempered player who stays within the limits of the stadium. He might get a friend to place a bet on the game in which he's playing, but that's about as daring as he'd get, although if the sporting body found out he'd be in trouble. Not bad with the ladies.
Brooklyn, hear this: A couple of hard day’s work won't kill you. It might even be good for you.
The Camel. He’s his own man, he hardly ever feels the need to rush, he sleeps whenever the need takes him, and for as long as he likes, and if he’s feeling social he is excellent company.

Broughton brings a fair thwack to the table. 
He brings integrity (when he’s not lying to his girlfriend about stuffing $50 notes down the front of a stripper’s G-string), he brings an educated background (despite an on-going issue with alcohol he graduated, almost with Honours), and he brings a large group of dedicated friends (who are mostly male, in lieu of a reasonably male-led life).
Most of all, and for all intent and purposes, Broughton is friendly and he has a kind heart (so we suggest that 66.6% of the time, when you read his name theory, please omit all that is enclosed in brackets). 
In fact, we’ll do it for you….

Broughton brings a fair thwack to the table.
He brings integrity, he brings an educated background and he brings a large group of dedicated friends.
Most of all, and for all intent and purposes, Broughton is friendly and he has a kind heart.
True story.
The end.
Like an exposed Kimberley escarpment that is 200 million years old, in Northern Australia, Browny is true to the bone.

Bruce rhymes with Clunk. As an anvil in an iron monger’s workshop, Bruce has been whacked and hammered with all forms of hammers and mallets but he’s up to it. It gives him something to belt his head against, and there’s no harder crunching in the world than metal banging against metal. Some smiles are just impossible to remove.

The joker of the group who, even amid some earth-shattering catastrophe, will find something to smile about. He loves it when his wife calls him Brucey because it almost invariably means he’s in for a bit of nookie that night, at which point he smiles to himself, punches the air and whispers, “Go Brucey! You little ripper!” 
Brucey is hard not to love, no matter how well you know him.
Bruno, we’re trying to sleep here so can you just shut-up?

Remarkable for not only his size and strength, Brutus is famous because he can be easily convinced that, by placing each foot in a metal pale and gripping the respective handles in each hand, if he tries hard enough, he can actually lift himself off the ground.

Heavens to Betsy, how many times has Bryan had to remind people of the spelling of his name? Oddly enough this very process has aided Bryan to become something of a solemn, peace-filled and quietly-spoken sage. Bryan has a sense of humour which is never overt (he’s no exhibitionist) and believe it or not he is quite artistic. (And yes, more so than his rather rural twin brother, Brian.)

Slightly left of centre, Bryant apsires to study English literature at a prestigious university. Yes, it's true, he's always had a crush on Audrey, but he needs to buck-up if he wants to keep up with her. He doesn't have a clue what he'll do with his degree, however. Indeed, that's a good question. Lad, what's the plan?

If the day comes when the American President has to get on the TV and tell the world of a meteor that has been discovered hurtling through the universe on a trajectory that will make it catastrophically collide with Earth, then he or she will read from a prepared statement that those in the White House know of as the Bryce Statement. It will be well articulated and perfectly presented with emotion, compassion and hopefully a drop of humour, but in the end it’s all about telling us how we are going to die. It’s probably a nice way to be told, truth be known.
You grin when you say his name and you therefore smirk when you think of him, so it’s probably a given that you laugh and be grateful in his company. Brycie is a cracking bastard, all round.
If you get him drunk enough he'll show you, for Bryden is very proud of his titanium cock ring.
Bryn is a cross between a grin, a surfboard fin and a big fat bunger as rolled by a happy hippy.
Brynley married Hilary and, while they'd never admit it, they fornicate about six times every four years.

You peer down at the river from on top of the bridge, wondering if you haven’t bitten off more than you can chew. You rub your chin thoughtfully in contemplation of the consequences. You're pretty sure there aren't any hidden snags, you don't think it's so far to fall that if you muff the entry you'll be unable to get back to the surface because of a possible injury, but you're not sure. So, yes, I'm going to jump, you think, and that's fine.
But the tiny crook of a frown that forms between your eyes while you're thinking about all of this is called, the Bryson Quirk. And it's healthy.
....you’re joking, right?
No, he's not a beer but sometimes you wonder, although he's not as lazy you might think. He's actually quite an astute little businessman.
Buddha is lucid and completely real.
Dangerous and brilliant, Buddy is the mercurial wonder child. Let’s just pray he never gets to grow up....
Like a frustrated Border collie who wished that his owner would just throw the fucking ball, Buggy is fun-loving, highly intelligent and direct.
Bullfrog has big red chubby cheeks and probably carries the tattoo of a lily on the point of his shoulder.
A bit thin on top, and hopefully only literally.

The country bumpkin whose gun collection is worth thousands. He knows how to use them too. He also spends more time at the pub than he does at home, although he does enjoy drinking and shooting at the same time.

Employment consultant, or some such administrative position is where you'll find this fellow. Burchell, a wee word of warning: if we up here in the commentary box are ever taxed for breathing oxygen, then we are coming to hunt you down. True story. We urge you to bare this in mind. 

Ever heard of Burning Man?....you should go.

Burkey is the kind of bloke who loses his underwater camera after nearly drowning in a pearl-diving accident. Three months later, within a kilometre or two from where he thought he's nearly died, he's also the kind of bloke to spot a strange barnacle-encrusted rock that looks abit odd, before recognising it as his underwater housing. (Camera dry as a bone and intact.) Last I heard he and his partner gave birth to a daughter who was also so into life that, even on Day 1, she couldn't be left alone in a room because she kept dragging herself out of it. Which newborn does that? Burkey.
See Bert

His name says it all. He sports a large welcoming personality and he loves to travel, although if he stays in one place for too long grass tends to grow-up around his wheels and he ends up never leaving.
It matters not that he’s had no formal training. Bushy is the outback mechanic, and he knows his shit.

Buster is almost impossible to tell-off because he always has a believable and convincing excuse at the ready. He's never malicious in his response - he's too friendly a guy for that. But he's smooth and a bit slick. Girls take ages to trust him.
Butch is a funny guy and he has plenty of irreverent friends but, even if he's doing it as a joke, he'd  never step into a straight-jacket without a knife hidden in his hand. Best mates with Marco.
Tight-arse.

Byron loves cooking and you should see him go. He starts preparing the day before by washing and ironing his white chefs apron, even though he's not a chef, classically speaking. He also likes to wear a tall chef's hat even if he's cooking for just himself. Why does he do this? I'm not sure. Is it perhaps because he has a flair for the dramatic?

Perhaps.

Rarely prone to just sitting around and staring out into space, thinking of nothing, Cabe uses his brain and rarely rushes head-long into things. I suppose many might describe him as being a little serious, but honestly, do you think success comes from just pure luck? Not a chance. You need to work at it, you need to be prepared and you need to be able to think on your feet and to adapt. He'd make quite a good barrister, actually. Whatever he does and however he does it, you can expect Cabe to apply himself.

Cabel makes an excellent middleman in business and he can look after himself if he gets lost on a hiking trip in the Rockies, the Amazon or the Flinders Ranges, depending on the scale of his injuries, naturally.

I wonder if his parents ever shagged on the beach in Broome, Western Australia…..anyway, some advice Cable: If you don’t get outside for work and for life and get active, you’re going to turn into a reasonably non-functioning drug addict. Good luck and peace out.
Like a fighter pilot with his thumb hovering over the trigger, Cadel is calm and primed but....does he believe?

Listen, Caden, do what you want with your life, become anything you decide, but you don’t have to get a labouring trade just because all your friends have. The world is a massive, amazing place and you’re no fool. There’s also no rush. Take your time. Expand your mind and travel, and see what takes your fancy. For the time being forget about the gym and trying to attain a 6-pack.
Good luck… 
(Note: We’ll offer up Caden’s Name Theory a little later - Management.)

A professional sailor on a racing yacht. He'd never tell his skipper but he's never really cared about winning or losing. He's never been that good at school or handling things like money, he just loves sailing fast and being out there. I have no idea what he'll do if he gets injured.

Interesting how some names pour a person into a life of an almost quiet recluse. No, Caellan isn't one of those, but you can't pick him by looking at him. Most of his thoughts he keeps to himself. Why is that? We're not sure. Time - he seems to have a lot of it. Girls too, if we thought about it, but his reticence to smile openly often leaves most people guessing. A message from the commentary box, brother: Don't stay inside. It'll kill you. Get outside and use your body. Amen.

Caielin is the name of one of those Sleepy Sharks that comes in close to the shore at night time. He moves through the water easily and with grace and while looking a little menacing, he's actually quite placid. He won’t bite and the only way you'll get hurt is if you try and wrestle him because, in close, his skin is incredibly tough and abrasive.

Caiden's motives are often unclear. They're not malicious or devious, he's not like that, generally, he just keeps most of his plans to himself because he doesn't usually see why they should effect anyone else. He's quite a capable young man.
Who, Caillan? Composed and sedate? I fuckin' doubt it. He's more like in-your-face, wondering what you did with the stash. And you better find it too - he's not one for waiting around.
Cain is almost identical to Caine, so please check him out, below, but this one is just a teency bit more impatient and uncertain.

Possessing something like a laissez faire attitude to just about everything, Caine may look like a straggler but don't be fooled. There's alot going on behind the scenes here and he is extremely independent. Good mates with Mark and Fergus.

Cale is another country boy who grew up swimming in channels and rivers, as well as getting pissed and shat on by the cows in the diary shed at 4 in the morning. His success in the arena of romance is largely achieved by pure luck, but he rides that like everything else and these days he does quite nicely, walking a straight line to those things he covets – utes, beer, new boots.

The Commander ends the briefing and studies the faces of the four young pilots in front of him, knowing full-well that even a successful mission would mean at least two of them will probably not make it back. He is already aware that Caleb, the squadron leader, would lay his life down if he had to – especially given the thousands at risk if they fail – but this is what they were trained to do. It’s why he was selected to lead the mission. And, if all hell breaks loose and he can’t make it back to the mainland he’s pretty sure Caleb will be smiling when he meets his maker. “Godspeed gentlemen,” the Commander says. The men rise and prepare to fly into battle...
Ah huh, yep, we know - he’s a normal sort of guy who, deep down, doesn’t actually really want to do anything.

People warm to Caley very quickly and he's never a thug. He was (and is) inexpensive and easy to raise and he's active in both body and mind. Some people just feel like they’re easy to deal with and Caley is definitely one of these.

Option A:  Another botanist. Enjoys the jungle and any wild-life ecology studies.

Option B:  Graphic designer.

Callais, did they name you that because you were conceived on French shores, or because you were conceived in a Maccas carpark? Mmmm, we'll ponder that. Anyway, Callais needs to stand up for himself a little more. Don't be afraid to ditch your friends if they're rude and childish dickheads, yeah?
Callan appears to be perpetually preoccupied, but is he? Either way, we know he’s more sensitive that he looks because he blushes easily, which is evidence he is far more empathetic than we imagined.

And here we have yet another young Millennial who, when finally standing and motivated doesn’t move slowly. He’s prompt, he’s physically active and, indeed, you might even describe him as a normal, nice young fellow who sits squarely in the middle of most bell curves. 
Callen, what do you have to say about this?…
Big ego. Maybe too big.
Slight of build. We’d suggest you beware of his pranks but they’re so well thought out and executed that you can’t prepare for them anyway.
Cam is a tremendous fellow. Relaxed with an edge, he understands women and men, he knows who he is and, most importantly, as a never-say-die optimist he endeavours to like everything.
The name of a big fluffy beach towel with a large ego. Pink and yellow.

Cameron, if he’s known by no other nickname, is a deep thinking man – deciding how to put out the garbage on a Monday night sometimes requires an intricate analysis, for instance – but the sad fact of the matter is that Cameron, the word, looks and sounds like something that a youth might extract from his or her nose.  
“Bloody hell!” Clint might say to Billy one afternoon, after they’ve robbed a defenceless grandmother and left her lying in the street. “Check out this Cameron!”

He was a surf coach in Brazil for a while until he tired of the number of women chasing him. Then he went to Portugal and did the same thing until he ran out of money, and condoms. Anyone heard from him lately?...
As a rather formal and boring secondary school college made of old red bricks, all Campbell wants to do is leave some kind of legacy.

In a past life, Cap was a wonderful and courageous medic in the trenches during WWI. Despite the obvious dangers, he'd repeatedly run out there into no man's land with bullets whistling all about, his only goal the screams of a young man with half his legs blown off, or some such catastrophic scene. Can you imagine people actually did this?

Anyway, no matter how fast his heart was beating and no matter how scared he himself was, he'd arrive with a smile and a never say die attitude, and he'd do the best he could.  Someone should've given him a posthumous medal for bravery.

In this life, whatever Cap is doing and however he is going about his business, you can be rest assured not much has changed. 

Nice one Cap.

Cappi hugs his children and grandchildren to the point of embarrassment. Always laughing, Cappi lets his wife run the affairs of the house, but he definitely understands the benefits of a hard day’s work. He’ll always be the joker.

The brand new livestock fence. His posts are new and chemically treated, they are exactly perpendicular to the ground and he sports new grade 9 fencing wire. He is tough to get passed in a hurry, however, and often you have to think long and hard about even attempting it because he usually has 240 volts running through him.

Carlin is the kind of man who works with horses, which makes sense because his own nature is quite similar to these rather magnificent creatures. You see, horses are just like us humans in their capacity to express emotion, apart from one very important difference: horses never lie. 
You want to go and meet a genuine, considerate, humorous man? Go and meet Carlin. 
And I say humorous, although he doesn’t even realise it. If you asked him about his method of tick removal, for instance, he’ll advise you to pinch your fingers in hard at the base and rotate anti-clockwise, not clockwise. He’ll tell you why, that’s not for me to say. All you need remember is that truth and love are his only currency. Amen, Carlin.
Me Carlo. Me gigolo.

Carlos dances like his jocks are on fire and someone has just poured ice water over his burning nuts. So, he’s slow, and he’s cool, and he smiles, and he moves those hips and slides those shoulders like he’s really glad he still has the use of his Jonathan Livingston.
The Masturbating Clownfish.

An unusual name for a modern man, Carmen shrugs off the jibes about the female sound and heads off in the direction of relaxed life set-ups and successful experiments. He never gets flustered and as such makes a wonderful optimist. He too can be a kinky fucker.

Old family money backs his endeavours and so Carmine tends to do okay. He’s a little gruff at times, which is only a wee defence mechanism he applies so’s not to appear vulnerable, but we suspect it’s because his dad was a bit serious, himself. Like all of us, the reactions of those who raise us arise from those who raised them, and at some point we all need to step out from beneath that umbrella and let the rain cleanse us to our true selves. Carmine will get there, and I trust you will too. Amen.

Carson will never succumb to the drudgeries of the poverty-stricken life, no sir. Good at negotiating deals out of the public eye, most of his skills in this realm are therefore only privy to a select few. Don't think he wont get his hands dirty if some actual hard work needs to be done, however. No, he's not used to getting mud and dirt on his hands, but if the group needs him to he'll mix it with the factory floor.

The textbook science boffin with a giant, almost creepy smile. He’s very bright, always tucks his shirt in and never goes outside into the sun without a wide-brimmed hat. He makes very odd noises while making love, although, to be honest, we don’t want you to imagine that.
Carter is the name of an extremely shiny and well made box of condoms.
Cary will tell you that he loathes the spotlight. He's lying.

(Pronounced Cass) For a non-cussing man he does look quite serious, doesn’t he? We think it’s all a bit of a bluff, actually, although we’re not sure. His results here in his 5th season on tour are just splendid. We know he works hard behind the scenes and he has plenty of friends on the tour whom he competes against often, and while fiercely competitive out in the arena, on the sidelines afterwards he’s a picture of politeness. Perhaps that’s his secret to success?…that he keeps everything a secret.
Casey is perfectly contained and concentrated and while his decisions aren’t always well thought out, when he decides to act he moves like grease lightning. Regret = Bullshit.

I'm not sure why his parents didn't call him Plenty of Cash, or perhaps, Yeah I've Got Twenty Bucks On Me, That'll Do Won't It?
As it is, Cash gets bored faster than a very fast thing running quickly on a fast moving train. He’ll need stimuli the whole time he’s here on Earth otherwise he’ll end up tearing things to pieces. He’d make a great lead singer of a rock band, but not one of these clean-living Christian bands that you hear about.

The understated juggernaut who's never lost a game of hide and seek. Don't keep it all inside Caspar, is the advice from the universal gods. Let it out, and get out into the world. Search for opportunites and don't sit back waiting for them to come to you. It's a startling, beautiful place, this planet, and you belong out there lad!

You know how some vampires can transform themselves into a puff of smoke so they can get through doors and walls and such? Well, in that form they move like Casper and, to be honest, we up here in the commentary box don't really know how to describe his performance, other than to say his team doesn't often lose. You with me?

Is he dodgy? Well, no. Slippery sometimes, sure. Trustworthy, we think so. He's certainly a physically active individual. People often presume he's a bit rude, but only regarding how he won't talk to some people, although it only effects him in the work place. Occasionally we all need to deal with people we'd rather not deal with, but Cassidy does a good job of steering around that. Will it effect his prospects? Maybe, but that's only our perspective. Cassidy is his own cat, so I'd urge you not to worry about a thing.

"Rejection? No not at all! That was her way of telling me that, while she's not ready for me now, she really wants me for later!"
The fact that white wine is dripping off his face here at the restaurant bar only tells him of how MUCH she wants that to happen.
That's Castellotti for you.

Cavey loves attending masquerade balls because it fits into his life mantra of, whatever you do make sure you keep 'em guessing. He doesn't fulfill a regular job, some of his friends are even weirder than he is and he's broken several bones in several different climbing/trekking adventures.

A skilled lacrosse player. Why? It's a fast game that requires speed and excellent hand-eye coordination, it's sometimes quite violent, although not maliciously so, which he enjoys, and it provides something of a routine in his life, which he needs. Cayden is a restless soul and we shudder to think what he'd get up to if he was left to roam the streets.
Cayson is quite a useful informer. And he's smart enough to never do his deals in the public eye, unless he opts for the maximum public setting, like a football game or something.
If he isn’t at least 75 years old, Cecil is weasely and limp-wristed.

Well, I suppose we should be grateful they didn't call him Four Ply or Juniper Berry, eh? Anyway, Cedar is deep. At least, we hope he's deep. He might be just a little bit shy. Can't blame him of course. I’d be concerned too if my parents decided to name me something people make furniture from. But, he's a nice man. His heart beats slower than most and like many others in the Kingdom, his presence in a room has the effect of calming those around him. Rarely is Cedar out to get himself noticed.

Cedric is a dairy farmer who speaks so quickly everyone assumes he’s telling one long undecipherable joke, which is both lucky and tragic because he’s bloody funny. Much to the lament of his wife, however, Cedric is absolutely useless in bed.
A doer. Better with men than with women and he’s never shied away from a hard day’s work. Big laugh. Overly strong handshake.

Oh for fuck sake Cesar, you've done it again! (ie. With complete confidence he said he could fix the brakes on my car, but not two minutes out of the garage the brakes failed, but I was too caught up with the fire under the bonnet to notice. Now the fire brigade is coming. As my car burned I asked Cesar what he did and he apologised for forgetting about the brakes. Apparently he just had a little tinker with the carby' so it'd run better. Her only charged me $1200.) And look at him….he's still smiling. Unbelievable.
The boating, diving, fishing type. If he isn’t one of those, or he isn’t physically active in some significant way, then his ego takes over such that he becomes a grossly overconfident bore.
Chance is streamlined and highly skilled at whatever he does, and luck has very little to do with it.
Channing can sweet talk his way into and out of just about anything.

Man, this guy is quick. He barely sleeps. He's here, he's there. He's up trees and he's over dale. In the bar for ten minutes and he's already got itchy feet, but not before he nabbed the phone number of that cute brunette. Where's he off to now?.....The airport?.....NEW YORK??....What the hell for?.....(A conference on that pyramid scheme?)..... Are you for real?......

Moral to the story: Some people never switch off and so they can never sit still. Chappy.

The starfish that lives on the bottom of the ocean. He moves slower than anybody and he can regenerate a limb if it is eaten – it’s a slow process, after all. Charles may not be the first person you’d invite to the New Years Eve party at the Playboy Mansion but at least he doesn’t drink much.

The back end of his name catches you off guard, like a soft and subtle catcher's mitt in baseball, and he's nowhere near as reckless as he sounds. Maybe he's a Libran and maybe he ain't, but as a peaceful mediator he does his job very well. Rarely does have calluses on his hands.
Nick with an education.
Christ, what a unit. Even breathing is enough to get him excited.

Chase wanted to be an accountant until his teachers realised that he couldn't bloody count. These days he works with Darren, and he probably makes more money anyway. (Although he does party with Ryan a bit, and not many people can keep that up for too long, let me tell you.)
The only thing Chasen is chasing is a fully open-minded approach. Don't get caught up around fences (or other peoples' whims) lad, get out there in the wind and discover your own belief system.

The rumours are true - Chay has been fired for insubordination before. It's official and so you can look it up in the records. What you won't read is that on each occasion Chay has been working for a boss who was a dangerous and beligerent idiot. Chay doesn't care about his official record and he'll talk about his experience freely. If you can find him, that is. He's quite the rover.
Chayce gets a manicure every Friday lunchtime.
The flamboyant Italian who made good. His daughters are gorgeous but woe-betide any man he catches looking at them for too long.

With a spirit that is stripped and pure to the core, Ché lives in the moment. He understands how good and bad deeds procure the future in very different ways, although he struggles to reconcile the notion that, here on Earth, at least, it seems nigh-on-impossible to have one without the other.
Chenar takes chances, but not silly ones. He's quite a thoughtful and introspective fellow and he enjoys a healthy diet.

Chester runs one of two ways: Either his parents are rich enough to send him to Harvard (law/economics), where his sense of entitlement runs his life, turning him into a painfully arrogant misogynist, or it’s a nickname given to a fellow with a perpetual smile on his face, a plethora of adoring friends in his midst (both male and female) and whose main aim in life is to avoid responsibility and have fun at all costs.
So, who you got?

Well, it’s better than Hyundai, eh? Anyway, Chevy doesn’t blast his way through walls like his mother intended. He’s actually far more circumspect than that and he’ll often take his time when making a decision. As a hands-on man however, he likes to finish what he begins and he hates wearing a suit.

People travel from all over the world to see him and endure many hardships on their once in a lifetime pilgrimage. They know that, if they can get to him, the knowledge gleaned from The Grand Master will be worth it.

In essence, what he will tell you is this: the answer lies within...

Yeah, well, you'd love Chibiabos to be your boss because we all love a captain who really doesn't care if you turn up to work or not, although that's not strictly fair. Talk about juggling more than 5 balls at once and retaining a sense of humour! Chibiabos seems to carry this off. With a naturally low resting pulse, he rarely gets highly stressed and he probably needs to remember to exercise.

Chip is one of those guys people like to talk about. Is he gay? Is he a genius? Is he a psychopath? Is it true about what he did? …The rumours never end and as Oscar Wilde once said, the only thing worse than being talked about is not being talked about. We love Chip either way but, no, he’s not a macho fuckwit, no matter where in the field he chooses to play. Beyond all that rubbish, Chip is smarter than 93% of people in the room and he has a wonderful sense of humour. Amen.

If modern society ever regresses back into Roman times by allowing the major television networks to produce a game show whereby people win prizes by killing other people, then Chito will be a world champion at dispatching others with a spear from surprisingly large distances.
Mr Disco at night. Plastic surgeon during the day. Like the Great Monkey (of Pigsy, Sandy and Tripitaka, fame) Chongo is world famous and irrepressible.

Chopper needs no introduction. Look him in the eye, retain a sense of humour and always speak the truth (so long as your dealings in life are honourable). He might have been violent once but not any more…even so, obeying those aforementioned rules is a fine life plan anyway. Chopper himself is easy to pick in the wild because of his trademark moustache and beard formation.

No use telling you his real name because even he has trouble spelling it, so Choppy it is. And what a specimen we have. Yes, sure, he moves reasonably quickly and easily, in the same way his mind deals with change and strangers, and as an ardent optimist he tends to adore both. Choppy has a certain kind of charisma which makes him eminently loveable and he can tell a funny and true tale in the most trying of circumstances. Not bad eh? The only flippant thing about Choppy is his name.
Doesn’t and/or can’t shut-up.

Chris is far more complicated than his female counterpart. As a mole that lives in the ground, he lives a neat, organised and dignified life that, on an outrageous day, could nearly be described as mysterious. Ensure that you don’t mess up the entrance to his burrow, however, because he’s liable to get quite angry.
Christian either reads too much of the Bible or snorts too much cocaine. Perhaps both.

Yes, his ego might run at you like a North American grizzly bear, but he’s all bluff and bluster. Christoph drives an abnormal motor car, has an eclectic group of artistic friends who, like him, tend to be on the snobbish side and, like a few others out there in the Kingdom, he rarely get his hands dirty. Having said all that, however, he’s an incredibly intelligent and proud individual which results in memorable projects, so it’s not like he doesn’t ever leave a legacy.

Teased by the boys at school for his lack of sporting prowess - and their jealousy of his academic success - Christopher got his own back when he took over daddy's multinational. And that's all wonderful, but no one knows that every Thursday night he sneaks a quick look over his shoulder before he steps through a dark doorway of a dingy little bar in the red light district that caters for just about anything. There had to be a reaction sometime.
Chuck snaps his finger a lot, and he's constantly on the lookout for the next deal/girl/scam/cheap car.

Chum attacks life like a lion attacking a gazelle, except there’s never any harm or malice in his method because all he’s really trying to do is encourage the gazelle to rejoice in its life so much that it begins to radiate light. Personal motto: Have disco, will travel.

Cian doesn't pass a 10 cent coin in the street without picking it up. (Secretly he would like to pick up the 5c coins too but he's embarassed about what others might say.) Some advice: Cian, why give a rats rissole about what other people think? They don't really care what you do so long as it doesn't effect them.

Mmm...interesting. His decisions are never made public and no one knows who he is seeing. Extremely bright, he is, but his curiosity is largely kept away from the paparazzi. Ciaran knows what he wants and he doesn't give a flying rats arse about anything else, let alone what people make of his endeavours. He's travelled plenty and he remembers just about all of it. But dont think he's nasty. He's exactly the opposite.

You know how some people just have that warm, friendly fuzz about them? Awkward strangers feel happy and relaxed around them, the opposite sex gravitate towards them and a room full of weirdness and ill-feeling is immediately vanished with a collective sigh of relief when they enter the room. It might be his smile, his eyes, or it might be because he has saltwater in his veins, but Cid is a delicious chunk of love and fun, and we’re so glad he finally got here.

No, Cillian doesn't dilly dally. Designed for peering around (and getting around) corners unseen and unheard, Cillian isn't one to waste either time or energy. Indeed, many might deem him to be a somewhat diffident lad. Maybe he is, but I doubt it. One suspects he's just saving his energy to spend it on people he respects because he definitely knows who he is. Old Cillian is no fool, and he cant be badgered into anything.

Is he a black man? He should be. He's a funky dude who, like Thiago way later, tends to look like he's dancing even when he's walking. Is he reliable? Should we employ him? Well, not if you want to move the company forward and increase your bottom line. It all depends on how happy you want your employees to be. They'll definitely be more productive with Cimarron around. Does that help?

(Pron. Sivva) There are some people you meet in life who you adore on sight. Civa is one of these cats. If he turned up at work in a superhero outfit you wouldn’t be surprised. If he donated a month’s salary to Medecins Sans Frontieres no one would bat an eyelid, not that you’d find out about it. If he flitted off to Hong Kong to sell some art, we’d take it in our stride and fill-in for him. And if he spent three days hold up in a hotel room with his betrothed covered in the juice of life, we’d only smile with the amount of fun they had. Such is Civa and such is life.
Wheat farmer.
The Fancy Dancy Doodley Dancy Man. Yes, he's a bit stupid but we love him, nonetheless.
Clarence has a huge lung capacity and a very low resting pulse. He is therefore quiet and peace-loving 99.2% of the time. (Note: Just beware of the remaining 0.8%.)
A tall, thinking bin for recycling waste. He never moves quickly and while he is something of a control freak, he's rarely angered.
Mr. Irreverant. Clarky will tell you that if you want to go and do something (eg. surfing, mud-crabbing, cafe building) then you should probably just go and do it.
Without doubt Claude is the laziest person on earth. He drags his feet when he walks and he lives for breakfast in bed.

Claudio is one of the few people who, in the course of giving someone a genuine compliment, often gets his words mixed up such that the complimentee generally wants to argue/fight with him. It's quite a bizarre, if not funny feature of his life. (Claudio, we appreciate it. So keep up the good work!)
Maximally alert, he ain’t, but Clay is definitely solid. (Get him away from the city ASAP.)
Peanut butter. (i.e: he’s liked by all, offensive to very few, he’s memorable for 3 minutes and all kids love him.)
The textbook Wild Card.
The farmer with the old man’s soul. The climate is heating up, which isn’t going to make his life any easier, but he also knows that there’s no point being too glum about it either.

“Well hot dog, Cletus! I found me some biscuits just there on the ground. Want some?” 
Cletus looks around, looks at the biscuits, they look good. He reaches, because he knows a good thing when he sees one, and he’d never knock back free food, no matter where it came from.

Some days you don't feel like being surprised by anything and Cleve is a fine example. We usually know where he is, we know what he's up to, we know who is hanging out with and we know where he works. And he's happy - we're definitely aware of that. If he was unhappy we're pretty sure we'd know about it although he has plenty of friends who would cheer him up. Cleve.
Cliff has a wonderful, dry sense of humour and he was raised in a time when hard work and a kind word were important qualities in a person, and not just a throw away line in a social media feed.

If he isn’t a wonderful traditional artist and he has no other nickname, then he is a boring white-fella who fulfils a sufficiently unexciting, middle-class house/life/philosophy. Ironic, eh? The former has barely spent a night under a roof and so is attached to the stars and the skies like you could not imagine…

Once he's out on the ground the boy can run, and there is no questioning his above-average intelligence and cunning but, yes, Clint, the word, is across between a clit and c_nt and while people down through the generations have deliberately mis-written his name on name tags, school bags, across the sky from the back of a plane and everywhere, basically, Clint is the man who has to wear it. Indeed, many Clints rise up and become great purely because of the fun pointed at them but, unfortunately, there is a high probability that Clint is nimble-minded douche bag.

By default, Clinton is upright and diligent but this is only one facet of this rather unique organism. His name sounds like it has been poured into a mould of perfect conformity and efficient management, and it’s so formal, in fact, that he has actually passed out the other end of that spectrum to become one of the world’s great eccentrics.

Clive is so clumsy that, on average, he falls over three times every week. But, generally speaking, because he appreciates the world as being one of the funniest things he’s ever heard of, more often than not when he does fall over he’ll remain on the ground for some time afterwards laughing at his own self. It’s a beautiful thing.

If the King ever needs to send a secret message that will avert war and save the Kingdom, then Clyde would be a prime candidate for the mission. Why? Because he's exactly not what the enemy spies would be expecting. He's cannier than the nearest fox and that time he takes leaving the house isn't because he's lazy, it's because he thinks things through. (And, yes, when it comes down to it, if he ever fell over and ruptured a lung it'd take him three days to feel the pain.) Amen young Clyde.
(Man, that was close.) Clynt treats most situations in life as some kind of lottery prize and he is therefore rather gifted and enigmatic.
The name of a Picasso painting that recently sold at auction for $112 million. How did that happen?? (And yes, Clynton is either an eccentric genius or a rather lovely, naive buffoon.)
Liar, liar, pants on fire.

Codi? OCD? Well, sort of, but then again, not really. He’s more like the manic-depressive without the depressive. Better than that, he’s not even that manic, but he does have mountainous reserves of energy. So, you better hope he has a dedicated ambition for something coz’ if this boy is left to run rampant he’ll terrorise the neighborhood in the same way a small, bored, psychotic Jack Russell tears apart your living room while you’re out. The flip-side is that once he’s focused, you won’t see a more inventive or driven young man. Indeed, these energy levels mean Codi will never properly ‘grow up’, and that is only a wonderful thing.

Affable and cosy to deal with, Cody is well positioned to use this empathy for his own ends, which he occasionally does, either deliberately or subconsciously. (Having said all that, he might be incredibly boring.)
Coen is a good competitor without being ruthless and never would he be hauled-up in front of an anti-corruption commission.
Cohan presents a nice mix of indoors and outdoors. He's not prone to putting on weight and he is sufficiently adventurous.

Cohen keeps a large chunk of his dreams and desires hidden away. He'd never get sprung like Jake, for instance, for Cohen is far more aware of his surroundings, not to mention the consequences of his actions.

The tall and slightly out of shape middle-aged bouncer, who works at the pub every Sunday afternoon. He’ll kick people out if he has to, and he can handle himself, but overall all he wants to do is see that the young kiddies have a good time without hurting either themselves or anyone else. His home life is actually very sedate.
Colby has more secret compartments in his bedroom - and therefore his life - than anyone.

Fuckin' Colesy. So, he goes to Burma on a whim to get away from it and to see what's out there. Four weeks in, and he's in the middle of the jungle delirious with malaria, starving hungry because of all the opium he's smoked and in piss-poor health in general. Not far from broke but definitely close to death, he has a fevered, shivering dream, one night, of meeting an old man carrying bags of lychees. Next day, he's staggering down a beaten track next to banana trees too ripe to eat. He reaches for his water bottle. It's empty. This is it, he thinks. I'm screwed. Today's the day. Then, in front of him a tiny old man with no teeth emerges from out of nowhere, holding up two fists full of lychees, his big toothless grin lighting up the sky for hundreds of miles around.
This sort of shit happens to Colesy all the time.

Colin nearly disappeared during WWI because all of them were used as cannon-fodder by the British Army. As fate would have it, he now grows the best roses in the world. So, yes, many Colins are older, but regardless, those Colins who are deeply loving, and who inscribe warmth and compassion into every interaction, and not all of them do, are some of the world’s most beautiful people. True story. Never forget that a good Colin is an absolute gem.
See Collin.
A good panel-beater who actually thinks better when he’s underwater.
Colton hates being wrong and he definitely hates losing. Perhaps he needs to learn to laugh at himself a bit more? It’s hard to say.
A survivor.

So, his parents wanted Arnie for a son? Aside from that weirdness Conan is so sick and tired of that reference that he’s almost become shy. I say almost. He’s most assuredly a placid, peace-loving man. Perhaps he’ll find pure serenity away from all humans amidst the lushness of well-tended garden?
No, he ain’t no icecream, he’s a self-employed man who works hard and who is very gullible. Even his kids can take the piss. He doesn’t mind.

Jimmy or a Nick, Connar is considered, he is thoughtful, he is kind and he is fair, putting the needs of others first. Indeed, Connar, you would make a wonderful teacher who would make a mark on his students. I’d suggest grief counselling too, but you’re a sensitive man and that kind of job might get you down more than most. Suffice to say, if there were more Connars in existence the world would be a much calmer and safer place than what it is. 

(Note: Connar is totally unrelated to Connor/Conor in that he has never stolen anything, deliberately embarrassed anyone or behaved in a remotely immoral fashion...or so his mother assures us.)
Mate, if you insist on leaping into this river where you can see snags and submerged trees all about, do yourself a favour by at least jumping feet first, okay? (Yes, you're the same as Conor.)

Connolly dances like a chicken that's accidentally pecked at a tab of acid rather than a some kind of seed. It's all a flail of arms and legs, which isn't dissimilar to how he functions in the office. Yes, he's an 'office' kind of guy.
Mate, if you insist on leaping into this river where you can see snags and submerged trees all about, do yourself a favour by at least jumping feet first, okay? (Yes, you're the same as Connor.)
A powerful man who, as a means to show that he really isn’t infertile, loves nothing more than travelling to far-away lands and slaying as many natives as possible in the name of progress.

Doesn’t matter if he’s new to the area or new to the line-up, if there are waves to be had, Coop will bluster his way to middle of the take-off zone immediately and give shit to anyone who even looks like getting in his way.

Cooper drives a late model BMW and spends a fortune on clothes and dry cleaning bills. He subscribes to the Financial Review and he ensures he leaves a copy in the front seat of his car but, aside from his these macho fantasies, he’s alright.

The Harley mechanic who, like any devoted artist, lives and breathes his passion. If he ever fell asleep across his chopper with his shirt off, you’d be hard pressed to discern the paintings on his body from the paintings on his bike.
Careful in life. Watchful with money.

Quite the successful businessman, Corey will tolerate tyre-kickers for only so long. If a potential customer comes into his store for the third time, having bought nothing on the previous two visits, they can expect to be greeted with a sawn-off shotgun pointed at them.
“You must be eager to get something, sir? I’m glad you’re back. What would you like?” Corey will ask politely, his finger on the trigger.
The patron never leaves empty handed and everyone goes home happy.
Corie shies away from decisions that will count. Artistic, yes, but he needs to attend to this matter of life more than he is.

Never sets foot outside the house with a blemish on his clothes. Sure, he might get dirty, he might end up brawling (as a younger man) and he might get blood and grease on him from helping a damsel in distress, and that's okay. But, present well at the start and the rest will follow - this is Cormac's main mantra.

Creative but unlucky, Cornelis has recently enlisted the help of an internet dating service and, on paper, he's doing well. He's had plenty of dates and they've been nice girls, but every time he's taken a girl to a restaurant for dinner she has managed to fall ill just as the desserts are brought out. It's never a ploy to leave early, and they like his company, it's just Cornelis's luck. Keep trying Cornelis, and we know he will because his enthusiasm is difficult to dampen.
The Glider. Unless he's the Cornelius who has just been plucked from the sea after the ship sunk and is still panicking despite the lifeboat being not that full and the ocean reasonably calm.
Well what did you think was going to happen Corrado? If you ride a horse with no clothes on of course your nuts are going to get squashed. Come on dude, think about it…
Corrin possesses more male beauty products than almost any other non-female in the Kingdom. Facial scrubs, cleansers, anti-wrinkle crap – you name it. He has the softest hands in the world.
Remember that scene in the movie Good Will Hunting when Matt Damon successfully defends himself in court, knowing full-well he’d broken the law? That’s Cors’.
See Potsy.

Cortland is that racehorse bought at the yearling sales as a creature that showed promise. He trained well and raced within his limits. He even won a few races in the country and in his only run in the big smoke he ran fourth. These days he's eating grass and hoping to meet a mare.
The wet slice of bread.

Okay, if his name is pronounced as 'Cozzie' we suggest you head on over to Cozzie and it's all pretty good. If it's pronounced as 'Cosy', then he's a different breed of otter altogether. His schemes are more hidden, as are his friends, and he is far more territorial. Got all that?
"Condoms? Me? Are you for real??...."
A perky little fellow.

Is he a labourer?
No.
Is he an astronaut?
No.
Does he perfrom lewd acts for money?
...No.
Does he possess many friends?
Yes.
Is he human?
...Yes.
Can he cook?
Yes, but he's messy.
Can he speak different languages?
Sometimes.
Is he covered in paint like Jackson Pollock?

Bingo.
Yes, he does accost people, but only with love and humour and plenty of light. What more is there to say? Costa is a remarkable gem. The End.

More feminine than his female counterpart, Courtney is about as useful as a tub of margarine that has been left outside near the barbecue overnight, and is now a partially melted lump with all manner of crumbs and meat clippings caked all over it.
Coxy is a charismatic man who has a multitude of dodgy contacts, not to mention a sprinkle of even dodgier vices.
One of the leaders of the pack, Cozzie has mostly male friends and he's very quick on his feet.
A supremely unflappable lunatic.

A complex mathematical equation, the solution of which will assist us in understanding how the universe and human society as a whole are going to evolve. IBM’s Deep Blue supercomputer had a crack at it back in the day, but it suffered a meltdown and no one has been game to tackle it since. I wonder what the solution is?…
Don't let the clean socks fool you. Crandall is a kinky fucker who knows how to have fun. And no one knows about it.
Difficult to ignore, Crash is an impressive individual who is anything but demure.
Crawf’s reaction to hearing his name called anywhere is not dissimilar to a bubbly fox terrier’s whose owner stops, looks at them, pauses and then with a big smile says, “…..Walk?”
MI6, The Federal Police, FBI, CIA, NSA, ASIO, etc etc etc. And he's kinky, although he'd kill you if you ever mentioned it in a public setting.

For such a smooth, single-shot sounding name Creed possesses a ferocity that only a scant few will ever get to witness or experience. He’s rarely the loudest person in the room and no, he’s not a brawler, although if he needed to fight his way out of a corner he’d very quickly take on the mantra of Kill Or Be Killed, and rightly so. Creed’s actions speak louder than words and he couldn’t give a rat’s arse about things like political systems and bureaucracy.

Reliable and real, Crewe doesn't need to attach himself to a crowd as a means of survival and he only laughs at things that affect him deeply. Yes, it means some question his sense of humour, but these people need his attention more than he needs theirs.

Remember Liquid Paper? As something of clean-freak and an organised man, on and off the paper, to this day it remains the best invention Cris has ever seen. You can't say he never applies himself to a task, however.

Unusual name. Easy smile.
Organised, present, never wasteful: these are some of the impressions Crispin leaves in his wake. What you may not be aware of is that he is also rarely hyper-conservative, seldom dull or lifeless, and never pessimistic.
Crocket has his hand on it, but he takes it as it comes and he does most things in his life pretty easily, as a result.
Crofto has woken up on a beach in front of a dying campfire, surrounded by passed-out bodies and warm cans of half-drunk beer, more than nearly anyone.
Nuggetty.

The crew up here in the commentary box are pretty sure Cruz is intended to rhyme with booze and not buzz. Be that as it may, is Cruz out of bed yet? And how can we conduct an interview with a man who doesn't own shoes, Cruz? It's a good question...

Careful to see that procedures are followed through to their natural end, Cuan rarely jumps into situations impulsively. It's just how it is. He'd be good at working for a team that is trying to maximise the aerodynamics of either a race car or an aircraft.

As an aboriginal in a past life and a gifted artist in this one, he is a seeker of truth whose passions live on his sleeve. Make of that what you will, but love drips out of his pores like the sweat of a beautiful black man that has just walked into the Derby pub, having left Broome about three days ago in the middle of the wet. (Note: If asked about the state of his phallus, he will reply that he is in possession of an “evil cock”.)

He’s never said a prayer for anything he’s ever killed in his life, regardless if it was an antelope he shot with a rifle, a bug he squashed with his foot or a kangaroo he hit with his car. Yeah, Curt is a real softie…(just kidding!). We struggle to envisage how he manages his romantic life in a fun and gentle manner, but there must be outliers of the Curt species who are just lovely, right?….Anyone met one?
Curtis possesses a highly acute acumen and he promises much.

He’s never picked a fight in his life - well, aside from one time at university when the reputation of a lady friend was questioned - and his work life operates at a managerial level, which makes sense. He sports an ego and he enjoys succeeding at tasks which require deep analysis and lots of preparation.
Cy doesn't just solve problems, he pulverizes them.
Mmm, Cybil likes a clean establishment. He loves watching the Tour de France, whether drugs are involved or not, and he likes the aerodynamic nature of the outfits they wear. Beyond that, who knows!
Cyril lives alone with his dog up in the hills, he brews his own liquor and he shoots rabbits that they both share. Sometimes he cooks them, sometimes he doesn’t.
Extremely calculating, Cyrus is in the secret service. His Directors prefer to remain ignorant of how he manages to extract the amount of information he does from his 'sources'.

Mate, pull your pants up, wash that crap out of your hair, stand up straight and if you shake someone's hand don't just present a limp, dead jellyfish grip. Get a job doing something you truly love and once in a while donate some money to a cause that helps those who are worse off than you. Finally, ensure you look people in the face who are talking to you and then, my boy, you will begin to change the world.

Like a piece of elastic that has gone slack and old, in an attempt to get on with his life Dade dawdles around here and there. Does he ever run? We doubt it. Time - he has oodles of it. The hustle and bustle of city-life, for instance, doesn't really get through to him and he takes ages to do the dishes. But, he's a well-meaning lad and we enjoy his company.

Daden is a paper-pusher, or at least the modern equivalent. Not really an alpha male, Daden pays his taxes and trudges to work in the uniform of the modern slave, wondering where and how things might have been different.
See Dafydd, except that this one seems to make more sense.

Dafydd has been compelled to turn into a complete weirdo – his Welsh heritage probably helps. He is never glum and no one knows if he has ever had a job, aside from professional skateboard rider for a while, and we only assume that because he rides one everywhere, trailing a mop of crazy hair, or what he has left of it, and possibly a line of giggling children.

He's a frustrating student. Not because he doesn't listen and not because he is disruptive in class, but it just takes so bloody long for anything to get inside and stick in that muddled head of his. Once the info is there, no worries. It just takes ages, that's all. I've no idea what he's doing these days, but I'll pay you $5 million if he's in England right now flying Typhoons for the RAF. No way.

Dain is going along quite nicely, but what the creative team wants to see is Dain walk to the top of the nearest mountain, hill or cliff, put his arms up in the air and scream at the heavens as loudly and for as long as he can without passing out. They think it'll do him the world of good.
Yes, he's a man and, yes, he's a wedding planner.

A reference to two American states? Really? Are your folks the full bob, Dakota? Anyway, he keeps his head low and tries to stay out of mischief, which can’t be said for most of his male friends who, by and large, are buffoons. The end.
A small mountain lake. Calm on the surface and freezing cold, he is so deep and inviting that no one actually knows how deep he really is.

Unfortunately Dallan didn't hear about eating vegetables until he left home. I wonder if his parents ever went to jail for abuse…anyway, considering he had a late start he's doing quite well, now. He wants to learn and he absorbs new information like a sponge. Better than that, he seems to be able to apply what he's learned. On its own this is a rare gift.
The singer Sade sang a song about him: “Smooth operator, smooth…..operator.” (In life he is a highly functioning drug addict.)

Dalton, how the fuck did you get yourself into this pickle? Look at  you, for god's sake. You've conned your way into this back room poker game after borrowing $15,000 off your mum (who you already owe 18 grand to), you've just gone into debt with these guys here tonight to the tune of another 5 and you're bluffing on a pair off 2's. Dalton, these blokes haven't got a sense of humour, mate. And they've got weapons. (sigh)....what are we going to do with you? Perhaps we’ll catch up with you in the next life, eh?…

Option A:  Damian is extremely single-minded. If he is a rational man then he is capable of great things but if he isn’t, and 65% of them aren’t, then he might be so blinkered that he is potentially dangerous. The only great one is a vascular surgeon who wears a chic black leather jacket, so technically they’re not all bad – even though it was a typically ‘Damian’s’ intelligence and drive that got him there in the first place. 

Option B:  A totally anal and obnoxious cop on a power trip.

Let's hope he's not a cop, but if he can steer clear of a controlling nature Damien has the capacity to be a wonderful man. Yep, sure, he might sport a temper from time to time but it's all a product of having too much energy. If you possess a Damien, can we suggest you point him in the direction of a hobby or passtime that he loves. That'll fix him up, no worries.

Picture, if you will, the mood of the crew when Elizabeth Taylor walks onto a movie set in the 1960’s. Everyone feels better, everyone feels inspired to do their best, and even the director understands that he doesn’t have to do that much. No, Damir isn’t Elizabeth Taylor, but there is some kind of calm, regal poltergeist in his DNA.

Nothing like his painful brothers, Damo is a sensitive, funny and kind-hearted bloke who lives the physical male life; pearl farming, mining, tuna fishing, etc etc. Well-suited to the Australian summer, they are nearly always blonde.

A perfectly-weighted name for a well-weighted man, and whose core stability precludes almost all irrationality. In short, Damon is rock solid, intelligent, different and funny, and absolutely nothing gets passed him.
The all-round Mr Nice Guy that mothers and grandmothers pinch on the cheek and say, “Oooh, you’re such a beautiful boy!” He now coaches a boys’ basketball team and wears a cap everywhere he goes.
Blessed with a calm head and an imposing persona, Dane times everything to perfection.

Dani is far more sensitive and calm than Danny. Why that is no one knows. His responses take a little longer because he thinks about what he's going to say. In fact, sometimes he's quite intense, but he means well. Believe it or not he'd make a good statistician - he doesn't always have to be a tradesman.

A clever and gentle-natured man at his core, Daniel may not be the last person you’d want next to you in a life-and-death situation and the last I heard he was answering telephones in the customer service department for most of the major banks. But, and it's a rather important 'but', Daniel does carry a morbid edge sometimes – a secret garden, if you will, that provides him with a steely gaze if things get really hairy.
Yes, Danko has friends and a social life, but he is one secretive dude. What's going on behind all those doors, brother? Something good we hope?...

The unexploded bomb unit arrives on the scene and they're nervous. The chief disarmer is all kitted out (the last one was killed only last week), not that it will matter if the device goes off. He bends down carefully, puts his stethascope to the metal skin of the bomb and he listens...
He's sweating, as are his team listening on the radio.
Then he smiles.
"It's okay boys," he says into the microphone. "It's a Danniel, not a Daniel."
The relief is palpable. And with that, he hits the device hard with his little hammer and the 'bomb' bursts open, covering him in harmless confetti.
Danniel.

Danny has more energy to burn than 98% of the population and as a sensitive young man he is prone, more than most, to those early influences which can mould a personality. Like a few other members of the Kingdom, Danny has two very different outcomes. 
If he did well early, then he has channelled all this energy, both mental and physical, into a loving and productive life and he’s a funny, generous guy all round. One of the very best, actually.
If he didn’t do well early, or he was brought up on the wrong side of the tracks, then in all likelihood you’re dealing with a Danny who will feed an inferiority complex by drinking or drugging too much in an effort to expel all his anger, and he therefore makes a good boxer or bar room brawler. It’s a pity this second Danny left school early. Indeed, some martial arts guidance might completely heal him. 
No matter which Danny you are dealing with, however, keep in mind that all members of the Danny genus need to be kept busy. It’s just how they are.
Hardwired to Satan.

The Tactician. Sure, give him shit about his name if you like but he's heard it all before. While you're giving him shit, he's scanning you like a barcode reader figuring out who you are, what you're about, where you're headed and what your true motives are. It rarely takes him long, and then he goes about his business under the cover of anonymity, rarely not succeeding because he's smarter than 88% of the population. You with me?

A girl’s name for a man in the city. Darby, how’s life? Are you parents a bit dippy? Once in a while you seem to act like a macho idiot, which is a possible reaction to your name, so we suggest letting go of all that crap and learning to exhibit your love for the world. We know you’ve got a good heart deep down. Time to bring it, cap’n. Management.
Corrin is the champion in the bathroom department, no question, but Darcy does alright. Other than that, he’s a good guy with plenty of friends, and who expects to do quite well.

As Jon is to John, Jacen is to Jason and Bryan is to Brian, here we have Daren. Yes, Darren and Daren sound identical but that’s where the similarities end. Daren doesn’t work with his hands, he has a much greater chance of being gay, he’s almost certainly attended some higher education institution, he is definitely more emotionally mature and he might even be an artist. In fact, if you want to break it down real quick, and this isn’t always going to be 100% by the way….
Daren = City
Darren = Country. 
Good luck!

He may or may not be gay, but he is a neat and rather refined man, irrespective. Highly intelligent, he knows most of the people whose photos grace the social pages and has probably slept with half of them.
If Darien was ever to represent his country at the olympics his chosen event would take place inside the equestrian arena. He loves all that shiny leather and the tight white riding trousers.

Here’s a message from Dario: Don’t fuckwith my friends, don’t fuckwith my family, but outside those walls I am one of the most loyal, giving, generous and ridiculously fun people you will ever meet. Amen.
Darius is one of those men who, at some point in their life, aspires to produce his magnum opus and be lauded, therein.
Darko, here's a tip from the boys in the commentary box: You don't need to tell all your friends the ins and outs of every girl you kiss or sleep with, okay hoss?

Darrell was never on NASA’s payroll but who cares? He knows First Aid, he understands when someone is under stress and as a comforter of sorts he’ll usually surrender his when someone is in need. And yes, once every year or so you might find him at a nudist beach enjoying pure sun on all of his skin, and because he often isn’t the world’s fittest man there may be plenty of that.
Darren is a brickie’s labourer, which is handy in a booming property market, although women are no good to him unless he can root ‘em.

Nope, he’s no brickie’s labourer. Darrin is artistic, sensitive and modern, and as such the scope of lifestyles available to him is as wide as his imagination. A little tip? He secretly loves the reactions of people who learn the correct spelling.
Not from the country, Darron wears scarfs on mild days, he has a large collection of designer socks and his dry cleaning bill is substantial.
Completely unrelated to his rather plain step-brother below, Darryl is the debonair devil in sheep’s clothing.

What an interesting chap. No, he doesn't lay bricks or build walls or dig as many holes as his cousin, Darren, although he does have a hard, shiny flat chunk at the top of him, or through the centre of him, somehow. Perhaps he's a top quality axe? He looks good though, and operates in his life within this nice sort of composition, do you know what I mean? And he listens, rarely talking over people.

Darhsan appreciates a freshly ironed shirt and shiny shoes more than most. As something of a classist he will tell you that your presentation is vital if you’re going to succeed. And he won’t care if you or anyone deems this idea to be boring or not.

That's it. I'm changing my name to "Beep pop a-loo op, she's my baby".
(Just kidding.) Alexander Dumas lying in his grave would love this guy, I’m sure. Here in the modern world, D’Artagnan has pulled off a miraculous recovery. Far from ending up in rehab – although he has come close on occasion – he is the toast of his social set. I’ve no idea how he did it. And yes, he's in marketing.
Nutritious and uncomplicated like a decent-sized potato.

Behind the scenes is where Daryn excels. He's the gifted producer/editor who makes the show happen, and whom no one knows exists, which is just how he likes it. His ego never drives his life and he is good at what he does. Note also that 11% of Daryns have built some kind of sexual play space in their house.

No, he's not a Dashhound, although he does have these long, ridiculous things hanging from his ears. Dashel, what's going on here, lad? You're dressed like a bloody slob, man. True, you're an 'artist' and so we expect a certain type of aesthetic I suppose, but seriously, you look like an unmade bed.

A smart and fast thinking young man who likes the idea of navigating. Rally car, aircraft and even blue water sailing - all of these things have crossed his mind as perhaps a job to aim for. Although sailing not so much, I suppose, because as often happens with those who think too much, he gets sea sick in the bath.
Is Dat a reiki healer? He should be if he isn’t. Pure of heart and radiantly optimistic, Dat conveys peace and understanding and everyone feels calm whenever they are near him.
His parents are obsessed with Star Trek. The result is that Dathon loves to travel and is intrigued by new people and adventures. In all honesty, he is delighted every time he leaves the house.

He says he’s a muslim but we think he’s full of shit. A deeply convoluted man, Daud arrives at some new hair-brain scheme every 40 minutes or so, and he gets so engrossed in such ideas that he’d barely make it out of a burning building due to another philosophical discussion he couldn’t bear to finish prematurely.
Dav gets straight to it with a no-nonsense attitude that he somehow melds with a knack for keeping it real and light-hearted.

Dave is a light-weight dead-end, which is why everyone feels like they know him and why people feel immediately comfortable around him. If he isn’t saved by some other nickname then he needs to be barked at by a drill sergeant; “Stand up straight boy! Don’t slouch! Get some ambition in your life!”…..that kind of thing. In life therefore Dave is often so chilled out he's basically asleep.

Death or glory is a wonderful, romantic ideal unless you’re on the losing side, eh lad? Are you lazy, stupid or are you an exhibitionist? We’ve got to hand it to you though, you’re a wonderful entertainer who is great for ratings. We have to ask, have you always been destined to wave away future responsibility for the sake of maximum fun in this moment? Should we envy or pity you? Having said all that, someone has to roll the dice - to show the rest of us what is possible if we throw caution to the wind.   
If you pull it off you’ll succeed spectacularly and if you don’t you’ll crash, catch on fire and die. It’ll make for great television either way, but you must know, Davey, the only reason so many of us are watching is just to see if you make it. Good luck!…

David is more serious than he appears because the heavy D’s at both ends weigh his name down like the legs of a North Sea oil platform, and to this end he may be too deep and sensitive for his own good. However, the ‘V’ in the middle provides a powerful launch pad for virtually anything. We wish him well.
Intelligent, slightly reserved and rarely a selfish lout. Like many good men Davin has never been in a fight in his life.
A big ball of coloured play-dough used by children under the age of 5.

Davy, we don’t think you’ll mind, but you and your equally irresponsible twin brother are one and the same. So, head on over to Davey and we’ll see you on the other side, one way or another…
Love Management.

Good mates with Jordi, Max and Dane, Dax is a progressive man who, no matter how they come to know him, always surprises his friends with some of the little side projects he gets involved with. You know the Go Pro cameras all the surfers are sticking on their boards, these days? Dax thought of that years ago, even though he doesn't personally surf, and he loves his punk.
A rather centred individual who takes a peculiar route in life. Not a dangerous or outlandish one, he's not that impulsive, for he'll assess the risk of his decisions before making the jump.

Deeper than your average river, Dayrian can remain within his walls for days on end. Hopefully he's planning and plotting for the next venture outside, which we hope is soon (and not sitting around staring at bloody video games for weeks). Mate, your nous is wasted staring at any kind of screen - Management.

No, he's  not a critical thinker but he’s not dill either. In order to be great all he probably needs is to have serious decisions thrust upon him. Until this happens it’ll all be too flimsy and easy…
The friendly and generous bloke who, rather than medidate, likes working on his boat. He might even be a boat builder, who knows?
Dazza does his best work at the Bachelor and Spinsters’ ball in the hours between 2am and 6am, such that people have no choice but to take notice of him.

Peculiar and patient, yet determined at the same time, Deacon is like a beacon of hope and encouragement for those who know him and for many who don't. And he does all of this with barely an ego to be seen.
Deakin writes a business plan and sticks to it. He also irons his socks.
Dean works at an abattoir where he operates a machine that kills cows by the hundreds. He eats lots of steak.
The free-thinking shit-stirrer. When life is good he’s there, front and centre. When it’s bad, you won’t see him for dust because he’ll be off somewhere else, trying to make it better.
Heralding from the same blood line as Sasha, Declan enjoys the luxury of being indulged by others, and he subsequently nearly always gets what he wants because people expect him to be himself.
The Lurker. A nice fellow, but yes, a whole chunk of Deegan is completely latent.

Deion, the crew up here in the commentary box suggest you steer well clear of any girls called Shazza. On the flip-side, he earns an above average wage, which is nice, has a large group of modern friends, none of whom have ever held a rifle, and if push came to shove we like to think Deion could chop wood and make a fire if he had to. But we're not sure...
Large, gentle and unconventional.
Demonthones, will you get off the stage and go back to work please? Your lunch break is over and if you want to act as a career then get yourself off to acting school or get an agent. Amen.

Dempsey is a bit of a goofball. You wouldn't say he's clumsy, exactly, and you wouldn't say he's awkward either, but he does have a very unique way of doing things. On the surface he seems a little bit shy, but like an engineer who can't switch off a heavily analytical mind, Dempsey processes things his way and in his time. It's usually worth the wait because while others rush head-long into some kind of stop-gap solution, Dempsey will disregard any negative (or frustrated) reactions near him as he considers the best option. The girl (partner) who gets Dempsey will be a cracker, for her (their) sense of humour will be extremely multi-layered and complex, as well.
Charismatic and unusual, Dempster is a dark horse in nearly every category.
Den deals with change brilliantly. Even something as banal as his wife/partner changing the furniture around is enough to get him frisky.

Having no idea what to do with his life, Denby attempted to fulfil a childhood fantasy by becoming a fireman. He ever told anyone of course, but he didn't do it to save people. What he really wanted was to be in a calendar of half-naked fireman. That way the girls would REALLY love him! (Happily, Denby became a great fireman, saved many many people and yes, you can see him in that calendar. He's that irreverent looking Mr. July smiling down at the cocker spaniel at his feet.)
Denis refuses to purchase new trousers unless the length is exactly correct. As a young man this penchant drove him loopy because of his height - he grew quite quickly, you see.
Not exactly a rogue elephant, Dennis is more like a rogue daffodil, with the occasional exception of Dennis the Alcoholic.

More American hyperbole! Denver does okay, but again, the conversations his name produces are enough for him to shy away from the spotlight. So, he won’t be a CEO of anything big, and that’s a fine outcome anyway.

Is he white? No? Excellent. Denzel has far more style and grace when he’s black. He’s into people, he’s educated and proactive, and he’s probably quieter in public than we would like. Well, unless he slipped into the bad habits of his twin brother, Denzil, but let’s not go there.

“Hey, wattup?" he says to his parents, having just arrived unannounced at the family home for the first time in nearly four years.
His father lifts his head up from the paper, looks him up and down and says, “Nope. You haven’t paid us off for the last money we gave you. Get a job!”

Faced with a room in which pandemonium reigns – people yelling and swearing, sobbing in some quarters, plates breaking, music blaring, tempers flared and emotions high – he will wander over to the cupboard, open the door peacefully, wait for silence to settle and ask, “Would anyone else like some cashews?”
Taxi driver. And no, he NEVER angles the rearview mirror in the hope of perving up girls' skirts, do you mate?

The name of the physiological process whereby something is rolled into a sphere by peristaltic movements and the associated secretions of mucous. A fur ball spat out by any cat is a classic example. (Unless he’s the Irish Dermott, in which case he’s a semi-talented stand-up comedian.)

Ever see the movie Aliens - the second one? You know the one - where the cyborg-man plays stab-the-table-around-the-blokes-fingers-with-an-open-palm?

Anyway, the cyborg is genuinely funny, he's smart as hell and utterly subtle. Best of all he's curious and he wants to help. That, friends and neighbours, is Derrick to a tee.

Ah, the simple life. Do you remember what that's like Derry? That's all he wants, you understand. He doesn't want an ipad or blue tooth or wi-fi or a plasma or a hybrid or a chest wax. Derry, what happened brother? If you want to be a milkman then my advice is the following – toss out all that crap you don't need, get yourself a healthy donkey and cart, and get delivering. You'll get fit, you'll make enough to get by and you'll have friends, even if one of them is a healthy donkey. Amen.

Not easily forgotten, Derryn approaches life like a displeased female hippo' who is unhappy about the proximity of the nearest tourist tinny. And she can be stealthy and tremendously powerful all at once. No, Derryn is not a she, but he wouldn't mind the inference because at the very least he is a well-travelled and open-minded man.

“Just quieten down there now please, Derwent. The rest of the class is trying to concentrate,” the teacher says to him.
