Is he the most unpanic-ridden person in the Kingdom? Wholly present and relevant, Harpur operates like the Belgian government during their early 'negotiations' with the Nazis.They remained calm, they never got flustered at the increasingly absurd, cruel and unfair restrictions placed upon its Jewish population, and they simply refused to buy into the anger and confusion the Nazis so wished to incite. Now, what does all this mean? Here in the real world Harpur is calm, he carries a peaceful smile everywhere he goes and behind it is the knowledge that every second is worth celebrating. Too right.
Film expert. Wears a beret.

You poor bugger…..your mother was so enamoured with the Star War’s and Indiana Jones’ character that you’re now carrying the mantle. As a walking cliché I suggest you change your name and give yourself a break. You’re a nice bloke, so what about Bill? Have you thought about that?
Jocular. He’s never a psychopath and he’s rarely offensive.
Germans, by and large, don't really understand fart jokes. It's lucky then that Hartmut thinks a lot of his German colleagues are a little bit too organised and dull.

If Hartwell were a dog, the only reason he’d ever need a muzzle is because his modus operandi would be to lick everyone to death immediately and constantly. Has he got a wife or a lover of sorts?….Anyone? We should probably talk to them.
A well maintained, sufficiently lubricated and perfectly functioning gearbox of a Kenworth truck. He works when he needs to work and he laughs loudly when he wants to laugh loudly. Why wouldn’t you.
Haset is so full of family love that he is almost exploding. Beyond that, picture a lady called Dot trapped in a male body.

If Hass is on a big ship that hits something and sinks, no way will his name appear in the lost at sea ledger, afterwards. We can’t tell you if he’d be heroic or not - we’d like to think that he would do his best to help others in need - but no way is this boy going to drown. 
And he’s probably not going to marry in a hurry either.

Well, no, he's not the most skilled player in the group but he trains hard and he's always one of the last to walk into the sheds after a session. In that regard he's quite aware of his skills and his place in the team. On game day he gets his fair share of the ball but it's his attitude and level of endeavour that are his real assets. And make no mistake, the marketing girls always want him in the team photo afterwards, and so long as they're kept happy we'll keep him on the list.
Hayes hangs out with the dodgy crew. His earns his dollars via dubious means and while he’s funny enough and pleasant in company, we wouldn’t recommend you loan him any money.
Generally modified to be chilled out and affable, Hazen is the sort of fellow who will go out of his way to put in a kind word for a friend in need.
Unpredictable. You don’t want to meet Heath in a dark alley in a rage.

Like a head umpire at the final of a Grand Slam event, Heber views the world with a quiet, almost dispassionate expression. He's all ears and eyes, however, and not much gets passed him. And, as ever, he's prepared to deal with an irate player, a problematic injury time as well as heckling from the crowd. He has a low resting pulse.

It’s 5am at the party, Hector is drunk, he’s tired, and most of all he’s sick of listening to the shit being spoken around him. He stands up from the couch, salutes a fare-ye-well to the remaining rabble before eloquently dodging their friendly abuse and making for the exit. There, in the doorway, freshly entered, is a woman so starkly beautiful Hector is suddenly confounded at how he’d been living without her. Suddenly wide awake, he walks tall towards her and stops in front of her. “Good evening,” he says with a gentle smile. “May I ask your name?”…

Hellfred's greatest joy in life, aside from driving his polished, red, immaculate MG convertible, generally, is studying his reflection on a bright sunny day, of he himself driving his polished, red, immaculate MG convertible in the shop windows as he motors up the main street. Mirror sunnies on. Slick smirk. Crisp white polo shirt, collar up.

And while many might consider him to be a conceited twit, Hellfred will tell you the whole thing is one giant fucking game, so why not just ham it up? Christ knows someone has to....
Tell us he’s a German engineer, surely? Nice fellow, however, but yeah, he’s a German engineer who probably doesn’t fully grasp slapstick comedy.
A country boy raised on hard-working country values. Well, that is until he gets on his motorbike and then he's a bloody menace to both himself and everyone else he shares the road with.

Henk is too brutally honest for either the political or corporate world, and let’s face it, his visage is one only a mother could love, but the truth he speaks is delivered in such a way as to make it one of the funniest things you will ever encounter. Henk ain’t fucking normal, and that’s just the way the good Lord intended it. Amen
What is it with Danes? He spends most of his time in the nude, even when he's fishing, he is a loving husband and he is a highly experimental cook.

As something of an eccentric it is a given that Henri possesses a huge intelligence. So what if he wears a bright yellow tuxedo to the awards dinner being given in his honour? What matters most is that Henri is The Crazy Inventor, and we’ll need his help, no matter what he’s wearing.....!
“Good old Henry,” you say. He’s not bright enough to be evil but he’s certainly good enough to be wonderful. And by God, he is.
Raised up on a sheep farm, Henty is blessed with giant hands and one of those rural demeanours that makes you feel both calm and safe at the same time. Not to be messed with.

Herb is the sort of bloke that walks back into the farmhouse at the end of another stiflingly hot day, having spent most of it shooting the sheep on his property that were starving to death in lieu of the drought that has devastated his land and his livelihood, and still has a smile for his wife and kids.
Herbie's smile is just a little bit creepy and he pulls his trousers up way too far.
As an ex-God he’s allowed a few liberties and he takes them, which is fair enough, but no one ought to get used to resting on their laurels. Doors don’t just magically open these days, chief.

The Beetle. You know the one. He comes hurtling in the open window like he's flying into battle, crashing with a loud thwack into the curtain. (So much for being discrete!) After he lands you can see him thinking, "Where the fuck am I? What the bloody hell is this place?" And off he goes again, circling around and around looking purposeful, hoping like Christ he can figure out how to get of here before he gets eaten or shot at. Herman.

After the bad cop has ranted and raved at the prisoner in the interrogation room with no success, he departs and after a short time, Hermes, the slippery good cop comes into the room. His mood is calm, he even smiles a bit, and he tries to entice the prisoner with encouraging words and the prospect of some kind of deal that might be able to be brokered, so long as the prisoner comes clean. Hermes.

Like an over-horny gorilla who rushes at rivals in the hope he’ll scare them away, Hernando is all bluff and bluster. He hasn’t got a scar on him. He’s a funny guy though. His life mantra?
Have melodrama, will travel.
No, he's not Yorrick and no he’s no heretic either, probably. What he is, is humorous, kind and artistic. He get’s bored at the drop of a hat.

A friendly fellow who dresses well, is courteous to strangers and who is never afraid to wear his heart on his sleeve. If there is a joke to be had, he’ll do his best to include those around him, rather than exclude.
Completely honourable, upstanding and polite.

Hilton doesn't go in for old rustic homes. What he wants to see is the yard taken over completely by a McMansion that resembles a fortress, and that, in his eyes, consitutes the very latest in modern living. (On the proviso that energy-saving techniques like recycled waste water, a vegetable garden and the like are none of his business. If you can attach a remote control to it or order it on line, including the vegies, then all the better.)
Born in Hamburg, Germany, Hinze is now 62 years old and is the chief curator at a rock museum.

Can you imagine Hitch being captured as a POW and brought into the enemy commanders HQ? The first thing he'd do would be to loudly and forcefully describe his superior moral position before insisting the 10 armed men surrounding him lay down their weapons and immediately surrender.

"That's more bloody like it," he'd say. "Now, where do you keep your liquor?"

Hitch
The little boy racer with a ton of style.

Hock spends most of his time looking at the palms of his hands, close up, trying to figure out how his body came to be constructed of star dust. “I mean, how did that happen??....,” he’ll whisper to himself, perplexed.

Hocko is the sort of bloke who gets so out of it, one night, he accidentally performs deeds so ridiculous that, not only can we not actually discuss them here, they become folklore. Not that he actually inflicts any kind of pain on anyone, it’s just that, once he gets rolling, Hocko doesn’t possess an off switch. Indeed, the only off switch we’ve ever known to work on him is the brick wall that he ends up crashing into all on his own. Some people just never grow up, do they?

No, he's no hero but he does have a large group of friends and an extended family set-up. Property and money are things he seems to deal with well, and it affords him plenty of leisure time. We’re not sure he always uses it wisely, but who are we to suggest any alterations to anyone’s state of happiness, let along Hogan’s.
Pimp.
A serious Eastern European man who likes his rubber boots, his furry cows and his quite weird pornography collection which defies description here.
Hollywood loves to flaunt it and people are sick of telling him to put it away.

Holt doesn't wait for anyone to catch up. If he spies an opening and you're late then forget it, because like water he'll slip through the crack and be gone. It’s why he’s a good basket baller even though he’s short.

Horatio is great at being second in charge and no one really takes him too seriously, which is a pity. 
Advice from Management: Fuck it Horatio, get big. In fact, don’t get big, get massive. Embrace the melodrama that people expect of you and be ridiculous, the more the better. We want to see you fly, boy! 
Why the hell not? Good luck.

Howard is a saturated log that’s lying on the bottom of a river, or maybe a lake.
 Question:  What’s he doing?
 Answer: Not much.
Every unexpected event in life presents Howell with an opportunity for philosophical contemplation and humoristic endeavour.

Hoy owns a van and for a price he’ll pick-up and remove just about anything at a moments notice. He charges quite a bit more for body disposal you understand, but this is probably fair enough. He doesn’t care what he’s wearing so long as he’s comfortable.
As a consequence of a very conservative upbringing he has solid and commendable values that stretch toward intolerance. He cleans out his ears, daily.

In one of those rare events that even the greatest minds that delve into the complicated mathematics of quantum mechanics are at a loss to define or understand, Huck radiates positive ions. So, take a big breath, stand forth, and just walk into him.

More than 150 people have auditioned for the role and still, after three days the producers are sitting in the front row, scratching their heads. But their luck is about to change. Huddo has made a late entrance, as usual, but here we go kids. Broadway will never be the same again. The rest, as they say, is history…
An award winning choreographer, set designer, actor, artist or writer.
Hudson is handsome (kind of) and funny (sort of), but he is a brooding egomaniac who eventually gives everyone the shits. What is it with these American names?

A bumbling good guy who never rushes anything, which is fine. What you may not be aware of however is that Huey, the god, is who every surfer prays to when they're out the back and in need of a wave. You’ll hear someone next to you say aloud in frustration, “Come on Heuy, what are you doin’ mate?”
And you’ll sit there and sure enough, suddenly the horizon changes colour and rises up. Huey was there all the time, you understand. He’s tapped into the Planet Gods because he is one. All we can do is pray he’s on our side. Best bit is, even if you drown, he’s leading you by the hand to the next place. There is nothing he won’t do for you.

The Hoarder. Whether he’s an opal prospector, a sculptor of marble or a painter of oil on canvas, Hugh is some kind of artist and he hasn’t showered or shaved in years. (Unless he’s the Hugh that works on the floor of the stock market, in which case I wouldn’t bother with him.)

When King Hugo (the full moon) comes out to play, it’s he who casts the spell which makes everyone go crazy – and he brings with him one of the great senses of humour. In human form Hugo is the unofficial leader, though he hates ever being called that, and not just anyone can pull it off. Nice one Hugo.

Humphrey isn’t so much as bold as he is experimental. A rollicking sense of optimism means he is rarely miserable although his mother and partners are perpetually exasperated at how messy he is around the house. He’d make a useless spy because it’s nigh’ impossible for him to leave a scene/cupboard/fridge without leaving evidence of his visit, and in love he is a doting, blithering buffoon, god bless him.
Delusional.
Educated and relaxed, Huon takes his time and rarely gets flustered.
The name of Ryan’s cock.
The Great Egyptian Sphinx. No one knows what he’s thinking although it’s probably pretty good because Hutchy is nothing if not cunning.

How can you take a man seriously when he doesn't? Perhaps this is why he is so lucky. In essence, Huw doesn't often sit idle and he is huge fun as a result. Good with kids, helpful with neighbours, and he'll try anything once.
Barrister.

He's a freak. No, he's never gone exploring but he loves the idea, however. Inevitably his romantic partners ditch him because they tire of being asked how he looks in, what he calls, his ‘frontier stance’. He places one leg up on the bed, one on the ground, puts his hands on hips and stares off into space as if he were observing a vast untouched mountain range that he’s about to conquer.
Huxton, mate, have you considered getting into the space program? The only place a human is going to be able to do that meaningfully, in the current era, is when we land on Mars, but that's not going to be for a while.
See Ian, although the weird ‘i’ in the middle of his name provides him with more academic potential, a more forthright business stance and a slightly larger ego.

The sound of a teaspoon being dropped onto a tiled floor. The ungainly twang is noisy without being painful and more often than not it leaves a mess, but did you ever stop and study the shape of the pattern of the mess? Check it out next time. You might be surprised to discover the artist that lies within. Suffice to say if Ian is ever undergoing some kind of existential crisis you’ll never know about it unless he tells you.

Regardless of where he is from (and if it’s not a nickname then he must be Danish or something) Ib bounces along with a cheerful grin, as if he’s a basketball having escaped the court via an errant shot and is now merrily bouncing his way down a steep hill towards a busy intersection. Ib doesn’t give a fuck. He just wants to have fun and hang out with as many cool, bouncing people as possible, and busy intersections are generally full of them. Amen.
Guy is Iggy's idol.

Every moment, event and deed in his life presents as an opportunity for good-natured competition. It can be painful after a while and his partners tend to be very patient. Usually, however, Ignatius is good fun and he provides a non-boring setting.
Igor is more light-hearted than you think but do yourself a favour and don’t even pretend that you want to fight him. It’s a Croatian thing...

“Ijad! Fuck, look out!” screams his panic-stricken friend, pointing desperately at the ground beneath Ijad’s feet. “Snaaaaake!”

Ijad calmly stops in his tracks and looks down. True enough a deadly adder is curled up and beginning to stir next to his sandals. Without even looking up, Ijad raises an open palm in the direction of his friend, silencing further outbursts. When he understands the snake is okay, he raises his eyes to his pal and quietly smiles.

“Relax,” Ijad whispers. “He’s cool.”

And day by day, Ijad knows that one day his friend will be too.

The end.

Ike crashes his helicopter and is badly injured. A rescuer arrives late and very calmly Ike says to them, “No, I’m done. Now leave me be.” 
Ike.
Ilias is a medical name for a medical man in that he computes information very quickly and, by and large, very well.

Ilman is a sufficiently savvy operator. He is generally educated enough to not only know the rules, but to occasionally deliberately break them, although not if it means hurting others in any way. (Wasteful government departments notwithstanding.) His kids treat him as if he is a playful teenager, himself, and he aspires to keep life simple and happy. In the bedroom he is as kinky as you'd expect.

Imron is a bloody twit sometimes. Sure, he's a funny, goofy guy who everyone likes and for good reason - he's generous with his time, he loves animals and kids and he loves the outdoors - but his capacity to think laterally on any level is completely missing. If he ever read one of those prank newspapers that regularly interviews alien abductees he'd be on the next plane to Area 51 and God knows where else, in search of aliens. Imron, just because you read it doesn't make it true, mate.

I swear Steven Spielberg altered a generation. Anyway, Indi is a nice young man just trying to get by in a giant, over-complicated world that is becoming more like Big Brother everyday. Indi yearns for the quiet life more than most and he's not sure what he wants from life just yet, so don't push him. Time - what he wants is a bit more time to figure it out.
Drinks a hot soy skinny latte and lives in the city.

Is he a shoemaker?
No. Not enough stimuli.
Is he a fighter pilot?
No way. His maths isn’t up to it, or maybe he just never got into it, and he isn’t the toughest in the group under pressure.
Is an artist?
Mmmm, sometimes, yep, even though he kind of loathes the cliché.
Is he a muso’?
Occasionally, yes, and a fine one. Anyway, forget the Q&A, what’s important to know is that Indigo is a borderline hippie, but not so much that he hasn’t organised himself in a Western world. And he’d make a fine dad, and what better job is there?
(PS- he’d actually be wonderful working with wood. Is he doing that? Anyone?...)
Ingo has drunk at the same pub every afternoon for 25 years. He seems to have avoided a life of responsibilty and at a very impressionable 50 years of age he still thinks he's a bloody teenager.
Innes is the opposite of incompetent. And he has a sense of humour. Don’t let any of his staff try to convince you otherwise.
Stoic.

A welcoming smile heralds an open-minded yet conservative-looking fellow. Sounds contradictory, I know. Rarely impulsive, Ion's car is well-serviced and the log book meticulously maintained, which, gleefully, is exactly the opposite of his sex life which, while organised, is full of kink, unpredictability and bizarre personalities. Go hard son!
Irfan excels at finding simple solutions to seemingly complex problems.
Irvin looks like a gum tree but he's actually a fern.

The men in the trenches are dour. Fear strangles their stomachs and all of them know that very few of them will be alive in ten minutes. Can you believe humans do such things to each other? Anyway, Irving is no different, except perhaps he is. “Oh well, fuck this,” he says. “If we're really going over the top, at least let me tell you blokes this joke I heard yesterday….” Irving.
You’ll often find his picture in the social pages where he is generally surrounded by beautiful women who seem to be having the time of their lives.
Cool cat. Bisexual.
Bank Manager. And he's at the beginning of his own little corporate mission.

Well-schooled and watchful of his possessions, Ismail is like a very shiny rock crystal which is fun to hold and observe, but who gives away nothing as to how he was constructed (or what he might be thinking).
The highly intelligent and fast-moving gymnast. Perpetually ready for just about everything.

If Iva were born in India, and we can virtually assure you that he isn’t, although who knows what happens in past life events, he would never be of a lower caste. Not that any notion of social status enters his head of course, for Iva is a clear-headed, eminently-present and generous individual. No, he doesn’t work with his hands and the graceful lines of his name forever propel him into a genial, artistic life which is as subdued as it is brilliant. He’s another one of these fathers who infuriates his young children (and partners, occasionally) because he simply refuses to be drawn into any kind of petty, quarrelling melodrama.
Ivan believes that everything in the world exists inside well-defined black and white squares.
No, Ivo isn’t evil, he’s just a man trying to look and act like a man in a world where men are being urged to behave very correctly.

Ivor keeps hearing voices behind  him. The upshot is that if you are ever talking to him, you can see that he's only partially listening. He's not being rude, trust me, he's just trying to figure out what's going on behind him. (He's written off several cars for the same reason.)

He's a funny fellow alright. Taken to flights of fancy quite easily, one minute you'll see him rushing off to helicopter school until he realises he's scared of heights. The next you'll find him blazing out to sea in his new career of deep-sea fisherman. Yes, he spent tens of thousands of dollars on a boat and fishing gear, but did he ever try and find out if got sea sick? Of course not. Now look at him - throwing his guts up all down the side of his big white boat and he's barely left the bloody harbour. 
Izaak, some advice lad: this here is the address of the local Buddhist temple. I want you to go there, sit down and just relax for a moment. There’s no rush, so close your eyes for a wee while and see if  you can discover what it is you truly desire.
As a funny, smart and charismatic bastard, Izzy is irrepressible.
Dutchman, and who knows what they get up to over there. The last I heard he was about to jump off a cliff wearing a bird-suit.

Finally, some parents who were progressive in a reasonable and intelligent manner! Jace is a tremendous, normal, funny kind of fellow. He'll help others from positions of power (ie - when he can), he has a large circle of friends and he looks forward to being a dad.
The name given to that tiny drop of blood that appears after accidentally stabbing yourself with a pin. (ie. he tries to be neat, but he forgets to think sometimes, that’s all.)
As one of life’s great experiences, Jack is the name given to the phenomenon of a parcel arriving unexpectedly in the mail from a good friend. Outstanding. (Note: Jack is another Child Nightmare.)
Funny guy. Loud mouth. Loves the spotlight. Not stupid.
Rubber neck.

No, Jackson isn't bland, although there was that rumour floating around for a while. Jackson is actually far more attentive than you'd imagine. Sure, he's lazy, he never cleans his room and when he does have a job he's usually late to show up, but he has an easy smile which is genuine and when you get him one-on-one he's a pretty good listener.

Look at him will ya? Standin' there on the corner, waitin' for the girls to come-a-runnin'.......his hair all trussed up, his thumbs in his pockets. Maybe he was born 40 years too late. Come on, come out here Jaco. I want you stand up in front of the class and tell us what you think. Trust me, you can't get it wrong, just be sure to stand tall and look us in the eye when you speak. Okay, you cool?...Excellent. Please begin...

Option A:  Jacob has a clean heart with a good soul. Sure, he might be a Baptist minister that hails from Vancouver and, yes, Canada is Boring’s idea of heaven but Jacob is worth his due. He has a toothy, natural grin and he possesses a generous laugh because he’s a generous man. Thank you Jacob.

Option B:  An out-of-control nut job, who needs to be shot at with the same device that takes care of Ross when he’s coming at you.

His name is like a maze. So, have you got him on a good day or he a bit melancholy and diffident? His name is almost too mature and wise for him to be an idiot, which is a pity. Yes, we all have responsibilities J, but once in a while you just have to say, "Bugger this. I quit." At which point you're entitled to stand up, throw your pen down, rip off your tie and get the hell out onto the open road and for some frivolous adventure! It'll do you good.

Jesus Jacobus, your name starts and stops and scoots off again like an old truck in need of a good overhaul. So, the formula? Stop once in a while and get away from the noise (idiots) you’re surrounded by and quiet the mind. Certainly, don’t get sucked into the moronic ideals in your midst. Learn to be comfortable in your own company and don’t do (too many) drugs…not in your case.
An opinionated and arrogant Frenchman....well......not all of them of course. The team in the commentary box were just eager to see what reaction they got.
Jaddan, do you have nickname? Anyway, we suggest you eat all your vegetables, don't always do or say what your friends think and get out of the house more than you are. Amen.
Pretty Boy…actually, that’s not strictly correct. He’s just a city lad with silly parents, who were desperately trying to be cool after he was born.
Stop dragging your feet, lad! Come on! Stand up. Do some good! Make a difference, I say!
The skinny rat bag who gets bored at the drop of a hat, and which is the only he gets into trouble like he does.
Jagger will drift anywhere that the tide takes him. Jagger, my friend, get swimming and come here to shore. I'll feed you when you get here and then we'll form a game plan, okay? Start today.

The wonderful International Man of Intrigue and Spiritual Enlightenment. He began life as a baby chimpanzee carved out of ice-cream but then he grew up, and his name and character took off like a hang-glider taking flight from the edge of a windswept cliff. Who knows where he’s headed but it will be somewhere ethereal. No question.
Nah, Jai isn’t a show-off. He’s actually attached to the Earth far more than you imagine and he’s disappointed in the behaviour of most of the world’s multi-nationals.

If Jaiden is American he one day hopes to fly to Mexico with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach.
If Jaiden is English he one day hopes to fly to Spain with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach.
If Jaiden is Australian he one day hopes to fly to Bali with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach.
If Jaiden is from Hong Kong he one day hopes to fly to Thailand with some friends so they can drink and party on the beach. Etc etc...
(Note: Jaiden ends up in a foreign hospital with hepatitis B and alchoholic poisoning.)
What a pretty little flower, he is! We can only presume he is aspires to become highly educated.
Intense and often perplexing.

Usually he's armed. Management has a suggestion for you, lad. Have you wondered what life would be like living somewhere where you don't need to carry a weapon? What you should be lugging around is a notebook, not a German made Gloc.
(Note: If he plays an instrument disregard the entire description.)

Jake has more pornography in his bedroom than any other male. He was once caught masturbating by his mother who burst into his room to find him standing over an upturned TV with his trousers around his ankles, and with Jake the Snake in his hand. He didn’t return to the house for days and, yes, he did eventually move out. He now wears a flannel shirt.

Jakob might be an atheist, which is allowed, although we do hope that from time to time he ponders how he came to be living, and what this whole life-caper is about. Unfortunately he seems to be more interested in his own hairdo, which, let's face it, is a bloody mess. Is that the current trend?
Useless on a building site where he is expected to work hard for a long time.
Well goodness me, Jamahl, you got a job! Shit eh?! We knew you’d come good brother, we just knew it! Now you just have to pay back all that money to your parents. Don’t worry, you’ll get there.

Jamal is decent fellow and socially adept. What he is skilled at, however, is grasping an opportunity when it arises and slipping through the gaps. Never forget that Jamal is a sneaky little fucker, and it helps that the boy can act.

Jameel moves and walks like his joints are made of rubber. Fast with a grin and an escape plan, Jameel is quite serious about not being too serious. And if someone accuses him of being a girl or weak, he'll huff and puff like a souped-up male gorilla who would rather stomp the ground heavily rather than actually go into battle.

A master of disguise and one of the Enigmas. Fiendishly clever, the only thing he won’t do is dig holes, although he does loathe all forms of menial labour. Occasionally very serious, rarely flippant and often the funniest person in a room, he always keeps a little in reserve. This is the James’ way.
Jamie is a young soul and often highly energetic or controversial. (Note: If he smokes a lot of cigarettes then the windows in his house will shake with the volume of his stereo.)
Jamil, don't slouch! And we dont mind the fact that you appear to do nothing, but seriously dude, a little hard work is good for the soul.

Jamin spends more time than most looking inward, not outward. As a very bright and occasionally quite intense young man, it’ll do him good to get outside amongst it and  to look up once in a while, if for no other reason that to see how large and amazing this world is. Don't worry about all that career crap Jamin - that'll come in good time if it needs to.
Jamison tends to overdo it.

(Pron. Yarn) Jan lives a streamlined life and rarely is he overweight. His European heritage assists him to be quite direct and so he accomplishes tasks with relative ease, yet he is a relaxed character who is comfortable in all social situations.

Yep, you heard right. And don't worry, we're scratching our heads up here in the commentary box too. But, hello, it seems Jane can actually play a bit! Oh, I see. He's under the radar, isn't he? By the time you stop and consider who you are dealing with he's got the ball and he's off, laughing hard all the way. Nice job Jane. Nice job indeed. (And no, he ain't no brick layer.)

He's the clean-living fellow with the whistle in his mouth, ready to blow it if he sees an infringement, or some kind of impending danger up ahead. Rarely outspoken and lewd, Jannes works hard and plays well, ensuring that no one is either left out or emotionally damaged by the events at hand. Conscientious and wise, Jannes is a man to be trusted and relied upon and rarely (if ever) would you find him in a rehab clinic…well…unless he was working there, of course.
Like Andre way before him, Jan Niklas looks nothing like the organised man you might expect. He smiles easily and he's nowhere near as anal as he sounds
Janos walks around in circles because his right foot is bigger than his left. It does make him a patient man, however, with a bright opinion of everything.
Jared is basically identical to Jarred except that he’s slightly more gullible

Jari isn’t as irresponsible as you think. If he’s a boy you should probably sell him, but as a young man he dots his i’s and crosses his t’s. There is every chance that at some point in his life he’ll find himself at a forest doof, where he’ll probably take some acid or some such thing, close his eyes and just dance for days while being attached to the universe in ways which will be indecipherable to most old folk.
See Jarred.

"Hang on, is that Darren, Sharon or who, did you say?"
This is the miniature, instantaneous and internal debate everyone has inside their head the first time they meet Jaron. And what does all this mean? Well, Jaron is polite for a start, but rarely is he able to produce a wild, loud and in-your-face response which stems from a solid basis of being ‘known’.
In adulthood therefore Jaron is a wildcard and, perhaps more than most, he is on a journey of self-discovery that this ‘unknowingness’ provides.

Does anyone know where he went? We saw him leg it over the fence but that was hours ago? Has he shown up at the police station?......No?......Okay, well, we'll just wait around here then. He knows where his bread is buttered.

Jarred is a polite, normal and content young man with a clean soul and a rural background (unless he gets drunk with a group of his male friends, in which case he’s liable to fall into the macho pack-mentality of group idiocy). Did he ever grow out of that??

Jarrett deals with the hectic city life better than most. Sure, he'd prefer to live by the sea in a more calmer and cleaner setting but for the time being he deals with the big smoke very well. Stress doesn't really absorb into his skin and so the usual dramas that bother people don’t normally effect him. He has an easy smile, he's patient enough and he gravitates friends to him. He’s another who would make a good dad and he’s looking forward to the day when it happens.
Good at pool. Although his hair gets in the way most of the time.
A simple man, Jarrod has dreams of sitting in a tub full of warm mash potato that's had a full bucket of butter dropped into it. But he's not selfish at all. He'll share it with you.

Record producer. He spends most of his time in L.A these days but he's a hard man to pin down. He doesn't mind London but the weather gets to him. On Sunday afternoons, back at his place, you'll often see him hanging by the pool with the 'crew', half of which seem to be gorgeous skinny girls in bikinis. He's best mates with Elvis and their parties, consequently, are even more famous than they are. Jarvis.

Polite, friendly and open, Jase attracts friends and business. He doesn't possess a nasty/vengeful bone in his body - unless someone has done something truly heinous - and life seems to be kind to him. He's make an excellent vet because he hates seeing animals in any kind of pain.
More thoughtful than his cast of ‘Jason cousins’ he gets into less trouble and is more sensitive in general. Timid once upon a time, Jasen succeeds through hard work and diligence.

Jason is one of the few creatures in the Kingdom to have two completely distinct subspecies: 
Jasonicus thuggus: Before he became a son of jail, he was a violent criminal who was sucked down one of life's tougher paths, in lieu of the fact that he carries one of the truly mean and irrational tempers. 
Jasonicus raucous: A highly intelligent, very active and super playful creature who doesn't have a nasty bone in his body, although all Jasons are competitive mongrels when they want to be. 
The latter is a splendid specimen while the former needs to learn how to forgive.

Born to get around corners easily, Jasper is slippery like an eel in both body and acumen, although he arrives with a splendid sense of decorum. Keep an eye out though because if there’s an angle yet to be tested then you just wait, he’ll find it.
Tall, dark and handsome, or possibly short, dark and nuggety, Javier swans along as if it’s all too easy. And perhaps it is. It’s all about attitude of course, as it is for each of us.

Not the most indefatigable of characters, Jax is fair weather sailor. He doesn’t want to take the yacht out in mountainous seas. No way. Plus, out there in the middle of the night, drenched, sea-sick and shitting himself, basically, and not that we blame him, how would he ever look cool? No one would see him for a start.
Fluff, until he stands tall in his own energy. (Another youngster who is a disaster in the classroom.)
A fully-fledged nightmare as a child, did he grow out of that? Anyone? Not quite blue chip stock, more like blue collar, and that’s okay.

Jay is an unusual bloke with an addictive nature and he’s so complex that he’s nearly simple. He thinks a lot – perhaps too much – but his interest in the various peoples of the world knows no bounds.
Ah, a slippery customer who knows the market very well, so well in fact he’d make a splendid inside trader.

Relaxed. Intelligent. Complex. Jayden is a funny guy without being the life of the gathering and he’s quirky without being a bore. Yep, Jayden does quite nicely most of the time. But hang on….what’s missing here?…

Far more patient and socially aware than his masturbating cousin (Jake), Jayke has to spell his name every 30 minutes, and far from producing an impatient, disturbed individual, it has given him a sense of calmness which many admire and certainly most should aspire to. Did he ever attend university? Who cares. He's a nice fellow with good friends. He's a good judge of character who doesn't tolerate charlatans of any kind and while behind closed doors he never dies wondering, he is nothing if not polite. Nice one Jayke.
Do what you like of course Jaymz, but get out of the city for a while. Just for a change of pace and for a setting devoid of glass, concrete or mirrors.

Jazber is irrefutable and irresistable, like one of those old motorbikes with a massive two-stroke engine. He takes a while to get started and he'd sleep all day if you let him, but when he fixes his gaze on what he wants and he gets up to speed, then look out!

On the surface Jazz is a happy, engaging sort of guy. But, under all that good will, and there's usually plenty, is a competitive streak that you only really experience properly if you're in the ring with him. Yes, Jazz is a cage-fighter, and he can look after himself.
(Said with a deep, slow voice)..... “My name’s JD... and I like my women... dim and pretty.”

True, it is impossible to take a man too seriously when his name is Jean, and so he had nowhere to go other than down the path of either the nonchalant comic legend, or the unforgiving captain of industry who is famous for getting heavily drunk and wanting to brawl.

Is he French? Oui? Okay, well, JC approaches life like a skilled exponent of origami. He likes to look at things, take a step back, and then deliberately turn them around so he can observe from a totally different angle. He's quite a quirky individual.

Did you ever hear of or see an American basketballer called Kareem Abdul Jabaar? (If in doubt, I suggest you rent the movie Airport, where he plays a wonderful cameo.) Anyway, Kareem moves in the same way as Jeandry's entire personality. He's a goofball, takes little seriously, and kind of floats (or plods) along like he hasn't planned a thing, even though he seems to always be in the right place at the right time. Know what I mean?
JP strolls around as if a nearby orchestra is playing the waltz. He smiles at most people and most things, usually, and while his financial life is often a disaster, you'd never know it.
Jed has a resting pulse of 11, he is able to carry a grown cow under each arm and he has a laugh with nearly everybody. Jed, how are you boy?

A reserved young man who does better as a lone competitor than in a team of macho wankers. He knows his talents, his limits and his potential, and being surrounded by a pack of grunting, testosterone-filled buffoons is enough to turn him off team sports forever. Perhaps he should try his hand at furniture making? He has patience and a good eye....so who knows?
Concrete expert.
Yep, and I'm Elmer Fudd, how are ya?
An agreeable, amiable and hard-working man, Jeff is often covered in concrete dust. Which is to say, he'll do the job and see it through, and he's rarely surprised by what it took.

Sure, Jelly is one fluid individual but he’s not fat and he’s not stupid. What Jelly is a genius at, and what many many people seem to struggle with, is a thing called ‘change’. It’s never scared him – why would it? – indeed, he thrives on it.
Vacuum cleaner. (He makes a lot of noise, he looks good in the cupboard, and he likes shiny red outfits.)
The name of the fellow who comes around to your house to fix your printer. He's a quiet kind of guy and a nice one.

The army Corporal who aspires to be a General. On the surface he is a tremendous leader of men but, sadly, he lacks common sense and this makes him incredibly dangerous in a situation where he’s in charge of men with guns.

Art teacher. The kind of man that his students come to appreciate more and more, the longer they spend out of school. As a chilled out, long-haired pseudo-hippie they all came to realise it wasn't the skills of art he was trying to instil, although he did do a good job of that, but more a sense of trying to look at the various things in the world from as many points of view as possible. Most of all, they remember laughing with him lots.

Jeremiah is a decent person and an aggressive haggler, such that rarely does he walk out of a shop without a discount. If the situation is reversed his rather suave and sanguine sales approach means the patrons rarely know that they're being given the hard sell. More than one woman has slapped him, too.
Jeremy is intelligent and ostensibly gentle, but if he’s highly ambitious then he can be a slippery customer to deal with. He’d make an excellent head steward for an airline.

Prompt. 
Clean. 
Educated.
Diligent. 
A little pig-headed but a nice smile. 
Funny in a twisted, European kind of way. 
Usually blonde. 
Jergen.
Yes, please see Jeremiah.
Rarely visibly excited, Jerome speaks fluent French, Arabic and English and he used to work for the military.

I know what you're thinking Jerremy - you want to do what Corrado did. Mate, I'm telling you, it looks like fun. It's not. If you want to rub your testicles against some leather, captain, visit an S&M club where someone who knows what they are doing can adminster the pain properly. You got that?

The name of a cardboard box used to hold bananas. He’s sort of useful, kind of flexible and semi-interesting if you need to move anywhere, but if he sits in the corner for too long you’ll forget that he exists at all.
See Davo, and we wish you the best of luck.
A baby-faced teenager no matter how old he is, who has a surprising amount of initiative.
Jesse rhymes with Mud Brick. (i.e: get him outside, get him away from technology.)
An unmitigated buffoon.
People stop and take a second when they hear his name, and Jesus is mild mannered as a result – possibly even timid.
What a unit? Jethro is the only man in the Kingdom who, if walking down the street on his own, will whisper quietly to his penis about what's happening so it/he/his buddy doesn't miss out. Jethro.
Jett can only count up to twenty nine. Is he an astrologer?

Agile and healthy, Jevan is a friendly man who rarely gets into major disputes. We're not sure but we suspect it's because he likes to be on the move, which means anyone who has a gripe with him can't usually find him. However, he has friends and he's a social animal. Does he have the capacity to be led down the garden path by someone else's misplaced enthusiasm?....Yep.
He’s no Rhodes Scholar but he’s 100% true blue.
The beers up are up, lad, but please tell me there's more to your life than this…..?
Bullwinkle.
No quiet moments. Not much sleep. A well-travelled background and a penchant for dangerous and out-of-control spouses means Ji, almost by default, has an artistic edge which always needs an outlet.
Cambodian or not, Jie Li has learnt how easily a smile gets things done, and how it makes people suddenly more eager to help.

Option A:  Brainwashed by society to the conformities of what constitutes a strong male in a rural environment, Jim, while a pleasant and generous individual, is incapable of dealing with highly complex issues. He is a simple fellow at his core, so maybe he’s lucky that he lives a simple life.

Option B:  Good bloke.
Jimbo is a sensational, goofy and loving man, who would be able to accomplish so much more in life if not for the fact that he has a sheep brain in his cranium, and not a human one.
The intellectual and/or physical juggernaut that, like many-a-James, keeps a fair bit in reserve while quietly biding his time.
Like any decent crap that you’re dying to have, Jimmy is bare-boned, rude, proud, occasionally very funny and, generally, wonderful to experience. (Just be careful of the cleanup.)
Jisou is an under-the-radar operator. He has the dedication and passion to enable him to stare at a screen/sculpture/mould/garden/duco for hours or days until he is sure he’s got it just right.

Known and loved by hundreds, JJ is exceptionally bright and enthusiastic. One of his few failings is that he is incapable of saying the word ‘no’. Whenever he goes out at night, he wears bright silver pants that could have been worn by any famous motorcycle stunt rider. Women adore him until he falls foul of them, at which point they learn to treat him like a lovable little brother. Hate never gets a look-in.

If Jo is from the country there is a good chance he could skin a sheep or a goat before he could walk. And if Jo is from the city he works for the financial system and has no idea about skinning or killing anything.
Active and tidy, Joakim is an energetic individual whose appreciation of people and place provides a refreshing point of view.
Is he a Rhodes Scholar? Well, probably not, but as one of the most genial men in the Kingdom he never has a bad word for anyone.

Wet sock. But, if someone tells him to put them on and run to the top of that mountain in the pouring rain, he knows they'll be wet soon anyway, even if they were dry. The moral to the story: do your best, and the best will happen young man.

He might be Scottish and he might not, but Jock is very intelligent, surprisingly sensitive and extremely funny. So long as he doesn’t live near any kind of outback mining community, then Jock is a wonderful bloke.
Had he decided to become a comedian or an actor he’d be famous by now, and for all the right reason.

A 1960's cartoon detective. He wears a hat popular with gangsters, he never leaves the house without a black tie and his shoes are always polished. But he's a canny sleuth. Good old fashion clues - this is what he likes. None of this modern-day DNA bullshit. And he dislikes what mobile phones are doing to the population.

"If you say you're going to be somewhere,” Jody often says, “then damn-well be there. The End." As a chivalrous man Jody opens car doors for ladies.
Joe moves, thinks and speaks slowly, unless he has an Asian heritage, in which case he does exactly the opposite.

Joel has one of the lowest IQ’s in the entire Kingdom. (The fact of the matter is that he's too busy crashing his bike, surfing, setting stuff on fire or fishing. He never even heard about the bloody I.Q test and so never attended. Thus, when the scores came back he was at the bottom. Joel.)

In what is considered a miracle of human physiology, while his body kept ageing, his brain and intellect ceased developing at the age of 14. To this day no one is sure if this is a curse or a blessing...

If Joff turns up with a carton of beer he rarely takes the time to stick them in a fridge or an esky. He just rips into the cardboard, hands out the beers to whoever wants one and away he goes, cracking beer number one. Days such as these rarely end quickly and never quietly.

Another fellow with a European bent. On a bad day he’s only a little temperamental and possibly a tad impatient, but that’s about as bad as it gets. He certainly doesn’t hide his feelings and for a technically-minded soul he has a deep, infectious laugh.

His teutonic nature borders on dull stolidity but he may surprise you with a joyful eruption of laughter that leaves you happy, and wondering if you're right. Is he South African? Yes, well, like Ross, get out your gun and keep it locked on him in case he makes a run at you...

John is the name of that huge boulder sitting out there on its own, near the edge of town. He’s been there so long that we hardly even notice him any more – he’s just part of the furniture. There’s a section on the other side of him that hardly ever sees the sun, which may have occasional ramifications, although nothing’s perfect anyway, but there he sits. He’ll be there long after all these humans are dust and one day he will become dust himself.

Leadership can be tough, both for your friends and sometimes your family, but somebody has to keep an eye out for fires on the horizon. Prevention is always better than the cure – you’ll hear him say these words more than once. He doesn’t mind if you dislike his style and he doesn’t care if you talk about him behind his back. That’s not his business. His job is to keep everyone alive and as happy as is possible, and if he succeeds at that the rest is just fluff. Amen.

In reality we’re not sure why there exists differences between man-made wonders of the world and those which are described as natural - I mean, both exist here on Earth, so why does it matter? - yet here we are. Two very heavy, conservative names placed together produce a diamond the likes of which many never be repeated again. We’ve no explanation. He might as well be an alien, so skilled and unique is he. (Very lazy when it comes to chasing the ladies, however, so I suppose no one is perfect.)

JL is the only man on Earth who cannot make love to anyone unless there is a functioning sextant in the room. Perhaps he was an explorer in a past life, I'm not sure, but he definitely has a flair for the dramatic.

The Mr. Good Natured who no one despises. Unfortunately (or fortunately) Johnno suffers from the same disease as Dave and Bob in that every stranger who ever meets him feels like they already know him.

When he was young, Johnny went so hard that he nearly went crazy but he finished all of that a long time ago and he has mellowed dramatically. Nowadays, his soul has relaxed completely and his confidence and quiet charisma leads the way. Johnny is admired by many, and the funny thing is that these admirers aren't even aware of it. Weird eh?

A tough youngster gives rise to a man who doesn’t grin as much as he could, or probably should. Peace, love and serenity are things to be aspired to chief, and it’s okay to show your vulnerabilities these days. Promise.
Jolie has a surprising amount of pluck and, no, levity is not necessarily his middle name. He likes things done his way and he believes in his own actions.

Jolin is like a small hound who behaves when the humans are around, but then as soon as they are gone is prone to tearing apart lounge rooms or wailing for hours in the hope of gleaning some attention from anywhere. He is perpetually on the brink of losing his driver’s licence.
Jolon works with his hands or possibly in the lower echelons of a white collar company. His saviours are his friends and this thing we call alcohol. Is it a curse? Perhaps…
The gay/artistic/feminine/sensitive/more progressive version of John.

The name topples over itself at the finish like a huge ocean wave crashing over a reef after a journey of a thousand miles and, therefore, there is a sense of tragic magnificence about him. But ignore all that. Jonah is no fool, far from it, and he is one of the few men who, if he taps into his potential, could influence the lives of many many people. If you meet him you should ask him if you can help. (Note: if he’s shy or a little timid, get hold of a whip and get him out that door. Amen.)

Jonas, it's great that you take a keen interest in your own health - in a perfect world we all probably should - but what's this fascination with your own rectum? It's got a few of us up here concerned…

To say he is self-righteous and proud might possibly infer he is something of an arrogant twat. He’s not – indeed, Jonathan has a great sense of humour. But it’s true, he’s self-righteous and proud, and there endeth the lesson.

If he isn’t either slightly ridiculous or an eccentric tosser, and there’s a 47% chance he is, then Jonathon is quiet and demure, and if you were to walk into a lounge room where he was nestled comfortably into a couch and he didn’t move or greet you, you’d barely register his presence. (Which is why he’s accidentally seen couples having sex in front of him at least a dozen times.)

Jonesy takes most calamities in his stride, not that he sees too many. As a prankster who is a magnet for friends and strangers, he uplifts all those in his midst. Usually he’s completely reliable and he’ll bend over backwards for just about anyone - fuckwits excluded.
United Nations rep? Bullshit. Jonte is a pair of clean coloured socks.

Too cool for school. (Again, what is it with these American names? And if he is one then please ignore the question.) Anyway, Jordan has a good heart, he just needs a bit of direction, that's all. In that regard he's not on his own.
The shy cat who, usually, is well aware of his own skills and limitations. The only downside of this is that he rarely talks himself up and sometimes, in this crazy modern world, you have to.
The definitive Cruiser.
Yep, he's an exact mix of the man above and man below….beyond that my lips are sealed. Management.
Lucky he’s skilled cos’ he’s crazy. The ladies love him.
The funny messenger boy.
A serious character who is there when you need him. He frowns more than he smiles but it’s probably all a front. He’s a good person and far brighter than you’d imagine.

Unexpectedly hilarious, secretly competitive and sometimes understated, Josh has the capacity to outmanoeuvre almost any opponent. It’s not that he’s the brightest spark in the pack, he’s not, though he’s no village idiot either, but he combines a nice mix of persistence, guile and humour. (Note: If he’s under 10 years of age he is a bloody nightmare.)
The sensitive arts student who has many more female friends than male. He desperately wants to win the the national portrait prize.

Josiah has a kind heart, we think, although usually he requires something like a Babel Fish (please refer to The Hitchhikers Guide to the Galaxy - it’s a book, Josiah) to understand even reasonably basic interpretations of just about everything. But forget all that. Hand him a soccer ball and tell him to go outside - that solves most problems later on.

We're scratching our heads up here in commentary box, trying to remember if anyone has ever seen Joss with anything other than a giant smile on his face. Anyone?...No? Oh well, there you have it. Joss is officially in the Top 20 happiest people in the Kingdom. But that doesn't make him a push-over. I wouldn't assume that.

Lets’s hope he doesn’t have a religious family for if that’s the case, if they can’t find him he’ll probably be in rehab, again. If not…..actually, do you know what?….let’s just find out if his dad is a rabbi then take it from there. Good luck.
Soft-natured like a placid pony.

Judd spends hours trying to make his hair look as if he's just woken up after having slept on the beach, and having surfed all day before that. Question: Judd, do you surf and do you sleep on the beach? No? Well come on, let's get serious. You're a nice fellow so ditch all this hair-crap and figure out what it is that's really important to you. THAT'S the key!

Jude is a mellow and sufficiently suave individual but he wouldn’t be seen dead drinking at the pub that his identical sister (Jude) works at, which is a pity. Having said that, if he did, and he got into a fight, she’d be able to defend him better than he would.
Judsen toes the line.
A sinewy little fucker who gets pissed and takes his pants off.

No, Juilian has never made a batch of concrete in his life but that's not his gig. He's into numbers and the stats, he likes his shoes to be shiny and he is very adept at tying his tie quickly. Number of hair product items in his bathroom: 12.
Maybe his dad wanted him to be the playboy that he never was, who knows? Juke is a working man of simple needs, and who usually walks in the door a filthy mess. Big smile. Foul temper.
Friendly. Confident. Playful. Relaxed. Blah blah blah...but he’s weird when he’s pissed because he can’t handle his alcohol.
Julian plays an instrument and he’s okay without setting the world on fire. What he is skilled at, however, is placating angry people and thinking with a political mind.

(First onto the life raft.) Like a thoroughbred horse that's almost impossible for the jockey to keep under control, Julius's ego threatens to tear off and take over. But do you know, young Julius isn't that naïve. We do hope he's called Jules occasionally, just to keep him grounded, otherwise he'll be poured into the clichéd path of designer sunnies and $400 jeans. Neither are any good for the planet, but it seems Julius turns out to be more thoughtful than that. Sure, there's a 70% that his wife might be described as a trophy, but he deals with business thinking and underlings in an astute manner. Someone has to run the company.
The alcoholic stoner who is as irrepressible as he is funny. (And, yes, he shears sheep.)

No energy to waste here. None. So don’t waste his time with half-measures and a lazy intent. Even his sense of humour is dry, at best. It might be the Polish blood in him, who knows, but his ancestors grew up in freezing winters and they therefore learned not to fuck about, and this genetic memory runs through Jurek big time.
Blonde. Does he have Northern European heritage? Probably. It makes him honest and direct, and he takes his time when he believes success is inevitable.

Jusstin, Management took an oath never to say this to anyone – after all, we each have a niche to fill and who is to say one name is any better than another - but in your case we are going to make an exception. Why the double S? Like one S isn't dodgy enough. But, on the flip side, we see that you are actually quite a chilled-out man who takes life's hits on the chin and who moves on quickly. Indeed, fuck it, don’t listen to us. Keep doing what you’re doing and let us know how you go.
Yours sincerely
Management.
‘Justin’ is what happens to a bowl of cereal if you leave it to take an extended phone call. Soggy, dull and aesthetically horrific, afterwards, to finish the meal is tantamount to culinary suicide.
I know, you've got one less Z than your mate, just below you. Juzo, but fear not. Head on down to Juzzo and he'll show what's going on. Oh, and by the way, welcome to the LIGHT!

Thank God! A Justin has made it out of the swamp and landed in a hammock, next to which is a table holding a bottle of beer, wine or sparkling mineral water (whatever takes your fancy, really), it's in the shade, it's near the beach, and woah, hang on! There's someone in the hammock with you! Well excuse me! I'll leave you in peace Juzzo. Take it easy and well done.  
Love Management.
Jye, my friend, it's not possible for someone to know everything unless you are some kind of God. So, are you? (Actually, don’t answer that.)
See the female Toby.

As a rather idealistic young lad, he always wanted to work with animals. Right now though, he's volunteering at the zoo shovelling a ton of elephant shit. So, keep going brother, you'll get there in the end. Have you thought about university and coming at it from the other end? There's a lot to be said for an education...

Come on, stop lounging around and walking with your shoulders slumped forward! Stand up man! Piss off that video game crap or soon your body will have forgotten what it is to move, and to feel wonderful, physical pain.

Had Kahn been born an American indian and was alive when the white-man was taking over his land and killing his people, he would have had more white-fella scalps hanging from his waist than anyone. And he's got a wicked sense of humour.

Not dissimilar in nature to Rick, Kai has a ton of energy and a mind that won’t easily switch off. He quite literally hasn’t got time for enemies as he’s continually wondering how he can get to that great spot, just over the horizon...
The Shadow.

Kaiden sits there like a rat trap, ready and willing but uncertain of when a rat, or a romantic interest, or a job, or the right travel destination, or the right car might arrive so he can move quickly and snatch it. Nice looking trap though, and he's ready all right. I wouldn't want to get him on a wrong day...

A nice fellow leading a normal, social and productive life. He has friends who like and admire him, although he doesn't often tell them where he's going. In that regard it takes a while for people to catch up with what he's been up to and what his ambitions are. Indeed, Kailan, what are they? You may as well tell us while we've got you here...

Once he gets his orientation right, and we’re not talking about his sexuality, Kainoa will be fine. A regularly-worn neck tie will kill him. This man, whilst not a genius, is a traveller. Even a skateboard will do him good, no matter how old he is.
Did his parents get lost, somewhere? Anyway, Kairo is a nice, placid kind of fellow who solves most problems placed in front of him. Sure, he’s a little timid in bed but, hey, no one is perfect!

An American-Canadian who was born as Karl. He was never that intricate a personality, anyway, but as soon as he rode his first horse it was obvious that the name Carl (or Karl) couldn’t be said smoothly while sitting in the saddle at a gentle canter. And that was that; Kal became Kal and to this day he’s a good and gentle person. Most animal lovers are.

Kalani wants to get moving, even if it’s via a video game he’s obsessed by. No, we can’t say he adores responsibility but it’s not his fault. He’s more of a loner than someone who gravitates people to them naturally, although he doesn’t mind a risky dare. Women are attracted to him not for what he says or does, but more via his general vibe. Does that make sense?

While not a true loner, Kale can and does work very well on his own. Usually, it's only because the tasks he gets involved with take some explaining - Kale is no fool - such that by the time he's finished describing what needs to be done and what you need to look out for, he could have done it himself. Kale.
The classy, educated and well-dressed feral.
Honourable. He’ll blow the whistle if he has to and he’ll wear the consequences, because he knows that someone has to.
The term given to the facial expression of a man who has just been kicked in the nuts.
Like the man himself, his name is calm and energetic with a perfect composition. And that’s Kapani’s secret – it’s all about balance.
A lanky, goofy sort of lad who shirks 97% of his responsibilities. He’s a poor scholar and an outrageous flirt - it’s probably the only aspect of his life in which he isn’t lazy.

In a past life Karl was a Nazi. But that was in a past life. What he hasn't shed (or learnt) yet is that one doesn't have to be organised to the minute all the time. Indeed, sometimes Karl, just close  your eyes and let your heart take you where the universe deems fit.

Karl-Angus is often a little heavy-handed in dealings. Does he think things through fully? Well, we hope so. He's not a violent or aggressive man, don't get that impression, but he's the kind of fellow who would pull out a one wood on the putting green. Economy of movement and words is also important here. If you're going out with one, don't be put-out if he doesn't talk for a day or three, sometimes. He's only worried about the diff on the car, or something physical like that. It's got nothing to do with you.

Karmichael concentrates very well. You should see him in the kitchen. He's quite the cook, truth be known, but, geez, by looking at him you wouldn't necessarily think that he's enjoying himself, which I can assure you he is. Does he have a penchant to follow the recipe to the exact last letter? Maybe that's his problem?

Staunch. Committed. Kase can take a lot of abuse before he cracks, and if you mess with his system, his set-up or try to mess with his head in some way as a prank then you can expect to cop the consequences.
"Superannuation??...Do you mean, I have to put money away for when I'm 80! Are you serious? That's not fair!"
Kayd feels fine so long as his clothes aren't too clean. Or too ironed for that matter. And he detests being fussed over.
A capable lad who generally doesn’t wait for life to come to him. Like Jim, however, complex issues may occasionally prove to be extremely problematic.

Was Kazaria born way out, no where city lights? Okay, good. In this instance Kazaria is one of the few men who quite literally cannot deal with the city. Give him dust, give him flood, give him animals and land to work with, just don't give him hustle and bustle. The only buildings Kazaria is happy to be near that are greater than two stories high are the following: there's a pub 400 miles that way, and there are two wheat silos 350 miles that way. 

Beyond that, give him raw blue sky and stars. 

Now, was he born in the city? Alright, just get him out of there. Surrounded by the human maelstrom his inner sensitivities will override his better judgement and he'll wind up with a substance abuse problem. (Not that this is the end of the world, but he's just better off away from all that human traffic.)

...if only K.C was able to write a story of his life and his pleasures. He has enjoyed the wild and wicked delights of the orient and beyond, and everyday he wakes up, looks about, and roars with the notion that his master may very well make him famous, today. K.C is the name of Kevin’s Cock and I will tell you, ladies and gentlemen, gentlemen especially, that K.C wants to be your friend.

K-Dog cannot sit still.
K-Dog is sad he can’t lick his own balls. (Guy is his idol).
K-Dog doesn’t mind sleeping outside, so long as there’s plenty of beer nearby.
K-Dog is his name, K-Dog is his nature.
Amen.
Keanu functions like a river, quietly going about his business and nourishing all those who take the time.

Shrinks tell us that all of us suffer from autism in some form or other. Keaton's is exhibited in a rather strange way. He is one of the few people in the Kingdom who will play practical jokes on himself. Because he has a shocking memory and a need for constant surprises he'll often set up some kind of reasonably harmless booby trap that he knows he'll forget about. Then, three months later, when he's opening some unused cupboard or reaching under some car seat, BANG, he'll cop it. Alternately, someone else will cop the ruse and he'll laugh just as much.

Is he from a freezing clime? Maybe, but he tends to perform better in the cold. Indeed, like Heather he may even subconsciously sabotage perfectly healthy or normal situations in order to make something worth overcoming. Know what I mean?
Is he a keen man? Probably. He’s also ostensibly conservative and pragmatic.

Like the teak deck of a yacht which is in the water and prepared to put to sea, Kehl is ready. He’s been sanded and varnished several times and he’s therefore not prone to sitting around anymore. He’s streamlined and excited about what life will throw at him, big seas or small. You’ll never see Kehl in some shed out the back for years, awaiting glory. Kehl has his game face on, in conjunction with a sense of humour – don’t worry about that – and he wants to live. Starting now.

So, you up for it?...
A terse-looking man and Chief Negotiator.

Keith's greatest pleasure in life is the 20 yard walk to the 'out house' that's made of old corrugated iron, for his morning constitutional. And when he gets there he relaxes in his own company while the kids, grandkids, great grandkids and others babble and yell and carry-on inside the house, which right now is a million miles away. Praise the Lord.

Very similar to guys like Parish, Kenny and even a proactive Graeme, Kellan seems to get a lot done without anyone ever actually seeing him do anything. It's quite a skill, I suppose. He has plenty of friends and he is a socially active individual, but as I say, no one ever witnesses the deeds which provide the rest of us with an assurance he is living his life actively, which he obviously is.

Kellen is the opposite of a bower bird. Bower birds, you see, collect all manner of pointless bits of plastic and coloured chunks of metal and feathers and bones and stones and god-knows-what else for the sole purpose of attracting a mate. The notion of a human Kellen cluttering his life/bedroom/car/anything is enough to give him palpitations. However, if he’s a suit-wearing fellow, and 90% of Kellens are, then he is likely to arrange his ties in a spectacularly ordered fashion based on their colour gradation…..so, mmmm, maybe he is a bit of a secretive little bower bird after all?

No, it’s not Callum, it’s Kellum, and do you reckon he doesn’t get that thrown at him every other day? The result is a forgiving fellow - usually - who doesn’t take the bull by the horns as often as he should. In his younger years he’s a little lost but he’ll grow out of it.

Kelly is a quick-witted and nimble, and his balance has to be seen to be believed. 
(Note: if he's old and a drinker, then, like all Kellys, he'll do it to the best of his ability, in which case he might sport a fantastically massive gut that he acquired via years of fully-fledged over indulgence. It’ll probably kill him in the end and that’s okay by him – he’ll tell you that something has to.)

Congenial and good-natured, Kelsey doesn't rush into things. He tends to let life come at him and in doing so he seems to have more time than most. Not prone to digging trenches, either for the plumbing or the military, Kelsey will delegate and gently coerce where he sees fit. He's educated, or at least he looks like he is, and he isn't a brawler.

As an independent operator, Kelso can truck it, he can track it and he can steal it without anyone knowing he was even there. But not if it means hurting or harming an innocent person because the man has morals.
At parties he kind of stands back from the crowd, sort of melding with the shadows. If you can be bothered talking to him it's worth it, though.
Kelvin wears a mullet hairdo, a huge moustache and at a large and hairy 52 years of age believes he’s a sex God. And perhaps he is...
He waited a long time for the new gay marriage laws to come into act and, this week, after years together, he's going to propose to his beloved.
Ken rhymes with Brick.

Can I? You sure can. But you better hurry 'cause he knows what he's doing and he won't take long. He'll see you at the next pit-stop, okay? Make sure you bring water, it's hot out here and he runs fast and straight. Kenai.
Kendall sneaks up on success and glory like a hunter quietly stalking his quarry, although he's never that obsessed that he won't duck down the street for a cup of coffee with his friends if asked.

Kenneth is the name of the face that every man pulls when he shaves the most difficult part of skin on his face – often it’s that bit just underneath the nostrils – and the more ridiculous the Kenneth, the easier it is to get to. There’s a trade off in all that we do, after all.

Kenny is more lively than his older cousin (Ken) but...what does he do with his time? He always seems to be cruising around but, does he have a job? Where does he go on the weekend? Has he got a girlfriend? Does he have any responsibilities, at all??....Anyone?

As a distant relative of Evan, Kent can keep you awake for hours. Kent….Kent…..Kent, drips the leaking tap. If you don't get up and do something about it you'll get no sleep at all. Nice guy though, and tremendously experimental in bed and with (the vary rare) wedding proposals.

Now here is a man who dots his I's and crosses his T's. His name looks and sounds like a newly filleted fish frame that's just been tossed to the waiting pelicans. (And you can't fish miles from shore on a 20 knot-day without knowing what the hell you're doing, and without having all your safety gear.) But, he knows how to let his hair down as well so don't presume he can’t or doesn't. As an adult, Kentan has a plethora of male friends and his fair share of doting ladies in his wake. Most important, just remember that mediocrity, ladies and gentlemen, is none of his business.
If Kenton ever farted publicly there's a good chance he'd be so embarrassed that he'd emigrate.
A Japanese tiger. A sexual Buddha. And get this, he’s a postman.
Despite a flailing mass of arms, legs and elbows, Keppler is an honest performer who does a good job.
A humorous and generous philosopher, no matter what he's doing.  He's definitely never stern, put it that way.
Owns an insurance company.

Far more capable than his female namesake, Kerry is self assured, energetic and well suited to positions of power and influence, although he never sees it like that – he’s just having a good time and not wasting any while he’s at it.
Kinda’ lazy yet kinda’ busy. Maybe he’s just tired? Kes is a good fellow who does the right thing 96% of the time.

Clean and purposeful, Ketch is excellent in his own company but that’s not to say he’s a loner. His peaceful attitude makes him very tough to be angry around and the ladies appear to be attracted to him without him really needing to say or do anything.
The Natural. This man’s man can cope with the seventy eight staff that work for him like he can cope with going to bed when he’s knackered, no worries.
An enthusiastic dunce and the name of any tourist who pulls his shorts up around his armpits and tucks his socks into his sandals.

Has Kewan ever rushed anything in his life? We don't think so. Thing is though, he's always on time, he never dresses like an unmade bed and his personal grooming regime is above average - as is his intelligence, as a matter of fact. Mmm, yes, Kewan is quite an interesting dude. He's not a plasterer.

(Pron. Shar-loo-vaar) You can’t say his name without a mouthful of marbles but he is a relaxed and friendly customer, as are most expat Norwegians. And the complexity of his name in this English-speaking land gives him great scope to become something out of the ordinary.
Khobi can't seem to eat without getting his food scattered everywhere, even at 18 years of age. His drives his poor mother insane.
Kiah will never suffer from arthritis and is currently enrolled in the performing arts.

Indeed he is a keel of sorts. A pillar for his family and his local community, Kiel rarely puts himself first. His only failing if he has one is that he can be very stubborn, which, when you think about, is most of the reason he makes a good pillar in the first place.

Indeed, Kier is like a pier. A very long pier that juts out into the bay. Yes, it's true, not many boats pull up to him anymore - there's a larger, newer jetty just up the coast made of steel and concrete. But I hear a rumour that a sailing ship is coming to town and they don't want to moor next to something new. They want to be tied-up to a structure that loves tradition and that can't be walked on with bare feet. Kier is made of old splintering wood, remember.

Kieran is a genial fellow who moves easily through the world and without much fanfare, and he possesses an unusual amount of pluck because he understands the benefits of dedicated application. He might even be pretty good with a guitar.

His name falls out of your mouth without any effort whatsoever, and the two 'e's help, but here's a question:

Kieren, my lad, are you a little lazy? Do you just cruise along without putting in much effort? Would you say the world in existence for you and you alone? It's not often that we suggest this, up here in the commentary box, but a little later on, not today, you might be well-served by entering into fatherhood. 

I know....crazy eh? The fact is that you've tons of energy, you're not a twit and you need something to keep you guessing. Let us know how you go....Management.

His back is too straight when he runs. Sure, it's great that he's trying to produce a perfect technique but we're all different, and we all move differently. When is he going to close his eyes and give himself to the rhythm of what's going through him? Kieron, some advice from up here in the box: Throw out all your text books and listen to your inner-self for a while. You can always come back to the books/accounts ledger/meetings list/technical issues later.

No, Killian isn't cautious, he just takes his time. In fact he's extremely laid back in general and his sense of humour is a dominant force in his life. He seems to sport very few issues and he is a great comfort to those who do. Possibly not CEO material, but you never can tell, and he's not going to labour all day in a sweltering concrete pit, either.
Deceptively lively. Kim doesn’t often show his emotions and he scowls a lot of the time in an attempt to convince the world that he is, in fact, a man and he’s a staunch realist as a result.

The cat in a human body. Know them and you’ll know Kimbo.  (Note: He’s the sort of fellow that buys $20,000 worth of shares in a few companies listed on the stock exchange, and then promptly forgets what price he bought them at.)
See Jester.

Kinglsey rides a gallant steed on his expansive estate, thinking that the American military satellites are watching his every move. Good luck Kingsley. (And in case you're interested just remember that young Kinglsey enjoys getting nude at the drop of a hat.)

The fox-hunt bugle sounds loudly. Can you hear it?
“...Brrr Brrr Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!! Brrr Brrr Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!”
Woah, here he comes! Yep, it's Kingston! Stark bollock naked, apart from that bloody hat, of course, tearing off down the street, scaring and scarring grannies for life.
“....Brrr, Brrr, Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!”
And there he goes, off into the distance, a huge smile on his face and with the cops in hot pursuit. God love him.
Kinton would make a splendid botanist or entomologist, only because he’s a stickler for categorising things about which he has a genuine passion for. He has sex with the lights off.

“The past is the past, and if you deal with each moment well then why worry about anything?” 
Indeed. 
Kip.
Butter fingers.
Kippo manages to bring out the animal in all the 'good' girls. We don't quite understand it either.

“Yeah, yeah, we’ve heard  how tough it was for your parents about a million times, Kipros. We know they’re proud of you, and we know you’ve turned out well, okay? So shut up and let us get on with it. You’re not only the wonderful person in this room…..And don’t look so hurt.”
Kirby is as useful, artistic and inspiring as a single cucumber sitting on a clean white plate. He is therefore quite unique.
Kirk is openly defiant and heroic in situations where a public wrong has occurred.

Kit would make a splendid medical doctor. Why? Because he’s smart, he’s optimistic, he loves people, he’s humorous in a very subtle way and he is experimental. 
And yes, he loves donning a surgeon’s mask, purely for the theatre of it, pardon the pun.
Klaw continually itches for a good time.
A male version of the female Eboni.

Just like Cyril, actually, Klyde has never heard of the internet, because he spends every waking moment, come rain, hail or shine, up to his navel in water. Is he the world's most devout trout fisherman? …….Maybe.
