Where is Knobby? Well, he's here, he's there, at least, he was a minute ago. Where is that cheeky little bastard? Christ, he just handed me a drink and now he's gone again! He's making the coach turn grey.
Knobsy lives for drinks with the boys. And he's a popular man.
Another lad who partied until the third dawn, at which point the cops showed up bearing guns, handcuffs and paddy wagons. Last we heard he was in law school, which is kind of ironic.

How does he do it, this fellow? He wanders around, kind of looking up at the stars, jogging and sort of bumbling his way through life. Many people, even many of his family members who think they know him, consider Koa to be a little lazy, or a tiny bit shy. Maybe abit of both, and sometimes either of those qualities can lead to the other, but what they don't know is that Koa has two rather wonderful aces up his sleeve.

One, he has a really good heart and, two, he his lucky.

And again, one inexorably leads to the other.
Amen to that.
Should have been one of the big cats because you can barely hear his feet touch the ground. Oh, hang on. Is he asleep?

As a mild-mannered modern man, Koben is probably better off staying away from the armed forces although he makes a better soldier than a General. As a normal, slightly-shy fellow, he's more secretive than his peers and we look forward to hearing about his greater ambitions.

Koben? Any thoughts?...

Kobi marches where he's told to march, and that's fine. What he should do, before the battalion is called out, especially, is pack his gear one night and go AWOL. Get out into the world captain and have a look around, then you can think about who you want to follow and why.

Kobus is happiest when he’s able to break down a situation into calculable portions where there are definitive, observable actions and reactions. He’s another fellow who’d make a good air traffic controller, but he may be too analytical for a soppy love affair. Then again, maybe that’s exactly what he needs?…
A cross between Walshy and Jacko, Kochie is a flamboyant shit-stirrer who loves donning his wife's knickers when he's drunk, at which point he uses a shoe as a pretend microphone while he sings.

Kody approaches life in a piecemeal fashion almost accidentally. As we keep saying up here in the commentary box, we all have a niche to fill and not everyone can just blaze in and leap at the first chance, grasp it between their teeth and rejoice in their victory…but then again, Kody, why not?
Kohl is ready. What job would you like him to do? He'll do it without fear nor favour and you can expect the job to be done on time and with discretion.
A brand of fake Louis Vuitton travel bags.
One of the Gifted Ones. True artistry, in any way, shape or form drips from his fingertips.
The Toast Burner.

“Life is all here in this moment,” is what he’ll tell you. “Fuck the past. Fuck the future. Do you understand me?” 
He’s infuriating after a while, true enough, but what do you do?
Hungarian. Shy, wild and wise, Kovak is an incredible guitarist. When he plays, it sings of love and therefore forgiveness.

Kris spends a lot of time down there in the basement, on his own. I shudder to think what the hell he's doing down there - inventing something, I hope, and not masturbating in the nude for days. You just never know. He does do obsession very well, however.

Big shoes to fill there, hoss. No one is God or the Buddha, but you ARE gentle and serene, so who knows? Are you a vegan, or is that just too cliched? You definitely don't work as a trader at the stock exchange, put it that way. Maybe you're an expert in the Kama Sutra? Our best hope?....You are the friendly fellow at the local organic fruit 'n veg shop who knows, and is delighted to see, everyone.

Kristan is a piston. He pumps it, he works it, and he rarely sits idle, mostly due to the fact that he's on the run from a very feminine name. But, a fine fellow he is, and he works hard and conscientiously.
Kristian is heterosexual, probably, and yet he owns and runs a shop that sells bras and lingerie for women. Shaves his arm hair. Very odd.

Have a look at him will you? He's in more strife (debt) than the early settlers but there he is, dressed in a nice (borrowed) suit, a glass of (stolen) champagne in hand, talking to that pretty lady over there in the corner. Right about now he’s telling her about his legend status. Unbelievable…
Has dread-locks that are four feet long and seven years old. He sells African drums at a fair market.
Come on, boy! It's time to FACE THY DEMONS!!

A long time back, Kuba made a very rare decision: rather than procure a tattoo or 30, which he may have done anyway, he decided to get an American basketball singlet actually sewn onto him, because that's all he seems to wear, anywhere. (Tell me he's altered that, someone, please....)
A young man with an Asian heritage. Young or old, Kung Fu is a funny, intelligent guy and far more proactive than those who gave him his nickname.
The Leopard.
Kurtis is no fool and also goes by the alias of, The Skunk!

Sitting at an outdoor table with nothing on but a pair of faded work pants and a smoking fag in his hand, Kurty will only listen to a discussion about what to do if you see a snake within 10 kilometres of the homestead for so long, before he tilts his head back, blows smoke into the air and barks, “Don’t be stupid. Just get the fucken shotgun and shoot it.”
Discussion over.
Kuyan is lost in dreamland. When he returns can you ask him to go and report to the career counsellor please? We've got some ideas he might like...

Ky is a young and energetic man at heart who operates inside the bare balls of a situation, which enables him to concentrate on the target. Something like peer group pressure barely registers with him at all.

Perhaps Kya needs to start a rebellion? Obeying orders is fine for a while, but not forever. Sooner or later you must find your own feet underneath your own heart. Sir Kya. Ditch the group. Get out on your own. You've got what it takes and you've got the nous. Don't let other opinions blind you. Most of them are on some bullshit, power-fix anyway.
His deeds of bravery are largely misread. Yes, he's lazy and keeps a messy space, but he'd take a bullet for the team if need be. He's quite single-minded, like that.
His mood is generally smooth and kind of hidden, and you'd never know if he was lustful or angry, or anything really. Kylar is a thinker and it'll take a while to get in passed the defence maze...

Kyle' is what you shout out after you cut yourself in the kitchen with a serrated knife. Good luck! But being maximally tenacious and successful points to a few important facts: 
1. He's extremely bright.
2. Poor impressions of his behaviour or demeanor are water off a duck's back. 
3. If society falls apart via some kind of catastrophe then be rest assured Kyle will not capitulate with the first wave.  
Kyle.

No, he's not really a stand-up comedian, although he does like to laugh, even though it presents as more of a thoughtful chuckle. Outlandish and roguish behaviour are rarely attributed to him, but he is a deep thinking man who has the capacity to solve intricate problems. He makes a patient biologist and an excellent card player, mostly because he has one of the best poker faces in the Kingdom. That and the fact he can sit in one position for hours with little or no discomfort.

Kymani is a man of the earth or the water. Yep, he looks fine and healthy because he is. He hasn’t much of a clue about how to hook up a new printer, build a LinkedIn profile or foster a compelling work ethic within an organisation. He grows herbs, he might even smoke some of them, he doesn't appreciate hyperactivity and he loves it when thunder busts in on a hot afternoon.
Kynah doesn't give in to propoganda. You can tell him whatever you like but unless he is certain of your standing, you can expect him to go and check out the facts for himself.

Good at maths (and academia in general) Kynan's friends have no idea how much brighter than them he really is. Early on he's a shy man, this Ky-nan, but he'll find his feet and get comfy in his skin, don't you worry. A wee snippet of advice chief: Don't head to trade school just because you're tired of regimented classes. Give yourself some time to evolve, and to make a base for a greater range of outcomes later. You can work with your hands at home any time, if you're that keen. Just don't give up on your creative brain because you're allowed to be amazing. Indeed, the universe encourages it. Good luck.

Here’s a nice little anecdote about how Kyran’s brain works. Say he was driving on the highway at 100km/hr and a front wheel suddenly detached. In that crucial nano-second prior to potential catastrophe, rather than panic, he would grasp the steering wheel hard and actually smile at what absurd, comical situation was about to play out. Kyran is very inquisitive, don’t forget, and what better moment to be utterly fascinated by than your possible imminent death?

I wonder if Kyran and Kyron are related? Anyway, with a name that sounds like some kind of traffic violation, it makes sense then that Kyron loses his driver's licence every three years. He hasn’t killed anyone yet so that’s a bonus and so long as he doesn't kill himself in the meantime we’ll be happy. So, Kyron, do up your seat belt and get your arse to a good driving school. Maybe you should race?

Option A: Named after a heavy metal band, and what does that mean? Yep - he's destined for a life in the clergy. 

Option B: The name of an Alsatian who is very well trained by quite an anal owner.
Not a nasty bone in his body does this man possess, and he's more powerful than he has any idea about. He might even be the Western World's answer to the Buddha, true story…
Well educated and healthy, Lachlan is a polite man who never does wrong by others.

Lachy has plenty of friends – both female and male – he never gets morbidly depressed, which means he’s a great remedy for those who are, and he does well in any outdoor life where there is plenty of sun-on-skin.

Laidlaw is the kind of fellow who divvies out splendid advice because he has quite the gift at assessing the bigger picture, although he is useless at transferring this insight to his own life. Why is that Laidlaw? No one is sure, but as we keep saying up here in the commentary box, each of us is perfect within the bounds of our own imperfections. Laidlaw knows this too, which is why he's pretty relaxed. His ego is just fine.

Laighton is an active man with an active imagination. He may not own one, but he'd love a jet-ski, maybe even a snow-mobile. He'd settle for a horse but he finds them deeply unsettling. While he can't enunciate his feelings on this, we can: 

If you can't put petrol in it, Laighton wont get on it.

And fair enough too. I suppose it points to the fact that it takes a while for Laighton to trust individuals (and horses) but he'll get there. Especially once he figures out what he really wants from his life.

A modern man who, so far, has avoided any serious hardship or test in his life. That will come in time, as it must for all of us eventually, and in the meantime he learns quickly from mistakes and rarely bears a grudge.
Laikin tends to hold it together and he doesn't leak much, be it money, drunk secrets or career opportunities that are worth following up.
Hand. On. Cock.
The arrogant and rather slow-moving (lazy) Goose.

Sheep’s little brother who has travelled more, is more outgoing and is generally funnier than not only his brother, but just about anyone else in the room. Lamb is young at heart and we suspect he will ever be thus, amen.

Lambros is the kind of fellow who inherits millions of dollars and quite quickly blows the lot in having a grand old time, and doing little for either the planet or those in need. That’s not to say he isn’t fun to be around, he absolutely is, but in a crisis situation it might pay to give the keys to someone else.
The Jack Russell that thinks he’s a rhinoceros. He expects women to fall at his feet, which they occasionally do, and he has a very mediocre I.Q.
Clark Kent minus the superpowers.
A text-book smart arse and sarcastic prick. How he manages to keep all these friends is beyond all of us, up here watching.
Otherwise known as Languid Larry.

Sure, his demeanour is occasionally quite serious and austere, but not once you get to know him. He speaks his mind, which, while confronting for many, only gets things done faster and eradicates those mistakes which stem from hesitation and procrastination, and if he does make a mistake he'll be quick to admit to it. When he plays tennis he likes to wear an all-white outfit.
The stern-looking astronomer. (He's actually just contemplating the latest x-ray spectrum.)

Laslo is wise, he has time and he knows that a poor outcome doesn’t necessarily mean disaster in the long run. Indeed, they often produce the best memories. And he goes out of his way to produce more sexual intrigue in a week than most people contemplate in a year.

A deep sea fisherman?…..not a chance. Lathan wears a suit and deals with marketing plans and product launches. Metaphorically, he’s like one of those pistachio nuts that looks like it will crack open easily, but only succeeds in cracking your tooth.
Picture the God of Neptune in the form of a Solomon Islander chief, enjoying a peaceful snorkel over the front of a pristine coral reef with his two kids following closely behind him. Welcome to Lau.

77% of Laurences have spent so much time being proper that those parts of their brain that hunger for thrills and excitement have completely shut down. What is left is a doleful old soul who quietly shuffles around the house in a subconscious quest for the answer to the question of why life seems so unfulfilling. (Laurence, if this is you, break some laws. Just for the hell of it and for a bit of chaos in your morning. Who knows? It might be fun?…)

The remaining 23% of Laurences are as kinky as hell, and will happily go for a walk into town with a butt plug firmly implanted, for no other reason than to smile and talk to strangers. 

Both are doing their job in the world.
That big bloke.
Subtle. Lawrence conducts the London Philharmonic Orchestra and when he’s not skiing with the family in Switzerland, he enjoys being whipped by a dominatrix in a Danish dungeon.

If a pack of irrational idiots ever corner you and decide to try and beat you up on the street somewhere, then Lawrie is a good man to step from out of the shadows and help out. The idiots, I suspect, would live to greatly regret it.
A tall man who stands very straight. He keeps a neat study and gets angry if his highly disciplined children become too rowdy.

He's a kinky fucker all right. Layton would pay a lot of money to be able to travel back in time to New York in the 1970s and party in some of those clubs that became world famous. And yes, these days he spends a couple of months on the island of Ibiza, Spain. Layton.
This Serbian is quick to pull the trigger.

There are a few of them out there in the Kingdom and here we have another one, although you should probably know that he is the best, whatever you think you know about the industry or your own psychology. He'll find a way to make you believe what he's saying, irrespective. Possible occupations: Used car salesman/arms dealer/politician/speech writer...you get the gist.

Never impolite and never a softy, Lea presents to the world in the same way as a well-prepared Christmas fruit cake. He is complex, yet he is also simple in his stance and he is never quite what you expect. He never rushes yet he loves an impromptu gathering. He makes no apologies and rarely seeks adulation. He is thoughtful and he is humorous. He is friendly and he is intelligent. And yes, Lea is an unusual name for a man and why not.
Lee is a straight-up bloke, but he might be a little bit impatient, or something, and there is a 70% chance that he is completely predictable.
Violent and abrasive.

Leif is hard to pin down and in confronting situations, like a cat, he always manages to land on his feet. The only place he wears a tie is at weddings and his point of view is usually unexpected and accurate. He’s not as flakey as we were led to believe.

Stubborn, he may be, but he’s definitely more experimental than one might imagine. If he starts a project he won't be distracted until it’s finished, and he is far more intelligent than those around him. And if he’s a kinky little fucker then you’d have no idea.
See Leyton.

Union heavyweight, he is not. Highly educated, he is. Polite at dinner parties, almost always. An appreciator of fine wines, absolutely. Well travelled, you got it. And does he remember when he was wronged and by whom?..... You better believe it. And if you’re the perpetrator then you’ll need eyes in the back of your head for a very long time.

Lemisio lives in the US of A. He's fit, he dresses in brightly coloured body-hugging outfits, he has a big smile on his face and he is extremely skilled at tossing small girls into the air (and catching them) at American football games to the tune of a big brass band playing in front of him. Yes, he's a male cheerleader, and he's good.
Len is a chainsaw in need of a decent service. He runs okay and cuts what he needs to cut, but he's beyond the point of being discrete about anything.
Watchmaker. Steady hands.
Big. Smart. Unpredictable.
Leo has aspired to be a porn star since he could walk. Indeed, he’s so enamoured with his own persona that he sometimes makes pornos on his own.

Okay, so yes, once upon a time we described Leon as one of the great apes, who lived in the jungle, loved bananas and was completely illiterate, but we think it’s time to fess up. Leon has a sense of humour, you bet, but he’s way more interesting and invigorating than some kind of kinky gibbon. Leon is into life and unusual life paths, and we are delighted to see him playing tonight. (Word on the street is that he’s been training hard in the pre-season, which, now that we think about it, isn’t surprising at all. He’s quite determined when he sets his sights on something.)
Camilla’s betrothed. He’s bigger than she is but they smell the same. Ain’t love grand?
A criminal. He stuffs socks down his jocks to try and make his cock look bigger. He’s a funny guy, though, regardless that he spends a lot of time trying to talk to girls from side on.
If ever Les feels tired and lacks the time or desire for a nap, he will stand and face the nearest wall before head-butting a hole in it. That wakes him up, no worries.

Leslie is a thoughtful man who, if not well passed middle age, is knee-deep in it. Mild-mannered and inoffensive, he has read more books than exist in a small library and our only real concern is that there aren’t many other Leslies left in the wild. If you meet one you should alert the nearest national museum – although there is a slim chance that he may actually work there, already.
“....Alright,” you smirk. “What’s he done this time?”
Levi has lots of friends, a big mouth and he's a smart arse when he wants to be. Yes, he’s been in the odd fist fight and he takes all of this in his stride.
A smart and occasionally intense young man who often seems preoccupied.
He could be anything on the surface – an ogre or a gentleman – but at his core he is a slippery shit-stirrer who loves a good time.
See the female Lexy, although you couldn’t really say that the male one is all that beautiful – quite the opposite, actually – and not that he’d give a shit, anyway.

Leyton is lucid and contained like an Olympic swimming pool, except that the lanes must be clearly marked, and it would be appreciated if the chemicals in the water react with urine to produce a colour so that the offender can be detected and ejected as quickly as possible.
Liam is a feisty little bastard that has no compunction in jobbing a man in the face who is twice his size. Sometimes he does it just for the fun of the ensuing brawl.
Why do I get the feeling that I'm about to walk into the National Museum stark bollock naked? (Although, he is first cousins with a man called Vernon.)
A nice bloke but a bit sleazy, or lazy or something.

Linden slots well into any hierarchal system of work and/or governance and is never destined to slog it out on the factory floor. Thoughtful and honest, he rarely lies although he’s a little predictable in bed…..or is he??

Isn’t it strange that ‘Lindsay’ on a woman is quite masculine, yet on a man it’s quite feminine? Anyway, the male version hardly ever panics and this grace under pressure allows him to remain quite methodical amid the turmoil. Such is life and such is Lindsay.
A little arrogant. A little impassive.
A genteel fellow. Quiet of speech, he takes great pleasure in sipping at a nice hot cup of camomile tea.
Lionel prefers cold toast in the morning, sherry of an evening, and he takes a long time to do anything. But, seriously, what’s the rush?
Si, Italiano. Which makes him musical and a good cook and an outrageous flirt, but he struggles with stiff competition. It's not that he likes the easy way out, it's just that he's used to cruising.
The Historian.
Educated, gentle, humorous, inquisitive and insightful. In fact.......no, you know what?...That says it all. Thanks Liv.

Listen, Livinio, sometimes there are no shortcuts. Sometimes you just have to roll your sleeves up, accept that the rewards are going to be hard-fought and hard-earned and just dig in for the hard slog. In case you haven't worked it out it's never not worth it. As we keep saying up here in the commentary box, life's lessons rarely arrive at the anticipated finish line.

"Here comes the ball now and look, in his usual casual style, LJ swoops down and grabs it, balks effortlessly around two opponents and hands off to a team mate running past. As usual, he made that move look easy. No, he's not the fastest in the team but his natural awareness allows him to assess his surroundings, which means he's rarely caught. Indeed, he rarely looks stressed about anything and he sleeps a hell of a lot, so they say…”

His parents would love him to finish law school and do the family proud, but he’s about sick and tired of the pre-programmed bullshit. From here on is anyone’s guess because now that he’s out of the ‘cage’ anything is possible. Last I heard he was talking about hitchhiking nude across America. Did that ever happen?…

Lloyd speaks very correctly, collects Jaguar motorcars and wears v-neck jumpers above long sleeve shirts. Unfortunately his permanent ad in the ‘Personal’ section of the local newspaper seems to go unnoticed, but he hasn’t lost faith that a very nice Mrs.Lloyd is out there, somewhere. Good luck, lad.
The Shape Shifter….

Super chilled-out and relaxed, I don’t think so. Lochaden likes to set goals and achieve them, he enjoys positions of power and influence, he thinks he has a sense of humour and he checks his share portfolio several times each day.
Fire retardant, and we’re not sure it’s legal to have a functioning office without at least of few of them placed strategically around each floor.
Logan has very long eye lashes that makes every woman say yes to him (but, will this affection make him lazy and overconfident?....)
His name is actually Gaelic for Louis, and it rumbles passed you like a giant ocean swell as you say it, which makes sense. Loic is the King of the Seas.

Loki should go and live in a polygamous community because he gets divorced and re-married to someone new every three years. So what's that now, 9 marriages, is it? Loki isn't really one for working through problems. If it doesn't work and you can't fix it in the first hour, get rid of it: this is Loki's mantra. He consequently pays a lot of money in alimony although his kids love him still, and that's what really matters. He's quite a laid-back fellow.

Have his parents ever visited there? In winter, especially? Fuck knows. Anyway, the fact is that London is a pretty normal sort of a dude. He’s not a slick corporate fellow and he’s probably more suited to a job that gets him outside, if only for the fact it’ll keep a lid on his ego and provide him with a wholesome sense of what’s important.
Nice guy with a wonky eye.

He's never heard of a thing called road rage and he always gives people the space to figure out what they want. He's never attempted a practical joke on anyone or any group, although he'd be great at it only because he's the last person anyone would suspect.
Lorenzo is a happy guy, usually, who is currently serving a three-year sentence for fraud.

People expect him to be a natural leader but this isn't really the case. It's hard work that Lorne struggles with, and how can you be the exalted leader of a company, family or community group when you sleep 10 hours every day? Something has to give. But, Lorne is a happy man who isn't a fool, and it's probably more than we hoped for.
The name of Shirley Temple’s favourite little pink dress.
Borderline megalomaniac.
A middle-aged fellow who loves to dress up in women’s clothes more than any other. If he was born in the late 80’s he’d now be a transsexual.

B-grade actor. A-grade clown. Thankfully he'd be a waste of time in the armed forces. But then again……maybe we should consider him for the marines and arm him with fruit, nuts and chocolates so he could storm the beaches with love?...
Slick with a line and slick with the hair gel, his life begins and ends with the pursuit of beautiful women (if he's into them, that is).

Lowell is the university professor who is hated (feared) by his peers due to his radical but brilliantly implemented and highly effective teaching methods. He dresses like a drunk blind man, his glasses sit oddly on his face and his students simply adore his humour and his insight. And yes, in his undergraduate days he did indeed spend three days alone in the desert in the nude.

Rarely, if ever, contemptible, Loy doesn't hang around with the rabble. His name swirls around quickly and then up into the air, in the same way that you might pour a jug of lukewarm chocolate milk into a mug before guzzling it down as fast as you can. When you finish, you always ask yourself why you don't drink more of the stuff. Indeed, why don't you? Loy tends to leave us feeling this way, and it's a rather pleasant and surprising skill to possess.
About as subtle as a brick, Lozza has a perpetually dirty face that somehow fits his persona of a constantly smiling and hard-working builder.

For such a mysterious cat Luc manages to tie together the various aspects and workings of his life very efficiently. He never panics, at least, he never puts himself in a position of ever needing to, and people admire and often seek out his rather artistic advice. Why he looks more serious than his peers has us scratching our heads up here in the commentary box because underneath he’s quite a happy guy. The only thing we can tell  you for certain about Luc is that he should avoid all military service. He’s just too sensitive to be constantly yelled at and, more than that, he’s very good in his own company.

Luca didn't start to train hard until his team was relegated to the second division. After being quite lazy for a while he has developed into a fantastic player. His team loves him, but he'll always shun the spot-light.

No, you'll never find Lucan at embroidery class. (You can do that anywhere, and so where's the prestige in that?) A French class in Paris, maybe? Perhaps a course on the finer points of early model BMW motorcycle engines, in Germany? (It's why Lucan decided to learn German) Or maybe he'll travel to that famous village in Borneo (famous in entomology circles, that is) to study butterflies. You never can tell. What you can expect, however, is that Lucan, via his own methods and without influence, will find his loves in life and then pursue them in a quiet and dogmatic fashion. And yep, girls love him, mostly because he seems so mysterious.

Ah, Lucas Pukas, good morning. How’s life? So, okay, let’s come clean here. Lucas, the name, does sound like something the dog throws up onto the kitchen floor after too many salt n’ vinegar chips, which isn’t a pretty picture now, is it? But, it’s nice to see you’ve ignored that little nickname. Your school report here in front of me says you’re doing well, actually. It says you’re energetic, if not just a tiny bit shy, and after some consultation, my colleagues and I believe you’ll thrive once you leave school, so keep at it. You’re blessed with tenacity, young man, and our only advice is that, once you’re out in the real world, try not to be too reactive to disagreeable people or situations that you’re confront with, unless things are serious, naturally. Beyond that, you’re a loyal young man and we don’t expect that to change. Good luck!

Normally, Lucca is a placid man with charisma and style. If pushed beyond any level of common decency, however, he might snap and become dangerous. He speaks ill of no one unless they’re in front of him and deserve it, and he rides a big black motorcycle that, like the man himself, is just as potent as it looks.

Lucian travels plenty and appreciates diversity in nearly all aspects of life. Open and friendly, thoughtful as well, he spends almost no time being bored because what is the bloody point of living a life where you’re not inspired by what you’re doing? Well said Lucian.
The deeper the water the happier he is. Especially when it comes to disposing of the bodies of rival gang members.

Stylish and suave is Lucienne’s definitive look and he knows a whole lot more about political history than he does about engines. He might seem a little arrogant, but surely someone has to be otherwise an entire word would cease to exist. Anyway, he’s not really. He’s just playing.
There's a few out there with a similar attitude, and they can’t all be right, but Lucio thinks he’s the best lover on Earth.
Powerful.

The bashful maths genius who rarely hasn’t got a smile on his face. The only times you'll see him frustrated are when he's in his office, knee-deep in some problem or other. He spent so long trying to solve Fermat's Theorem he almost went insane. It might explain why he wears silly hats in public, not that he has much self-awareness anyway, god love him.
The motorcycle mechanic who knows everyone in town.
See Louis, except Luis is even less subtle, if that's possible.
He's out there, man. In summer you'll find him in Mexico swan-diving from the tops of very tall cliffs.

His origins are eastern European and he has far more grunt that his Australian/American/English male namesake (Lucas). Designed to blend into the background, Lukas gets on with things while at the same time completely ignoring anyone who he considers to be remotely idiotic. (Unless, they happen to be female and beautiful.)
Luke exists out there somewhere between a fluke and a stroke of genius. He courts disaster with a grin on his face but he can easily fall into a heap if the wind changes direction.
Oh man, you're likely to find this dude somewhere in the following: in jail; on stage; on a cave dive at 220 metres sucking a Heliox mix. If he's alive let me know, can you? He owes me 1200 bucks.

Far from being as boring as bat shit, Luther plots an intricate course in life and away he goes, out the back door first, usually, enroute to the clothes line and only because he’s a stickler for spotlessly clean underwear, and plenty of it. If travelling for more than a few weeks, other than two dozen pairs of jocks, he’ll ensure he has six empty plastic bags in which to place soiled linen because under no circumstances would he allow the rest of his luggage to be infected.
An organised and happy chap with European parents who is more concerned with the journey than the destination. Like many Euros he’s happiest when naked. He is also an experimental cook and lover.

Lyal is a gentle, educated man. Yes, it’s true that he is basically identical to his twin brother (Lyall) but for some reason known only to the gods, one ‘l’ at the end of his name provides him with a more calming aspect, both internally and externally. We have no idea why this is. Anyway, Lyal makes a fine father, a competent and trusted mediator and a patient and attentive lover.

Lyall uses a heavy breathing technique to remove stress from his body. Sometimes you can see him sitting there at his desk, breathing deeply for hours. I say, Lyall, old boy, why don't you go outside with that computer that's giving you so much grief, get a brick and smash the b-Jesus out of it. Computers are a dime a dozen, these days, and you more than most will benefit from standing on green grass in bare feet.

Yes, like his twin brothers Lyal and Lyall, Lyle is a centred man who thinks about things and who ponders life. He certainly wouldn’t risk all his savings on a hot tip that someone gave him for the stock market, no way.
I wonder if anyone calls him Lyn? Anyway, Lynden is a proper, considerate and well-weighted gentleman. (PS- the thicker the book, the better.)

No, not a salty dog living alone on his yacht, even though he could. Lyndon is thoughtful and wise, and not prone to impulse, but don't think he won't contemplate all or any options when it comes to pleasing his lover. Too right. He's a compassionate man, after all.
Lynn can cope with the best and the worst and he looks for the good in people, but if you want to negotiate an armistice then get him on the team pronto. End of story.

Oddly enough he can't hold a tune to save his life, and he's just about fed up with people asking him if he's in a band. What he does do, and very well I might add, is weld. At the start he did it as a tradesmen, but that wasn't him. These days you can see the spoils of his handiwork at his property. Large, crazy and haunting metal sculptures are everywhere. So, while he doesn't sing, the wind certainly does when it blows through his art.
M is a single standing edifice. He’s soft in the middle but that matters not. For all intent and purposes, M is a classless leader.

Mac is bright, easily bored and not easily forgotten. He's not as lethal business owner, however, and this is probably a blessing. The notion of sacking his employees to save a few bucks would never enter his head.
Nice guy. Zero common sense. And he's not on his own, is he Norman?
See Noelene, although Macca is far less intelligent.
His voice is deeper than Bronwyn’s although she laughs more. Like Caroline, however, Mace never makes the same mistake twice. And yes, Mace is a man.

No, he's no sculptor, that's for sure. He has a sense of humour tucked beneath his rather aloof exterior but it takes a while for it to come to the surface. Macen is definitely his own man and he can't really be badgered into doing anything he doesn't want to do. Having said that, he'll move with the pack so long as the pack aren't complete idiots and while not really a natural leader, he'll step up when he needs to. If you offend him deeply once, then you won't get the chance to do it again.

Mack is too industrious and worldly to become an ambulance driver, but many of his friends rib him about such a possibility, such is the general level of empathy he feels towards friends and strangers alike. He doesn't tolerate corruption of any kind and one day he'll sail across the Pacific Ocean in a yacht he built himself. Not bad eh? Hell, he might even raise his family in such a place.

Sure, he might be a fish scientist but that’s just one part of it. Mackie is full of empathy and love and good humour, just don’t let him smoke the evil weed or drink too much coz’ then he’ll start talking and when his blood is running hot he may not stop the sun is up the following morning. On top of that, he is intensely loyal, he prefers old cars to new and he is often quite secretive about his creative pursuits.

Maclayne is the kind of man who will buy a car from the car lot based purely on how shiny it is. He won't even try turning the thing on. We've no idea how he gets on in the world romantically. We suspect it'd be lot's of fun and bubbles in the first two weeks, followed by torment, screaming and ultimate tragedy during the ensuing three.

Guarded he might be, just a little bit, but it’s a wild ride to get to adulthood. He’s healthy now and looking great - fit and strong too - but actions have reactions and he understands his surrounds faster now than ever before. Once he trusts you you're in. And he's a good friend to have.

Yep, he's a man, a caring an interesting man, and his name is Madava. His name is slow and loping, which is how he walks, and he thinks deeply, ruminating for a long time before he speaks. Rest assured, Madava will never sit in an office working for 'the man'. No sir. Hopefully he ran off with the circus, or with whichever metaphorical artistic  group arrived first. Amen.
Maddaggain, is that a watch on your wrist or a miniature fucking circus. Seriously man, we can see that thing from space. Do you really think it's going to get you laid?

Far from being just ornamental, Maddex is a constantly-moving shit-stirrer who never dies wondering what might have been. So, he’s here, he’s there, and his enthusiasm for life means he’s always welcomed, no matter how brief his stays are.

Maddox is a smart alex, I mean, a smart alec. As a low-level hustler and swindler, he knows all the dodgy blokes down at the smokey end of the bar and he agrees to nothing without settling on a price first. If armageddon happens and humans are reduced to a scrapping, fight-to-the-end state of living, then Maddox will do just fine.

Madisch abhors morose or overtly shy people. If a  situation isn’t to your liking, either fix it or shut up: this is his motto, and rightly so. His life is usually a cavalcade of busyness and laughter, and invigorating ideas. If you have some ongoing issue I’m not sure I’d go to Madisch for a shoulder to cry on, well, unless you’re a pretty girl, but if you’ve a great idea about some new genius start-up company, get him on board for sure. He parties long and hard, and he seems to cope with the hangovers better than most.

You must be happy they didn't call you Angela, eh? As a fellow with a very feminine name, Madison has evolved into quite a forgiving and caring individual. God knows we need more of them. He’ll certainly never be the over-seer of any kind of Eastern European slavery racket, thankfully.
The name of large, flawless diamond sitting patiently and quietly upon a blue velvet pillow.

Why is everyone calling their children the names of American states? Maine, did your mum love Stephen King? Is that it? Anyway, it's made you an occasionally intolerant and bored-looking fellow who doesn't smile enough. Then again, perhaps it's a result of you wishing your parents lived in another country? I'm not sure.
The successful pig farmer.

(Pron. Malakai) Ah, if only his name was spelt like that. If Malachi had his shit together then he’d be amazing – perhaps he is not meant to – but like one or two other prodigal sons within the realm, Malachi is wasteful and he lacks foresight.
A chunk of wood about six feet long that’s lying on the floor. He’s rich in colour, heavy in weight and, how are you Malcolm?

Now Mali, life can be easy and super cruisy, as you know, but the real fun and the great moments of self-discovery occur when you confront those things that scare you. Your task then, young man, is go forth into the world, with or without your large group of friends - preferably without, because some of them are pretty lazy too - find out what those things are and then charge them head on.

(Note: Please retain some common sense in these said adventures and we'll talk about assisting those in need a little bit more, a bit later on.)

Is Mance breezy? Is Mance carefree? These are questions those who have just met him will ask his closer friends and they will answer that, on the surface, yes he is. Like a well-designed shop front, Mance provides the facade to the world which does the job, but there are fingers in pies and schemes afoot in the back rooms, make no mistake. (Not illegal or dangerous schemes by the way. Just smart, speculative ones.)

Manfred wears Ralph Lauren polo shirts with the collar up and a big chunky, silver watch. Does he possess a small, expensive car collection? Perhaps. 
He’s rarely short, he thinks all women always love him and his kids attend a very expensive private schools.
Friendly guy. Aggressive drunk.
Owns greyhounds. Races them too, and only rarely does he give them a bit of special 'racing juice' on the morning of the meet.

Manju has tattoos - who doesn't these days? - and he's into his music big-time. Does he make money out of it? Not quite but he'll get there. He has a large cheesy grin and when he hears a funky beat his head starts moving as separate from his body like a chicken looking for feed.

Manning is only one or two disasters from being wind-swept and weather beaten. What the hell are you talking about, you ask? Well, Manning is a formal man, and formalities by definition, at some point, invite a person to act in a way that isn’t truly natural. I mean, who cares if your dinner partner licks their plate? Who cares what brand shirt your wearing? All this inane concern about nothing takes a toll after a while. It’s just not real, Manning. You want our advice? Throw out all your suits immediately and go visit a nudist camp for a week. You might come back a different, and are more relaxed and splendid individual. 
Amen.
“Don’t tell ‘em I was here and if they ask where you got them, just say Tony found them.”…..Mannix is involved in these kinds of conversations often.
Manny rarely travels 2nd class, and this despite the bad language and the lewd gestures.

Like his namesake beneath the waves Manta moves without seemingly doing anything. He switches jobs and girlfriends without a whisper and always seems to be smiling. Maybe he smokes a lot of pot, we’re not sure, but he doesn't have a career as such, we can tell you that.

"Me Manu, you Jane. You come with me. You come to jungle, now.”
(Jane, et al not happy.)
Sketchy.
The Principal Artist with the Melbourne/Chicago/Geneva Ballet Company.

‘Marcel’ is what happens to a person when they come back from the optometrist with their first pair of new spectacles. Suddenly, you have clarity, you sense things you never sensed before and, most important, you have time. (In person, Marcel therefore never rushes, his deepest thoughts are kept to himself and the most outlandish thing you might see him do is straddle his deep-black 1200cc motorbike and disappear into the night at a staggering speed.)
Message from Management: Marcellinus, you’ve spent too much money on pointless material crap. Do you think you’ll worry about any of it on your death bed? It’s time to do some good…

Marcello has read too many gangster books. He's not a violent man, per se, but he does love the idea of going to a fine dining restaurant with a gun stuffed down the back of his trousers. Question: Marcello, are you okay?
Marcelo annoints his cock with only the finest oils.

Marco lost his virginity when he was 11 and having had that much fun as a youngster he therefore refuses to grow up. Can you blame him? These days he wears tight Speedos and waxes his chest, back, buttocks and testicles.

Marcus is single-minded and cool in a crisis. ‘Who is Marcus?’ many people ask, and there is a simple answer: Marcus is Marcus. (In a past life he was a gay New Yorker and his full name was Marcus Maximus.)
Marek has an innocent grin but forget the facade for he’s nearly always near the middle of whatever shit-storm is going down. He just likes to see what will happen, that’s all.

No, he's not a breed of sheep, he's a bouncing pony with a diamond-encrusted bridle who knows full well that this part of the circus performance is screwed without him. 

Just have a look at that strut!...

Mario is a hyena that lives a pack existence. Regardless that he might be covered in the blood of a recent kill, he’s as funny as hell on a good day and petulant and short tempered on a bad one. This is the life and this is Mario's niche.

Option A:  As a distant relative of the Roman Emperor, Nero, Marius is a predestined leader of men who is skilled at making decisions devoid of emotional involvement. Boring, he may be, but he will tell you that some mild human death and suffering (not to mention plenty of environmental degradation) is a necessary bi-product of any great commercial success.
 
Option B:  Wears hemp clothing. Owns a bead shop.

Option A:  Mark is an organised, modern man. Generally he is well-groomed, has friends and is no dummy, and he has a dedicated need to achieve something. As such he is best suited to a life in which there is some high level of diligence and training. He makes a good cop, when there is such a thing, and a capable commercial pilot. He operates quite well under pressure.

Option B:  Hangs out with Greg.

His folks are academics and Markham was told-off plenty as a little boy. He wrestled with that as he wrestles with all problems and eventually he found his solution: To be happier and more forgiving than they were.

Eh? Marko? Launch himself out the front of a landing craft and charge up the beach with a bayonet fixed to the front of this rifle? Are you out of your bloody mind? The only time you'll see Marko run at anything is if the horse he backed has won and he wants to beat the rush to collect from the bookmaker. Either that or some parent has surprised he and his lover in the lounge room and he's making a nude dash for the back door.

Successful in a capitalistic sense, does Markus need a sense of humour more than he currently possesses? Perhaps, or maybe it’s just a bi-product of not feeling the need to associate with people or situations he is remotely bothered by. He’s certainly ambitious, so in that regard it makes sense. Markus is highly intelligent, he dresses very well and as a stylish city bound man he could pass as being gay, straight or indifferent to the whole shebang.

Marky is a nice bi guy. Clearly, his sexuality is irrelevant but it does highlight the fact that he is true to his heart and true to his friends. He is also smarter and funnier than a very smart, funny person. Marky.

Marlen is an interesting bloke who lives the quiet artists’ life. His girlfriends tend to be much younger than him – not to mention physically beautiful – and if he ever gets dumped he knows that all he has to do is relax and get on with life because he always seems to win them back.
Yep, you guessed it, Marley is Clio's brother and what a wonderful creature he is!

Oh my god, man. Come on, we're going to climb that mountain there. It's all about getting some fresh air into those lungs and to get those muscles of yours moving. Any longer in front of that bloody device and you're entire body will atrophy so there's nothing left of you but a blob in a jar.

No, he’s not Marlon Brando and he’s not a marlin fish. He’s Marlo. His parents conceived him in the ocean one drunken night and here we are….maybe he does have vestigial fins in his DNA somewhere? Anyway, Marlo isn’t usually comfortable in a crowd. He doesn’t ever count the money in his wallet - indeed, does he even possess one? - and he is amazed (and disappointed) at how nearly everyone in his midst is attempting desperately to accrue some kind of wealth. 

He’d make a good shaman.
Organised. Upper-middle class. Thinks he’s a bit special.

Marshy lives for the above average heat of some semi-desert. Don't give him snow. Don't give him big brown bears that might eat him. He doesn’t mind hard work, he loves a beer and he has more friends than he knows what to do with, but don't talk shit. You can give him machinery to tinker with if you like, that's fine, but just give him big skies and clean air to breath, okay? Marshy.
Young at heart and agile, Mart gets just as excited as his kids at the prospect of a trip to anywhere new.
Public servant.

Yep, he gets called Martha all the time and why not - it's a funny, quirky name for someone who needed one. Indeed, Marthyn, forget Marthyn. We like Martha. You cant wipe the smile from his face, no matter how or why it was put there, and overall we want him around.
Good friends with Simon, Patrick, Chris and Greg. Jonathon, too.

Marto is an active man. His girlfriends, wives and others, however, while generally adoring Marto’s sense of adventure, his cheeky grin and his loveable nature, know that he possesses the attention span of a fucking goldfish. Yes, he can strategically nod and appear to be listening, but he isn’t. It’s all an act. So, if you’ve got something you need to get off your chest with someone who will listen, I’d head next door.
The University Prankster who is often short in stature.
The name of the special wheelie chalk machine that is used at Wimbledon to mark the white lines on centre court.
Is it magic or he a magician? No one is certain, but there aren't nearly enough of them. (And no, sorry, we can't explain him properly either. Management.)
Just before he has his photo taken, Masie sucks in a big gulp of air and puffs himself up in the same way a clumsy male pigeon fluffs-up his feathers while in pursuit of another bored female.

Mason is a bit stiff and not from the waist, down. It's the capacity to think laterally in a fluid and relaxed fashion that is at question here. But, he seems to do quite well and he's rarely broke, for some reason….And don’t worry, we don’t get it either.
Mat the doormat. (Come on dude, time for two Ts.)
A fighter.

Boy, is he a thinker. There's a reason for that because there's a reason for everything, right? Mateo probably needs to smile more than he does but no one is perfect. He could certainly do with a couple of meditation techniques to use when his brain starts to overheat.

Mathew is the name of a great mountain ravine up in the Himalayas way above the tree line. Hard to get to, it’s an intricately complex place whose difficulty in reaching is matched only by the view that you get once you arrive. Only a select few will ever get to appreciate Mathew’s beauty but it’s an unforgiving environment. If you get injured while you’re up there and the weather closes in, then forget it. You’re doomed. (Note: the number of 't's' is irrelevant, with this boy.)

A rather neat individual, this is what Matio isn't: biker, plasterer, rabbit skinner, raw pig eater and sewer worker.

And this is what he could be: designer, architect, engineer, mathematician, psychopath, IT guru.

Matisse slides through life with the luck of someone unusually blessed. But it hasn't made him lazy - far from it. Matisse wears his heart on his sleeve and he rarely dies wondering. Yes, he'll wail with a broken heart, but as he'll tell you, stress, pain and anger are much better vented than secretly retained. Lots of friends. Gives good advice.

Matt observes the world go by with a natural ease. He is sufficiently outgoing and usually highly intelligent, and he never has too many troubles finding romance, but I’ll let you in on a little secret – Matt maybe so competitive that he borders on being occasionally violent!

Gallery artist. Street artist. His enthusiasm for everything and everyone means he will stay young for a very long time, probably forever. He attracts women like nobody’s business and no one would be surprised if, via one of the usual random flukes he seems to generate, he inherited about $9 million from some lost uncle or somewhere. Last I heard he was embarking on a job of tattooing his own entire body. Mattae.

Yes, he is a polite and sometimes secretive man, but Matthias grunts so loudly when he's making love that he can be heard two floors above and below him. There's an unconfirmed rumour that his lovers learn to wear ear plugs. (We all have a niche to fill, remember.)
Listen, fret not. Two Ts = One T, Matthew, so please head on up to your funk soul brother. Management.

His name falls out of your mouth and zips around the corner to see what he’s missed out on, and what’s about to happen next. Rarely morose and glum for very long, Matty is young at heart but not so immature that he loses sight of those events which are meaningful, despite his occasional spats. As a burgeoning adult he’s doing very well, and certainly his rather massive circle of friends points to this fact.

An indigenous elder who sees ghosts and laughter everywhere. When or if he becomes a ghost himself he will continue to laugh constantly and he will always adore beautiful women. Where are you Maur'? 

(Note: If Maurice is a white man he will clean his car spotlessly every Sunday and for reasons no one has any idea about, he will glean an immense amount of pride from presenting his clean mechanical travel tool to the street. Very odd.)
Mr. Congeniality.
Scammer. Sure, he's got the smile and the moves and he's a charmer alright. But, yeah, he's a scammer.
Mauro sits so still that people have mistaken him for being dead. He can out-stare the best of them.

What? Maverick has no blemishes on his record? Who told you that load of nonsense? No, in many ways we're quite proud of Maverick, and how he's managed to stay out of jail for as long as he has. He's not a nasty person though, please don't get that impression. Indeed, we love the way Mav' rushes into things without thinking....then again, he might just grow out of that because that's what we're used to. We'll keep you posted....

This boy is blessed with the letter x in his name that fits in with those around it in an incredibly powerful way. As a result, Max is a wonderfully unusual human being: He is charismatic, sexy and determined, and things just seem to happen when he’s around.

A Cavoodle dog (a King Charles Cavalier crossed with a poodle) that is covered in a mop of silky white hair. If he hears a noise outside he’ll start barking like crazy before bolting out of the kitchen, whereupon he’ll often crash, head first, into the glass sliding doors that he omitted to check were open or not. But the impact never shuts him up for long. The human version is basically identical.

Clinical and therefore just a little dull, Maxim is bright enough but what about a smile once in a while brother? I suppose his analytical mind hasn't really stopped since he arrived here on Earth and so perhaps we can’t blame him for looking preoccupied? He’d make a good organic chemist, physicist or mathematician. He possesses a twisted sense of humour.

Is he German? Does he at least possess northern European parents? Anyway, whatever, Maximilian is more sensitive than his name would have you believe. Staunchly loyal, he will never be found begging for money in a Mumbai alley way…well….unless he decides to start smoking opium on his travels, but that’s not really his caper. You see, Maximilian is a clean-living fellow most of the time and his pursuits are usually healthy and profitable.

This fellow is basically identical to his twin brother (Maximilian) so go look him up, except Maximillian has an ever-so-slightly greater chance of being fraudulent, and of being kicked out of any house he is living in, even though this is an unlikely event at the best of times. For what it’s worth, both of them are almost certainly university educated.

Once upon a time Maximus owned a  Used Car Dealership. He did quite well, especially given that Nick (said he) did his tax for him. Anyway, that was a long time ago and Maximus has forsaken his tendencies to steal from the mechanically uneducated to stealing from the fiscally irresponsible. Financial management: this is where he resides these days and why oh why Maximus did you forsake your artistic bent?
Maxwell has two pieces of toast with vegemite and a big mug of tea every single morning. Loves crosswords.

Maxy is thinking all the time, he is discouraged by useless people and dull deeds, and if the world were to be taken out by that giant meteor that Bryce might rattle on about, Maxy wouldn’t mind so much, so long as he was standing at the spot where it hit the earth so he could watch.

Mazza has a giant grin and we don’t think he’d mind us telling you that he is one kinky fucker. Indeed, he’d probably be stoked about it because it might increase his chances of getting lucky with that special lady who can handle that kind of thing. Disregarding his sexual exploits, Mazza actually works pretty hard, unless he detested his boss, in which case he wouldn't mind being fired either. Mazza.

Is he a clan leader? Well, no, but he does imagine himself thus, which is why he has something of a presence. He’s not a twat, usually, although he does covet the usual set of material goods that have brainwashed a large chunk of society in general. You can’t blame him for that I guess. McGregor is human like the rest of us. He’s also a funny guy and worth his due.
McKella has long arms like Roger, although he isn't as furry. A slightly more savvy version of Ronnie, McKella flirts with the white collar end of the law and he's never lifted a brick in his life.
Melvin is a party, and how many names are a party?
Christ, did your parents duck into a litte alcove on a tour of Elvis's mansion and have it off? Anyway, Memphis is an okay fellow, but he doesn't chew his food enough and rarely is his mouth closed.

Merrick rhymes with either Smart Alec or Smart At It. No one is really sure....perhaps it’s a bit of both? In the real world he operates like a big, dumb chocolate lab' whose job is to never ever grow up, to slobber over everything and eat holes in the sides of all the couches. A nightmare to own but bloody fun to visit.

Merv is a good guy who is there when you need him. If Merv goes to the pub for a friend’s birthday, for example, no matter how many times he himself throws up and no matter how often he gets rejected from entering the disco, afterwards, he’ll stick around outside until he knows that the birthday boy has had a good night.

What is reality? – This is Mervin’s personal ethos. Metaphorically or otherwise, Mervin speaks Italian, French, Spanish, German, Swedish and English, he is skilled at metallurgy and wine making and, if attending a large and formal dinner party, he is just as likely to be secretly undoing the $700 bra strap of the Duchess with one hand, while at the same time leading the rest of the table in a resounding rendition from Bizet’s Carmen, with the other.

The debonair mystery man. If you can track down Kenny and ask him how his brain works as it pertains to work and women, and we only suggest him because there are way more Kennys in the wild, then you will go some way as to understanding Micha. Good luck.
Micah dresses neatly, is never seen unshaven in public, he speaks very well and while at university he is the president of a politial club. Very clean hands.

Catholic school boy. Political advisor/fundraiser. Head engineer. Chief Justice. Airline pilot.....he’s in there somewhere*. 

*(ie- he’s organised, he’s smart and he’s reasonably conservative.)

Successful business deals, political leverage, societial status: these things are important to Micheal and hence form a large portion of his thought processes. That tiny slick of impatience that was provided to him by everyone continually mis-spelling his name as a young man has squeezed out a hard and uncompromising business head in adulthood. Is he tolerant? Sometimes. Does he give to charities very often?
.....Are you serious?

French? Dutch? Maybe. Where ever he is from, Michelle is direct, ambitious and knowledgeable. Is he arrogant? Sometimes. A pain in the arse? Occasionally. Funny? Usually. It depends if he thinks you are a twit or not.

An Australian icon. He’s no rocket scientist – indeed, only physical things that he can touch make sense to him – but his symbol, the fist with the raised thumb, belongs on a flag, somewhere. (Note: He detests being called Mike.)
As an amateur boxer, Mickey has tattoos on his back and shoulders, wears a white singlet, sweats a lot and sports a nose that has been broken at least three times.

If Micro is a big guy he is rather dim, and he almost certainly possesses one special skill involving either brute strength or some gut-churning party trick, like eating a spider before every third tequila shot, for example. If Micro is small, then he is only small in stature. He’s highly intelligent, he’s a gifted strategist and he is constantly thinking about what will happen next. You’ll hear big-Micro walking down the street  from 25 metres away, but little-Micro moves too fast to pin down although I can tell you for a fact he’s doing well, having laid an excellent foundation.

Midge is less sure of himself than he looks, which is a shame. But he’s an optimistic, compassionate man who rarely gets stuck, be it in a bad relationship, a dodgy part of town or at the back of the queue.

Where is he from, this man of dark hair and black, black eye brows? Is he a drifter or does he live here? Anyway, Miguel is a rogue at the bar and, gentlemen, if you're concerened about how you and your girlfriend are going it might pay to keep an eye on him. Ladies, Miguel will love you, even if it's only for one glorious night!

Mika works for a tech company in robotic research. What he says that they can do already is staggering and it's not all good news for us humans, for the future. But that isn't Mika's business. He's here to do his job, make his robots as well as he can and, hopefully, make as much cash as possible.

Mike would make an excellent dentist. He is a calming soul who gets on well with people of all ages and who understands the consequences of his actions. He feels slightly uncomfortable when people call him Mick.

Perpetually young at heart, Mikey is usually a big, cuddly, friendly guy with no apparent responsibilities whatsoever. If he's thin of stature, however, then he's a lot more competitive and capable than he lets on. And probably not as outgoing.

Mikle is similar to his more affluent cousin (Michael) except that he's never been schooled in any form of theology, his ego isn't anything like the same size and he's probably visited more budget gentlemens' clubs.
Milan has a deep voice and he likes to give the impression that he works too hard

Pronounced Miele, like the vacuum cleaner, here we have a fellow who is gentle but not feeble. Miele is comfortable and content and despite a rather superior intellect, he is always subtle. Never dates uneducated women.
Nothing like Myles, Miles is an American ditz.

A lone, very smart stray cat who saunters into your house like he owns the joint, and who expects cat food, milk, and certainly a bowl of water. No way will he allow you to put a collar and a bell on him but, give him his due, he loves affection and kind words like most of us. Heed this though, if things aren't to his liking for more than 36 hours then you won't see him again. His name is Milla and he's a long way from figuring out what he's doing here. You'll need to be very patient.

Millar isn't comfortable in a bathroom if the towels aren't draped over the towel rack in a neat and square fashion, and if there are more than one they need to be symmetrical in presentation. At someone’ else’s house he even has to re-align them if they’re not, then he can relax. (If you're talking to him at a party, for instance, and he looks a litte serious or distracted don't take it personally. He's probably just wondering what the towel set-up is like.)

On the surface everything is shipshape, but this cat can hold a secret, as well as a secret get away plan. Is he a criminal? No, but he’d probably do alright if he became one. The cops and the ladies can never pin him down, which explains why he’s perpetually single, which in turn can be explained by his propensity to never stay in one place for too long.
The Gifted Accomplice.
See Greig, except there’s nothing aloof about Milny at all.
Have you ever been so hungry when you ate a sandwich that you bit your fingers by mistake? It’s called The Milton Bite and it hurts like shit but, Christ, it’s funny.
Milo works with Dion. He ain’t no builder.

Mini doesn’t squander much, but he’s not anal either. Far from it. For whatever reason, Mini’s name compels  the world to assume that he is never going to be the loudest and most obnoxious person in the room. Which means, therefore, he’s usually the most demure as well as being one of the most pleasant and delightful individuals you will ever meet. Yes, he has an ego but you’d never know, only because even he doesn’t. Mini thinks deeply, rarely acts impulsively and always considers others before he acts. Not bad for a man with a ‘little’ name, eh?
The splendid Joker in any deck of cards. His specialty is lewd European trash jokes.

As a father he's a little over-bearing. Sure, we all expect our kids to be great and to turn out well, but they have to be free to make their own mistakes in their own time. I suppose it makes sense Misel is a bit harsh in this life, sometimes, because he spent several past lives in villages across Europe, several hundred years ago, living in very tough conditions and being regularly raided by bands of brigands. He has a sense of humour, you just have to dig a bit to find it, that's all.
The loud, humorous and wholly inappropriate restaurant owner who ensures most of his takings don’t go through the till.

Mitch is a gregarious and energetic man. He surfs, he does maths and he has a well- rounded grasp of both the world and his place in it. Like his more unforgiving brother, below, he also knows how to get what he wants although he won’t go as far as killing anyone in order to get it.
The Lion Tamer.

Mitt is the name of that donkey that you're about to ride out into the desert, en route to a drug deal with a Mexican cartel that'd soon as shoot you rather than look at you. There's going to be ten of them and only one of you, no one's around, and I'm SURE they'll give you all those drugs after taking all your money. They're fine upstanding men, aren't they? They wouldn't go back on their word, would they? I mean, they're business men, right?.... (Moral to the story? Mitt, think.)

Like a slippery eel that knows where it's going, M.J can bend and slide and allow the energies around him to work for him, not against him. He struggles on land, though. (That is, in any kind of organised, repetitive situation, like a 9 to 5 job, for instance.)
The undercover master who is peculiar, honest to the tune of 81% and exact. A little narrow-minded at times.
A betting man who loves the company of betting men.
Thinks too much.
This boy is soft at his core but he is idealistic and reckless on the surface. Gently, gently Molly....

Built for the big occasion, Monte is the kind of fellow who will walk into a S&M club for the first time shitting himself and swearing black and blue that there’s no way he’s getting his kit off for anyone, and not 30 minutes later he’s being gloriously whipped by a startling Amazonian-looking woman while at the time being anally probed by a different lady and her special hand-held device. 

Make no mistake, Monte is destined to live a fulfilled and interesting life, none of which is boring or forgetful, and many could take a leaf out of his book.
You guessed it; Monty has a giant silver ring pierced through his knob. It's why he speaks so well and so extravagantly - he's constantly feeling it as he talks. Weird, huh?

Moot left a town of about 4 people leaving 3, somewhere out in the middle of nowhere, and soon found himself cleaning the bottom of ferries next to a jetty while wearing SCUBA gear. Being from frontier country, he used a frontier-style method to perve on women. As the customers boarded the ferry, he would position himself under the jetty and perve upwards with the reg’ in his mouth, and every time he spied a girl in a short skirt or a dress, he’d yell out ‘Moot!!’ at the top of his voice. It’s a miracle he wasn’t arrested.
Mop is a simple fellow but don’t be fooled for he is a switched-on operator who has secret plans no one knows about.

Some advice if you’re about to give Morani the sack: Try not to criticise anything about him, and not even to his friends if you happen to see them later. That’s all I’m saying. It’s his Maori blood that makes him that way……we think. Good luck!
Morgan carries an attitude that stems from old family money and, fortunately or unfortunately, plenty is expected of him.
Conservative and stern, Morris has strict moral values. He could probably recite most of the decent psalms from the bible.
Morten is a calm, quirky and funny individual. As such he is likely to be an investigator of the universe within one of the fields of oceanography, meteorology or biology.

There’s nothing Russian about him – apart from his love of Vodka – and while he is definitely not normal he looks to get on with life and have as much filthy fun as possible. The last time anyone saw him alive he was being dragged alone into a tent by three gorgeous young nubiles.
Full of himself.

Mossy isn’t from the city, and he'd prefer a beer to any other kind of drink, and he'd rather sleep in than get up and deal with life sometimes, but when he did he'd put in a good effort, grumbling only rarely, and he has a better than vague idea about cars and how they work (not these new ones though). Perhaps best of all he has an easy smile and people like him. As do his kids, even though they give him shit about him never growing up.

Such is life. Such is Mossy.
Big head. Big ears. (With sweet fuck all between them.)

The wonderful ancient God of mirth, music and profitable betting who can’t sit in the same spot for more than about 11 minutes. He’s also known as the Host with the Most and arguably the best tour manager to have ever lived.

Astute and more delicate than you imagine, in a past life Munro was a splendid alpaca. He looks out for his team, he confronts problems head on and he retains a sense of humour in all but the most dire of predicaments.

The name given to any man by a woman with a sense of humour and who loves him deeply, and who expects him to mow the lawn and mend things around the house. And, of course, to be playful when it counts. :)

Murdoch doesn't just like to win, he likes to pulverise the opposition. If he's a short man then he suffers from the syndrome terribly. Usually, however, he wears a suit and tie and he does nothing for free.
Loves a decent wine bar on Friday night. The clubs are too loud for him.

The Murray is the phenomenon of dropping a bucket that is half filled with mud. After it hits the ground most of it slops straight up and hits you in the face as you stand there. “Oh, Murray!” you cry. He’s tolerated in the country, indeed he’s very funny, but city folk just don’t understand him.

By definition, Mustufah is hard-working and conscientious. He might even be a little too forgiving occasionally, but the traditions around his family are very important and take precedence over the rest of his life.
Kinky and thoughtful, Muzz is one of the boys but he’s not an idiot, and he’s definitely not lacking in available love to give to the world.

Normal? Mykl? Bullshit. He reads weird magazines, seeks out bizarre experiences when he travels and let's face it, everyone is scared to ask him what he does for a crust. He can't help it if his IQ is so high everyone thinks he has Asperger’s. Mykl is like one of those strange nerds who, in Hollywood movies, comes up with the brilliant chemical formula which will save civilisation from some kind of huge plague. Sure, his personal life is a mess and we don't know when he last got laid, but do you want to save the world or not? Call him....
Quietly confident.
Myron stands for hours in front of a mirror, practising his various facial expressions in preparation for the next audition.

No, that's Nadeem not Nadine, and only 20% of Nadeems will want to fight you if you repeatedly call him that. As a rule, Nadeem is a gentle sound for a forgiving and friendly man. But yes, like many Middle Eastern men, if you question his parentage he'll lose the smile and shape up immediately. (He is therefore not the person to be Earth's rep when/if we finally meet some curious extraterrestrials.)
Across between Norm and Karen, Naren is a contented and humble soul and quite possibly another accomplished artist who is doing his bit.
Nariano is one of the few men in the Kingdom who is just about sick and tired of women throwing themselves at him.
The lock-picker who smiles all day and all night.

No, Nat isn't going to spend hours in deep discussions about the philosophy of any particular decision. If it feels right he’ll do it, if it doesn’t he won’t and the past is the past - this about sums him up. To sit around and talk about the ins and outs of why or why not something happened will only bore him shitless. By the way, don't deem him to be impulsive just because he moves and acts faster than you. It's just how he is. He's a hands-on dude, simple as that. Girls love him in his younger years because they think he's reckless, and he'll milk that idea for all its worth too, don't you worry, even though that isn't true either. He's no fool.
Deliberately eats food that makes him fart a lot.
Usually blonde, Nathan is one of the Achievers. Anal and organised, his only real problem is that he wears underpants that are too small, which results in lots of frowning when he smiles.

It probably won’t ever happen – I mean, how many people actually get to save the world – but if someone had to, Nathaniel would be a fine contender. Not because he is full of valour and genius for in that regard he’s the same as the next person, but because he’s a funny, cooky and intelligent melodramatasist whose talents are wasted on the benign.

Fascinating name for an enigmatic and funny bastard. For example, it’s easier to pronounce ‘Nazeem’ if you’re smiling, but in a rather bizarre dichotomy, it’s also wonderful to shout as a swear-replacement at 3am just after you’ve cracked your second smallest toes into a large, sharp toy en route to a barely-awake urination. So, yes, he’s funny, but he’s fucking frustrating as well. Weird thing is, we can’t even tell you why. We just don’t know. Nazeem

As a young child he was a first rate nightmare. Indeed, how his parents didn't throw him overboard on that trip I'm not sure. We would have. But, in adulthood, Nazomi has shed all that tantrum-throwing out the window and he actually takes his time and considers his position before acting. He might even consider others, and who would have imagined that 15 years ago?

Neal gets involved in his community. He’s got his first aid certificate, which he remembers every detail of, he helps old ladies cross the road and he has even volunteered for St.Vinnies. He eats well but not extravagantly, he likes a wee glass of port of an evening and at his funeral will be a large congregation, each of whom will be compelled to ask themselves how much they give. Thank you Neal.

Wise beyond his years, Neale is revered within his friendship group - a rather dignified and intelligent group - for being the most level-headed of them all, and this is no mean feat. He thinks before he speaks and is therefore a good listener. When it comes to romance he is attentive and caring, although he so content in his own company he sometimes forgets to pursue such things in the first place. He often has an indoor hobby.
Ned slips under the radar as an underrated, genuine and sufficiently hilarious legend. Shocking with women.
The Ringleader.

The Negs of adulthood is almost identical to the Negs of his childhood. In primary school, for instance, if he and his best mate were being chastised by the female teacher and most of the anger was directed at his mate, Negs would use the opportunity to sneak around behind the head mistress and gently lift up her skirt for a quick peek.

Neil rhymes with any decent grimace. (eg: pulling leeches from your skin, ripping the wax from a hirsute part of your body, extracting tropical ticks that have their heads embedded in you and running across 90 degree sand without sandals in order to get to the water.) But, he is a loving man who is true and loyal.
A good honest worker who will gladly put himself in harms way in order to save the tribe.

A deranged man who yells at non-existent people, who are caught up in his paranoid delusions of world catastrophe and bloodshed. Either that or he's a genius way ahead of his time. I guess we'll find out...
See Smiddy.

Nesh is a happy, busy guy. He likes to dress in a stylish fashion, he is successful in work, he masturbates in front of the mirror, he is funny and he has friends. What more can a fellow ask for? He’s not tall.
You’ll often find him at the bar of any inland pub on a Friday afternoon drinking with a few of his mates.

Neville doesn’t like what the young folk are doing to the world, and he especially doesn’t like their lack of morals and manners. When he visits the dentist to have a tooth removed he refuses to have a local anaesthetic, and there’s no way he’d abandon a fruitful fishing trip if he accidentally stuck a hook through his thumb that went all the way through the nail.

Well (spit)…..somebody told me that if I rode this damn donkey out here and carried this bag (spit) for these people, that someone would pay me a lot of money (spit). But, hell, it's boiling hot, I ain't got no water, I can't seem to find the people I'm meant to be givin' this bag to (spit) and, shit, I might just die out here and no one'll know. How dumb would that be? (Excellent question, Newt.)

What it is with some men? Is he the dummest smart man on the planet? Yes, Newton, we know - you're maths skills are top of the class, you can sip a wine and tell us from which side of the valley it was made, let alone its vintage and country of origin and what you don't know about world politics isn't worth talking about, but why oh why would you get near the edge of a boat’s deck wearing rubber gum boots? If you fall in, by the time you get them off you'll be so far from the surface it won't matter. Like that other time you mowed the lawn in your bear feet and wonder how you ended up with 12 stitches. You with me?
A hard-working scientist who deals with wetlands. He spends most of his time in the lab, or so he says, anyway.

Giant IQ. Nicholas is a pale-skinned man with the demeanour of an arrogant used-car salesman. People befriend him because they feel bad that he doesn’t have any until they realise why he hasn’t got any. But, as a gifted shit-stirrer who gets off on testing others, he’s highly intelligent and you can’t begrudge him that.

The prodigal son that women are magnetically attracted to. Reckless and irresponsible, he loves outdoor sports and nightclubs, and he understands his place in the world, perfectly. He’s never filed a tax return in his life.

Possibly as bald as a fair dinkum badger, Nico pesters and is easily pestered, himself. He is well-dressed and he's always checking his wallet. He's certain that all women adore him, but there is a rumour his is actually crap in bed?....Can anyone confirm this for us?...
Works very hard. Saves his pennies. Encourages his kids to do the same. And when he drinks…..ooh, my goodness, does he drink!

He might be Austrian, then again his dad might have arrived here on a boat from Denmark 40 years ago. Where ever his blood originates from, however, Niels is a duty-filled man who devotes himself to any task.
