It’s not Nigel’s fault that he has idiotically rude parents, but you can forget the rumours because he is a far nicer and more intelligent person than we were led to believe. Indeed, Nigel is top notch.

Well I suppose they could have called him Toyota Corolla, or maybe, Northrop Grumman. But no, they called him Nike, and it's true, he can run abit, especially around tight little corners when the cops are after him.
Like a demanding gymnastics coach, Nikhil carries almost unrealistic expectations but you have to give him points for persistence.
Greedy.
Nikome possesses the resting heart rate of an Olympic distance swimmer and the smile of a contented monk who has been reincarnated so many times that nothing surprises him anymore.

Ever seen the puppet TV show, The Avengers? Well Nimrod is the name of a Commander of a battleship whose job is to sail around the seas and randomly shoot its cannons into rogue states. There's no diplomacy here folks. "Let's just get in there and get those bad guys, even before they become bad guys": this is Nimrod's personal motto. Is he this demonstrative in the street or in the kitchen? Well, no, that's the weird thing. Around the house he's a big loveable pussy cat, but put him in a uniform and hand him some weapons then WOAH! Look out!

While not a busy-body, Nitram is definitely a busy-beaver. He seems to have several projects on the go at the same time and this doesn’t faze him. The trade-off is that he can wake up some days and realise he hasn’t had any romance for years.

Nah, Nixon aint no mole in the ground. He's more like a giant bald eagle wearing flashy silver trousers, who soars through the sky shouting, "God-damn!! Look at me soar!!! Yeah!!!!"

You have no choice, therefore, but to love him.

Serene and truly good (like the fourth of fifth day after earth’s alleged creation when there were no animals or humans – just plants) Niz is the quiet calm of the thick rainforest that existed before the maelstrom of animal life and death that came later.

And bloody bravo mum and dad for ditching the h at the end. The boys in the commentary box have been discussing the two species of Noah/Noa for a while now, and everyone is scratching their heads. With the h ripped off Noa is now suddenly fast, he wants things to happen, he’s into life and movement, and yet he has achieved all this without his ego tearing off up the street like a flamingo with its nuts out. Noa is a man of the earth/water, no question, and if you own one our only advice is to not to pen him in or try to change him, ever. He may settle one day, but it has to be on his terms and in his time. Let us know how you go…

His name leaves your mouth and swirls around like a puff of disappearing smoke and Noah is therefore hard to get to know, but he is an intense soul who thinks a hell of a lot and he comes from a generation that feel entitled to be blissfully happy 24/7. (Note: 57% of the time Noah is an aspiring artist, he wears lots of black and loves being viewed as something of a hipster, though he’d never admit it).

Noak, are you Australian, firstly, and if not, have you heard of it? In case you haven't there's a phrase they have down there called 'blue balls'. It's a condition that I won't go into here. If you don't know what it is I suggest you look it up. And then, do something about it. You'll be surprised how much girls will want to talk to you. Management.

“Do you know what your values are and are you being fair?” 
These are questions Noam might ask you and if you answer yes, he will expect you to break the rules but only in accordance with fairness, not greed.

It happens to men more than women I think, but ‘Noel’ is the name of the rather tragic splash that occurs whenever a mobile phone is accidentally dropped into the dunny while a person is taking a piss.
Rarely first out of the blocks, Nolan isn’t one for physical exertion, which is a pity. Indeed, it’s about the only advice the commentary team can offer him. He’s certainly educated enough.
The Movie Extra.
Nor will quite happily walk into a busy pub on his own, enjoy a beer or three, and be completely unfazed whether he ends up speaking to everyone or no one.

Norm rarely showers, which is a pity because he lives in the heat of Northern Australia, Southern Florida or perhaps the Philippines, and he only moves quickly when he needs to grab another beer although he’ll do anything for anybody, if asked. (He’d never tell you, openly, but he craves the company.)

Richard’s offsider and a fellow knight, who is blessed with no common sense whatsoever. The last time he rode into battle he accidentally stabbed his own horse with his sword as they were crossing a stream. The poor horse died and Norman, the irreverent twit, damn-near drowned in the process.
Nugget is the working-mans’ ideal of a funny little bastard and if he isn’t very short, he’s a certainty to have a bright red afro.
Cutsy, wootsy, dootsy…….

Forget his heritage in this life. In a past life, in fact in a few past lives, Nusque was an Eskimo living way up in the northern hemisphere. First world hardships, dramas and smartphone meltdowns mean nothing to him because he's done it way tougher than most of these fools, here in the west, here in the 21st century. He's warmed by weird humour as well, and as such his friends are quite remarkable, also. Nusque is very comfortable in his skin, which, let's face it, is most of the battle. Nice work Nusque.
It’s not possible to be called Nuts and not be a humorous individual but the ego, which in this case runs far deeper than the larrikin at the surface, will always get things done in the end.
Traffic cop. He can stand in one spot, uncomplaining, for days.
Whichever name he gets it from, O is the perfect blend of humour and good grace, of application and silliness, of compassion and composure. Need we say any more.

I guess they could have named him Prada or Billabong - who knows? Either way Oakley is a little slow on the uptake, possibly because he gets distracted. If you know one you can do him a favour by calling him “O”. He’ll stand up straighter and react faster, and he’ll be far more adept at making critical decisions. The end.
Ocean gets handed more joints than nearly anyone in the entire Kingdom such that he's nearly lost at sea. (Mate, we all need a breather from time to time.)

Fickle? You better believe it. Then again, corporate strategic meetings, expensive silk ties and the correct shoes are categorically none of his fucking business, praise the lord. So, the fact that he’s never punctual, happy as a mountain goat and, in his youth, perpetually stoned means that he’s allowed to be a little unreliable in the real world. The Spiritual Seekers usually are, and whether they’re successful or not.

Man, how can one person be so slack yet get as much done as he does? Ever seen the movie Into The Wild? Well that bloke who vanished into the wilderness and who eventually died is just like Ock, except Ock's luck is much better, which means he never died. Indeed, if Ock tried that in attempt to find himself, he'd be found instead by three gorgeous female Norwegian trekkers with long legs and blonde hair down to their arses. Know what I mean? How does he do it?
Never rushed, Oden is the name of a Viking ship sailing the frigid waters of the North Sea. Well made, Oden deals with adversity very well. Indeed, he loves it.
When in doubt, Odysseus heads to the casino. Full stop.
Peaceful on the outside. Domineering in the bedroom.
Rarely loud and ‘in your face’, Olar measures his words that are well-intended and wise. He’s a funny guy, and in past life he was a Great Fish Sage that lived in the Mekong River, in Vietnam.
A gentle, caring and giant-hearted man.
Cray fisherman.
Serious when it comes to the family name and moneys owed, Oleh is continually trying to find a way forward.

Once we described Oliver is serious and sensitive, and someone who was in his element when it rained for days on end because it meant he didn’t have to leave the house. A little confession from the boys in the commentary box….we were just trying to get a rise out of him. Oliver is sensitive, that part is true enough, and sure, he’s serious when he needs to be, just, but Oliver is into life and he has a fun streak which runs through the middle of his entire being. You may not necessarily see it (although in the case of Oliver being the loudest and most extravagant personality in the room, you can’t miss it) but be rest assured that somewhere, somehow, perhaps in a social setting which you aren’t privy to yet, Oliver is the life of the gathering and people are disappointed if he doesn’t show up. Too right.

Ollie is about 40cm tall, covered in brown fur, has little buttons for eyes and boys and girls talk to him after they go to bed. Which is to say, Ollie is reasonably adorable, he’s more peace-loving than just about anyone and his rather massive group of friends is testament to how funny and compassionate he is. What more can we say? If he ever elects to joint the army you are dealing with some kind of Ollie impostor, full stop.

He's a polite man who doesn't mind a bit of hard work. But, Omar, in case you're in the habit of denying them, and just to let you know, women are capable of doing every job as well as any man, and behaving the same way if she feels like it, as well. With that in mind, may peace be with you.

Onyx, do you have the spark of genius? Is it in there? Are you capable of rising up when the chips are down?.....that, my boy, is the question and only you can answer it. (Note: at least they didn't call you basalt, or sandstone.)

Oren doesn't so much as blast into the room, he kind of slides in without people realising. Suddenly you turn around and there he is - Oren. You haven't seen him in ages and you've been looking forward to catching up because he's a good guy. And he's always full of surprises.
Oresto is a loveable buffoon. He can't swim and he loves his food.

Like a gaseous nebula in the night sky, Ori gives the appearance of being quite calm and serene, but internally there are tempests raging. Your exposure to these storms depends on how close you get, I suppose. He’s not destined to be a leader of industry, but he may very well deliver a permaculture workshop.

As The Plastic Man, Orion is similar to Gwen in that he is something of a chameleon. Orion seems to be everywhere at once and capable of all myriad of deeds and thoughts, although only a chosen few will be privy to what they are…
Pavlova.
When Orpheus is drunk at parties he likes to stand up on a seat and give a speech, and he thinks the movie Avatar was a fucking documentary.

An outstanding personality from any angle. He has a thousand jokes and weird anecdotes up his sleeve and the numbers of many more mysterious women in his little black book. He hardly ever works and he gets invited to lots of parties.
City dweller. Knows all the haunts. Good at taking the path of least resistance.
A humble farmer.

We can't say Otis is carved into refinement, but he does appear to be organised in his head. True, you might not think that after looking at his bedroom, but he's not as ambivalent about life matters as you would imagine. Projects: this is what Otis is into. He likes to plot his progress and give himself a framework in which to operate. He might even take a while to get to know well, but he'll be worth the journey.
Peaceful. Humorous. Wise. Affectionate.
(Pron. Oo-uh) Traditional and Turkish, Ou dances like an alien creature that has just discovered recreational drugs.

Owen is a round sound for a round fellow and for a well-rounded individual. He grows organic veggies when he can and a beard sometimes – the former in summer, the latter in winter – and he’s solid in long-term relationships, mostly because he knows who he is.
Oxlan will disobey a direct order if he deems it grossly unfair or cruel, but he’ll tolerate a fair bit until then. Once bitten he never forgets and once his trust is gone it’s gone for good.
No wonder he was an artistic genius. Pablo thinks fast and laterally, and as such he alters course in a flash. He is a good friend and a diabolical enemy.
The Fluid Link Man. Paddo is as knowledgeable and savvy as a sewer rat and he has the weird knack of unconsciously gravitating people towards him.
An interesting troublemaker.
Yes, Paige is a man. Paige is a good man. And he’s quietly spoken.

What? He’s prone to fits of sensationalism? Nooooo…..surely not! (Unless of course he’s a fucking astronaut, in which case I think we all agree there’s no need for him to say or do anything to get our attention.)

Paris isn’t from France and his hands are hard from hard work, and hand moisturiser is none of his business unless he’s alone and feeling horny. He doesn’t tend to fools and he can look after himself if need be. Whether he’s small in stature or not he’s usually the largest man in the room because he is honourable and has integrity, although he rarely stops at one beer.
The Mysterious Good Guy. Parish achieves great things but he seems to do it under the cover of perpetual darkness because no one ever actually sees him do anything. How do you do it, Parish?

The Rat! Very smart, Parker thinks on his feet and, if ever there is some massive catastrophic event effecting thousands, he is never one of the first casualties. Probably not one of the last, either.
Serene and good-humoured, Parko presents a shining example of good grace and wisdom to his kids. Best of all he'll never fully grow up.
See Parish.
Good friends with Gideon, Pascal is the artist's artist. True to his chosen form of expression, Pascal is intensely passionate about what he does, just as he is for anyone who tries their best.
Pasco is a fucking lightning bolt. Can you smell the ozone? Don't play golf with him. Amen.

An outboard motor mechanic from some far flung island outpost, and pound for pound one of the funniest people on earth. If questioned about his method of feeding his dogs he’ll reply with the following statement: “All you do is put out the dog nuts and they’ll eat ‘em. Eventually they’ll keep comin’ back. What else can they do?”

Far more naive than his female counterpart, if Pat isn’t a rather innocent kind of fellow then he is thin-skinned. If this is the case then he will try to look relaxed and cool but in actual fact he will complain more than anyone.

Patrick is a little toy chimpanzee powered by AA batteries who bangs his symbols together for hours, making an irritating, “Patrick, Patrick, Patrick, Patrick,” noise, that drives you mental. Later, when he grows up, he becomes a rude doctor with a shocking bedside manner, who gets very angry when the women he fancies don’t fancy him back.

Paul is an interesting persona. A polite man whose depths sometimes take years to see, he’s intelligent enough, normal enough and he almost never falls ill. To maintain a perfect balance in his life, however, he must perform some semi-evil act every six months. Paul is a deceptively tall name and without some kind of dirty little secret to keep him real, he’d just topple over.
Pauly rhymes with Can I Help You?  Thus, he’s always there, and he’ll do anything to help anyone who needs it.

Rarely does Pavo take no for an answer, and if he does it means he’s exhausted all other avenues of reprieve. Many consider him to be a physically tough individual and this is probably true, but he is fair, and perhaps this is the toughest aspect of him of all: to be objective and to keep trying, until he realises he shouldn’t or can’t. Strong family values.
Some people are just plain cool. You can't manufacture it, you can't bottle it and it's very hard to grow. Pax has it in spades. The only question is, how is he using it? Mmm?

Pearce, get away from that fucking mirror, will you? Now, get outside and get your hands dirty because germs are good for you. 
The end.

Like a contented and graceful waterbird, Peck may look like he's standing around doing nothing but this is not the case. Rarely prone to fits of melancholy, if someone or something is to his disliking, Peck's facial expression will hardly alter. All that will happen is that he'll spread his wings regally, wait for the first lick of breeze and then lift off to somewhere more welcoming, barely without a sound. Peck.
Be it in an illicit or legitimate trade in which he’s involved, Pedro is prepared to get his hands dirty while at the same time existing in the upper echelons.

Most men of Adriatic decent are sure of themselves and of their decisions, but cheerful Percic is a little bit different. If questioned about his parentage by somebody in a jovial manner, for example, he won’t immediately assume that he needs to kill them.
Often quite tall, Percy is rarely rattled and his conversations with women are usually risqué.
If he isn’t a trifle goofy and light-hearted, then there is an excellent chance he is English and an arrogant cock head.

The affable man-about-town. He rarely sleeps around and never says anything bad about anyone unless it is wholly deserved, and where it’s airing actually achieves something. He may not have finished high school, but Perko works hard and is a rock for most of his friends.

Pero is a knowledgeable, thinking individual who takes only a moment to size up most situations – lethal or otherwise – and he’s always ready to act, holding only as much fear in his heart as he needs to keep him thinking efficiently.
The bottom button on a shirt as worn by Alastair. He is secretly devastated when he gets tucked-in because he can’t see anything and this happens all the time. Spoilt as a child.
See Peter.

His name is older than the rocks but he always has plenty of energy, which might explain why he’s the butt of many jokes and the cornerstone of many buildings. How did you pull that off Pete? I’m still trying to figure it out.
Bull at a gate.
As a result of constantly explaining his name properly he has learned to turn everything into a joke, which is handy given his quite ambitious nature. Unpredictably fun in the bedroom
Petros is no stargazer, but he does keep an eagle eye on his employees inside his fruit factory. He pays them well, but he just likes to keep an eye on things.
As a bouncer with a degree in Greek philosophy, Pez is a big guy whose dangerous eyes shield a soft heart.
The Streaker.

(Before we begin Philip, we need to tell you that you and the double-L version are identical, so suck it up.)
Anyway, where were we? Ah yes…Philip has read more books than he has hit some kind of ball with some kind of bat, implement. Indeed, what is sport? On the flip side he is so intellectual that he wouldn't enjoy how that third sentence was constructed at all, although he’s smart enough to have followed the thread of what we're on about. It's a weird world, eh? In summation, we can tell you that Philip (and his double-L cousin) is something of a conservative man. Is he a bore? Well, that's a good question. We can say that he does like the sound of his own voice.

Once the President of the University Wine Appreciation Society, Philippe finished his Ph.D, worked for a bit, then gave it away so he could follow his passion of learning about Shibari. We suggest you look it up. The moral to the story is that he is one deep-thinking man, funny too, who takes every path in life to the very end, sexual play included.
No, he's not a boring poo-poo man. He's the same as Philip, with one L. So, head on up there brother and we'll see you in the pavillion after the game.

A king amongst his peers. He counsels, he’s a confidante and he is a salve for all those who need one. His deep-thinking approach to all issues means he experiments beyond the norm and this only adds weight to his quest - to seek meaning and significance here in this thing we call Life.
Pheonix nearly drowned in surf that was way too big for him. His friends, who could handle themselves, tried to tell him but there’s just no getting through to some people.
If he thought it would do you any good, Pi would tell you that genius is the loneliest ticket in the world.
Film maker. Father. Comedian. Remarkable facial hair. No idea about this thing called money let alone fiscal responsibility.

A stickler for tradition, Piero's parents instilled in him a duty to care after his family and loved ones. Truth be known his wife is better at it than he is, but he pretends to be in control sometimes. Piero has a mischievous side that MUST be indulged from time to time. And he'll tell you: what is life if it isn't fun?
For something different, Piers will often masturbate while wearing a condom. He calls it practice.

Well, yes, he is something of a Peter, but his European bent means he is far more adherent to methods and systems which are proven to work. And if they don't work he'll almost certainly never employ them again. He makes a capable sailor, a fair and friendly leader and a caring and humorous partner, who, albeit, is occasionally quite stubborn.
Self-assured. Not the chauvinist we were led to believe at all.
Piggy is outgoing and a friend to all, but like many of his colleagues he is a nightmare when he’s pissed.

Rarely overweight, Pip darts around like Muhammad Ali in the ring, and his actions are nearly always aimed at some kind of creative outlet. Pip is no plumber although his active brain means he might own a building company, which is about as close to plumbing as he’d ever get.

The city wannabe hipster, minus the beard. Trendy spectacles adorn his face and his scarves are sometimes worn in quite warm weather. He’ll tell you there’s nothing wrong with possessing a little style, and he may be right. Our only question is that which is untested: In a life and death situation could you turn to him for advice? And you might be surprised with the answer…
Pissup is constructed of sturdy moral fibre and he tells a perfectly intricate story –  missing no details whatsoever – that always finishes unpredictably.
A jolly man who, only recently, learnt to buy his own underpants.

No mountain is too big. P.K is relaxed and perceptive and he does most things in an above-average fashion. Self-promotion: he doesn’t need it. His actions and attitude do the calling and there endeth the lesson.
Originally from somewhere near South Africa, Pook is centred, calm and forgiving like an oily flat ocean and the universe thus allows him to do anything he wants. Nice work Pook.
Pope is the kind of bloke who goes to the Melbourne Cup on his own, knowing no one, and by 5pm is $10,000 up, and best mates with the winning jockey.
Money is attracted to this fellow because people trust him. He’d make a good white collar crim’.

"Oh no, I quite like visiting the dump, as a matter of fact. The smell isn't that bad, and you'd be amazed what you can find."

Portland is proof artistry lies in the most obscure places, sometimes.

Q: How can any man feel empowered and dynamic when called such a thing? 
A: …Exactly. 
The result is a cuddly, funny bastard who has a perpetual smile stuck to his face. He does get sad, but only because, unlike many men, he gives full scope to his emotions. The men of the world could definitely learn a lot from his example.

(Note: Women, by and large, don’t really need the lesson because they are far more advanced in this arena.)
One dimensional.
Jesus Prescott, go and sit over there in the corner with Bruno and Bindi. Thank you.
Snob.
Here is another who believes that the world was made for them, although Preston doesn’t understand why walking around with his thumb up his own arse looks weird. It’s his God-given right, after all.

Intelligent and sensitive, as well as being very funny, Presty is here for the long haul. Always one to take a bullet for the team, he occasionally suffers the long fight more than most. But, he keeps his chin up because above all else he is the perennial optimist.

Like a river that has moods known only unto itself, Provan is his own creature. If he's a city cat then he comes out only at night, and if he's a country boy then he'll barely stay in the one spot for more than a few days. Solitude: he's good at it. If he is that country boy, and let's hope he is, he rarely wears a watch, he gets up with the first birds and he knows everything about the seasons, rock formations and the flood plains. If he's that city cat, he's got dark hair and he doesn't trust just anyone.
Is Ptolemy into astronomy, anyone? Seriously, is he? The stars or the cards? Anyway, he’s a nice fella’ who wears plenty of amulets and bracelets, etc.

Now Puke, you know we like you, okay? You have friends who adore you, you seem to make the right decisions most of the time and you're far more dedicated than your name leads us to believe, but how can we send you to this conference in Japan if you insist on being called Puke? Most of them speak English mate, and they know what a puke is. Are you on my wavelength, chief? (By the way, it's your shout.)
Pumpkin is the sort of man that gets married in scarlett. He'll tell you he married a Princess.

Like a wild male lion on the savannah that has just injested a gob-full of ecstacy and cocaine, all Pussy is concerned about is cuddling up to any creature he can find, before declaring his undying love. Zebra, gnu, hyena, landcruiser - he doesn't care. He's just so full of love and purring bliss that he can barely contain himself.
Quade presumes he's a hero and he seems to have a very limited sense of humour.

One might suspect that Quentin is peculiar and potentially highly uncoordinated, but Quentin’s defining characteristic is that he is completely unpredictable. 
(Note: There are rumours going around, however, that his name is responsible for the Q in IQ.)
The Island.

The word can’t be said without smiling and Quinny, therefore, takes very little seriously. Kids light up when they see him, for instance, because, like dogs, cats, crows and most horses, they are the only ones that can see what’s really going on - ie. he unconsciously generates an energy field that instantly makes those in his midst feel completely happy. Weird but true.

Time-consuming tasks are no issue for this fellow. Most of the effort, he will tell you, is in the preparation anyway, so why rush anything? Yes, he's intelligent, but he appears smarter than he is because of the patience he possesses and his capacity to remain calm at all times. Socially he's a little odd, only because people are never exactly sure what he's on about.

The friendly bloke who owns the shop down the road. He has a big smile and a kind word for everyone, which is his best and only marketing ploy. He’ll never be super rich and he couldn’t give a rats arse, so long as his wife and children are catered for. Qumar is lovely.
He may not roar like a lion but he definitely cackles, usually at the back of the room in the shadows where he cant be seen and so won't get into trouble. He's crashed a lot of cars.
Picture Annie, in a male body. Though not anywhere near as imaginative a lover.
The name of a pet.

The name of a South Pacific Island dance. You can only do it properly if you are smiling ridiculously, fitter than a Malley Bull, dressed in a islander grass skirt and wielding a spear with the full intention of slaying any bastard who has anything bad to say about you, which obviously never happens.

Sure, he's a dreamer, a painter, philosopher, boozer and more, but it's all a front. Rafael knows about life and he knows that all any of us are, really, is some kind of wild, fantastic 3-dimensional video creature in the middle of the most crazy game in the universe. My advice? Do what he does.....
The scruffy knockabout that women tend to adore. But, he needs to do something about this debt…
Rafferty lives his life as if he's the star of a movie that is running 24/7. It's actually worth watching about 20% of the time.

Great friends with Alby, Rafi has broken or lost so many items that didn't belong to him, it isn't funny. Did he replace them? 
Well, time is short, you see, he never seems to have much cash on him and, well, he always meant it when he said he was going to. On the up side, Rafi wouldn’t hurt a fly.
This boy makes clinical decisions, which partially explains his success, but he's a bit too organised.

Raiden is a fine fellow but we feel it's premature to be talking about him, here. What isn't finished here Raiden? What have you yet to do or yet to understand? What are you waiting for? Come on, do it. Then we'll talk…

Mmm, I wonder how the world would treat him if he'd been called Gentle Drizzle. Anyway, Rain broods, at least, he looks like he's brooding. Which means he's probably just not masturbating enough. (I know, hard to imagine, eh?)
Rainer smokes only Camel and despite his friends, which are many, his only true allegience is to the Mafia Don who he is entrusted to protect.

Raj is many things, and the boy sports an ego, but he is definitely loved, although usually by men more so than women. His parents probably hail from the subcontinent but it matters not. Many women rate him as a 'player' at all the nightclubs around town but he'll settle down in the end. Rarely poverty stricken.

Raja is more humble than his brother, Raj, despite having a healthy sense of self-worth, also. Raja's moral standards appear to be set pretty high and he'd make a fine doctor, although we'd hope the reasons he'd choose such a life path were not solely to please his parents and attract a satisfactory reproductive mate.

His name catches everyone completely off guard and they have no choice but to stand up straight and listen to him, out of surprise as much as anything. The wash-up is that Rakhal is a sufficiently unconventional and honourable man.

Ralph is an affable fellow who remembers most jokes, and this says everything about his intellect that is huge. If he had an edge to him he could do anything and exalt in the greatness of his achievements, but then he wouldn’t be Ralph.

Like Richie not long after him, Ramey makes a splendid 2nd in charge, or maybe even a 3rd or 4th. Responsibility: who needs that shit, is what might well turn out to be his mantra. But, someone has to make the others laugh and feel comfortable and not everyone can pull it off. There are too many people taking too much of life too seriously anyway. Girls tend to love him, although they're never sure if he's up to this fathering caper. I guess we'll have to wait and see. A funny guy though and a cool cat, so long as no one makes him Captain.

Ramish can sit down, close his eyes and inside 30 seconds put himself into a meditative state that brings him straight into his third eye. Sounds wild, eh? And it is. But in here he is granted visions of worlds so splendid we can't describe them. Like a few others out there, he sees the future, he sees the past, and he should probably surf if he doesn’t. It's an energy thing.

Plenty of books in his study point to an informed, travelled and rather predictable life. Yes, yes, he’s seen the pyramids and boated down the Mekong but beyond children he’s sticking to the game plan, not that there’s anything wrong with that. If no one paid their taxes roads wouldn’t exist, and then what?
Randal is a brand new chemistry textbook that ends up spending years in the library, and where he gathers dust and meditates.
Very similar to Randal, except this textbook has been in the backpack of a gorgeous English girl who has travelled the world. She stole it.

Randolph, the great goose, was born about 40 years too late. Then again, imagine if he wasn’t? As a man of means, Randolph might very well toss it all in one day and go off-grid. Ditch the car. Throw out the TV. Get into gardening. These are the deeds of an eccentric man, not to mention a fine and wise one.

He’s a unit, alright. Randy is an outgoing bloke who drives a Japanese sports car that has purple neon lights attached to the bottom of it and a souped-up muffler attached at the rear. The muffler is big and silver and, secretly, Randy wants a cock that looks and sounds the same.

Upbeat and savvy, Ranjeet runs an efficient business. He knows many of the family members of most of his employees and this personal touch lends itself to a happy, fun environment. His own family life isn’t too different, although he does love his sons slightly more than his daughters.
Raoul is having too much fun to consider doing something as banal as getting a job. But, he's a great dancer, the girls love him and he's rarely rich.

Yep, in a past life he was one so what do you do? You remain centred and you fill your life with as much clean fun as is feasible with only 24 hours in a day, and perhaps that’s Rasta’s little secret. Time is a relative concept and if you want it to, it doesn’t even have to exist. Bravo Rasta.

(The lawyer talking to him in the lockup…)

Rastus, I don’t get it. You threw away a mining job of 300 grand a year to come and live in the city. You’re I.Q, according to this testing here, is in the top 1.5% of the population.
(Rastus smiles, shrugs his shoulders.)
So answer me this will you, for someone so smart why do you end up in here so often?
(Rastus looks down at his feet, looks back to his lawyer.)
…Coz’ I get bored out there. And I’ve got an addictive nature. What can I say?

The end.
Raul has very strict ideas about family morals and behaviour. (Note: If he was born north of Barcelona, dismiss this name theory, immediately, because he is the exact opposite.)
The Magician. He has beautiful white teeth, he smiles 95% of the time and he constantly thrills thousands of people with the dance parties that he puts on.

Ray was released from prison about a year ago after doing something silly when he was much younger and far stupider. He came to regret that but, nowadays, having won back the love of his kids, he wouldn’t trade any of his history for anything. He hasn’t had time to become an entrepreneur.

All his friends spent plenty of time in school detention but somehow he managed to slip passed the edge of all that chaos. Indeed, he is often quite discreet and more diplomatic than you think. How this came to be is anyone's guess. Healthy and active, Rayden rarely attracts lots of attention and no one in the Kingdom is as quick and as stealthy as spotting and pocketing a $50 note someone accidentally dropped.

Did you ever read that story as a child, "The Hare and the Raymond"? It's one of our favourites. The underdog keeps going and going, never giving up, and he deserves his victory - he's worked hard. The only tragedy is that by the time he crosses the finish line everyone has gone home. Raymond.

(Pronounced Read, as in, I will now go into my room and read my book.) Speaking of which, Read is well-read too. A tall, placid and splendid individual, in a past life Read was a giant rain forest tree - home to literally billions and millions of little critters whom he felt inexorably spiritually attached to.
Jackaroo/rancher.
Reece is many things - he is a small splinter beneath a finger nail, he is cocky and ever-so-slightly sleazy, he is a good assassin.
The Vampire. (ie. Nocturnal, probably quite brilliant, partially psychopathic.)
Reef, don't drop out of school. I know you're thinking about it. Get past the dip, it'll be worth it in the end. Love, Management.

Sceptical - you bet. Like a very smart dog who has been dropped off at a dog refuge by his previous owners - let's face it, they were never up to the task of caring for another creature properly - he takes a while to warm to people but once he's in, and he trusts you, then whoa betide any man or animal who comes between him and those he loves.

Reg is as deaf as a decent sized post. He says, “What?” so often and so loudly at the nursing home that people have stopped talking to him, outright. As a young bloke, however, he sold combine harvesters and raised a nice family.

A name for the silver screen. Regan is a sufficiently thoughtful and dedicated man but if you ever implied that his name had a feminine aspect to it, he would probably pick you up by the throat with one hand and gently tear your head from your shoulders, with the other.

Regi is the kind of fellow who, if driving, lost,  through the Italian country-side in a rented car with his girlfriend would go out of his way to find a hitch-hiker who could help them figure out where they are. Big smile. Takes very little seriously.

A pompous English explorer who never knew his east from south. He was only able to do the travelling he did, anyway, because his father had some pull with the government but all was for nought, however, because in 1910, while on an expedition into the mountains of New Guinea, he was eaten by a tribe of cannibals. Apparently his meat was crap.
In a past life Reid was a Spanish Conquistador. Good for the modern world. Bad for earth-loving natives.
Do you know, for all the bullshit and the run-ins, and the useless attributes, Reife is a hopeless romantic who comes good every time.
The Gallant Saviour.
The semi-successful mover and shaker who knows all the bouncers at all the clubs. They, and most of the girls inside, as a matter of fact, love him.

Rem is utterly reliable, not only for a helping hand but for some sound advice and a smile when needed. He doesn’t take days to make decisions and his whole energy attracts good people. Perhaps we should clone him and drop thousands of him into some of the world’s trouble spots? It couldn’t hurt…

“Fuck the nanny state.,” he says often. 
Remo is a passionate man who can fix anything and if he can’t he’ll know someone who can, be it legally or otherwise. Welcome to Remo.

A loving man who needs to keep moving. If he stops for too long, or spends too much time mulling over some drama, problem or issue, then there is a risk he'll stall and lose all artistic/creative momentum. The moral to the story here Remy: if you lose your way then just do what feels right. Don't think about it too much.
Spends a lot of money on 'stuff' and he has a large ego. Likes to wear a scarf-thing around his neck, even if it's not that cold.
Renier aspires to be some kind of mover and shaker. Mostly it's a money thing. What about love, Renier? They tell me it's the greatest moving and shaking event of all…

Reno spends far too much time in high school detention or in juvenile lock-up. Reno, some advice from up here in the box: For one month get away from those friends of yours that lead you astray, find  yourself a pass-time that involves using your body, stay off all drugs and alcohol, get some fruit, vegetables, nuts, fish and water into you, find a couple of good books to read and get to bed early. I'm telling you, one month of this will change your life. Please report back to us when you're done.

What a splendid dipstick Renton is. It’s true, he’s never mended a fence in his life and he wouldn’t know how. He couldn’t ‘carpenter’ his way out of a paper bag and as an inner-city city-slicker, perhaps we wouldn’t expect him to. Calm and quiet like a heavy, clean and empty water glass, Renton does well on eHarmony, and so he should. He’s a nice guy.

Reon rarely works with his hands. He has 40 shirts in his cupboard but only 2 of them are cleaned and ironed. What does that mean? Well, it depends on how much importance you place on clean, ironed shirts, I suppose…

A litle Malaysian guy who can't wipe the smile off his face. It's impossible not to love the guy, but don't waste his time - or ours - by expcecting him to be the head negotiator at the meeting, or deliver the bad news at the AGM. Resee is too spiritual for that crap.

The name of a mountain stream that is cool, calm and clean. (Either that or he's in the money markets and only divulges his secrets if it means a lazy mill' is going to fall into one of his accounts, in which case not even his closest friends or partner is ever likely to find out.)
Man, this boy can dance. So, no, he's not shy. There's a mountain being moved behind the scenes.
Reve will only sleep with a girl, or a man if he's into them, if they have clean, white linen sheets with a very high thread count.

Revell fights hard with himself not to party as hard as can be. He turns up to work on time and sometimes he even has to fight hard to do that. Best of all, Revell is trying hard to be a good man. It's even more impressive given that he finds the whole story of life filled with so much irrelevant, meaningless bullshit.

Option A:  Maggie’s father. Also black.

Option B:  Good mates with Neville, Graeme, Bruce and Kev. (Look ‘em up.)

With a name that’s about as exciting as a well-functioning hot-water system, Rheen is an industrious little fucker with a cheeky grin. Decisions are made quickly here and he doesn’t turn around and lament at any that didn’t play out the way he intended.
If he didn't have to eat Rhen would sleep all day, such is how chilled-out he is.

His name is unique in the Kingdom in that it’s the only one that sounds like a motorbike being revved, such that if you say it loudly at him there’s a chance he’ll jump, but, overall, Rhett is a cool cat who wears unusual shoes. We all have a niche to fill.
Big nose. Smart head.

Rhyce is an organised man and not prone to fits of impulsive behaviour. That's not to say he never acts on the spur of the moment but there is always some measure of contemplation. And he's not stupid. For example, if he's attending a summer-time party at a two-storey house, where there is swimming pool adjacent to the building, long before he arrives he would presume some of his less mindful friends would jump into the pool from the 2nd storey balcony. What his friends won't have done however is (A) get on the phone that afternoon and ring the party hosts, casually enquiring as to the depth of the pool at the deep end, if it has one, and (B) get on the internet afterwards and determine the depth of water required for a human of X kg to drop safely into it from the height of a 2nd storey balcony.

So, naturally, in the middle of the party, Rhyce's random leap into the pool, on the surface, looks like a sporadic, zany moment of hilarious genius. And on one level it is.
Slippery he may be, but you want him on your team. Not the oppositions.

Where as his cousin (Ryan) is someone who will imbibe any substance he can get his hands on, Rian attempts to take a stand against the tide of either peer group or social pressure by attempting not to party himself into the ground. He needs his sleep anyway. He's got a university exam to sit in the morning.
“Hullooooo,” he says with a very heavy accent to a lovely young girl. “I think...tonight......you would be liking to make love with me, no?”
Yep. See Ricardo and cease your complaining about your extra c.

“So, where is he? He said he was going to meet me here?”
His flatmate smiles. “Nah. You know that model he met at that party last week?”
You stand there, confused. “...Yeah?”
“Well she called by half an hour ago in her convertible. His taken off with her up to the lakes for the weekend. He said to say sorry, but that you’d understand.”
“Oh fuck! That prick!”
Rich’s flatmate smiles. “Yeah, that’s exactly what he said you’d say.”

The knight in shining armour with an ill-fitting helmet that badly impedes his vision 80% of the time. He rides a big white stallion that’s not dissimilar to that ridden by Cassandra, although his task of riding anywhere quickly is made far more difficult because the horse continually tries to throw him for its personal amusement.
Richie always has fags on him and is continually on the lookout for mischief. He’s an excellent prankster and an excellent second lieutenant.

Plucked from obscurity, how Richo pulled it off appears to be something of a miracle. True, he worked hard behind the scenes to get himself ready but, even so, we're still amazed at how well he's done. One minute he was getting his arse whacked by a bloody big cane, next minute he's at the President's house receiving the keys to the city. 
Richo is living proof that self-belief and a healthy disrespect for the system will get you everywhere.
Mr. Restless and Mr. Almost Hyperactive.

Ricki can be a tempestuous little shit on occasion. Generally he gets into tasks quickly, rarely sitting around to watch others get some advantage ahead of him. He's not big on missing out and he's never meditated in his life.
Ricky feels very little pain. Does that make him something of a masochist? Maybe....

Riley has an ego that won't easily lie down and it’s something that he wrestles with constantly. He’s good looking, he’s intelligent and he’s charismatic – he knows all this – but he’s a compassionate human being as well with a generous sense of stupid fun. The total story may take years to tell.
Ball waxer. His own, usually.

Riordan has never done a push-up in his life and we’d be disappointed if he started now. As a borderline academic he knows a great deal about a great many things, and he is always eager to learn more. He looks a little gruff but he’s not really. He might be a little deaf, perhaps that explains his occasionally intense glare?

Ah, Sigourney, if only anyone was as tough as you… 
Anyway, here in the real world Ripley is a soft-handed city boy who spends 90% of his waking life staring at some kind of electronic screen in the name of both work and play. And he’s not on his own, sadly. But, Ripley is no dill.
River burns it at both ends and he therefore needs to drink more water than he does.

An accountant? Not bloody likely. He's the sort of bloke who will arrive at the party on time, behave well and enjoy the company of others until the stroke of midnight when he will stand in the middle of the room and strip to his under-trousers before yelling, "CHECK THESE OUT!"

And yes, he's wearing a pair of boxer shorts with flashing neon lights woven into them. He found them on his last trip to Tokyo and he's been in love with them ever since. In short, Roarke is and entrepreneur and he's very happy to never die wondering.

Constant like the sunrise and the sunset, his name is heavy with the burden of reliability and normalness that he would love to shun, and very occasionally does. Basically, Rob is a good guy who will do anything for you. (Note: 18% of Rob’s use this empathy to get away with dodgy deals.)

They say the best muso’s are all slightly unhinged. Perhaps all the best artists are? There is definitely a child-like quality here and an occasional neediness. But, dogs don’t bite him and that says a lot.

Robbo rhymes with Righto, and to that end he is a free-thinking and unselfconscious legend. He’s one of the few people on the planet who can pick up a didge’ with little or no musical history and make it sing like it’s walking on water.

Robby had it all but lacking discipline, he realized too late that pure skill was never going to be enough. He’s not always a lost soul, although if he is then all is not lost, either, because he makes up for it by often being the life of a gathering.

Yep, so Robert might be boorish sometimes, but someone has to design the road rules with a conservative mindset. Remember, the road rules exist for the worst drivers, not the best. In that regard he has almost certainly saved your life more than once. You just never knew it.

How can one letter add so much? Roberto's Italian/Brazilian/Mexican or Spanish ancestry has allowed him a certain freedom in that he is surrounded by music, food, women, wine and friends. (Even though he still might live with his parents, and pay off a massive gambling debt.)
The lazy gorilla.
Timidity: 70%. Altruistic tendencies: 100%.
Young and clean in a sporty way, Robinson is as fresh and energetic as a daisy.

Rocci, stop fucking complaining about shit that doesn’t matter. 
“What do  you mean?” he cries, when accused of such a thing.

Sure, he's explosive but only in the way of yelling at his management team about what they're doing wrong. Rocket has deeply held beliefs which is why he's so passionate about the various aspects of his life. He tries to leave nothing to chance, even though he knows great luck is a rare and often untamed beast. If you're not a believer of his vision then you're better off on a different team.
Rocko is sweet and gentle like a playful puppy with sharp teeth, and who is all about having the most fun possible without regard to consequence.
No shy man can pull-off a Rocky, and so it is. But he’s no buffoon. He’ll plot and scheme and organise with the best of them, and he’s rarely shy when it comes to chasing ladies, either.
Rococo is no lawyer. Indeed, the only way he would ever wind up in the Supreme Court is if those fraud charges finally came back to haunt him.
Rod is intelligent and charismatic, and here for this moment. (He might also be sufficiently opinionated.)

Once upon a time we coined him Humpty Dumpty, but maybe that was just to get a reaction out of him, and to remind him to keep a sense of humour. If he's called Roderick only, and not some other kind of nickname, then we advise you take the same measures as one would with Ross, except make sure your gun is in good working order. Goodluck.

Well, it's true, like many men in the Kingdom Rodger likes playing with his todger. What can you do? Out there in the real world he bounces along like he's expecting fun and hilarity any second now, which might explain why he gets fired so often. He's always ducking over to someone else's work station to see what they're doing, or running to the window to see what car just pulled up, or even just leaning as far back in his chair as he can without toppling over, while staring up at the ceiling where he imagines that he is flying over an alien landscape. Where should we put him? Anyone?...
Quick and clever. Liked by all. Forever the quiet and consummate actor.

Yes, it’s fair to say that the parents of any girls he dates don’t like him, but clearly that’s his job. I mean, we can understand their concern. The last time they permitted him to take out their daughter – and this was months ago, mind you – the girl’s mother sprung the couple in her daughter’s bedroom at 2am. In two swift moves, all Rodriguez had time to do was leap from the maiden’s bed to his pile of clothes, cover his erection and leap out the window.
I wonder if the girl’s mother has forgiven him?
A nice man who is a bit slower to catch on than most of the crowd. Or perhaps he just likes his own company, which is where he thinks more clearly.

Roger has long arms, is covered in dangly red hair and lives in the island jungles of, what used to be known as, Borneo. He has very expressive lips, he is highly intelligent and as a youngster he’s often seen on TV wearing human nappies. In short, Roger is a cooky, unorthodox and highly entertaining fellow. The End.
Patient and contained, Rohan is the sort of bloke who makes an excellent professional photographer.
A caver. He nearly died on a mountain in New Zealand once, but that hasn’t stopped him climbing – far from it. And he was the dux of his last year in high school.
Roland is a graduate of Eton College, in England. He thinks that he is an excellent cricketer and rower, even though has no shoulders, petticoat hands and no hand-eye coordination what so ever.

Rolf is a unique and supremely charismatic lover of life. His name sounds like a big dog barking happily at its owner in order to encourage them to come and do anything, and, consequently, Rolf has been able to foster his eccentric and artistic life exactly the way he always wanted because he never fully matured.

Roly bustles his portly frame through the door. “Blah blah blah....you wouldn’t believe what just happened to me! Hey, did you hear the one about the priest and the donkey? Anyone seen my lighter? What are you pricks up to, anyway?” etc etc
 
Even watching him is enough to make you tired.
Roman is the supremely cool, sanguine and friendly world-traveller.

Fair suck of the sav’, Romeo! He smiles. He’s heard it all before - the jibes about his name, that is. Is he a soldier? Fuck no. Romeo runs a cafe/restaurant, puts the least number of transactions possible through the till and loves everyone. The tax department has an entire section devoted to him. Amen.

“G’day love,” he says when he walks through the door, exhausted.  “Hi darl’,” he hears from somewhere inside the house. 

And the stars above track silently behind a brilliant blue sky, because Ron is a hard-working, honourable man.
As Irma’s catatonic brother, on special occasions we’ll see him attached to the front of the breweries promotional wagon. After all, everyone loves a dopy Clydesdale.

Does he speak Hebrew? Does he hang out with long-beards? There are some things you can’t jest about, with Roni. If you accused him of behaving like a woman he would want to fight you, no matter how well you know him, which is bloody absurd Roni. Chill-out mate, and if you lug around any rosary beads please, get rid of them and get yourself a skateboard, or something.

No, he hasn't rappelled down a mountain face to save the damsel in distress, but his parents named him that way, thinking one day he might. He’s actually quite chilled out and while we cant say he’s shy, his does shy away from the limelight. A good heart. Ronin.

Not the petty crim’ like his kindred brother (Ronny), this guy is far suaver and savvier. Sure, Ronnie breaks the rules, but not the ones that will land you in jail, and if he ever did he’s smart enough to enact them when no one is looking. Ronnie is a man for the good times with plenty of energy, and he attracts plenty of good attention. Not one to sit around idle for days on end.
Ronny chuckles a lot and gets on with things and, 25% of the time, at least, he hides his small-scale crimes quite nicely.

Like his cousin below, Rorey plans and thinks big. Is it his money he's playing with? Given the likelihood of success, it's probably a smart move if it isn't. And fear not, despite the bravado Rorey ain't the total fool.

Big name. Big responsibility. You said you can hang-glide even though you’ve never done it, mate, which is fine. So, now, here you are, on the mountain side, strapped in. Are you still ready?......Yeah?.....okay, go for it!
(and a hush goes through the crowd as he leaps.......)
Firm but kind, Rosario is the Gentle Patriarch.
The goofy firebrand and potent rebel, although you’ll only ever see him in action when he’s really fired-up about something, which is never that often.
TAKE ALL PRECAUTION! Keep a tranquilliser gun trained on him at all times, even if he appears tame, because he might be faking it. You just never know.

Mmmm, well no surprises here kids. Rosso is one part Ross, obviously, one part Ian, and one part Johnny. At his heart Rosso has a deep-seated desire to do genuine good in the world, despite his playful irreverence, and if he felt the need he could successfully sell biscuits to workers in a biscuit factory.

Uncompromising and friendly, Rouke isn't a flippant personality, although he does get bored after a while. Sure, we all do from time to time, but Rouke won't wait for someone else to amuse him. Like a heavy screwdriver opening a big tin of paint, Rouke will jimmy and push and lever either a person or a situation in order to (a) find out what's going on or (b) extract some kind of unpredictable reaction in the name of entertainment.
Fast thinker. He moves from place to place, from person to person and from moment to moment so quickly that he is effectively unembarrassable.
See James, except Row lacks the disguises and he doesn’t suffer from occasional mood swings.
He ain't no grease monkey, although he might be a swinger, who knows? What he is, is cool.

Country boy and an a rather elemental man. Rowen is interested in life and always ready to learn, and like Kenny and a few other pseudo-mysterious cats out there, most of his friends are perpetually unsure of his whereabouts. Most important, his name opens you up when you say it and therefore there are very few bad/manipulative/evil Rowens out there in the wild....we think.
Don’t be coy Roy, it’s okay to be a boy and you’ll be surprised how many of them there are.

Royce rarely walks lightly and his blood lines can be traced all the way back to grand old England, a long, long time ago. Ridiculous, silly and pointless acts of childishness are none of his business, but that's not to say he isn't a big kid at heart. As a serious blue chip invester, however, he's not prone to putting himself in a position where everything can be squandered in a flash, and regardless whether it's his dignity, his financial state or his emotional and physical well-being. You with me?
See Reuben.

Rudolph has a grand laugh and a plethora of adoring friends but it’s true - what he makes up for in humour and levity he lacks in common sense. For example, Rudolph’s idea of a personal challenge is to drive across the country in his old Roller, stark bollock naked. After all, why take any aspect of life seriously?
Indeed.
The dodgy diamond trader.

Rudy has two possible outcomes in life. Either he grows big and dumb, real quick, and dominates the schoolyard as a bully, ending up in a highly evolved life of crime and drugs before dying by the sword (having lived by the sword), or he grows slowly under the weight of huge intellect and eventually spends his days and years in his room trying to hack into mainframe computer systems all over the world. (The latter Rudy spent his previous life as a field mouse, the former as a ship’s anchor.)

As a child, Rupert spent a lot of time getting into trouble without accidentally killing anyone and in adulthood he has carried-on his merry way. He probably isn’t super fit, which won’t bother him too much, he makes everyone laugh (basically whenever he wants), he’s more intelligent than the next bloke and overall he’s tremendous fun.

His name is heavy and curt like a lead weight plummeting to the bottom of the ocean, and so brief and spectacularly uninformative that there was no way he was ever going to end up like that. In actual fact, Russ secretly searches more intently than most, and definitely more than you might imagine from plainly observing him. His ego doesn’t run his life and all of us are better off for it. Thanks Russ.
Russell, the love Mussel, is like an irrepressible Cocker Spaniel who refuses to sit down and who, if remotely happy, will constantly try and have sex with your leg.
Camps. Surfs. Fishes. Eats. Thinks. Does.
In a perfect world Ry would just surf all day, every day. All the rest of his life is just filler for when the swell is missing.
The affable tradie’ that parties so hard on the weekend he sometimes does himself damage.
Good guy. His ego might drive his existence but he is sufficiently cluey and compassionate, and his only really negative attribute is that he is occasionally extremely lazy.

Get him outside and he’ll find his way, but don’t give him too much rope. He sometimes forgets what he’s attached to, hence he’s liable to fly away into the universe on a whim, in which case we won’t see him for yonks. Anyway, he’s fun to have around so it’s not like keeping an eye on him presents an issue.

My god, have you ever seen anyone spend so long in front of the mirror trying to get a tiny, 1 inch lick of head hair positioned exactly right? We haven't. Ryker, some advice from up here in the commentary box: go and volunteer for the Salvation Army for a week or two, then you'll begin to understand what really matters.

In the band he plays the electric organ and his long curly hair makes it impossible to see the tension and the passion on his face, which is a pity. The upshot of all this is that he never has as many girls after him at the post-concert party because very few people know who he is.

Ryle is placid like an old eagle that can’t be bothered chasing after the females any more. He’s just content to sit on his perch, take in the view, admire the surrounds and generally go about his business of being sufficiently noble.
The 'artistic' version of Riley.
Yeah, Ryot is a scream until he gets arrested, which is often.

Sacha would make a great politician because he is one of the least irascible people in the Kingdom. Time - Sacha seems to have plenty of it. No one really knows why, although it might be because people are never sure they're meeting a man, and so it take a few seconds to get their head around the fact. By the time they've come to terms with the situation, Sacha has summed them up completely, which has the side effect of producing a calm and surprising environment for everybody. The upshot of all this is that Sacha is a skilled and unassuming leader who enjoys change and a challenge. But yes, when or if he wants to party, you can expect not to be going home before dawn.
“Ah, sleeps for pussies!” he barks at 4 in the morning to a dwindling crowd in the lounge room. “Come on! Fuckin’ wake up! I’ve just cracked the last keg!”

He balks, he turns, he jumps, occasionally without even looking. But, as a balanced thespian who indulges in the beauty of the small things, his actions always aim to highlight such moments to the world around him. Sackie is an underrated performer.

I wonder if he has Lebanese parents? Anyway, like a male Louie before him, Saleem is cool and suave and ever-so-good with the ladies. He rarely works with his hands and he doesn't spend hours and days pondering his own mental processes.
The gentle sailor.

The name of the human being inside Humphrey B. Bear or Big Bird, if you know either of them. In essence, Sam is funny and friendly, and he can act. Better than that, actually, he doesn’t have a nasty bone in his body.

Responsibilities: Capital Zero.
Capacity for hard work and long periods of intense concentration: Capital Zero.
But by god, women adore him and he can dance like no one’s business. 
And Samba is lucky so don’t write him off just coz’ he’s late.

Yep, well, whaddaya do? The word falls out of your mouth as easy as pouring a glass of warm milk down a dairy farming hill, and leaves you smiling. What does this mean? Well, Sammey has barely a nasty bone in his body, and the girls he's managed to piss off only got angry because he forgot the instructions he was given. What do you do? There's only so much a country boy can handle at once.
Sammy is a textbook knockabout lad who cruises along, quite nicely. As a perpetual optimist people are always happy to see him, and he’s never deliberately hurt anyone who didn’t deserve it.

These days you'll often hear people sprout on about how everyone's opinion is none of their business. It's a true statement, give or take, but few people are beholden to this ethos, naturally. Samson is one of these cats. It's not that he's arrogant, and he's definitely not conceited, it's just that Samson was plonked here on Earth by the gods, or whoever tends these matters, to show others how to give unconditional love at all times.
In many ways he's like the Pied Piper. Indeed, he might just be the Pied Piper of Love. Thank you Samson.

If Samuel never gets called Sam or Sammy by his friends, then he attended a renowned private boys’ school, dated the girls from the correct private girls’ school and was given a brand new Audi for is 18th birthday. I’ve just asked the boys in the commentary box for any more info and they’re not even listening. Sorry.

No, he’s probably not originally Australian, American or English but how many of us really are? His Northern European eccentricities make him honest in dealings, easy in company and he is skilled at sliding his way out of a maze.

As a retired industrialist who used to deal in rivers of gold, Sandy spends every Friday night in an expensive private mens’ club sucking on his sherry and his cigars, divvying out insider’s-advice to some of the doting young guns who hang on his every word.

Sanjay has all the moves and he knows most of the answers, and if he doesn’t know them he’ll perform a short skit in order to jolt his memory, or the memory of others. Alternately, he’ll perform a skit in order to entertain all of those people aforementioned, just for the hell of it. Has anyone thought of trying to clone him?

His cheeky grin hides the fact that he deals with heated situations very well. Like a few other likely lads out there, his moves on the dance floor force one to consider if perhaps he has a living mouse down his underpants, and we're all better off for his exuberance. Peaceful in love and life, Santiago gravitates people towards him and he's not as lazy as you think.

The extravagant flamingo whose manners and joie de vivre ingratiate him to most people. He does have expensive taste, which is fine, so long as he’s playing with his own money. Know what I mean chief?
Light-hearted. He instigates the good times and, often, he is actually quite devious. (Note: In a past life his name was Maria.)

Surprisingly composed, Sascha holds it all back until it's almost too late. Just when you think he's missed, or screwed up, or waited too long, BANG!, he makes his move. Sascha was not built to live in any kind of office, especially that of an accounting firm. That'd kill him.
Sasha will literally froth at the mouth at the prospect of going dancing.
The tiny marsupial mouse who scurries about in the quiet of the night, going about his business quite happily and very efficiently. No one can tell you what colour his eyes are.
The Coach.
Saverio is actually quite humble, although he's rather disappointed by the expectations that people place on him. He's just a normal guy, remember.

The upbeat man-about-town. Like Deano way before him, he doesn't let a bad situation or an ill-wind prevent him from standing up and saying, "Well, enough of this. I'm off!"

In life he is enjoyed by his colleagues and peers as an eternal optimist, and when he's miserable, which is both rare and funny, actually, you're liable to never know about it.
Penis photographer.

Yeah, Saxby went to New Orleans once. The day after he got there a hurricane tore the city to shreds and he came home with an STD after getting drunk and sleeping with a giant, black prostitute in the back of a van. We think she was a woman.

Well, you can't say he isn't dramatic. Did you know Saxon is the only creature in the entire Kingdom who likes to play the trombone while making love? 

(Just kidding - we WISH he was that inventive in bed.)

Predictably, here we have a scamp by name and a scamp by nature. Just imagine for a moment, if you will, that every male in the Middle East sported some kind of analogous (Arabic-sounding) name? A word that bounced and sang and pranced as you said it? I tell you what would happen: Page one line one, violence and hatred would immediately cease. The entire population would suddenly appreciate women and gays, they'd celebrate spiritual and cultural differences, they'd rejoice in spontaneous outbursts of play acting and song, and people would actively share everything with those who were less fortunate. And, fuck me, then we'd have peace on Earth. So, yes, Scamp is not supposed to be serious or overly responsible, and for this we are eternally grateful.
The perennial shit-giver who takes nothing seriously.

If he's going to gamble he won't be doing it out the front with all the drunken cattle from the country, sitting proudly in front of their pile of $2 chips. No sir. He'll be out the back in an exclusive room where the ante ain't for the faint hearted. No one knows what he's thinking and that's just the way he likes it...
Sure, he picks his nose in public but Scott is young at heart, enthusiastic in life and more ambitious than most.

A physically active individual, people meet Scotty for the first time and feel like they know him, and this empathy gives him a huge scope for success. His great skill, however, is to keep a cool head when others begin to panic and if you were on an Irene-affected flight, you’d want Scotty sitting next to you so you could swap jokes until you bought-it.

The nickname given to a man who has never left home, and who has therefore failed to launch. 

Note from Management: Careful son, if you don’t sort out your shit it just might stick. Good luck.
Sean masturbates a tremendous amount, some-times in public, occasionally in car parks.

No one can tell you about Sean and so you will have to go and find out for yourself. You’ll need to walk up into the hills and seek out that old guy with the dogs. He’ll give you some bizarre instructions and a special leather pouch that, hopefully, will contain a strange amulet. Sounds weird, huh? Anyway, many people have vanished trying to find him but what I can tell you is that he is a good and remarkable man – if he is a man. 
(Note: There are rumours that he has human bones hanging from his ears and is over 13,000 years old.....)

It’s a long story, but the short version is that Seany isn’t into long, involved lectures, so university is probably out. What he is great at is making things up on the fly. Don’t give him too many plans right now, give them to him when he asks for them, and whether you think that’s too late or not. He’s just better thinking and planning on his feet.
We would expect Sebastian to be a deep thinker and he nearly gets there. What he is, though, is a complicated and good soul. (Note: If he has blonde hair he is not from Earth.)
Seddon, you have muddy pants again. Please go and change them. What were you doing in the mud again, boy?
Never shy and often the loudest person present, Sergio expects a lot from people and from life, although he never seems that serious when it gets down to the balls of it.
Setanta is what Santa Claus turns into after drinking a bottle and a half of Irish Whisky.  (It’s the only time you’ll see him agro or horny.)

Just as you begin to say his name it suddenly ends in a twisted mess, which is a similar sensation to suddenly finding yourself in a car that’s about to crash into a wall at speed, when only a few seconds earlier you could have sworn you were lying on the couch and about to fall asleep. Very disconcerting. Depending on the car, the wall and the type of beach, it can be an experience which is either disastrous or bloody funny.
Seymour would make a good private detective. He’s fanatical about detail and is obsessed with some of his theories, which he one day hopes to prove.

Muslim. Shabeer’s method of jumping from a diving board is to bounce twice, leaping straight up into the air, bringing the knees up to the chest which are clutched with both hands, and then entering the water with the cheeks full of air and a very serious expression on the face. If done correctly the result is a tremendous explosion.

For such a ridiculous name Shadow has turned out quite well. He can joke with anyone - yes, of course he knows he has a strange name - and far from shy away from it, he enjoys the varied reactions that he receives from it. On occasion it's even permitted him to make friends and meet women, so it's not all bad. He won't ever have a regular job, whatever that means.
The sporting umpire. Wears tight shorts.

Tactful. It would take an outrageous piece of behaviour for Shafiq to stand up and admonish someone at a dinner, for instance. Unless you questioned his parentage, naturally, in which case he’d lunge across the table with whatever implement he could get his hands on. Anything less than that, he’d probably just conspire to catch up with the offending person afterwards.

Great mates with Baz, Nugget, Shane and Johnno, Shagger’s role in life is one bordering on the Court Jester, although he’s generally too busy organising the upcoming booze up. Truth be known, he laughs more than he shags, indeed, he even laughs while he’s shaggin’. His girlfriend has a big infectious laugh, just like him.

Please, tell me lord, that young Shai is an outdoors kind of guy? Coz if he isn't, he'll tear the house apart like a bloody psychotic Jack Russell left alone for a day and half. This boy needs something to do, and he loves the sun. So, ban all video games, banish the TV to the scrap heap, kick him up the arse when he whinges and get him outside.

Okay, so his hands tremble, but his mind doesn’t. Almost devoid of an ego, Shakey goes about his business and is quick to lend a hand. He understands motors and wood, and not that I mean to harp on about it but, if anything, his ego could do with a boost.
Shamus refuses to pay less than $130 for a bottle of wine.
Darren's mate.

Shannon wanders around in a daze of having little idea what to do. Unlike his female counterpart, his name trails off into nothing and leaves you kind of scratching your head. Although when he does figure it out he can be surprisingly (if not, secretly) industrious.
The funny ratbag who, in heaven, would piss himself with laughter if his death was ever recorded in the Darwin Awards.

It took a while for Sharne to figure out his place in life. He’s not Shane and he’s not Shaun, and as a result he works inside using his head and not outside with his hands. That’s not to say one is better than the other, for hard physical work is good for the soul, it’s just a case of Sharne having found his niche. He’s no macho idiot.

Shaun deals well in those things that he perceives to be the bare essentials, and this is one of his gifts. He listens to his inner-voice which is usually steady and correct and so, depending on how he is living and where he is in the world, if he deems that he needs to smuggle a cup of hash oil back into the country because he can’t bring himself to throw it out, he will use his impressive intellect and take the proper measures to ensure that (a) he doesn’t get caught and (b) all of his good friends get a chance to enjoy it.
Yep, not the most intriguing name but not to worry. Give him a job with his hands and not his acumen, and he’s fine, though, truth be known, he does possess a hidden artistic streak.

The last any one heard of him was two weeks ago when he left the resort he was staying at in Morocco, apparently without telling anyone. No one knows what he did with the hash oil that was given to him.
" …..Folks are dumb, where I come from…"

Shay is an obliging man with a humble heart and a physically fit frame. Rarely obese, Shay likes his beans and his nuts and his vegies and his lean meats, and he struggles with the indoor working life. IQ in the mid-range and he has a temper that rises to the quick surprisingly rapidly if pressed.

Yep, curly blonde hair on a man who was raised a long way out in the country. Solid and dependable, Sheep is in it for the long haul and yes, as a young man he got to handle plenty of creatures whose name he bears. He ain’t no city slicker.

Shehan has a heritage that stems from somewhere near India, possibly Sri Lanka. His name nearly sounds like he’s shearin’, which makes sense because he’s a straight up fellow who is as honest as he is affable.
Sheldon gives an elequant speech but he is awkward on the dance floor and unimaginative in the boudoir.

Good friends with Nathan, Shelton has more rules around eating than nearly anyone. The salt and pepper have to placed just so, his drink can't be too full or too empty, the meal has to be at the right temperature and whatever you do, don't speak to him while he's chewing.

First cousin of Herman.
Very high IQ.
Zero common sense.
The school principal wanted to expel him for accidentally setting Miss Johnson’s car on fire, for instance, but how can you expel the smartest kid in the school?
He might be gay, he might be straight, but whatever he is, he's definitely splendid and he aint no head-kicker. Shimmy Timmy is, however, The Man Most Mysterious. Beyond that, it's anyone's guess...
A slightly more polite version of Jimmy.
Shivers is more of a beer man, and he tends to keeps most things under wraps.
The actor’s actor who performs even when he’s asleep. It’s a rare gift.
Amazing isn't it, that a man can earn a quarter of a million dollars a year and not possess any.
A bolt from the blue who seems to trip over his feet occasionally. It’s all that navel gazing that does it, but usually he moves quite freely. A small message, Sholto: what’s the rush, boy?
Shorty is a funny guy who is smarter than he looks and who doesn’t ever quit.

Sure, his parents are fucking idiots, but that's another story. However, if you think the intellect of the man is wanting you better think again. Yep, Shrek will have his share of detractors and cop his fair share of crap for his name, but hear this: Shrek is like a fledgling company about to list on the stock exchange, and which has a bold, revolutionary new product that will improve life on earth. So, ignore the hype, look into his eyes and invest quick. He doesn't need your assurance, trust me.

(Pronounced 'sigh'). A nickname of many-a-simons, and a more loving and relaxed version by a long way. The hard-arsed competitive/secretive edge is gone and is replaced with your genial, loving and attentive fellow who everyone knows and adores. And rightly so.

The End.
Never nasty and dull, Sid gets on well with nearly everyone he meets because he gives them the benefit of the doubt.

In a habit that he developed in childhood, whenever he’s awaiting the arrival of his supper, Sidney grasps his knife and fork in each hand and bangs them repetitively and simultaneously on the table, shouting, “Yum, yum! Hungry! Yum yum! Hungry!”

Listen, Siegfried, we've been chatting up here in the commentary box and we suggest you take yourself off to a dramatic acting class. If you're going to carry on like a cheap watch 24/7 you might as well get paid for it. Plus, we'll get some sleep and the umpires can get their breath back.
The sort of man that changes his name.

As a naturally occurring physiological function, and as we’ve mentioned before, Germans don't really understand fart jokes. No, Silas generally isn't a German, but his take on life means that hidden or purely pointless jokes are often lost on him. Great friends with Nicholas, Benjamin and Christian, Silas has a gigantic IQ, detests fools and is quite open about his psychotic tendencies. (Advice from management: if you have one get him away from the city and into the outdoors.)

Silkie has a great desire to reform the education system. (Just kidding!) Indeed, did he go to school? Oh that's right, he started playing in that band and they got a record deal when he was in about year 10. Where is he now? Anyone? 
Oh, really? He's into climbing mountains? Without a safety rope, you say? Oh my god.
Oh well, just don’t tell the insurance companies, eh?

Yes, he’s a human. By definition Silvester is a funny guy with no chance of filling a highly responsible/senior position in the company, which, to be honest, is a pity because he’d do a fine job. He’s honest, despite the piss-taking, and he rewards initiative and a keen acumen. He’s also a kinky fucker in the bedroom.
Silvio is another grown-up boy whose enthusiasm is occasionally employed to hold up buildings. He has the capacity to be the world’s most adoring friend, as well as your most lethal enemy.
Simeon niggles and nestles his way into the ‘cool’ little nooks and crannies of the artistic world.

Everyone is a scavenger of some sort but this guy is better than most. On any given day Simon is any one of the following: Savvy, Sleazy, Sensible, Sensitive, Selfish and Strong. What makes life interesting for those who him is that he’s one of the few men who can do more than one task at a time, and do them well. Simon can be a smart, slippery customer so we urge you to bear this in mind. So, which Simon have you got today?…
Sinjin encourages the world to come to him, not the other way round.
Sisco rhymes with “Fuck, yeah!”
Skaife is quick to point the finger, unless he’s the one trying to pull a swifty.
